entries.en: Penned by the enigmatic merchant, Sirius, this tome unveils his 'humble' origins, draped in shadow and affluence. A tale of ambition where modesty meets grandeur.
entries.zh: 这本书由神秘商人西里乌斯执笔，揭示了他笼罩在阴影与财富之中的「卑微」出身。这是一个关于野心、谦逊与宏伟交织的故事。

entries.en: Sirius appears every %1$s Skyblock Days (Usally the %2$sth min of every real-life hour) in front of house in the Wilderness.
entries.zh: 西里乌斯每 %1$s 个空岛日出现一次（通常在现实中每小时的第 %2$s 分钟），位于荒野中的房屋前。

entries.en: Consume this item to get Sirius as an Abiphone Contact!
entries.zh: 食用此物品，即可将西里乌斯添加为阿比手机联系人！

entries.en: Skeletal Defense Your skeleton shoots an arrow dealing %1$sx your  Crit Damage when a mob gets close to you (%2$ss cooldown).

entries.en: [NPC] Angler Angus: Whenever you fish, make sure you're using some type of Bait.
entries.zh: [NPC] 垂钓者安格斯: 每次钓鱼时，记得用上某种鱼饵。

entries.en: [NPC] Angler Angus: You can store Bait in your inventory or Bait Sacks, which are unlocked at Raw Cod Collection III.
entries.zh: [NPC] 垂钓者安格斯: 鱼饵可以放在物品栏里，也可以放进鱼饵收纳袋，后者在生鳕鱼收集 III 解锁。

entries.en: [NPC] Angler Angus: Bait is automatically consumed whenever you cast your rod, so it's easy to use!
entries.zh: [NPC] 垂钓者安格斯: 每次抛竿都会自动消耗鱼饵，用起来很方便！

entries.en: [NPC] Angler Angus: I craft Fish Bait all the time because it's so easy to do - just a couple of Raw Cod and a Raw Salmon!
entries.zh: [NPC] 垂钓者安格斯: 我总是自己合成鱼饵，因为太简单了——只要几条生鳕鱼和一条生鲑鱼！

entries.en: [NPC] Angler Angus: Here, I've got some spare Fish Bait for ya!
entries.zh: [NPC] 垂钓者安格斯: 来，我这儿有些多余的鱼饵送你！
你领取了鱼饵！

entries.en: [NPC] Angler Angus: Fish Bait seems to give a really effective  Fishing Speed boost!
entries.zh: [NPC] 垂钓者安格斯: 鱼饵似乎能非常有效地提升  钓鱼速度！

entries.en: [NPC] Angler Angus: All Baits serve some specialized purpose, so be sure to keep some on you at all times!
entries.zh: [NPC] 垂钓者安格斯: 每种鱼饵都有专门的用途，所以随时都要带上一些！

entries.en: [NPC] Angler Angus: If you have any questions about Bait, you can view my Bait Guide at any time!
entries.zh: [NPC] 垂钓者安格斯: 如果你对鱼饵有任何疑问，随时可以查看我的鱼饵指南！
丰收盛宴

entries.en: [NPC] Angler Angus: You can also use /bait as a shortcut if you aren't feeling like paying me a visit!

entries.en: Bait can be stored in your inventory
entries.zh: 鱼饵可以放在物品栏里，

entries.en: or Bait Sacks, which are unlocked at Raw Cod III.
entries.zh: 也可以放进鱼饵收纳袋，后者在生鳕鱼 III 解锁。

entries.en: When you cast your rod, Bait is automatically consumed and its buff is applied.
entries.zh: 抛竿时会自动消耗鱼饵并获得其增益效果。

entries.en: Some Baits, like Fish Bait, increase your  Fishing Speed, which makes it quicker to catch fish.
entries.zh: 部分鱼饵（如「鱼饵」）可以提高你的  钓鱼速度，让你更快钓到鱼。

entries.en: Other Baits, like Spiked Bait, make you more likely to catch Sea Creatures.
entries.zh: 其他鱼饵（如尖刺鱼饵）则能让你更容易钓到海怪。

entries.en: Fishing with Bait makes fishing easier, so keep plenty on hand!
entries.zh: 用鱼饵钓鱼会轻松很多，所以多备一些吧！

entries.en: Frog and Amphibian Family When threatened, the Tadgang has the unique ability to group together, merging their tiny forms to transform into a large, formidable frog.
entries.zh: 青蛙与两栖系列受到威胁时，蝌蚪帮拥有一种独特的能力：聚集在一起，将微小的身躯融为一体，化身为一只巨大而可怕的青蛙。

entries.en: Crime Family Gotta see off the competition Hitman Cooldown (Global)

entries.en: Bird Family Harpies have a wingspan of up to %1$s meters, their powerful wings enabling swift, agile flight and sudden, deadly dives.
entries.zh: 鸟类系列鹰身女妖的翼展可达 %1$s米，强健的双翼让它们能够迅捷灵活地飞行，并发动突然而致命的俯冲。

entries.en: A silent tiller revered for its unseen but vital role in the life cycle of the earth.
entries.zh: 一位沉默的耕耘者，因其在大地生命循环中看不见却至关重要的作用而备受尊崇。
花园访客到来的速度 %1$s%→+%2$s%加快。

entries.en: Lotusfish follow a strict diet consisting only of the various lotuses found around the Atoll.
entries.zh: 莲花鱼严格遵循一套食谱，只吃环礁周围的各种莲花。

entries.en: These undead creatures are driven by an insatiable greed, forever seeking out precious metals and jewels.
entries.zh: 这些亡灵生物受到永不满足的贪欲驱使，永远在搜寻贵金属和珠宝。

entries.en: Known for their agile movements, they dart between submerged roots and plants with ease.
entries.zh: 它们以灵活的身姿著称，能在水下的树根和植物之间轻松穿梭。

entries.en: These ethereal beings can create dense fog, obscuring vision and muffling sound.
entries.zh: 这些缥缈的生灵能制造浓雾，遮蔽视线、掩盖声响。

entries.en: This unusual blaze confounds its enemies with its disorienting appearance, attacking from unexpected angles.
entries.zh: 这种奇特的烈焰人以令人晕头转向的外表迷惑敌人，从意想不到的角度发起攻击。

entries.en: Bug Family A particularly large and intimidating beetle, though it spends most of its time fighting other Stag Beetles.
entries.zh: 虫类系列一种体型格外庞大、令人生畏的甲虫，不过它大部分时间都在和其他锹形虫打架。

entries.en: Squid Family A silent guardian of the sky, its vast wings are a tranquil spectacle, often seen soaring high above with a serene grace.
entries.zh: 鱿鱼系列天空中沉默的守护者，它宽大的双翼是一道宁静的奇景，常常可见它在高空翱翔，姿态安详优雅。

entries.en: Yogs bounce menacingly through the fiery depths, their magma-like bodies radiating intense heat.
entries.zh: 尤格在炽热的深处气势汹汹地弹跳，它们岩浆般的身体散发出强烈的热量。

entries.en: These nocturnal hunters are masters of stealth, using their acute hearing to pinpoint the location of their prey.
entries.zh: 这些夜行猎手是潜行大师，凭借敏锐的听觉精确定位猎物的位置。

entries.en: Reptile and Lizard Family These amphibious creatures can regenerate lost limbs.
entries.zh: 爬行动物与蜥蜴系列这些两栖生物能够再生失去的肢体。

entries.en: These undead workers are driven by an insatiable need to mine, endlessly chipping away at the rock with their rusty tools.
entries.zh: 这些亡灵工人受到永不满足的挖矿欲望驱使，用生锈的工具没完没了地敲凿岩石。

entries.en: Born blind, Flitters often spend their entire lives flying in the same direction. Because of this, they can end up just about anywhere.
entries.zh: 翩飞虫生来失明，常常一生都朝着同一个方向飞行。正因如此，它们几乎可能出现在任何地方。

entries.en: Talk to me again if you ever want to give my Harp a try!
entries.zh: 想试试我的竖琴的话，随时再来找我！

entries.en: I watched the comings and goings in this park and it occurred to me that a very common problem plagues these areas.
entries.zh: 我一直留意着这座公园里的来来往往，发现这一带被一个很常见的问题困扰着。

entries.en: You need an experienced person to handle the situation.
entries.zh: 这种情况需要一个有经验的人来处理。

entries.en: Those troublesome creatures are ruining everything and must be dealt with. Do you understand?
entries.zh: 那些麻烦的小东西正在毁掉一切，必须解决掉。你明白吗？

entries.en: This park deserves better and I want to see it flourish like it used to be.
entries.zh: 这座公园值得更好的样子，我想看到它像从前一样繁茂。

entries.en: Let us keep this between us, and I will generously reward you for your efforts.
entries.zh: 这件事就你知我知，你出了力，我会重重酬谢。

entries.en: The moles must be dealt with, and I am sure you will do so quickly and quietly.
entries.zh: 那些鼹鼠必须解决掉，我相信你会办得又快又安静。

entries.en: Great. First thing we need is to build some traps.
entries.zh: 很好。首先我们需要造一些陷阱。

entries.en: For that however, I need %1$s Jungle Logs, should be enough to get things going.
entries.zh: 不过为此我需要 %1$s 个丛林原木，应该够开工了。

entries.en: Moles loooove carrots, they are just too good to resist.
entries.zh: 鼹鼠超——爱胡萝卜，它们根本抵挡不住。

entries.en: Don't worry, I've got a stash ready.
entries.zh: 别担心，我已经备好一批了。

entries.en: Just thinking about them makes me... Uhm, I mean makes them come out of their hiding space.
entries.zh: 光是想想它们就让我……呃，我是说让它们从藏身处钻出来。

entries.en: Fantastic, that's all I needed to build the traps.
entries.zh: 太好了，造陷阱需要的东西都齐了。

entries.en: It will take me some time to assemble them, so you should come back later.
entries.zh: 组装它们得花点时间，你晚点再来吧。
你好呀！
欢迎来到加拉蒂亚！

entries.en: I'm here to give you your own Heart of the Forest.
entries.zh: 我是来给你一颗属于你自己的森林之心的。
这里每个人都有一颗！

entries.en: The Heart of the Forest can be found in your SkyBlock Menu while on Galatea.
entries.zh: 在加拉蒂亚时，可以在空岛菜单里找到森林之心。

entries.en: You can unlock and level up various perks and abilities there.
entries.zh: 你可以在那里解锁并升级各种天赋和技能。

entries.en: You can talk to Agatha near the lake to gain HOTF Exp.
entries.zh: 你可以去湖边找阿加莎谈话，获得森林之心经验。

entries.en: To level up your perks you will need Forest Whispers. These are obtained by cutting trees!
entries.zh: 升级天赋需要森林低语，砍树就能获得！

entries.en: I also have tasks for you to do while on this island.
entries.zh: 你在这座岛上时，我还有一些任务交给你。

entries.en: For each task I will reward you handsomely!
entries.zh: 每完成一个任务，我都会好好奖励你！

entries.en: I hear you've been busy in The Park. Charlie's a good friend.
entries.zh: 听说你在公园里忙了不少事。查理是我的好朋友。

entries.en: Friends of my friends are my enemies - whoops, my friends I mean!
entries.zh: 朋友的朋友就是我的敌人——哎呀，我是说朋友！

entries.en: You might be wondering why I'm on top of this bush?
entries.zh: 你可能在想，我为什么待在这丛灌木上？

entries.en: I'm camping it to get the berries before someone else.
entries.zh: 我在这儿蹲守，好赶在别人之前摘到浆果。

entries.en: I'm joking! I would never do such thing, haha!
entries.zh: 开玩笑的！我才不会干这种事，哈哈！
绝不。

entries.en: See for yourself! Look, a berry just appeared, simply punch the bush to collect it!
entries.zh: 你自己看！瞧，刚冒出一颗浆果，打一下灌木就能收集！
很好！

entries.en: Berries are pretty useful to craft Hunting items.
entries.zh: 浆果可以用来合成狩猎物品，很有用。

entries.en: If you want to learn more about Hunting, you should talk to David Hunterborough next door.
entries.zh: 想多了解狩猎的话，去找隔壁的大卫·亨特伯勒聊聊吧。

entries.en: I'm more specialized in tree cutting.
entries.zh: 我更擅长的是砍树。

entries.en: Have you ever heard about  Sweep?
entries.zh: 你听说过  横扫吗？

entries.en: So you probably know that Sweep allows you to cut multiple logs at once.
entries.zh: 那你大概知道，横扫能让你一次砍下多块原木。

entries.en: For example, %1$s Sweep should allow you to cut %2$s logs.
entries.zh: 比如，%1$s 横扫应该能让你砍下 %2$s 块原木。

entries.en: Except that some Trees are tougher than others!
entries.zh: 只不过有些树比别的树更坚硬！

entries.en: If a Tree has a high Toughness, you will need more than %1$s Sweep to cut %2$s logs!
entries.zh: 如果一棵树的韧性很高，你需要超过 %1$s 横扫才能砍下 %2$s 块原木！

entries.en: This Fig Tree right next to us, has a Toughness of %1$s.
entries.zh: 我们旁边这棵无花果树的韧性是 %1$s。

entries.en: So I suggest you use an axe with at least +%1$s Sweep.
entries.zh: 所以我建议你用至少有 +%1$s 横扫的斧头。

entries.en: Here, let me give you this legendary axe that has been passed down my whole family tree for %1$s generations.
entries.zh: 来，我把这把在我家族里传了 %1$s 代的传奇斧头送给你。

entries.en: Just kidding, this axe is terrible, but it will do for now.
entries.zh: 开玩笑的，这把斧头烂透了，不过眼下凑合着用吧。
不过还没完……

entries.en: The trees on this island are even tougher if they are not cut in the proper order.
entries.zh: 这座岛上的树如果不按正确顺序砍，会变得更坚硬。

entries.en: For example, you should cut the trunks of the Fig Trees first!
entries.zh: 比如，你应该先砍无花果树的树干！

entries.en: Otherwise, you won't be that efficient at cutting them down.
entries.zh: 不然你砍起来就没那么有效率了。

entries.en: You can also throw some axes into the air by right-clicking with them in your hand.
entries.zh: 手持斧头右键，还能把它扔到空中。

entries.en: Have a go at cutting down this Fig Tree behind me.
entries.zh: 试着把我身后这棵无花果树砍倒吧。
不错嘛！

entries.en: You may have noticed already, but cutting down a tree here will grant you a Tree Gift.
entries.zh: 你可能已经注意到了，在这里砍倒一棵树会获得一份树木馈赠。

entries.en: Tree Gifts are rewarded to everyone who helped to cut down a tree.
entries.zh: 所有帮忙砍倒这棵树的人都能获得树木馈赠。

entries.en: Cutting down enough Fig or Mangrove Trees will level up your milestones and grant extra  Sweep.
entries.zh: 砍倒足够多的无花果树或红树，会提升你的里程碑并获得额外的  横扫。

entries.en: This means that it's better to group together to cut down trees around here.
entries.zh: 所以在这一带最好组队一起砍树。

entries.en: There is a lot more to know about cutting down trees, so talk to me if you want to learn more.
entries.zh: 关于砍树还有很多门道，想了解更多就来找我。
大惊吓……
它就在那儿！

entries.en: At least I think. You can never be too sure until it's really happening...
entries.zh: 至少我是这么觉得的。不真发生之前，谁也说不准……

entries.en: Something has to be done, otherwise things are going to get way too spooky...
entries.zh: 得做点什么才行，不然事情就要变得太吓人了……

entries.en: Last time my assistant was alright.
entries.zh: 上次我的助手还好好的。
是你吗？

entries.zh: 计时已暂停，但效果仍然有效。

entries.en: Prefers to sleep in, grumpy if disturbed.
entries.zh: 喜欢睡懒觉，被吵醒就发脾气。

entries.en: Despite the lack of organs, still managed to be promoted.
entries.zh: 虽然没有器官，却还是升职了。

entries.en: Never stopped anyone from entering the factory, but is trying his best.
entries.zh: 从来没拦住过谁进工厂，但它已经尽力了。

entries.en: Kept in servitude for breaking blocks around the factory.
entries.zh: 因为在工厂附近乱挖方块而被罚做苦役。

entries.zh: 找到蒙特祖玛之魂的两块碎片。

entries.zh: 在裂隙中破解一桩反向谋杀案。

entries.zh: 拒绝使用任何能力，因为能力太 OP 了，而你从不滥用 OP 的东西。

entries.en: Ancient robots which protect the lands of the Precursor from whomever dares to trespass.
entries.zh: 守护先驱者之地、驱逐一切擅闯者的远古机器人。
宝石帮的幕后主使。

entries.en: Beautiful critters that roam around harmlessly in Fairy regions.
entries.zh: 在妖精区域里无害游荡的美丽小生物。

entries.en: Team Treasurite is up to no good. Prepare for trouble!
entries.zh: 宝石帮又在干坏事了。准备迎接麻烦吧！

entries.en: They say that the juice of these slimes has valuable magical properties.
entries.zh: 据说这些史莱姆的汁液具有珍贵的魔法属性。

entries.en: These infectious worms nourish themselves from Amethyst veins.
entries.zh: 这些具有传染性的蠕虫靠紫水晶矿脉为生。

entries.en: Like their skeleton counterparts, these zombies have bedazzled themselves throughout the years.
entries.zh: 和它们的骷髅同伴一样，这些僵尸多年来把自己打扮得珠光宝气。

entries.en: These pigmen will defend their redstone to the death.
entries.zh: 这些猪人会誓死保卫它们的红石。

entries.en: Take the things you love in life, and run with them.
entries.zh: 把你生命中所爱的东西带上，带着它们跑吧。

entries.en: It is hard to find that which you cannot see.
entries.zh: 看不见的东西最难找。

entries.en: Does nothing but steal, even from its fellow goblins.
entries.zh: 除了偷东西什么也不干，连自己的哥布林同伴都偷。

entries.en: Guardians of the Gate to the icy caves below.
entries.zh: 通往下方冰窟之门的守卫。

entries.en: The Goblins have plagued the Dwarven Mines for centuries.
entries.zh: 哥布林已经为祸矮人矿洞数百年。

entries.en: Powder and coal replaces ash and soot!
entries.zh: 粉末和煤炭取代了灰烬与烟尘！

entries.en: The real treasure was the gold we found along the way.
entries.zh: 真正的宝藏是我们一路上找到的黄金。

entries.zh: 查看你在死水河岸钓鱼时击杀过的所有海怪。

entries.zh: 查看你钓鱼时击杀过的所有冬季海怪。

entries.en: The real enemy isn't the dead - it's the living.
entries.zh: 真正的敌人不是死人，而是活人。

entries.en: Dashingly striking, watch for this spider's long jumps!
entries.zh: 冲刺迅猛，小心这只蜘蛛的远距离跳跃！

entries.en: These Skeletons just never stay dead.
entries.zh: 这些骷髅就是死不透。

entries.en: Though weak alone, they find strength in numbers.
entries.zh: 单个很弱，成群就很强。

entries.en: If you think you've killed this spider, think again.
entries.zh: 如果你以为杀死了这只蜘蛛，那就再想想吧。
拥有超自然的能力，可以……附身……于你。
在各个空岛岛屿上作祟。

entries.en: Inside the Dragon's Den, there is no escape from the fury of the beasts.
entries.zh: 在巨龙巢穴里，没有谁能逃过巨兽的怒火。

entries.en: Forged from the forces of hot and cold.
entries.zh: 由冷与热的力量锻造而成。

entries.en: The top lieutenants of the void heraldry.
entries.zh: 虚空纹章的高级副官。

entries.en: Unwavering in their devotion to the Dragon.
entries.zh: 对巨龙的忠诚坚定不移。

entries.zh: 击杀一只属于该族系的怪物，即可在怪物图鉴中解锁它！

entries.zh: 来自独一无二（就像雪花一样）来源的永久属性。

entries.zh: 虽是天赋异禀的弓箭手，却热爱拳头相见。

entries.zh: 和普通的九头蛇不同，这条连身体都会再长一个！

entries.en: 1. A ghast shoots fireballs at you.
entries.zh: 1. 恶魂会向你发射火球。

entries.en: 1. Hit the mob with the correct sword.
entries.zh: 1. 使用正确的剑攻击怪物。

entries.en: 1. Jump through the open holes in the moving walls.
entries.zh: 1. 从移动墙壁的开口中跳过。
1. 将怪物击入岩浆。

entries.en: 1. Shoot the targets before they disappear.
entries.zh: 1. 在靶子消失前射中它们。

entries.en: 1. Stare directly at a moving skeleton.
entries.zh: 1. 直视移动中的骷髅。

entries.en: 1. Temporary blocks will spawn to stand on.
entries.zh: 1. 场上会生成可供站立的临时方块。

entries.en: 2. Earn points by avoiding fireballs over time.
entries.zh: 2. 持续躲避火球即可得分。

entries.en: 2. Earn points by staying on the platform.
entries.zh: 2. 留在平台上即可得分。

entries.en: 2. Every 30 seconds, gain a new type of sword.
entries.zh: 2. 每 30 秒获得一种新的剑。
2. 绿色目标价值 8 分。

entries.en: 2. If the block is red it'll disappear soon!
entries.zh: 2. 方块变红后很快就会消失！

entries.en: 2. More accurate staring gives more points and time in the arena.
entries.zh: 2. 视线越精准，获得的分数和竞技场时间越多。

entries.en: 2. Some mobs give more points than others.
entries.zh: 2. 不同怪物提供的分数不同。
3. 避开会扣分的怪物！

entries.en: 3. Don't get pushed into the lava!
entries.zh: 3. 别被推入岩浆！

entries.en: 3. Don't hit the mob with the wrong sword.
entries.zh: 3. 不要用错误的剑攻击怪物。

entries.en: 3. Don't look away for too long or fall in the lava!
entries.zh: 3. 不要移开视线太久，也别掉进岩浆！

entries.en: 3. Don't stand around and fall into the lava.
entries.zh: 3. 别原地发呆掉进岩浆。

entries.en: 3. Don't trip and fall into lava!
entries.zh: 3. 别脚滑掉进岩浆！
3. 黄色目标价值 16 分。
4. 红色目标价值 32 分。

entries.en: After completing a Catacombs or Kuudra run, if you don't open a chest, I'll save it here for you!
entries.zh: 完成地下墓穴或库德拉挑战后，若你没有开启宝箱，我会替你保存在这里！

entries.en: But beware, I can only hold 60 runs worth of chests, and will discard them after 72 hours!
entries.zh: 但请注意，我最多只能保存 60 场挑战的宝箱，并会在 72 小时后将其丢弃！

entries.en: Buy back any rewards you may have lost!
entries.zh: 买回任何可能遗失的奖励！

entries.en: CAREFUL: Salvaging an item will delete it forever!
entries.zh: 小心: 分解物品会将其永久删除！

entries.en: Catch 15 Bronze tier or above Trophy Fish.
entries.zh: 捕获 15 种铜品质或更高品质的奖杯鱼。

entries.en: Catch Gold tier or above of all Trophy Fish.
entries.zh: 捕获所有奖杯鱼的金品质或更高品质。

entries.en: Catch Silver tier or above of all Trophy Fish.
entries.zh: 捕获所有奖杯鱼的银品质或更高品质。

entries.en: Catch all Trophy Fish at a tier to gain unique rewards!
entries.zh: 在同一品质捕获全部奖杯鱼，即可获得独特奖励！

entries.en: Catch all tiers of all Trophy Fish.
entries.zh: 捕获所有奖杯鱼的全部品质。

entries.en: Combine two Kuudra Armors to increase their tier.
entries.zh: 合成两件库德拉护甲，提升其等阶。

entries.en: Confirm when purchasing items worth at least half a million coins.
entries.zh: 购买物品时，若其价值至少达到 50 万硬币，则要求确认。

entries.en: Crimson Essence can be used to upgrade items at the Blacksmith.
entries.zh: 绯红精粹可用于在铁匠处升级物品。

entries.en: Dungeon items grant stat boosts while you are in Dungeons based on your Dungeoneering Skill level.
entries.zh: 地牢物品会根据你的地牢探险技能等级，在地牢内提供属性加成。

entries.en: Each item level upgrade ✪ grants a +%1$s% stat bonus and a +%2$s% bonus while in Dungeons.
entries.zh: 物品每提升一星 ✪，属性加成 +%1$s%，在地牢中加成 +%2$s%。

entries.en: Fillets all the Trophy Fish in your inventory, giving you MagmaFish as a reward!
entries.zh: 切制物品栏中的所有奖杯鱼，并将其转化为岩浆鱼作为奖励！

entries.en: Grants an 50% chance to change the color of a sheep when shearing it.
entries.zh: 剪羊毛时有 50% 概率改变羊的颜色。

entries.en: Insert all salvageable Epic items dropped from mobs in your inventory that have not been modified or upgraded.
entries.zh: 放入物品栏中所有由怪物掉落、未经改造或升级且可分解的史诗物品。

entries.en: Insert all salvageable Rare items dropped from mobs in your inventory that have not been modified or upgraded.
entries.zh: 放入物品栏中所有由怪物掉落、未经改造或升级且可分解的稀有物品。

entries.en: It's warm chocolatey goodness imbues you with the ability to overcome the heat death of the Blazing Volcano.
entries.zh: 温暖香甜的巧克力赋予你抵御炽焰火山致命高温的能力。

entries.en: Place a target item in the left slot and a sacrifice item in the right slot to combine!
entries.zh: 将目标物品放入左侧槽位，将献祭物品放入右侧槽位，即可合成！

entries.en: Pulling a blaze multiplies its damage taken by 2x and stops it from flying.
entries.zh: 被拖拽的烈焰人受到的伤害变为 2 倍，且无法继续飞行。
多个收纳袋的容量可以叠加。

entries.en: Sacrifice a Kuudra Armor into the target item.
entries.zh: 将一件库德拉盔甲献祭给目标物品。

entries.en: Salvage weapons and armor for materials.
entries.zh: 分解武器和护甲，获得材料。

entries.en: The item you are sacrificing in order to upgrade the item on the left should be placed in the slot on this side.
entries.zh: 将用于升级左侧物品的献祭物品放入这一侧的格子。

entries.en: The item you want to upgrade should be placed in the slot on this side.
entries.zh: 将需要升级的物品放入这一侧的格子。

entries.en: There is no contact which you can add back here.
entries.zh: 这里没有可以重新添加的联系人。

entries.en: This guide shows the different Essences you can obtain and which items can be upgraded using each one.
entries.zh: 本指南展示你可以获取的各种精粹，以及每种精粹可以升级的物品。

entries.en: Throw a hook to grab and pull blazes.
entries.zh: 投出钩爪，抓住并拖拽烈焰人。

entries.en: Tier Requirements: ✗ Have Elle take you to Kuudra!
entries.zh: 难度要求: ✗ 让艾尔带你前往库德拉！

entries.en: Trophy fish pickups of BRONZE quality go directly into your sacks.
entries.zh: 铜品质的奖杯鱼会直接进入你的收纳袋。

entries.en: Trophy fish pickups of SILVER quality go directly into your sacks.
entries.zh: 银品质的奖杯鱼会直接进入你的收纳袋。

entries.en: Upgrade items using materials and Essence to improve their stats!
entries.zh: 使用材料和精粹升级物品，提高其属性！

entries.en: You can use Essence to upgrade items or convert them into Dungeon items.
entries.zh: 你可以使用精粹升级物品，或将其转化为地牢物品。

entries.en: "If Magma Cream is the cement, Magma Chunks are the bricks." - Magma Cube local expert.
entries.zh: “如果说岩浆膏是水泥，那岩浆块就是砖头。”——当地岩浆怪专家

entries.en: At %1$s stacks, sneak to reset your stacks and perform a Ground Pound dealing damage to mobs within %2$s blocks. (Damage scales with your EHP, max %3$s).
entries.zh: 达到 %1$s 层时，潜行可消耗所有层数，发动地面重击重击，对 %2$s 格内的生物造成伤害。(伤害随有效生命值提高，上限 %3$s)。

entries.en: Increases your ☯ Combat Wisdom by %1$s➜%2$s while on the Crimson Isle and in the Kuudra Boss Fight.
entries.zh: 在绯红孤岛或库德拉首领战中,☯ 战斗智慧提高 %1$s➜%2$s。
将 %1$s 个%2$s带到城镇公告板。
击败小型首领%1$s %2$s 次！

entries.en: Rescue a trapped hostage in the other faction's territory!
entries.zh: 前往敌对阵营的领地，救出被困的人质！

entries.en: Complete the Test of %1$s with a minimum rating of %2$s.
entries.zh: 完成%1$s试炼，并达到 %2$s 级或更高评价。

entries.en: Increase how fast you can retrieve Elle's supplies from the lava.
entries.zh: 提高从熔岩中打捞艾尔的补给的速度。

entries.en: Increase how fast you build Elle's Ballista.
entries.zh: 提高建造艾尔的弩炮的速度。

entries.en: Energized Chunks deal more damage to Kuudra and increase the submerge counter more.
entries.zh: 充能块对库德拉造成的伤害更高，延长下潜倒计时的效果也更强。

entries.en: Mine faster and deal more damage to Kuudra's stomach orbs!
entries.zh: 更快地挖掘库德拉胃部的晶球，并对其造成更多伤害！

entries.en: Consume a Wheel of Fate to reroll the Shards in this chest to a higher rarity one, if possible.
entries.zh: 消耗一个命运之轮，将此箱中的碎片重抽为更高稀有度的碎片(如有可能)。

entries.en: You may only use a wheel once per Kuudra chest.
entries.zh: 每个库德拉箱子只能使用一次命运之轮。

entries.en: Take these supplies back to the middle island for Elle!
entries.zh: 把这些补给送回中央岛屿，交给艾尔！

entries.en: Take this Fuel Cell back to the Ballista to charge it!
entries.zh: 把燃料电池送回弩炮处，为它充能！

entries.zh: 正在为你的队伍开启库德拉巢穴……

entries.en: Opening Kuudra's Hollow for your party!
entries.zh: 正在为你的队伍开启库德拉巢穴！

entries.en: Removes your group from the queue so no other players can join.
entries.zh: 将你的队伍从队列中移除，不再让其他玩家加入。

entries.en: Auto revives you on death with %1$s% of your health, you can purchase multiple auto revives.
entries.zh: 死亡时自动复活，恢复 %1$s% 生命值。可购买多次自动复活机会。

entries.en: Time is money! Save a few clicks by filling up your quiver.
entries.zh: 时间就是金钱！一键装满箭袋，少点几下。

entries.en: Increase the speed your cannonballs fly through the air towards their target!
entries.zh: 提高炮弹飞向目标的速度！

entries.en: Increase the damage radius of your cannonball explosion, allowing you to hit more targets at once!
entries.zh: 扩大炮弹爆炸的伤害范围，一次命中更多目标！

entries.en: Increases the damage dealt of every cannonball shot. Cannon deals % Max HP damage on hit.
entries.zh: 提高每发炮弹的伤害。命中时，根据目标的最大生命值造成百分比伤害。

entries.en: Cannonballs deal bonus damage to Tentacles and Dropships!
entries.zh: 炮弹对触手和空投飞艇造成额外伤害！

entries.en: Increases the total amount of cannonballs shot out of your cannon each shot!
entries.zh: 增加每次开炮发射的炮弹数量！

entries.en: Decreases the cooldown between cannon shots, allowing you to shoot more rapidly!
entries.zh: 缩短开炮的冷却时间，使你能更频繁地射击！

entries.en: Increases the Ballista damage dealt to Kuudra.
entries.zh: 提高弩炮对库德拉造成的伤害。

entries.en: Specialise and focus on mastering the tasks needed to take down the beast himself!
entries.zh: 专注完成关键任务，为击倒巨兽铺平道路！

entries.en: Increase the damage dealt to Kuudra and his Tentacles.
entries.zh: 提高对库德拉及其触手造成的伤害。

entries.en: Climb into a cannon and get shot out! Great for getting around or flying into Kuudra's mouth!
entries.zh: 钻进大炮，把自己发射出去！无论是快速移动，还是飞进库德拉的嘴里，都很方便！

entries.en: I heard there exists a golden helmet that helps you swim faster in water. I would like to test its magical properties, could you bring me one?
entries.zh: 听说有一种金色头盔，能让人在水里游得更快。我想研究它的魔法性质，能带一顶来吗？

entries.en: For a price, I can upgrade and salvage your items!
entries.zh: 付点钱，我就能替你升级或分解物品！

entries.en: I don't sell my items to people who don't work with us.
entries.zh: 我不卖东西给外人。
欢迎来到我的巢穴！

entries.en: I'm a spider, I eat humans, I'm evil, etc... Just bear with me.
entries.zh: 我是蜘蛛，会吃人，还是个坏蛋什么的……你就先忍忍吧。

entries.en: I can't eat people wearing armor like you are.
entries.zh: 像你这样穿着护甲的人，我可吃不下。

entries.en: So why don't we make a deal?
entries.zh: 所以，我们来做笔交易怎么样？

entries.en: You bring me a delicious meal, one without any armor. I'll take them out and you get a reward!
entries.zh: 给我带一顿没穿护甲的美餐来。我负责把人吃掉，你负责拿奖励！

entries.en: What say you? Are you in?
entries.zh: 怎么样，干不干？
喂，你！嘘！

entries.en: I'm hungry again and I need a meal.
entries.zh: 我又饿了，得来顿饭。

entries.en: Could you come help me out at my Den? And bring a friend. ;)
entries.zh: 能来我的巢穴帮个忙吗？记得带位朋友来。;)
好吃好吃，都到肚子里来！
真是顿大餐！

entries.en: You are quite unscrupulous! Maybe we can be friends!
entries.zh: 你还真是不择手段！没准我们能做朋友！
呃……你自己来也行！
吧唧吧唧吧唧。
嗯——嗯嗯——太香啦！

entries.en: I'll give you something pretty useful. You'll see.
entries.zh: 我会给你一件挺有用的东西。到时候你就知道了。

entries.en: It has to be a human, and they cannot be wearing any armor. That's all I'm asking!
entries.zh: 必须是人类，而且不能穿任何护甲。我的要求就这么简单！

entries.en: I am famished! Bring me a meal and I will reward you!
entries.zh: 我快饿扁了！给我带顿饭来，少不了你的奖励！

entries.en: Bring me a human meal. No armor! Thank you!
entries.zh: 给我带份人类大餐来。不能穿护甲！谢啦！

entries.en: Hey, just the one I needed to hear from!
entries.zh: 嘿，正想找你呢！

entries.en: Maybe you can lure another unsuspecting meal when I'm hungry again?
entries.zh: 等我再饿的时候，你还能不能再骗顿毫无防备的大餐过来？
我也不知道，就随口一提。
我吃饱啦！
刚才真是饿坏了！谢啦！
这太荒唐了！

entries.en: Everyone knows time travel is a myth!
entries.zh: 谁都知道，时间旅行只是个传说！

entries.en: Excuse me, can't you see we are trying to have a conversation here?
entries.zh: 不好意思，你没看见我们正在谈话吗？
请别打扰我们！

entries.en: Just because you don't understand something doesn't mean it's not possible!
entries.zh: 你不理解一件事，不代表它不可能存在！

entries.en: Not even a century ago teleportation was thought to be impossible!
entries.zh: 甚至不到一个世纪前，传送还被认为是不可能的！

entries.en: And you yourself are capable of telepathy and telekinesis, which nobody knew were even possible recently!
entries.zh: 就连你自己都会心灵感应和念力——不久前大家还不知道这些能力真的存在！
哦，你是谁？

entries.en: Can you not disturb our conversation?
entries.zh: 能别打扰我们说话吗？
你好，旅行者！

entries.en: Kuudra will return one day but we must first put aside our differences and be ready.
entries.zh: 库德拉总有一天会归来；但在那之前，我们必须放下分歧，做好准备。

entries.en: We must show Kuudra that we stand united for its return.
entries.zh: 我们必须让库德拉看见:为了迎接它归来，我们已经团结一心。

entries.en: That's a very impressive armor set you are wearing, Kuudra would be impressed!
entries.zh: 你这身护甲真气派，库德拉看了一定会满意！

entries.en: We are united! Kuudra SHOW YOURSELF TO US.
entries.zh: 我们已经团结一心！库德拉，向我们现身吧！
它为什么没有现身……
也许它再也不会回来了……

entries.en: Thank you for your dedication adventurer, here is a token of my gratitude.
entries.zh: 感谢你一直以来的付出，冒险者。这份谢礼请收下。

entries.en: I see you holding something there...
entries.zh: 我看见你手里拿着什么了……

entries.en: And it seems as though you need some assistance.
entries.zh: 看来你需要搭把手。

entries.en: I would be able to provide it, but you came without the correct friend.
entries.zh: 我能帮你，不过你没带对伙伴来。

entries.en: Ah yes! You are here with the right companion.
entries.zh: 啊，没错！这次你带对伙伴了。

entries.en: It seems as though I can now properly assist you.
entries.zh: 这样我就能真正帮上你了。

entries.en: Let me go ahead and help you break down that item.
entries.zh: 来，我帮你把那件东西拆开。

entries.en: I wish you luck on your journey, adventurer!
entries.zh: 祝你一路顺风，冒险者！
嘿，你是冒险者吗？

entries.en: There are Relics I am searching for all around this island!
entries.zh: 我在这座岛上四处寻找遗物！

entries.en: But I am not strong enough to find them.
entries.zh: 可惜我实力不够，没法自己找齐。

entries.en: Take my compass to assist you in your journey!
entries.zh: 带上我的罗盘吧，路上能帮到你！

entries.en: Some spider eggs look a bit different, check behind those.
entries.zh: 有些蜘蛛卵看着不太一样，去它们后面找找。

entries.en: Are you sure you looked through every cobweb?
entries.zh: 你确定每一张蜘蛛网都翻过了吗？

entries.en: Down there, multiple rooms are blocked by cobwebs.
entries.zh: 下面有好几个房间，入口都被蜘蛛网封住了。

entries.en: The spiders are hiding some of the relics behind cobwebs.
entries.zh: 蜘蛛把一些遗物藏在了蜘蛛网后面。

entries.en: Look around spider eggs too, and cobwebs!
entries.zh: 蜘蛛卵周围也找找，还有蜘蛛网！

entries.en: Dig through gravel and you should be able to find a relic.
entries.zh: 挖开沙砾，应该就能找到一件遗物。

entries.en: I'm fairly sure there is a Relic nearby the dragon's tail.
entries.zh: 我很确定，龙尾巴附近有一件遗物。

entries.en: Don't forget to look down those caves, there are plenty down there lying around.
entries.zh: 别忘了下那些洞穴看看，里面散落着不少遗物。

entries.en: I managed to find one behind a spider egg, but once again I just couldn't reach it...
entries.zh: 我在一颗蜘蛛卵后面找到了一件，可惜又是够不着……

entries.en: When in doubt, check behind cobwebs!
entries.zh: 没头绪的时候，就去蜘蛛网后面找找！

entries.en: Look up around the caves, some spiders have their nest behind some cobwebs up there.
entries.zh: 在洞穴里多抬头看看，有些蜘蛛把巢筑在上面的蜘蛛网后头。

entries.en: I won't lie, some of those I could find myself, but I hate cobwebs.
entries.zh: 说实话，有几件我自己也找得到，可我实在讨厌蜘蛛网。

entries.en: Spiders often dig up mushrooms and create tiny rooms below, make sure to check those!
entries.zh: 蜘蛛经常在蘑菇下面挖小房间，记得去看看！

entries.en: There might be some below mushrooms too!
entries.zh: 蘑菇下面可能也有！

entries.en: One of the Relics is inside a tiny hole inside the caves.
entries.zh: 有一件遗物藏在洞穴里的一个小洞中。

entries.en: There are some relics up there hidden on the Spider's Den.
entries.zh: 蜘蛛巢穴上面也藏着一些遗物。

entries.en: Always check the roof in the caves, there are holes behind the cobwebs.
entries.zh: 在洞穴里记得看看洞顶，蜘蛛网后面有洞。

entries.en: You know that breakable wall in the caves? Look around it.
entries.zh: 知道洞穴里那堵能打破的墙吧？在它周围找找。

entries.en: Walk around the edges, you will probably find some cave entrances.
entries.zh: 沿着边缘走一圈，说不定能找到一些洞穴入口。

entries.en: I know a spot down in the caves but I just have no idea how to get into that room, the entrance is tiny.
entries.zh: 我知道下面洞穴里有个地方，可实在不知道怎么进那个房间，入口太小了。

entries.en: There is a relic a little below a Fairy Soul in the caves.
entries.zh: 洞穴里有一件遗物，就在一颗仙女之魂的下方不远处。

entries.en: Make sure you check all the mushrooms, sometimes there are tiny holes behind them.
entries.zh: 每一株蘑菇都要检查，有时它们后面藏着小洞。

entries.en: Sometimes look behind leaves too, there are many hidden caves on this island!
entries.zh: 也别忘了看看树叶后面，这座岛上藏着不少洞穴！

entries.en: I believe there is one down in the spider cave, behind a wall of cobwebs.
entries.zh: 我记得蜘蛛洞穴下方有一件，就在一面蜘蛛网墙后面。

entries.en: I heard rumors that there is a man-made hole inside the cave, with a Fairy Soul even!
entries.zh: 听说洞穴里有个人工挖出的洞，里面甚至还有仙女之魂！

entries.en: Are you sure you checked every mushroom?
entries.zh: 你确定每一株蘑菇都看过了吗？

entries.en: I found one below the house too but I really can't access it, I'm not sure how to get there...
entries.zh: 我还在房子下面找到了一件，可就是进不去，也不知道该怎么过去……

entries.en: Pretty sure there is one nearby the Dragon skull.
entries.zh: 龙的头骨附近肯定有一件。

entries.en: Wow! You found all the Relics.
entries.zh: 哇！你把所有遗物都找齐了。

entries.en: Take this as a reward, you've earned it.
entries.zh: 拿着，这是你应得的奖励。

entries.en: I found an interesting specimen in the spider caves, perhaps there's other stuff to find in there.
entries.zh: 我在蜘蛛洞穴里发现了个有趣的标本，那里说不定还有别的东西可找。

entries.en: Oh, hello there! You must be the adventurer who helped who helped me find all those relics.
entries.zh: 哦，你好！你就是帮我找齐那些遗物的冒险者吧。

entries.en: I came to visit your Garden and see if I could find any artifacts. I heard there might be something interesting here.
entries.zh: 我来你的花园逛逛，看看能不能找到什么古物。听说这里可能有些有意思的东西。

entries.en: Oh, that's alright. I understand you're busy with your own adventures.
entries.zh: 哦，没关系。我明白，你还有自己的冒险要忙。

entries.en: I learned more than I could have from success alone.
entries.zh: 这次失败教会我的，可比一帆风顺多得多。
而且我全都记下来了。

entries.en: Next time, things will be different, you will see.
entries.zh: 下次可就不一样了，等着瞧吧。

entries.en: I'm going back to the drawing boards.
entries.zh: 我得回去重新谋划一番。

entries.en: I've noticed how many people have been stopping by.
entries.zh: 我发现最近来这里的人越来越多了。

entries.en: My lab doesn't feel very secret anymore.
entries.zh: 我的实验室都快谈不上秘密了。

entries.en: I do not take any visitors at the moment.
entries.zh: 我现在不接待访客。

entries.en: Feel free to visit my laboratory.
entries.zh: 不过，你可以去我的实验室看看。

entries.en: I am currently working on my evil plan.
entries.zh: 我正在酝酿邪恶计划。

entries.en: A few more years and I should be ready.
entries.zh: 再过几年，应该就准备妥当了。
别拘束，就当自己家。

entries.en: I wish I could serve you some tea.
entries.zh: 真希望能给你沏杯茶。
抱歉，我不太会招待客人。

entries.en: Plotting an evil plan is actually a lot of work.
entries.zh: 策划邪恶计划，其实还挺费工夫的。

entries.en: Careful, don't stand in my way please.
entries.zh: 小心些，麻烦别挡着我的路。

entries.en: I'm not ready to show my face to the world yet.
entries.zh: 我还没准备好向全世界露面。

entries.en: Why is there so much hate in the world?
entries.zh: 世上为什么有这么多仇恨？

entries.en: You discover a new species and your first reaction is to kill them?
entries.zh: 发现一个新物种，你的第一反应就是把他们杀掉吗？

entries.en: Have you even tried to understand them?
entries.zh: 你就没试着了解过他们吗？

entries.en: Don't you think what you are doing is wrong?
entries.zh: 你不觉得自己做错了吗？

entries.en: Have you noticed how everyone around here kind of resembles a Vampire?
entries.zh: 你有没有发现，这儿的人个个都挺像吸血鬼的？

entries.en: It would be a pretty convenient place for a Vampire to hide.
entries.zh: 这里确实很适合吸血鬼藏身。

entries.en: Not that I'm a Vampire of course - I am definitely not.
entries.zh: 当然不是说我是吸血鬼——我绝对不是。

entries.en: A Cup of Blood? What a strange present, I'm sure a Vampire would like that.
entries.zh: 鲜血之杯？这礼物还真奇怪，吸血鬼肯定会喜欢。

entries.en: Thanks for the gift. I really appreciate it. Of course I won't be drinking that.
entries.zh: 谢谢你的礼物，我很感激。当然，我肯定不会喝它。
我不渴了！

entries.en: Err, from water and other non-Vampire liquids that is.
entries.zh: 呃，是喝了水和其他非吸血鬼饮料之后不渴了。

entries.en: Thank you for the gesture though!
entries.zh: 不过还是谢谢你这份心意！

entries.en: I can't be seen conversing with you right now!
entries.zh: 我现在可不能让人看见我和你说话！

entries.en: I am quite thirsty all the time, it's a rare condition.
entries.zh: 我总是很渴，这是种罕见的病。

entries.en: Why are you looking at me that way? I am not a Vampire, you are!
entries.zh: 你干吗这么看着我？我才不是吸血鬼，你才是！

entries.en: There is no sunlight either, it would be quite accommodating for a Vampire.
entries.zh: 而且这里晒不到太阳，吸血鬼住着肯定很舒服。

entries.en: I like to drag my feet because it's more time out of the house.
entries.zh: 我就喜欢慢吞吞地走，这样能在外面多待会儿。
一会儿拿这个，一会儿取那个……

entries.en: Is that really all I'm good for?
entries.zh: 难道我就只会跑腿吗？

entries.en: How many times do I have to go to the shop every day...
entries.zh: 我每天到底得跑多少趟商店啊……

entries.en: She should really just wholesale at this rate. Cut out the middle mage.
entries.zh: 照这个量，她真该直接走批发，省掉我这个中间法师。
再来些瓶子，拜托了。唉。
还是老样子。谢了。

entries.en: Double order today. She's onto something big.
entries.zh: 今天要双份。她肯定在搞什么大项目。
实验进展怎么样？

entries.en: The store was super busy today!
entries.zh: 今天商店忙得不得了！
你的瓶子拿来了，莫利姆。

entries.en: I heard there exist golden boots that helps you swim faster in water. I would like to test their magical properties, could you bring me them?
entries.zh: 听说有双金色靴子能让人在水里游得更快。我想研究它的魔法特性，能替我带来吗？
你会后悔的。

entries.en: You don't look like a Barbarian to me!
entries.zh: 我看你可不像野蛮人！
欢迎加入野蛮人阵营，%1$s!

entries.en: I provide the Piglins with important items.
entries.zh: 我负责给猪灵供应重要物资。
你最好快跑。
好痛！
准备挨一顿揍吧。

entries.en: Deposit your Coins before the Mushroom Bulls get to you!
entries.zh: 快把硬币存起来，别等蘑菇牛先把你送走！

entries.en: Hello, adventurer! I am Bramass Beastslayer! I've slain beasts of all sorts across SkyBlock!
entries.zh: 你好，冒险者！我是布拉玛斯·屠兽者！空岛各地的猛兽，我都猎杀过！

entries.en: I sure wish there was a record of all my accomplishments in one place!
entries.zh: 要是能把我的战绩都记在一处，那该多好啊！
哦，等等……还真有这么个东西！

entries.en: Your Bestiary is a compendium of all of the mobs in SkyBlock!
entries.zh: 你的怪物图鉴收录了空岛中的所有怪物！

entries.en: View your mob stats, unlock rewards, and more!
entries.zh: 可以查看怪物统计、解锁奖励，还有不少别的功能！

entries.en: You can find the Bestiary in your Combat Skill menu!
entries.zh: 在战斗技能菜单里就能找到怪物图鉴！

entries.en: Killing enough mobs in a given Family unlocks rewards.
entries.zh: 击杀同一族群的怪物达到一定数量，就能解锁奖励。

entries.en: You can unlock ✯ Magic Find and ❁ Strength bonuses, and loot drop information for that Family!
entries.zh: 你可以解锁针对该族群的✯ 魔法寻宝和❁ 力量加成，还能查看它们的战利品掉落信息！

entries.en: Reach Milestones in your Bestiary by unlocking unique Family tiers.
entries.zh: 解锁不同族群的等阶，就能达成怪物图鉴的里程碑。

entries.en: Reaching Milestones rewards ❤ Health, Combat Exp, and more!
entries.zh: 达成里程碑可以获得❤ 生命值、战斗经验等奖励！

entries.en: You can always view your Bestiary in your Combat Skill menu!
entries.zh: 随时打开战斗技能菜单，都能查看你的怪物图鉴！

entries.en: Killing mobs in a Family enough times rewards you with ✯ Magic Find towards that mob!
entries.zh: 击杀同一族群的怪物达到一定次数后，就能获得针对该怪物的✯ 魔法寻宝加成！

entries.en: This increases your chance to find rare loot when killing this mob!
entries.zh: 这样，击杀这种怪物时就更容易获得稀有战利品了！

entries.en: Deposit your Coins before the Flaming Spiders get to you!
entries.zh: 快把硬币存好，别等烈焰蜘蛛找上门！
站住！

entries.en: I have a Fairy Soul inside my property. If you want it you will have to pay!
entries.zh: 我的地盘里有一个仙女之魂。想拿走就得付钱！

entries.en: You can get access to my house for 1,000,000 coins!
entries.zh: 花 1,000,000 硬币，我就让你自由进出我家！
要买通行权吗？

entries.en: Congratulations! You can now come and go as you please!
entries.zh: 恭喜！以后你想来就来，想走就走！

entries.en: In that case you better get off my property before I call the guards!
entries.zh: 那就赶紧离开我的地盘，不然我叫卫兵了！

entries.en: Are you trying to scam me, bruh? Get off my property!
entries.zh: 想空手套白狼呢，哥们？滚出我的地盘！

entries.en: Nice try, bruh! Pay the toll to get the soul!
entries.zh: 想得挺美啊，哥们！先交通行费，再拿仙女之魂！

entries.en: Once I found this Fairy Soul I decided to build my house around it.
entries.zh: 发现这个仙女之魂后，我干脆围着它盖了栋房子。

entries.en: I actually use the Fairy Soul as a lamp. They kinda glow in the dark a bit.
entries.zh: 其实我拿仙女之魂当灯用。它们在黑暗里还真会发点光。

entries.en: Our relations with the Piglins is getting worse, things are spiraling out of control.
entries.zh: 我们与猪灵的关系越来越糟，局势已经快失控了。

entries.en: You are looking for the Dean's Apprentice?
entries.zh: 你在找院长的学徒？

entries.en: I'm afraid he might be in great danger, I just found his backpack and there is some blood on it...
entries.zh: 恐怕他正身陷险境。我刚找到他的背包，上面还有血迹……

entries.en: We must find him at once, I really hope this isn't the Piglin's doing.
entries.zh: 我们必须立刻找到他。真希望这不是猪灵干的。

entries.en: Let's separate. Take my contact and call me if you find anything.
entries.zh: 我们分头行动。保存我的联系方式，一有发现就打给我。

entries.en: He might be nearby, let me know if you find anything.
entries.zh: 他应该就在附近，有任何发现立刻告诉我。
✆ 你找到学徒了？

entries.en: ✆ Good work. We will come to you at once!
entries.zh: ✆ 干得好，我们马上赶过去！

entries.en: Looks like we found him just in time, he will live, but he needs medical attention.
entries.zh: 看来我们来得正是时候。他能活下来，但必须马上接受治疗。

entries.en: I know the Dean's Apprentice, they would never take that much damage from the monsters around here.
entries.zh: 我了解院长的学徒，附近这些怪物不可能把他伤成这样。

entries.en: Once they wake up from their coma we will know what happened to them, but I have my suspicions.
entries.zh: 等他从昏迷中醒来，我们就能知道发生了什么。不过我心里已经有了猜测。

entries.en: The guards and I will bring him back to the city, please explain the situation to the Dean.
entries.zh: 我和卫兵会把他送回城里，请你去向院长说明情况。
%1$s! 你来得正好。

entries.en: Our entire stash of Sulphur got stolen. I have no idea how "they" did it.
entries.zh: 我们储备的硫磺全被偷了。我完全不知道“他们”是怎么做到的。

entries.en: The Queen is warning me against hasty conclusions, but enough is enough.
entries.zh: 女王告诫我不要妄下结论，可忍耐也该有个限度。

entries.en: We cannot let the Barbarians trespass our borders without retaliation.
entries.zh: 野蛮人胆敢越过边境，我们绝不能毫无回应。

entries.en: My scouts told me they sighted Barbarian activities in the North, near the Forgotten Skull.
entries.zh: 斥候报告说，野蛮人在北方的遗忘之颅附近有所活动。

entries.en: Let's meet again there, and be prepared for combat.
entries.zh: 我们到那里会合，做好战斗准备。

entries.en: The Forgotten Skull in the North is close to the Barbarian borders, they are probably hiding the stolen Sulphur there.
entries.zh: 北方的遗忘之颅靠近野蛮人边境，他们很可能把偷来的硫磺藏在那里。

entries.en: Some matters cannot be solved peacefully.
entries.zh: 有些事没法和平解决。

entries.en: ✆ Thank you for helping with the tentacle monster.
entries.zh: ✆ 谢谢你帮忙对付那只触手怪。

entries.en: ✆ We owe the Piglins an apology.
entries.zh: ✆ 我们欠猪灵一个道歉。

entries.en: ✆ I will stay in Scarleton and prepare for the next battle!
entries.zh: ✆ 我会留在绯红城，为下一场战斗做好准备！

entries.en: %1$s you should contact the Dean and explain the situation, he might be able to make light of this situation.
entries.zh: %1$s,你该联系院长，把情况告诉他。他也许能弄清这是怎么回事。
不错，还差%1$s 个胡萝卜。
很好。

entries.en: Hopefully our business has been very profitable for the both of us.
entries.zh: 希望这笔生意让我们双方都赚得盆满钵满。
胡萝卜出口任务完成！
+12☘ 胡萝卜时运
谢谢你的胡萝卜。

entries.en: I don't know where you got them from and at this point I'm too afraid to ask.
entries.zh: 我不知道你从哪弄来这些的，事到如今我也不敢问了。
不错，还差%1$s 个南瓜。
南瓜出口任务完成！
+12☘ 南瓜时运
谢谢你的南瓜。

entries.en: They're squishy and disgusting. I don't want to know where you got these from.
entries.zh: 这些东西软趴趴的，真恶心。我一点也不想知道你从哪弄来的。

entries.en: Nice, only %1$s Chocolate Bars to go.
entries.zh: 不错，还差%1$s 块巧克力棒。
巧克力棒出口任务完成！
谢谢你的巧克力。

entries.en: It is absolutely delicious. By far the best chocolate bars I have ever eaten in my life!
entries.zh: 实在太好吃了。这绝对是我这辈子吃过最棒的巧克力棒！

entries.en: Nice, only %1$s Fine Flours to go.
entries.zh: 不错，还差%1$s 份精制面粉。
精制面粉出口任务完成！
+12☘ 小麦时运
谢谢你的面粉。
不错，还差%1$s 个蘑菇。
蘑菇出口任务完成！
+12☘ 蘑菇时运
谢谢你的蘑菇。

entries.en: Although since they're all half-eaten, you technically brought me half the amount!
entries.zh: 不过这些全都被吃掉了一半，严格来说你只交了半份！
不错，还差%1$s 个疣疣。
疣疣出口任务完成！
+12☘ 下界疣时运
谢谢你的疣疣。

entries.en: Nice, only %1$s Prickly Kisses to go.
entries.zh: 不错，还差%1$s 个刺吻。
刺吻出口任务完成！
+12☘ 野玫瑰时运

entries.en: Thank you for the Prickly Kisses.
entries.zh: 谢谢你的刺吻。

entries.en: I hope you handle these with care. I got pricked by those once.
entries.zh: 拿的时候小心点，我以前被它们扎过一次。

entries.en: It was NOT a pleasant experience.
entries.zh: 那滋味可一点都不好受。
不错，还差%1$s 个仙人掌。
仙人掌出口任务完成！
+12☘ 仙人掌时运
谢谢你的仙人掌。

entries.en: They're cute but prickly, like my grandmother.
entries.zh: 它们挺可爱的，就是有点扎手——跟我奶奶一样。

entries.en: I suppose you want my Abiphone Contact.
entries.zh: 看来你想要我的阿比手机联系方式。

entries.en: Well, what's in it for me?
entries.zh: 那我能得到什么好处？

entries.en: I'll tell you what - I want a Magma Core.
entries.zh: 这样吧，我要一个岩浆核心。

entries.en: Bring me that and I'm sure we can reach an agreement.
entries.zh: 把它带来，我们肯定能谈妥。

entries.en: You don't have a Magma Core.
entries.zh: 你没有岩浆核心。

entries.en: Don't waste my time please, I have things to do and places to be.
entries.zh: 请别浪费我的时间，我还有不少事要忙。

entries.en: That does appear to be a Magma Core.
entries.zh: 看起来确实是岩浆核心。

entries.en: Well, as per the terms of our agreement, I suppose you can have my contact.
entries.zh: 好吧，按约定，我会把联系方式给你。

entries.en: Only call me if you've got items to give me, please.
entries.zh: 拜托，只有要给我物品时再打电话。
毕竟，时间就是金钱。

entries.en: I use the top bed, because I'm the strongest.
entries.zh: 我睡上铺，因为我最强。
阵营的新成员！

entries.en: The entire stash of Sulphur of the Piglin Faction has been stolen this morning.
entries.zh: 猪灵阵营储存的全部硫磺今早被偷了。

entries.en: I sent my son Ugo on a mission to recover the Sulphur.
entries.zh: 我派儿子乌戈去追回硫磺。

entries.en: He might be fighting the Mage Faction as we speak.
entries.zh: 他说不定此刻正在和法师阵营交战。

entries.en: I implore you. Please assist Ugo in this operation.
entries.zh: 拜托你，协助乌戈完成这次行动。

entries.en: I don't know what I would do without my son. My only son.
entries.zh: 我无法想象失去儿子该怎么办。他是我唯一的儿子。

entries.en: They have followed the traces of the Sulphur all the way to the Forgotten Skull in the North.
entries.zh: 他们循着硫磺的痕迹，一路追到了北方的遗忘之颅。
请去帮帮乌戈。

entries.en: I have an important meeting to attend.
entries.zh: 我还有一场重要会议要参加。

entries.en: I am very busy right now.
entries.zh: 我现在非常忙。

entries.en: Being a friend comes with responsibilities.
entries.zh: 既然是朋友，就得担起朋友的责任。

entries.en: You are not from around here.
entries.zh: 你不是本地人。

entries.en: My kids are a handful, but I love them so.
entries.zh: 我家孩子个个都让人操心，可我就是爱他们。

entries.en: Please don't play with my kids.
entries.zh: 请别跟我家孩子玩。

entries.en: When I'm older, I'll travel the world.
entries.zh: 等我长大了，我要环游世界。
欢迎来到游客中心！

entries.en: This town was built four centuries ago, or more!
entries.zh: 这座城镇建于四百多年前！

entries.en: Visitors come from all around the world to visit our Cathedral.
entries.zh: 世界各地的游客都会来参观我们的大教堂。

entries.en: But maybe you are more interested in our famous floating water fountain?
entries.zh: 不过，你也许会对我们远近闻名的悬浮喷泉更感兴趣？

entries.en: Or the Statue of the Hero?
entries.zh: 或者英雄雕像？

entries.en: There is so much to see!
entries.zh: 值得看的地方可多着呢！

entries.en: If you have any tourist-related questions, I'll be right here!
entries.zh: 有任何观光方面的问题，尽管来找我！
祝你在绯红城玩得开心！
你是游客吗？

entries.en: This is my favorite site, I know everything about the great Dragons.
entries.zh: 这里是我最喜欢的遗迹，那些伟大巨龙的事我全都知道。

entries.en: This is of course Jythar, the Eternal One.
entries.zh: 这位当然就是永恒者吉萨尔。

entries.en: The dragon army attacked our dimension many centuries ago and sent the world into pieces.
entries.zh: 许多世纪前，巨龙大军袭击了我们的维度，将整个世界打得四分五裂。

entries.en: The skeleton of Chozon can be seen on the island south of here. He was one of the generals of Jythar.
entries.zh: 从这里往南的岛上能看到 Chozon 的遗骸。他曾是吉萨尔麾下的一名将军。

entries.en: Dogen, Kirva, and Daydro perished and fell in the void, to my knowledge.
entries.zh: 据我所知,Dogen、Kirva 和 Daydro 都已战死，坠入了虚空。

entries.en: The 4 generals were so huge that their reach could cover the sun and bring shadows upon entire cities.
entries.zh: 四位将军身形庞大，舒展躯体便足以遮住太阳，让整座城市笼罩在阴影中。

entries.en: Thousands of Dragons attacked that day and all were defeated, but did they fail?
entries.zh: 那一天，数千条巨龙发起进攻，最终全军覆没——可它们真的失败了吗？
它们的目的究竟是什么？

entries.en: I think they decided to break the world to weaken us, and by us I mean everyone in this dimension.
entries.zh: 我认为，它们决定击碎世界来削弱我们——我说的我们，是这个维度里的所有人。

entries.en: Despite the wars raging at the time, we were still able to unite and beat this common enemy.
entries.zh: 尽管当时战火四起，我们仍能团结起来，击败共同的敌人。

entries.en: Jythar knew there would be no path to victory against us for as long as we could unite.
entries.zh: 吉萨尔知道，只要我们还能团结一心，它就绝无胜算。
可它为什么不撤退？

entries.en: Why did he keep attacking us until his death?
entries.zh: 为什么非要进攻到死？

entries.en: I doubt it was madness. Dragons live for millennia, their Emperor surely wasn't mad.
entries.zh: 我不认为那是疯狂。巨龙寿逾千年，它们的帝王不可能只是疯了。

entries.en: So why would he give up his life to guarantee a potential victory in the future?
entries.zh: 那么，它为什么甘愿牺牲生命，只为换取未来一场可能的胜利？

entries.en: It's impossible for us to know, but we can theorize.
entries.zh: 我们不可能知道真相，但可以作出推测。

entries.en: It is known from the Dragons summoned nowadays that they worship their Queen.
entries.zh: 从如今被召唤出的巨龙身上可以确定，它们崇拜自己的女王。

entries.en: Queen, Empress - the exact word might have been lost in translation.
entries.zh: 女王，或是女皇——确切的称呼或许早已在传译中失落。

entries.en: I think Jythar did it for her.
entries.zh: 我想，吉萨尔是为了她才这么做的。

entries.en: I think the reason is love.
entries.zh: 我想，原因就是爱。

entries.en: Maybe I am wrong, but I choose to believe it.
entries.zh: 也许我错了，但我愿意相信这个答案。

entries.en: This titan next to us is known by many names, some call them the Calamity.
entries.zh: 我们身旁的这位巨物有许多名字，有人称其为大灾变。

entries.en: They are the enemies, but if they are motivated by love, maybe we can communicate with them.
entries.zh: 它们是敌人，但若驱使它们的也是爱，也许我们仍能与它们沟通。

entries.en: What do you think? Am I too romantic, or did my explanation make sense?
entries.zh: 你怎么看？是我太浪漫了，还是这番解释确有道理？

entries.en: I'm not that smart, they just needed a third person.
entries.zh: 我其实没那么聪明，他们只是需要凑第三个人。
我挺喜欢发表意见的。

entries.en: This side of the table isn't as valuable as the other side.
entries.zh: 桌子这边的地位可不如另一边。

entries.en: I like to use this path to go to the Cathedral.
entries.zh: 我喜欢走这条路去大教堂。

entries.en: It's much more quiet around here, I can clear my head.
entries.zh: 这附近安静多了，正好让我理理思绪。
我现在很忙。

entries.en: You... are not one of my students!
entries.zh: 你……不是我的学生！

entries.en: I hope you are not here to rob me, I could still take on a dozen of young guns like you!
entries.zh: 希望你不是来抢劫的。像你这样的年轻人，来一打我也能收拾！

entries.en: Oh, that's not why you are here? Then why are you here? Speak up I don't have all day!
entries.zh: 哦，不是来抢劫的？那你到底来干什么？快说，我可没空耗一整天！

entries.en: [YOU] I have something to show you: [CLICK TO SHOW]
entries.zh: [你] 我有样东西给你看: [点击展示]

entries.en: You again, what do you want this time?
entries.zh: 又是你，这次想干什么？

entries.en: Oh, where did you find this? This looks like an older, simpler version of our Ability Phones, in a way this is remarkable.
entries.zh: 哦，这是从哪儿找到的？看起来像是技能电话更古老、更简陋的版本……某种意义上还挺了不起。

entries.en: But why do you have this, are you interested in that kind of magical technology?
entries.zh: 可你为什么会拿着它？你对这类魔法科技感兴趣？

entries.en: Oh, you mean...you are more interested in advanced magical technology right?
entries.zh: 哦，你的意思是……你更喜欢先进的魔法科技，对吧？
改变主意了吗？

entries.en: In that case thanks for the gift, and have a great life.
entries.zh: 那就谢谢你的礼物了。祝你往后生活愉快。

entries.en: Perfect, well then you are at the right place, let me write you a letter of recommendation!
entries.zh: 太好了，那你来对地方了。我给你写封推荐信！
稍等……
来，拿好！

entries.en: First you should go to the Queen with it, we have a very strict code around here and you won't go far without the Queen's approval.
entries.zh: 先把信交给女王。这里规矩森严，没有女王批准，你哪儿也去不了。

entries.en: Hopefully the Queen will grant you access to some parts of the city.
entries.zh: 希望女王会准许你进入城里的部分区域。

entries.en: Once that's done, go visit my cousin Udel in his shop in the plaza.
entries.zh: 办完后，去广场的店里找我表亲乌德尔。

entries.en: I'll let him know you are coming and he'll make you a price for your own Abiphone.
entries.zh: 我会通知他你要来，他会给你的专属阿比手机开个价。

entries.en: You should bring that letter to the Queen ASAP. Did you lose the letter?
entries.zh: 你该尽快把信交给女王。难道把信弄丢了？

entries.en: Alright, if you are struggling to find the Queen, she is usually in the throne room, or in her quarters.
entries.zh: 好吧，要是找不到女王，她通常在王座厅或自己的房间。

entries.en: ✆ Oh, it's you! So the Queen welcomed you in our Faction? That's great
entries.zh: ✆ 哦，是你！女王已经接纳你加入我们的阵营了？太好了！

entries.en: ✆ Listen, I don't have a ton of time right now, the object of my current research has just been stolen!
entries.zh: ✆ 听着，我现在没多少时间——正在研究的东西刚刚被偷了！

entries.en: ✆ I'm sorry, but I'll have to call you back later. Enjoy your Abiphone!
entries.zh: ✆ 抱歉，晚点再回电。好好享受你的阿比手机！
✆ 哦，%1$s,又是你吗？

entries.en: ✆ I am still really stressed out about the long research.
entries.zh: ✆ 研究资料丢了，到现在还让我焦头烂额。

entries.en: ✆ It's a long story but in short, we believe the Piglins stole it, it's a real problem.
entries.zh: ✆ 说来话长。简单讲，我们认为东西是猪灵偷走的，麻烦大了。

entries.en: ✆ What did you just say? You recovered it? And they didn't even see you?
entries.zh: ✆ 你刚才说什么？你把它找回来了？而且他们根本没发现你？

entries.en: ✆ I can't believe it, you are truly a hero! I'm currently near the Community Center, please come here and bring the research back.
entries.zh: ✆ 真不敢相信，你简直是英雄！我现在就在社区中心附近，请过来把研究资料交还给我们。

entries.en: Salt is immensely important, this is quite the revolution for us!
entries.zh: 盐实在太重要了，这对我们称得上一场革命！

entries.en: I can't thank you enough, what you did was heroic!
entries.zh: 怎么感谢你都不够，你做的事堪称英雄之举！

entries.en: You are probably aware but we used to be Pig farmers but Sulphur turned our pigs into Piglins.
entries.zh: 你可能已经知道，我们过去养猪为生，却是硫磺把猪变成了猪灵。

entries.en: For decades we had to survive with almost nothing to eat, until we learned magic.
entries.zh: 几十年来，我们几乎找不到可吃的东西，直到学会魔法才熬过来。

entries.en: Piglins can eat nether warts, but we certainly can't!
entries.zh: 猪灵能吃下界疣，我们可绝对不行！

entries.en: Anyways, if you want to learn more about that, there are books in the Academy regarding the Dark Ages.
entries.zh: 总之，想了解更多的话，学院里有讲述黑暗时代的书。

entries.en: I am trying to finish my work on this machine but my Apprentice is missing.
entries.zh: 我正想完成这台机器，可我的学徒失踪了。

entries.en: He is out there in the wild looking for precious ingredients and he should have been back a long time ago.
entries.zh: 他外出寻找珍贵原料，早就该回来了。

entries.en: Their Abiphone doesn't seem to be working, I am starting to get worried.
entries.zh: 他的阿比手机似乎也坏了，我越来越担心。

entries.en: Would you be so kind to look for them, they are probably North of that Red Sand Desert.
entries.zh: 能劳烦你去找找他吗？他多半在那片红沙沙漠北边。

entries.en: Please find my apprentice, he should be North of the Burning Desert.
entries.zh: 请找到我的学徒，他应该在烈焰沙漠北边。

entries.en: You found my Apprentice and he WHAT?!
entries.zh: 你找到我的学徒了，而且他怎么了！?
硫磺！这下出大事了！!

entries.en: My poor Apprentice, it is my vault, I shouldn't send him on difficult missions.
entries.zh: 我可怜的学徒……是我的错，不该派他执行这么困难的任务。

entries.en: This will also delay my work considerably, how am I going to obtain all those precious materials now...
entries.zh: 这也会严重拖慢工作。现在上哪儿弄到那些珍贵材料……

entries.en: Oh, you are willing to help?
entries.zh: 哦，你愿意帮忙？

entries.en: Well in that case, I will send you the list of items I need.
entries.zh: 那好，我把需要的物品清单发给你。

entries.en: Thank you very much you are a life savior, quite literally.
entries.zh: 太感谢了，你真是救命恩人——字面意义上的。

entries.en: Let me know when you obtained the 10 Magma Chunks and 5 Burning Eyes.
entries.zh: 拿到 10 个岩浆块和 5 只燃烧之眼后告诉我。

entries.en: Magma Chunks and Burning Eyes, perfect!
entries.zh: 岩浆块和燃烧之眼，完美！

entries.en: That should be enough to finish my work.
entries.zh: 这些应该足够完成工作。

entries.en: I will call you once I'm done.
entries.zh: 做好后我会联系你。

entries.en: Thank you very much %1$s, I will call you when I'm done
entries.zh: 非常感谢，%1$s。完成后我会联系你。

entries.en: Oh, I was just about to call you!
entries.zh: 哦，我正准备打给你呢！

entries.en: I have almost completed my research, however I need a few extra components.
entries.zh: 研究差不多完成了，不过还缺几个额外组件。

entries.en: Those ones are going to be tougher to obtain though.
entries.zh: 只是这些东西会更难弄到。

entries.en: You will have to defeat mighty opponents.
entries.zh: 你得击败一些强敌。

entries.en: The first ingredient I need is a Hallowed Skull, which is obtained from a Bladesoul.
entries.zh: 第一种原料是圣化头骨，要从剑魂身上取得。

entries.en: This creature can be found inside the Stronghold, south of the island.
entries.zh: 这种生物就在岛屿南边的要塞里。

entries.en: Hallowed Skulls can be obtained from Bladesoul inside the Stronghold.
entries.zh: 圣化头骨可以从剑魂身上取得，它就在要塞里。

entries.en: The Stronghold was built by Blazes and Wither Skeletons, they are still expanding it slowly, quite fascinating.
entries.zh: 那座要塞由烈焰人和凋灵骷髅建造，他们至今还在缓慢扩建。真是迷人。
圣化头骨！太棒了！

entries.en: I need a couple more components, the next one is a Lumino Fiber.
entries.zh: 还缺几种组件。下一种是荧光纤维。

entries.en: Only the strongest of Blazes can create those, and there is a terrifying Blaze in the North West.
entries.zh: 只有最强大的烈焰人才能制造它。有只可怕的烈焰人就在西北方。

entries.en: If you can defeat them, I'm sure you'll obtain a Lumino Fiber.
entries.zh: 只要击败它，肯定能拿到荧光纤维。

entries.en: The reason why I need a Lumino Fiber? Well...it's hard to explain.
entries.zh: 为什么需要荧光纤维？这个嘛……很难解释。

entries.en: I have reasons to believe there is a lot of Sulphur in the North, it would explain the appearance of those Blaze species.
entries.zh: 我有理由相信，大量硫磺蕴藏在北方，这也能解释那些烈焰人物种为何出现。

entries.en: Thanks! I almost have all the components I need now.
entries.zh: 谢了！现在几乎集齐全部组件了。

entries.en: The last one is a Leather Cloth, and not just any kind.
entries.zh: 最后一样是皮革布，而且不能是普通货色。

entries.en: There is a rogue Barbarian going by the name of Duke X.
entries.zh: 有个叛离阵营的野蛮人，名叫公爵 X。

entries.en: He owns all the Leather Cloth on the island, find him and you'll find the items.
entries.zh: 他掌握着岛上所有的皮革布。找到他，就能找到这种材料。

entries.en: Piglins can grow incredibly strong if they consume large amounts of Sulphur, but they lose their sanity in the process.
entries.zh: 猪灵摄入大量硫磺后会变得异常强壮，但也会逐渐失去理智。

entries.en: Last I heard, they are located near the Barbarian Faction.
entries.zh: 我最后听说，他就在野蛮人阵营附近。

entries.en: I knew I could count on you.
entries.zh: 我就知道可以指望你。

entries.en: This strong Cloth will be able to contain the skull and the lumino fibers together.
entries.zh: 这种结实的布料能把头骨和荧光纤维固定在一起。

entries.en: In theory this should help refining Sulphur, if I can get it to work.
entries.zh: 理论上，它应该有助于精炼硫磺——前提是我能让它正常运作。

entries.en: Would you mind talking to Captain Ahone?
entries.zh: 能去和阿霍恩队长谈谈吗？

entries.en: Please tell him I need a full backpack worth of Sulphur.
entries.zh: 请告诉他，我需要整整一背包的硫磺。

entries.en: Captain Ahone should be below the Community Center.
entries.zh: 阿霍恩队长应该就在社区中心下方。

entries.en: There is still so much to learn about Sulphur.
entries.zh: 硫磺还有太多秘密等待研究。

entries.en: You found who stole our Sulphur?
entries.zh: 你找到偷走硫磺的家伙了？

entries.en: A giant magma creature with massive tentacles?
entries.zh: 是一只长着巨大触手的岩浆怪物？

entries.en: Well that explains a lot, my Apprentice just awoken from his coma, he described the same creature.
entries.zh: 那就说得通了。我的学徒刚从昏迷中醒来，描述的也是同一种生物。

entries.en: In a way it is good that the Piglins were not behind this.
entries.zh: 某种意义上，这至少说明幕后黑手不是猪灵。

entries.en: We need to learn more about that monster, where it is from and what it wants.
entries.zh: 我们必须查清那只怪物的来历和目的。
之后再联系你！

entries.en: This monster probably feeds itself with Sulphur.
entries.zh: 那只怪物很可能以硫磺为食。

entries.en: If left unchecked, it is possible that the powers of this creature will grow.
entries.zh: 如果放任不管，它的力量很可能继续增长。

entries.en: Oh, it's you! So the Queen welcomed you in our Faction? That's great!
entries.zh: 哦，是你！女王已经接纳你加入我们的阵营了？太好了！

entries.en: Listen, I don't have a lot of time right now, the object of my current research has just been stolen!
entries.zh: 听着，我现在没多少时间——正在研究的东西刚刚被偷了！

entries.en: I am still really stressed out about the lost research.
entries.zh: 研究资料丢了，到现在还让我焦头烂额。

entries.en: My poor Apprentice, it is my fault, I shouldn't send him on difficult missions.
entries.zh: 我可怜的学徒……都是我的错，不该让他去做这么危险的任务。

entries.en: Oh, I was about to call you!
entries.zh: 哦，我正打算给你打电话呢！

entries.en: The first ingredient I need is a Hallowed Skull, it is obtained from a Bladesoul.
entries.zh: 第一种原料是圣化头骨，要从剑魂身上取得。

entries.en: I need to think. I need to think.
entries.zh: 我得想想。我得好好想想。

entries.en: I hate Blazes. Blazes are terrible. Blazes hurt. Blazes make me cry.
entries.zh: 我讨厌烈焰人。烈焰人糟透了。烈焰人会伤人。烈焰人把我都整哭了。

entries.en: Do not talk to me, we are not the same.
entries.zh: 别跟我说话，你我不是一路人。

entries.en: I have seen many adventurers challenge Kuudra, but they don't understand what they're doing.
entries.zh: 我见过许多冒险者挑战库德拉，可他们根本不明白自己在做什么。

entries.en: There are many ways to find Kuudra, you just have to think.
entries.zh: 找到库德拉的方法有很多，你只需要动动脑子。

entries.en: You might be someone worth taking to, but the condition isn't right.
entries.zh: 你倒像是个值得聊聊的人，可现在条件还不合适。

entries.en: You seem like someone of similar interests.
entries.zh: 看来我们的兴趣很相近。

entries.en: I have a shop of some unique items that may interest you.
entries.zh: 我这儿有家小店，里面的独特商品也许会让你感兴趣。

entries.en: Have a look and see if theres anything you like.
entries.zh: 随便看看，说不定就有你喜欢的东西。

entries.en: You know, adventurer, I can help you with something else.
entries.zh: 冒险者，其实我还能帮你办另一件事。

entries.en: In order to do so, I need something special...
entries.zh: 不过要办成它，我需要一样特别的东西……

entries.en: Bring it to me and I will be ready to assist!
entries.zh: 把它带来，我就能帮你！
冒险者！

entries.en: I see you have something in your inventory...
entries.zh: 我看到你物品栏里有样东西……

entries.en: I feel as though I've seen it before...
entries.zh: 总觉得我以前见过它……

entries.en: Ah yes, I can see it clearer in your hand.
entries.zh: 啊，没错，拿在手里就看清楚多了。

entries.en: I definitely seem to recognize this item!
entries.zh: 我肯定认得这件东西！

entries.en: Do you mind if you give it to me so I can inspect it?
entries.zh: 能把它给我检查一下吗？

entries.en: Don't worry! I'll give you something in return of course!
entries.zh: 别担心！我当然会拿东西跟你交换！

entries.en: You should find this item I give you of value.
entries.zh: 我给你的这件东西应该很有价值。

entries.en: It may seem uninteresting, but I'm sure you can find a way to use it for good.
entries.zh: 它看起来也许不起眼，但我相信你能把它用在正途上。

entries.en: You might be someone worth taking to, but the time isn't right.
entries.zh: 你倒像是个值得聊聊的人，可现在时机不对。

entries.en: I could talk to you, but the conditions don't seem right.
entries.zh: 我本可以跟你聊聊，可条件似乎还不对。

entries.en: This is the Statue of the Hero. I come here every day to pray.
entries.zh: 这是英雄雕像。我每天都会来这里祈祷。

entries.en: The legend says that a Hero arrived centuries ago, and helped us in times of need.
entries.zh: 传说几百年前，有一位英雄来到这里，在危难中向我们伸出了援手。

entries.en: Some of us still believe that the Hero will come back one day.
entries.zh: 我们当中，仍有人相信那位英雄终有一天会回来。

entries.en: Do you want me to tell the story?
entries.zh: 想听我讲讲这段故事吗？

entries.en: I could tell you were not very interested.
entries.zh: 看得出来，你不太感兴趣。

entries.en: I will go back to my prayers.
entries.zh: 那我接着祈祷了。

entries.en: After we started learning magic centuries ago, most people stopped praying in the Cathedral.
entries.zh: 几百年前，我们开始研习魔法。从那以后，大多数人就不再去大教堂祈祷了。

entries.en: They were too busy to learn and create new spells, and even turned the Cathedral into an Academy.
entries.zh: 他们忙着学习、创造新法术，甚至把大教堂改成了学院。

entries.en: Those people will say that they believe in knowledge and magic.
entries.zh: 他们会说，自己信仰的是知识与魔法。

entries.en: Some others still believe that it was our prayers that gave us our powers.
entries.zh: 也有人始终相信，正是祈祷赐予了我们力量。

entries.en: They believe it was the Sky's plan to make us independent through Sulphur, and that the Sky is good and fair.
entries.zh: 他们相信，上天让我们借助硫磺自立，是早有安排的。他们也相信，上天仁慈而公正。

entries.en: And finally there are still very few people like me, who hold their faith in the Hero.
entries.zh: 最后，还有像我这样的少数人，依然信仰着那位英雄。

entries.en: The Hero was humble, yet they saved us all from doom.
entries.zh: 那位英雄谦逊无名，却将我们所有人从毁灭中拯救了出来。

entries.en: I must pray at home, for it is late.
entries.zh: 天色晚了，我得回家祈祷。

entries.en: The town may never sleep, but I do.
entries.zh: 城镇或许不眠，我可得睡觉。

entries.en: Rise and shine! Pray from dusk til dawn!
entries.zh: 打起精神来！从黄昏祈祷到黎明！

entries.en: Are you coming to pray with me?
entries.zh: 你要来和我一起祈祷吗？
我正要睡觉呢。
已经很晚了。

entries.en: What do you think? Do you believe in the Hero too?
entries.zh: 你怎么看？你也相信那位英雄吗？

entries.en: Do you think the Hero was a man or a woman? There is so little information that remains...
entries.zh: 你觉得那位英雄是男是女？留下来的记载实在太少了……

entries.en: ONE SECOND I'M PRETTY BUSY RIGHT NOW!
entries.zh: 等一下，我现在忙得不可开交！

entries.en: COULD YOU HELP ME INSTEAD OF JUST SITTING THERE?!
entries.zh: 你能不能别光站着，搭把手啊？!
哇，刚才可真够呛！

entries.en: I'm immune to fire but those monsters are still quite troublesome...
entries.zh: 我虽然不怕火，可那些怪物还是相当难缠……

entries.en: Thanks for your help, I seriously appreciate that.
entries.zh: 谢谢你帮忙，真的，太感谢了。

entries.en: I'm in a bit of a hurry, though. I need to collect 2 Spectre Dust, 3 Blaze Ashes, 4 Magma Chunks and I'm super late.
entries.zh: 不过我赶时间。我得收集 2 份幽魂粉尘、3 份烈焰人灰烬和 4 块岩浆碎块，而且已经迟到很久了。
你愿意帮我吗？

entries.en: Okay, that's fine. I just won't be able to buy food today and I won't be able to pay my rent.
entries.zh: 好吧，没关系。无非就是我今天买不起饭，也交不起房租。

entries.en: I might also die finding those items and you'll have that on your conscience.
entries.zh: 我去找那些东西时也可能送命，到时你良心上可得背着这件事。
祝你今天愉快。

entries.en: Thanks! You seem pretty strong, all you have to do is exterminate some of the monsters around. Follow me!
entries.zh: 谢啦！你看着挺能打，只要清理掉附近几只怪物就好。跟我来！

entries.en: Here, some of the mobs are inside that building and some are on the outside if you follow the path. Piece of cake!
entries.zh: 就是这里。有些怪在楼里，沿路往前还能看到一些。小菜一碟！

entries.en: I need 2 Spectre Dust, 3 Blaze Ashes, 4 Magma Chunks.
entries.zh: 我需要 2 份幽魂粉尘、3 份烈焰人灰烬和 4 块岩浆碎块。

entries.en: Most monsters around drop valuable items, you can make a living killing them.
entries.zh: 附近大多数怪物都会掉值钱的东西，靠猎杀它们就能养活自己。

entries.en: I'll be right there, I need to catch my breath.
entries.zh: 我就在这儿歇口气。

entries.en: I needed 2 Spectre Dust, 3 Blaze Ashes, 4 Magma Chunks.
entries.zh: 我要的是 2 份幽魂粉尘、3 份烈焰人灰烬和 4 块岩浆碎块。
哦，你已经全找齐了？

entries.en: Thanks for the items, that's super nice of you!
entries.zh: 谢谢你送来这些东西，你人也太好了！

entries.en: You are new around here, right? Never seen you before.
entries.zh: 你是刚来这里的吧？我以前没见过你。

entries.en: You are probably wondering what the heck happened to this place?
entries.zh: 你大概正纳闷，这地方到底经历了什么吧？

entries.en: This land actually used to be a peaceful forest with farmers, a long long time ago.
entries.zh: 很久很久以前，这片土地其实是一座宁静的森林，还有农民在这里生活。

entries.en: The giant volcano emerged and it kept on growing, over the centuries the whole place changed for the worse.
entries.zh: 巨大的火山拔地而起，并不断生长。几个世纪过去，整片土地也变得越来越糟。

entries.en: I've really got to go now but if you are interested I suggest you explore the island a bit more.
entries.zh: 我真的得走了。不过你要是感兴趣，不妨再多探索一下这座岛。

entries.en: Thanks for your help, see you around!
entries.zh: 谢谢你帮忙，回头见！

entries.en: Why don't you explore the Village a bit more?
entries.zh: 不如再去村子里多转转？

entries.en: You don't need to follow me everywhere you know?
entries.zh: 你知道吧，真不用走到哪儿都跟着我。

entries.en: Wow careful, you can't simply enter this building, this place is the residence of the Queen!
entries.zh: 哇，小心！这栋建筑不能随便进去，这里可是女王的居所！

entries.en: Wow careful, you can't simply enter this building, this place is the residence of the Chief!
entries.zh: 哇，小心！这栋建筑不能随便进去，这里可是酋长的居所！

entries.en: There are 2 different Factions on this island with incredible tensions between them!
entries.zh: 岛上有两个不同的阵营，双方关系紧张得不得了！

entries.en: They don't mind travelers but you have to earn their trust before you can do such things.
entries.zh: 他们并不排斥旅行者，但你得先赢得信任，才能出入这种地方。

entries.en: In fact, you'll have to choose a faction, but it's a little bit early for that.
entries.zh: 事实上，你迟早要选一个阵营，不过现在做决定还早了点。

entries.en: Joining a faction is an important choice, I suggest you get to know the two factions first.
entries.zh: 加入哪一方可是个重要选择。我建议你先了解一下两个阵营。

entries.en: Perhaps you should start by talking to multiple villagers from each faction.
entries.zh: 先分别找两个阵营的几位村民聊聊吧。

entries.en: The other faction is on the other side of the island.
entries.zh: 另一个阵营就在岛的另一边。

entries.en: The history between the 2 factions is long and complicated.
entries.zh: 两个阵营之间的恩怨又长又复杂。

entries.en: Talk to the villagers and come back to me.
entries.zh: 去和村民们聊聊，再回来找我。

entries.en: Make sure you also talk to villagers from the other faction before you make your choice.
entries.zh: 做决定前，别忘了也去听听另一个阵营的说法。

entries.en: So you talked to a few villagers from both factions? Nice.
entries.zh: 这么说，两个阵营的村民你都聊过几位了？不错。

entries.en: I hope you know which faction you want to join. But don't worry, you'll be able to change factions if you want.
entries.zh: 希望你已经想好要加入哪一方。不过别担心，以后想换阵营也可以。

entries.en: However, changing factions usually means that you become unfriendly with your current faction.
entries.zh: 但换阵营通常意味着，你会和当前阵营交恶。

entries.en: Anyways, which faction did you choose?
entries.zh: 总之，你选哪个阵营？

entries.en: Hum, so you chose the Mage Faction then.
entries.zh: 嗯……原来你选了法师阵营。

entries.en: It's not going to be easy to join them.
entries.zh: 想加入他们可没那么容易。

entries.en: You first have to prove your worth if you want to have a chance at joining their ranks.
entries.zh: 想得到加入的机会，你得先证明自己的价值。
嗯，让我想想……

entries.en: Oh! I know what you should do!
entries.zh: 哦！我知道该怎么办了！

entries.en: If you can bring them back a book or a piece of technology they have never seen before, I'm sure they will take a liking to you.
entries.zh: 如果你能带去一本他们没见过的书，或一件新奇的技术造物，他们肯定会对你另眼相看。

entries.en: I couldn't help but notice that you come from the place we commonly know as The Hub.
entries.zh: 我注意到，你来自我们通常称作主城的地方。

entries.en: In which case, you must have met Maddox?
entries.zh: 那你一定见过马多克斯吧？

entries.en: In fact, they instead showed that they had immense strength, and a taste for violence.
entries.zh: 相反，他们展现出了惊人的力量，还格外热衷于暴力。

entries.en: They got banned from the Academy during their first year, and even got exiled from the island after a terrible incident.
entries.zh: 入学第一年，他们就被学院开除了；后来又因一场可怕的事故，被逐出了整座岛。

entries.en: But I digress. My point is they are both Taika, and I know for a fact that Aatrox is crafting simple Ability Phones for his brother.
entries.zh: 扯远了。重点是，他们都是泰卡人，而且我确定亚托克斯正在给他兄弟制作简易技能电话。

entries.en: In fact I have one myself. Here take it, I'll just request another one from Maddox. I keep losing them.
entries.zh: 其实我手上就有一部。拿去吧，我再找马多克斯要一部就行——反正我老是弄丢。

entries.en: Oh wow, it worked! I'm so happy for you!
entries.zh: 哇，真的成功了！真替你高兴！

entries.en: And you even got an Abiphone! Take my contact so we can stay in touch.
entries.zh: 你连阿比手机都买好了！保存我的联系方式，这样就能随时联系了。

entries.en: Nice! So what are you up to?
entries.zh: 不错嘛！所以你现在在忙什么？

entries.en: The Dean told you his research got stolen?!
entries.zh: 院长说他的研究成果被偷了？!

entries.en: Ah, it's not so surprising, maybe you don't know but the Piglins are not so fond of the Taika people.
entries.zh: 啊，其实也不算意外。你可能不知道，猪灵一向不太喜欢泰卡人。

entries.en: I do have an idea where that stolen research might be, follow me.
entries.zh: 我倒是想到一个地方，那份失窃的研究可能就在那里。跟我来。

entries.en: You see this giant Dragon Skull inside the Barbarian Faction?
entries.zh: 看见野蛮人阵营里的那具巨龙头骨了吗？

entries.en: That's the skeleton of Jythar the Eternal one - the one who caused the destruction of the world.
entries.zh: 那是永恒者吉萨尔的遗骸——正是它曾毁灭了这个世界。

entries.en: Now you probably understand why the village in front is called Dragontail.
entries.zh: 现在你大概明白，前面的村庄为什么叫龙尾镇了。

entries.en: Anyways, the Barbarians built their Bastion inside the skeleton, and I suspect this is where the stolen object is guarded.
entries.zh: 总之，野蛮人把壁垒建在了遗骸内部。我怀疑失窃物品就被守在那里。

entries.en: Piglins fear the growing power of the Taika Kingdom, so they most likely stole it to study the research.
entries.zh: 猪灵畏惧泰卡王国日益壮大的力量，所以很可能是为了研究才把它偷走。

entries.en: Maybe you could sneak in and recover the item. Without getting seen and creating a major diplomatic incident, of course.
entries.zh: 也许你能偷偷潜进去把东西拿回来。当然，千万别被发现，更别闹出严重的外交事故。

entries.en: I'm not sure exactly where they keep it, but just make sure you don't get seen by the guards!
entries.zh: 我不确定他们把东西藏在哪儿，总之别让卫兵看见你！

entries.en: I can't help you however, I have way too much to lose sorry. But good luck!
entries.zh: 不过我不能陪你进去，抱歉，我承担不起那个后果。祝你好运！

entries.en: Piglins can't see very far because of the fog, just don't stand in front of them.
entries.zh: 雾太大，猪灵看不了多远。只要别杵在他们正前方就行。

entries.en: Do you even know what you are looking for? Maybe a book or a magical item?
entries.zh: 你到底知不知道要找什么？也许是本书，或者某件魔法物品？

entries.en: ✆ Hello? Oh, you are still alive, awesome!
entries.zh: ✆ 喂？哦，你还活着，太棒了！

entries.en: ✆ Have you got the research back or did you chicken out?
entries.zh: ✆ 研究拿回来了吗，还是你临阵退缩了？

entries.en: ✆ Great! You are cooler than you look!
entries.zh: ✆ 太好了！你比看上去厉害多了！

entries.en: ✆ Go back to the Dean then, I'm sure this will grant you a lot of reputation!
entries.zh: ✆ 那就回去找院长吧，这事肯定能让你赚到不少声望！

entries.en: ✆ Alright then! I have to go now, was nice talking to you!
entries.zh: ✆ 好啦！我得走了，和你聊天很开心！

entries.en: You want to join the Barbarian Faction, hum.
entries.zh: 你想加入野蛮人阵营，嗯……
真是个奇怪的选择。

entries.en: In any case, I have no idea how to guarantee your entry in their faction!
entries.zh: 不管怎样，我也不知道怎么才能保证他们收下你！

entries.en: But let's not get discouraged just yet, we'll find something I'm sure.
entries.zh: 不过先别泄气，我们一定能想出办法。

entries.en: Piglins crave Sulphur. Our first goal should be to find some.
entries.zh: 猪灵对硫磺求之若渴。我们的首要任务是找一些回来。

entries.en: There are only 2 ways to get Sulphur.
entries.zh: 获得硫磺的途径只有两种。

entries.en: You either wait for the Volcano to erupt, or you find a Corrupted Monster.
entries.zh: 要么等火山喷发，要么找到一只腐化怪物。

entries.en: And guess what, I know where to look!
entries.zh: 猜怎么着，我知道该去哪里找！
跟我来！

entries.en: So you want to join the Barbarian Faction then...
entries.zh: 所以你还是想加入野蛮人阵营……

entries.en: I do have an idea how you could do it.
entries.zh: 我倒是有个办法。

entries.en: Look, we found one! A Corrupted Monster!
entries.zh: 快看，找到了！一只腐化怪物！

entries.en: It's just ahead of us, the Burning Spider!
entries.zh: 就在前面，是燃烧蜘蛛！
去解决它吧，祝你好运！
这只猪灵迷路了！

entries.en: They probably got cornered by monsters and had to hide here.
entries.zh: 它大概被怪物逼到了绝路，只能躲在这里。

entries.en: Piglins turn back into pigs if they go too long without Sulphur.
entries.zh: 猪灵太久接触不到硫磺，就会变回猪。

entries.en: That Corrupted Monster should have dropped some Sulphur. Quick, give it to them!
entries.zh: 刚才那只腐化怪物应该掉了些硫磺。快，拿给它！
这里就是法师大教堂。

entries.en: Your job is to enter the Cathedral and find the Dean's office.
entries.zh: 你的任务是进入大教堂，找到院长办公室。

entries.en: They are probably hiding the research there.
entries.zh: 他们很可能把研究成果藏在那里。

entries.en: There are multiple entrances, most of them have guards but this one down there is often unprotected.
entries.zh: 这里有好几个入口，大多有人把守，不过下面那个经常没人看着。

entries.en: Good luck, I'll be right there in case you need moral support.
entries.zh: 祝你好运。我就在这儿，随时给你提供精神支持。

entries.en: Don't get caught by the guards!
entries.zh: 别被卫兵抓住！

entries.en: The Dean's office? I don't know where it is.
entries.zh: 院长办公室？我不知道在哪儿。

entries.en: It's definitely in their Cathedral though, I know they reorganized a lot of it into an Academy.
entries.zh: 但肯定在大教堂里。我知道他们把很大一部分区域改成了学院。
你拿对东西了吗？

entries.en: Okay great, let's leave this place. I have Mycelium all over my shoes.
entries.zh: 好极了，我们赶紧离开。我鞋底全是菌丝体。
再去找乌戈谈谈吧。

entries.en: I'll use a Travel Scroll, see you there.
entries.zh: 我用传送卷轴先走一步，到那里见。

entries.en: %1$s if you know other strong adventurers, now is the time to bring them.
entries.zh: %1$s,如果你认识其他强大的冒险者，现在该把他们叫来了。

entries.en: This monster is something else, trust me.
entries.zh: 相信我，那只怪物绝非等闲之辈。
准备好战斗了吗？

entries.en: Come back when you are ready, hurry up!
entries.zh: 准备好了就赶紧回来！
准备好了吗？
太好了！开打吧！

entries.en: Thanks for sticking around, you looked real cool out there!
entries.zh: 谢谢你一直留到最后，刚才战斗时可帅呆了！

entries.en: I really have to do everything around here.
entries.zh: 这里怎么什么事都得我来做。
跟我交谈即可开始！

entries.en: Okay adventurers, I will go fish up Kuudra!
entries.zh: 好了，冒险者们，我去把库德拉钓上来！

entries.en: Head over to the main platform, I will join you when I get a bite!
entries.zh: 先去主平台，等鱼咬钩我就来和你们会合！
库德拉来了！
它来了！
熔岩巨妖——库德拉！
这只可生气了！

entries.en: THE BRIDGE IS COLLAPSING, GET TO THE CENTER!
entries.zh: 桥要塌了，快去中央！

entries.en: Okay adventurers, I will go and fish up Kuudra!
entries.zh: 好了，冒险者们，我这就去把库德拉钓上来！
不对，只是一条岩浆鱼！

entries.en: Wait... I think I've hooked onto something!
entries.zh: 等等……我好像钓到什么东西了！

entries.en: Whatever it is, it sure is big! This might be it!
entries.zh: 不管是什么，个头可真大！也许就是它！
不妙。
怎么又来！
呼……好险！

entries.en: ARGH! All of the supplies fell into the lava! You need to retrieve them quickly!
entries.zh: 啊！所有物资都掉进熔岩里了！得赶紧捞回来！

entries.en: Use your Lava Fishing Rods to pull them closer to the platform and collect them!
entries.zh: 用熔岩钓竿把物资拉近平台，再收集起来！

entries.en: I'll help you clear out Kuudra's minions, go fetch my supplies!
entries.zh: 我来帮你们清理库德拉的爪牙，快去拿回我的物资！

entries.en: OMG! Great work collecting my supplies!
entries.zh: 我的天！物资全收回来了，干得漂亮！

entries.en: Now... please just cover me for a few minutes, I'll put together our special weapon!
entries.zh: 现在……请掩护我几分钟，我来组装我们的秘密武器！

entries.en: It's time to build the Ballista again! Cover me!
entries.zh: 又到组装弩炮的时候了！掩护我！

entries.en: What the hell is that noise?! I think we've made him mad!
entries.zh: 这鬼动静是什么？! 我们好像把它惹火了！

entries.en: Looks like the horde is coming! Cover me!
entries.zh: 怪群来了！掩护我！

entries.en: Damaging Kuudra directly is futile. His thick skin is impenetrable with conventional weapons!
entries.zh: 直接攻击库德拉没用。它的厚皮根本打不穿，普通武器对它无效！
不是吧。
这一下伤得可不轻！

entries.en: I'm sure that'll buff out... I hope..
entries.zh: 这点损伤应该能修好……但愿吧……
啊，这声音听着可不妙。

entries.en: Guys!! You need to focus the tentacles!
entries.zh: 各位！! 集中攻击触手！

entries.en: Those Energized Chunks really pack a punch when they explode! Try hitting them towards Kuudra!
entries.zh: 充能块爆炸时威力十足！试着把它们打向库德拉！

entries.en: A Dropship is approaching! Take it down before it's too late!
entries.zh: 一艘空投艇正在接近！趁还来得及把它击落！

entries.en: A fleet of Dropships are approaching! Take them down before it's too late!
entries.zh: 一支空投艇编队正在接近！趁还来得及把它们击落！

entries.en: Look out, Magma Followers! Don't let them merge!
entries.zh: 小心，岩浆追随者！别让它们融合！

entries.en: A group of Wandering Blazes are emerging from Kuudra's mouth!
entries.zh: 一群游荡烈焰人正从库德拉嘴里冒出来！

entries.en: Phew! The Ballista is finally ready! It should be strong enough to tank Kuudra's blows now!
entries.zh: 呼！弩炮终于造好了！现在应该足以扛住库德拉的攻击！

entries.en: We need to find the fuel for the Ballista, it must have fallen in the lava with the rest of my supplies!
entries.zh: 得找到弩炮的燃料，它肯定掉进熔岩里了，和我其他的物资一起！

entries.en: Looks like Kuudra has re-emerged! It's time to shoot him with the Ballista!
entries.zh: 库德拉又冒出来了！该用弩炮射它了！

entries.en: Phew! The Ballista is finally ready! It should be strong enough to tank Kuudra's blow!
entries.zh: 呼！弩炮终于造好了！现在应该足以扛住库德拉的攻击！

entries.en: We need to find fuel for the Ballista, it must be fallen into the lava with the rest of my supplies!
entries.zh: 我们得找到弩炮燃料，它肯定和其他物资一起掉进熔岩了！
咦，那是什么声音？
哇……哇啊！发生什么了！!

entries.en: *muffles*Help! I'm still alive in here! It stinks!
entries.zh: *含糊不清*救命！我还活着！这里臭死了！

entries.en: *muffles*I think I'm in Kuudra's Belly! I was standing too close!
entries.zh: *含糊不清*我好像在库德拉肚子里！刚才站得太近了！

entries.en: *muffles*See if you can find a way to get in here too! I see something which may help us kill Kuudra!
entries.zh: *含糊不清*想办法也进来！我看见了某种也许能杀死库德拉的东西！
哦，真巧，居然在这里见到你。

entries.en: What? Yes I am still alive. I landed in Kuudra's belly here.
entries.zh: 怎么？对，我还活着。我掉进库德拉的肚子里了。

entries.en: It looks like if we mine these purple pods, we can do some real damage to Kuudra!
entries.zh: 看来只要挖掉这些紫色囊泡，就能真正重创库德拉！

entries.en: Oh come on! What is it this time!
entries.zh: 不会吧！这次又是什么！

entries.en: I'll fight the mobs, you focus on destroying these pods!
entries.zh: 我来对付怪物，你专心摧毁这些囊泡！

entries.en: We need to get out before we burn in this lava!
entries.zh: 得赶在被熔岩烧死前逃出去！

entries.en: We can escape back out his throat at the top of his stomach!
entries.zh: 可以从胃顶端沿着它的喉咙逃出去！
啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊——

entries.en: When Kuudra submerges, we will be flushed out of his stomach! We need to get back inside but be careful when he submerges!
entries.zh: 库德拉下潜时，我们会被冲出它的胃！还得重新进去，但它下潜时一定要小心！

entries.en: That looks like it hurt! Quickly, while Kuudra is distracted shoot him with the Ballista!
entries.zh: 这一下看着就疼！快，趁库德拉分神，用弩炮轰它！

entries.en: POW! SURELY THAT'S IT! I don't think he has any more in him!
entries.zh: 砰！这下总该结束了！它肯定再也撑不住了！

entries.en: I knew you could do it!
entries.zh: 我就知道你们能做到！

entries.en: One last flail before admitting defeat, huh?
entries.zh: 认输前还要最后挣扎一下，是吧？

entries.en: Good job everyone. A hard fought battle come to an end. Let's get out of here before we run into any more trouble!
entries.zh: 大家干得好，这场苦战终于结束了。趁麻烦还没找上门，赶紧离开这里！

entries.en: What's happening? Why isn't he dying?
entries.zh: 怎么回事？它为什么还没死？

entries.en: What just happened? Is this Kuudra's real lair?
entries.zh: 刚才发生了什么？这里才是库德拉真正的巢穴吗？

entries.en: I'm not going down there... that's all you.
entries.zh: 我可不下去……接下来全靠你们了。

entries.en: How do you like your Faction?
entries.zh: 你觉得现在的阵营怎么样？

entries.en: If you want to swap Factions let me know, it really isn't that hard.
entries.zh: 想换阵营就告诉我，其实没那么难。

entries.en: All you have to do is lose all your Reputation points, we call that "becoming neutral".
entries.zh: 只要失去全部声望点数就行，我们把这种状态叫作“变为中立”。

entries.en: If you go neutral, let me know!
entries.zh: 变为中立后记得告诉我！

entries.en: Do you want to change your Faction?
entries.zh: 你想更换阵营吗？

entries.en: You want to join the Barbarian Faction, hmm.
entries.zh: 你想加入野蛮人阵营，嗯……

entries.en: So you want to join the Mage Faction then...
entries.zh: 所以你想加入法师阵营……

entries.en: You want to change factions AGAIN?!
entries.zh: 你又想换阵营？!

entries.en: Well because you already joined that faction in the past, all you have to do is go to their Community Center.
entries.zh: 既然你以前加入过那个阵营，只要去他们的社区中心就行。

entries.en: From their Town Board you can sign up to their Faction again as long as you were a part of it in the past!
entries.zh: 只要过去曾是其中一员，就能在城镇公告板上重新加入那个阵营！

entries.en: I'M UP HERE! ON TOP OF THE MOUNTAIN!!
entries.zh: 我在上面！山顶上！!

entries.en: I'm about to jump on top of this mountain, get ready!
entries.zh: 我要跳到这座山顶上去了，准备好！

entries.en: That's the skeleton of Jythar, the Eternal One - the one who caused the destruction of the world.
entries.zh: 那是永恒者吉萨尔的骸骨——正是它毁灭了这个世界。

entries.en: I saw what happened. I saw everything!
entries.zh: 刚才的事我看见了。我全都看见了！

entries.en: %1$s, if you know other strong adventurers, now is the time to bring them.
entries.zh: %1$s，如果你还认识别的厉害冒险者，现在就叫他们来吧。

entries.en: The Academy was great today, learned a lot of important things.
entries.zh: 今天在学院过得真不错，学到了不少重要知识。
