entries.en: I'm just waiting for my friend to arrive so we can walk back home together.
entries.zh: 我就在等朋友过来，然后一起走回家。

entries.en: My friend should be here any minute now.
entries.zh: 我的朋友应该马上就到了。
马——上——就到……
我是最后出生的。

entries.en: Try some of Scarleton's finest spirits!
entries.zh: 来尝尝绯红城最上等的烈酒吧！
停不下来，根本停不下来！

entries.en: I was probably a rabbit in another life!
entries.zh: 我上辈子多半是只兔子！
我就爱跑跑跳跳。
库德拉和我们没什么不同。

entries.en: Sulphur is life - if there is enough for us there is enough for them.
entries.zh: 硫磺就是生命——既然够我们用，也一定够它们用。

entries.en: I would gladly share my Sulphur with them!
entries.zh: 我很乐意把自己的硫磺分给它们！
请给它们一次机会！
没时间了……
我得做好准备。
啊啊啊！
别杀我！!!!

entries.en: Excuse me. You really scared me!
entries.zh: 不好意思，你真的吓到我了！

entries.en: I'm not a gambler, but if I had to bet on a faction to win this war, I wouldn't bet on us.
entries.zh: 我不爱赌博，但真要押哪方能赢这场战争，我绝不会押我们。

entries.en: Soon enough I'll barricade myself in my basement.
entries.zh: 过不了多久，我就要把自己关进地下室，堵死入口了。

entries.en: I have enough provisions to last at least 7 months.
entries.zh: 我的储备至少够撑 7 个月。

entries.en: That's not enough...no that's far from enough.
entries.zh: 还是不够……不，远远不够。

entries.en: What I need the most right now is a Heavy Pearl.
entries.zh: 我现在最需要的就是一颗沉重珍珠。

entries.en: If you bring one to me I'll reward you handsomely.
entries.zh: 你要是能带一颗回来，我会重重酬谢你。

entries.en: There is only one way to obtain Heavy Pearls.
entries.zh: 想拿到沉重珍珠，只有一种办法。

entries.en: First you have to go down in that giant cave below the Volcano.
entries.zh: 首先，你得下到火山底下那座大洞窟里。

entries.en: From there you need to enter the cave that goes North-West.
entries.zh: 然后，从那里进入通往西北方的洞窟。

entries.en: Inside that cave lives very rare creatures called Hellwisps.
entries.zh: 那座洞窟里住着一种极其罕见的生物，名叫地狱鬼火。

entries.en: If you keep going down and down, you'll find another cave, which leads to The Matriarch.
entries.zh: 继续一路往下，你会找到另一座洞窟，通往女族长所在之处。

entries.en: That creature is much larger than the other ones and has been there for decades, if not centuries.
entries.zh: 那只生物比其他同类大得多，已经在那里活了几十年，甚至可能有几百年。

entries.en: To get a Heavy Pearl, you need to let the Matriarch eat you alive.
entries.zh: 想拿到沉重珍珠，你得让女族长把你活吞下去。

entries.en: Once you are inside its stomach, you can steal a few pearls.
entries.zh: 进了它的肚子，你就能偷走几颗珍珠。

entries.en: Then all you have to do is escape before the acid kills you, I think there is a way but I'm not so sure how.
entries.zh: 接下来只要赶在被胃酸弄死之前逃出去就行了。我想应该有办法，就是不太清楚该怎么做。

entries.en: You have to get the pearls on your first try because the Matriarch won't eat you again.
entries.zh: 你得第一次就拿到珍珠，因为女族长不会再吃你一次。

entries.en: Usually it takes at least a day before she forgets your scent and eats you again.
entries.zh: 通常至少要等一天，它才会忘掉你的气味，愿意再次吞下你。

entries.en: Please bring me back one of those Heavy Pearls.
entries.zh: 请给我带一颗沉重珍珠回来。

entries.en: I think the best way to get out is for The Matriarch to spit you out, but I'll admit I don't know how.
entries.zh: 我觉得最好的逃生办法是让女族长把你吐出来，不过老实说，我不知道该怎么让它这么做。

entries.en: Heavy Pearls have many, many properties.
entries.zh: 沉重珍珠有很多很多用途。
咿呀啊啊啊啊啊啊！

entries.en: You almost gave me a heart attack!!!
entries.zh: 你差点把我吓出心脏病！!!

entries.en: Oh, you managed to get a Heavy Pearl!
entries.zh: 哦，你居然拿到了沉重珍珠！

entries.en: Now that you mention it, I remember how to escape the belly of the Matriarch!
entries.zh: 你这么一说，我想起来该怎么逃出女族长的肚子了！

entries.en: All you have to do it punch its uvula!
entries.zh: 你只要揍它的小舌头就行！

entries.en: In a way they are not so different than us.
entries.zh: 从某种角度看，它们和我们也没那么不同。

entries.en: Thank you very much, here take these Coins.
entries.zh: 太谢谢你了，这些硬币你拿着。
现在我更希望你赶紧离开。
我实在不信任任何人。

entries.en: All you have to do is punch its uvula!
entries.zh: 你只要揍它的悬雍垂就行了！

entries.en: Me Grog, you thirsty. Buy drink!
entries.zh: 俺是格罗格。你渴，买喝的！

entries.en: I can hear the footsteps of a traitor. You're not supposed to be here!
entries.zh: 我听见叛徒的脚步声了。这里不是你该来的地方！

entries.en: Hey, I can see you over there! You're not supposed to be here!
entries.zh: 喂，我看到你了！这里不是你该来的地方！

entries.en: Get out of here, traitorous scum.
entries.zh: 滚出去，叛徒败类。

entries.en: I lost them. Got to be around here somewhere...
entries.zh: 跟丢了。一定还躲在这附近……

entries.en: The End is a large island... my favorite hobby is racing across it!
entries.zh: 末地这么大……我最喜欢的事，就是在岛上来一场赛跑！

entries.en: My best time is pretty fast, you probably will never beat me. But you can try!
entries.zh: 我的最好成绩可快了，你大概永远都超不过。不过，试试也无妨！

entries.en: To complete the race, you'll need to reach the opposite side of the island and come all the way back.
entries.zh: 想跑完全程，你得先到岛的另一头，再一路跑回来。

entries.en: Start the race by walking over the pressure plate. If you finish in under 3 minutes, I'll reward you for it! Good luck!
entries.zh: 踩上压力板就能开始比赛。只要不到 3 分钟就跑完，我就给你奖励！加油！

entries.en: But you can get a much quicker time if you use the items that I do.
entries.zh: 不过，要是用上我这些小道具，你还能跑得更快。

entries.en: Take these Silent Pearls, they allow you to teleport without angering Endermen.
entries.zh: 拿着这些无声珍珠，用它们传送就不会惹怒末影人了。

entries.en: Try again, but this time come back in 2 minutes or less!
entries.zh: 再来一次吧，这回要在 2 分钟内回来！
你跑得越来越快了！

entries.en: Have this Enderman Mask! I wear it sometimes to make me feel like an Enderman.
entries.zh: 这个末影人面具送你！我有时会戴上它，过一把当末影人的瘾。

entries.en: See if you can beat 80 seconds!
entries.zh: 看看能不能跑进 80 秒！

entries.en: Now we're talking! You're getting close to my record!
entries.zh: 这才像话！你快赶上我的纪录了！

entries.en: Here's a weird item that I have no use for. It won't help you beat my personal best, but it's your item now.
entries.zh: 这个怪东西我用不上，送你吧。虽然它帮不了你打破我的纪录，不过现在它归你了。

entries.en: Finish the race in under 48 seconds and come talk to me! I promise the reward will be better!
entries.zh: 跑进 48 秒再来找我！保证下次的奖励更好！

entries.en: You're so close!! Can you finish the race in 48 seconds or less and beat my personal record?
entries.zh: 就差一点了！! 你能在 48 秒内跑完，打破我的纪录吗？

entries.en: You did it! Congratulations, %1$s. You are now faster than Guber!
entries.zh: 你做到了！恭喜你，%1$s。现在你比古伯跑得还快了！

entries.en: A legendary speedster once ran this island, some say he finished the race in mere seconds!
entries.zh: 曾经有位传说中的飞毛腿跑过这座岛，听说他只花了几秒就跑完了！

entries.en: He left behind this Pig's Foot. I want you to have it, as you have proven to be the best of the best!
entries.zh: 他留下了这只猪蹄。现在我想把它送给你，你已经证明自己是高手中的高手了！

entries.en: As you can see, this item is quite powerful. It makes you incredibly fast!
entries.zh: 看得出来吧，这东西可厉害了，能让你跑得飞快！

entries.en: Hey you! Over here! Come talk to me! I'll teach you about racing!
entries.zh: 嘿，你！这边！过来聊聊，我教你怎么竞速！

entries.en: Give it a go! Can you finish the race in %1$s or less?
entries.zh: 试试吧！能在 %1$s 内跑完全程吗？

entries.en: Run over the pressure plate to start racing!
entries.zh: 踩过压力板就能开始比赛！

entries.en: What are you talking to me for? Get back in the race!
entries.zh: 还找我聊什么呢？快回去比赛！

entries.en: Run across The End to the opposite side of the island to complete the race!
entries.zh: 穿过末地，跑到岛的另一头才能完成比赛！

entries.en: Keep it up! Can you finish the race in %1$s or less?
entries.zh: 再接再厉！能在 %1$s 内跑完全程吗？

entries.en: You shouldn't be talking to me if you want to beat %1$s!
entries.zh: 想跑进 %1$s，就别在这儿跟我聊天了！

entries.en: Keep at it! Can you finish the race in %1$s or less?
entries.zh: 继续努力！能在 %1$s 内跑完全程吗？

entries.en: How do you suppose you'll beat %1$s by talking to me?
entries.zh: 光跟我聊天，你打算怎么跑进 %1$s?

entries.en: Get back in the race! You only have %1$s!
entries.zh: 快回去比赛！你只有 %1$s!

entries.en: Get back in the race! %1$s isn't enough time for there to be chit chat!
entries.zh: 快回去比赛！ %1$s 可没工夫让你闲聊！

entries.en: You'll never beat my personal best if you waste this much time! Yikes!
entries.zh: 这样浪费时间，你可永远破不了我的个人纪录！哎哟！

entries.en: You should know by now talking to me during the race is only going to hurt your time! Yeesh!
entries.zh: 你也该知道了，比赛时跟我聊天只会拖慢成绩！真是的！
哇，这可真厉害。
给，拿着这份晦涩结局！

entries.en: Behind me is the Spiders Mound.
entries.zh: 我身后就是蜘蛛山丘。

entries.en: Be careful, though! The Broodmother has made the summit home, and she's quite tenacious!
entries.zh: 但要小心！育母蜘蛛已经在山顶安了家，而且她相当难缠！

entries.en: Broodmother, Broodfather, Arachne... There are so many dangerous spiders around here.
entries.zh: 育母蜘蛛、育父蜘蛛、阿拉克涅……这附近的危险蜘蛛可真不少。

entries.en: The gravel on this island seems to magically reappear when you break it. I don't ask questions.
entries.zh: 这座岛的沙砾挖掉后好像又会自己冒出来。别问我，我也搞不懂。

entries.en: Slimes seem to spawn on the hills when it rains. They're a bit more dangerous during a thunderstorm.
entries.zh: 山坡上似乎会在下雨时冒出史莱姆。碰上雷暴，它们还会更危险。

entries.en: Try to reach the top of the Spider Mound.
entries.zh: 试着登顶蜘蛛山丘。

entries.en: Once there, test yourself against the Broodmother, if you're up to the challenge!
entries.zh: 到了山顶，就挑战一下育母蜘蛛——如果你有胆量的话！

entries.en: Be careful, though. The Broodmother has made the summit to her home, and she's quite tenacious!
entries.zh: 不过要当心。育母蜘蛛已经在山顶安了家，可难缠得很！

entries.en: Behind me is Spider Mound. Many like to test their skills by trying to reach the top of it.
entries.zh: 我身后就是蜘蛛山丘。不少人会试着爬到山顶，检验自己的实力。
哇，你还挺厉害的嘛！

entries.en: Unfortunately, there's always bigger fish. Or, in this case, a bigger spider.
entries.zh: 可惜，强中自有强中手。或者说，这里总有更大的蜘蛛。

entries.en: But, for now, you should hone your skills until you reach Combat Skill Level 12, and then travel to The End.
entries.zh: 不过眼下，你还是先把战斗技能练到 12 级，再去末地吧。

entries.en: Hone your skills until you reach Combat Skill Level 12, and then travel to The End!
entries.zh: 先把战斗技能练到 12 级，再去末地吧！

entries.en: Those Dashing Spiders are pretty obnoxious. I find a well-placed arrow can help with that.
entries.zh: 那些飞扑蜘蛛真是烦人。我发现，只要一箭射得准，就能解决。
早啊，冒险者！

entries.en: Wait, is it? I'm not sure; it's always so dark here...
entries.zh: 等等，现在真是早上吗？我也不确定；这里一直这么暗……

entries.en: Oh well, anyway, I can provide all manners of fun minions to you!
entries.zh: 算啦，不管怎样，我这儿有各种有趣的小人供你挑选！

entries.en: Oh, thank goodness! They sent someone to get me out of here.
entries.zh: 哦，谢天谢地！他们终于派人来救我了。

entries.en: Do you know what they would've done if they found me?
entries.zh: 要是被他们发现，你知道我会落得什么下场吗？
欢迎来到我的小工坊，%1$s!

entries.en: I will upgrade and salvage items for a cost!
entries.zh: 只要付费，我就能替你升级和分解物品！

entries.en: I'm busy working on my coop.
entries.zh: 我正忙着修鸡舍。
一。只。都。不。剩。

entries.en: I wake up this morning and all my chickens are GONE.
entries.zh: 今天早上我一醒来，所有鸡全都不见了。

entries.en: I finally found animals immune to Sulphur mutations but breeding them is a misery.
entries.zh: 我好不容易才找到不会被硫磺诱发变异的动物，可繁育它们简直苦不堪言。

entries.en: Could you help me getting them back inside?
entries.zh: 你能帮我把它们赶回鸡舍吗？

entries.en: I quit my previous job for this. It HAS to work.
entries.zh: 我连上一份工作都辞了，这次必须成功。

entries.en: My chickens can't be that far, I have 5 of them.
entries.zh: 我的鸡应该跑不远，一共有 5 只。

entries.en: Oh %1$s was missing too? Wondered why it was so peaceful.
entries.zh: 哦，%1$s 也跑丢了？难怪刚才这么清静。

entries.en: %1$s Jr., what time to do you call this?
entries.zh: 小 %1$s,你还知道回来？

entries.en: Oh %1$s, I'm so glad to have you back!
entries.zh: 哦，%1$s,你回来真是太好了！

entries.en: Finally! %1$s has been returned to me!
entries.zh: 终于！ %1$s 回到我身边了！

entries.en: Oh there they are! Nice to see you again Regi... I mean %1$s.
entries.zh: 哦，在那儿呢！好久不见,Regi……我是说，%1$s。

entries.en: I don't know how to thank you!
entries.zh: 我都不知道该怎么谢你了！
你救了我的生意！

entries.en: Come back in a few days and I'll reward you with my first chicken!
entries.zh: 过几天再来，我会把第一只鸡送给你作为答谢！
一只超级鸡！

entries.en: I was wrong!! My chickens are not immune to Sulphur!
entries.zh: 我错了！! 我的鸡根本不免疫硫磺！

entries.en: One of my chickens mutated into an abomination.
entries.zh: 有一只鸡变异成了怪物。

entries.en: I don't know what to do, it's way to strong for me!
entries.zh: 我不知道该怎么办，它对我来说实在太强了！

entries.en: I can't believe you managed to slay this creature of nightmares.
entries.zh: 真不敢相信，你竟然杀掉了这只噩梦般的怪物。

entries.en: I wish I could reward you but I am completely ruined.
entries.zh: 我也想给你报酬，可我已经彻底破产了。

entries.en: I am never going to financially recover from this...
entries.zh: 这辈子怕是都缓不过来了……
✆ 我的鸡……它们变异了！

entries.en: ✆ COME TO THE CHICKEN COOP QUICKLY!!!!!
entries.zh: ✆ 快来鸡舍！!!!!

entries.en: I'll be more careful from now on!
entries.zh: 以后我一定多加小心！

entries.en: If you have an Abiphone you should add me to your contacts!
entries.zh: 要是你有阿比手机，就把我加进联系人吧！

entries.en: Maybe come back when you are more experienced for more.
entries.zh: 等你更有经验些再来吧，到时还有别的事。

entries.en: Build yourself some reputation first, then we can talk again.
entries.zh: 先积累些声望，我们再谈。

entries.en: Come back later and I will have more for you to see.
entries.zh: 晚点再来，我还有东西要给你看。

entries.en: What am I going to do? My business is finished!
entries.zh: 这下怎么办？我的生意全完了！

entries.en: Are you strong enough to defeat it?
entries.zh: 你有实力打败它吗？

entries.en: Maybe I should try to get my old job back...
entries.zh: 也许我该想办法回去干老本行……
我永远忘不了鸡斯拉。

entries.en: I don't recognise you stranger, clear off.
entries.zh: 我不认识你，陌生人。走开。

entries.en: Guards! Stranger danger! Keep them away from my chickens!
entries.zh: 卫兵！有陌生人！别让对方靠近我的鸡！

entries.en: Could you help getting them back inside?
entries.zh: 能帮我把它们赶回去吗？

entries.en: %1$s Jr., what time do you call this?
entries.zh: 小 %1$s,也不看看都几点了！

entries.en: You heard what Michael said about Mob Types?
entries.zh: 你听过迈克尔讲生物类型了吗？

entries.en: Not to flex, but I've seen enough films to know about every mob type in existence.
entries.zh: 不是我吹，电影看得多，世上每一种生物类型我都认识。

entries.en: I'm bored, so let's play a game, just us two.
entries.zh: 我正无聊呢，咱俩来玩个游戏吧。

entries.en: Then go talk to him, bro.
entries.zh: 那就先去找他聊聊呗。

entries.en: You go out and slay some mobs and, every time you kill a mob with a new mob type, I'll add it to my book!
entries.zh: 你出去打怪，每击杀一种新类型的怪物，我就把它记进我的书里！

entries.en: I'll give you a reward each time you kill a new mob type, so get busy!
entries.zh: 每击杀一种新类型的怪物，我就给你一份奖励，快去忙吧！

entries.en: Dude, I'm so bored out here. Mind showing me what you've been up to?
entries.zh: 在这儿待得真无聊。给我看看你最近都干了些什么呗？

entries.en: 'Sup champ! How's that Mob Type collection coming along? Let's take a look!
entries.zh: 哟，高手！生物类型收集得怎么样了？来看看！

entries.en: Talk to me again if you want to check your progress!
entries.zh: 想查看进度，就再来找我聊聊！

entries.en: The view from my window is amazing.
entries.zh: 从我窗户看出去的风景美极了。

entries.en: That's the main reason why I bought this place.
entries.zh: 我买下这里，主要就是为了这片景色。
唉……这风景真美啊……

entries.en: A week...I only have a week...
entries.zh: 一周……我只剩一周了……

entries.en: I have beef with a mage and we agreed to have a duel in a week.
entries.zh: 我跟一个法师结了梁子，约好一周后决斗。

entries.en: Why did I agree to this? I've never fought in my life!
entries.zh: 我为什么要答应啊？我这辈子都没打过架！

entries.en: Would you mind helping me train? You would save my life!
entries.zh: 能帮我训练吗？这可真是在救我的命！

entries.en: I'm ready to fight again, are you also ready?
entries.zh: 我准备好再打一场了，你也准备好了吗？

entries.en: I'm ready for my lesson, are you?
entries.zh: 我准备好上课了，你呢？

entries.en: I can tell I'm improving, let's keep going, shall we?
entries.zh: 我能感觉到自己在进步，继续练，怎么样？

entries.en: Only 3 more training sessions, are you ready?
entries.zh: 只剩 3 次训练了，准备好了吗？

entries.en: I had a good night's sleep. I'm so ready for this session, are you?
entries.zh: 昨晚睡得真香，我已经迫不及待了。你准备好了吗？
7 天,7 堂课。
太好了！那就开练！
开打吧！
糟了，这下我麻烦大了。
我被你一下秒了……
这也太打击人了。

entries.en: You are beating me too easily, this isn't helping with my insecurity...
entries.zh: 你赢得也太轻松了，我反而更没自信了……
天啊……
我到底有多弱啊？

entries.en: You are the best teacher I could have hoped for...
entries.zh: 你就是我能遇到的最好老师……
我变强了！冲啊！!

entries.en: What a match, I truly enjoy sparring with you.
entries.zh: 打得真痛快，我真的很喜欢跟你切磋。

entries.en: I am so happy with the improvements I've made this week, and it's all thanks to you.
entries.zh: 我太满意自己这周的进步了，这一切都多亏了你。

entries.en: Just a week ago I was feeling insecure, now I'm going to this duel with confidence.
entries.zh: 一周前我还毫无自信，现在我能昂首挺胸地去决斗了。

entries.en: Please come back tomorrow and help me train again.
entries.zh: 明天也请来陪我练练吧。

entries.en: Okay, I'll wait here until you are ready.
entries.zh: 好，我在这儿等你，准备好了再来找我。

entries.en: Sulphurcare is our proposal - no taxes on Sulphur!
entries.zh: 我们的主张是硫磺福利——硫磺零税！

entries.en: Any Piglin should have access to their share of the stash.
entries.zh: 每个猪灵都该拿到储备里属于自己的那一份。
别客气，就当自己家！
懂得分享才叫关爱！

entries.en: Protesting sure takes a lot out of you. I need to rest!
entries.zh: 抗议可真耗体力。我得歇会儿！

entries.en: Help spread our message! Sulphur for all!
entries.zh: 帮我们把口号传出去！硫磺属于大家！

entries.en: I don't have anything to sell you right now.
entries.zh: 我现在没什么能卖给你的。

entries.en: Come back later and I might be able to sell you something!
entries.zh: 以后再来吧，说不定到时我就有东西卖了！
你是来卖东西的吗？

entries.en: No, forget what I just said.
entries.zh: 不，当我没说。
离我们远点。

entries.en: I've been studying the ancient artifacts of Kuudra.
entries.zh: 我一直在研究与库德拉有关的古代文物。

entries.en: I found this artifact that had some weird writing on it.
entries.zh: 我找到一件刻有奇怪文字的神器。

entries.en: It seems to be missing some information so I can't figure out what it means.
entries.zh: 可上面的信息似乎残缺不全，我没法弄懂它的含义。

entries.en: There has to be information somewhere that can fill in the blanks.
entries.zh: 一定有什么资料能补全这些空白。

entries.en: If you want to take a look here is what it says.
entries.zh: 想看的话，上面写的是这些。
那是库德拉遗物吗？
你从哪儿找到的？
算了，不重要。

entries.en: Since you brought this to me, I'll give you something to show my appreciation.
entries.zh: 既然是你把它带来，我就送点东西聊表谢意。

entries.en: Thanks for showing me the Kuudra relic!
entries.zh: 谢谢你让我看了库德拉遗物！

entries.en: You never did tell me how you found it...
entries.zh: 你一直没告诉我到底是怎么找到它的……

entries.en: Ah yes the Exquisite Kuudra Teeth Plaque!
entries.zh: 啊，没错，精致库德拉牙垢！

entries.en: I'll go ahead and help break that down for you!
entries.zh: 我来帮你把它拆解掉！

entries.en: You know... this item can be very helpful to unlock something special!
entries.zh: 你知道吗……这件物品能帮你解锁某种特别的东西！
你好，冒险者！

entries.en: Are you a believer in the return of Kuudra?
entries.zh: 你相信库德拉终将归来吗？

entries.en: If you are, why don't you offer up some coin to show your belief.
entries.zh: 若你相信，不妨献上些硬币，以示虔诚。

entries.en: It is said that Kuudra once blessed this lavapool.
entries.zh: 传说库德拉曾赐福于这片熔岩池。

entries.en: Maybe Kuudra will show favor upon you.
entries.zh: 也许库德拉也会眷顾你。

entries.en: Disappointing, maybe one day you will believe.
entries.zh: 真令人失望。也许有一天，你会成为信徒。

entries.en: Thank you for your offering. Kuudra will be pleased.
entries.zh: 感谢你的奉献，库德拉会满意的。

entries.en: What a great offering. Kuudra will be pleased.
entries.zh: 多么丰厚的奉献！库德拉会满意的。
你果真是虔诚的信徒。
库德拉会赐福于你。
冒险者！

entries.en: it seems like Kuudra has shown favour upon you!
entries.zh: 看来库德拉已向你降下恩宠！

entries.en: This item surfaced from the lavapool
entries.zh: 这件物品从熔岩池中浮了上来。

entries.en: You must believe in Kuudra's return!
entries.zh: 你一定相信库德拉会归来！

entries.en: I know this as you have that intriguing item!
entries.zh: 我看得出来，因为你带着那件耐人寻味的物品！

entries.en: You don't have to offer some coin...
entries.zh: 你不必再献硬币了……

entries.en: Just tell me how to help you!
entries.zh: 直接告诉我该怎么帮你吧！

entries.en: Oh so you want me to help you!
entries.zh: 哦，原来你想让我帮忙！

entries.en: I can definitely do that for you adventurer!
entries.zh: 当然没问题，冒险者！

entries.en: There, go and hope for his return.
entries.zh: 好了，去祈盼祂的归来吧。
无法读取该数字！
数字无效！
你没有这么多硬币！

entries.en: Wow! That is a classic. It's great to meet a fellow follower of Kuudra.
entries.zh: 哇！这句可是经典。能遇到另一位库德拉的信徒真好。

entries.en: I wish I could give you something to commemorate meeting you, but I don't have that much anymore.
entries.zh: 真想送你点什么纪念我们的相遇，可惜我现在没多少东西了。

entries.en: Maybe if we met in the past I would have something for you.
entries.zh: 要是我们在过去相遇，说不定我还能拿出点东西给你。

entries.en: Have I met you before? I am getting some dejavu.
entries.zh: 我们以前见过吗？我怎么有种似曾相识的感觉。

entries.en: Wow that's a lot of resources!
entries.zh: 哇，这么多材料！

entries.en: Too bad you didn't put in the effort to collect them yourselves.
entries.zh: 可惜不是你亲手收集的。

entries.en: Wow how did you know I liked these items!
entries.zh: 哇，你怎么知道我喜欢这些东西！

entries.en: I'm lucky to have met you.
entries.zh: 能遇到你真幸运。

entries.en: Here, take this to commemorate our meeting!
entries.zh: 来，收下这个，纪念我们的相遇！

entries.en: I don't know, adventurer, is it his real lair???
entries.zh: 我也不知道啊，冒险者，那到底是不是它真正的老巢？??

entries.en: Speaking of layers, I see you have Repulsive Kuudra Teeth Plaque!
entries.zh: 说到一层层的东西，我看你带着恶心库德拉牙垢！

entries.en: You can definitely use that to take some layers off Kuudra's teeth!
entries.zh: 它肯定能帮库德拉的牙齿刮掉好几层牙垢！

entries.en: There, I'll help you get it broken down!
entries.zh: 来，我帮你把它拆开！

entries.en: I know so many things about Kuudra.
entries.zh: 关于库德拉，我知道的可多了。
那些内容相当有意思。

entries.en: I've been studying the ancient texts of Kuudra.
entries.zh: 我一直在研究记载库德拉的古代文献。

entries.en: When I was much younger, I used to collect so much Magma Cream and Netherrack.
entries.zh: 我年轻得多的时候，曾收集过大量岩浆膏和下界岩。

entries.en: Unfortunately, those days are behind me.
entries.zh: 可惜，那样的日子已经过去了。

entries.en: I now spend my days learning about Kuudra.
entries.zh: 如今我每天都在钻研库德拉。

entries.en: Have you tried lava fishing before?
entries.zh: 你试过在熔岩里钓鱼吗？

entries.en: Us Piglins believe lava fishes are sacred beasts.
entries.zh: 我们猪灵相信，熔岩鱼是神圣的生灵。

entries.en: However recently something strange has been happening to the fishes.
entries.zh: 可最近，这些鱼身上发生了些怪事。

entries.en: I am trying to understand the cause of this turmoil.
entries.zh: 我正在调查这场异变的起因。

entries.en: My beliefs prevent me from fishing, but I cannot investigate without seeing some specimens myself.
entries.zh: 信仰不允许我亲自钓鱼，可不看看样本，我就没法继续调查。

entries.en: Could you please bring me 1 Flyfish and 1 Skeleton Fish.
entries.zh: 能请你带 1 条飞鳍鱼和 1 条骷髅鱼给我吗？

entries.en: I don't know myself how to find those, but there is an expert who lives at the top of the volcano.
entries.zh: 我也不知道该怎么找到它们，不过炽焰火山山顶住着一位专家。
那位专家叫奥杰。

entries.en: I don't want to point fingers at anyone, but if anyone is messing with the lava, it's certainly not our faction.
entries.zh: 我不想随便指责谁，但真有人在熔岩里搞鬼，肯定不是我们阵营干的。

entries.en: Odger is a Goblin. I think he eats the fishes, raw...
entries.zh: 奥杰是个哥布林。我觉得他会生吃那些鱼……

entries.en: I am glad we can count you in our ranks!
entries.zh: 很高兴我们阵营里有你这样可靠的人！

entries.en: I'll be studying those Fishes now.
entries.zh: 我这就开始研究这些鱼。
回头见。

entries.en: We Piglins send our deads in the lava of the Volcano for their final journey.
entries.zh: 我们猪灵会把逝者送进火山的熔岩，让他们走完最后一程。

entries.en: A long long time ago, when we cremated the corpse of our great Chief Malak, the Volcano erupted.
entries.zh: 很久很久以前，我们火化伟大的酋长马拉克的遗体时，火山喷发了。

entries.en: It was the largest eruption we have ever seen. As if the Volcano was talking to us.
entries.zh: 那是我们见过最猛烈的一次喷发，仿佛火山在向我们诉说。

entries.en: And from that burst, thousands of lava fishes fell from the sky onto Dragontail.
entries.zh: 喷发过后，成千上万条熔岩鱼从天而降，落在龙尾镇。

entries.en: We believe Malak and our ancestors found a new life inside the creatures of the lava.
entries.zh: 我们相信，马拉克和先祖们在熔岩生物的体内获得了新生。

entries.en: For the longest time I thought I would move to the Crimson Isle or visit the Catacombs after this place.
entries.zh: 很长一段时间里，我都想着，离开这里以后就去绯红孤岛，或者到地下墓穴看看。

entries.en: But the truth is, I really like it here.
entries.zh: 可说真的，我还挺喜欢这里的。

entries.en: What I enjoyed the most was helping you and I want to stay here to help more people.
entries.zh: 帮上你的忙，是我最开心的事。所以我想留下来，再帮帮其他人。

entries.en: You already made a ton of progress and I'm excited for the future.
entries.zh: 你已经进步这么多了，真期待你接下来的冒险。

entries.en: ⚑ Dragon Guide is my new vocation.
entries.zh: ⚑ 巨龙向导就是我的新工作。
有关巨龙的事，尽管问我！

entries.en: Woah, you're wearing the full Ender Set!
entries.zh: 哇，你已经穿齐整套末影套装了！

entries.en: That's incredible, that took me at least a week!
entries.zh: 真厉害！我当初可花了至少一个星期呢！

entries.en: You wouldn't believe what just happened, I was fighting one of those Dragons...
entries.zh: 你绝对想不到刚才发生了什么，我正跟一头巨龙交战……

entries.en: The fight was going smoothly and just as I was about to land the finishing blow, BAM!
entries.zh: 本来打得好好的，眼看就要给它最后一击了——砰！

entries.en: The Dragon teleported behind me and hit me with a claw attack!
entries.zh: 那头龙突然传送到我背后，一爪子就拍了过来！

entries.en: That was crazy, I'm still shaking!
entries.zh: 太吓人了，我到现在还在发抖！
你这反应，好像没多激动啊……

entries.en: Anyways, I'm hurt and I lost my bow in the chaos.
entries.zh: 总之，我受了伤，混乱中还把弓给弄丢了。

entries.en: I'm 90% sure one of those Seers in the Dragon's Nest has it.
entries.zh: 我有九成把握，弓就在龙巢里的某个先知手上。

entries.en: Would you mind defeating some of them for me?
entries.zh: 能帮我去打倒一些先知吗？

entries.en: I'm sure one of them will have my Dragon Shortbow.
entries.zh: 我的巨龙短弓肯定在它们其中一个手上。

entries.en: Ah you found my Dragon Shortbow!
entries.zh: 啊，你找到我的巨龙短弓了！

entries.en: I knew I saw one of those Seers grab it for themselves.
entries.zh: 我就说没看错，果然是哪个先知把它顺走了。

entries.en: Thank you so much, I owe you one.
entries.zh: 太感谢了，算我欠你个人情。

entries.en: I got the bow from the Pearl Dealer up there near the entrance of the island.
entries.zh: 这把弓是我从上面岛屿入口附近的珍珠商人那里弄来的。

entries.en: He doesn't usually sell them but he's my friend.
entries.zh: 他平时不卖这个，不过我俩是朋友。

entries.en: I'll let him know you helped me!
entries.zh: 我会告诉他，你可是帮了我大忙！

entries.en: Drop by his shop a little later and I'm sure he will sell you one for cheap!
entries.zh: 过会儿去他店里看看吧，他肯定会便宜卖你一把！

entries.en: I'm just about to go slay some Dragons.
entries.zh: 我正准备再去猎杀几头巨龙。

entries.en: Come see me later and I'll tell you all about them!
entries.zh: 晚点来找我，我给你好好讲讲它们！
累了？我？不不不。
我只是在歇会儿。

entries.en: The End is a creepy place, but you get used to it!
entries.zh: 末地是有点瘆人，不过待久了就习惯了！

entries.en: If you want a piece of advice, you should start by killing the Endermen up here.
entries.zh: 要我给点建议的话，你应该先练练手，去杀这上面的末影人。

entries.en: They sometimes drop important gear like the armor I'm wearing.
entries.zh: 它们有时会掉落很有用的装备，比如我身上这套护甲。
不过，你的实力够吗？
先试着击杀 %1$s 只吧！
行啊，不错不错！

entries.en: It took me a while to get that strong.
entries.zh: 我当初可是练了好一阵才有这身手。

entries.en: I use a Void Sword, it's a very powerful weapon.
entries.zh: 我用的是虚空之剑，这武器可厉害了。

entries.en: It gets stronger with each piece of Ender Armor you are wearing.
entries.zh: 你身上的末影盔甲每多一件，它的威力就更强一分。

entries.en: I have an extremely strong emotional attachment to this item so...
entries.zh: 我对这把剑可是感情深厚，所以嘛……

entries.en: I'm willing to sell it to you for the modest sum of %1$s coins.
entries.zh: 我愿意卖给你，只收你区区 %1$s 硬币。
你意下如何？

entries.en: I think you are making a mistake, perhaps the biggest mistake of your life!
entries.zh: 我觉得你这决定可不明智，说不定会后悔一辈子！

entries.en: Are you sure you don't want that sword?
entries.zh: 你确定不要这把剑？

entries.en: Happy dealing with you, I hope this sword will help you as much as it helped me.
entries.zh: 成交，合作愉快！希望这把剑也能像当初帮我一样帮到你。

entries.en: You should focus on getting all %1$s pieces of the Ender Armor now.
entries.zh: 接下来，你该专心收齐全套 %1$s 件末影套装了。

entries.en: Half of them are dropped by the Endermen on this layer, the other pieces are a little harder to obtain.
entries.zh: 其中一半会由这一层的末影人掉落，其余几件就没那么容易找了。

entries.en: I'm sure you'll figure it out.
entries.zh: 我相信你会找到办法的。

entries.en: My time here is over, I think I'll go down in the Dragon's Nest very soon.
entries.zh: 我在这儿待得差不多了，应该很快就会下到龙巢去。
回头见！
嘿，%1$s,最近怎么样？

entries.en: Do you recognize me? I changed my armor!
entries.zh: 还认得我吗？我换了身护甲！

entries.en: Have you found the full Ender Armor Set and Equipment yet?
entries.zh: 你已经集齐整套末影盔甲与装备了吗？

entries.en: Ah, do you need help finding the remaining pieces?
entries.zh: 啊，还差几件没找到？要我帮忙吗？

entries.en: Okay. If you need help, I'll be here.
entries.zh: 行，需要帮忙的话，我就在这儿。

entries.en: Which piece are you struggling to find?
entries.zh: 哪一件最难找？

entries.en: Ahh, this one is a bit tricky.
entries.zh: 啊，这件确实有点难搞。

entries.en: You see those purple End Stone or Obsidian that sometimes appear around here?
entries.zh: 看到附近偶尔出现的那些紫色末地石或黑曜石了吗？

entries.en: If you mine enough Ender Nodes you'll eventually find the Gauntlet.
entries.zh: 多挖一些末影节点，迟早能找到末影护手。

entries.en: Are there other pieces you need info on?
entries.zh: 还想问问其他部件吗？

entries.en: You haven't got this one yet?
entries.zh: 这件你还没拿到？

entries.en: It's just from regular Endermen, like the rest of the armor!
entries.zh: 它和其他护甲一样，普通末影人就会掉！
这件还不算难。

entries.en: You see those Seers inside the Dragon's Nest?
entries.zh: 看到龙巢里的那些先知了吗？

entries.en: If you take down enough of those you'll end up getting the Cloak.
entries.zh: 多击败一些，就能拿到末影披风。
真的？

entries.en: It's from those Endermen up there, where we first met.
entries.zh: 它是从上面那些末影人身上掉的，就是我们第一次见面的地方。

entries.en: Awesome, wear all the pieces and show me!
entries.zh: 太好了，穿齐所有部件给我看看！
真奇怪。

entries.en: If you change your mind you can also go talk to Rusty in the Gold Mine.
entries.zh: 要是改主意了，也可以去金矿找拉斯蒂聊聊。

entries.en: Distracted people sometimes lose their Void Sword and he sells them back.
entries.zh: 有些粗心的人会弄丢自己的虚空之剑，他那儿能买回来。

entries.en: Have you found the full Ender Armor Set yet?
entries.zh: 你找齐整套末影套装了吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [Wow, that's crazy!] [Wow, that's crazy...]
entries.zh: 选择一个选项: [哇，太刺激了！] [哇，可真够刺激的……]

entries.en: You said it! I thought I was going to die!
entries.zh: 可不是嘛！我还以为这回要没命了！

entries.en: I want to see if you can kill at least 5 Enderman.
entries.zh: 我想看看你能不能杀掉至少 5 只末影人。

entries.en: I might give you something if you succeed.
entries.zh: 要是成功了，说不定我会送你点什么。

entries.en: I don't really know what happened around here, I'm pretty terrible in history.
entries.zh: 我也不太清楚这里发生过什么，我历史学得实在不怎么样。

entries.en: Someone called me an "Ender noob" the other day, that was pretty rude.
entries.zh: 前几天有人管我叫“末影菜鸟”,也太没礼貌了。

entries.en: You should look for End Stone or Obsidian with purple glows.
entries.zh: 你可以找找那些泛着紫光的末地石和黑曜石。

entries.en: They contain cool loot when mined!
entries.zh: 挖开之后能找到不少好东西！

entries.en: Please bring me back my bow if you find it.
entries.zh: 要是找到我的弓，麻烦帮我带回来。

entries.en: I'm fairly sure one of those Seers has it.
entries.zh: 我挺肯定，就在某个先知手上。

entries.en: I'm going to use it to kill more Dragons as soon as I'm fully recovered.
entries.zh: 等我完全恢复，就要带着它去多杀几条巨龙。

entries.en: I'd tell you more about Dragons but you're not even Combat level 18.
entries.zh: 我倒是想多给你讲讲巨龙，不过你的战斗等级还没到 18 级呢。

entries.en: Try your luck slaying some Zealots.
entries.zh: 去杀些狂热末影人试试身手吧。
我做的灯可爱吧！

entries.en: They emit light without any combustible.
entries.zh: 它们不用任何燃料就能发光。
划时代的发明！
想出去冒个险吗？

entries.en: Do you wish to slay the mightiest beasts of the land?
entries.zh: 要不要试着打倒这里最厉害的怪物？

entries.en: Complete Slayer Quests and fight bosses to unlock exotic rewards!
entries.zh: 来做做猎杀任务吧！挑战首领，还能解锁些稀罕的奖励。
把我的蝙蝠电话还给我。

entries.en: I was the first to offer magical over-the-air contact. Don't you forget it.
entries.zh: 我可是第一个提供魔法远程通讯的人，这点你可别忘了。

entries.en: You again? What do you want this time?
entries.zh: 又是你？这次想要什么？
有人接电话了！

entries.en: You hear the line pick up...
entries.zh: 你听见电话接通了……
嘿，找我有什么事？

entries.en: How does a lobster answer? Shello!
entries.zh: 龙虾接电话怎么打招呼？ “虾喽！”

entries.en: You did NOT just do that!
entries.zh: 你居然真敢这么干！

entries.en: You don't look like a Mage to me!
entries.zh: 你看着可不像个法师！
欢迎你，新加入的阵营成员！

entries.en: I provide the faction with important items.
entries.zh: 我负责为阵营供应重要物资。
欢迎加入法师阵营，%1$s!

entries.en: I provide the Taika with important items.
entries.zh: 我负责为泰卡族供应重要物资。
你最好小心点！

entries.en: What do you think you are doing?
entries.zh: 你以为自己在干什么？
我要把你化成灰！
晚上好，冒险者！

entries.en: Wait, is it? I'm not sure; it's always so bright in here...
entries.zh: 等等，现在是晚上吗？我也不确定，这里总是亮堂堂的……

entries.en: Oh well, anyway, I can sell all kinds of functional minions to you!
entries.zh: 算了，总之，我这里出售各种实用小人！
啊，你是什么人？

entries.en: Hmmm well, are you powerful? I enjoy watching entities display their power... or die in a pit of fire trying!
entries.zh: 嗯……你很强吗？我最喜欢看人展示实力了……或者挑战失败，掉进火坑里送命！

entries.en: Talk to me again, and I'll give you some challenges to entertain me... I mean, prove yourself.
entries.zh: 再跟我聊一次，我就给你几项挑战逗我开心……咳，证明你自己。

entries.en: In fact, here's a little gift to encourage you to give it a try.
entries.zh: 其实，先送你点小礼物，鼓励你试试看。

entries.en: You were not good enough. Come back when you've trained more.
entries.zh: 你还不够格。练得像样点再来。

entries.en: Hardly skilled, but I'll let it pass. Come talk to me for your next challenge, and do better in the future.
entries.zh: 本事稀松，不过这次算你过了。来找我领取下一项挑战，下次可得表现好点。

entries.en: Rather average, I'd say. Speak to me again to try a new challenge, or improve on this one!
entries.zh: 只能算普普通通吧。再来找我挑战新项目，或者重试这项刷新成绩！

entries.en: That was pretty good! Please come by again for a new challenge.
entries.zh: 表现不错！下次再来接受新挑战吧。

entries.en: Wow, that was really impressive. Come talk to me to view your next challenge.
entries.zh: 嚯，确实很精彩。来找我看看下一项挑战。

entries.en: That was a remarkable performance! I look forward to giving you your next challenge.
entries.zh: 这场表现相当出色！我都等不及给你下一项挑战了。

entries.en: Ahhh, here we go! Let's get you into the Arena.
entries.zh: 好——要开始了！我送你进竞技场。

entries.en: Have patience, I'm getting you in right now!
entries.zh: 耐心点，这就送你进去！

entries.en: It is not safe to do that challenge right now. Come back later!
entries.zh: 现在进行这项挑战不安全。晚点再来！

entries.en: I only test people who use their bare skills. No extra help allowed! Come back to me once you've stored your items away.
entries.zh: 我只考验不借外物的真本事。不许带任何帮手！把物品全存好再来。

entries.en: No pets allowed in the dojo! Get off of your pet.
entries.zh: 道场不许骑宠物！快从宠物身上下来。
乌戈，是你吗？
你昨天旷课了。
前天也旷了。

entries.en: So today you'll have to do three lessons.
entries.zh: 所以今天你得补上三堂课。

entries.en: The first one is a Test of Force.
entries.zh: 第一项是力量试炼。
进竞技场。

entries.en: Humph. This will do for now.
entries.zh: 哼。暂时算你过了。

entries.en: Onto the next Test, Stamina this time.
entries.zh: 下一项试炼，这次考耐力。

entries.en: You are not performing that well today, but I'll accept that score for today.
entries.zh: 今天表现不怎么样，不过这个分数我先收下。

entries.en: One more test before I let you go. The Test of Mastery.
entries.zh: 再过一项就放你走。精通试炼。

entries.en: Well done Ugo, you finished your training for today.
entries.zh: 不错，乌戈，今天的训练完成了。

entries.en: Remember Ugo, I can show you the path but I can not walk it for you.
entries.zh: 记住，乌戈，我能给你指路，但不能替你走。

entries.en: If you want to make your father proud you will have to train more than it is expected of you.
entries.zh: 想让你父亲为你骄傲，就得练得比别人要求的更多。

entries.en: Respect your training and you will respect yourself.
entries.zh: 尊重你的训练，才会尊重你自己。
去吧。

entries.en: Make sure you empty your inventory entirely before you enter.
entries.zh: 进去之前，务必把物品栏彻底清空。

entries.en: Ugo! You know very well you need to store all your items away before you enter the Arena.
entries.zh: 乌戈！你明明知道进竞技场前必须把所有物品都存起来。

entries.en: This isn't good enough Ugo! Your father would be very annoyed if I told him the score you got!
entries.zh: 这成绩可不行，乌戈！要是我告诉你父亲，他准得气坏了！

entries.en: Go back inside and do better!
entries.zh: 回去重来，给我做得更好！

entries.en: After completing our challenges you will get various rewards, including different colored belts.
entries.zh: 完成挑战后，你会获得各种奖励，包括各色腰带。
一派胡言……

entries.en: The appearance of that strange disturbance on the nearby island might have nothing to do with time travel.
entries.zh: 附近岛屿出现的奇怪扰动，也许跟时间旅行毫无关系。

entries.en: That doesn't mean we should ignore it, someone needs to...
entries.zh: 但这不代表我们可以置之不理，总得有人……

entries.en: Can't you see we are busy?
entries.zh: 没看见我们正忙着吗？

entries.en: Wassup! We're out here on a camping trip!
entries.zh: 嘿！我们来这儿露营啦！

entries.en: I don't really know why we chose the Spider's Den, though...
entries.zh: 不过我也不太明白，为什么偏偏选了蜘蛛巢穴……

entries.en: Still, I've been playing lots of games to pass the time.
entries.zh: 好在还能玩不少游戏打发时间。

entries.en: Quick! Trivia question! Do you know what Mob Types are?
entries.zh: 来，快问快答！你知道什么是生物类型吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [No, I am very silly] [Yes, I am very smart]
entries.zh: 选择一个选项: [不知道，我傻乎乎的] [知道，我可聪明了]

entries.en: No problem! Allow me to explain.
entries.zh: 没事！我给你讲讲。
那么，来说说生物类型。

entries.en: Every mob has at least one type, which you can see next to its name.
entries.zh: 每种生物都至少有一种类型，看它名字旁边就能知道。

entries.en: For example, Dasher Spiders are classified as  Arthropods, which you can tell because of the symbol next to their name.
entries.zh: 比如，疾行蜘蛛就属于 节肢动物，看名字旁边的符号就能认出来。

entries.en: Most mobs have one type, but some have more.
entries.zh: 大多数生物只有一种类型，不过也有些有不止一种。

entries.en: My mate Ike knows which types all the different symbols represent.
entries.zh: 我朋友艾克知道各个符号都代表什么类型。

entries.en: Go talk to him if you want to learn more!
entries.zh: 想了解更多的话，就去找他聊聊吧！
行啊，行啊……

entries.en: Well I'm going to explain it anyways, otherwise my entire existence lacks purpose!
entries.zh: 不过我还是得讲，不然我待在这儿还有什么意义啊！

entries.en: Ahh, I see you've been reading the wiki!
entries.zh: 啊哈，看来你读过 Wiki!

entries.en: I read it too from time to time. It gives me valuable insights into my experiments!
entries.zh: 我偶尔也会读。它总能给我的实验带来宝贵启发！

entries.en: Leave me to my experiments, stranger!
entries.zh: 陌生人，别打扰我做实验！

entries.en: I'm on the verge of inventing a new enchantment!
entries.zh: 我马上就要发明一种新附魔了！
就差一点……就差一点……
阿扎克斯去哪儿了？
我需要更多瓶子！更多！

entries.en: This experiment is close to succeeding, it could be my new Scarlet Prize!
entries.zh: 这个实验就要成功了，它说不定能为我再拿一座绯红奖！

entries.en: Yes! The table. it speaks to me!
entries.zh: 对！附魔台……它在对我说话！
还差那么一点……

entries.en: We are on the right track...
entries.zh: 方向对了……
但我们需要更强的东西！
就是这样！
成功了！
我创造出了一种新附魔！

entries.en: As you helped greatly with this achievement, let me bestow upon you the first imbued book!
entries.zh: 你为这项成果出了大力，就让我把第一本灌注完成的附魔书赠予你吧！

entries.en: Just because it worked before doesn't mean it will work again.
entries.zh: 之前成功过，不代表再来一次也会成功。

entries.en: Please splash your experience onto someone who is less busy!
entries.zh: 请把你的经验泼给没这么忙的人！

entries.en: Is that how you behave in that other faction?
entries.zh: 你在另一个阵营里就是这么行事的？
太没礼貌了！

entries.en: My next work will be even more grandiose!
entries.zh: 我的下一项成果会更加宏伟！
没错，没错……嗯……对……有意思……
什么？我什么都没说！
别偷听我们说话……
你闯进我们的地盘了。
有人在偷听！

entries.en: Who are you and who gave you the code?
entries.zh: 你是谁？谁把密码告诉你的？

entries.en: You are not supposed to be here.
entries.zh: 你不该出现在这里。

entries.en: To be fair, I'm not supposed to be here either.
entries.zh: 说实话，我也不该待在这里。

entries.en: If you are here for business then it makes no difference to me.
entries.zh: 如果你是来做生意的，那我也无所谓。

entries.en: I sell Abiphones straight from the Mage faction.
entries.zh: 我卖的阿比手机都是从法师阵营直接弄来的。

entries.en: Lava fishing is the best, it is my favorite pastime.
entries.zh: 熔岩钓鱼最棒了，这是我最喜欢的消遣。

entries.en: Do you like my collection of Trophies?
entries.zh: 喜欢我收藏的这些奖杯吗？

entries.en: Some fishes can only be caught under specific conditions, and it requires great focus.
entries.zh: 有些鱼只有在特定条件下才能钓到，而且必须全神贯注。

entries.en: My name is Odexar! I have quite the reputation around here.
entries.zh: 我叫奥德克萨！在这附近也算小有名气。

entries.en: You see, I'm the best lava fisher in the world.
entries.zh: 你看，我可是全世界最厉害的熔岩钓手。

entries.en: Recently I fished a magnificent Volcanic Stonefish from a secret spot I won't reveal.
entries.zh: 最近，我在一个不能透露的秘密钓点钓到了一条绝佳的火山石鱼。

entries.en: I would like to show it to Odger but I hurt my feet badly.
entries.zh: 我很想拿给奥杰看，可我的脚伤得不轻。

entries.en: Would you mind taking my Volcanic Stonefish to Odger's house on top of the Volcano?
entries.zh: 能麻烦你把我的火山石鱼带到火山顶上奥杰的家吗？

entries.en: Thanks, I'm sure Odger will be proud, that is the best Trophy Fish I got in a long time!
entries.zh: 谢啦，奥杰一定会为我骄傲的！这可是我很久以来钓到的最好一条奖杯鱼！

entries.en: Odger lives in a house inside the Volcano at the very top, you can't miss it.
entries.zh: 奥杰住在火山内部最高处的一间屋子里，你肯定不会错过。

entries.en: Trophy Fishing is my passion, and Odger is the local specialist.
entries.zh: 奖杯钓鱼是我的挚爱，奥杰则是本地这方面的专家。

entries.en: Marvelous! The Fish looks even better than I remembered!
entries.zh: 太棒了！这条鱼看起来比我记忆中还漂亮！

entries.en: Odger has delicate hands, this is really top quality work!
entries.zh: 奥杰的手艺真细致，这绝对是顶级作品！

entries.en: What do you say? Odger said I was a bad fisherman?
entries.zh: 你说什么？奥杰说我是个差劲的钓手？

entries.en: Hahaha!! What a jokester this Odger, love that goblin.
entries.zh: 哈哈哈！! 奥杰可真会开玩笑，我就喜欢那只哥布林。

entries.en: Thanks a lot friend, here take those 80 coins. Don't spend them all in one go!
entries.zh: 太谢谢你了，朋友。这 80 枚硬币拿去吧，可别一下全花光！

entries.en: My fishing rod is quite amazing but I'm still saving up for a better one, I can't wait!
entries.zh: 我的鱼竿已经很厉害了，但我还在攒钱换一根更好的，真等不及了！

entries.en: The largest fish in my collection is almost a meter long, and weighs close to 100 lb!
entries.zh: 我收藏里最大的鱼接近一米长，体重也快到 100 磅了！

entries.en: The largest fish in my collection is almost a meter long, and weighs close to 100 lb.
entries.zh: 我收藏里最大的鱼接近一米长，体重也快到 100 磅了。

entries.en: Wait, that Loudmouth Bass of yours is %1$s lbs...
entries.zh: 等等，你那条大嘴鲈鱼重 %1$s 磅……

entries.en: I really thought I was finally good at something for a while, you know?
entries.zh: 你知道吗？有那么一阵子，我真以为自己终于有件事做得不错了。

entries.en: And then you came on over here and trampled on my dreams.
entries.zh: 然后你跑过来，一脚把我的梦想踩碎了。

entries.en: Hope you feel real good about yourself, loudmouth.
entries.zh: 希望你现在很得意，大嘴巴。
绯红孤岛钓鱼，不一样。

entries.en: Fish trophy like fish. But not same.
entries.zh: 奖杯鱼像鱼。但不一样。

entries.en: Unique way to fish. All trophy fish.
entries.zh: 奖杯鱼。每种都有自己的钓法。

entries.en: Bring trophy fish. To me. Reward.
entries.zh: 带奖杯鱼给我。奖励。
拿着。能帮你。
选择话题: [任务] [奖杯钓鱼]
这是奥德克萨给的？
对。很差。
太小。少见。还坏了。
奥德克萨没本事。没品位。
给我找条更好的奖杯鱼。

entries.en: Don't want to work on fish.
entries.zh: 不想处理这条鱼。
给我找条火山石鱼。
鱼聪明。奥德克萨笨。
火山的。火山。
鱼很好。更好。好多了。
你有本事。好渔夫。

entries.en: Give this to Odexar. Tell Odexar no more. Tell him.
entries.zh: 把这个交给奥德克萨。告诉他没有下次。告诉他。
飞鳍鱼。骷髅鱼。
要提示？
作弊。你作弊……
真正的渔夫不要提示。

entries.en: Oh Lasea need fish? Lasea cute.
entries.zh: 哦，拉西亚要鱼？拉西亚可爱。

entries.en: Don't tell Lasea. Maybe tell. No don't tell.
entries.zh: 别告诉拉西亚。也许告诉她。不，别说。
啊啊啊啊啊！

entries.en: Flyfish need be high above lava. You.
entries.zh: 钓飞鳍鱼。你得站在熔岩上方很高的地方。

entries.en: Skeleton Fish from Burning Desert. Rare.
entries.zh: 骷髅鱼来自烈焰沙漠。很稀有。
我刚才说的话。忘掉。拜托。

entries.en: ✆ Odger put name in funny device? Hmm...
entries.zh: ✆ 把奥杰的名字放进怪东西？唔……
✆ 先帮奥杰。然后可以。

entries.en: ✆ Odger like Lasea. Lasea like fish. Odger like fish.
entries.zh: ✆ 奥杰喜欢拉西亚。拉西亚喜欢鱼。奥杰喜欢鱼。

entries.en: ✆ Bring Odger. Trophy Fish. Diamond. Any kind.
entries.zh: ✆ 给奥杰带奖杯鱼。钻石品质。哪种都行。

entries.en: ✆ Diamond fish. You have. For Odger?
entries.zh: ✆ 钻石品质的鱼。你有。给奥杰？
✆ 谢谢。奥杰说。
✆ 奖杯鱼。给拉西亚。
✆ 联系方式。给你。拿着。
吸气……呼气……

entries.en: I'm trying to gather enough courage to go upstairs.
entries.zh: 我正在鼓起勇气上楼。

entries.en: This apartment is very cozy but it triggers something in me.
entries.zh: 这间公寓很舒适，可待在里面总让我浑身不自在。

entries.en: I think I might be claustrophobic.
entries.zh: 我想，我可能有幽闭恐惧症。

entries.en: Alwin says we don't need more space, I wish I could agree...
entries.zh: 阿尔温说我们不需要更大的空间，真希望我也能认同……

entries.en: My husband works all the time.
entries.zh: 我丈夫一天到晚都在工作。
我只是个不起眼的画家。

entries.en: Painting is a way to escape the harsh reality; I can create my own flawless world.
entries.zh: 绘画能让我逃离残酷的现实;在画里，我可以创造一个无瑕的世界。

entries.en: I paint all sorts of things, but it costs a lot of colored dyes.
entries.zh: 我什么都画，但得用掉很多彩色染料。

entries.en: Could you help me and bring me some flowers? Most flowers cannot spawn on the Crimson Isle.
entries.zh: 能帮我带些花来吗？绯红孤岛上大多数花都长不出来。
能给我带一个 %1$s 来吗？

entries.en: That is not the correct flower I'm looking for.
entries.zh: 这不是我要找的那种花。

entries.en: Bring me that %1$s as soon as you can!
entries.zh: 尽快把 %1$s 带来！
这些画可不会自己把自己画完！

entries.en: Thank you for supporting my passion.
entries.zh: 谢谢你支持我的热爱。

entries.en: I often need flowers, feel free to come back in a few days.
entries.zh: 我经常需要花，过几天随时可以再来。
太好了，继续画画！

entries.en: I can sense a great deal of virtue in you. You are a source of inspiration.
entries.zh: 我能感受到你身上满满的善意。你给了我灵感。
请安静一点。

entries.en: Sorry, but I need to concentrate.
entries.zh: 抱歉，我得集中精神。

entries.en: ✆ Are you available? I desperately need a %1$s today.
entries.zh: ✆ 你现在有空吗？我今天急需一个 %1$s。

entries.en: ✆ Please meet me at my house if you have one. I would greatly appreciate it!
entries.zh: ✆ 如果你有，请来我家找我。我会非常感激！

entries.en: ✆ Bring me that %1$s as soon as you can!
entries.zh: ✆ 尽快把 %1$s 带来！
✆ 这些画可不会自己画完！

entries.en: ✆ I don't need any flowers at the moment!
entries.zh: ✆ 我现在不需要花！
✆ 无人接听。
太谢谢你了。

entries.en: Here, I want you to have another painting.
entries.zh: 来，我想再送你一幅画。
你领取了 《汤》!

entries.en: The layout of our village is so complex...
entries.zh: 我们村子的布局也太复杂了……

entries.en: I just got a new job, but I don't know how to find the address.
entries.zh: 我刚找到一份新工作，却不知道地址该怎么走。

entries.en: Navigating around here is really tough...
entries.zh: 在这里认路真是太难了……

entries.en: I haven't managed to find the place yet, but soon!
entries.zh: 我还没找到那个地方，不过就快了！

entries.en: Hopefully I'll find the way tomorrow.
entries.zh: 希望明天能找到路吧。

entries.en: I think this is the way?
entries.zh: 我觉得……是这条路？
应该就在这儿才对。

entries.en: I hope I won't be late.
entries.zh: 希望我不会迟到。

entries.en: I got the wrong address again...
entries.zh: 我又找错地址了……
看来我迷路了。
天哪……不是这里。

entries.en: I don't think this is it...
entries.zh: 这里好像也不对……
你就是 %1$s，对吧？

entries.en: My friend told me about you!
entries.zh: 我朋友跟我提起过你！

entries.en: If you want a Dragon Shortbow, I'll give you one for free!
entries.zh: 想要巨龙短弓的话，我免费送你一把！

entries.en: A good deed demands a proper reward!
entries.zh: 做了好事，总该有份像样的回报！

entries.en: Talk to Guber up the staircase, he is a master of traversing this troubling terrain.
entries.zh: 去找楼梯上面的古伯聊聊吧，在这种难走的地形里穿行，他可是行家。

entries.en: The End has endless End Stone and Obsidian. You may find a special type of these resources deep in the caves.
entries.zh: 末地的末地石和黑曜石取之不尽。到洞穴深处去找找，说不定还能发现它们的特殊品种。

entries.en: Ender Pearls attract the attention of Endermen, but Silent Pearls don't! You can get them in my shop.
entries.zh: 末影珍珠会引来末影人的注意，但无声珍珠不会！我的店里就有卖。

entries.en: The items in my shop may be of help as you descend into the depths of The End.
entries.zh: 往末地深处探索时，我店里的东西也许能帮上忙。

entries.en: You have reached The End, though this is only the beginning.
entries.zh: 你虽已抵达末地，但这还只是个开始。

entries.en: I am the Pearl Dealer, and you are on dangerous ground.
entries.zh: 我是珍珠商人，你脚下这片土地可不太平。

entries.en: Be careful when using Ender Pearls on this island, their energy attracts Endermen!
entries.zh: 在这座岛上使用末影珍珠时要小心，它的能量会招来末影人！

entries.en: The End also has many resources, including End Stone and Obsidian.
entries.zh: 末地也有丰富的资源，包括末地石和黑曜石。

entries.en: The deeper you go, the stranger the things you'll find!
entries.zh: 越往深处走，遇见的东西就越稀奇！

entries.en: Have you tried running The End Race yet?
entries.zh: 你跑过末地竞速了吗？

entries.en: Talk to Guber to learn more. He is just up that staircase over there!
entries.zh: 去找古伯了解详情吧，他就在那边楼梯上面！

entries.en: I'm a young and ambitious architect.
entries.zh: 我是个年轻又有抱负的建筑师。

entries.en: Let me know if you need a house, I'll quote you a price!
entries.zh: 需要盖房子就来找我，我给你报个价！

entries.en: Clients? No, I never had any. But soon surely!
entries.zh: 客户？没有，我还从没接到过。不过肯定快有了！

entries.en: I designed my own house. You like?
entries.zh: 我的房子是自己设计的。喜欢吗？

entries.en: Ahh...I don't know what I'm going to do...
entries.zh: 唉……我真不知道该怎么办了……

entries.en: This is rough to be honest, my potatoes...
entries.zh: 说真的，太难了……我的土豆……

entries.en: I just want to eat something other than nether wart for once in my life...
entries.zh: 我这辈子就想吃一次下界疣以外的东西……

entries.en: And potatoes look so yummy and juicy...but water...instantly evaporates around here...
entries.zh: 土豆看起来又香又多汁……可这里的水……一眨眼就蒸发了……
我只是……真的好难过……
硫磺在上！成功了！是土豆！

entries.en: But how? I've been trying for years, and you just did it so easily...
entries.zh: 可你怎么办到的？我试了好几年，你却一下就成功了……
也许我就是……这么差劲……一点用都没有……

entries.en: Why can't I be successful like everyone else...
entries.zh: 为什么我就不能像别人一样成功……

entries.en: And I keep complaining...I'm so annoying...
entries.zh: 我还一直抱怨个不停……我真烦人……

entries.en: I lost the Enchanted Bone Meal... of course...
entries.zh: 我把附魔骨粉弄丢了……果然……

entries.en: Don't feel pressured to give me any more... I don't deserve this...
entries.zh: 别勉强自己再给我了……我不配……

entries.en: Oh thanks, I really appreciate you! You are a hero to me.
entries.zh: 哦，谢谢你，我真的太感激了！你就是我的英雄。

entries.en: You help me like someone would help an insect stuck in a puddle.
entries.zh: 你帮我的样子，就像有人把困在水坑里的小虫捞出来。
我不知道……

entries.en: What can I do, this is agony...
entries.zh: 我还能怎么办……太痛苦了……
要是我再聪明一点就好了……
我什么办法都试过了。

entries.en: Another day without potatoes...I can't handle it...
entries.zh: 又是吃不到土豆的一天……我受不了了……

entries.en: Feels bad man, this is just terrible.
entries.zh: 难受啊，真的太惨了。

entries.en: I'm so untalented, I'll probably burn the potatoes when I cook them.
entries.zh: 我这么没用，做饭时大概还会把土豆烧焦。

entries.en: I hope I won't lose this Enchanted Bone Meal...
entries.zh: 希望我不会再把这份附魔骨粉弄丢……

entries.en: Why did I not think of this...
entries.zh: 我怎么就没想到呢……
嗯……火焰的声音……
听着就像音乐。

entries.en: Just listen to the fire with me, what a delightful melody.
entries.zh: 陪我一起听听火焰吧，这旋律多美妙。

entries.en: I could stay here for hours just listening to this exquisite harmony.
entries.zh: 光听着这精妙的和声，我能在这儿待上好几个小时。
嘶咔沙啦嘶咔……你懂吧？
这真是……妙不可言……

entries.en: Close your eyes and listen, it's so subtle and clean...
entries.zh: 闭上眼睛仔细听，多么细腻，多么纯粹……

entries.en: There is plenty Sulphur for everyone.
entries.zh: 硫磺多得够大家分。

entries.en: I can barely buy enough for my kids.
entries.zh: 可我连给孩子们买够用的量都做不到。

entries.en: It takes all of us to enact change!
entries.zh: 只有大家齐心协力，才能推动改变！
随便看看吧！

entries.en: It's not much, but Keran and I love it here!
entries.zh: 这里不算豪华，不过克兰和我都很喜欢！

entries.en: Back to the old grind tomorrow! For now...time to rest!
entries.zh: 明天又得继续苦干！现在嘛……该休息了！

entries.en: What does a stranger have to do with the Taika people? Speak!
entries.zh: 陌生人找泰卡族有何贵干？说！
[点击展示]
至少可以说……很有意思。

entries.en: I have the upmost faith in our Dean, if they value your company then I'll welcome you to our faction.
entries.zh: 我对院长深信不疑。既然他器重你，我便准许你加入我们的阵营。

entries.en: But if you are up to no good, I'll revoke this access immediately.
entries.zh: 但你若心怀不轨，我会立刻收回这份许可。

entries.en: Now go, and enjoy our great city, new Faction member!
entries.zh: 去吧，新成员，好好领略这座伟大的城市！

entries.en: You are a little bit too close to me, keep your distances.
entries.zh: 你靠得太近了，注意保持距离。
✆ 想要我的联系方式？

entries.en: ✆ Maybe if you reach enough reputation...but maybe not...
entries.zh: ✆ 等你的声望足够高再说吧……也未必会给你……

entries.en: ✆ You have quite the reputation around here!
entries.zh: ✆ 你在这里可真是声名显赫！

entries.en: ✆ I suppose you have more than earned my contact! Here you go!
entries.zh: ✆ 看来你完全有资格得到我的联系方式！拿去吧！

entries.en: ✆ I didn't give you my contact for this reason.
entries.zh: ✆ 我把联系方式给你，可不是为了这种事。

entries.en: ✆ Only call me if you have something urgent to talk about.
entries.zh: ✆ 只有要紧事才许打给我。

entries.en: Us Taika people love the taste of Melon Juice so much that we'd go just about anywhere to get some.
entries.zh: 我们泰卡族太爱西瓜汁的滋味了，为了喝上一口，去哪儿都行。

entries.en: Normally I'd send somebody else to do my bidding for me, but this is an urgent matter.
entries.zh: 平时我会派别人替我办事，但这次事态紧急。

entries.en: Do you have the faintest idea who you're talking to? I won't forget this!
entries.zh: 你究竟知不知道自己在和谁说话？这笔账我记下了！

entries.en: The Mage Faction is growing, we will soon uncover all the secrets of Mana.
entries.zh: 法师阵营日益壮大，我们很快就会揭开法力的一切奥秘。

entries.en: I can sense great power in you.
entries.zh: 我能感受到你体内蕴藏的强大力量。

entries.en: Thank you very much %1$s. Would you mind leaving us now, we have matters to discuss.
entries.zh: 非常感谢你，%1$s。我们还有要事商议，能请你先回避一下吗？

entries.en: You want to help us rescue a hostage from those filthy brutes over there?
entries.zh: 想帮我们从那群肮脏的蛮子手里救出一名人质吗？

entries.en: Perfect! Go see our Undercover Agent at the Cathedral area in Mage territory to get started.
entries.zh: 太好了！去法师领地的大教堂一带找我们的卧底特工，任务从那里开始。

entries.en: Perfect! Go see our Undercover Agent at the The Bastion area in Barbarian territory to get started.
entries.zh: 太好了！去野蛮人领地的堡垒一带找我们的卧底特工，任务从那里开始。

entries.en: Thank you for your help! Go see the Undercover Agent for details.
entries.zh: 多谢帮忙！详情去问卧底特工。

entries.en: You look suspicious. I have my eyes on you...
entries.zh: 你很可疑。我可盯着你呢……

entries.en: You have a rescue with the enemy? I KNEW they were spying on us!
entries.zh: 你居然帮敌人执行营救任务？我就知道他们在监视我们！

entries.en: Perfect! Go see our Undercover Agent at The Bastion area in Barbarian territory to get started.
entries.zh: 太好了！去野蛮人领地的堡垒一带找我们的卧底特工，任务从那里开始。
你喜欢我的猫吗？

entries.en: My favorite cat? I love them all.
entries.zh: 最喜欢哪只？我每一只都爱。

entries.en: I like to study cats, and I think they sometimes study me.
entries.zh: 我喜欢研究猫，有时候我觉得它们也在研究我。

entries.en: I think all cats teleport to the same spiritual world when they dream.
entries.zh: 我觉得所有猫做梦时，都会传送到同一个灵界。

entries.en: Cats are the only known animals that are gifted with magic, except they are too lazy to use their powers.
entries.zh: 猫是已知唯一拥有魔法天赋的动物，只可惜它们懒得使用力量。

entries.en: My dear Leo is on his 9th life, I give him all the care in the world.
entries.zh: 我亲爱的利奥已经活到第 9 条命了，我把世上最好的照顾都给了它。
喵。
喵呜。
喵——呜。

entries.en: Hey, I could use some help! My Promising Shovel just broke, and I don't have the right ingredients to make a new one.
entries.zh: 嘿，能帮我个忙吗？我的潜力锹刚坏了，可我手头的材料不够再做一把。

entries.en: If you could get me a couple iron ingots, I could make one for us both!
entries.zh: 你要是能弄来两块铁锭，我就能给咱俩各做一把！

entries.en: Thanks a lot. Here's your Promising Shovel.
entries.zh: 多谢啦。这是你的潜力锹。

entries.en: Have you met Pat? He's my brother. We're the Flint Bros!
entries.zh: 你见过帕特吗？他是我兄弟。我们就是燧石兄弟！

entries.en: Mining gravel is hard work, but the flint is worth it.
entries.zh: 挖沙砾是个辛苦活，不过为了燧石也值了。

entries.en: Careful when it rains around here, it gets dangerous!
entries.zh: 这儿一下雨就危险，可得小心！
我真的快愁死了……

entries.en: Yesterday I had a heated argument with a Piglin and we agreed to have a duel in a week.
entries.zh: 昨天我跟一个猪灵大吵了一架，还约好一周后决斗。

entries.en: The problem is that I'm not a fighter, at ALL!
entries.zh: 问题是，我根本就不会打架！一点都不会！

entries.en: Would you mind helping me train a little bit? You look like a seasoned veteran, no offense.
entries.zh: 能不能帮我稍微训练一下？你看着像身经百战的老手——没有说你老的意思。

entries.en: I'm ready to be defeated again... Are you ready?
entries.zh: 我准备好再挨一顿打了……你准备好了吗？

entries.en: I barely recovered from the last training session but I'm ready, are you?
entries.zh: 上次训练的伤才刚好，不过我准备好了。你呢？

entries.en: I can feel that I'm slowly growing stronger, are you ready for today's training session?
entries.zh: 我能感觉到自己在一点点变强。今天的训练，你准备好了吗？

entries.en: Only 3 days left to train, are you ready?
entries.zh: 只剩 3 天训练了，准备好了吗？

entries.en: I feel so strong today, are you ready?
entries.zh: 我今天感觉强得可怕，你准备好了吗？

entries.en: It has already been a week, time flies!
entries.zh: 居然已经过去一周了，时间真快！

entries.en: In that case, please show me your fighting moves.
entries.zh: 那就请让我见识一下你的招式吧。
看招！

entries.en: Welp, no hard feelings, I guess.
entries.zh: 好吧，不来也没关系……大概吧。
我的天，你也太强了。
太丢脸了。

entries.en: That really hurts, but I need to get stronger at ALL COST!
entries.zh: 真的好痛，但无论付出什么代价，我都得变强！

entries.en: That really hurts, but I need to get stronger at ALL COSTS!
entries.zh: 嘶，真疼……可我无论如何都得变强！

entries.en: You are truly on another level...
entries.zh: 你跟我根本不是一个级别的……
你还是轻轻松松就把我打败了……
太激烈了！

entries.en: I really don't deserve such a skilled trainer.
entries.zh: 我何德何能，能有你这么厉害的教练。

entries.en: I've grown so much over the last week thanks to you.
entries.zh: 多亏了你，这一周里我进步了太多。

entries.en: Just a week ago I was stressed and scared, now I feel confident.
entries.zh: 一周前我还又焦虑又害怕，现在却充满信心。

entries.en: Bring the item I gave you to Juliette!
entries.zh: 把我给你的东西带给朱丽叶！

entries.en: If you lost the item, we can fix that! Although, you will have to cover my expenses, considering the sentimental value... [CLICK]
entries.zh: 东西弄丢了也能补！不过考虑到这份心意的分量，成本得由你承担…… [点击]
我……正在找黄金……

entries.en: but I can only find clay and granite here!
entries.zh: 可这里怎么只有黏土和花岗岩！

entries.en: I heard of a gold mine in the Savanna Woodland.
entries.zh: 听说有座金矿就在热带草原林地。

entries.en: I'd like to craft a gift for my beloved Juliette.
entries.zh: 我想亲手做份礼物，送给挚爱的朱丽叶。

entries.en: Could you find some gold for me, please?
entries.zh: 能帮我找些黄金来吗？拜托了。

entries.en: Here, could you do me a favor and bring this gift back to Juliette?
entries.zh: 来，能再帮个忙，把这份礼物带给朱丽叶吗？
买东西？
哈哈！

entries.en: I'm here to get a flower bouquet for Juliette.
entries.zh: 我是来给朱丽叶挑一束花的。

entries.en: Could you help out and get some flowers?
entries.zh: 能帮我采些花吗？

entries.en: I was thinking of a bouquet of roses.
entries.zh: 我想送一束玫瑰。

entries.en: Just one? That's not much of a bouquet!
entries.zh: 只有一朵？这可算不上花束！

entries.en: Going to need a few more than that!
entries.zh: 还得再多来几朵！

entries.en: I love roses! Can you get more?
entries.zh: 我爱玫瑰！还能再找些吗？

entries.en: That's a lot of flowers! Maybe a few more...
entries.zh: 已经有很多花了！不过也许还能再添几朵……
哇，真漂亮！

entries.en: Please bring the bouquet to Juliette!
entries.zh: 请把这束花带给朱丽叶！
我爱绿宝石！

entries.en: There's emerald on everything I like!
entries.zh: 我喜欢的东西上都有绿宝石！
可这颗怎么也取不下来！

entries.en: Could you bring me some emerald?
entries.zh: 能帮我带些绿宝石来吗？

entries.en: I'm going to need a full stack of those!
entries.zh: 我需要整整一组！

entries.en: Very cool, but regular emeralds will do the trick.
entries.zh: 很酷，不过普通绿宝石就够用了。

entries.en: Although I adore this pristine piece of emerald, I don't need it yet.
entries.zh: 这块纯净无瑕的绿宝石虽然让我爱不释手，但现在还用不上。

entries.en: I don't need a whole block!
entries.zh: 我不需要整块绿宝石块！

entries.en: Now bring this gift to Juliette!
entries.zh: 现在把这份礼物带给朱丽叶吧！
嘿，又见面了！

entries.en: I wanted mushrooms to concoct a stew,
entries.zh: 我想找些蘑菇炖汤,

entries.en: but these big red ones won't cut it.
entries.zh: 可这些大红蘑菇不合适。
我需要品质上乘的蘑菇。

entries.en: I can't cook a gourmet stew with tiny mushrooms!
entries.zh: 这么小的蘑菇可做不出高级炖汤！
我要更大的！

entries.en: That's not the color of mushroom I'm looking for.
entries.zh: 这不是我要找的蘑菇颜色。
太好了！正是我需要的！
不过……能帮我附个魔吗？

entries.en: I need the perfect stew for my beloved Juliette.
entries.zh: 我要给挚爱的朱丽叶做一锅完美的炖汤。

entries.en: That's a big mushroom that I don't need.
entries.zh: 这蘑菇确实很大，可不是我要的。

entries.en: It's well known that good stews aren't made from brown mushrooms.
entries.zh: 众所周知，好炖汤可不用棕色蘑菇。
我需要的是红蘑菇。
太棒了！
这儿有一份汤，送给朱丽叶！
嗯！味道真不错！

entries.en: So cold! I wish I had coffee right now...
entries.zh: 好冷啊！这时候要是有杯咖啡就好了……

entries.en: I want to reach the moon for Juliette.
entries.zh: 我想摘下月亮，送给朱丽叶。
真摘！

entries.en: I wish I could jump like a Rabbit and grab a chunk of it.
entries.zh: 要是我能像兔子一样跳起来，抓下一块就好了。

entries.en: A potion might do the trick, but not quite that one.
entries.zh: 药水也许有用，但不是这一种。
兔子药水？听起来不错！

entries.en: Although... could you bring a more potent one?
entries.zh: 不过……能带瓶更强效的吗？

entries.en: I don't want to take any chances!
entries.zh: 我可不想冒险失败！
这药水真棒！

entries.en: Any chance you could have it taste like coffee?
entries.zh: 能把它调成咖啡味吗？

entries.en: Come back with a caffeinated beverage, thanks!
entries.zh: 请带杯含咖啡因的饮料回来，谢谢！
谢谢！
回头见！
把月亮碎块带给朱丽叶！
嗨，朋友！

entries.en: I want to make a secret gift for Juliette.
entries.zh: 我想做份神秘礼物，送给朱丽叶。
我攒了好多黄金……

entries.en: Now I just need enough heat to melt it!
entries.zh: 现在只差足够的热量，就能把它们熔化了！

entries.en: That's not even close to hot!
entries.zh: 这根本不够热！
*尝了一口*

entries.en: This is the kind of lava I need...
entries.zh: 这正是我需要的熔岩……
可我需要更烫的。

entries.en: This is too magical for my taste.
entries.zh: 这魔法味太重，不合我的口味。

entries.en: Thank you so much for helping with all my gift ideas.
entries.zh: 谢谢你一直帮我实现这些送礼点子。

entries.en: Can you bring this one to Juliette?
entries.zh: 能把这份也带给朱丽叶吗？

entries.en: I'm trying to solve this Rubix Prism.
entries.zh: 我正在破解这个魔方棱镜。

entries.en: Going to need someone wicked smart to solve it.
entries.zh: 得找个特别聪明的人才能解开。
你挺聪明的。

entries.en: I bet you wish you were smarter, though!
entries.zh: 不过你肯定还想再聪明些，对吧！
虽然你相当机敏,

entries.en: you don't have quite what it takes for the Prism!
entries.zh: 你还没达到破解这个 Prism 的要求！

entries.en: Can you somehow get even more intelligence?
entries.zh: 你还能再提高点智力吗？

entries.en: I can definitely see it, your brain barely fits your head.
entries.zh: 我看得出来，你的脑子都快大得装不进脑袋了。

entries.en: Just not quite genius enough to solve the Prism!
entries.zh: 但还没天才到能解开这个 Prism 的程度！

entries.en: If I was to quantify it, I'd say you need 1,291 Intelligence.
entries.zh: 要用数字来说的话，我猜你需要 1,291 点智力。
难以置信！
你解开 Prism 了！

entries.en: Please, bring it to Juliette and show her how smart I am.
entries.zh: 拜托，把它带给朱丽叶，让她看看我有多聪明。

entries.en: Juliette keeps talking to me about this other person.
entries.zh: 朱丽叶总跟我提起另一个人。

entries.en: I don't know what's going, they meet over and over!
entries.zh: 我不知道怎么回事，他们一遍又一遍地见面！

entries.en: Our love is stronger than theirs!
entries.zh: 我们的爱比他们的更坚定！

entries.en: I'm waiting for this other person to show up.
entries.zh: 我正在等那个人出现。

entries.en: I'll need my favorite weapon, can you fetch it for me?
entries.zh: 我需要最喜欢的武器，能帮我取来吗？
那根本不是武器！
不过我确实挺喜欢它的！
那把剑太弱了！

entries.en: Besides, would you really give it to me?
entries.zh: 再说了，你真的舍得把它给我吗？

entries.en: This is exactly what I need!
entries.zh: 这正是我需要的！

entries.en: Now I just have to wait for the pretendent.
entries.zh: 现在只要等那个追求者现身了。

entries.en: Please bring this poem to Juliette.
entries.zh: 请把这首诗带给朱丽叶。

entries.en: I hope she'll see the reason.
entries.zh: 希望她能明白我的心意。

entries.en: I need your help to win Juliette back.
entries.zh: 我需要你帮我重新赢回朱丽叶的心。

entries.en: My plan is to assemble the greatest bouquet ever!
entries.zh: 我的计划是扎出有史以来最棒的花束！

entries.en: I need a ridiculous amount of flowers.
entries.zh: 我需要多得离谱的花。
真是精美绝伦！!

entries.en: With this, I can get enough flowers to win Juliette back!
entries.zh: 有了这个，就能弄到足够多的花，重新赢回朱丽叶的心！

entries.en: %1$s! You're the best person to turn the day into something memorable!
entries.zh: %1$s! 要让今天变得难忘，你就是最合适的人选！

entries.en: But first, you should wear something nice!
entries.zh: 不过，你得先穿得体面些！
真精神！
你看起来真是光彩照人！

entries.en: Thank you so much for reuniting Juliette and I.
entries.zh: 太感谢你了，多亏你让我和朱丽叶重聚。

entries.en: Please, one last time, give this to Juliette.
entries.zh: 拜托，最后一次了，把这个交给朱丽叶。
我爱朱丽叶！
你怎么找到我的？

entries.en: I don't even have an entrance to my house.
entries.zh: 我家连个入口都没有。
你是狗仔，对吧？

entries.en: I am very, very famous. I can't blame you.
entries.zh: 我可是大名鼎鼎，你会找来拍我也不奇怪。

entries.en: If you want to take a picture of me, you'll have to pay 10,000 Coins.
entries.zh: 想给我拍照，就得付 10,000 硬币。

entries.en: You don't have enough scratch, pal. Get outta here!
entries.zh: 钱不够啊，伙计。赶紧走人！

entries.en: Fine, you can take a picture of me now.
entries.zh: 行了，现在你可以给我拍照了。

entries.en: So you gonna pay me, or?
entries.zh: 所以，你到底付不付钱？

entries.en: Pay me, please. I need this.
entries.zh: 拜托，把钱付了吧。我真的需要。
说好的钱呢？

entries.en: People have told me I'm very photogenic.
entries.zh: 大家都说我特别上镜。

entries.en: Take all of the pictures you want of me!
entries.zh: 想拍多少张就拍多少张！

entries.en: Get your photos in while you can!
entries.zh: 趁现在还能拍，抓紧多拍几张！

entries.en: We store a great deal of knowledge about the history of this island in this Cathedral.
entries.zh: 这座大教堂收藏着大量有关本岛历史的知识。

entries.en: Every single book is imbued so that only true mages can pull them out.
entries.zh: 每一本书都被施了魔法，只有真正的法师才能把它们取出来。

entries.en: Even if you possessed that power, I doubt someone like you could read our texts.
entries.zh: 就算你有那份力量，我也怀疑你这种人能不能读懂我们的典籍。

entries.en: I love Rhanora's cats, but she wont let me play with any of them!
entries.zh: 我很喜欢拉诺拉的猫，可她一只都不肯让我陪着玩！

entries.en: I wonder if she will notice if one goes missing...
entries.zh: 要是少了一只……她会发现吗？
哼哼。
什么，什么时候？哦。

entries.en: How long have I been gone?
entries.zh: 我离开多久了？

entries.en: I keep on forgetting about Sulphur...
entries.zh: 我总是忘记硫磺这回事……

entries.en: Nowadays I live as a recluse, focusing on my work.
entries.zh: 如今我离群索居，只专心写作。

entries.en: I'm a writer, so I need calm to concentrate on my new novel.
entries.zh: 我是作家，得有个安静的环境才能专心写新小说。

entries.en: I really need to get back to work.
entries.zh: 我真得回去工作了。

entries.en: The name of my new novel? Hmm...
entries.zh: 我的新小说叫什么？嗯……
还没想好。

entries.en: I mostly write fictions. Because you helped me, I'll tell you some of the plot.
entries.zh: 我主要写虚构故事。看在你帮过我的份上，给你透露一点情节吧。

entries.en: The story takes place in a dystopian Crimson Isle where the lava of the Volcano is turning into water.
entries.zh: 故事发生在一个反乌托邦式的绯红孤岛，那里的火山熔岩正逐渐变成水。

entries.en: We Piglins always dream of water. This book will be about showing that water also brings pain and struggle.
entries.zh: 我们猪灵总是梦想着水。这本书会告诉大家，水同样会带来痛苦和挣扎。
又来了……

entries.en: I get so absorbed by my work...
entries.zh: 我一工作起来就太投入了……

entries.en: Time really flies when you work on something you love.
entries.zh: 做热爱的事，时间总是过得飞快。

entries.en: Thanks for the Sulphur! I'll finish my new novel now.
entries.zh: 谢谢你的硫磺！我这就把新小说写完。
我的新小说？

entries.en: It's about an old hero that everyone still considers as the strongest.
entries.zh: 讲的是一位老英雄，所有人仍把他视为最强者。

entries.en: But he himself knows very well that his prime is over and that his next fight will be his last.
entries.zh: 但他心里很清楚，自己的巅峰早已过去，下一战也将是最后一战。

entries.en: It's be a sad story about how the expectations of others can force you to do things that hurt you.
entries.zh: 这是个悲伤的故事:他人的期待如何逼着你去做伤害自己的事。

entries.en: My new novel is about someone who has a strange power that allows him to inspect the memories of others.
entries.zh: 我的新小说讲一个拥有奇异能力的人，他可以窥探他人的记忆。

entries.en: The first part shows him having fun with his powers and exploring ways to use memories to his advantage.
entries.zh: 故事前半段，他玩转这种能力，摸索如何利用别人的记忆为自己谋利。

entries.en: But one day he finds a strange character, and in their memories he sees things he should have never seen...
entries.zh: 可有一天，他遇见了一个神秘人物，并在那人的记忆里看见了自己绝不该看见的东西……

entries.en: That's it! I won't tell you more than that!
entries.zh: 就说到这儿！后面我可不会再透露了！

entries.en: I'm currently working on a complex love story.
entries.zh: 我正在写一个错综复杂的爱情故事。

entries.en: A smart and beautiful girl is forced to marry someone they have never met before.
entries.zh: 一位聪明又美丽的姑娘被迫嫁给一个素未谋面的人。

entries.en: She's apprehensive at first but when she meets him they end up surpassing all expectations.
entries.zh: 她起初忐忑不安，可真正见到他后，两人都远远超出了彼此的期待。

entries.en: She falls in love quickly but he doesn't and for the first time in her life she has to deal with that emotional pain.
entries.zh: 她很快坠入爱河，可他没有。这是她一生中第一次不得不面对这样的情伤。

entries.en: It's a simple story but it touches a lot of interesting subjects.
entries.zh: 故事很简单，却会触及许多有意思的话题。

entries.en: I'm writing a fictional story about Kaeman and his wife Sarah, before the Calamity.
entries.zh: 我在写一个发生于大灾变之前，关于凯曼和他的妻子莎拉的虚构故事。

entries.en: Most people know Kaeman as the Wither King, but I think it's important to remind people that he once was a human.
entries.zh: 大多数人只知道凯曼是凋灵之王，但我觉得，大家不该忘记他也曾是个人类。

entries.en: The tragedy of his life isn't very known. He had an idyllic relationship with his wife, up until their daughter was born.
entries.zh: 他一生的悲剧鲜为人知。女儿出生前，他和妻子的感情一直美满得近乎理想。

entries.en: I'm trying to show how pain and sorrow turned this well respected man into an evil doer.
entries.zh: 我想写出痛苦与悲伤如何把这位受人敬重的人变成恶徒。

entries.en: My new book is a different take on the battle royale stories.
entries.zh: 我的新书会用不同角度来写大逃杀题材。

entries.en: Every 10 years there is a global tournament to the death with all the strongest warriors in the world.
entries.zh: 每 10 年，全世界最强的战士都会参加一场决出生死的全球大赛。

entries.en: The winner of the tournament becomes immortal.
entries.zh: 大赛的胜者将获得永生。

entries.en: Every 250 years there is a special battle royale tournament with the previous 24 winners.
entries.zh: 每 250 年，往届的 24 名胜者还会参加一场特别的大逃杀。

entries.en: The twist is that those battle veterans are accustomed to their immortality, which has impacted their views and personalities over time.
entries.zh: 转折在于，这些身经百战的老将早已习惯永生，漫长岁月也慢慢改变了他们的观念与性格。

entries.en: It's a bit cheesy, but you gotta make money sometimes.
entries.zh: 是有点俗套，但人总得偶尔恰饭嘛。

entries.en: I think this new story will be my masterpiece.
entries.zh: 我觉得这个新故事会成为我的巅峰之作。

entries.en: It's a thriller about a genius serial killer who's obsessed with framing police inspectors with his murders.
entries.zh: 这是部惊悚小说，主角是个天才连环杀手，痴迷于把自己的谋杀案嫁祸给警探。

entries.en: But this time the inspector he framed escaped the justice system and hunts him down.
entries.zh: 但这一次，被他陷害的警探逃过司法制裁，反过来追杀他。

entries.en: It's an incredible battle of wits between two brilliant minds.
entries.zh: 两个绝顶聪明的人展开了一场精彩至极的斗智。
哼哼？

entries.en: ✆ I'm pretty busy right now, sorry.
entries.zh: ✆ 抱歉，我现在挺忙的。

entries.en: ✆ I know you are worried about me but I'm feeling fine right now.
entries.zh: ✆ 我知道你担心我，但我现在感觉很好。

entries.en: ✆ I need to finish my book.
entries.zh: ✆ 我得把书写完。

entries.en: ✆ Is this urgent? I'm working on my new novel at the moment.
entries.zh: ✆ 有急事吗？我正在写新小说。
哦……你好。

entries.en: I like staying here with my spiders, but Arachne started capturing some of them.
entries.zh: 我喜欢待在这儿陪我的蜘蛛，可是阿拉克涅开始抓走它们了。
你能帮帮忙吗？
太谢谢你了……

entries.en: If you want, I can help you gain the strength of spiders!
entries.zh: 要是你愿意，我也能帮你获得蜘蛛的力量！
嘿，朋友。

entries.en: I'm feeling kind of down at the minute.
entries.zh: 我这会儿有点提不起精神。

entries.en: All of my pet spiders left me to go and worship Arachne.
entries.zh: 我养的蜘蛛全离开了我，跑去拜阿拉克涅了。

entries.en: I don't blame them, it looks pretty exciting down there, but it's got kinda lonely up here as a result, you know?
entries.zh: 我不怪它们，下面看着确实挺热闹的。不过它们一走，我这儿就有点冷清了，你懂吧？

entries.en: Hey, do you think you could give me a [Lvl 1] Tarantula?
entries.zh: 嘿，你能送我一只[1 级] 狼蛛吗？

entries.en: I'm sure one of those little guys would keep me company, at least for a while.
entries.zh: 我想，有个小家伙陪着，至少能暂时解解闷。

entries.en: If they wanna go worship Arachne when they're all grown up, that's cool with me but, until then, we could be great friends.
entries.zh: 等它长大了，要是也想去拜阿拉克涅，我也不介意。不过在那之前，我们能做很好的朋友。
[交出宠物]

entries.en: Uh, dude, you don't have a [Lvl 1] Tarantula.
entries.zh: 呃，朋友，你没有[1 级] 狼蛛啊。

entries.en: I'd know, I'm quite the expert on our eight-legged friends - they don't call me the Spider Tamer for nothing!
entries.zh: 我一眼就能看出来，我可是这些八条腿朋友的专家——大家叫我驯蛛师可不是白叫的！
谢啦，朋友！

entries.en: This might just be the cutest Tarantula I've ever seen!
entries.zh: 这可能是我见过最可爱的狼蛛了！

entries.en: Look! She's looking at me with each of her eight eyes, how cute!
entries.zh: 你看！她正用八只眼睛盯着我呢，多可爱呀！

entries.en: I think I'll name her Aragog.
entries.zh: 我想给她起名叫 Aragog。
对了，给，这是我的联系方式。

entries.en: Spider Tamer has been added to your Abiphone's contacts!
entries.zh: 驯蛛师已添加到你的阿比手机联系人中！

entries.en: If you ever need to use the Spider Essence Shop or just want to hear some spider fun facts, hit me up!
entries.zh: 以后你要是想逛蜘蛛精粹商店，或者想听点蜘蛛趣闻，就打给我！

entries.en: Did you know? Tarantulas can get so big that they can prey on some birds, and even lizards!
entries.zh: 你知道吗？狼蛛能长得很大，甚至能捕食一些鸟类和蜥蜴！

entries.en: Did you know? Spiders are arachnids, not insects!
entries.zh: 你知道吗？蜘蛛是蛛形纲动物，不是昆虫！

entries.en: Did you know? Most spiders have blue blood.
entries.zh: 你知道吗？大多数蜘蛛的血是蓝色的。

entries.en: Did you know? Spiders don't have an internal skeleton.
entries.zh: 你知道吗？蜘蛛没有体内骨骼。

entries.en: Did you know? Spiders sense their surroundings through vibrations and their sensitive leg hairs.
entries.zh: 你知道吗？蜘蛛靠振动和腿上敏感的绒毛感知周围。

entries.en: Did you know? Most spiders liquify their food! That's how they can eat stuff that's bigger than them!
entries.zh: 你知道吗？大多数蜘蛛会先把食物液化！所以它们才吃得下比自己还大的东西！

entries.en: How did you manage to get in here???
entries.zh: 你到底是怎么进来的？??
把活板门关好！

entries.en: Magma Cube pets are forbidden in Dragontail!
entries.zh: 龙尾镇禁止饲养岩浆怪宠物！
求你千万别告诉别人！!!

entries.en: He's so cute when he sleeps. Or she? I don't even know.
entries.zh: 它睡着时可爱极了。到底是公是母？我都不知道。

entries.en: I don't know what I would do without Maggie.
entries.zh: 真不知道没有玛吉我该怎么办。

entries.en: Maggie was so tiny when I got them, they grow up so fast.
entries.zh: 我刚养玛吉时它还那么小，一转眼就长大了。

entries.en: If anything happened to Maggie I would go nuts.
entries.zh: 玛吉要是出了什么事，我会疯掉的。

entries.en: I don't know where Maggie went! I'm freaking out!
entries.zh: 我不知道玛吉跑哪儿去了！我快急疯了！

entries.en: Someone came and took Maggie away from me!
entries.zh: 有人来把玛吉从我身边带走了！

entries.en: I would have stopped it, but I don't move very well.
entries.zh: 我本来想拦住，可我行动不太方便。

entries.en: People always seem to take Maggie away from me, but they always come back!
entries.zh: 总有人把玛吉从我身边带走，不过它每次都会回来！

entries.en: My kid has been crying for hours.
entries.zh: 我家孩子已经哭好几个小时了。

entries.en: We just came back from our walk and a monster ate his favorite toy.
entries.zh: 我们刚散步回来，路上有只怪物吃掉了他最喜欢的玩具。

entries.en: One of the Magma Cube Riders out there did it!
entries.zh: 就是外面那些岩浆怪骑手中的一个干的！
你找到他的玩具了！
太感谢你了，%1$s!

entries.en: My little Turd has such a lovely voice, I don't mind hearing him cry.
entries.zh: 我家小特德的嗓音可好听了，所以听他哭我也不介意。

entries.en: Such an expensive toy, I am glad you found it for him!
entries.zh: 这么贵的玩具，还好你替他找回来了！

entries.en: Thanks for finding his toy again, %1$s!
entries.zh: 谢谢你又一次找回了他的玩具，%1$s!
他怎么老把它弄丢……

entries.en: ✆ The monsters ate his toy again! I don't know what to do!
entries.zh: ✆ 怪物又把他的玩具吃了！我真不知道该怎么办！
✆ 这次是一只 %1$s!

entries.en: ✆ Can you come back here and help?
entries.zh: ✆ 你能回来帮帮忙吗？
离我孩子远点！

entries.en: Step away from my child, stranger!
entries.zh: 陌生人，离我孩子远点！

entries.en: Don't talk to strangers, little Turd.
entries.zh: 小特德，别跟陌生人说话。

entries.en: Stop harassing me and my child!
entries.zh: 别再骚扰我和孩子了！

entries.en: I don't think he will ever calm down until he gets his toy back.
entries.zh: 不把玩具找回来，他恐怕怎么也安静不下来。
这孩子真让人操心。

entries.en: Maybe one of the Magma Cube Riders out there will have his toy.
entries.zh: 他的玩具没准就在外面的某个岩浆怪骑手身上。

entries.en: Why can't there be peace in the world?
entries.zh: 这个世界为什么就不能和平一点呢？

entries.en: I feel like people in power are so disconnected from reality.
entries.zh: 我总觉得那些掌权的人完全不接地气。

entries.en: The regular population just wants to have a calm and happy life.
entries.zh: 普通人不过是想过上平静幸福的日子。
说真的，谁在乎那些啊？

entries.en: I'm sorry for venting, but is that even a hot take?
entries.zh: 抱歉跟你倒了这么多苦水，可这难道还算什么惊世骇俗的观点吗？

entries.en: If the principal objective of a leader isn't the well being of their population, there is a problem.
entries.zh: 一个领袖若不把民众的福祉放在首位，那本身就有问题。
哇啊啊啊啊啊
哇啊啊啊啊啊！
哇啊啊啊啊啊啊啊
哇啊啊啊
哇啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！
我的玩具。是我的！

entries.en: I don't want to play with you.
entries.zh: 我才不要跟你玩。

entries.en: Mom!!!! Tell the weird stranger that it's MY toy!
entries.zh: 妈妈！!!! 快告诉这个怪人，那是我的玩具！

entries.en: Sacrifice your items at this Draconic Altar to obtain Dragon Essence and special items.
entries.zh: 在这座龙族祭坛献祭物品，即可获得巨龙精粹和特殊物品。

entries.en: You can then exchange this Essence with me for special perks that will aid you in your quest to slay the mighty Dragons.
entries.zh: 之后，你可以拿这些精粹来找我兑换特殊天赋，它们会助你讨伐强大的巨龙。

entries.en: Oh, you must be %1$s! My cousin told me you'd come by my place.
entries.zh: 哦，你一定就是 %1$s! 我表亲说过你会来找我。

entries.en: The friends of the Dean are my friends too!
entries.zh: 迪恩的朋友，也就是我的朋友！

entries.en: I'll give you a 1.5% cost reduction on all the items in my shop!!
entries.zh: 我给你便宜 1.5%,店里所有商品都算！!

entries.en: I have a wide range of Abiphones, from the Abiphone X+ to the Abiphone XIII Pro Giga!
entries.zh: 我这儿阿比手机款式齐全，从阿比手机 X+ 到阿比手机 XIII Pro Giga 应有尽有！

entries.en: Great! I'll let you know when I have a more expensive version of the same Abiphone available!
entries.zh: 好极了！等同款阿比手机有更贵的版本，我就通知你！

entries.en: Sorry I mean a more powerful version of the Abiphone for the same price.
entries.zh: 抱歉，我是说同价位下更强大的版本。

entries.en: Anyways, Abiphones are magical devices that allow you to send sounds towards another Abiphone.
entries.zh: 总之，阿比手机是一种魔法设备，可以把声音传到另一台阿比手机。

entries.en: It might be hard for you to wrap your head around that concept, but you'll get used to it. Trust me.
entries.zh: 这个概念一时半会儿可能不好理解，不过你会习惯的。相信我。

entries.en: Most people around here have an Abiphone, and some of them might let you add them to your contacts.
entries.zh: 这附近大多数人都有阿比手机，其中一些人会同意你把他们加进联系人。

entries.en: If you have someone's contact you can call them at any time, and they can also call you whenever.
entries.zh: 有了某人的联系方式，你随时都能打给对方，对方也能随时打给你。

entries.en: I took the liberty to add Dean to your contacts already. I made sure you couldn't remove it, accidents happen!
entries.zh: 我已经自作主张把迪恩加进你的联系人了，还特意设成不能删除——免得误操作嘛！

entries.en: Have a good day! Make sure you come back later to check my stock!
entries.zh: 祝你今天愉快！记得之后再来看看有没有新货！

entries.en: I'm in the middle of presenting the new Abiphone!
entries.zh: 我正在发布新款阿比手机呢！
各位顾客，大家好！

entries.en: I am glad you could make it!
entries.zh: 很高兴各位能来！

entries.en: Today, I am unveiling the newest technology in Abiphones.
entries.zh: 今天，我将揭晓阿比手机的最新科技。
我们隆重推出:

entries.en: Our latest addition to the Abiphone line has space for an extra contact!
entries.zh: 阿比手机家族的最新成员，又多出了一个联系人栏位！

entries.en: And with the latest technology, you can add FIVE more music discs!
entries.zh: 借助最新科技，你还能多添加整整五张音乐唱片！

entries.en: It would be better if they were playable...
entries.zh: 要是这些唱片真能播放就更好了……
咳咳。

entries.en: Our new model comes in 3 atunning colors!
entries.zh: 我们的新机型提供三种惊艳配色！

entries.en: And the price is still only 100m coins!
entries.zh: 而价格依旧只要 100m 硬币！

entries.en: On top of that, if you own an old Abiphone XIII, you can trade it in!
entries.zh: 不仅如此，如果你有旧款阿比手机 XIII,还能拿来折价换购！

entries.en: The future of Abiphones is TODAY!
entries.zh: 阿比手机的未来，就在今天！

entries.en: The Abiphone XIV is now for sale!
entries.zh: 阿比手机 XIV 现已发售！
各位顾客，大家好！

entries.en: I am so glad you could make it to my keynote!
entries.zh: 非常高兴各位能来参加我的发布会！

entries.en: In the past 72 years, my minions have worked hard to make a new Abiphone model.
entries.zh: 过去 72 年里，我的小人们辛勤工作，终于造出了新款阿比手机。

entries.en: I've obviously been working hard directing my minions!
entries.zh: 当然，我指挥这些小人也辛苦得很！

entries.en: I have made great technological leaps since our last model.
entries.zh: 自上一代机型以来，我们实现了巨大的技术飞跃。

entries.en: So without further ado, I am proud to present:
entries.zh: 那么闲话少说，我自豪地向各位介绍:

entries.en: No, I'm in the middle of my keynote!
entries.zh: 不行，我正在开发布会！
对，我待会儿回给你。
咳。

entries.en: Sorry about that, I forgot to put my Abiphone on vibrate.
entries.zh: 抱歉，刚才忘记把阿比手机调成振动了。

entries.en: Anyways, I am proud to present:
entries.zh: 总之，我自豪地向各位介绍:

entries.en: This stunning new model has a brand-new speaker system.
entries.zh: 这款惊艳的新机型搭载了全新的扬声器系统。

entries.en: Allowing you to choose a ringtone from our built-in selection!
entries.zh: 让你可以从内置曲库中挑选铃声！

entries.en: Through sheer determination, I have also managed to find enough space for 1 extra contact!
entries.zh: 凭着非凡的毅力，我还硬是挤出了一个额外的联系人栏位！

entries.en: To satisfy my shareholders, I had to double the price of this new Abiphone.
entries.zh: 为了让股东满意，我不得不把新款阿比手机的价格翻倍。

entries.en: To satisfy my customers, I am giving everyone 50% off on their new Abiphone purchase!
entries.zh: 为了让顾客满意，所有人购买新款阿比手机一律五折！
这样一来，大家都开心！

entries.en: You can trade in your old Abiphone XIV for an even bigger discount!
entries.zh: 你还可以用旧款阿比手机 XIV 折价换购，享受更大优惠！

entries.en: First, I would like to apologize for this one being a little later than usual.
entries.zh: 首先，我要为这次发布会比往常稍晚致歉。

entries.en: There is an ongoing lawsuit between myself and a counterfeit Abiphone, which has been taking up most of my time.
entries.zh: 我和一家山寨阿比手机的官司还在继续，占去了我大部分时间。

entries.en: However, I am here, and so are you, so let's begin!
entries.zh: 不过我来了，各位也来了，那就开始吧！

entries.en: Since my previous keynote, my minions and I have been even harder at work trying to find something even more innovative than the Abiphone Flip.
entries.zh: 自上次发布会以来，我和小人们更加卖力，只为找到比阿比手机 Flip 更具创新性的东西。

entries.en: We thought and thought and then thought some more before I, and only I, had an incredible breakthrough.
entries.zh: 我们想了又想，反复琢磨，最后是我——只有我——取得了惊人的突破。

entries.en: What if our latest model could save you, like, a second, whenever you wanted to call someone?
entries.zh: 要是新机型能让你每次打电话时省下——比如说——整整一秒呢？

entries.en: After all, less downtime for my clientele means I get more uptime on my all-inclusive holidays!
entries.zh: 毕竟，顾客少等一秒，我的全包度假就能多享受一秒！

entries.en: So, without further ado, I am proud to present:
entries.zh: 那么，闲话少说，我自豪地向各位介绍:

entries.en: The most cutting edge technology around today, this new model comes with the Speed Dial feature!
entries.zh: 这是当今最尖端的科技:新机型配备了快速拨号功能！

entries.en: This allows you to call your favorite contact with just a single click!
entries.zh: 只需点击一次，就能呼叫你最喜欢的联系人！

entries.en: Also, in my infinite generosity, I have given this model an additional contact slot!
entries.zh: 而且，慷慨无边的我还为这款机型增加了一个联系人栏位！

entries.en: That's all for this year. Udel's Abiphone Services appreciate your continued support during the ongoing lawsuit!
entries.zh: 今年的内容就到这里。乌德尔的阿比手机服务感谢各位在官司期间继续支持我们！
那么，闲话少说……

entries.en: Sorry, I mean a more powerful version of the Abiphone for the same price.
