entries.zh: 抱歉，我是说同价位下功能更强的阿比手机。

entries.en: Most people around here have an Abiphone, and some of them might let you add them to your Contacts.
entries.zh: 这附近大多数人都有阿比手机，其中一些人会同意你把他们加进联系人。

entries.en: If you have someone's Contact you can call them at any time, and they can also call you whenever.
entries.zh: 有了某人的联系方式，你随时都能打给对方，对方也能随时打给你。

entries.en: Did you even agree to do this?
entries.zh: 你问过他们愿不愿意吗？

entries.en: Thanks for helping out, and good luck!
entries.zh: 谢谢你出手相助，祝你好运！

entries.en: You actually did it, I can't thank you enough!
entries.zh: 你居然真的成功了，太感谢了！

entries.en: Let's show it to my father.
entries.zh: 拿去给我父亲看看吧。
哦，还有……

entries.en: Please don't mention that I didn't get it myself.
entries.zh: 千万别说这东西不是我亲手拿到的。

entries.en: I completely forgot about my Training.
entries.zh: 我完全忘了训练。

entries.en: I have to go to the Town Board.
entries.zh: 得赶去城镇公告板。
动作快点。
这就是我们的城镇公告板。

entries.en: Whenever someone needs something they put a request here and anyone can fulfill it.
entries.zh: 谁有需求就会在这里张贴任务，任何人都能接下完成。

entries.en: Not enough people are doing them so I usually have to do most requests myself.
entries.zh: 愿意做的人太少，所以大部分请求通常都得我自己处理。

entries.en: There are also Dojo requests, those are my training sessions...
entries.zh: 这里还有道场任务——也就是我的训练课程……

entries.en: I don't think I can do my training with my bad leg.
entries.zh: 以我这条伤腿，恐怕没法参加训练。

entries.en: Master Tao has terrible sight, maybe you could go to the Dojo and pretend to be me?
entries.zh: Tao 大师眼神很差。你能去道场冒充我吗？
我在这里等你。

entries.en: The Dojo is on the opposite side of the island, south of Scarleton, the Mage city.
entries.zh: 道场在岛屿另一头，位于法师之城绯红城的南边。

entries.en: How was the training? Not too bad?
entries.zh: 训练怎么样？不算太糟吧？

entries.en: I'm sorry you had to go through this.
entries.zh: 抱歉，害你遭了这份罪。

entries.en: My father wants me to become the next Chief one day.
entries.zh: 父亲希望我有朝一日继任酋长。

entries.en: I don't really have a choice.
entries.zh: 我其实没得选。

entries.en: If that's fine with you, I'll give you a couple of my missions, but they are quite tough.
entries.zh: 如果你不介意，我可以分给你几项自己的任务——不过都很难。

entries.en: The first one requires eliminating a Mage Outlaw.
entries.zh: 第一项是消灭一个法师逃犯。

entries.en: They are technically Mages, but not part of the Mage Faction, they constantly cause problems.
entries.zh: 严格来说他们也是法师，但不属于法师阵营，总是在惹麻烦。

entries.en: The one we need to eliminate is in the Courtyard, it's on the outskirts of Scarleton, towards the north.
entries.zh: 目标就在庭院。那地方位于绯红城外围，往北走。

entries.en: Mage Outlaws often attack Piglins, the Wizards don't really want to deal with them so we have to do it ourself.
entries.zh: 法师逃犯经常袭击猪灵，巫师们又不太愿意处理，只好由我们动手。

entries.en: The Courtyard is a bit hidden, it is north-west of Scarleton, just outside of the city.
entries.zh: 庭院藏得有点深，在绯红城西北方向，刚出城不远。
解决了？太好了！

entries.en: You are quite competent, those Mages are usually quite strong, they also think very highly of themselves.
entries.zh: 你很能干嘛。那些法师通常实力很强，还总是自视甚高。

entries.en: The next mission is to kill the Magma Boss.
entries.zh: 下一项任务是击杀岩浆巨怪。

entries.en: He's an overgrown Magma Cube that keeps on growing infinitely.
entries.zh: 它是一只体型过度膨胀、还会无限长大的岩浆怪。

entries.en: We have to defeat him every few weeks to keep it in check, otherwise it can grow out of control.
entries.zh: 我们每隔几周就得击败它一次，免得体型彻底失控。

entries.en: Don't feel too bad about killing those Magma Cubes, they will be born again.
entries.zh: 不用太同情那些岩浆怪，它们还会再次诞生。

entries.en: Once you find the large room below the Volcano, you'll be able to see it.
entries.zh: 找到火山下方的巨大房间，自然就能看见它。

entries.en: I am glad you are back.
entries.zh: 很高兴你回来了。

entries.en: You completed all my missions, I am very grateful.
entries.zh: 你完成了我的全部任务，我非常感激。

entries.en: Now if you will excuse me, it's time for me to take care of my leg.
entries.zh: 现在失陪了，该处理一下这条腿了。
回头见，%1$s。
该顾好自己了。

entries.en: Hello human! Are you doing great?
entries.zh: 嗨，人类！最近过得怎么样？

entries.en: Don't come close! I'm warning you!
entries.zh: 别靠近！我警告过你了！

entries.en: They throw fireballs when they fly above you, isn't that amazing?
entries.zh: 它们飞到你头顶时会扔火球，是不是超酷？

entries.en: I don't sell my items to players who don't work with us.
entries.zh: 我不会把东西卖给不为我们效力的人。

entries.en: Pst, hey %1$s! You must be the one they sent to get our guy back.
entries.zh: 嘘，嘿，%1$s! 你就是他们派来救我们那位弟兄的人吧。

entries.en: Here's what you need to do.
entries.zh: 接下来听好。

entries.en: You need to sneak through this area and avoid the guards.
entries.zh: 你得潜行穿过这片区域，避开守卫。

entries.en: You need to stay out of their sight.
entries.zh: 绝不能进入他们的视线。

entries.en: They also have remarkable hearing. Sneaking will be much harder for them to detect than sprinting.
entries.zh: 他们的听力也很敏锐。潜行比冲刺更不容易被发现。

entries.en: If you're observant, you might be able to distract some of them.
entries.zh: 留心观察的话，也许能想办法引开其中一些守卫。

entries.en: If it's too dangerous for you, tell me. If you leave the area, we'll assume you've abandoned the mission and find someone else instead.
entries.zh: 如果觉得太危险，就告诉我。你一旦离开这片区域，我们会当你放弃任务，另找人接手。
祝你好运！
对你来说太危险了？

entries.en: Oh well, we'll find someone else. Leave before you're captured too.
entries.zh: 行吧，我们会另找人。趁你还没被抓，快走。

entries.en: I enjoy long strolls in Scarleton.
entries.zh: 我喜欢在绯红城悠闲地散长步。

entries.en: It's so refreshing to see some new faces in the town!
entries.zh: 城里来了些新面孔，感觉真新鲜！

entries.en: The more I look into the fire, the more I understand.
entries.zh: 我凝视火焰越久，领悟得就越多。

entries.en: I knew you would come, I saw it in the flames a few minutes ago.
entries.zh: 我就知道你会来。几分钟前，火焰已经把这一幕告诉了我。

entries.en: Do you know why we can see the future inside the flames?
entries.zh: 你知道我们为什么能在火焰中看见未来吗？
我知道！
因为火焰是永恒的。

entries.en: I could extinguish it now and light it back up in a year. It would still be the same flames.
entries.zh: 我现在可以将它熄灭，一年后再重新点燃——那依然会是同一团火焰。

entries.en: If you want, I can read your future. Are you interested?
entries.zh: 如果你愿意，我可以为你占卜未来。有兴趣吗？

entries.en: Well? Shall I read your future in the flames?
entries.zh: 怎么样？要我从火焰中读出你的未来吗？
火焰正以奇怪的方式舞动……

entries.en: I see... I see you... Fighting... The vision is quite blurry...
entries.zh: 我看见了……我看见你……在战斗……画面非常模糊……

entries.en: You are holding a sword... But how...
entries.zh: 你手里握着一把剑……可是，怎么会……

entries.en: That sword, the emblems on it...
entries.zh: 那把剑，还有上面的徽记……
这样的未来……不可能……

entries.en: I see that one day you will join our faction... You shall will become a great asset...
entries.zh: 我看见终有一天，你会加入我们的阵营……你将成为不可多得的助力……

entries.en: I see that you will betray us one day, and join the Barbarian faction...
entries.zh: 我看见有一天，你会背叛我们，转而加入野蛮人阵营……

entries.en: Ohh... I see you... Fighting a monstrous creature... With giant tentacles...
entries.zh: 哦……我看见你……正与一头怪物战斗……它长着巨大的触手……

entries.en: I knew you would say that.
entries.zh: 我就知道你会这么说。

entries.en: You just wanted to see what I would say, and then ask again.
entries.zh: 你只是想看看我会怎么回答，然后再来问一次。
真是毫无悬念。

entries.en: In any case, I'll read your future.
entries.zh: 不管怎样，我都会替你占卜未来。

entries.en: Disturbing... the visions must have been wrong.
entries.zh: 令人不安……刚才的景象一定出错了。

entries.en: But the flames are never wrong...
entries.zh: 可火焰从不会出错……

entries.en: I also saw some pretty embarrassing stuff...
entries.zh: 我还看见了一些……挺尴尬的事……

entries.en: Not everyone wants to see their future, but they should.
entries.zh: 不是每个人都想看见自己的未来，但他们都应该看看。

entries.en: In any case, I'll read your future...
entries.zh: 不管怎样，我还是替你看看未来吧……

entries.en: Disturbing...the visions must have been wrong.
entries.zh: 真让人不安……一定是幻象出了错。

entries.en: Kuudra runs are full of goodies.
entries.zh: 库德拉战利品里可全是好东西。

entries.en: If you don't have time to claim them, I got your back.
entries.zh: 要是你没空领取，放心，交给我保管。

entries.en: If you didn't have time to claim them, I got your back.
entries.zh: 要是你当时没来得及领，放心，我替你收着呢。

entries.en: I call upon my loyal servants for this final battle!
entries.zh: 我召集忠诚的仆从，决战就在此刻！

entries.en: I grow my own Nether Warts!
entries.zh: 我的下界疣都是自己种的！

entries.en: That way I can save a lot of money on food!
entries.zh: 这样能省下不少伙食费！

entries.en: I like watching Nether Warts grow. If you look closely you can see it grow, I think.
entries.zh: 我喜欢看下界疣生长。仔细盯着的话，应该能看见它长大……大概。

entries.en: The house on the other side is also mine, that's what saving money does.
entries.zh: 对面的房子也是我的，这就是省钱的力量。
我认识不少人！

entries.en: If you ever removed an Abiphone Contact by accident and don't know how to reach them, maybe I can hook you up!
entries.zh: 如果你不小心删除了某个阿比手机联系人，又不知道怎么联系他们，也许我能帮你牵上线！
你好啊，冒险者！

entries.en: You look like someone who could help me with my research!
entries.zh: 你看起来正是能帮我搞研究的人！

entries.en: If you join our faction I might have some tasks for you.
entries.zh: 要是加入我们的阵营，我或许能给你安排些差事。

entries.en: I'll make it worth your while.
entries.zh: 报酬绝不会让你失望。

entries.en: You have no business talking to me.
entries.zh: 你我之间没什么好谈的。

entries.en: I'm the local alchemist, I do research on different types of gold.
entries.zh: 我是这里的炼金术士，专门研究各种形态的黄金。

entries.en: If you have some time maybe you could help me with some tasks.
entries.zh: 有空的话，也许你能帮我完成几项研究。

entries.en: I'll make sure it's worth your time.
entries.zh: 我保证不会让你白忙。

entries.en: Talk to me again if you want to help out.
entries.zh: 愿意帮忙的话，再来找我聊聊。

entries.en: To start out I'll need some generic gold to experiment on, could you get me a stack?
entries.zh: 先从普通黄金开始实验吧。能帮我弄一组金锭来吗？

entries.en: Next I need some flat gold to test how reflective gold is, could you try forging gold into 5 gold plates?
entries.zh: 接下来我要测试黄金的反光性。能帮我锻造 5 块金板吗？

entries.en: It seems like the first piece you brought me is only 25% of the magical power, could you get me the leggings?
entries.zh: 看来你带来的第一件装备只蕴含了整套魔力的 25%。能再把护腿找来吗？

entries.en: Now I need a lot of compacted gold, it has to be extremely dense. A half stack should do.
entries.zh: 现在需要大量压实的黄金，密度越高越好。半组应该够了。

entries.en: There is a fine-grained gold substance somewhere in the Hub, I'll need 5 of that.
entries.zh: 主城某处有一种细颗粒的黄金物质，我需要 5 份。

entries.en: Next I'm going to need a vegetable that is made out of solid gold. I want to experiment with how gold interacts with organics, maybe you could find some, like a half stack?
entries.zh: 接下来我要一种纯金做成的蔬菜，研究黄金与有机物的反应。你能找来半组左右吗？

entries.en: I just need one last thing, there's an extremely dangerous scientist who sells an assortment of items, he has a special rounded type of gold. Try to convince him to sell you it.
entries.zh: 只差最后一样了。有个极其危险的科学家在卖各种东西，他手里有一种特殊的球状黄金。想办法说服他卖给你吧。
终于，我的研究完成了！

entries.en: You have single-handedly sped up my research by several years.
entries.zh: 你一个人就让我的研究进度提前了好几年。

entries.en: If I ever need your help, I will be sure to let you know!
entries.zh: 以后再需要帮忙，我一定会来找你！

entries.en: This isn't the correct amount of the item I asked for.
entries.zh: 这不是我要求的数量。

entries.en: I need the EXACT amount I asked for!
entries.zh: 我需要的必须一件不多、一件不少！
乌戈，你跑哪儿去了？
我就交给你这一件事！

entries.en: 3 days later you come back with empty hands and a broken leg!?
entries.zh: 整整 3 天后，你空着手回来，腿还断了！?
这个——

entries.en: And you two, what are your names?
entries.zh: 还有你们两个，叫什么名字？

entries.en: Thank you for saving my rascal of a son.
entries.zh: 谢谢你们救了我这个不成器的儿子。

entries.en: Are you looking to join our ranks?
entries.zh: 你们是来加入我们的吗？
不是，可是——

entries.en: I welcome you both to the Barbarian Faction!
entries.zh: 欢迎你们加入野蛮人阵营！

entries.en: If you betray us you'll die.
entries.zh: 胆敢背叛，死路一条。
别说了！

entries.en: Ugo, go back out there and finish the job!
entries.zh: 乌戈，回去把任务完成！

entries.en: Guards, escort them out of my Hut!
entries.zh: 卫兵，把他们送出我的小屋！
乌戈，你怎么一瘸一拐的？
我的腿——

entries.en: Have you found the evil wizard machine?
entries.zh: 找到那台邪恶法师机器了吗？

entries.en: Give it to the guards, we will investigate it.
entries.zh: 交给卫兵，我们会调查。

entries.en: Enough with the mages and their shenanigans.
entries.zh: 受够那些法师和他们的破把戏了。

entries.en: The Town Board is filling up and you are late on your Training Ugo.
entries.zh: 城镇公告板都快贴满了，你的训练还迟到了，乌戈。
你到底干什么去了？

entries.en: Hurry up, failure isn't an option.
entries.zh: 快点，这次任务不容失败。
你们总算取回硫磺了。
怎么用了这么久？
有一头巨——

entries.en: You even needed the help of those adventurers.
entries.zh: 居然还要那些冒险者来帮忙。
你不觉得丢脸吗？
我没有——

entries.en: Look at the time. You are late to your training.
entries.zh: 看看时间，你的训练迟到了。

entries.en: Guards, escort my son out of the hut.
entries.zh: 卫兵，把我儿子送出小屋。
%1$s,我欠你一份大人情。

entries.en: I cherish Ugo more than anything else in this world.
entries.zh: 在这世上，乌戈比什么都珍贵。

entries.en: A father could not be prouder of his son.
entries.zh: 身为父亲，我不能为儿子感到更骄傲了。

entries.en: My mind is at peace knowing you are by his side.
entries.zh: 知道你陪在他身边，我就安心了。

entries.en: More importantly, I am glad he finally met someone he can consider his friend.
entries.zh: 更重要的是，我很高兴他终于交到了一个能称为朋友的人。

entries.en: I taught him everything I could, but there are things only friends can teach.
entries.zh: 我已经把能教的都教给了他，但有些事只有朋友能教。

entries.en: I won't hold you any longer.
entries.zh: 不再耽误你了。
祝你一路顺风。

entries.en: Sorry, I only work with Mages...
entries.zh: 抱歉，我只和法师合作……
请选择: [是] [否]

entries.en: Oh, %1$s is here! They're the one who retrieved the research!
entries.zh: 哦，%1$s 来了！就是这位取回了研究资料！

entries.en: I see, we owe you adventurer, this object is of great value to us.
entries.zh: 原来如此。冒险者，我们欠你一份人情，这件东西对我们极其珍贵。

entries.en: Yes indeed! With it we are able to extract salt from Netherrack, it will be a massive asset when cooking.
entries.zh: 确实如此！有了它，我们就能从下界岩里提取盐，烹饪时可就派上大用场了。

entries.en: You see, while we evolved past the need for crops and cattle, the quality of our food remains low.
entries.zh: 你也知道，虽说我们早已不再依赖作物和牲畜，食物品质却一直不怎么样。

entries.en: I would say close to 50% of our research is still spent on food artifacts and machines.
entries.zh: 可以说，我们近 50% 的研究仍花在食物器具和机器上。

entries.en: And once again those Piglins stole our research.
entries.zh: 那些猪灵又一次偷走了我们的研究资料。

entries.en: They believe we are working on war engines.
entries.zh: 他们认定我们在研制战争机器。

entries.en: The tension is rising and soon we might have to cross swords with them.
entries.zh: 局势愈发紧张，我们恐怕很快就要与他们兵戎相见。

entries.en: Captain Ahone, this isn't a conversation we should have right now.
entries.zh: 阿霍恩队长，这些事现在不宜谈。

entries.en: Thank you very much, %1$s. Would you mind leaving us now, we have matters to discuss.
entries.zh: 非常感谢你，%1$s。我们还有要事商议，能请你先回避一下吗？

entries.en: %1$s please meet me back at the Academy, we have a lot to talk about!
entries.zh: %1$s,请回学院找我，我们有很多事要谈！
你是巫师吗？

entries.en: Well you don't look like one, and you don't smell like one either.
entries.zh: 嗯，你看着不像，闻起来也不像。

entries.en: In that case, I have nothing against you. I wish you a sulphuric day sir.
entries.zh: 既然如此，我就不为难你了。祝你今天硫气满满。

entries.en: Hello stranger. Are you looking to join our faction?
entries.zh: 你好，陌生人。想加入我们的阵营吗？
真是个绝妙的选择！

entries.en: We have a range of motives far deeper and more interesting than those terrible fire mages.
entries.zh: 我们的目标可比那些糟糕的火焰法师深远、有趣多了。

entries.en: Joining our faction is quite hard but I'm sure an incredible individual like you will manage!
entries.zh: 加入我们可不容易，不过像你这么厉害的人肯定办得到！
硫——磺。
我，硫磺。
你是英雄吗？

entries.en: Did you come to free us from the everlasting threat of the wizards?
entries.zh: 你是来帮我们摆脱巫师永无休止的威胁吗？

entries.en: The mighty Volcano is protecting us, but for how long?
entries.zh: 强大的火山一直庇护着我们，可它还能撑多久？
你看着很可疑。

entries.en: Sorry, I can't talk to you right now.
entries.zh: 抱歉，我现在没空跟你聊。
别再烦我了。

entries.en: I'm pooped! Full days of protesting will do that to ya.
entries.zh: 累趴了！抗议一整天，谁都吃不消。
该睡觉了！

entries.en: Up and at 'em! Let's do this!
entries.zh: 起床开工！上吧！

entries.en: Follow the movement! Sulphur for all!
entries.zh: 加入我们的行动！硫磺属于大家！

entries.en: Oh, a new face! Welcome to the City of Magic!
entries.zh: 哦，新面孔！欢迎来到魔法之城！

entries.en: We used to be Pig Farmers centuries ago, but thanks to Sulphur we are now superior beings capable of mastering the magical elements!
entries.zh: 几个世纪前，我们还只是养猪人;多亏硫磺，如今我们已成为能够驾驭魔法元素的高等存在！

entries.en: If you are interested in tourist attractions I suggest you visit our Cathedral, which is also our Academy now.
entries.zh: 想逛逛景点的话，我推荐去大教堂看看——那里现在也是我们的学院。
%1$s 智力！呃……还行吧！

entries.en: %1$s Intelligence! Wow that's not bad at all!
entries.zh: %1$s 智力！哇，相当不错嘛！

entries.en: %1$s Intelligence! What, how? Who are you even?
entries.zh: %1$s 智力！什么，怎么做到的？你到底是谁？

entries.en: Have you tried the new ability phone?
entries.zh: 你试过新款阿比手机了吗？

entries.en: The new one is barely better than the one from last year, people still buy them like sheep...
entries.zh: 新款也就比去年的好一点点，大家却还是一窝蜂地买……

entries.en: Wait, you don't even have an Abiphone?
entries.zh: 等等，你居然连阿比手机都没有？

entries.en: Ah, the Piglins yes, quite troublesome they are.
entries.zh: 啊，猪灵啊，确实挺麻烦的。

entries.en: I wouldn't go there if I were you.
entries.zh: 换作是我，可不会去那边。
你处理得相当不错。

entries.en: Corrupted Monsters rarely appear on the island, it usually means they consumed too much Sulphur.
entries.zh: 腐化怪物在岛上很少见，通常是因为它们吞下了太多硫磺。
哼哼。
听见了吗？

entries.en: I think it was coming from here!
entries.zh: 声音好像是从这里传来的！
走吧。
你救了我！

entries.en: Memory is failing me but I think I remember getting attacked.
entries.zh: 我的记忆有些模糊，不过好像还记得自己遭到了袭击。

entries.en: My leg got hurt and I had to hide here, the rest is blurry...
entries.zh: 我的腿受了伤，只能躲在这里。之后的事就记不清了……

entries.en: How could you leave Dragontail without Sulphur on you!
entries.zh: 你怎么敢离开龙尾镇时不带硫磺！

entries.en: I know, I was careless, I was on a mission for...
entries.zh: 我知道，是我大意了。我当时正在执行……

entries.en: SULPHUR! My father is going to KILL ME!!
entries.zh: 硫磺！我爸会杀了我的！!
没必要这么夸张。

entries.en: You don't understand, my father is the Chief!
entries.zh: 你不明白，我爸就是酋长！
看来一点也没夸张。

entries.en: Please help me, I have to present myself to him.
entries.zh: 请帮帮我，我必须去向他复命。
当然。

entries.en: I will shoulder you to the Chief's Hut.
entries.zh: 我扛你去酋长小屋。

entries.en: %1$s make sure monsters don't attack us on the way there.
entries.zh: %1$s,路上别让怪物袭击我们。
我的腿真的很疼。

entries.en: It was already quite bad before this fall but now...
entries.zh: 摔下来之前就伤得不轻，现在更是……

entries.en: Your father sure has some character.
entries.zh: 你父亲还真是个性十足。

entries.en: He's not that bad, you get used to it.
entries.zh: 他没那么糟，习惯就好了。

entries.en: I don't know what he wants you to do out there, but we can't let you go back there with your injured leg.
entries.zh: 我不知道他派你出去做什么，但你腿伤成这样，我们不能让你再回去。
恐怕我必须回去。

entries.en: Just tell us what you have to do and we'll do it for you.
entries.zh: 把任务告诉我们，我们替你完成。

entries.en: I can't tell you it's highly confidential.
entries.zh: 不能说，这是最高机密。

entries.en: I don't care, you can't go back out there with a broken leg.
entries.zh: 我不管。你腿都断了，不能再出去。

entries.en: My father believes that the Mage Faction is working on some kind of powerful war instrument.
entries.zh: 我父亲认为，法师阵营正在研制某种强大的战争兵器。

entries.en: We know they are hiding something inside their Cathedral.
entries.zh: 我们知道他们把某样东西藏在大教堂里。

entries.en: My job is to infiltrate their Cathedral and steal their war machine so we can study it.
entries.zh: 我的任务是潜入大教堂，偷走那台战争机器，带回来研究。

entries.en: Say no more, that's a perfect job for %1$s.
entries.zh: 不用多说，这任务正适合 %1$s。
为什么是他们？
好，出发吧。

entries.en: I'm right here, don't get lost.
entries.zh: 我就在这儿，别跟丢了。
嘿，你有跟上来吗？
怎么这么慢？
迷路了吗？
你是蜗牛吗？

entries.en: Captain Ahone, Ugo, this is a misunderstanding!
entries.zh: 阿霍恩队长，乌戈，这是一场误会！

entries.en: I saw what happened! I saw everything!
entries.zh: 我看见了！整件事我都看见了！

entries.en: A monstruous creature was carrying the Sulphur, mountains of Sulphur!
entries.zh: 是一只可怕的怪物搬走了硫磺，多得都堆成了山！

entries.en: The monster had giant tentacles, I have never seen anything like it before in my life!
entries.zh: 那怪物长着巨大的触手，我这辈子从没见过这种东西！

entries.en: Elle of the Nether, do not attempt to trick us.
entries.zh: 来自下界的艾尔，别想欺骗我们。

entries.en: Your motives are noble, but time for diplomacy is over.
entries.zh: 你的本意值得尊重，但外交斡旋到此为止。

entries.en: Barbarians, return our Sulphur at once, or face the consequences of your actions.
entries.zh: 野蛮人，立刻归还我们的硫磺，否则就承担你们行为的后果。

entries.en: WE stole YOUR Sulphur?! You wizards have some nerves!
entries.zh: 是我们偷了你们的硫磺？! 你们这些巫师可真敢说！

entries.en: We came here following the trails of the Sulphur that YOU robbed!
entries.zh: 我们是循着被你们抢走的硫磺踪迹才来到这里的！

entries.en: You were BOTH robbed, isn't it obvious?!
entries.zh: 你们两边都被偷了，这还不够明显吗？!

entries.en: The culprit is inside, and it is not Human nor Piglin.
entries.zh: 罪魁祸首就在里面，而且既不是人类也不是猪灵。

entries.en: I have no idea what it is, but I have to warn you, that fiend is immensely powerful.
entries.zh: 我不知道那究竟是什么，但必须警告你们——那怪物强得可怕。

entries.en: Now if you wish to retrieve your Sulphur, follow me inside.
entries.zh: 想拿回硫磺的话，现在就跟我进去。

entries.en: This giant tentacle monster story is real?
entries.zh: 那个巨型触手怪的故事是真的？

entries.en: I have trouble believing it, but in any case we have to get to the bottom of this.
entries.zh: 这很难让人相信，不过无论如何，我们都得查个水落石出。
我同意，进去吧。
这一仗可真够劲！

entries.en: And we got all the Sulphur back!
entries.zh: 硫磺也全拿回来了！

entries.en: But what exactly was that monster?
entries.zh: 可那只怪物到底是什么？

entries.en: No idea, such a titan appearing out of nowhere isn't a good sign.
entries.zh: 不知道。这种庞然大物凭空出现，绝不是好兆头。

entries.en: Especially if it's after our Sulphur.
entries.zh: 尤其是它还盯上了我们的硫磺。

entries.en: We clearly hurt it real bad, but for all we know it's still alive.
entries.zh: 我们显然重创了它，但谁也不知道它是不是还活着。

entries.en: Barbarians, I would like to apologise for accusing you. You fought well out there.
entries.zh: 野蛮人，我为先前的指控向你们道歉。刚才你们打得很漂亮。

entries.en: No hard feelings, I also judged you too quickly.
entries.zh: 没事，我也太早下结论了。

entries.en: You too %1$s, you and your friends fought bravely, we couldn't have done it without you
entries.zh: 还有你，%1$s，你和朋友们都很英勇。没有你们，我们做不到。

entries.en: I have to report to the Queen, there is no time to waste.
entries.zh: 我必须立刻向女王汇报，不能再耽搁了。

entries.en: I'll also alert our Chief. Time to go.
entries.zh: 我也会通知酋长。该走了。

entries.en: Is anyone going to thank me?
entries.zh: 就没人打算谢谢我吗？

entries.en: Hey there, I'm the Auction Master.
entries.zh: 你好，我是拍卖大师。

entries.en: At the auction house you can put your valuable items up for auction!
entries.zh: 你可以把值钱的物品放到拍卖行拍卖！

entries.en: You may also want to check back here to see what items other players are selling to see if you can get a good deal.
entries.zh: 也可以常回来看看其他玩家在卖什么，说不定能捡到便宜。

entries.en: Talk to me if you would like to start your first auction or if you want to see the items currently being sold.
entries.zh: 想开第一场拍卖，或者看看现在有哪些物品在卖，就来找我。

entries.en: Are you ready for my last training session?
entries.zh: 准备好陪我完成最后一次训练了吗？

entries.en: Don't go easy on me, I'm very bad but I only have a week to improve.
entries.zh: 别放水。我现在虽然很菜，可只有一周时间能进步。

entries.en: Please come back tomorrow and help me train again!
entries.zh: 明天一定要回来继续帮我训练啊！
明天再来吧。

entries.en: I really hope I'll be ready on time.
entries.zh: 真希望我能及时准备好。
越来越有样子了！

entries.en: I am finally ready for my duel.
entries.zh: 我终于为决斗做好准备了。

entries.en: Please accept this, I can't thank you enough.
entries.zh: 请收下这个。再怎么感谢你都不够。

entries.en: I'll prepare for my duel now.
entries.zh: 我该去为决斗做最后准备了。

entries.en: I think I'll become a motivational speaker.
entries.zh: 我觉得自己都能去当励志演说家了。

entries.en: Crazy to think I could improve so much in a week.
entries.zh: 真不敢相信我一周就能进步这么多。

entries.en: I want to improve every day, for the rest of my life.
entries.zh: 往后余生，我想每天都比昨天更好。
你好！

entries.en: I went to the duel yesterday but we both agreed not to fight.
entries.zh: 我昨天去赴约了，但我们最后一致决定不打了。

entries.en: We both became much stronger during the last week, but strength should not be used for violence.
entries.zh: 这一周里我们都变强了许多，但力量不该用来施暴。

entries.en: I spent a week training my body, but I think my mind improved even more.
entries.zh: 我花了一周锻炼身体，可我的心境似乎成长得更多。

entries.en: I feel so much more sure of myself! I've grown beyond my old futile conflicts.
entries.zh: 我现在自信多了！那些无谓的旧争端已经困不住我。

entries.en: This was a life changing experience.
entries.zh: 这段经历改变了我的人生。

entries.en: Ohh man I'm in trouble! If you were part of my faction, maybe you could help me.
entries.zh: 糟了，我摊上大麻烦了！要是你属于我们阵营，或许还能帮帮我。

entries.en: Eek, you remind me of someone I need to duel in a week! If you weren't in his faction, maybe you could help me...
entries.zh: 咦，你让我想起那个一周后要跟我决斗的人！要不是你跟他同一阵营，也许还能帮帮我……

entries.en: Why aren't you on my side anymore? I don't want to embarrass myself; come back and help me.
entries.zh: 你怎么不站在我这边了？我不想在决斗时丢脸;回来帮帮我吧。

entries.en: Wait you're not on my my side? Even after all that training? I am so dead...
entries.zh: 等等，训练了这么久，你居然不站在我这边？我死定了……
别对长辈没大没小。
别偷听了！!!
请别来打扰我们。
你这样很没礼貌。
你为什么会在这里？

entries.en: Select an option: [I'm here to cause trouble, of course] [I have a letter of recommendation]
entries.zh: 请选择: [我当然是来找麻烦的]  [我有一封推荐信]
好吧，你可以过去！

entries.en: DO YOU WANT TO BE PULVERIZED?
entries.zh: 你想被碾成粉末吗？
你想干什么？

entries.en: WE HAVE OUR EYES ON YOU.
entries.zh: 我们会盯着你。

entries.en: Hey, this is a restricted area. Leave now!
entries.zh: 喂，这里是禁区。马上离开！
喂？

entries.en: You may need more reputation to unlock all of my supplies!
entries.zh: 你还得多积累些声望，才能解锁我这里的全部物资！

entries.en: So do you know if they got the new Abiphones?
entries.zh: 所以，你知道他们有没有进新款阿比手机吗？

entries.en: Ya, they got all of them. It's a bit expensive though.
entries.zh: 有啊，所有型号都有，就是有点贵。

entries.en: Incredible and do you know the code..?
entries.zh: 太棒了，那你知道密码吗……?

entries.en: Yep, but keep it to yourself.
entries.zh: 知道，不过可别说出去。
今天的密码是 %1$s。
好，记住了。

entries.en: Are you sure you wanna do this?
entries.zh: 你确定要这么干吗？

entries.en: You did NOT just do that.
entries.zh: 你还真敢动手啊。

entries.en: You are making a big mistake.
entries.zh: 你这是在犯大错。
你闹够了！
够了！
我就是战争！
喂！住手！
卫兵，拿下他们！

entries.en: DON'T DISAPPOINT ME, I HAVEN'T HAD A GOOD FIGHT IN A WHILE.
entries.zh: 别让我失望，我已经很久没痛快打过一场了。

entries.en: MY MINIONS WILL HAVE TO WIPE THE FLOOR AFTER I'M DONE WITH YOU ALL!
entries.zh: 等我收拾完你们，还得让手下来拖地收拾残局！

entries.en: Time for me to blast you away for good!
entries.zh: 该把你们彻底轰飞了！

entries.en: THAT BEAM! IT HURTS! IT HURTS!!
entries.zh: 我去，好痛！好痛！!
什么？
好像听见了什么……
尝尝凋灵头颅的滋味，杂种！

entries.en: I HOPE YOU LIKE EXPLOSIONS TOO!
entries.zh: 我希望你们也能欣赏爆炸的艺术！

entries.en: YOUR MOBILITY TRICKS DON'T WORK IN MY DOMAIN!
entries.zh: 你们那些身法，在我的领域里没用！

entries.en: How about you taste some rapid fire Wither Skulls!
entries.zh: 尝尝这阵凋灵头颅连射！
刚才那是什么？
耍我是吧！
马克索真是没用，果然不出所料。

entries.en: Don't boast about beating this simple-minded Wither.
entries.zh: 你们只是打败了那个头脑简单的凋灵而已，少得意。

entries.en: My abilities are unparalleled, in many ways I am the last bastion.
entries.zh: 我的本事无人能及，怎么说我都是这里最后一道防线。

entries.en: The power of lightning is quite phenomenal. A single strike can vaporize a person whole.
entries.zh: 闪电的威力相当惊人，一道下去就能把一个人整个烧成灰。

entries.en: I'd be happy to show you what that's like!
entries.zh: 我很乐意让你们亲身试试！
能量啊，听我号令！

entries.en: No more adventurers, no more heroes, death and thunder!
entries.zh: 不再有冒险者，不再有英雄——只剩死亡与雷霆！

entries.en: Not just your land, but every kingdom will soon be ruled by our army of undead!
entries.zh: 用不了多久，不只你们那片土地，所有空岛都会落到我们亡灵大军手里！

entries.en: This factory is too small for me!
entries.zh: 这座工厂装不下我！

entries.en: THUNDER LET ME BE YOUR CATALYST!
entries.zh: 雷霆啊，让我来做你的引信！
躲开这个！

entries.en: The Age of Men is over, we are creating tens, hundreds of withers!!
entries.zh: 人类的时代结束了，我们正成批创造凋零——几十只、上百只！!

entries.en: THAT WAS ONLY IN MY WAY!
entries.zh: 那根柱子本来就碍事！

entries.en: I should have known that I stood no chance.
entries.zh: 我早该知道自己毫无胜算。

entries.en: At least my son died by your hands.
entries.zh: 至少我的儿子死在了你们手里。

entries.en: Who dares trespass into my domain?
entries.zh: 哪个人敢闯入我的领域？
未激活的终端
未激活
装置

entries.en: There is no stopping me down there!
entries.zh: 在下面，没人能阻止我！
再近点！
佩服。
啊，我还挺喜欢那个的。
真痒啊。
别打了。

entries.en: YOUR WEAPONS CAN'T PIERCE THROUGH MY SHIELD!
entries.zh: 你们的武器破不了我的护盾！
哎哟，这下是真疼！
尚未激活

entries.en: You can't damage me, you can barely slow me down!
entries.zh: 你们伤不了我，顶多让我慢下来！
别碰那些终端！

entries.en: Slowing me down only prolongs your pain!
entries.zh: 拖慢我，只会让你们多受些折磨！

entries.en: Do you really think we won't repair everything? Your impact will be minuscule!
entries.zh: 你们真以为我们不会修好一切？你们造成的影响微不足道！

entries.en: Let's see how you can handle this.
entries.zh: 让我看看你们怎么应付这一手。
唔……就这个吧！

entries.en: That will be enough for now.
entries.zh: 暂时就这些吧。

entries.en: I am the death zone, you are smart to flee.
entries.zh: 我便是死亡禁区，逃跑算你们聪明。

entries.en: I will replace that gate with a stronger one!
entries.zh: 我会换上一道更结实的闸门！
靠近点！

entries.en: This guy looks like a fighter.
entries.zh: 这家伙看着挺能打。

entries.en: WELL! WELL! WELL! LOOK WHO'S HERE!
entries.zh: 哟哟哟，看看谁来了！

entries.en: The memory of your death will be your fondest, focus up!
entries.zh: 你们会把自己的死当成最美好的回忆。打起精神来！
靠近点！

entries.en: Punishment served, nothing survives my reach.
entries.zh: 惩罚已至，我所及之处，绝无生还。
水晶核心最佳用时

entries.en: How many Fairy Souls are there in %1$s?
entries.zh: %1$s里有多少个仙女之魂？

entries.en: What is the name of the vendor in the Hub who sells
entries.zh: 主城里哪位商人出售
染色玻璃？
ⓐ %1$s 个仙女之魂。
ⓑ %1$s 个仙女之魂。
ⓒ %1$s 个仙女之魂。
你变成了幽灵！

entries.en: Hopefully your teammates will be able to revive you!
entries.zh: 希望队友能把你救回来！
灵魂长弓掉落了！
%1$s 捡起了灵魂长弓！

entries.en: ⚡ The Chaos Guardian is preparing to Discharge! ⚡
entries.zh: ⚡ 混沌守卫即将放电！ ⚡

entries.en: The Reinforced Guardian is preparing a volley of TNT!
entries.zh: 强化守卫即将发射 TNT 齐射！

entries.en: The Healthy Guardian is preparing Giga Heal!
entries.zh: 治愈守卫即将施放超级治疗！
我最近一直在想……

entries.en: Have you noticed that it's not possible to enter The Catacombs alone?
entries.zh: 你有没有发现，没法独自进入地下墓穴？

entries.en: Mort's just really stubborn when it comes to The Catacombs. He's seen so many adventurers get lost down there that he now refuses to let anyone in without a buddy.
entries.zh: 一提到地下墓穴，莫特就特别固执。他见过太多冒险者在里面迷路，所以现在没有同伴，他就不放人进去。

entries.en: Not the mention that The Catacombs is extremenly dangerous to explore alone.
entries.zh: 更别说独自探索地下墓穴，可是极其危险的。

entries.en: Although he won't let the average adventurer pass, he might reconsider it if you're strong enough.
entries.zh: 虽然他不会让普通冒险者通过，但如果你足够强，他或许会重新考虑。

entries.en: Well, for The Catacombs, I reckon that if you have defeated The Professor, he'd probably let you in.
entries.zh: 至于地下墓穴，我想你要是击败过教授，他大概就会放行。

entries.en: If you can do that, I'll give you my personal recommendation!
entries.zh: 如果你能做到，我就亲自为你推荐！

entries.en: Talk to me again when you have done that.
entries.zh: 完成后再来找我。

entries.en: Unfortunately, it seems you haven't yet defeated The Professor! Come back when you have done that!
entries.zh: 可惜，看来你还没击败过教授！等你打败他再来吧！

entries.en: So, have you defeated The Professor yet?
entries.zh: 怎么样，你击败过教授了吗？

entries.en: Then take this letter to Mort whenever you feel like entering The Catacombs alone. Make sure that you're not in a party.
entries.zh: 那你想独自进入地下墓穴时，就拿这封信给莫特看。记得先退出队伍。
祝你好运。

entries.en: Good luck on your solo adventures. I look forward to hearing about your triumphs within The Catacombs!
entries.zh: 祝你的单人冒险一切顺利。我期待听到你在地下墓穴中凯旋的消息！

entries.en: I can see that you already have my recommendation letter on you!
entries.zh: 我看得出来，你身上已经带着我的推荐信了！

entries.en: You've already handed in my recommendation letter! You don't need another one.
entries.zh: 你已经把我的推荐信交给莫特了！不需要再拿一封。

entries.en: The reward is not in my chest!
entries.zh: 奖励不在我的箱子里！

entries.en: Gratz for making it this far, but I'm basically unbeatable.
entries.zh: 恭喜你们走到这里，但你们真的能打得过我吗？

entries.en: I don't even need to fight, this is the life!
entries.zh: 我甚至不用战斗，这才叫生活！

entries.en: I can summon lots of undead! Check this out.
entries.zh: 我能召唤一大群亡灵！看看这个。
噢，我死了！
骗你的！
假的！

entries.en: Alright, maybe I'm just weak after all..
entries.zh: 好吧，也许我终究只是太弱了……

entries.en: But my masters are a lot stronger..
entries.zh: 但我的主人们比我强大得多……
你们等着瞧……
住手。
你们一点也不好笑。
等等……
真尴尬。
给我一秒……
没劲。
别烦我！
去和我的亡灵们战斗吧。
你跑什么？
挂！
开挂！
这不公平！
好痛！

entries.en: All I have are positive thoughts.
entries.zh: 我只有积极的想法。
你想要气球吗？
跑，跑，跑，快跑哇！

entries.en: Hoho, looks like you killed me!
entries.zh: 嚯嚯，看起来你们杀了我！
你们这些蠢货！

entries.en: You fell victim to one of the classic blunders!
entries.zh: 你们中了最经典的圈套！
将军。

entries.en: I can revive myself and become much stronger!
entries.zh: 我能复活自己，还会变得更加强大！

entries.en: Oh noes, you got me.. what ever will I do?!
entries.zh: 哎呀呀，被你们打中了……我该怎么办才好呢？!
你想要气球吗，%1$s?
闭上眼睛，%1$s!

entries.en: Gratz for making it this far, but I’m basically unbeatable.
entries.zh: 恭喜你们走到这里，不过我基本上是无敌的。

entries.en: They are both telling the truth. The reward isn't in %1$s's chest.
entries.zh: 他们俩说的都是真话。奖励不在 %1$s 的箱子里。

entries.en: You are not ready for this fight.
entries.zh: 你还没准备好打这一仗。

entries.en: Finish the Crimson Isle Factions questline before talking to me again.
entries.zh: 完成绯红孤岛阵营任务线后再来找我。

entries.en: ✆ Huh? you want to add my contact to your Abiphone?
entries.zh: ✆ 嗯？你想把我的联系方式加到阿比手机里？

entries.en: ✆ I guess we can come to an agreement.
entries.zh: ✆ 我想我们可以谈个条件。

entries.en: ✆ I'm far too weak to take on Kuudra myself, but maybe one day...
entries.zh: ✆ 我现在还太弱，无法独自挑战库德拉，不过也许总有一天……

entries.en: ✆ Bring me a Bezal Shard, and I'll give you my contact.
entries.zh: ✆ 给我带一块贝扎尔碎片，我就把联系方式给你。

entries.en: ✆ You don't have what I need! Nice try!
entries.zh: ✆ 你没带我要的东西！想得美！

entries.en: ✆ Ah, that is what I asked for. Thanks.
entries.zh: ✆ 啊，这正是我要的。谢谢。

entries.en: ✆ Here is my contact. Give me a call if you wish to take on the one they call 'Kuudra.'
entries.zh: ✆ 这是我的联系方式。如果你想挑战那个被称作“库德拉”的家伙，就给我打电话。

entries.en: After completed a dungeon run, you get a selection of treasure chests.
entries.zh: 完成一次地牢挑战后，会有一排宝箱供你挑选。

entries.en: If you don't open any, I collect and hoard them for you!
entries.zh: 如果你一个都没开，我就会替你收起来！

entries.en: Did you know, I used to live in the catacombs before they moved in all the zombies?
entries.zh: 你知道吗？在那些僵尸全搬进来之前，我曾经住在地牢里。

entries.en: It's always best to keep a handle on things!
entries.zh: 凡事最好都能把握得住！

entries.en: The Wither King now lives in the deepest floor of the Catacombs, but where is the Wither Prince?
entries.zh: 凋灵之王如今住在地下墓穴最深层，但凋灵王子又在哪里呢？

entries.en: I wonder if they'll ever open more doors in here.
entries.zh: 不知道他们以后会不会再多开几道门。

entries.en: The reward is in my chest!
entries.zh: 奖励就在我的箱子里！

entries.en: Don't think you can hide from me %1$s
entries.zh: 别以为你能躲过我，%1$s

entries.en: Little ants, plotting and scheming, thinking they are invincible...
entries.zh: 小小蝼蚁，还真当自己无敌了……

entries.en: I won't let you break the factory core, I gave my life to my Master.
entries.zh: 我绝不会让你们摧毁工厂核心；我已将自己的生命献给主人。

entries.en: No one matches me in close quarters.
entries.zh: 近身交战，无人能与我匹敌。

entries.en: You have done it, you destroyed the factory...
entries.zh: 你们做到了，工厂已被摧毁……

entries.en: But you have nowhere to hide anymore!
entries.zh: 但你们再也无处可藏！

entries.en: YOU ARE FACE TO FACE WITH GOLDOR!
entries.zh: 现在，戈尔多就在你们面前！
耐克伦，原谅我。

entries.en: FINALLY! This took way too long.
entries.zh: 终于！你们也太磨蹭了。

entries.en: Now that you're a Ghost, can you help me clean up?
entries.zh: 既然你们变成了幽灵，可以帮我打扫一下吗？
到我身边来！

entries.en: You are breaking precious materials, unforgivable.
entries.zh: 你们竟敢破坏我的珍贵东西，不可饶恕。

entries.en: What do you think you are doing there!
entries.zh: 你们在那儿干什么！
你们的死期到了！!

entries.en: The little ants have a brain it seems.
entries.zh: 看来这群小蝼蚁还有点脑子。

entries.en: I'm Guildford! Yes, that Guildford. I'm sure you've heard of me!
entries.zh: 我是吉尔福德！没错，就是那个吉尔福德。你肯定听说过我！

entries.en: There is some fantastic scenery around this land. I like to race back and forth!
entries.zh: 这一带风景相当不错，我就爱在这儿来回跑！

entries.en: You can speak to me any time and I'll set up a race with the settings you choose.
entries.zh: 随时都可以来找我，我会按照你选择的设置安排竞速。

entries.en: If you do well in the races I will reward you!
entries.zh: 如果你在竞速中表现出色，我会奖励你！

entries.en: They are both lying, the reward is in my chest!
entries.zh: 他们俩都在撒谎，奖励就在我的箱子里！

entries.en: Oh my shadows! Perfect in every way!
entries.zh: 我的影子啊！处处都完美！

entries.en: Stronger than my subjects and more loyal...I am invincible...
entries.zh: 比我的臣民更强，也更忠诚……你们是打不赢我的……

entries.en: Well fought humans, no longer you will disrupt the silence of the Catacombs.
entries.zh: 打得不错，小人类，你们再也无法打扰地下墓穴的寂静了。

entries.en: Impossible! How did you figure out which one I was?!
entries.zh: 这不可能！你们是怎么认出哪个是我的？！

entries.en: If you think this is the end, you are so wrong!
entries.zh: 如果你们以为这就结束了，那就大错特错了！

entries.en: My shadows are everywhere, THEY WILL FIND YOU!!
entries.zh: 我的影子无处不在，它们会找到你们的！!

entries.en: You look like a real fool right now.
entries.zh: 你现在看起来真像个傻瓜。
太蠢了！
哎呀！这都能认错。

entries.en: They couldn't even find the real Livid, psht!
entries.zh: 他们连真正的利维德都找不到，切！
接招！
只是时间问题！
无穷的力量！
躲开这个！
安静！

entries.en: My daggers can pierce through steel!
entries.zh: 我的匕首能刺穿钢铁！

entries.en: I am Livid, but I am not Livid.
entries.zh: 我是利维德，但我又不是。
我不过是一道影子。
继续找！
找错了！

entries.en: Welcome, you've arrived right on time. I am Livid, the Master of Shadows.
entries.zh: 欢迎，你们来得正是时候。我是利维德，影之主宰。

entries.en: This Orb you see, is Thorn, or what is left of him.
entries.zh: 你们看到的那颗宝珠就是索恩——或者说，是他剩下的部分。

entries.en: In a way, I have to thank you for finally getting rid of him.
entries.zh: 说起来，我还得谢谢你们，终于替我把他解决了。

entries.en: I can now turn those Spirits into shadows of myself, identical to their creator.
entries.zh: 现在我可以把那些灵体变成我的影子，和造出它们的人一模一样。

entries.en: I respect you for making it to here, but I'll be your undoing.
entries.zh: 能走到这里，我敬你们几分——但你们会栽在我手上。
奖励在我的箱子里！

entries.en: One of the others is lying!
entries.zh: 另外两人中有一个在撒谎！

entries.en: Both of them are telling the truth. Also, %1$s has the reward in their chest!
entries.zh: 他们俩说的都是真话。而且，奖励在 %1$s的箱子里！
你好。

entries.en: Tunnels in the caves were created to bury victims of the Calamity.
entries.zh: 洞里那些隧道，当初是挖来埋大灾变遇难者的。

entries.en: An evil force took control of the graves.
entries.zh: 一股邪恶力量占据了这些坟墓。

entries.en: Corpses are raised into a powerful army fueled by pain, misery and anguish.
entries.zh: 尸体在痛苦、悲惨与折磨的驱动下复生，组成了一支强大的军队。
总之！

entries.en: If you find gear inside, I can upgrade it for you!
entries.zh: 你要是在里面找到装备，我可以帮你升级！

entries.en: I don't tend to give out my contact to those delving into The Catacombs.
entries.zh: 我一般不把联系方式给那些深入地下墓穴的人。

entries.en: I used to, but remembering who's still alive and who isn't is a nightmare.
entries.zh: 我以前会给，但要记住谁还活着、谁已经死了，简直是场噩梦。

entries.en: By the end of any given week, 90% of the people in my directory would be dead.
entries.zh: 每到一周结束，我通讯录里就有 90% 的人死了。

entries.en: Removing them was a real pain.
entries.zh: 把他们逐个删掉实在麻烦。

entries.en: Anyways, I guess I'll add you, but only if you can prove to me that you won't just die like everyone else.
entries.zh: 总之，我可以加你，但你得先证明自己不会像其他人一样轻易死掉。

entries.en: Survive long enough to collect 5,000 Undead Essence, and then bring it to me.
entries.zh: 你先活到攒够 5,000 亡灵精粹，再拿来给我。

entries.en: You don't have enough Undead Essence.
entries.zh: 你的亡灵精粹还不够。
我要的是 5,000 份。

entries.en: Come back when you've got enough.
entries.zh: 凑够以后再回来。
谢谢。

entries.en: I wish you the best of luck in The Catacombs.
entries.zh: 祝你在地下墓穴里好运。

entries.en: Try to stay alive, for both your sake and mine - I don't feel like expending the minimal effort required to remove you from my contacts.
entries.zh: 为了你我双方着想，尽量活着吧——我连把你从联系人中删除所需的那一点点力气都不想花。
这是我的联系方式。

entries.en: I'M TOO YOUNG TO DIE AGAIN!
entries.zh: 我这么年轻，怎么又要死了！

entries.en: I'LL MAKE YOU REMEMBER MY DEATH!!
entries.zh: 我会让你们永远记住我的死去！!

entries.en: My chest has the reward and I'm telling the truth!
entries.zh: 奖励在我的箱子里，我说的可是真话！

entries.en: My chest doesn't have the reward. We are all telling the truth.
entries.zh: 奖励不在我的箱子里。我们说的都是真话。
%1$s说的是真话。
嘿，%1$s，欢迎来到地下墓穴！

entries.en: We hope you have a long stay!
entries.zh: 希望你能在这里待很久！
最好是来一场永恒的冒险。

entries.en: Our forces are made of rotting adventurers.
entries.zh: 我们这支队伍全是些烂掉的冒险者。

entries.en: A party of 5 players is crucial.
entries.zh: 凑齐 5 个人的队伍很关键。
该去交朋友了。
流浪者！

entries.en: Save your own skin, seek challenge elsewhere first.
entries.zh: 先保住自己这条小命，想找刺激上别处去。

entries.en: You need Combat Level XV before leading a dungeon.
entries.zh: 你需要达到战斗等级 XV，才能带队进入地牢。

entries.en: Here, I found this map when I first entered the dungeon.
entries.zh: 拿着，这是我第一次进入地牢时发现的地图。

entries.en: You should find it useful if you get lost.
entries.zh: 如果迷路了，这张地图应该能派上用场。
祝你好运。
别忘了带上地牢宝珠！

entries.en: It gives each class 2 unique abilities inside Dungeons!
entries.zh: 它能让每个职业在地牢中拥有 2 个独特技能！

entries.en: Right click the Orb for spells, and Left click (or Drop) to use your Ultimate!
entries.zh: 右键点击光球选择法术，左键（或按丢弃键）释放终极技能！

entries.en: Welcome back. Are you here to enter The Catacombs again?
entries.zh: 欢迎回来。你又要进地下墓穴了？

entries.en: WHAT? You want to go in alone? I simply cannot allow that to happen.
entries.zh: 什么？你想一个人进去？这可绝对不行。
嗯，这是什么？

entries.en: I see.. you have a recommendation letter from Saul. Well, I guess its OK then, I suppose.
entries.zh: 原来如此……你有索尔的推荐信。好吧，那应该可以……大概吧。

entries.en: I'll allow you to enter The Catacombs alone from now on.
entries.zh: 从现在起，我允许你独自进入地下墓穴

entries.en: However, let me give you an explicit final warning.
entries.zh: 不过，我得明确给你一个最后警告。

entries.en: The Dungeon you will enter will be exactly the same difficulty as if you joined with a party.
entries.zh: 你独自进入的地牢，难度和组队进入时完全一样。

entries.en: After all, The Catacombs won't go easy on you just because you're on your own.
entries.zh: 毕竟，地下墓穴可不会因为你独自一人就手下留情。

entries.en: You have been warned. I wish you the best of luck.
entries.zh: 我已经警告过你了。祝你好运。

entries.en: You do know I am dead, right?
entries.zh: 你知道我已经死了，对吧？

entries.en: Why do you want me on your Abiphone?
entries.zh: 你为什么想把我加到阿比手机里？

entries.en: Anyway, you can have it... for a price.
entries.zh: 总之，你可以得到我的联系方式……但要付出代价。

entries.en: Could you give me a Saving Grace? No particular reason.
entries.zh: 能给我一个救赎恩典吗？没什么特别的原因。

entries.en: You don't even have a Saving Grace...
entries.zh: 你连救赎恩典都没有……

entries.en: I was a little too optimistic.
entries.zh: 是我有点过于乐观了。

entries.en: Could you maybe give me a Spirit Bone?
entries.zh: 要不，再给我一根灵魂之骨？

entries.en: You don't even have a Spirit Bone...
entries.zh: 你连灵魂之骨都没有……

entries.en: I've accepted that I'm probably going to remain undead for quite a while.
entries.zh: 我已经接受了自己可能还要当很久亡灵的事实。

entries.en: So, while I'm here, I might as well try to make some friends.
entries.zh: 既然还要留在这里，我不妨试着交些朋友。

entries.en: First stop is using this here Spirit Bone to tame myself a canine companion.
entries.zh: 第一步，就用这根灵魂之骨给自己驯服个狗狗作伴。

entries.en: Thought we ourselves are but a blink in th face of eternity, our friendship will be everlasting.
entries.zh: 虽然我们自身在永恒面前不过转瞬即逝，但我们的友谊将长存。

entries.en: Alright, thanks for your efforts, take my contact.
entries.zh: 好了，谢谢你的努力，收下我的联系方式吧。

entries.en: Right-click the Orb for spells, and Left-click (or Drop) to use your Ultimate!
entries.zh: 右键点击光球选择法术，左键（或按丢弃键）释放终极技能！

entries.en: Finally, I heard so much about you. The Eye likes you very much.
entries.zh: 终于见面了，我听说过你们很多事。我的那只眼睛很喜欢你们。

entries.en: You went further than any human before, congratulations.
entries.zh: 非常恭喜，你们比之前任何人都走得更远。

entries.en: I'm afraid, your journey ends now.
entries.zh: 但很抱歉，你们的旅程就要在这里结束了。

entries.en: My master and I spent centuries building this factory...and this army.
entries.zh: 我的主人和我花了数百年建造这座工厂……以及这支军队。

entries.en: I won't allow you to destroy it all now.
entries.zh: 我不会允许你们现在毁掉这一切。
再见。

entries.en: That's a very impressive trick. I guess I'll have to handle this myself.
entries.zh: 这招很厉害。看来我得亲自处理了。

entries.en: I ensure you, these blades are far sharper than Goldor's ever were.
entries.zh: 我向你保证，这些刀刃远比戈尔多的刀刃锋利。
这一切，都白费了……

entries.en: I understand your words now, my master.
entries.zh: 我现在明白您的话了，我的主人。
地下墓穴……不复存在了。

entries.en: You merely adopted the Catacombs! I was molded by them!
entries.zh: 你们不过是后来才踏入地下墓穴！而我是由地下墓穴塑造的！

entries.en: I - Necron - was destined to rule over Mankind! Dead or Alive!
entries.zh: 我——耐克伦——注定要统治人类！无论生死！

entries.en: The Catacombs made you stronger, but can you beat me?!
entries.zh: 地下墓穴让你们变强了，但你们能打败我吗？!

entries.en: Show me how you beat Storm!!!
entries.zh: 让我看看你们是怎么击败斯托姆的！!!

entries.en: Not just your Village, but the whole world will end!
entries.zh: 不只你们的村庄，整个世界都将终结！
为生存而战！

entries.en: Sometimes when you have a problem, you just need to destroy it all and start again.
entries.zh: 有时遇到问题，只需摧毁一切，重新开始。
见识我纯粹的核能吧！

entries.en: IF YOU WANT TO STAY COOL, DON'T LOOK!
entries.zh: 想别被烤熟的话，就别看！
再见了，宝贝！
啊！
腾点地方出来！

entries.en: Adventurers! Be careful of who you are messing with...
entries.zh: 冒险者们！当心你们招惹的是谁……

entries.en: These Catacombs hold many riches, powerful items and great experience.
entries.zh: 这座地下墓穴里藏着大量财富、强力装备，还有丰厚的经验。

entries.en: My trick? I make coins from the others' greed.
entries.zh: 我的门道？就是从别人的贪心里赚钱。

entries.en: Are you interested in buying anything?
entries.zh: 你有兴趣买点什么吗？
✆ 哼，我可不好说。
✆ 我真的很忙。

entries.en: ✆ If I give you my contact it's strictly business, right?
entries.zh: ✆ 如果把联系方式给你，就只谈生意，对吧？

entries.en: ✆ I like collecting rings. There is one I've been wanting for a while now.
entries.zh: ✆ 我喜欢收藏戒指。有一枚我已经想要很久了。

entries.en: ✆ Have you heard of the Catacombs Expert Ring?
entries.zh: ✆ 你听说过地下墓穴专家戒指吗？
✆ 我可太想要了。
✆ 真的？

entries.en: ✆ I haven't received a present like that...ever I think.
entries.zh: ✆ 我想……我从没收到过这样的礼物。

entries.en: ✆ Here take my contact, and thank you!
entries.zh: ✆ 给你我的联系方式，谢谢！

entries.en: ✆ You don't have what I need, nice try!
entries.zh: ✆ 你没有我要的东西，想得美！

entries.en: I am Oruo the Omniscient. I have lived many lives. I have learned all there is to know.
entries.zh: 我是全知者奥鲁奥。我活过许多世，该知道的我都知道。

entries.en: Though I sit stationary in this prison that is The Catacombs, my knowledge knows no bounds.
entries.zh: 尽管我被困在地下墓穴这座牢笼里动弹不得，我的学识却没有边界。

entries.en: Prove your knowledge by answering 3 questions and I shall reward you in ways that transcend time!
entries.zh: 答对三道题证明你们的学识，我便给你们一份超越时间的奖赏！

entries.en: Answer incorrectly, and your moment of ineptitude will live on for generations.
entries.zh: 答错的话，你们出丑的这一刻会被传上好几代。
%1$s 答对了第 %2$s 题！

entries.en: %1$s thinks the answer is %2$s! Lock in your party's answer in my Chamber!
entries.zh: %1$s 认为答案是 %2$s! 去我的房间里锁定队伍的答案！

entries.en: 2 questions left... Then you will have proven your worth to me!
entries.zh: 还剩两道题……答完你们就算在我这儿证明了自己！
还剩最后一道题！
%1$s 答对了最后一题！

entries.en: I bestow upon you all the power of a hundred years!
entries.zh: 我把百年的力量赐予你们！

entries.en: As a token of my respect, I have maxed out all of your Training Weights and added time to your Bottle of Jyrre!
entries.zh: 作为敬意，我把你们身上的训练负重全部加满，还给吉尔瓶添了时间！

entries.en: What is the status of Maxor, Storm, Goldor, and Necron?
entries.zh: 马克索、斯托姆、戈尔多和耐克伦的身份是什么？

entries.en: Which of these monsters only spawns at night?
entries.zh: 下列哪种怪物只在夜间生成？
ⓐ %1$s 个仙女之魂
ⓑ %1$s 个仙女之魂
ⓒ %1$s 个仙女之魂

entries.en: My chest doesn't have the reward. At least one of the others is telling the truth!
entries.zh: 奖励不在我的箱子里。另外两人中，至少有一个说的是真话！

entries.en: The reward is not in my chest. They are both lying.
entries.zh: 奖励不在我的箱子里。他们俩都在说谎。

entries.en: One of us is telling the truth!
entries.zh: 我们之中有一个人说的是真话！

entries.en: So you made it all the way here... Now you wish to defy me? Sadan?!
entries.zh: 你们一路来到了这里……现在想要违抗我？萨丹？！

entries.en: The audacity! I have been the ruler of these floors for a hundred years!
entries.zh: 真是胆大妄为！我统治地牢已经一百年了！

entries.en: I am the bridge between this realm and the world below! You shall not pass!
entries.zh: 我是这个世界与下方世界的桥梁！你们休想通过！

entries.en: You've managed to kill a Giant! Good luck with the rest of them!
entries.zh: 你们居然杀死了一只巨人！剩下的可没这么好对付！

entries.en: Wow, one Giant down already? You guys are good!
entries.zh: 哇，已经解决一个巨人了？你们挺厉害！

entries.en: How many players does it take to kill a Giant?
entries.zh: 要多少个玩家才能杀死一只巨人？
你们杀了我最弱的巨人！

entries.en: Uh oh! Half of my Giant creations have bit the dust! Whatever will I do?
entries.zh: 哦豁！我一半的巨人造物都倒下了！我该怎么办呢？

entries.en: 2 of my Giants down?! No matter, these last two are tough!
entries.zh: 我的两只巨人倒下了？! 无所谓，最后两只很强！

entries.en: That Giant was weak! I clearly screwed up during the necromancy process.
entries.zh: 那只巨人太弱了！显然我在亡灵术过程中搞砸了。
我开始冒汗了！
只剩 1 个巨人了！

entries.en: Whoops! There goes my third Giant!
entries.zh: 糟糕！我的第三只巨人也没了！

entries.en: Interesting strategy, waking up my Golems. Or was that unintentional, %1$s?
entries.zh: 唤醒我的傀儡，有意思。还是说你不是故意的，%1$s?

entries.en: You weren't supposed to wake up that Golem, %1$s!
entries.zh: 你不该唤醒那只傀儡，%1$s!

entries.en: My Terracotta Army wasn't enough? You had to awaken a Golem on top, %1$s?!
entries.zh: 我的陶俑军团还不够？你还非得再唤醒一只傀儡，%1$s?!

entries.en: Those Golems will be your undoing, %1$s!
entries.zh: 那些傀儡会毁掉你，%1$s!

entries.en: How many more of my Golems will you disturb, %1$s?
entries.zh: 你还要惊扰多少只傀儡，%1$s?

entries.en: Reckless humans! You should know by now my Golems do not want to be awoken, %1$s!
entries.zh: 鲁莽的人类！你们早该明白我的傀儡不想被唤醒，%1$s!

entries.en: All my Golems want is some peace and quiet! Can you not, %1$s?!
entries.zh: 我的傀儡只想清静一下！你就不能住手吗，%1$s?!

entries.en: How did that Golem wake up? Carelessness from you adventurers, no doubt.
entries.zh: 那只傀儡怎么醒了？毫无疑问，是你们这些冒险者太粗心。

entries.en: Thanks to %1$s, all of my Golems have been awoken! Quite the feat!
entries.zh: 多亏了%1$s，我所有的傀儡都醒了！真了不起！

entries.en: Wonderous! Not one sleeping Golem was left unperturbed by you reckless humans! Thanks, %1$s!
entries.zh: 太精彩了！你们这些鲁莽的人类连一只沉睡的傀儡都没放过！多谢了，%1$s!

entries.en: I've never seen such carelessness in my years as a Necromancer! So little regard for my Golems, and even less regard for your own lives! Blame %1$s!
entries.zh: 我当亡灵法师这么多年，从没见过如此粗心的人！既不在乎我的傀儡，更不在乎自己的性命！都怪%1$s!

entries.en: My Terracotta Army is using some of the finest souls - old warriors and wizards!
entries.zh: 我的陶俑军团使用了最上等的灵魂——古老的战士与巫师！

entries.en: You will be humbled, reckless humans!
entries.zh: 你们会学会谦卑的，鲁莽的人类！

entries.en: Can you at least enjoy my science, pushing the boundaries of Necromancy!
entries.zh: 至少欣赏一下我的科学吧，它正在拓展亡灵术的极限！

entries.en: Corpses are deficient, full of weaknesses. Statues are stronger, faster, and easier to repair.
entries.zh: 尸体缺陷重重，满是弱点。雕像更强、更快，也更容易修复。

entries.en: Can't you see that there is no winning? This room will be your tomb.
entries.zh: 还看不出你们毫无胜算吗？这个房间会成为你们的坟墓。

entries.en: So much effort, for what? You should have joined us instead, Necron will cure this world!
entries.zh: 费这么大力气，为了什么？你们本该加入我们，耐克伦会治愈这个世界！
糟透了……糟透了……

entries.en: I'm growing tired of this folly. My Giants are restless.
entries.zh: 我开始厌倦这场闹剧了。我的巨人们躁动不安。

entries.en: It's about time we see what my Giants can do...
entries.zh: 该看看我的巨人有何本事了……

entries.en: Rumor has it those are dead Precursors, legendary civilization.
entries.zh: 传说那些是死去的先驱，来自一个传奇文明。

entries.en: My first time using them, extremely interesting!
entries.zh: 这是我第一次使用它们，非常有趣！

entries.en: Which one is your favorite? Those laser eyes...beautiful!
entries.zh: 你最喜欢哪一个？那双激光眼……真美！

entries.en: This is what peak Necromancy looks like!
entries.zh: 这就是亡灵术的巅峰！

entries.en: Boulders, lasers, stomping, and giant swords! Oh my!
entries.zh: 巨石、激光、践踏和巨剑！哎呀！
够了！
我的巨人们！解放吧！

entries.en: You did it. I understand now, you have earned my respect.
entries.zh: 你们做到了。我明白了，你们赢得了我的尊重。

entries.en: If only you had become my disciples instead of this incompetent bunch.
entries.zh: 如果你们成为我的弟子，而不是这群无能之辈就好了。

entries.en: Maybe in another life. Until then, meet my ultimate corpse.
entries.zh: 也许来世吧。在那之前，见识我终极的尸体。

entries.en: I'm sorry, but I need to concentrate. I wish it didn't have to come to this.
entries.zh: 抱歉，我需要集中精神。真希望事情不必走到这一步。

entries.en: You thought I'd fall for the same tricks as those before me? Not today!
entries.zh: 你们以为我会像前面那些人一样中招？这次可不会！

entries.en: It was inevitable. You are fighting forces beyond your imagination.
entries.zh: 这是不可避免的。你们面对的是超乎想象的力量。

entries.en: No adventurer can see what lays beyond this floor.
entries.zh: 没有冒险者能看到这一层之后的景象。
安息吧。
父亲，原谅我！!!

entries.en: I'm sorry but I need to concentrate. I wish it didn't have to come to this.
entries.zh: 抱歉，我得集中精神。真希望事情不用走到这一步。

entries.en: This is where the journey ends for you, Adventurers.
entries.zh: 冒险者们，你们的旅程将要在此终结。

entries.en: The last few who tried fighting me are now in those Crypts.
entries.zh: 最近几个试图与我战斗的人，现在就在旁边那些墓穴里。

entries.en: If you can beat my Undeads, I'll personally grant you the privilege to replace them.
entries.zh: 如果你们能击败我的亡灵，我会亲自赐予你们取代它们的荣幸。
起来吧，我的造物！
这应该会很有趣。

entries.en: Those toys are not strong enough I see.
entries.zh: 看起来那些玩具不够强。
不过别高兴得太早。

entries.en: Did you forget? I was taught by the best! Let's dance.
entries.zh: 你们忘了吗？我可是最强者亲自教出来的！来跳舞吧！
我的牧师在哪儿！
战士！冲向这个蠢货！
退后！

entries.en: You'd make a great Undead minion!
entries.zh: 你会成为优秀的亡灵手下！

entries.en: I can't believe Bonzo lost to someone so weak!
entries.zh: 真不敢相信邦佐会输给这么弱的人！

entries.en: I'll make you take the %1$s's place!
entries.zh: 我会让你取代%1$s的位置！

entries.en: Oh, you killed my %1$s? No problem.
entries.zh: 哦，你嘎了我的%1$s? 没关系。
我本来对你有更高的期望，%1$s。
别再躲了！

entries.en: I'll send you to the Wither Realm!
entries.zh: 我会把你送进凋灵领域！

entries.en: Just who do you think I am!
entries.zh: 你以为我是谁！

entries.en: Soon I'll be shooting your skull!
entries.zh: 很快，我就要拿你的头骨当靶子了！
亡灵忍术！
呀嘞呀嘞……

entries.en: I'm going to be the Wither King!
entries.zh: 我将成为凋灵之王！
终极凋灵！

entries.en: Fine then! I'll take you myself!
entries.zh: 好吧！让我亲自收拾你们！

entries.en: That was nothing my Priest can't heal!
entries.zh: 切，这点伤，我的牧师轻易就能治好！

entries.en: I always knew I would win...I'm a genius.
entries.zh: 我早就知道我会赢……我可是天才。

entries.en: But don't worry I'll add you to my collection.
entries.zh: 别担心，我会把你们收藏起来。

entries.en: In a way, you'll live forever...
entries.zh: 从某种意义上说，你们会永远活着……永远……
无论如何……
你们永远都不可能击败我的老师……
他的技术……太厉害了……

entries.en: How can you move forward when you keep regretting the past?
entries.zh: 一直困在过去的遗憾里，你又怎么向前走？
削弱狂战士！

entries.en: Bahahaha! Not a single intact pillar remains!
entries.zh: 啊哈！一根完好的柱子都不剩了！

entries.en: Rejoice, your last moments are with me and my lightning.
entries.zh: 该高兴起来了，因为你们最后这点时间有我和我的闪电陪着。

entries.en: The days are numbered until I am finally unleashed again on the world!
entries.zh: 再过不了几天，我就要重新被放出去祸害这个世界了！

entries.en: Fool, I'd hide under something next time if I were you!
entries.zh: 蠢货，换作是我，下次会找个东西躲着！

entries.en: Slowing me down will be your greatest accomplishment!
entries.zh: 能拖慢我，就算你们这辈子最大的成就了！

entries.en: I was burdened with terrible news recently...
entries.zh: 我最近得知了一个糟糕的消息……
我最有天赋的学生……
让我向你展示真正的力量！

entries.en: You took one of them down, but that won't be enough!
entries.zh: 你们击倒了其中一个，但这还不够！

entries.en: I'm afraid I can quickly revive any one of my Guardians!
entries.zh: 恐怕我能迅速复活任意一名守卫！

entries.en: My barrier is weakening, but it still holds strong!
entries.zh: 我的屏障正在减弱，但仍然坚不可摧！
已经击倒两个守卫了？有点本事……

entries.en: What?! Nobody has managed to take three of my Guardians down before!
entries.zh: 什么？! 从来没人能击倒我的三名守卫！
我的守卫！

entries.en: My technique is much more advanced than Scarf's..
entries.zh: 我的技术比斯卡夫的先进得多……

entries.en: My barrier will hold as long as my Guardians are alive.
entries.zh: 只要守卫还活着，我的屏障就不会倒下。

entries.en: Give up Adventurers, it only takes me a few seconds to revive my guardians.
entries.zh: 放弃吧，冒险者们，我只需几秒就能复活守卫。

entries.en: I can do this all day.
entries.zh: 我可以这样耗上一整天。

entries.en: Perfect offense and defense, I am INVINCIBLE!
entries.zh: 完美的进攻与防御，我所向无敌！
接着！接住！
给你们来个曲球！

entries.en: Oh? You found my Guardians' one weakness?
entries.zh: 哦？你们找到了我的守卫唯一的弱点？

entries.en: Even if you took my barrier down, I can still fight.
entries.zh: 即使你们摧毁了我的屏障，我仍然能战斗。

entries.en: This time I'll be your opponent!
entries.zh: 这次我来做你们的对手！

entries.en: These wounds are nothing for my Giga Heal!
entries.zh: 这些伤势对我的超级治疗来说不算什么！

entries.en: How do you like the taste of Gunpowder?
entries.zh: 火药的滋味如何？

entries.en: Another flawless Giga Heal. You are making this too easy for me!
entries.zh: 又一次完美的超级治疗。你们让这一切太轻松了！

entries.en: I see. You have forced me to use my ultimate technique.
entries.zh: 原来如此。你们逼我使出终极招式了。

entries.en: These Guardians aren't just for show I'm afraid!
entries.zh: 恐怕这些守卫可不只是摆设！

entries.en: The process is irreversible, but I'll be stronger than a Wither now!
entries.zh: 这个过程不可逆，但现在我会比凋灵更强！

entries.en: Now that you have fallen, my student has been avenged.
entries.zh: 既然你们已经倒下，我的学生也算大仇得报。

entries.en: Picking a fight with me and my experiments will only lead to your demise!
entries.zh: 挑战我和我的实验就是作死行为！
我给你们一个 F-!

entries.en: What?! My Guardian power is unbeatable!
entries.zh: 什么？! 我的守卫之力明明不可战胜！

entries.en: How could you... I needed more power...
entries.zh: 这怎么可能……我需要更多力量……

entries.en: I can't let my Master hear about this.. he'll kill m-
entries.zh: 不能让我的主人听说这件事……他会杀了我——
够了，蠢货！

entries.en: Adventurers! Be careful of who you are messing with..
entries.zh: 冒险者们！当心你们招惹的是谁……

entries.en: Before I have to deal with you myself.
entries.zh: 别逼我亲自处理你们。

entries.en: My Guardians! Show them your power!
entries.zh: 我的守卫们！向他们展示你们的力量！

entries.en: Giga Heal requires a large amount of concentration.
entries.zh: 施放超级治疗，可得全神贯注。

entries.en: A few hits can throw that off, and you didn't even bother trying. Fools!
entries.zh: 挨上几下就会分心，你们居然连试都不试。蠢货！

entries.en: You have failed to prove yourself, and have paid with your lives. You will make an excellent addition to my collection.
entries.zh: 没能证明自己，还搭上了性命。你们将是我的绝佳收藏品。
我不是你的敌人。
别逼我射你。
哎哟——开玩笑的……

entries.en: We're always watching. Come down from there!
entries.zh: 我们一直看着呢。给我下来！

entries.en: Don't try to sneak anything past my Watchful Eyes. They see you up there!
entries.zh: 别想瞒过我的监视之眼。它们看得到你在上面！

entries.en: My Watchful Eyes see you up there! Come down and fight!
entries.zh: 我的监视之眼看见你在上面了！给我下来！
游荡之魂？可怜的家伙。

entries.en: A Wandering Soul? Don't you guys have a Healer?
entries.zh: 游荡之魂？你们不是有治疗师吗？

entries.en: Oops. Wasn't meant to revive that one.
entries.zh: 哎呀，那个不是我想复活的。

entries.en: This one looks like a fighter.
entries.zh: 这家伙看着挺能打。
再活一次吧！
唔……就这个吧！

entries.en: Welcome back to the realm of the living, %1$s
entries.zh: 欢迎回到阳间的世界，%1$s

entries.en: So your name is Sadan, I see...
entries.zh: 原来你叫萨丹啊……
啊，你们终于来了。

entries.en: I have watching you closely since we last met.
entries.zh: 上次见面之后，我一直盯着你们看。

entries.en: I don't know if you are ready for what's behind this door.
entries.zh: 我不知道你们准备好面对这扇门后的东西没有。

entries.en: So I will decide if you are strong enough.
entries.zh: 所以我来看看你们够不够强。
啊，我们又见面了……

entries.en: I have done some experiments to develop new abilities for my Skulls.
entries.zh: 我做了些实验，给我的头颅添了几手新本事。

entries.en: Let's see how you handle this!
entries.zh: 看看你们怎么应付这一手！

entries.en: So you made it this far... interesting.
entries.zh: 你们竟然走到了这里……有意思。

entries.en: You are much stronger than I was expecting.
entries.zh: 你们比我想的强多了。

entries.en: Not to worry, I recently added a very fine piece to my collection!
entries.zh: 不过别担心，我最近刚给收藏添了件好货！

entries.en: You've managed to scratch and claw your way here, eh?
entries.zh: 你们总算连滚带爬地摸到这儿了，是吧？

entries.en: Don't even think about trying to outwit me this time!
entries.zh: 这次别想再耍小聪明骗过我！

entries.en: My Watchful Eyes are keeping their...eyes...on you!
entries.zh: 我的监视之眼，正拿它们的……眼睛……盯着你们！

entries.en: I'm starting to get tired of seeing you around here...
entries.zh: 在这儿老碰见你们，我有点烦了……

entries.en: This time I've imbued my minions with special properties!
entries.zh: 这次我给手下加了点特别的东西！

entries.en: These will be quick and agile!
entries.zh: 这几个又快又灵活！

entries.en: These will be adorned in the finest gold!
entries.zh: 这几个身上镶着最好的黄金！

entries.en: These will be healthier than any summon I've ever created!
entries.zh: 这几个的生命值会比我造过的任何召唤物都高！

entries.en: These will be kinda hard to see ngl.
entries.zh: 说实话，这几个会有点难发现。

entries.en: These will strike thunder from the sky!
entries.zh: 这几个会从天上劈雷下来！

entries.en: These will be stubborn and unwilling to change!
entries.zh: 这几个死活不肯变，那就这样吧！
哦……你好？

entries.en: You've arrived too early, I haven't even set up..
entries.zh: 你们来得太早了，我这儿还没布置好呢……
行吧……那就打吧，随便了。

entries.en: Things feel a little more roomy now, eh?
entries.zh: 现在感觉宽敞多了，对吧？

entries.en: I've knocked down those pillars to go for a more...open concept.
entries.zh: 我把那些柱子拆了，想弄得更……开阔一点。

entries.en: Plus I needed to give my new friends some space to roam...
entries.zh: 而且我得给新朋友们留点四处活动的空间……

entries.en: I have been watching you closely since we last met.
entries.zh: 上次见面之后，我一直盯着你们看。

entries.en: We are always watching. Come down from there!
entries.zh: 我们一直看着呢。给我下来！
我的监视之眼什么都看得见！

entries.en: Congratulations, you made it through the Entrance.
entries.zh: 恭喜，你们闯过了入口层。

entries.en: I have been watching you closely...
entries.zh: 我一直盯着你们看……

entries.en: Unfortunately, for now, this is the end of the road.
entries.zh: 很遗憾，你们暂时只能走到这儿了。

entries.en: I sense many dead spirits eager to return to the living..
entries.zh: 我感觉到有不少亡魂急着还阳……

entries.en: I will bring some of them back. Watch this.
entries.zh: 我这就带回来几个。看好了。

entries.en: Welcome back to the realm of the living %1$s.
entries.zh: 欢迎回来，重返生者的世界吧，%1$s。
哇，一个游荡之魂。有意思。

entries.en: Awakening me from my slumber, what a strange choice.
entries.zh: 把我从沉睡里叫醒……真是个奇怪的选择。

entries.en: I have nothing left to fight for, I finally had peace.
entries.zh: 我已经没什么好争的了，好不容易才落得清静。
又是你们……?

entries.en: I no longer wish to fight, but I know that will not stop you.
entries.zh: 我已经不想再打了，可我知道这拦不住你们。

entries.en: We will decide it all, here, now.
entries.zh: 那就在这里，就现在，把一切了结吧。

entries.en: My enemies are now my strongest allies!
entries.zh: 从前的敌人，现在成了我最强的盟友！

entries.en: Does that mean Necron is no more? I have been a mediocre master.
entries.zh: 这么说，耐克伦已经不在了？看来我算不上一个称职的主人。

entries.en: Storm was my favorite sparring partner, you must have enjoyed fighting him!
entries.zh: 斯托姆是我最喜欢的陪练。跟他打，你们一定很过瘾吧！

entries.en: This world isn't worth fighting for, how can you be so determined?
entries.zh: 这世界根本不值得你们拼命，你们怎么就这么较真？

entries.en: Mortals fighting against supreme beings, what a moving spectacle.
entries.zh: 凡人跟高高在上的存在动手，这场面倒是挺动人。

entries.en: I enjoy your passion, if the circumstances had been different, we could have been friends.
entries.zh: 我喜欢你们这股劲头。要是换个情形，我们本来是能做朋友的。

entries.en: I have worked on this spell for centuries.
entries.zh: 这道法术，我钻研了数百年。

entries.en: Some of you do have some talent, I can feel it, the other ones not so much.
entries.zh: 我感觉得出来，你们里面有几个确实有天赋——剩下那些就算了。
白费力气。

entries.en: Did you forget? I am invincible!
entries.zh: 忘了吗？我可是打不倒的！

entries.en: You don't have your sword this time!
entries.zh: 这次你们手上可没有那把剑！
徒劳。

entries.en: You just made a terrible mistake!
entries.zh: 你们犯了个致命的错误！
这点本事，还不够看。
人类，你们的身手退步了。
哦，这一下可真疼！
我的灵魂丢一个也无所谓。
这种东西我多的是。

entries.en: Thank you for coming all the way here.
entries.zh: 难为你们大老远跑这一趟。

entries.en: Now I will truly have peace.
entries.zh: 这下我总算能真正安息了。

entries.en: Let's enjoy your final moments in silence.
entries.zh: 我们就安安静静地享受你们最后这点时间吧。

entries.en: Incredible. You did what I couldn't do myself.
entries.zh: 太不可思议了。你们完成了连我也做不到的事。

entries.en: In a way I should thank you, I lost all hopes centuries ago that it would ever end.
entries.zh: 说起来我还得谢谢你们。几百年前我就不指望这一切会有个头了。

entries.en: I hope you'll become the Heroes I could never be.
entries.zh: 希望你们能成为我这辈子没能成为的那种英雄。

entries.en: So long champions of this mad world!
entries.zh: 永别了，这疯狂世界的勇士们！

entries.en: My strengths are depleting, this... this is it...
entries.zh: 我的力量正在消散……就……到这里了……

entries.en: Welcome Adventurers! I am Thorn, the Spirit! And host of the Vegan Trials!
entries.zh: 欢迎，冒险者们！我是灵体索恩！也是素食试炼的主持人！

entries.en: My Arena is the most entertaining place in all the Catacombs!
entries.zh: 我的竞技场是整个地下墓穴中最有趣的地方！
今天你们就是我们的节目。

entries.en: Dance! Dance with my Spirit animals! And may you perish in a delightful way!
entries.zh: 跳吧！跟我的灵魂动物一起跳！也祝你们死得漂亮！

entries.en: Tickle tickle, you are in a pickle!
entries.zh: 挠痒挠痒，你们要遭殃！

entries.en: I'm already dead adventurer! Earthly weapons won't affect me!
entries.zh: 我早就已经死了，小人类！阳间的武器伤不到我！

entries.en: Don't waste your energy on me, humans - I am Thorn the Spirit!
entries.zh: 别在我身上浪费力气了，小人类——我是灵体索恩！

entries.en: I love your fighting spirit, but I am immune to your tricks!
entries.zh: 我喜欢你们的斗志，但你们的把戏对我没用！

entries.en: Trying to damage me like that...desperate...
entries.zh: 就想这么伤到我……真是病急乱投医……
我……好晕……
好痛……多么细腻的感觉……
转了一圈又一圈，又添一道伤口。
我的能量……正在流失……

entries.en: Go my Spirits, go! Unsullied souls!
entries.zh: 去吧，我的灵体们！纯洁的灵魂！

entries.en: More Spirits! Born of feathers and light!
entries.zh: 再来些灵体！要用羽毛和光造出来的！

entries.en: Dance for me humans! Your Art will be remembered!
entries.zh: 为我跳舞吧，小人类！你们这份艺术，我会记住的！

entries.en: Can you hear the crowd?! The sound of death!
entries.zh: 听见观众的声音了吗？! 那是死亡之声！

entries.en: Jump and laugh, scream and cry! Be passionate!
entries.zh: 跳跃欢笑，尖叫哭泣！尽情投入吧！
演得真精彩，小人类，漂亮极了。

entries.en: How one dies shows how one lived. And it was your masterpiece.
entries.zh: 一个人怎么死，就看得出他怎么活。而这一场，就是你们的代表作。

entries.en: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A rabbit!
entries.zh: 你们会变成什么灵体呢？有了！一只兔子！

entries.en: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A chihuahua!
entries.zh: 你们会变成什么灵体呢？有了！一只吉娃娃！

entries.en: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A sheep!
entries.zh: 你们会变成什么灵体呢？有了！一只羊！

entries.en: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A chicken!
entries.zh: 你们会变成什么灵体呢？有了！一只鸡！

entries.en: This is it... where shall I go now?
entries.zh: 看来得接受现实了……那我现在该去哪里？

entries.en: All those memories will be lost in time, like tears in rain...
entries.zh: 这一切记忆都将消逝在时光中，一如雨中的泪水……
恭喜你们，小人类，你们通关了。

entries.en: Alright here we go Thorn! Drop some spirits on these fools!
entries.zh: 好了索恩，上吧！放几只灵体收拾这帮蠢货！
为邦佐报仇！ #铭记邦佐

entries.en: Let's go Thorn! They don't stand a chance!
entries.zh: 索恩，加油！他们没戏！

entries.en: Thorn is preparing his attacks! What an amazing spirit!
entries.zh: 索恩正在准备攻击！多么惊人的灵体！

entries.en: Vegans! Yeahhh!!! Now let's exploit some animals for personal gain! Woo woo!
entries.zh: 素食主义者！好耶！!! 接下来就该压榨动物给自己捞好处了！喔喔喔！

entries.en: Here we go Thorn! Take it to 'em!
entries.zh: 索恩，上吧！收拾他们！
没错，索恩，让他们瞧瞧！
把他们变成灵体！
索恩，上啊！冲——!!!
素食万岁！
来几只鸡吧！!!

entries.en: Dolphins are my spirit animal. Too bad this is 1.8.
entries.zh: 海豚是我的本命。可惜这是 1.8。
干掉%1$s!
耶！!!! 你干掉他们了！

entries.en: Another one bites the dust!! You the best Thorn!
entries.zh: 又一个倒下了！! 索恩，你是最棒的！
哇！ %1$s 好菜！
%1$s扛不住索恩的猛攻！太惨了！!
继续打，索恩！给他们瞧瞧！!
外挂！!! 我们要看回放！!

entries.en: That wasn't fair!! He can't fight back!!
entries.zh: 这不公平！! 他根本还不了手！!
这肯定开了！

entries.en: I see they've figured out how to damage Thorn. Finally.
entries.zh: 看来他们终于弄明白怎么伤到索恩了。

entries.en: They didn't even pickup the Spirit Bow! Whoopsies!
entries.zh: 他们连灵魂长弓都没捡！逆天！

entries.en: They're not even trying to win!
entries.zh: 他们根本没想赢！

entries.en: LOL! Pickup the Spirit Bow next time you fools!
entries.zh: 笑死！下次记得捡灵魂长弓，你们这些蠢货！

entries.en: Are they blind?! The Spirit Bow just sat there untouched!
entries.zh: 他们是瞎了吗？! 灵魂长弓就在那里，完全没人拿！

entries.en: %1$s missed the shot! No way!! Hahaha
entries.zh: %1$s射偏了！不会吧！! 哈哈哈
天啊，%1$s真的不会瞄准！!

entries.en: Alright those humans are a joke, missing easy shots like that...
entries.zh: 得了吧，那几个小人类就是个笑话，这么简单都能射偏……
好耶！!! 继续躲开他们，索恩！
他们输啦！! 好耶！
可悲的表演。我太喜欢了！!

entries.en: Come back any time! Just kidding, you CAN'T!!
entries.zh: 随时再来！开玩笑的，你们来不了了！!
索恩火力全开——
F 刷起来！
什么？他们怎么赢的？?
RNM，退钱！!

entries.en: Why do the good guys always win!!
entries.zh: 为什么好人总能赢！!
这游戏也太不平衡了！!!

entries.en: I hope you get terrible loot! Booooo!!
entries.zh: 希望你们爆的东西全是垃圾！咦——!!

entries.en: You won't beat the next floor anyways!!
entries.zh: 反正你们也打不过下一层！!

entries.en: Where is the arbiter? That wasn't right...
entries.zh: 裁判在哪儿？这不对劲啊……

entries.en: Make it a best of 3, best of 3!!!!
entries.zh: 改成三局两胜！三局两胜！!!!
索恩卡了！不公平！
刚才出 BUG 了……重来！!!

entries.en: There is no justice in this world...
entries.zh: 这个世界没有正义……
铭记邦佐！ #永不遗忘

entries.en: My disappointment is immeasurable and my day is ruined.
entries.zh: 我失望透顶，这一天算是毁了。

entries.en: I shouldn't have put so many Coins on this match..
entries.zh: 我不该在这场比赛押这么多硬币……

entries.en: Where is watchdog when we need it??
entries.zh: Watchdog 反作弊去哪儿了？?
我现在就举报他们开挂！
太不讲武德了……

entries.en: Those people are so rude. I feel sorry for Thorn.
entries.zh: 那些人太粗鲁了。我真替索恩难过。

entries.en: Killing a spirit...what kind of man does that? ... No man at all.
entries.zh: 杀死一个灵体……什么人会这么做？ ……这根本不是人。

entries.en: Nooo! You can't just beat Thorn!
entries.zh: 不——! 你们不能就这么把索恩打了！

entries.en: Pack it up boys...nothing to see here...
entries.zh: 收拾东西走吧，伙计们……没什么可看的了……
又是 2020 年那种灾难。

entries.en: This is it...where shall I go now?
entries.zh: 就到这里了……接下来我该去哪儿呢？

entries.en: You want to know the secret of my potions?
entries.zh: 想知道我这些药水的秘密吗？

entries.en: It's quite simple - the brew requires Revive Stones!
entries.zh: 其实很简单，酿药需要复活石！

entries.en: That's why they can only be made around here.
entries.zh: 所以这些药水只能在这里酿。

entries.en: Give me a couple of those and I'll give you my Abiphone contact.
entries.zh: 给我两块，我就把阿比手机联系方式给你。
啊，正是我需要的！

entries.en: They are both telling the truth, the reward is in %1$s's chest!
entries.zh: 他们俩说的都是真话，奖励在%1$s的箱子里！

entries.en: The reward isn't in any of our chests.
entries.zh: 奖励不在我们任何一个人的箱子里。

entries.en: Do you really have what it takes to fight Kuudra?
entries.zh: 你真有那个本事去打库德拉吗？

entries.en: Because if you don't...I have exactly what you need!
entries.zh: 如果没有……我这里正好有你需要的东西！

entries.en: I'm the Crimson Essence guy, but you can call me Vulcan.
entries.zh: 我是负责绯红精粹的人，不过你可以叫我伏尔甘。

entries.en: ✆ Nice to see you're still alive and kicking.
entries.zh: ✆ 看你还活蹦乱跳的，挺好。
✆ 嗯，想要我的阿比手机联系方式？

entries.en: ✆ I suppose I could do that.
entries.zh: ✆ 我想可以。

entries.en: ✆ Come and see me after completing the INFERNAL tier of Kuudra for the first time, then we can talk.
entries.zh: ✆ 首次通关库德拉炼狱难度后再来找我，到时我们再谈。

entries.en: ✆ Looks like you've completed the INFERNAL tier of Kuudra, so I'll consider you worthy.
entries.zh: ✆ 看来你已经通关了库德拉炼狱难度，我认可你的资格。

entries.en: If you didn't find the Wither Key yet, it probably means you need to go back!
entries.zh: 还没找到凋灵钥匙？那你大概得回头找找了！

entries.en: You need a Wither Key to open this door!
entries.zh: 得有凋灵钥匙才能打开这扇门！

entries.en: That's a door, and I keep the door...there.
entries.zh: 那是扇门，而我守着那扇门……就在那儿。

entries.en: Mi Wizard, mi lost mi crystal ball
entries.zh: 我是个巫师，我的水晶球丢了。

entries.en: If you find mi crystal, can you give it back to me lady
entries.zh: 姑娘，你要是找到了，能把它还给我吗？

entries.en: Oh my lovely crystal ball, mi so happy
entries.zh: 噢，我可爱的水晶球，太好了，太好了。

entries.en: You deserve a reward young gobelin
entries.zh: 小哥布林，你该得到些奖励。

entries.en: Granted your team a Blessing of Wisdom I
entries.zh: 已为你的队伍赐予智慧祝福 I
就是个老巫师，你懂的。

entries.en: Mi don't know what I'd do with no crystal ball
entries.zh: 没了水晶球，我可不知道该怎么办。

entries.en: Are you really a lady? You ain't trying to play tricks with mi I hope.
entries.zh: 你真是位姑娘？可别耍我这个老头子啊。

entries.en: You may want to store your Coins in a safe place while you are off adventuring.
entries.zh: 外出冒险时，不妨把硬币存放在安全的地方。

entries.en: Storing them in your Bank keeps them safe and allows you to earn interest at the start of every season!
entries.zh: 把它们存入银行既能保障安全，还能在每个季节开始时获得利息！

entries.en: Wondering where to store your cakes? You can buy a New Year Cake Bag from me. Click me again to open my shop!
entries.zh: 愁蛋糕没地方放？来我这儿买个新年蛋糕袋吧。再点我一下就能打开商店！

entries.en: At the end of each year I bake cakes for everyone in town to celebrate the year.
entries.zh: 每年年末，我都会给镇上的每个人烤蛋糕，庆祝新年。

entries.en: I made one especially for you, here you go.
entries.zh: 我特地给你做了一块，拿去吧。
欢迎，欢迎，欢迎！

entries.en: Come, see what I have on offer for you today.
entries.zh: 来，看看我今天有什么好货。

entries.en: Special items for a special currency just for you!
entries.zh: 专为你准备的特别商品，用特别的货币就能换到！

entries.en: You can get this North Star currency by giving gifts to others!
entries.zh: 给别人送礼，就能拿到北极星这种货币！
啊，想要我的阿比手机联系方式？

entries.en: You know, I haven't really felt like making friends since I lost my red hoodie.
entries.zh: 说真的，自从弄丢了那件红色连帽衫，我就一直没心思交朋友。

entries.en: That thing was like a part of me!
entries.zh: 它简直就是我的一部分啊！

entries.en: Until I find it, socializing just won't feel the same.
entries.zh: 在找回它之前，跟人来往总觉得少了点什么。

entries.en: I'm sorry, I just don't feel like giving my contact this time...
entries.zh: 抱歉，我现在实在没心思给人留联系方式...
我的红色连帽衫！

entries.en: I can't believe it! This means the world to me!
entries.zh: 真不敢相信！这对我来说太重要了！
日子一下子又有盼头了。

entries.en: Hey, let's swap contacts! I think this is the beginning of a great friendship.
entries.zh: 来，交换一下联系方式吧！我觉得咱们会成为好朋友的。

entries.en: Thanks for reuniting me with my hoodie, %1$s!
entries.zh: %1$s，谢谢你帮我找回了 hoodie!
我会一直感激你的！

entries.en: I accept Candy in exchange for exclusively spooky items!
entries.zh: 拿糖果来，我给你换独家的惊魂物品！

entries.en: Each Spooky Festival, the top Candy-collecting players can earn even spookier rewards!
entries.zh: 每届惊魂节，糖果收得最多的玩家还能拿到更惊悚的奖励！

entries.en: Click me again to open my shop.
entries.zh: 再点我一下，打开我的商店。

entries.en: ✆ You want to be able to call me anytime?
entries.zh: ✆ 你想随时都能给我打电话？

entries.en: ✆ Well that's not possible, I'm only available at night.
entries.zh: ✆ 那可不行，我只在晚上出没。

entries.en: ✆ If you give me 64 Purple Candy and 6 Ectoplasm, I might give you my contact.
entries.zh: ✆ 给我 64 个紫色糖果和 6 个灵质，我也许会把联系方式给你。

entries.en: ✆ Mhm... Your face just isn't very scary...
entries.zh: ✆ 嗯……你这张脸实在不怎么吓人……

entries.en: ✆ But it's not your fault I suppose, here take my contact.
entries.zh: ✆ 不过这也怪不得你，拿去吧，我的联系方式。

entries.en: ✆ Listen buddy it's not because I gave you my contact that it gives you the right to wake me up in the middle of the day.
entries.zh: ✆ 听着伙计，我把联系方式给了你，不代表你就能大白天把我吵醒。

entries.en: ✆ Call me back tonight or I'm blocking you.
entries.zh: ✆ 今晚再打，不然我拉黑你。
[交出物品]
欢迎来到杰瑞的工坊。

entries.en: Here the Jerrys make and deliver Gifts to all of SkyBlock!
entries.zh: 杰瑞们在这里制作礼物并送往整个空岛！

entries.en: When its time to deliver Gifts, Mount Jerry always erupts and the village is ravaged by heat-based enemies!
entries.zh: 每到派送礼物的时候，杰瑞山总会喷发，那些浑身冒火的敌人就会来蹂躏村庄！

entries.en: It is up to you, %1$s, to help save the day. Take this Snow Cannon to aid you in your defense against the Magma Grinches.
entries.zh: 这次就靠你了，%1$s! 拿上这门雪炮，帮我们挡住岩浆格林奇吧。

entries.en: It holds and fires Snowballs, which are the best way to extinguish the enemy!
entries.zh: 它能装填并发射雪球，用来给这些敌人降降温再合适不过了！

entries.en: I can refill it at any time for a modest price. Also feel free to check out my shop upstairs!
entries.zh: 花上一点钱，我随时都能帮你补满弹药。也欢迎到我楼上的商店看看！

entries.en: Click me with a Snow Cannon, Snow Blaster, or Frosty the Howitzer to refill it!
entries.zh: 拿着雪炮、雪爆枪或冰霜榴弹炮点击我，就能补充弹药！

entries.en: I noticed you don't have a Snow Cannon, would you like to buy another?
entries.zh: 你身上好像没有雪炮，要再买一门吗？
购买雪炮 (点击)
哇，我可太喜欢雪了。

entries.en: I love it so much that I bought an industrial strength snow machine so that I can have snow on demand!
entries.zh: 我喜欢雪喜欢到买了台工业级造雪机，这样想看雪就有雪！

entries.en: What are you talking to me for? The village needs your help!
entries.zh: 还跟我聊什么呢？村子正等着你帮忙！

entries.en: I finally got my snow machine to work!
entries.zh: 我的造雪机终于能用了！

entries.en: This snow should put a damper on those Magma Cubes! You can thank me later!
entries.zh: 这场雪够那些岩浆怪喝一壶了！回头再谢我吧！
是我，加里。
噢，你好呀！

entries.en: You look like someone who appreciates the finer points of gifting, am I right?
entries.zh: 看你的样子，一定很懂送礼的乐趣吧？
哎呀，瞧我这礼数！

entries.en: I'm Generow, the coolest gift-loving penguin you'll ever meet!
entries.zh: 我叫杰纳罗，你肯定没见过比我更酷、更爱礼物的企鹅！

entries.en: I live for two things: receiving gifts and gifting others.
entries.zh: 我这辈子就爱两件事: 收礼物，还有送礼物。

entries.en: But I must admit, the latter warms my feathers even more!
entries.zh: 不过说真的，送礼物更让我暖到羽毛尖儿！

entries.en: Well, you see, this December is special.
entries.zh: 你看，今年十二月可不一般。

entries.en: I've come to reward those who share the joy of gifting!
entries.zh: 我专程来奖励那些把送礼的快乐分享出去的人！

entries.en: Ah, eager to know, are we?
entries.zh: 嘿，已经迫不及待想知道了吧？

entries.en: The more players you gift, the better your reward.
entries.zh: 你给越多人送礼，奖励就越好。

entries.en: It's all about spreading the cheer, you see.
entries.zh: 说到底，就是要让大家都开开心心嘛。
快看看这个！
点击领取你的奖励吧！

entries.en: Gift enough different players, and you'll earn yourself something extraordinary!
entries.zh: 给足够多位不同的玩家送礼，就能拿到特别的好东西！
请选择: [你是谁？]

entries.en: Select an option: [What are you doing here?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [你在这里做什么？]

entries.en: Select an option: [Tell me more about these rewards.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [跟我讲讲这些奖励吧。]

咯咯咯哒。
咯咯咯哒哒。
咯咯哒！

entries.en: Coot Coot Cluck, Puk Puk Pukaaak!
entries.zh: 咕咕咯，咯咯咯哒！
