entries.zh: 咯咯哒咯咯检查点 %1$s 咯咯 < %2$s 秒？

entries.en: Cluck cluck! Bacawk! Red Gift bakok.
entries.zh: 咯咯！咯咯哒！红色礼物咯。

entries.en: Cluck cluck! Bacawk! Gift Compass bakok.
entries.zh: 咯咯！咯咯哒！礼物罗盘咯。

entries.en: Cluck cluck! Bacawk! Frozen Chicken bakok.
entries.zh: 咯咯！咯咯哒！冰冻小鸡咯。

entries.en: Cluck cluck! Bacawk! Jingle Bells bakok.
entries.zh: 咯咯！咯咯哒！铃儿响叮当咯。
哟，朋友！
听好了，玩法是这样的。

entries.en: Fish up those fancy Bouncy Beach Balls from Treasure, and you'll get to play a minigame that's as fun as bouncing on your nose!
entries.zh: 从宝藏里钓出那些花哨的 Bouncy Beach Balls,就能玩个小游戏，跟用鼻子顶球一样好玩！

entries.en: Rack up some Fishy Treats, then swing by here and treat yourself to something shiny.
entries.zh: 攒点鱼味零食，再来我这儿换点亮闪闪的好东西，犒劳一下自己。
明白了吧？

entries.en: Now, get out there and make a splash!
entries.zh: 好啦，去水边大显身手吧！
又到杰瑞季了，%1$s!

entries.en: You may have noticed some Gifts laying around.
entries.zh: 你应该已经发现周围散落着一些礼物了吧。

entries.en: Each SkyBlock year, I place them throughout the village to spread joy and good tidings.
entries.zh: 每个空岛年，我都会把礼物放在村子各处，给大家送去欢乐和祝福。

entries.en: Find them all and come back to me!
entries.zh: 把礼物找齐，再回来找我吧！

entries.en: Find all of the Gifts around the village and come back to me!
entries.zh: 把村子里的礼物都找齐，再回来找我吧！

entries.en: I see you've found some Gifts, but there are still many more in the village. Find the rest and come back for a reward!
entries.zh: 看来你已经找到一些礼物了，不过村子里还藏着不少呢。把剩下的找齐，再来领奖吧！

entries.en: You're getting there, %1$s! Find the rest of the Gifts and come back for a reward!
entries.zh: 越来越接近了，%1$s! 把剩下的礼物找齐，再来领奖吧！

entries.en: You're so close! Find %1$s more Gifts and come back to me!
entries.zh: 就差一点啦！再找 %1$s 份礼物，就回来找我吧！

entries.en: You're so close! Find the last Gift and come back for a reward!
entries.zh: 就差一点啦！找到最后一份礼物，再来领奖吧！

entries.en: You found all of the Gifts!
entries.zh: 礼物全都让你找齐啦！

entries.en: Take this Green Gift! You'll hopefully find something nicer than what was in those White Gifts!
entries.zh: 拿好这份绿色礼物！希望你能开出比那些白色礼物更好的东西！

entries.en: If you haven't already, be sure to give your other Gifts away to others. Giving Gifts benefits both you and the receiver!
entries.zh: 要是还没送出去，记得把其他礼物分给大家。送礼物时，你和收礼的人都能有收获！

entries.en: ✆ Of course I can add you as a contact!
entries.zh: ✆ 当然可以把你加进联系人啦！

entries.en: ✆ I have %1$s contacts on my Abiphone.
entries.zh: ✆ 我有 %1$s 位联系人，都在我的阿比手机里。
✆ 我的阿比手机可大了！

entries.en: ✆ If you want my contact, all you have to do is repeat this phrase exactly...
entries.zh: ✆ 想加我的联系方式，只要把下面这句话原样复述一遍……
✆ 太棒啦！
✆ 我真喜欢你！

entries.en: ✆ Call me every year and I'll hand you a White Gift!
entries.zh: ✆ 每年给我打个电话，我就送你一份白色礼物！

entries.en: ✆ I sent a gift to your inventory! With love, St. Jerry.
entries.zh: ✆ 礼物已经送进你的物品栏啦！送上满满的祝福，圣杰瑞。

entries.en: ✆ But hey, merry season of the Jerry to you anyway!
entries.zh: ✆ 不过嘛，还是祝你杰瑞季快乐！
✆ 明年再给我打电话吧！

entries.en: Did you know you can access your Bank from Jerry's Workshop? Check out the Bank in the center of the village!
entries.zh: 你知道吗？在杰瑞的工坊也能使用银行。去村子中央的银行看看吧！

entries.en: Click someone with a Gift to give both you and them a Gift!
entries.zh: 拿着礼物点击别人，你和对方就都能收到礼物啦！

entries.en: Come back next SkyBlock year to find more Gifts!
entries.zh: 下个空岛年再来找更多礼物吧！

entries.en: Ice fishing is a great way to relax during the winter!
entries.zh: 冰钓可是冬天放松的好法子！

entries.en: There are all sorts of icy creatures within the depths of Jerry Pond!
entries.zh: 杰瑞池塘深处藏着各种冰雪生物！

entries.en: You can trade Gifts directly with others or randomly gift players on the island!
entries.zh: 你可以直接和别人交易礼物，也可以在岛上随意找人送礼物！

entries.en: Gifting others benefits both you and the other person!
entries.zh: 把礼物送给别人，你和对方都能有收获！

entries.en: Ahoy, %1$s! Welcome to the Jerry Pond!
entries.zh: 嘿哟，%1$s! 欢迎来到杰瑞池塘！

entries.en: You may have noticed that this pond is full of unique creatures and treasures!
entries.zh: 你大概也发现了，这片池塘里全是稀奇的生物和宝贝！

entries.en: I'm looking for Ice Hunks and Blue Ice Hunks!
entries.zh: 我在收冰块碎片和蓝冰碎片！

entries.en: You can find these by ice fishing in the pond - break the ice and cast your rod!
entries.zh: 在池塘里冰钓就能钓到——砸开冰面，甩竿！

entries.en: Bring enough hunks back to me and I will reforge your fishing rod with modifiers exclusive to me - Terry!
entries.zh: 攒够了拿来给我，我就用只有我特里才有的词条给你重铸鱼竿！

entries.en: ✆ If you want my Abiphone Contact, you're gonna have to bring me the goods.
entries.zh: ✆ 想要我的阿比手机联系方式，得先把货带来。

entries.en: ✆ Ice Hunks and Blue Ice Hunks won't cut it anymore, unfortunately.
entries.zh: ✆ 可惜，冰块碎片和蓝冰碎片已经不够看了。

entries.en: %1$s will leave your Garden and maybe come back later.
entries.zh: %1$s将离开你的花园，也许之后还会再来。
我要退款！

entries.en: I heard this guy sells bad crops
entries.zh: 听说这家卖的作物不怎么样。

entries.en: I should get my order filled first
entries.zh: 应该先处理我的订单。

entries.en: But I've been waiting for longer
entries.zh: 可我都等得更久了。

entries.en: I better not be late for lunch
entries.zh: 可别耽误我吃午饭。
这也太慢了吧。
我都等了好——几个小时了。

entries.en: When's the next update coming out?
entries.zh: 下次更新到底什么时候来啊？
这谷仓真不错！
好累啊。
这服务也太差了！
等得我都快睡着了。

entries.en: I hope nobody calls me while I'm waiting
entries.zh: 希望排队的时候别有人给我打电话。
好累啊。

entries.en: When’s the next update coming out?
entries.zh: 下次更新到底什么时候来啊？
为了排这个队，我连早饭都没吃。
有人插队！
外面太热了。
那个人好臭。
我的脚好疼……
等得我都快睡着了。
喂，别挤！
那人的阿比手机太吵了。

entries.en: I’m supposed to be home by now
entries.zh: 我这时候本该到家了。
外面太冷了。
外面天都黑了。
几点了？

entries.en: But I’ve been waiting here longer
entries.zh: 可我已经在这儿等得更久了。
来玩井字棋吧！
我赢了！
你耍赖！
听说了，还挺让人不安的。
咚咚咚。
谁呀？
干啥鸭。
什么是“干啥鸭”？

entries.en: Nothing much, what’s up with you?
entries.zh: 没干啥，你呢？

entries.en: I miscalculated, I need more for my research.
entries.zh: 我算错了，研究还需要更多材料。

entries.en: As promised, here is your reward.
entries.zh: 如约，这是你的报酬。

entries.en: You have single-handedly slowed down my research by several years.
entries.zh: 你一个人就让我的研究至少拖慢了好几年。

entries.en: Been running low on my brewing supplies, Nether Warts are quite hard to come by these days.
entries.zh: 我的酿造材料快见底了，最近下界疣可不好找。

entries.en: Project Centurion can finally begin. You've been quite the help.
entries.zh: 百夫长计划终于能开始了。你可帮了大忙。

entries.en: Unfortunate, I'll see if I can find some Nether Warts from someone else.
entries.zh: 真遗憾，我再去找别人弄些下界疣吧。

entries.en: I've seen it in my flames, you are destined for great things.
entries.zh: 我在火焰中看到了，你注定会成就大事。

entries.en: For now, you shouldn't let it get to your head.
entries.zh: 不过现在，可别因此冲昏头脑。

entries.en: An Abiphone? What kind of witchcraft is that?
entries.zh: 阿比手机？这又是什么巫术？

entries.en: Turns out I own one too. I never knew what it was called.
entries.zh: 原来我也有一个，只是一直不知道它叫什么。

entries.en: So, you want me to add you?
entries.zh: 所以，你想让我加你？

entries.en: Get me a stack of Mutant Nether Wart.
entries.zh: 给我弄一组变异下界疣来。

entries.en: You have less warts than I have on my face!
entries.zh: 你带来的疣还没我脸上的多！

entries.en: I was right, you are indeed destined for great things.
entries.zh: 果然没看错，你确实注定会成就大事。

entries.en: There is a darkness in you, %1$s.
entries.zh: 你心里藏着一片黑暗，%1$s.
[展示阿比手机]

entries.en: Someone just bought up my entire stock of Nether Wart! Could you help me replenish my supply?
entries.zh: 有人刚把我的下界疣库存全买光了！能帮我补点货吗？

entries.en: Thanks. Hopefully I won't run out again.
entries.zh: 谢了。希望这次不会又卖断货。

entries.en: Looks like I'll have to find something else to sell.
entries.zh: 看来我得找点别的东西卖了。

entries.en: Did you know that SkyBlock has been running for %1$s in-game months already? Time flies.
entries.zh: 你知道空岛已经运行了 %1$s 个游戏内月份吗？时间过得真快。

entries.en: I guess I'll come back in a bit.
entries.zh: 那我过会儿再来。
嘿嘿嘿！

entries.en: I'll trade your Jacob's Tickets for useful items!
entries.zh: 拿你的雅各布的票券来，我给你换实用的好东西！

entries.en: I'll trade your Jacob's Tickets for farming tools!
entries.zh: 拿你的雅各布的票券来，我给你换农具！
✆ 嗨，亲爱的！

entries.en: ✆ I only share my contact with those who are on Jacob's contact list.
entries.zh: ✆ 我只把联系方式给雅各布通讯录里的人。

entries.en: ✆ Oh and also, you need to have earned a GOLD medal in his contest if you want to be on MY list!
entries.zh: ✆ 哦对了，想进我的通讯录，你还得在他的竞赛里拿过金牌才行！
✆ 太好了！

entries.en: ✆ If I need any farming done back home, I'll be sure to call ya!
entries.zh: ✆ 家里要是有农活要干，我一定打给你！

entries.en: Hey hey hey again! I'll trade you some copper for some carrots!
entries.zh: 嘿嘿嘿，又见面啦！给我些胡萝卜，我拿铜跟你换！
耶，太感谢你啦！
哦，可恶 :(

entries.en: My wheat minion has been slacking recently, I am thinking about giving it an upgrade. He hasn't produced any wheat in years! Every time I check on him, he's empty.
entries.zh: 我的小麦小人最近偷懒，我正考虑给他升级。他都好几年没产出过小麦了！每次我去看，他都是空的。

entries.en: Holy Macaroni! That should boost my minion to at least Tier 5! Thank you a lot!
entries.zh: 我的天哪！这些应该能把我的小人至少升到 5 级！太感谢了！

entries.en: I guess I'll have to keep going like this.
entries.zh: 看来我只能继续这样熬下去了。

entries.en: My Wheat Minions produce the finest flour around, but they can't keep up with today's demand...
entries.zh: 我的小麦小人产的是附近最好的面粉，可赶不上如今的需求……

entries.en: That should do it! Thanks for your help, %1$s.
entries.zh: 这些应该够了！谢谢你的帮忙，%1$s。

entries.en: "Use better minion fuel"? But... what could possibly be better than Enchanted Bread?.
entries.zh: “用更好的小人燃料”？可是……还有什么能比附魔面包更好？.

entries.en: I want to make some new brews, do you think you can give me some ingredients to work with?
entries.zh: 我想调几种新酒，你能给我些材料让我试试吗？

entries.en: Many Thanks! I'll be sure to let you have the first taste as soon as it's done... at a discounted price of course.
entries.zh: 万分感谢！做好后我一定让你第一个尝……当然是打折价。

entries.en: Hard times we are in. Take care!
entries.zh: 日子不好过啊。保重！

entries.en: I think I am really onto something here.
entries.zh: 我觉得自己这次真的发现了什么。

entries.en: Jake says he can't walk, but I've seen him walk yesterday.
entries.zh: 杰伊克说自己不能走路，可我昨天明明看见他走路了。

entries.en: He also asks strangers to get him some animals, but these animals are nowhere to be found!
entries.zh: 他还让陌生人替他找些动物，可这些动物根本无处可寻！

entries.en: I'm getting really close to solving this mystery.
entries.zh: 我离揭开这个谜团真的很近了。

entries.en: I followed him today to where he brings all the animals he catches. He goes down some weird cave...
entries.zh: 今天我跟着他到了他安置抓来动物的地方。他进了一座奇怪的洞穴……

entries.en: Unfortunately, I couldn't follow him any further as he almost noticed me, so I backed off for now.
entries.zh: 可惜他差点发现我，我没法继续跟下去，只好暂时撤退。

entries.en: I managed to follow him into the cave today, he had a shovel with him and a note fell out of his pocket...
entries.zh: 今天我成功跟他进了洞。他带着一把铲子，还有张纸条从口袋里掉了出来……

entries.en: Not really sure what these numbers mean yet, do you have any ideas?
entries.zh: 我还不确定这些数字是什么意思，你有什么头绪吗？

entries.en: You found what? A secret lab hidden inside the cave???
entries.zh: 你找到了什么？藏在洞里的秘密实验室？??

entries.en: We need to check this out together. I'll meet you there!
entries.zh: 我们得一起去查个究竟。我会在那里等你！

entries.en: Hey, %1$s, I've been thinking a lot about that lab we found... I think there's more to it than just the plushies.
entries.zh: 嘿，%1$s，我一直在想我们找到的那间实验室……我觉得它不只是有些毛绒玩具那么简单。

entries.en: Especially with all those strange machines and experiments. I need your help again... let's meet back in the lab.
entries.zh: 尤其是那些奇怪的机器和实验。我又需要你帮忙了……我们在实验室见。

entries.en: Maybe I was wrong to trust you...
entries.zh: 也许我不该相信你……

entries.en: That Jake fellow is a bit suspicious.
entries.zh: 那个叫杰伊克的家伙有点可疑。

entries.en: He says he can't leave his house but I've seen him walking around all the time...
entries.zh: 他说他出不了门，但我明明总看见他在外面到处晃悠……

entries.en: I keep thinking about Jake's behavior...
entries.zh: 我一直在琢磨杰伊克的那些举动……

entries.en: I know I'll catch him doing something!
entries.zh: 我一定能逮到他在做什么！

entries.en: Did you figure out the meaning of the note yet?
entries.zh: 你弄明白纸条上的数字是什么意思了吗？

entries.en: Maybe you should go to the cave where I followed him. I remember there were a lot of mushrooms.
entries.zh: 也许你该去我跟踪他时去过的那个洞穴看看。我记得那里有很多蘑菇。

entries.en: Seems that I have misjudged Jake, he might not have been as suspicious as I thought.
entries.zh: 看来是我误会杰伊克了，他可能没有我想的那么可疑。

entries.en: The plushie he gave me is quite cute actually!
entries.zh: 他送我的毛绒玩具其实还挺可爱的！

entries.en: Thanks again for helping me discovering the truth about Jake.
entries.zh: 谢谢你帮我查清了杰伊克的事。

entries.en: Can't believe he had a second secret lab to hide!
entries.zh: 真没想到，他还藏着第二间秘密实验室！

entries.en: Hi! I have a quest for a member of your co-op! Tell them to come see me!
entries.zh: 嗨！我有个任务要找你的一位合作队友！让对方来见我吧！

entries.en: This place still gives me chills... but I'm sure there's more to uncover.
entries.zh: 这里还是让我发毛……但我相信，还有没查清的事。

entries.en: We know Jake's been hiding things, and I think we're getting closer to the truth.
entries.zh: 我们知道杰伊克一直有所隐瞒，我觉得我们离真相越来越近了。

entries.en: Hmm, this corner... I don't think I've noticed this before.
entries.zh: 嗯，这个角落……我之前好像没注意过。

entries.en: There's something strange about this wall. It looks out of place...
entries.zh: 这面墙有点奇怪，看着跟周围格格不入……

entries.en: What is this? A hidden passage? I knew Jake was hiding something from me, but this... this is something different.
entries.zh: 这是什么？暗道？我就知道杰伊克瞒着我什么，可这……跟我想的不一样。

entries.en: I don't know if we should trust this, but we've come this far... Let's see what's behind it.
entries.zh: 我不知道这条路安不安全，不过都走到这儿了……进去看看吧。

entries.en: See if you can pull down this lever, it's a bit stuck.
entries.zh: 试试看能不能把这根拉杆扳下来，它有点卡住了。
等等，这里有根拉杆！

entries.en: I have a business deal to propose to you. I have something that you need, and you have something that I need. Let's make a deal, shall we?
entries.zh: 我有笔生意想和你谈。我有你需要的东西，你也有我需要的东西。我们成交吧，如何？

entries.en: I knew you would come to terms. Pleasure doing business with you.
entries.zh: 我就知道你会同意。和你做生意很愉快。
谢了。

entries.en: Are you trying to scam me, bruh? Get out of here! Oh wait, this is your house...I'll get out of here!
entries.zh: 你是在坑我吗，兄弟？滚出去！哦等等，这是你家……那我滚出去！
行，拜。

entries.en: Hey, %1$s. I found this blueprint laying around in my house, just collecting dust. Thought it might catch your interest.
entries.zh: 嘿，%1$s。我在家里发现了一张一直落灰的蓝图，觉得你可能会感兴趣。

entries.en: Here you go! Hopefully, you'll make better use of it than I ever could.
entries.zh: 给你！希望你能比我更好地利用它。

entries.en: Hey, I noticed you haven't used that blueprint I gave to you. Did you lose it?
entries.zh: 嘿，我发现你还没用我给你的那张蓝图。你把它弄丢了吗？

entries.en: Luckily for you, I made a copy!
entries.zh: 算你走运，我还留了副本！

entries.en: Here you go! Don't misplace it this time. It would've done just the same in my home.
entries.zh: 给你！这次别再弄丢了。它放在我家也只会继续吃灰。

entries.en: No worries, I'll hang on to it for now. I'll come back later.
entries.zh: 没事，我暂时替你留着。我之后再来。

entries.en: Hey, how are you doing with the Greenhouse? That blueprint was complex.
entries.zh: 嘿，温室建得怎么样了？那张蓝图可够复杂的。

entries.en: Thank you! I'll be checking in to see how you're doing with the Greenhouse.
entries.zh: 谢谢！我还会来看看你的温室建得怎么样。

entries.en: No worries, I'll come back later.
entries.zh: 没事，我之后再来。

entries.en: Ah, hello there! I have some information for you, but you need to finish talking to Sam first!
entries.zh: 啊，你来了！我是有些事想告诉你，不过先把萨姆那边的话听完再说。

entries.en: Looks like you could use some help with your Greenhouse.
entries.zh: 看来你的温室需要搭把手了。

entries.en: Don't worry, I got you covered!
entries.zh: 别担心，这事包在我身上！

entries.en: Talk to me any time to see your Greenhouse mutation progression.
entries.zh: 想看温室变异进度，随时来找我。

entries.en: I crave vast heaps of carrots, my hunger ferrets!
entries.zh: 我渴求成堆的胡萝卜，饥饿在啃噬着我！
我再也不会饥饿了。

entries.en: How dare you let this hare hunger.
entries.zh: 你竟敢让这只野兔挨饿。

entries.en: I like to press a flower for each place the Carnival stops at. Do you have any?
entries.zh: 狂欢节每到一处，我都喜欢压一朵花留念。你有花吗？
谢谢！这些闻起来太棒了！

entries.en: Oh, that's unfortunate. Maybe next time?
entries.zh: 哦，真遗憾。下次吧？

entries.en: Ever feel like you're being watched?
entries.zh: 有没有觉得，有人在盯着你？

entries.en: Like your every action is being recorded and monitored?
entries.zh: 好像你的一举一动，都被记录、监视着？

entries.en: Well, that sure is the case here at The Carnival...
entries.zh: 嗯，在嘉年华，确实是这样……

entries.en: Don't think too hard about it.
entries.zh: 别想太多啦。

entries.en: Greetings, I am in dire need of my favorite snack.
entries.zh: 你好，我急需我最爱的零食。

entries.en: I lied about having an important meeting just to be here, glad it was worth it!
entries.zh: 为了来这儿我谎称自己有重要会议，还好这一趟值得！
这……可不妙！

entries.en: Hey %1$s, the mayor elections are coming up and I've ran out of ballot paper! Could you help me out?
entries.zh: 嘿，%1$s,市长选举快到了，可我的选票纸用完了！能帮我一下吗？

entries.en: Thank you very much! I'll make sure to give these extra ballots to only the elites!
entries.zh: 非常感谢！我保证这些额外选票只会发给精英们！

entries.en: Oh no... I might have to cancel the elections now...
entries.zh: 哦不……我现在可能得取消选举了……

entries.en: In order to better understand the cold, sometimes you have to get warm.
entries.zh: 想把寒冷弄明白，有时候也得先暖和一下。
咱俩这交情，够冷静，也够铁。
我可不是%1$s爱好者。

entries.en: Exploring the whole wide world makes me hungry, I could take some fresh potatoes.
entries.zh: 探索这广阔世界可真让人饿，我想来点新鲜土豆。

entries.en: Thanks man, that should be enough food for my travels.
entries.zh: 谢了兄弟，这些食物够我上路用了。

entries.en: Darn it, I'll have to find another farmer then.
entries.zh: 真倒霉，我只好另找一位农夫了。

entries.en: where am i? oh i am here now.
entries.zh: 我在哪？哦，我现在在这儿。

entries.en: You seem new here. You should probably try to get some Enchanted Wheat for me.
entries.zh: 看着像是新来的啊。不如先帮我弄点附魔小麦吧。
下次见！

entries.en: I suppose this is your very own kingdom in a sense, %1$s? Splendid.
entries.zh: 这么说，这里算是你自己的王国了，%1$s? 太棒了。

entries.en: Potatoes are a dwarf's favorite food. They are like us in many ways, springing to life from the soil under even the harshest conditions.
entries.zh: 土豆是矮人最爱的食物。它们和我们有许多相似之处，即使在最严酷的环境里也能从土壤中蓬勃生长。

entries.en: That resolve is what makes us who we are and keeps our flame alight.
entries.zh: 正是这份坚韧塑造了我们，让我们的火焰始终燃烧。

entries.en: We will push beyond the tunnels and retake what is ours, no matter the cost.
entries.zh: 无论代价如何，我们都会突破隧道，夺回属于我们的东西。

entries.en: This doesn't change things between us - you are still needed as a member of the Expedition Team.
entries.zh: 这不会改变我们之间的关系——远征队依然需要你这名成员。

entries.en: I'm all out of Melons down in the Catacombs, you got any?
entries.zh: 我在地下墓穴里的西瓜全吃完了，你有吗？

entries.en: Truthfully, I've forgotten how I ended up down there in the first place.
entries.zh: 说实话，我都忘了自己最初是怎么到那下面去的。
真糟糕。不过还是谢了。

entries.en: Why do you need my contact?
entries.zh: 你要我的联系方式做什么？
我不是只卖一种东西吗？

entries.en: I mean...I don't know, sure, just take my contact.
entries.zh: 我是说……算了，我也不知道，好吧，联系方式拿去。

entries.en: Dusk needs some watermelon to quench his thirst. Dusk would appreciate it.
entries.zh: 达斯克想吃点西瓜解渴。达斯克会很感激。

entries.en: Dusk thanks you. Dusk will make sure to visit your farm again.
entries.zh: 达斯克谢谢你。达斯克一定还会来你的农场。

entries.en: Dusk is disappointed. Dusk goes away now.
entries.zh: 达斯克很失望。达斯克现在要走了。

entries.en: Sometimes, after a long day of fighting incomprehensible horrors in the Crimson Isle, you just want to kick back.
entries.zh: 有时候，在绯红孤岛和难以名状的恐怖战斗了一整天后，人只想放松一下。

entries.en: Time to kick back and put my feet up, at least until tomorrow!
entries.zh: 该放松下来，把脚翘起来了——至少在明天之前！

entries.en: Do you have any idea how many Mushroom Bulls I'll have to go through just to find a single high-quality mushroom?
entries.zh: 你知道为了找到一颗高品质蘑菇，我得对付多少蘑菇牛吗？

entries.en: Hi! I'm looking for a very specific crop.
entries.zh: 嗨！我在找一种很特别的作物。

entries.en: Nether Warts have some...unique properties, that make them especially useful to me
entries.zh: 下界疣有些……独特的性质，对我特别有用。

entries.en: I'm looking for a very specific artifact.
entries.zh: 我正在找一件很特别的神器。

entries.en: You'll know when you find it.
entries.zh: 等你找到，就会明白。
是裂隙棱镜！

entries.en: It's very powerful, but sometimes... it fails.
entries.zh: 它很强大，可有时候……会失效。

entries.en: Basically, as the Rift is another dimension...
entries.zh: 说白了，因为裂隙是另一个维度……

entries.en: It's a bunch of magic nonsense, but what matters is, I have the fix!
entries.zh: 全是些魔法上的怪问题，不过重点是，我有办法解决！

entries.en: Erihann imbued your Rift Prism right into your spirit!
entries.zh: 埃里汉将你的裂隙棱镜直接灌注进了你的灵魂！

entries.en: You are imbued with the power of the Rift Prism.
entries.zh: 你的体内已经灌注了裂隙棱镜的力量。
我都有点羡慕了。:)

entries.en: This pet I'm looking after is super hungry! You got anything?
entries.zh: 我照看的这只宠物饿坏了！你有吃的吗？

entries.en: That should work! Hopefully they'll be all tired from eating and finally have a nap.
entries.zh: 这些应该行！希望它吃累了，终于能睡个觉。

entries.en: Oh my feathers, these little ones are not going to be happy!
entries.zh: 我的天啊，这些小家伙肯定要不高兴了！
我饿了……你带什么好吃的来了？

entries.en: Ooh, this is exactly what I wanted!
entries.zh: 哦！这正是我想要的！

entries.en: Back to standing still for hours on end!
entries.zh: 又得一连站上好几个小时了！

entries.en: You can buy and sell harvested crops with me!
entries.zh: 收获的作物，可以来我这儿买卖！

entries.en: Wheat, carrots, potatoes, and melon are my specialities!
entries.zh: 小麦、胡萝卜、马铃薯和西瓜，都是我的拿手货！

entries.en: I've been living on this island for 10 years.
entries.zh: 我在这座岛上住了 10 年了。

entries.en: Before that, I used to compete in sugar cane contests.
entries.zh: 再早些时候，我还经常参加甘蔗比赛呢。

entries.en: I've now retired to this house to live out the rest of my days.
entries.zh: 现在退休了，就守着这间小屋，安安稳稳过日子。

entries.en: I've competed in numerous sugar cane contests, but I've never actually tried farming other crops.
entries.zh: 甘蔗比赛我参加过不少，可还真没种过别的作物。

entries.en: This'll be a nice hobby to work on. Thank you.
entries.zh: 往后正好多个爱好。谢啦。

entries.en: Cultivating sugar cane gets boring eventually.
entries.zh: 种甘蔗到头来总会腻。
欢迎来到谷仓！

entries.en: Feel free to harvest any crops on the island, I'm taking a break.
entries.zh: 岛上的庄稼随便收，我正歇着呢。

entries.en: Did you craft a Wheat Minion yet? Here's the recipe!
entries.zh: 你做过小麦小人了吗？配方给你！

entries.en: Nice! I have a Tier X Wheat Minion of my own, maybe one day you can be like me!
entries.zh: 不错！我自己有一台 10 档的小麦小人，说不定哪天你也能像我这样！

entries.en: Take this Chicken Pet, it'll help you gather more crops!
entries.zh: 拿着这只鸡宠物，它能帮你多收作物！

entries.en: In order to summon your Chicken Pet, you'll need to add it to your Pets Menu first.
entries.zh: 想召唤鸡宠物，得先把它加进宠物菜单。

entries.en: Hold your Chicken Pet in your hand and right-click to put it in your Pets Menu!
entries.zh: 把鸡宠物拿在手里，右键就能放进宠物菜单！

entries.en: Great! Now go to the SkyBlock Menu and and open up your Pets Menu.
entries.zh: 很好！现在打开空岛菜单，进宠物菜单。

entries.en: From there, find your Chicken Pet and left-click to summon it!
entries.zh: 在里面找到鸡宠物，左键点一下就能召唤！

entries.en: That Chicken Pet gives you Farming Fortune, which gives you a chance to drop additional crops!
entries.zh: 这只鸡宠物会给你农业时运，有概率多掉作物！

entries.en: Try collecting some of the various crops on the island.
entries.zh: 去岛上各种庄稼都收一点试试。

entries.en: The farm animals here provide a variety of resources.
entries.zh: 这儿的牲畜能出产各种资源。

entries.en: Did you know that chickens drop eggs and cows can be milked?
entries.zh: 你知道吗？鸡会下蛋，牛还能挤奶。

entries.en: Collect wheat, carrots, potatoes, pumpkins, and melon to add to your Collection and unlock cool rewards!
entries.zh: 收集小麦、胡萝卜、马铃薯、南瓜和西瓜，加进你的收集，还能解锁不错的奖励！

entries.en: Those Fairy Souls scare off the animals.
entries.zh: 那些仙女之魂把动物都吓跑了。

entries.en: Have you been to the Mushroom Desert?
entries.zh: 你去过蘑菇沙漠没？

entries.en: You can find many more types of crops there!
entries.zh: 那边的作物种类多得多！

entries.en: The entrance to the Mushroom Desert sits atop a hill to the north.
entries.zh: 蘑菇沙漠的入口在北边的山顶上。

entries.en: There you'll find resources only an experienced farmer can handle - cocoa beans, sugar cane, mushrooms, and cactus!
entries.zh: 那儿的资源只有老手才玩得转——可可豆、甘蔗、蘑菇，还有仙人掌！

entries.en: You can unlock access by leveling up your Farming Skill to Level V.
entries.zh: 把农业技能练到 5 级就能进去。

entries.en: Reach Farming Skill Level V to unlock access to the Mushroom Desert.
entries.zh: 农业技能练到 5 级，即可解锁蘑菇沙漠。
做一台小麦小人！

entries.en: Collect 1 of each crop in The Barn to add to your Farming Collection!
entries.zh: 把谷仓里的每种作物各收 1 个，加进你的农业收集！

entries.en: Collect leather, chicken, and pork to add to your Farming Collection!
entries.zh: 收集皮革、鸡肉和猪肉，加进你的农业收集！

entries.en: I took a break from work for too long! Now I need your help to meet my quota!
entries.zh: 我这假摸得有点久了！现在得靠你帮我把指标凑上！

entries.en: Exactly what I needed. I think I will take the remainder of the day off.
entries.zh: 正是我要的。今天剩下的时间，我看就接着歇了。

entries.en: You condemn me to doing my own work? How can you do this to me!
entries.zh: 你要逼我自己干活？你怎么能这样对我！

entries.en: That Chicken Pet gives you ☘ Farming Fortune, which gives you a chance to drop additional crops!
entries.zh: 这只鸡宠物会给你 ☘ 农业时运，有概率多掉作物！

entries.en: Mortal, the time of reckoning is near. The Past will light the future.
entries.zh: 凡人，清算之时将至。过往将照亮未来。

entries.en: May your destiny be ridded with fortune.
entries.zh: 愿你的命运被好运缠身。
快了。

entries.en: You won't be able to store any items in the Garden, you should keep them on your Private Island!
entries.zh: 花园里可存不了东西，你得把它们放回私人岛屿上！
下次见！
那下次吧。

entries.en: A Carrot King has been scaring off all the good fish, I need to deal with it before I lose more fish.
entries.zh: 一只胡萝卜国王把好鱼都吓跑了，我得在失去更多鱼之前解决它。

entries.en: Holy Mackerel! You got me the whole nine yards.
entries.zh: 我的天哪！你把一整套都给我弄来了。

entries.en: S'alright, we are all busy some days.
entries.zh: 没事，谁都会有忙不过来的时候。

entries.en: Hmm, you're not quite ready yet.
entries.zh: 嗯，你现在还没准备好。

entries.en: Go talk to the Fishing Merchant in the Fishing Outpost, get geared up, and get fishin'!
entries.zh: 先去钓鱼前哨找钓鱼商人，备齐装备，钓起来吧！

entries.en: Come back once you've reached Fishing Skill V and I'll tell you how you can get to a new island!
entries.zh: 等你练到钓鱼技能 V 级再回来，我就告诉你怎么去新的岛屿！
小子，小点声！

entries.en: If you want to learn about Fishing, go talk to my wife, Fisherwoman Enid.
entries.zh: 想学钓鱼，就去找我太太——女渔夫伊妮德。

entries.en: She's fishing a bit upstream. Once she's shown you the ropes, come back and talk to me!
entries.zh: 她在上游不远处钓鱼。等她带你入了门，再回来找我！

entries.en: Hey there buddy, think you can help me out?
entries.zh: 嘿，能帮我个忙吗？

entries.en: My buddy, Captain Baha, and I are just about done building a ship that can set sail to the Backwater Bayou.
entries.zh: 我和老伙计巴哈船长造的船就快完工了，能开到死水河岸去。

entries.en: All that's left is to add the Rusty Ship Engine, but I tripped and dropped it into the pond here...
entries.zh: 就差装上生锈船引擎了，可我绊了一跤，它就掉进了这儿的池塘里...

entries.en: Do you think you could fish it out for me?
entries.zh: 能帮我把它钓上来吗？

entries.en: If you find it, bring it to Captain Baha so you can set sail!
entries.zh: 找到了就把它交给巴哈船长，这样你就能起航了！

entries.en: Can you fish up the Rusty Ship Engine for me?
entries.zh: 能帮我把生锈船引擎钓上来吗？

entries.en: It's somewhere in this pond here.
entries.zh: 它就在这池塘里的某个地方。

entries.en: Once you fish it out, you can set sail to the Backwater Bayou!
entries.zh: 把它钓上来，你就能起航前往死水河岸了！

entries.en: Ah! The Rusty Ship Engine! Perfect!
entries.zh: 啊！生锈船引擎！太好了！

entries.en: Bring that to Captain Baha and he'll be able to help you set sail!
entries.zh: 把它带给巴哈船长，他就能帮你起航了！

entries.en: He's behind the Fisherman's Hut, waiting by the Ship.
entries.zh: 他在渔夫小屋后面，就在船旁边等着。

entries.en: Just leave out the part about me dropping it, would ya?
entries.zh: 不过，可别提是我把它弄掉的，行不？

entries.en: Thanks for helping me find the Rusty Ship Engine, %1$s!
entries.zh: %1$s,多谢你帮我找回生锈船引擎！

entries.en: You can use the Ship Navigator to set sail to the Backwater Bayou!
entries.zh: 现在你可以用船舶导航器起航，前往死水河岸了！
一路平安！

entries.en: My hiking buddy has been missing for a couple days...
entries.zh: 我的徒步伙伴失踪好几天了……

entries.en: He said he was going to go explore the gorge, but that was a while ago.
entries.zh: 他说要去峡谷探险，可那已经是好一阵子前的事了。

entries.en: I'm getting worried, could you go check on him?
entries.zh: 我有点担心，你能去看看他吗？

entries.en: Thank you for saving my friend!
entries.zh: 谢谢你救了我的朋友！

entries.en: My hiking buddy still hasn't returned. I'm afraid the worst has happened and he's starved to death...
entries.zh: 我的徒步伙伴还是没回来。恐怕最糟的事已经发生，他饿死在那里了……

entries.en: I'm going to send someone down soon to find him.
entries.zh: 我会尽快派人下去找他。

entries.en: My last hiking buddy didn't make it out of the gorge...
entries.zh: 我上一个徒步伙伴没能走出峡谷……

entries.en: My new hiking buddy went there a couple days ago to explore but he hasn't come back!
entries.zh: 我的新伙伴前几天也去了那里探险，可他到现在都没回来！

entries.en: Could you go check up on him?
entries.zh: 你能去看看他吗？

entries.en: I'm planning to head back into the gorge to fetch my hiker friend, but I'll need some meat to cook before I head in there.
entries.zh: 我打算再进峡谷，把我的徒步伙伴接回来。不过出发前，得先弄些肉煮着吃。

entries.en: Thanks! I'll be heading to look for him as soon as possible.
entries.zh: 谢了！我会尽快出发去找他。

entries.en: That's alright. I can always head into the Oasis to hunt down some sheep.
entries.zh: 没关系。我还可以去绿洲猎几只绵羊。

entries.en: While I love the cold, I can no longer feel my fingers.
entries.zh: 虽然我喜欢寒冷，但我的手指已经没知觉了。

entries.en: Ooh yes! I can make some hot chocolate with this!
entries.zh: 哦太好了！我能用这些做热巧克力了！

entries.en: No sense of festive spirit in you, is there?
entries.zh: 你一点节日精神都没有，对吧？

entries.en: My little child, you don't look so good. You should eat something. I have an idea, give me some ingredients and I'll make you a nice soup.
entries.zh: 我的孩子，你脸色不太好。该吃点东西了。我有个主意，给我些材料，我给你煮碗好汤。

entries.en: I will make you a meal that you won't forget!
entries.zh: 我会给你做一顿让你忘不了的饭！

entries.en: You denied Grandma Wolf's request. How dare you treat your granny like that.
entries.zh: 你拒绝了狼外婆的请求。你怎么敢这样对待自己的奶奶。

entries.en: I've added the Grandma Wolf Pet to your Pets Menu.
entries.zh: 我已经把狼外婆宠物放进你的宠物菜单了。

entries.en: The Grandma Wolf is particularly adept at combos. The more mobs you kill in quick succession, the better!
entries.zh: 狼外婆最擅长连杀。短时间内接连击杀的怪物越多，效果就越好！

entries.en: If you reach high enough Bestiary Milestones, I will increase the rarity of this pet!
entries.zh: 只要你达到足够高的怪物图鉴里程碑，我就能提高这只宠物的稀有度！

entries.en: The pet does not need to be spawned for combos to work! Happy hunting!
entries.zh: 不用召唤宠物，连杀效果也能生效！狩猎愉快！

entries.en: I'm afraid that's all I can do for you. Thank you for helping this little old Grandma!
entries.zh: 恐怕我能帮你的就到这儿了。谢谢你帮我这个小老太婆！

entries.en: I've already upgraded your pet to the maximum tier! Leave this little old Grandma alone!
entries.zh: 我已经把你的宠物升到最高档了！让我这个小老太婆清静清静吧！

entries.en: I'm afraid you don't have a Grandma Wolf Pet! Leave this little old Grandma alone!
entries.zh: 你恐怕没有狼外婆宠物吧！让我这个小老太婆清静清静吧！

entries.en: Oh, %1$s! I'm having a conundrum! There's so much to kill, yet so little time.
entries.zh: 哦，%1$s! 我可愁坏了！要杀的怪这么多，时间却这么少。

entries.en: There you go! I've upgraded your Grandma Wolf Pet to %1$s!
entries.zh: 好啦！我把你的狼外婆宠物升到%1$s了！

entries.en: Come back when you've reached Bestiary Milestone %1$s to upgrade it to %2$s!
entries.zh: 等你达到怪物图鉴里程碑 %1$s，再来把它升到%2$s吧！

entries.en: I will upgrade your Grandma Wolf Pet to %1$s when you reach Bestiary Milestone %2$s.
entries.zh: 等你达到怪物图鉴里程碑 %2$s，我就能把你的狼外婆宠物升到%1$s。

entries.en: Heard you may got some mushrooms...I've been looking for some...
entries.zh: 听说你可能有些蘑菇……我一直在找……

entries.en: Thank ya man, I knew I could trust you! These will come in good use!
entries.zh: 谢了兄弟，我就知道能信你！这些可派上大用场了！

entries.en: Oh man gee, that's awful man, call me when you got 'em alright?
entries.zh: 哦天哪，这太糟了兄弟，等你有了再叫我，好吗？
听说过个人银行吗？

entries.en: It will let you access your bank remotely.
entries.zh: 有了它，就能远程使用银行。

entries.en: Unlock it through the Emerald Collection.
entries.zh: 在绿宝石收集里就能解锁。

entries.en: I'm looking to try out a new bait for fishing in the Jerry Pond, can you help me out?
entries.zh: 我想在杰瑞池塘试试新鱼饵，你能帮我吗？

entries.en: This'll work, I'll let you know if I catch anything!
entries.zh: 这些能用，钓到东西我会告诉你！

entries.en: Don't come asking me for help anytime soon...
entries.zh: 近期别来找我帮忙……

entries.en: Y'know when I'm fishing here it always feels just as fast as up top.
entries.zh: 你知道吗，我在这儿钓鱼，总觉得跟上面一样快。

entries.en: I'm used to fishing underground being so slow! This is great!
entries.zh: 以前在地下钓鱼都慢得很，我早习惯了！这儿可真不错！

entries.en: Oh man it's so much warmer down here! I don't miss that awful ice cave at all.
entries.zh: 哎呀，这下面暖和多了！那个讨厌的冰洞，我可一点也不想念。

entries.en: All these fish down here are really tough, they are very heat resistant.
entries.zh: 这下面的鱼可真够顽强的，特别耐热。

entries.en: Thank goodness I don't have to see %1$s anymore...
entries.zh: 谢天谢地，总算不用再见到%1$s了……

entries.en: I do feel a bit bad for my boys but I'm sure they are fine now.
entries.zh: 我倒是有点心疼那几个伙计，不过他们现在肯定都挺好的。

entries.en: I hope they get a promotion in the end.
entries.zh: 希望他们最后都能升职吧。

entries.en: Hoppity's Hunt is on, and I need a break! Got something sweet?
entries.zh: Hoppity's Hunt 正在进行，我得歇一会儿！有甜食吗？

entries.en: Simply exquisite! I don't think I'll ever get tired of chocolate.
entries.zh: 简直绝妙！我想我永远吃不腻巧克力。
哦……真小气，不是吗？

entries.en: Hello there, I seem to be stuck here with no good food to eat, could you bring me some square orange fruits?
entries.zh: 你好，我好像被困在这里，没有好吃的东西。能给我带些方方的橙色水果吗？

entries.en: Thanks so much for feeding me, please take this as a token of my gratitude.
entries.zh: 非常感谢你喂我，请收下这个作为谢礼。

entries.en: I guess I'll just go hungry then...
entries.zh: 看来我只能饿着了……
你好，路过的朋友！

entries.en: I fell down into this ravine a couple days ago and can't climb out.
entries.zh: 我前几天掉进了这条峡谷，爬不上去了。

entries.en: My friend Jake said he would come get me but he hasn't arrived yet.
entries.zh: 我的朋友杰伊克说会来救我，可他还没到。

entries.en: Could you bring me food until he gets here?
entries.zh: 在他赶来之前，你能给我送点吃的吗？

entries.en: This isn't the food I wanted, please get me the correct food.
entries.zh: 这不是我想吃的东西，请给我带对食物。

entries.en: This isn't the correct amount I asked for.
entries.zh: 这不是我说的数量。
谢谢你送来的食物。

entries.en: This should fill me up for 144 SkyBlock days.
entries.zh: 这些应该能让我撑过 144 个空岛日。

entries.en: Come back before then so I don't perish!
entries.zh: 一定要在那之前回来，别让我饿死啊！

entries.en: I appreciate the effort but you recently gave me food.
entries.zh: 谢谢你的好意，不过你刚给我送过吃的。

entries.en: Come back later with more food!
entries.zh: 过会儿再带些吃的来吧！
谢谢你送来的食物！

entries.en: I think I see Jake on the edge of the ravine!
entries.zh: 我好像看见杰伊克在峡谷边上了！

entries.en: Thank you for feeding me all these days, meet me at the house near the portal and I will give you something to show my gratitude!
entries.zh: 谢谢你这些天一直给我送饭。到传送门附近的屋子来找我吧，我要送你点东西表示感谢！

entries.en: Thank you for feeding me all those days.
entries.zh: 谢谢你在那段日子里一直给我送饭。

entries.en: To show my gratitude, please have this!
entries.zh: 一点谢礼，请收下吧！

entries.en: Could you get me %1$s of this food?
entries.zh: 你能给我带 %1$s 个这种食物吗？

entries.en: I asked for %1$s of this item.
entries.zh: 我要的是 %1$s 个这种东西。
我想吃的是%1$s。

entries.en: I asked for food that is a %1$s.
entries.zh: 我要的食物是%1$s。
我正在追猎一只隐匿的动物。

entries.en: If you want to hunt animals too, go talk to Trevor!
entries.zh: 你也想打猎的话，就去找特雷弗聊聊吧！

entries.en: You can find him just past the bridge in his den.
entries.zh: 过了桥，就能在他的猎人小屋找到他。

entries.en: Are you in the market for a Husbandry Axe?
entries.zh: 想买把畜牧斧吗？

entries.en: They'll help you gather drops from animals faster!
entries.zh: 有了它，从牲畜身上收东西能快不少！

entries.en: Did you know that you gain additional ☘ Farming Fortune while on the The Garden? You can check it in your SkyBlock Profile!
entries.zh: 你知道吗？待在花园里能额外获得 ☘ 农业时运！打开你的空岛档案就能看到。

entries.en: Thanks for the crops. See ya around.
entries.zh: 谢谢你的庄稼。回头见。
那我晚点再来。

entries.en: Did you know that you gain additional ☘ Farming Fortune while on the Garden? You can check it in your SkyBlock Profile!
entries.zh: 你知道吗？待在花园里能额外获得 ☘ 农业时运！打开你的空岛档案就能看到。
我的农业竞赛开始了！
嘿，你好啊！

entries.en: I organize farming contests once every few days!
entries.zh: 我隔几天就办一场农业竞赛！

entries.en: You need Farming X to participate! :)
entries.zh: 你得先把农业练到 10 级才能参赛！ :)
嘿！今天天气不错啊？

entries.en: You wouldn't happen to be one mighty farmer eh?
entries.zh: 你该不会就是那位了不起的农夫吧，嗯哼？

entries.en: You wouldn't happen to be one mighty fine farmer eh?
entries.zh: 你该不会就是那位了不起的好农夫吧，嗯哼？

entries.en: Well, well! I coordinate a farming contest every few SkyBlock days, eh?
entries.zh: 好嘛，好嘛！每隔几个空岛日，我就张罗一场农业竞赛，懂吧？

entries.en: Check ye calendar eh? Or better yet, click me to learn more, eh!
entries.zh: 去翻翻你的日历呗？或者干脆再点我一下，我细说给你听！

entries.en: Finnegan is forcing me to be more lenient with rankings...
entries.zh: 芬尼根非逼着我把名次划得宽松点……

entries.en: Your Anita's Talisman is giving you +5 %1$s Fortune during the contest!
entries.zh: 你的安妮塔护符在本场竞赛中为你提供 +5 %1$s时运！

entries.en: Your Anita's Ring is giving you +15 %1$s Fortune during the contest!
entries.zh: 你的安妮塔戒指在本场竞赛中为你提供 +15 %1$s时运！

entries.en: Your Anita's Artifact is giving you +25 %1$s Fortune during the contest!
entries.zh: 你的安妮塔神器在本场竞赛中为你提供 +25 %1$s时运！

entries.en: PERSONAL BEST! You've surpassed your previous record of %1$s items collected in the %2$s Contest!
entries.zh: 个人最佳！你刷新了自己在%2$s竞赛中的纪录，此前是 %1$s 个！
农业竞赛结束了！

entries.en: Let me count the final results eh?
entries.zh: 让我来算算最终成绩...

entries.en: Let me count the results eh?
entries.zh: 让我来算算成绩....

entries.en: You placed in the %1$s bracket in the %2$s Contest!
entries.zh: 你在%2$s竞赛中进入了%1$s档！
你收集了 %1$s 个！个人最佳！
你收集了 %1$s 个！
你此前的个人最佳是 %1$s 个。

entries.en: Your Personal Bests perk is now granting you +%1$s☘ %2$s Fortune!
entries.zh: 你的个人最佳天赋现在为你提供 +%1$s☘ %2$s时运！

entries.en: You didn't earn a medal, but you may claim a participation reward in the %1$s Contest!
entries.zh: 你没拿到奖牌，不过可以领一份%1$s竞赛的参与奖！

entries.en: Come see me in the Hub to claim your reward!
entries.zh: 来主城找我领奖！

entries.en: Uh oh! Couldn't figure out how well ya did!
entries.zh: 糟糕！我没算出来你这场发挥得怎么样！

entries.en: Come see me in the hub anyway!
entries.zh: 不管怎样，来大厅找我一趟吧！

entries.en: Howdy! Fine barn ye got there eh? Good lad, you think ye could get me some wheat, eh?
entries.zh: 嘿！你这谷仓真不赖啊？好小伙，能给我弄点小麦来不？

entries.en: Thanks a lot matey. That'll help ye prepare my next farming contest eh?
entries.zh: 多谢了伙计。这下我下一场农业竞赛就好准备了.

entries.en: Gosh darn it matey, can't believe ya do me like that, eh?
entries.zh: 我的天哪，伙计，你真忍心这么对我？
✆ 嘿，你好啊！
✆ 你想要我那个啥……Abi 什么玩意儿的联系方式？

entries.en: ✆ Ma' always told me to worry of stuff I don't understand.
entries.zh: ✆ 我妈总说，搞不懂的东西要多留个心眼。

entries.en: ✆ I'm far from stupid, don't get me wrong, eh.
entries.zh: ✆ 别误会，我可一点都不傻，啊。

entries.en: ✆ I simply enjoy a more simple life, ye?
entries.zh: ✆ 我只是更喜欢简简单单地过日子，懂吧？

entries.en: ✆ Ya sure can add my contact, against 10 Jacob's Ticket, eh?
entries.zh: ✆ 加我当然行，拿 10 张雅各布的票券来换，啊？

entries.en: ✆ Ya won't call me too often, eh?
entries.zh: ✆ 你不会老给我打电话吧？

entries.en: ✆ Howdy, just telling ya there are contests today for %1$s, %2$s, and %3$s!
entries.zh: ✆ 嘿，跟你说一声，今天的竞赛作物是%1$s、%2$s和%3$s!
✆ 希望能看到你下地干活！

entries.en: Hot diggity, that's a lot of medals! I gave ya some rewards, speak with me if you're interested in the rest.
entries.zh: 好家伙，这么多奖牌！我先给你发一部分奖励，剩下的想要就再来找我。
嘿，你好啊！

entries.en: A recipe has no soul. It is up to the cook to bring that ingredient to the table.
entries.zh: 食谱没有灵魂。要由厨师把灵魂带进食材里。

entries.en: Knowledge is the food of the soul.
entries.zh: 知识是灵魂的食粮。

entries.en: One cannot sleep well, love well, think well, if one has not dined well.
entries.zh: 一个人若没吃好，便睡不好、爱不好、思考不好。

entries.en: Hi I'm Jake. I've been living on this island for 25 years.
entries.zh: 你好，我是杰伊克。我在这座岛上已经住了 25 年。

entries.en: I used to study animals from all over the land!
entries.zh: 以前我研究过各地的动物！

entries.en: Unfortunately, I suffered an injury which restricts me from leaving my house.
entries.zh: 可惜后来受了伤，现在没法出门了。
我是真的很喜欢研究动物。

entries.en: Could you bring me an animal? You can find them all over the island!
entries.zh: 能帮我带只动物来吗？岛上到处都能找到！

entries.en: Someone already brought me an animal!
entries.zh: 已经有人给我带来动物了！

entries.en: I'm feeling generous, I'll show you my store.
entries.zh: 今天心情好，带你看看我的商店吧。

entries.en: Someone already brought me this animal recently, but since you put in all the effort I'll open my store for you.
entries.zh: 最近已经有人带过这种动物了。不过你也费了这么大劲，我就为你打开商店吧。
哇，是头牛！

entries.en: How did you get this over the void? Incredible!
entries.zh: 你是怎么把它带过虚空的？太厉害了！

entries.en: To show you my gratitude, I have a special item to sell you!
entries.zh: 为了感谢你，我有件特别的东西可以卖给你！

entries.en: Wow a mushroom Cow! How did you get it out of the Gorge?
entries.zh: 哇，是只哞菇！你是怎么把它从蘑菇峡谷带出来的？
哇，是只鸡！
它是飞过来的吗？
哇，是头猪！

entries.en: How did you get this over the void? You must be really strong.
entries.zh: 你是怎么把它带过虚空的？你力气一定很大。

entries.en: Thank you for bringing me this rabbit!
entries.zh: 谢谢你给我带来这只兔子！

entries.en: To show my gratitude, I have a special item to sell you!
entries.zh: 为了表示感谢，我有件特别的东西可以卖给你！

entries.en: Thank you for bringing me this sheep!
entries.zh: 谢谢你给我带来这只绵羊！

entries.en: This rabbit looks a little funny, did you fish it out of the Oasis?
entries.zh: 这只兔子看起来有点奇怪，是你从绿洲钓上来的吗？

entries.en: This sheep looks a little funny, did you fish it out of the Oasis?
entries.zh: 这只绵羊看起来有点奇怪，是你从绿洲钓上来的吗？
传说中的骷髅皇帝！

entries.en: I searched all my life to find this creature but was never able to find it!
entries.zh: 我找了它一辈子，却一直没能找到！
这里太奇怪了……

entries.en: I can't believe this has been down here for all this time... I am speechless.
entries.zh: 不敢相信，这里居然一直藏着这些东西……我都不知道该说什么了。

entries.en: WHAT? There are animals inside of here?!?! Jake is doing horrible experiments with these animals that he catches...
entries.zh: 什么？这里面竟然有动物？!?! 杰伊克居然在做可怕的实验，用的就是这些动物，都是他抓来的……

entries.en: He has gone completely mad! He's a psychopath!
entries.zh: 他彻底疯了！简直是个变态！

entries.en: And look at all of these tools he has laying around here... a SAW?... a HAMMER?
entries.zh: 再看看这里到处摆着的工具……锯子？……锤子？

entries.en: What is this psycho doing with these animals???
entries.zh: 这疯子究竟在对这些动物做什么？??

entries.en: Jake has a lot of explaining to do!
entries.zh: 杰伊克必须给我们一个解释！

entries.en: IT'S NOT WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE!
entries.zh: 不是你们想的那样！

entries.en: WE KNOW WHAT YOU ARE DOING IN HERE, YOU PSYCHO! YOU WILL PAY FOR WHAT YOU ARE DOING TO THESE ANIMALS!
entries.zh: 我们知道你在这里干什么，疯子！你这样对待这些动物，一定会付出代价！

entries.en: ANIMALS? I CAN EXPLAIN, I SWEAR!
entries.zh: 动物？我能解释，我发誓！

entries.en: WELL GO ON THEN, EXPLAIN YOURSELF!
entries.zh: 那你倒是说啊，解释清楚！

entries.en: I don't know what you guys think I am doing here, but this is just my workshop!
entries.zh: 不知道你们以为我在这里干什么，但这不过是我的工作间！

entries.en: I am just making toys for animals...
entries.zh: 我只是在给动物做玩具……

entries.en: Oh really? Do you really think we are that naive?
entries.zh: 是吗？你真觉得我们有那么好骗？

entries.en: We know that you are experimenting with animals down here, how do you explain this tank?
entries.zh: 我们知道你在这下面拿动物做实验，那这个水槽你怎么解释？

entries.en: Those are my plushies! I preserve them in Jelly so they stay fresh!
entries.zh: 那些是我的毛绒玩具！我把它们泡在果冻里，这样就能保鲜！

entries.en: They look super realistic, but no animal was harmed when making them!
entries.zh: 它们看起来是特别逼真，可制作时没有任何动物受伤！

entries.en: I can prove it! Here, take this. This is one of the plushies I made, you can have it!
entries.zh: 我可以证明！来，拿着，这是我做的一个毛绒玩具，送给你了！

entries.en: So really, I am not harming them at all!
entries.zh: 所以，我真的一点也没伤害它们！

entries.en: Everything makes sense now...I'm sorry I yelled at you Jake. I'm so sorry.
entries.zh: 现在都说得通了……对不起，杰伊克，我不该冲你吼。真的对不起。

entries.en: It's alright now. I was wrong to lie about it and I should have told you sooner.
entries.zh: 没事了。撒谎是我不对，我早该告诉你的。

entries.en: %1$s, thank you so much for telling me what you saw here. I'll be forever grateful.
entries.zh: %1$s，谢谢你把这里的见闻告诉我。我会一直感激你的。

entries.en: I have to go now, I hope to see you guys soon.
entries.zh: 我得走了，希望很快能再见到你们。

entries.en: That was a close one, thank you %1$s for having my back. Anyway, I need to go back to my business.
entries.zh: 好险，多亏了 %1$s 替我解围。好了，我该回去忙自己的事了。

entries.en: I... I had no idea this was here. What could Jake be hiding in this secret part of the lab?
entries.zh: 我……我完全不知道这里还有这些。杰伊克在实验室的这个秘密区域藏了什么？

entries.en: It's very dark in here, where's the light-switch in this place?
entries.zh: 这里好黑，灯的开关在哪儿？

entries.en: Oh... my... what is all of this?
entries.zh: 天……啊……这些都是什么？

entries.en: This is... this isn't just about plushies anymore. Jake's been working on something much bigger.
entries.zh: 这……已经不只是毛绒玩具的事了。杰伊克一直在研究更大的项目。

entries.en: Hybridization? Mutation? What is this madness? He's experimenting on something...
entries.zh: 杂交？变异？这也太疯狂了吧？他在做什么实验……

entries.en: Resilient livestock... enhanced growth rates... Jake, what have you done?
entries.zh: 适应力强的牲畜……更快的生长速度……杰伊克，你都做了些什么？

entries.en: These aren't normal crops. These are mutated... just like the ones we've been finding in the Garden. But why hide all of this down here?
entries.zh: 这些不是普通的作物，它们都发生了变异……跟我们在花园里发现的一样。可是，为什么要把这些都藏在这里？

entries.en: Beth... I told you to stay out of this.
entries.zh: 贝丝……我说过，别插手这件事。

entries.en: Jake! You have a lot of explaining to do, once again... What is all of this? What are you doing down here?
entries.zh: 杰伊克！你又得好好解释一下了……这些到底是什么？你在这里干什么？

entries.en: Please tell me the truth this time Jake, I can't take all these lies anymore!
entries.zh: 杰伊克，这次请告诉我实话，我再也受不了这些谎话了！

entries.en: It's... it's not what it looks like. This lab... it's for research. To improve farming techniques, to help both crops and animals adapt to new environments.
entries.zh: 不……不是你想的那样。这间实验室……是用来做研究的。我想改进农业技术，帮助作物和动物适应新的环境。

entries.en: Research? This doesn't look like research, Jake! This looks like you are playing with life itself. Those tanks, those animals, what are you actually doing to them?
entries.zh: 研究？这可不像研究，杰伊克！你简直是在拿生命当儿戏。那些水槽、那些动物，你到底对它们做了什么？

entries.en: You don't understand, Beth! Farming as we know is evolving. If we don't adapt, we'll be left behind. The world's demands are growing, and so are the challenges.
entries.zh: 你不明白，贝丝！我们熟悉的农业正在改变。不跟着适应，我们就会被甩在后面。大家的需求在增长，难题也越来越多。

entries.en: That doesn't give you the right to hide this from everyone. What about the risks? The ethics?
entries.zh: 那也不代表你有权瞒着所有人。风险呢？伦理呢？
你在创造完全违背自然的东西。

entries.en: sigh I know it seems... wrong. But these experiments could change everything.
entries.zh: 唉……我知道，这看起来……不太对。但这些实验也许能改变一切。

entries.en: Imagine crops that can survive the harshest conditions, or animals that never get sick.
entries.zh: 想想看，能在最恶劣的环境下存活的作物，或是永远不会生病的动物。

entries.en: It's not just about survival, it's about thriving.
entries.zh: 不只是活下来，还要长得更好。

entries.en: And what about the things you are not telling me? What else are you hiding down here, Jake?
entries.zh: 那你没告诉我的事呢？杰伊克，你在这里还藏了什么？

entries.en: There are some things you're better off not knowing. Not yet at least.
entries.zh: 有些事，你不知道反而更好。至少现在还不该知道。

entries.en: No, Jake. I've come this far, and I won't stop now. If you won't tell me the truth, I'll find it myself.
entries.zh: 不行，杰伊克。我已经查到这里了，不会就这么停下。你不肯说实话，我就自己找。

entries.en: Beth, you don't understand, some things aren't ready to be uncovered. It's not about keeping secrets, it's about protecting what I've been working towards.
entries.zh: 贝丝，你不明白，有些东西还没到公开的时候。我不是想守着秘密，我只是想保护自己一直为之努力的成果。

entries.en: Protecting what? Your pride? Your experiments? This isn't just about you, Jake. We have a responsibility to use this lab for good, not to bury it under layers of secrecy.
entries.zh: 保护什么？你的面子？你的实验？杰伊克，这不只是你一个人的事。我们有责任让这间实验室造福大家，而不是把它埋在层层秘密之下。
这是什么？
那是……作物分析仪。

entries.en: It's a tool I've been developing. It analyzes mutations in crops, helps identify traits that can improve yield, resistance or even flavor.
entries.zh: 这是我一直在研发的工具。它能分析作物的变异，找出能提高产量、抗性，甚至改善风味的特征。

entries.en: But it's not finished. It's delicate work, Beth. Work that requires precision, and data.
entries.zh: 但它还没完成。贝丝，这项研究很精细，必须精确，还得有数据。

entries.en: Work that shouldn't be done in isolation. Jake, this could change everything for farmers everywhere. Why are you hiding something so revolutionary?
entries.zh: 也不是该独自埋头做的研究。杰伊克，这可能改变各地农民的生活。这么突破性的成果，你为什么要藏起来？

entries.en: Because it's not perfect yet. A mistake could have disastrous consequences. I didn't want to involve anyone until I was sure it was ready.
entries.zh: 因为它还不够完善。一个失误就可能酿成灾难。在确定准备好之前，我不想把任何人牵扯进来。

entries.en: Jake, you've done incredible work here. But you don't have to do it alone anymore. Let me and %1$s help you.
entries.zh: 杰伊克，你的研究真的很了不起。但现在不用再一个人做了。让我和 %1$s 来帮你吧。

entries.en: Together, we can finish this and make sure it's used responsibly.
entries.zh: 我们一起把它完成，也一起确保它得到负责任的使用。

entries.en: Alright. You're right, Beth. I've been trying to carry this burden alone for too long. If we're going to make this work, we'll do it together.
entries.zh: 好吧。贝丝，你说得对。我一个人扛了太久。既然要把这件事做成，那我们就一起做。

entries.en: And you, %1$s, you've been instrumental in getting us to this point. You should have access to the Crop Analyzer. You've earned my trust.
entries.zh: 还有你，%1$s，能走到这一步，你帮了很大的忙。你也该能使用作物分析仪了。你已经赢得了我的信任。

entries.en: Feel free to analyze any mutations you find!
entries.zh: 找到什么变异作物，都可以拿来分析！

entries.en: Hold your horses! You don't even know how this machine works yet, you might break something if you don't pay attention!
entries.zh: 先别急！你还不知道这台机器怎么用，稍不留神就可能弄坏东西！

entries.en: Allow me to introduce you to this machine first.
entries.zh: 让我先给你介绍一下这台机器。

entries.en: To help with my research, I need to collect various data samples of special mutated crops.
entries.zh: 为了推进研究，我需要收集各种特殊变异作物的数据样本。

entries.en: Their DNA is quite intriguing, making them a perfect basis for my research!
entries.zh: 它们的 DNA 很有意思，正适合作为我的研究基础！

entries.en: To get started, acquire a Dustgrain first in your Greenhouse and then come back to me.
entries.zh: 先从你的温室里弄一份尘粒，再回来找我，我们就能开始了。

entries.en: Splendid! Now that we have our sample, place it inside the machine to analyze the mutation.
entries.zh: 太好了！样本有了，把它放进机器，分析一下这份变异作物吧。

entries.en: Good job! We have successfully sequenced the mutation, adding another sample to my collection!
entries.zh: 干得好！这份变异作物的测序成功了，我的样本库又添了一份样本！

entries.en: If you find anymore mutations, I have not yet categorized, please feel free to analyze them here!
entries.zh: 如果找到我还没分类的变异作物，尽管拿到这里分析！

entries.en: Analyzing these mutations will help us understand how we can improve existing crops which will help farmers everywhere!
entries.zh: 分析这些变异作物，能让我们知道如何改良现有作物，帮助各地的农民！
✆ 想要我的联系方式？

entries.en: ✆ I don't give it out often.
entries.zh: ✆ 我可不常给人。

entries.en: ✆ I'm still getting calls from that one guy asking if I want to "extend my shovel warranty".
entries.zh: ✆ 到现在还有个家伙不停打来，问我要不要给铲子续保。

entries.en: ✆ But if you help me with my research, I can trust you with it.
entries.zh: ✆ 不过，要是你帮我做研究，我就放心把联系方式给你。

entries.en: ✆ Bring me a Chocoberry. One sample shall be enough.
entries.zh: ✆ 给我带一个巧克力莓。一份样本就够了。

entries.en: ✆ I cannot add you yet, I still have to finish my research.
entries.zh: ✆ 现在还不能加你，我的研究还没做完。

entries.en: ✆ Bring me a Chocoberry first, and I'll give you my contact!
entries.zh: ✆ 先带一个巧克力莓给我，我就把联系方式给你！

entries.en: ✆ This Chocoberry looks great, perfect condition even!
entries.zh: ✆ 这个巧克力莓真不错，状态简直完美！

entries.en: ✆ This gives me everything I need.
entries.zh: ✆ 这样我需要的就都齐了。

entries.en: ✆ You've earned my contact. I'll add you now.
entries.zh: ✆ 现在可以把联系方式给你了。我这就加你。

entries.en: ✆ But don't call me after 8pm, please.
entries.zh: ✆ 不过，晚上 8 点以后就别给我打电话了，拜托。

entries.en: You might have noticed that you can purchase additional plots within your Desk in the Barn!
entries.zh: 你可能注意到，可以在谷仓的管理台购买额外地皮！
谢谢！下次见！
没事。

entries.en: You should hear what Sam has to say first before talking to me!
entries.zh: 先去听听萨姆怎么说，再来找我！

entries.en: It looks like you're pretty new to this Garden thing. Come back once you've reached Garden Level IV!
entries.zh: 看来你刚接触花园这一套。等花园等级到了 4 级再来找我吧！

entries.en: Have you picked up a Specialized Farming Tool yet?
entries.zh: 你入手专精农业工具了吗？

entries.en: These Specialized Farming Tools are a game changer! You can level them and upgrade to become even more powerful.
entries.zh: 这些专精农业工具能彻底改变你的种田方式！它们可以升级、可以强化，越用越强。

entries.en: Farming using one of these tools also gives you Sowdust, which will be essential in upgrading your Chips!
entries.zh: 用这些农具种田还能攒下播尘，升级芯片全靠它！

entries.en: Once you get your hands on one, swing by and see me and I'll teach you about Chips!
entries.zh: 等你弄到一件，就过来找我，我教你芯片是怎么回事！

entries.en: Show me a Specialized Farming Tool and I'll teach you about Chips!
entries.zh: 给我看一件专精农业工具，我就教你芯片的门道！

entries.en: Well, well! You got yourself a real Farming Tool, huh?
entries.zh: 哟，不错！你还真弄到一件正经农业工具了？

entries.en: These don't just sit pretty, they grow stronger the more you use 'em!
entries.zh: 它们可不是摆设，越用越强！

entries.en: Every crop you harvest gives your tool experience, leveling it up over time.
entries.zh: 你每收一株作物，农具就攒一点经验，慢慢就升级了。

entries.en: But here's the catch - once it hits Level 15, you'll need to upgrade it before it can keep growing. Same goes for Level 30.
entries.zh: 不过有个坎——到了 15 级，得先强化一次才能继续升。30 级也一样。

entries.en: Oh, and you might have noticed something new, Sowdust. You'll start earning it just by using your tool from now on.
entries.zh: 哦，你可能注意到了一样新东西:播尘。从现在起，只要用农具干活就能攒到它。

entries.en: This stuff is important because it lets you upgrade Chips, which will give you permanent buffs.
entries.zh: 这东西很要紧，拿它能升级芯片，而芯片会给你永久的增益。

entries.en: Here, take this, your first Chip. Go ahead and use the chip to unlock it.
entries.zh: 来，拿着，你的第一块芯片。用掉它就能解锁。

entries.en: Nice! I've added the Chip Menu to your SkyBlock Menu while you are on the Garden, so you'll have easier access to them from now on.
entries.zh: 不错！我把芯片菜单加进你的空岛菜单了(在花园里的时候),以后找起来更方便。

entries.en: You can now have as many Chips as you want, just keep upgrading them with Sowdust!
entries.zh: 现在芯片想要多少有多少，记得用播尘不断升级它们！

entries.en: Chips can be found all over the place, and once you unlock them, you can start upgrading them.
entries.zh: 芯片到处都能找到，解锁之后就可以开始升级了。

entries.en: And if you come accross duplicates of the same Chip, don't worry, you'll be able to upgrade them to EPIC and LEGENDARY rarity, boosting their maximum level and effectiveness even further!
entries.zh: 要是捡到重复的芯片也别急，可以拿来把它升到史诗和传说稀有度，等级上限和效果都会更进一步！

entries.en: Hello %1$s. Glad to meet you here. I need some Bread.
entries.zh: 你好，%1$s。在这儿见到你真好。我需要一些面包。

entries.en: Hello %1$s. Glad to meet you here. I need some %2$s.
entries.zh: 你好，%1$s。在这儿见到你真好。我需要一些%2$s。

entries.en: This is not my realm. I must return. Thank you.
entries.zh: 此地非我领域。我必须回去了。谢谢你。
杰瑞不开心。

entries.en: Sadly you can't gather logs in the The Garden, however there are plenty of crops here!
entries.zh: 可惜花园里没法采集原木，不过这里的庄稼倒是多得很！
嗯，太可惜了。

entries.en: One day you'll be able to buy the sun, trust me on that mate.
entries.zh: 总有一天你能买下太阳，相信我吧伙计。
这让我感觉好多了。
好吧……

entries.en: Greetings! I've been running low on paper recently for my Enchanted Books, could you bring me some Sugar Cane?
entries.zh: 你好！我最近做附魔书的纸快用完了，能给我带些甘蔗来吗？

entries.en: I'll be sure to make some Enchanted Books out of these, I hope you come around some day!
entries.zh: 我一定用它们做出几本附魔书来，希望你哪天来坐坐！

entries.en: Very unfortunate, I really needed that paper...
entries.zh: 真遗憾，我是真的很需要那些纸……

entries.en: You've amassed quite a fortune. I have an antiquity that might interest you. However, I wouldn't sell it to just anybody, you know? I need something in return. So, what do you say?
entries.zh: 你积攒了相当可观的财富。我有件古物或许会让你感兴趣。不过你知道，我不会卖给随便什么人。我需要些回报。怎么样？

entries.en: I'm glad we are in agreement, %1$s. Meet me in the Hub, we'll discuss our business then.
entries.zh: 很高兴我们达成一致，%1$s。来主城见我，到时再谈生意。

entries.en: Not everyone can afford my lifestyle!
entries.zh: 不是每个人都负担得起我的生活方式！

entries.en: My assistant is feeling off, and I think we could do with a hearty meal. Do you think you can help us out?
entries.zh: 我的助手不太舒服，我觉得我们该吃顿丰盛的饭。你能帮帮我们吗？

entries.en: Thank you! I'm sure this will make him feel better.
entries.zh: 谢谢！我相信这会让他好起来。

entries.en: I thought you'd be more thankful for the sweet axe my assistant gave you.
entries.zh: 我还以为你会更感激我助手送你的那把甜斧头。

entries.en: If you ever get lost, you should check on the Desk on what to do next.
entries.zh: 要是你不知道接下来做什么，可以看看管理台。
祝你愉快。

entries.en: I'm here to put a value on your farm. Bring me your fanciest crop.
entries.zh: 我是来评估你农场价值的。把你最精致的作物带来。

entries.en: Truly Magnificent! I value your farm at a minimum of %1$s coins!
entries.zh: 实在壮观！我给你的农场估值至少 %1$s 硬币！

entries.en: I value your farm at 0 coins. Horrible service.
entries.zh: 我给你的农场估值 0 硬币。服务糟透了。

entries.en: I must say, this Garden is starting to grow on me. Figuratively, of course.
entries.zh: 我得说，这个花园开始让我喜欢上了。当然是比喻意义上。

entries.en: Miss me? Don't answer that, I know you did.
entries.zh: 想我了吗？别回答，我知道你想了。

entries.en: Ah, The Garden. Where dreams wither and weeds thrive. What do you have for me today?
entries.zh: 啊，花园。梦想枯萎、杂草繁茂的地方。今天你给我带了什么？

entries.en: Ah, Cropie! Nature's little mystery. Got any?
entries.zh: 啊，作物仔！大自然的小谜团。你有吗？

entries.en: Squash? Not the sport, darling. The vegetable. I'll make it worth your while.
entries.zh: 倭瓜？亲爱的，不是那项运动，是蔬菜。我会让你觉得值得。

entries.en: Got any Fermento? Trust me, it's not for a fruit salad.
entries.zh: 有发酵吗？相信我，不是要做水果沙拉。

entries.en: Ah, a trade well made. A potion for you, brewed by yours truly.
entries.zh: 啊，一笔好交易。给你一瓶我亲自酿制的药水。

entries.en: Good deal. Here, this potion isn't found on any old store shelf. Don't waste it.
entries.zh: 好交易。给你，这瓶药水可不是随便哪家店架上都有的。别浪费了。

entries.en: You're not here on Seth's behalf, are you? I mean, he's cute but he could never afford me.
entries.zh: 你不是替赛斯来的吧？我的意思是，他挺可爱，但绝对雇不起我。

entries.en: Ah, you think this potion is strong? You have no idea what power really tastes like.
entries.zh: 啊，你觉得这药水很强？你根本不知道真正的力量是什么滋味。

entries.en: Rare materials are just the tip of the iceberg. But then, you're not ready for what's beneath.
entries.zh: 稀有材料不过是冰山一角。不过你还没准备好面对冰山下的东西。

entries.en: I've seen things that would make your health bar drop to zero. But don't worry, your little Cropies are safe with me.
entries.zh: 我见过能让你生命条直接归零的东西。不过别担心，你的小作物仔在我这里很安全。

entries.en: Who needs friends when you have powerful enemies? Oh wait, I have both!
entries.zh: 有强大的敌人时，谁还需要朋友？哦等等，我两样都有！

entries.en: What's my secret to eternal youth? That's for me to know and for you to find out...maybe.
entries.zh: 我永葆青春的秘诀是什么？这该由我知道，由你去发现……也许吧。

entries.en: These potions are child's play. The real stuff? Well, that's not on the menu for rookies.
entries.zh: 这些药水只是小孩子的把戏。真正的货色？嗯，那可不供应给新手。

entries.en: Ah, you want to know my secrets? Even if I told you, you wouldn't believe me.
entries.zh: 啊，你想知道我的秘密？就算告诉你，你也不会相信。

entries.en: Don't bother asking why I need these materials. Let's just say it's...above your clearance level.
entries.zh: 别问我为什么需要这些材料。只能说……这超出了你的权限级别。

entries.en: Seth understands the value of my potions. Do you?
entries.zh: 赛斯明白我的药水价值。你明白吗？

entries.en: Let's just say these materials aren't the only rare commodities I'm interested in.
entries.zh: 只能说，这些材料不是我感兴趣的唯一稀有商品。

entries.en: No materials? Huh, I guess your adventures are as empty as your inventory.
entries.zh: 没有材料？哼，看来你的冒险和你的物品栏一样空。

entries.en: Ah, so the Garden isn't just full of weeds, huh?
entries.zh: 哦，原来花园里不全是杂草啊？

entries.en: Finally, someone worth talking to. You look like you know the difference between a Cropie and a lump of dirt.
entries.zh: 总算有个值得聊聊的人了。看你的样子，应该分得清作物仔和土疙瘩。

entries.en: I'm in the market for some rare materials. Maybe you're familiar?
entries.zh: 我想买点稀有材料。你应该知道些门路吧？

entries.en: In exchange, I might have something 'special' for you.
entries.zh: 作为交换，我也许有点“特别”的东西给你。

entries.en: Hey there! I'm looking for a new type of flower to plant in my Garden.
entries.zh: 嘿！我想找一种新的花，种到我的花园里。
这个正合适！再会！

entries.en: If you ever change your mind, you know where to find me!
entries.zh: 你要是改主意了，知道上哪儿找我！

entries.en: May I quickly grab some Melon, please? I left the Gold Essence Shop unattended!
entries.zh: 能快点给我拿些西瓜吗？我把黄金精粹商店丢着没人看了！

entries.en: Have you ever tried eating a Glistening Melon Slice? It's not easy, let me tell you!
entries.zh: 你试过吃 Glistening 西瓜片吗？我跟你说，可没那么容易！

entries.en: I'm in too much of a rush to be angry! Bye!
entries.zh: 我赶时间，没空生气！再见！

entries.en: Hey! I'm Marigold! I don't recall seeing you around these parts before...
entries.zh: 嗨！我是玛丽戈德！以前好像没在这附近见过你...

entries.en: Now normally, I run a humble little shop that allows you to upgrade some useful perks in exchange for Gold Essence!
entries.zh: 我平时经营着一家小店，一些实用的增益都能用黄金精粹来升级！

entries.en: However, a pesky Golden Goblin just came by and snatched a bunch of my Gold Essence! How can I operate safely with thieves like that running around?
entries.zh: 不过，刚才有只讨厌的金哥布林跑来抢走了一大堆我的黄金精粹！这种小偷到处乱跑，我怎么安心做生意啊？

entries.en: Speak to me again after killing a Golden Goblin and I'll show you my shop! I heard Golden Goblins have a small chance to spawn when mining ores or throwing Goblin Eggs in the Dwarven Mines or Crystal Hollows.
entries.zh: 你先去击杀一只黄金哥布林，回来找我，我就给你看看我的店！听说在矮人矿洞或水晶洞窟里，挖掘矿石或投掷哥布林蛋时，都有小概率出现黄金哥布林。

entries.en: Speak to me again after killing a-
entries.zh: 你先击杀一只，再来找我——

entries.en: wait... your Bestiary shows that you've already killed a Golden Goblin!
entries.zh: 等一下...你的怪物图鉴上写着，你已经击杀过金哥布林了！

entries.en: I can't thank you enough! As a token of my gratitude, here's another 25 Gold Essence to get you started at my shop! It's not a lot, but a little goes a long way!
entries.zh: 太谢谢你了！我再送你 25 黄金精粹表示感谢，你可以先在我店里用上！虽然不多，但也能派上用场！

entries.en: Let me show you the Gold Essence Shop!
entries.zh: 我带你看看黄金精粹商店！

entries.en: Amazing! Thanks for the help - those pesky Golden Goblins seem to appear all the time!
entries.zh: 太好了！谢谢你帮忙——这些讨厌的黄金哥布林好像总是冒出来！

entries.en: As a token of my gratitude, here's another 25 Gold Essence to get you started at my shop! It's not a lot, but a little goes a long way!
entries.zh: 我再送你 25 黄金精粹表示感谢，你可以先在我店里用上！虽然不多，但也能派上用场！
✆ 我的阿比手机联系方式？
✆ 好啊！

entries.en: ✆ I mean, I'm supposed to ask you for something, right?
entries.zh: ✆ 我是说，我是不是该找你要点东西来着？
✆ 不如来一颗弥达斯宝石？

entries.en: ✆ I've always wanted one, but you can't find them around here, and I'm too scared to venture into The Catacombs in search of one.
entries.zh: ✆ 我一直想要一颗，可这附近找不到，我又不敢去地下墓穴里找。

entries.en: ✆ Hmm, you don't seem to have a Midas Jewel.
entries.zh: ✆ 嗯，你身上好像没有弥达斯宝石。

entries.en: ✆ You can sometimes find one when killing King Midas in The Catacombs.
entries.zh: ✆ 在地下墓穴里击杀弥达斯王，有时会掉落一颗。
✆ ...不过我也只是听说的。
✆ 哇，真漂亮！

entries.en: ✆ I hope it wasn't too much of a hassle to get, I've heard stories of The Catacombs...
entries.zh: ✆ 希望你找它没费太多工夫，我听说过地下墓穴的那些故事...

entries.en: ✆ Here's my contact, you can call me whenever you need to access the Gold Essence Shop.
entries.zh: ✆ 这是我的联系方式，要用黄金精粹商店的时候，随时给我打电话。
✆ 还是要再谢谢你！

entries.en: I paid for one of Treasure Hunter's tips today and again, it only led me to a dirty shoelace. His tips are just not worth it...
entries.zh: 我今天又花钱买了寻宝人的一条提示，结果又只找到一根脏鞋带。他的提示根本不值……

entries.en: Maybe if I continue buying his tips I'll hit the jackpot soon. Just gotta spend a little bit more...
entries.zh: 也许我继续买他的提示，很快就会中大奖。只要再多花一点……

entries.en: You're no better than the Treasure Hunter...
entries.zh: 你和寻宝人没什么两样……

entries.en: I think the Treasure Hunter is a scammer.
entries.zh: 我觉得寻宝人是个骗子。

entries.en: He's always selling information about treasure locations but I always hear that no one finds treasure.
entries.zh: 他一直在卖宝藏地点的消息，可我听到的总是没人找到宝藏。

entries.en: Recruit, please scavenge the island for any food you can find.
entries.zh: 新兵，去岛上搜寻你能找到的任何食物。
工作令人满意，新兵。

entries.en: If I could demote you any further I would, recruit.
entries.zh: 要是还能再给你降级，我早就这么做了，新兵。

entries.en: I use all sorts of wood types to create strong and useful items!
entries.zh: 我用各种木材，做些结实又好用的东西！
来，看看吧！
哎，听我说。

entries.en: The other day I was chumming with my chums.
entries.zh: 前几天，我跟几个钓友一块儿弄碎鱼饵。

entries.en: One of them yaps and I say, "ever tried my tonic"?
entries.zh: 有个家伙聊个没完，我就问他: 试过我做的补剂没？

entries.en: So yeah, I come back to my crib, right?
entries.zh: 后来啊，我就回自个儿的窝了。

entries.en: And listen, I've never seen anybody down here, but you seem like a nice fellow.
entries.zh: 说起来，还真没见过别人到这底下来。不过你看着挺好相处的。

entries.en: So just bring me Glowing Mushroom x8 and I'll show you how to chum, alright buddy?
entries.zh: 这样吧，带点发光蘑菇 x8 来，我就教你怎么弄碎鱼饵，怎么样？

entries.en: So just bring me 8 Glowing Mushrooms and I'll show you how to chum, alright buddy?
entries.zh: 这样吧，带 8 个发光蘑菇来，我就教你怎么弄碎鱼饵，怎么样？

entries.en: Ok listen now, I practice a secret chumming technique.
entries.zh: 好，听仔细了，我这可是弄碎鱼饵的独门秘技。
那就是——反向打窝！

entries.en: Instead of chumming, it's the sea creatures giving you Chums.
entries.zh: 不用你投饵，反过来让海洋生物给你碎鱼饵。
听我说，简单得很。

entries.en: First we trade a Chum Bucket, ok?
entries.zh: 先在我这儿换个碎鱼饵桶。
点我就行！

entries.en: First you place down the bucket near water, right?
entries.zh: 先把桶放在水边。

entries.en: Then use a fishing rod and throw a line in said water.
entries.zh: 再拿出钓鱼竿，往那片水里甩一竿。

entries.en: Ok and you wait now. That part is easier with YOUR chums.
entries.zh: 接下来就等着。叫上你自己的钓友，这一步就轻松多了。

entries.en: Listen, time is shorter with friends.
entries.zh: 听我说，跟朋友一起，等的时间就短了。

entries.en: After waiting you kill a sea creature and get a Chum.
entries.zh: 等海洋生物上钩，干掉它，你就能拿到碎鱼饵了。

entries.en: You put it in the bucket and someday it's filled.
entries.zh: 把碎鱼饵往桶里装，迟早能装满。

entries.en: Then listen you bring me the filled bucket, ok?
entries.zh: 记住啊，装满了就把桶带来给我。
哇，不错不错！

entries.en: You are the chumming expert ok?
entries.zh: 你这已经是弄碎鱼饵的行家了嘛！

entries.en: Listen. I also have some good items for your chumming.
entries.zh: 对了，我这儿还有不少好东西，能帮你弄碎鱼饵。

entries.en: And I have this really good tonic. It's a really good tonic, ok?
entries.zh: 还有我这补剂，真是好东西。我可没瞎吹啊。

entries.en: So get mushrooms, fill chum buckets, trade tonics! Easy chums!
entries.zh: 采蘑菇，装满碎鱼饵桶，来换补剂！就这么简单，钓友们！

entries.en: ✆ Hey chum. Long time no see.
entries.zh: ✆ 哟，钓友，好久不见。
✆ 好，听我说。

entries.en: ✆ I got all my chums in my phone, ok?
entries.zh: ✆ 我的钓友啊，全存在手机里了。

entries.en: ✆ And we're chums too, you and I.
entries.zh: ✆ 咱俩也是钓友，对吧。

entries.en: ✆ But I only got so many contact slots, you know?
entries.zh: ✆ 可通讯录就那么点空位啊。

entries.en: ✆ And who am I to say which of my chums are the most important, you know?
entries.zh: ✆ 你说，我哪能给朋友排个三六九等呢？

entries.en: ✆ What kind of chum would that make me?
entries.zh: ✆ 那我还算什么朋友啊？

entries.en: ✆ So, if you want your digits in my phone, imma need you to get me something...
entries.zh: ✆ 所以啊，想把你的号码存进来，得帮我带点东西……

entries.en: ✆ What do you think it is?
entries.zh: ✆ 你猜会是什么？
✆ 当然是碎鱼饵啦，钓友！

entries.en: ✆ Bring me Full Chum Bucket x64 and I'll add you to my Abiphone!
entries.zh: ✆ 带点满碎鱼饵桶 x64 来，我就把你加进我的阿比手机！
✆ 这可是友情价！
✆ 哎，钓友，不是这个。

entries.en: ✆ I asked for Full Chum Bucket x64.
entries.zh: ✆ 我要的是满碎鱼饵桶 x64。
✆ 不是你手里这玩意儿。
✆ 哇，这就对了。

entries.en: ✆ This is the stuff. The good stuff.
entries.zh: ✆ 就是这个。好东西啊。
✆ 喏，这是我的联系方式！

entries.en: ✆ You ever need chumming supplies just give your chum Moby a call!
entries.zh: ✆ 以后缺弄碎鱼饵的东西，就给你的钓友莫比打电话！
✆ 哟，钓友！

entries.en: Listen. Glowing Mushrooms don't seem to be too good for my health. About time I tried something else. You got anything, chum?
entries.zh: 听我说，发光蘑菇好像对身体不太好。也该换点别的试试了。你手头有别的没，钓友？
不错。

entries.en: You are no chum of mine.
entries.zh: 你可不是我的钓友。

entries.en: Where I live, vegetables aren't really an option. No sunlight, you see. Could you get me some?
entries.zh: 我住的地方根本种不了蔬菜。你知道的，没有阳光。能给我弄一些吗？

entries.en: You know you should live life in moderation. Too much of anything is no good. Balance is key.
entries.zh: 你知道生活该有节制。任何事太过都不好。平衡才是关键。

entries.en: Welp. Meat is good too, I suppose.
entries.zh: 唉。我想肉也不错。
补货，补货！

entries.en: Thanks! I'm headed back to my shop, hope to see you there soon!
entries.zh: 谢谢！我这就回店里了，希望很快能在那里见到你！

entries.en: I see. Hopefully next time I see you, you won't be needing anything that requires anything from me...
entries.zh: 我明白了。希望下次见你时，你不会需要任何得向我索取材料的东西……

entries.en: Hey, you got some wheat for my pets by any chance? Gotta keep those little monsters fed, haha!
entries.zh: 嘿，你这儿有没有小麦，给我的宠物们吃点？这群小馋鬼可饿不得，哈哈！

entries.en: You know how it is, they never stop eating haha, thank you very much!
entries.zh: 你也知道，这些小家伙的嘴就没停过，哈哈。真是太谢谢你了！

entries.en: Oh, you're out of wheat? Alright, I'll come back later then.
entries.zh: 哦，你的小麦没了？好吧，那我之后再来。

entries.en: My old buddy was a Wart Dealer...I miss him, and his Wart.
entries.zh: 我的老伙计以前是个地狱疣商人……我想念他，也想念他的疣。

entries.en: I'm glad that you're keeping him in your memories.
entries.zh: 我很高兴你还把他记在心里。

entries.en: His memory will soon be lost, like tears in rain.
entries.zh: 他的记忆很快会消失，就像雨中的泪水。

entries.en: There's pests everywhere. I can smell 'em in the walls!
entries.zh: 到处都是害虫。我在墙里都能闻到它们的味道！

entries.en: Thanks mate, this should help me catch 'em!
entries.zh: 谢了伙计，这些应该能帮我抓住它们！

entries.en: Hm, how strange.. you smell just like 'em..
entries.zh: 嗯，真奇怪……你闻起来就和它们一样……

entries.en: The figure hands you a slip of paper.
entries.zh: 那道身影递给你一张纸条。

entries.en: The figure nods at you and shambles away.
entries.zh: 那道身影朝你点了点头，蹒跚着离开了。

entries.en: The figure glares at you and shambles away.
entries.zh: 那道身影瞪了你一眼，蹒跚着离开了。

entries.en: Let Phillip finish teaching you about Pests, then come chat with me!
entries.zh: 先让菲利普把害虫的事教完，再来找我聊聊吧！

entries.en: You know, having dealt with Pests for so long, I'm starting to find them kinda cute!
entries.zh: 你知道吗，跟害虫打交道久了，我居然开始觉得它们有点可爱了！

entries.en: I've even developed a way to attract certain Pests to my plots.
entries.zh: 我甚至琢磨出了一种办法，能把特定的害虫引到我的地皮上。
看好了！这就是喷雾器！

entries.en: Its patented technology transforms organic matter into aromas that only Pests can smell.
entries.zh: 它采用的专利技术能把有机物转化成只有害虫才能闻到的气味。

entries.en: Go see for yourself. Take this Tasty Cheese and use the Sprayonator to spray a plot.
entries.zh: 自己试试看吧。拿着这些美味奶酪，用喷雾器喷洒一块地皮。

entries.en: Then use your vacuum to catch a Rat Pest in that plot!
entries.zh: 然后用吸尘器在那块地皮里抓一只老鼠害虫！

entries.en: Take the Sprayonator and get to spraying!
entries.zh: 拿上喷雾器，开始喷洒吧！
谢谢你送来的%1$s 害虫，%2$s!

entries.en: In exchange for %1$s Pests, I've given you %2$s%3$s Farming Fortune for %4$s!
entries.zh: 你交来的 %1$s 只害虫，换来了 %2$s %3$s 农业时运，持续 %4$s!

entries.en: You've exchanged enough Pests with me recently. You still have %1$s Pests in your Vacuum Bag!
entries.zh: 你最近送来的害虫已经够多了。你的吸尘袋里还有 %1$s 只害虫。

entries.en: Come back soon when I can handle more!
entries.zh: 过会儿再来吧，等我腾出手就能继续收了！

entries.en: Sorry for the intrusion, but I got a report of a Pest outbreak around here?
entries.zh: 不好意思打扰了，不过我接到报告，说这附近闹了害虫？
呃……虫子？祸害？讨厌的小东西？你懂的……就是害虫！

entries.en: They seem to pop up when you're breaking crops on your Garden!
entries.zh: 你在自己的花园里收割作物时，它们好像就会冒出来！

entries.en: Okay, feller. Take this SkyMart Vacuum!
entries.zh: 好吧，拿着这把天空超市吸尘器！

entries.en: There's a Pest out there somewhere, I'm certain of it.
entries.zh: 外面肯定有只害虫，我敢打包票。

entries.en: When you find one, simply aim the vacuum, hold down the button, and you can suck them buggers up real quick!
entries.zh: 找到它之后，只要拿吸尘器瞄准，按住按键，就能很快把这小坏蛋吸进去！

entries.en: When you've done that, come back and tell me all about how much fun you had!
entries.zh: 抓到以后回来跟我说说，玩得有多过瘾！

entries.en: Go out there and vacuum a Pest!
entries.zh: 快去，用吸尘器抓只害虫来！

entries.en: It's not hard. Just aim, hold down the button, and don't stop until the bug's been squashed!
entries.zh: 不难的。瞄准，按住按键，不把虫子收拾掉就别松手！

entries.en: Wow! Look at that ugly thing. Bet you had a blast trying to wrangle it into your vacuum!
entries.zh: 哇！瞧这丑东西。把它弄进吸尘器肯定很过瘾吧！

entries.en: To each their own. I'm fascinated by these little fellers!
entries.zh: 各有所好嘛。我可太喜欢这些小家伙了！

entries.en: Bring some back for me to, uh...study...and I'll reward you with ☘ Farming Fortune for your troubles!
entries.zh: 带些回来让我，呃……研究研究……我会给你 ☘ 农业时运作为辛苦费！
谢谢你送来的害虫，%1$s!

entries.en: Vacuum more Pests and exchange them with me to gain even more ☘ Farming Fortune!
entries.zh: 多吸些害虫来跟我交换，就能获得更多 ☘ 农业时运！

entries.en: Yer know, standing 'ere all day with nothing to do gets pretty borin' at times.
entries.zh: 你知道，每天站在这儿无事可做，有时还真挺无聊的。

entries.en: If you want my contact, how about you bring me somethin' to keep me occupied, eh?
entries.zh: 想要我的联系方式？那就带点能让我解闷的东西来，怎么样？

entries.en: A Squeaky Toy would do the trick.
entries.zh: 一个吱吱玩具就不错。

entries.en: You hearin' me? Bring me one of those and you can have my contact.
entries.zh: 听清楚了吧？给我带一个来，联系方式就给你。
哎，你这是干什么呢？

entries.en: Quit yer playin' and bring me a Squeaky Toy or you ain't getting my contact!
entries.zh: 别逗我了，带个吱吱玩具来，不然别想要我的联系方式！

entries.en: You can sometimes find 'em after vacuuming up a Field Mouse. You can only catch those rare little guys in Pest Traps.
entries.zh: 用吸尘器抓到田鼠后，有时就能找到。那些稀罕的小家伙，只能用害虫陷阱抓到。

entries.en: I heard somebody 'round here sells them. Oh - it's me!
entries.zh: 听说这附近有人卖那东西。哦——就是我！
谢啦，这就行了！

entries.en: To be honest with ya, though, I have no use for this toy.
entries.zh: 不过跟你说实话吧，这玩具我还真用不上。

entries.en: I just ask for it because it gets people buying a bunch of Pest Traps from me in order to go about getting it.
entries.zh: 我之所以要它，就是想让大家为了弄到它，来我这儿多买些害虫陷阱。

entries.en: Waddya call that, a pyramid scheme? Ponzi scheme? I don't know... I just call it bein' me.
entries.zh: 你管这叫什么，传销？庞氏骗局？我也说不准……反正我就这德性。

entries.en: Anyways, here's that contact you was after.
entries.zh: 总之，你要的联系方式拿好。

entries.en: See ya around, my partner in pesthuntin'!
entries.zh: 回头见，我的捕虫搭档！

entries.en: Don't tell my wife I said that.
entries.zh: 可别告诉我妻子，我刚才这么说过。
请选择: [什么是害虫？]

entries.en: Select an option: [What am I supposed to do about this?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [那我该怎么办？]
请选择: [还行吧。]

entries.en: I once dumped a magical water bucket into the toilet. It won't stop overflowing. Anyway, you got something for me?
entries.zh: 我之前用魔法水桶往马桶里倒过水，结果它到现在还在往外冒水。先不说这个了，我要的东西有了吗？

entries.en: Thanks. That should help me fix my water troubles.
entries.zh: 谢了。这下我的水患应该有救了。

entries.en: I guess I'll just try to fix it myself.
entries.zh: 看来我只能自己试着修了。
碰上水患了？没问题！
✆ 我的阿比手机联系方式？没问题！

entries.en: ✆ Call me during business hours and I'll help with your water troubles at a discount!
entries.zh: ✆ 营业时间给我打电话，我就能帮你解决水患，还给你打折！

entries.en: Water troubles? You know I'm on it!
entries.zh: 碰上水患了？包在我身上！

entries.en: ✆ Please only call me during business hours.
entries.zh: ✆ 麻烦只在营业时间给我打电话。

entries.en: ✆ If there's really an emergency, come and see me!
entries.zh: ✆ 真有急事的话，就过来找我！

entries.en: I'm very hungry. Give me the Enchanted Cake!
entries.zh: 我非常饿。把附魔蛋糕给我！

entries.en: You know, that wasn't too bad.
entries.zh: 你知道吗，这还不赖。
不！我不要那个！

entries.en: Fancy seeing you here, friend! Today is a special day for me, as I am seeing Juliette! Think you can help me get her some flowers?
entries.zh: 真巧啊，朋友！今天对我很特别，因为我要去见朱丽叶！你能帮我给她弄些花吗？

entries.en: You're a lifesaver! Today's going to be the best day ever! Well, after my wedding day, that is.
entries.zh: 你真是救星！今天会是最棒的一天！当然，仅次于我的婚礼那天。

entries.en: Just because I see Juliette every day doesn't mean it's not a reason to celebrate.
entries.zh: 我每天都见朱丽叶，不代表这就不值得庆祝。

entries.en: Ever wondered how I find all the things that other players lost? I outsource it. Right now, someone is looking for their %1$s. Can you find that for me?
entries.zh: 想过我是怎么找回其他玩家丢失的东西的吗？我外包了。现在有人正在找他们的%1$s。你能替我找来吗？

entries.en: There we go, a job well done. I'll make sure to leave a good review for you!
entries.zh: 这就对了，活干得漂亮。我一定会给你留个好评！

entries.en: Turns out, if you want something done, you have to do it yourself.
entries.zh: 看来想把事情办成，还是得亲自来。

entries.en: Welcome, fellow member of the Campfire Cult. It is time to embrace the Campfire within and sacrifice something. What that something should be is an interesting question. I am thinking potato. Yes. Yes, a good baked potato does sound very good right now.
entries.zh: 欢迎，营火教团的同伴。是时候拥抱内心的营火并献祭些什么了。该献祭什么是个有趣的问题。我想是土豆。对。对，一颗好烤土豆现在听起来确实很不错。

entries.en: Come, my brethren, and let us rejoice!
entries.zh: 来吧，我的兄弟姐妹们，让我们欢庆吧！

entries.en: Did you know that there is a Garden Level? Increase it by hitting milestones or selling to customers like me!
entries.zh: 你知道花园还有等级吗？达成里程碑，或者把东西卖给我这样的顾客，等级就能往上涨！
这买卖划算！
没关系。

entries.en: I am so excited to have you here!
entries.zh: 你能来我真是太开心了！

entries.en: You can come to me anytime you need help, but first let's clear out a plot to grow your crops.
entries.zh: 需要帮忙随时来找我，不过咱们得先清出一块地来种庄稼。

entries.en: For that however... I need some Compost... If you can bring me some Wheat, I can make some Compost out of it!
entries.zh: 不过要清地……得先有堆肥……你要是能给我弄些小麦来，我就能拿它做出堆肥！

entries.en: Now I can finally produce some Compost... let's head inside!
entries.zh: 这下总算能做堆肥了……咱们进屋去！
你看这台机器……

entries.en: It produces Compost when you put crops inside of it... somehow... but that's what I need to increase the amount of plots we can have! So exciting!
entries.zh: 把庄稼丢进去，它就能产出堆肥……原理我也说不清……但有了堆肥，咱们能开的地皮数量就能变多！想想就激动！

entries.en: It needs machine fuel to operate... luckily we can order fuel online!
entries.zh: 它得靠机器燃料才能运转……好在燃料可以直接网购！

entries.en: Head over to the desk, there you can browse SkyMart to order some fuel.
entries.zh: 去管理台那边，打开天空超市就能下单买燃料。

entries.en: Remember, you can order fuel from the Desk nearby.
entries.zh: 记得，燃料可以在旁边的管理台下单。

entries.en: Great! Now, you can go open the composter and put the fuel in there, and it'll start doing... whatever it does!
entries.zh: 太好了！现在去打开堆肥器，把燃料放进去，它就会开始……嗯，干它该干的事！

entries.en: Have you refuelled the Composter yet?
entries.zh: 你给堆肥器加燃料了吗？
哦，堆肥器做好了！

entries.en: We can finally free up a plot! Take out the compost when you are ready!
entries.zh: 终于能腾出一块地了！准备好了就把堆肥取出来吧！

entries.en: Amazing!!! We got ourselves a brand new plot!
entries.zh: 太棒了！!! 咱们有一块崭新的地啦！

entries.en: Now to the dirty part... the plot has to be cleaned up before it can be used...
entries.zh: 接下来是脏活……这块地得先清理干净才能用……

entries.en: Head over to your unlocked plot and try to clean it up a bit and then come back to me once you've done so!
entries.zh: 去你刚解锁的那块地，把它收拾收拾，弄完了再回来找我！
对了，这个给你。

entries.en: Oh, I think you forgot to take this!
entries.zh: 哦，你好像忘了拿这个！

entries.en: This Scythe will help you clean your plot even faster!
entries.zh: 有了这把镰刀，清地能快不少！

entries.en: It looks like one of your co-op members already purchased a plot, but you should go help them clean it up!
entries.zh: 看来你的合作伙伴已经买下一块地了，不过你也该去搭把手，一起清理！
太好了，你找到了！

entries.en: I believe in you. Go make it sparkly clean!
entries.zh: 我相信你。去把它收拾得亮堂堂的！

entries.en: Wow! It's squeaky clean over there, you did so well!
entries.zh: 哇！那边收拾得一尘不染，你太厉害了！

entries.en: Now you can grow crops you've unlocked there!
entries.zh: 现在你可以在那儿种已解锁的作物了！

entries.en: To save you a bit of time, you can also use a preset farm at your desk!
entries.zh: 想省点时间的话，也可以在管理台用预设农田！

entries.en: Come and talk to me when you've finished up on your Plot!
entries.zh: 你那块地忙完了就来找我聊聊！

entries.en: However, it looks like one of your co-op members already did that!
entries.zh: 不过，看起来你的合作伙伴已经把这事办好了！

entries.en: I have an idea! Why don't you collect me some Wheat and I'll bake us some lovely bread for dinner!
entries.zh: 我有个主意！你去给我收点小麦，我来烤几块香喷喷的面包当晚饭！
求你啦……!!

entries.en: To bake us some bread, I think I need about 100 Wheat.
entries.zh: 要烤面包的话，我估计得要 100 个小麦。

entries.en: That shouldn't be a problem for someone like you, right?
entries.zh: 对你这样的人来说，不成问题吧？

entries.en: Wow, that was quick! Here, take some fresh bread! *nom* *nom*
entries.zh: 哇，这么快！来，尝尝刚出炉的面包！ *吧唧* *吧唧*

entries.en: It's pretty tasty. But it seems like we still have some dozen Wheat left over and our Composter is already full...
entries.zh: 真好吃。不过好像还剩下几十个小麦，而堆肥器已经装满了……

entries.en: Oh, I have an idea! We could open a small stand and sell our Wheat to other people!
entries.zh: 哦，我有主意了！咱们可以支个小摊，把小麦卖给别人！

entries.en: Don't be selfish! This Wheat is too good to waste. We've got enough to share with everyone!
entries.zh: 别这么小气嘛！这么好的小麦浪费了多可惜。咱们多得很，够分给大家的！

entries.en: We need to set up a stand somewhere...
entries.zh: 咱们得找个地方支摊子……

entries.en: I think this spot would work perfectly!
entries.zh: 我看这个位置就再合适不过了！

entries.en: Oh, we already have our first customer! How exciting, I wonder what they want! Can you check on them?
entries.zh: 哦，第一位顾客已经上门了！好激动，不知道对方想要什么！你去招呼一下？

entries.en: Your first customer is right in front of you!
entries.zh: 你的第一位顾客就在你眼前！

entries.en: Go ahead and talk to them to see what they need!
entries.zh: 去跟对方聊聊，看看需要什么！

entries.en: Wow we did it! We served our first customer!
entries.zh: 哇，成功了！咱们接待了第一位顾客！

entries.en: Keep checking back on them, I am sure more people will visit our farm soon.
entries.zh: 记得常回来看看，我敢说很快就会有更多人来咱们农场的。

entries.en: Besides that, you can always go check the desk to find out what to do next!
entries.zh: 另外，不知道接下来做什么的话，随时可以去管理台看看！
那我先回外面去了。

entries.en: What's this? ... A blueprint for a Greenhouse?!
entries.zh: 这是什么？ ……温室的设计图？!

entries.en: Do you know what this means??
entries.zh: 你知道这意味着什么吗？?

entries.en: We can build our very own Greenhouse!
entries.zh: 咱们可以建一座属于自己的温室了！

entries.en: I'm so excited, I can't wait to get started on it!
entries.zh: 太激动了，我等不及要动工了！

entries.en: I'm sorry, I just can't help myself. Let me calm myself down a bit.
entries.zh: 抱歉，我实在按捺不住。让我先冷静一下。
*深呼吸声*

entries.en: Alright, I feel better now. First we need to gather some resources to build the Greenhouse.
entries.zh: 好了，我缓过来了。首先，咱们得凑齐建温室的材料。
