entries.en: Looking at the blueprint, it seems we need about 64 Enchanted Oak Logs and ...? 128 Enchanted Sand??
entries.zh: 照设计图看，大概需要 64 个附魔橡木原木，还有……? 128 个附魔沙子？?

entries.en: If you can find these items, we'll be one step closer to building our very own Greenhouse!
entries.zh: 只要你能找齐这些东西，咱们离自己的温室就更近一步了！

entries.en: Remember, you should go to the Desk and select one of your plots.
entries.zh: 记得去管理台，选一块你的地。

entries.en: Then, you should convert it to a Greenhouse.
entries.zh: 然后把它改建成温室。

entries.en: Wow, it looks even better than I imagined!
entries.zh: 哇，比我想象中还要漂亮！

entries.en: Now, let's get to work. It's time to plant our first crop.
entries.zh: 好了，开工吧。该种下咱们的第一株作物了。

entries.en: Why don't you do the honor? Here, take this carrot and plant it in the Greenhouse!
entries.zh: 这份荣誉就交给你了！来，拿着这根胡萝卜，把它种进温室！

entries.en: Inside the Greenhouse, crops usually grow at a much slower speed than normal, but they will also yield way more!
entries.zh: 温室里的作物长得比平时慢得多，但产量也高得多！

entries.en: Nice! But crops need water to grow. Use this watering can to water the plot.
entries.zh: 不错！但作物得浇水才能生长。用这把洒水壶给地皮浇浇水。

entries.en: Watering a crop inside the Greenhouse is different than normal.
entries.zh: 在温室里浇水和平时不一样。

entries.en: In here, you need to water crops from time to time to keep them healthy.
entries.zh: 在这里，你得时不时浇一浇，作物才能长得健康。
不然它们会彻底干枯的！

entries.en: Just aim the can at the crop you want to water and hold right-click!
entries.zh: 把洒水壶对准想浇的作物，按住右键就行！

entries.en: Look at that! It's already growing! It should be ready to harvest soon.
entries.zh: 快看！它已经在长了！应该很快就能收获。

entries.en: It's fully grown! You should be able to harvest it now.
entries.zh: 长熟了！现在可以收获了。

entries.en: Amazing! We've done it! Our very first harvest from the Greenhouse. You've really got the hang of this.
entries.zh: 太棒了！成功了！温室里的第一次收成。你已经完全上手了。

entries.en: Now that you are familiar with the basics, let's move on to the more advanced techniques.
entries.zh: 基础你已经熟悉了，接下来讲点进阶的技巧。

entries.en: Planted crops in your Greenhouse apply buffs and debuffs to nearby crops!
entries.zh: 温室里种下的作物会给旁边的作物施加增益或减益！
咱们直观地演示一下。

entries.en: Take these Carrot x2 and plant them next to each other in the Greenhouse.
entries.zh: 拿上这 2 根胡萝卜，把它们并排种进温室。

entries.en: And don't forget to water them!
entries.zh: 别忘了浇水！

entries.en: Remember, you need to plant 2 Wheat crops next to each other.
entries.zh: 记住，要把 2 株小麦并排种下。

entries.en: Then, water them so they grow strong and healthy.
entries.zh: 然后给它们浇水，让它们长得壮壮的。

entries.en: Once you do that, I'll show you a neat trick!
entries.zh: 弄好之后，我教你一个小妙招！

entries.en: Nice! Now that both plants are growing, take this Plant Diagnostics Tool to learn how crops are affected by each other.
entries.zh: 不错！两株都在长了，拿上这个植物诊断工具，看看作物之间是怎么互相影响的。

entries.en: It's also great for knowing when a crop will finish growing or how much water it needs!
entries.zh: 它还能告诉你作物什么时候长熟、还需要多少水！

entries.en: Why don't you try it out right now?
entries.zh: 现在就试试吧？

entries.en: Try to use the Plant Diagnostics Tool on a crop to understand it better!
entries.zh: 对着作物用一下植物诊断工具，更好地了解它！

entries.en: Great job! I think you are ready to learn about mutations now!
entries.zh: 干得漂亮！我看你可以学学变异作物了！

entries.en: Sometimes, when you grow certain crops next to each other, a mutation will eventually sprout nearby. This doesn't always need to be on dirt!
entries.zh: 有时候，把某些作物挨着种，附近就会冒出一株变异作物。而且它不一定非得长在泥土上！

entries.en: There are lots of mutations that exist and they are quite interesting to discover, however I really only know how to spread one of them.
entries.zh: 变异作物有很多种，一一发现它们很有意思，不过我只知道其中一种的培育方法。

entries.en: From what I remember, all you need to do is plant 2x Seeds side by side. Make sure to leave space for the mutation to spread!
entries.zh: 我记得，只要把 2 份种子并排种下就行。记得留出空位，好让变异作物长出来！

entries.en: From what I remember, all you need to do is surround an empty piece of farmland with 4x Wheat Crops, in a plus shape!
entries.zh: 我记得，只要用 4 株小麦把一格空耕地围成十字形就行！

entries.en: I have a few seeds left for you to try it out for yourself!
entries.zh: 我还剩几份种子，给你自己试试！

entries.en: Hmmmm I think that's right. I watered them too so they grow strong and healthy!
entries.zh: 嗯……我觉得这样就对了。我也给它们浇过水了，保准长得壮壮的！
哇，成功了！

entries.en: Go ahead and harvest the mutated crop. Right there, in the middle of the wheat!
entries.zh: 去把那株变异作物收了吧。就在那儿，小麦中间！

entries.en: You are pretty much a Greenhouse Expert now!
entries.zh: 现在你差不多算温室专家了！

entries.en: I taught you all I know about Greenhouses, you are on your own from now on!
entries.zh: 关于温室我知道的都教给你了，接下来就靠你自己啦！

entries.en: If you have any more questions, you can talk to the Carpenter in the Greenhouse.
entries.zh: 还有什么问题的话，可以去温室里找木匠聊聊。

entries.en: Oh wow, is that gift for me?
entries.zh: 哇，这是送给我的礼物吗？

entries.en: I'll make sure to find a nice place for it!
entries.zh: 我一定给它找个好地方摆着！

entries.en: Looks like your HydroCan ran out of water, you can simply refill it by right-clicking on any water block! [I GET IT]
entries.zh: 看来你的水力壶没水，对着任意水方块右键就能加满！ [我懂了]

entries.en: When you paste a crop preset onto your Plot, it will plant any specified resource from your inventory. So cool!
entries.zh: 往地皮上粘贴作物预设时，它会自动从你物品栏里取材料种下去。太酷了！

entries.en: As your Garden Level increases from working on the farm, you'll be able to harvest more crops. Amazing!
entries.zh: 在农场里忙活能提升花园等级，等级越高，能种的作物就越多。太棒了！

entries.en: Make sure your composter has enough resources! It won't start making more compost if it doesn't have the full materials to do it.
entries.zh: 记得给堆肥器备足材料！材料不够的话，它是不会开工做堆肥的。

entries.en: Oh, have you met my friends here? They like to host farming contests and sell cool new tools!
entries.zh: 哦，见过我这儿的朋友们了吗？他们喜欢办农业竞赛，还卖各种新奇的工具！

entries.en: As you interact with more NPCs in the game, more kinds of customers will show up to buy stuff.
entries.zh: 你在游戏里接触的 NPC 越多，来买东西的顾客种类就越多。

entries.en: I love spring! It's not too hot or too cold, it's perfect!
entries.zh: 我最爱春天了！不冷不热，刚刚好！
外面好暖和！

entries.en: I should go out with my friends soon, maybe get some ice cream.
entries.zh: 我该找朋友们出去玩玩了，顺便吃个冰淇淋。
树叶五颜六色的，真好看！
外面好冷！

entries.en: Make sure you're keeping yourself warm.
entries.zh: 记得注意保暖哦。
啊，你好呀，客人！

entries.en: Meet me on your own island for help.
entries.zh: 想找我帮忙的话，回你自己的岛上来见我。

entries.en: Amazing!!! We got ourselves a brand new plot!!
entries.zh: 太棒了！!! 咱们有一块崭新的地啦！

entries.en: Do you have any pumpkins I can wear as a mask while down in the Glacite Tunnels?
entries.zh: 你有南瓜能让我在极冰矿道里当面具戴吗？

entries.en: Thanks, hopefully I'll be safe with this to hide behind!
entries.zh: 谢谢，希望有这个遮着我就安全了！

entries.en: You want me to go back down there with nothing to hide behind? Bro...
entries.zh: 你想让我什么遮挡都没有就回到下面去？兄弟……

entries.en: Wanting to buy something from me? I got some pretty fancy tuxedos for sale, for a price of a small fortune.
entries.zh: 想买点什么？我这儿有几套相当气派的燕尾服，就是得花上一小笔身家。

entries.en: Wow, don't you look dashing with that! Pleasure doing business with you.
entries.zh: 哎呀，这身穿在你身上真精神！合作愉快。

entries.en: *sigh* You're missing out on some awfully fancy gear.
entries.zh: *叹气* 你错过了一些相当华丽的装备。

entries.en: Hey kid, I haven't seen you in a while. Arachne's powers are growing day by day. Soon she'll take over the Spider's Den.
entries.zh: 嘿孩子，好久没见你了。阿拉克涅的力量日渐增强。很快她就会占领蜘蛛巢穴。

entries.en: The evil doesn't defeat itself. You should come to the Spider's Den again when you are free.
entries.zh: 邪恶不会自己被打败。你有空该再来蜘蛛巢穴。
愿平安与你同在。

entries.en: Welcome to my keep, my sheep are some of the best in the world.
entries.zh: 欢迎来我的牧场！我养的羊，可是世界上数一数二的。

entries.en: They have regenerative properties that allow for them to regenerate their wool faster than normal!
entries.zh: 它们长毛可快了，刚剪完没多久就又长齐了！
今天实在有点累。

entries.en: Could you shear all my sheep at once?
entries.zh: 能帮我一口气把这些羊的毛都剪了吗？

entries.en: I will have a reward if you do so!
entries.zh: 剪完了，我有谢礼给你！
还有羊没剪到呢！
多谢你帮忙！

entries.en: Please accept this as a token of my gratitude!
entries.zh: 一点心意，收下吧！

entries.en: My sheep are some of the best in the world!
entries.zh: 我养的羊，可是世界上数一数二的！

entries.en: My helmet is constantly breaking. Could you provide me with some Pumpkins to help with maintenance?
entries.zh: 我的头盔老是坏。你能给我些南瓜用于维护吗？

entries.en: Thank you, I'll never run out of Pumpkins!
entries.zh: 谢谢，我再也不会缺南瓜了！

entries.en: I'll look elsewhere for more Pumpkins.
entries.zh: 我会去别处找更多南瓜。

entries.en: For the holidays, we're offering exclusive doorbuster deals for the whole family to enjoy!
entries.zh: 过节啦！我们推出了独家超值优惠，全家都能来享受！

entries.en: Check out our new Festive Sinker, which is great for fishing up Gifts!
entries.zh: 来看看我们新出的节庆坠子吧，用它来钓礼物特别合适！

entries.en: We are also offering Frosty the Snow Blaster, an upgraded Snow Cannon that shoots much farther!
entries.zh: 我们还卖冰霜雪球枪，是雪炮的升级版，射得远多了！

entries.en: It seems like my brew selection is rather small...I've recently heard that melon juice is really sought after so maybe it can enhance my drinks' flavors!
entries.zh: 我这儿的酿饮种类好像是有点少……最近听说西瓜汁特别抢手，没准加进去能让我的饮品更好喝！

entries.en: Well done! I'm sure that even Sirius will enjoy my revolutionary melon refreshments.
entries.zh: 干得漂亮！我这款全新西瓜特饮，就连西里乌斯喝了肯定都说好。

entries.en: What a pity! Enjoy the Bartender's terrible and unrefreshing mixins.
entries.zh: 真可惜！好好享受酒保那难喝又不解渴的混饮吧。

entries.en: I've always wanted to start a farm but instead I got sucked into this life of crim...I mean business!
entries.zh: 我一直想开个农场，可我却被卷进这罪……我是说生意人的生活！

entries.en: This smell... it reminds me of my childhood when I used to pick flowers in the garden. Keep this between you and me, understand?
entries.zh: 这味道……让我想起小时候在花园摘花的日子。这件事就你我知道，明白吗？

entries.en: I'll be back. I know you'll make the right decision.
entries.zh: 我会回来的。我知道你会做出正确选择。

entries.en: Man, coming back here after being in space for so long feels really good.
entries.zh: 老兄，在太空待了那么久再回到这里，感觉真好。

entries.en: Something I have been craving for a while is %1$s, they unfortunately do not grow in space.
entries.zh: 我惦记%1$s已经很久了，可惜太空里长不出来。

entries.en: You are amazing, thank you so much.
entries.zh: 你太厉害了，非常感谢。
我相当失望。

entries.en: Golly gee - I want to spread joy around the world, in the form of raw materials!
entries.zh: 天哪——我想把快乐以原材料的形式散播到全世界！

entries.en: Your help has been the greatest gift of all.
entries.zh: 你的帮助是最珍贵的礼物。

entries.en: Without your help, I can only supply plain white gifts this holiday.
entries.zh: 没有你的帮助，这个节日我只能供应普通的白色礼物。

entries.en: The amount of plots you can unlock here is perfect for a Co-op. So much space!
entries.zh: 这里能解锁的地皮数量非常适合 Co-op。空间真多！
好选择！

entries.en: Don't worry, I'll come back later.
entries.zh: 别担心，我之后会再来。
嘿，我是塔尔博特！

entries.en: ✆ You want my Abiphone Contact, don't you?
entries.zh: ✆ 你是来要我的阿比手机联系方式的吧？

entries.en: ✆ I should warn you, though, the connection can be a bit spotty around these parts!
entries.zh: ✆ 不过先说好，这附近的信号不太稳定！

entries.en: ✆ How about you bring me 100 Pelts? Do that and I'll give you my contact.
entries.zh: ✆ 带 100 张毛皮给我怎么样？带来了，我就给你联系方式。
✆ 你的毛皮不够啊！
✆ 我要的是 100 张……

entries.en: ✆ Thanks for the pelts! A man can never have enough of them.
entries.zh: ✆ 谢啦！毛皮这东西，再多也不嫌多。

entries.en: ✆ Give me a call whenever you need to use my shop!
entries.zh: ✆ 想买东西，随时打电话给我！

entries.en: I've been planning to build a trap for unaware animals so I can hunt them more efficiently. I really need some cactus, preferably the ones with the biggest spikes!
entries.zh: 我打算做个陷阱，趁动物没防备时逮住它们，打猎也能省点事。正缺些仙人掌，最好挑刺最大的！

entries.en: Amazing! Thanks for taking the time! Now, time to finish my Cactus Trap...and hopefully it boosts my pelt earnings.
entries.zh: 太好了！谢谢你专门跑这一趟！该去把我的仙人掌陷阱做完了……希望能多赚点毛皮。

entries.en: You can't tell me that you couldn't find a single cactus...
entries.zh: 你可别告诉我，你连一株仙人掌都找不到……
你好，冒险者。

entries.en: I have a pretty dashing cosmetic if you would care to exchange it for some rare crops.
entries.zh: 我有件相当帅气的饰品，愿意用它换些稀有作物吗？

entries.en: I can see you value fashion over most farmers!
entries.zh: 看得出来，你比大多数农夫更看重时尚！
谢啦！
真可惜。

entries.en: Make sure to check out my Fashion Shop in the Hub to see if there's something you'd like more.
entries.zh: 记得去主城的时装店看看，说不定有你更喜欢的东西。

entries.en: Ahoy, %1$s! People always tell me they like ice cream, but ice never really tastes like anything for me!
entries.zh: 嘿哟，%1$s! 大伙儿都说喜欢吃冰淇淋，可冰在我嘴里从来就没什么味道！

entries.en: You are saying I need to combine these items with ice to have a taste? I'll believe it when I see it!
entries.zh: 你是说把这些东西和冰掺在一起就有味道了？眼见为实，我得亲自试试！

entries.en: I'll keep crunching on those ice cubes, maybe I am missing something.
entries.zh: 那我接着嚼我的冰块吧，说不定是我漏了什么门道。

entries.en: You are currently missing %1$s Fairy Souls. Better get to work!
entries.zh: 你还缺 %1$s 枚仙女之魂。赶紧去找吧！

entries.en: You collected every single Fairy Soul?!? Amazing!
entries.zh: 你把仙女之魂全都收齐了？!? 太厉害了！
这正是我需要的！

entries.en: Alright, I won't bother you anymore.
entries.zh: 好吧，我不打扰你了。

entries.en: I don't have a recipe for you, however I'd happily take some crops.
entries.zh: 我没什么配方给你，不过很乐意收些作物。

entries.en: I'll be sure to come by next time.
entries.zh: 我下次一定会再来。

entries.en: No problem, see ya next time!
entries.zh: 没问题，下次见！

entries.en: I ordered a snack down to my room in the Catacombs. Took them years to find me, and even then they forgot the toppings!
entries.zh: 我在地下墓穴的房间点了份零食。他们花了好几年才找到我，结果还忘了配料！

entries.en: Sometimes you just have to take matters into your own hands, you know?
entries.zh: 有时候，事情就是得自己亲手办，你知道吧？

entries.en: I didn't expect you of all people to let me down...
entries.zh: 我真没想到你会让我失望……
✆ 哟，兄弟，最近怎么样？

entries.en: ✆ Such lovely weather in this little ol' cave today, isn't it?
entries.zh: ✆ 今天这小破山洞里天气真不错，你说是吧？

entries.en: ✆ I guess you want my Abiphone Contact, huh?
entries.zh: ✆ 我猜你是想要我的阿比手机联系方式，对吧？

entries.en: ✆ Well, I'll give you it if you play a game with me.
entries.zh: ✆ 陪我玩个游戏，我就给你。

entries.en: ✆ Not much else to do around here, really.
entries.zh: ✆ 说真的，这儿也没什么别的乐子。

entries.en: ✆ How about you guess my favorite animal?
entries.zh: ✆ 猜猜我最喜欢什么动物，怎么样？

entries.en: ✆ I'll let you know if you get it right.
entries.zh: ✆ 猜对了我就告诉你。

entries.en: ✆ Haha yeah, my favorite animal is a horse.
entries.zh: ✆ 哈哈，没错，我最喜欢的是马。
✆ 有你的，兄弟。

entries.en: ✆ Well, I'm a man of my word. Here's my contact.
entries.zh: ✆ 说到做到，这是我的联系方式。

entries.en: I'm the Treasure Hunter, I've been searching for treasure all over this island.
entries.zh: 我是寻宝人，这座岛上到处都留下过我寻宝的足迹。

entries.en: Rumor has it that there are rare stones and other valuable bounty hidden in the ground all over the island.
entries.zh: 听说岛上各处的地下，都埋着稀有的石头和其他值钱的宝贝。

entries.en: Tell you what, for a small price I'll give you the info I know about.
entries.zh: 这样吧，给我一点报酬，我就把知道的消息告诉你。

entries.en: Are you trying to scam me?
entries.zh: 你想空手套情报啊？
你的钱不够。

entries.en: Come back when you have enough for the tip.
entries.zh: 凑够情报费再来吧。
忘了我给的线索？

entries.en: Just for you I'll tell you it again at no charge!
entries.zh: 这回算你走运，我免费再说一遍！

entries.en: Remember, you need to DIG to find the treasure!
entries.zh: 记住，想找到宝藏，得动手挖！

entries.en: Sorry I dont have any more info.
entries.zh: 抱歉，我没别的消息了。

entries.en: Come back in 3 SkyBlock days and I might know something new.
entries.zh: 过 3 个空岛日再来，也许到时就有新消息了。

entries.en: Glad to see you again adventurer!
entries.zh: 又见面了，冒险者！

entries.en: You know the drill, for a small fee I will give you some info on the treasure.
entries.zh: 规矩你懂的，给点小钱，我就告诉你一些宝藏的消息。

entries.en: In the Mushroom Gorge where blue meets the ceiling and floor, you will find what you are looking for.
entries.zh: 在蘑菇峡谷里，蓝色与洞顶、地面相接的地方，就有你要找的东西。

entries.en: I seem to recall seeing something near the well in the village.
entries.zh: 我好像在村里的水井附近见过什么。

entries.en: I saw some treasure by a cow skull near the village.
entries.zh: 我在村子附近的牛头骨旁见过宝藏。

entries.en: There's this guy who says he has the best sheep in the world. I think I saw something around his hut.
entries.zh: 有个家伙总说自己养的羊天下第一。我好像在他小屋附近看到了什么。

entries.en: I remember there was a stone pillar made only of cobblestone in the oasis, could be something there.
entries.zh: 我记得绿洲里有根全用圆石砌的柱子，那儿也许有东西。

entries.en: There was a haystack with a crop greener than usual around it, I think there is something near there.
entries.zh: 有个干草堆，旁边的作物比平常更绿。我觉得那附近有东西。

entries.en: Some dirt was kicked up by the water pool in the overgrown Mushroom Cave. Have a look over there.
entries.zh: 繁茂蘑菇洞穴的水池边有些土被翻动了。去那儿看看吧。

entries.en: There are some small ruins out in the desert, might want to check them out.
entries.zh: 沙漠里有几处小遗迹，不妨去瞧瞧。

entries.en: I was at the upper oasis today, I recall seeing something on the cobblestone stepping stones.
entries.zh: 我今天去过上层绿洲，记得在圆石踏脚石上看到了什么。

entries.en: Near a melon patch inside a tunnel in the mountain I spotted something.
entries.zh: 我在山中隧道里的一片西瓜田附近发现了点东西。

entries.en: I spotted something by an odd looking mushroom on one of the ledges in the Mushroom Gorge, you should check it out.
entries.zh: 蘑菇峡谷有处岩台，上面长着一株奇怪的蘑菇。我在它旁边发现了东西，你去瞧瞧吧。

entries.en: I was in the desert earlier, and I saw something near a red sand rock.
entries.zh: 我先前去沙漠时，在一块红沙岩石附近看到了什么。

entries.en: There's a single piece of tall grass growing in the desert, I saw something there.
entries.zh: 沙漠里孤零零长着一株高草，我在那儿看到了点东西。

entries.en: Something caught my eye by the red sand near the bridge over the gorge.
entries.zh: 峡谷上方的桥附近，红沙旁有东西引起了我的注意。

entries.en: I found something by a mossy stone pillar in the oasis, you should take a look.
entries.zh: 我在绿洲里一根覆满苔藓的石柱旁发现了东西，你该去看看。

entries.en: I saw something near a farmer's cart, you should check it out.
entries.zh: 我在农夫的推车附近看到了什么，你去瞧瞧吧。

entries.en: I thought I saw something near the smallest stone pillar in the oasis.
entries.zh: 我好像在绿洲最小的那根石柱旁看到了东西。

entries.en: I was down near the lower oasis yesterday, I think I saw something under the bridge.
entries.zh: 昨天我去过下层绿洲附近，好像在桥底下看到了什么。

entries.en: There's a treasure chest somewhere in a small cave in the gorge.
entries.zh: 峡谷的一处小洞穴里藏着宝箱。

entries.en: There's a small house in the gorge, I saw some treasure near there.
entries.zh: 峡谷里有间小屋，我在那附近见过宝藏。

entries.en: Down in the glowing Mushroom Cave, there was a weird looking mushroom, check it out.
entries.zh: 发光蘑菇洞穴深处有株模样奇怪的蘑菇，去看看吧。

entries.en: There are some old stone structures in the Mushroom Gorge, give them a look.
entries.zh: 蘑菇峡谷里有几座古老的石质建筑，去瞧瞧。

entries.en: There's this guy who collects animals to experiment on, I think I saw something near his house.
entries.zh: 有个家伙专门收集动物做实验，我好像在他家附近看到了东西。
你好啊！

entries.en: My name is Trevor, I'm a trapper who specializes in hunting animals all over this island.
entries.zh: 我叫特雷弗，是个捕猎者，专门在这座岛上追猎动物。

entries.en: I hunt animals that drop pelts, these pelts can be traded over at my friend's shop for valuables.
entries.zh: 我猎的动物会掉毛皮，拿这些毛皮去我朋友的店里，能换不少好东西。

entries.en: Talk to me again if you would like a task.
entries.zh: 想接个活儿的话，再跟我聊聊。

entries.en: You will have 10 minutes to find the mob from when you accept the task.
entries.zh: 接下任务后，你有 10 分钟找到那只动物。

entries.en: Any longer than that and the animal will run away!
entries.zh: 超过这个时间，它可就跑远了！

entries.en: If you change your mind, you know where to find me!
entries.zh: 改主意了就回来找我！

entries.en: You can find your %1$s animal near the %2$s.
entries.zh: 你的目标是一只%1$s的动物，就在%2$s附近。

entries.en: Sorry I don't have any animals for you to hunt.
entries.zh: 抱歉，现在没有能交给你追猎的动物。
过 %1$s 秒再来吧！

entries.en: You already have a mob spawned! Hunt that mob first!
entries.zh: 你的目标已经出现了！先去把那只猎到再说！

entries.en: I couldn't locate any animals. Come back in a little bit!
entries.zh: 我还没找到动物的踪迹，过会儿再来吧！

entries.en: ✆ Eh, I still have an Abiflip.
entries.zh: ✆ 呃，我还在用阿比翻盖机呢。

entries.en: ✆ It has 3 contact slots and I already have Tammy and Tony.
entries.zh: ✆ 它只能存 3 个联系人，塔米和托尼已经占了两个。

entries.en: ✆ I heard the new models are nice, but they're too smart for me!
entries.zh: ✆ 听说新款挺不错，可惜太智能了，我玩不转！

entries.en: ✆ I could add you for let's say... 24 Pelts and 1,000,000 coins?
entries.zh: ✆ 要不这样……给我 24 张毛皮和 1,000,000 硬币，我就加你，怎么样？

entries.en: ✆ That's awesome, but now my Abiflip is full.
entries.zh: ✆ 太好了，不过这下我的阿比翻盖机也存满了。

entries.en: ✆ You don't have what it takes!
entries.zh: ✆ 你还没带够我要的东西！

entries.en: ✆ I'm currently hunting! Don't call again!
entries.zh: ✆ 我正打猎呢！先别打过来了！

entries.en: I've been tracking an animal for the past few days. Got anything I could use as bait?
entries.zh: 这几天我一直在追踪一只动物。你有能让我当诱饵的东西吗？

entries.en: This should do nicely. I'll have plenty of pelts by the end of the day.
entries.zh: 这些正合适。今天结束前我会有不少毛皮。

entries.en: Looks like I'll have to catch it the old fashioned way.
entries.zh: 看来我只能用老办法抓它了。
需要一份贡品。

entries.en: This will make for the perfect sacrifice.
entries.zh: 这会成为完美的祭品。
这根本不行。

entries.en: Sometimes, Dark Candy is not enough to satiate a gnawing hunger. Something...more, is needed.
entries.zh: 有时，黑暗糖果不足以填补啃噬般的饥饿。需要……更多的东西。
我很感激你的供奉。

entries.en: I have an offer for you that you can't refuse.
entries.zh: 我有一笔你无法拒绝的交易。
我就说吧。
哦，这可尴尬了。

entries.en: I decided to take a leisurely stroll in search of inspiration, and as fate would have it - I ended up here!
entries.zh: 我决定悠闲散步寻找灵感，而命运使然——我来到了这里！

entries.en: These...these speak to me. There's something about them. You have inspired me once again!
entries.zh: 这些……这些在对我说话。它们有种特别的东西。你又一次给了我灵感！

entries.en: If you truly love nature, you will find beauty everywhere. You, my friend, need to open your eyes.
entries.zh: 如果你真正热爱自然，就会在处处发现美。我的朋友，你得睁开眼睛。

entries.en: Hey man, I just need one more vinyl to complete the full Pest Vinyl collection.
entries.zh: 嘿，我还差一张唱片，就能凑齐整套害虫唱片了。

entries.en: Finally! Thanks man, now I have another complete set!
entries.zh: 终于凑齐了！谢谢你，我又集齐了一套！

entries.en: Hey! I am looking to make some Hot Potato Books to enhance some of my weapons, do you have any potatoes to spare?
entries.zh: 嘿！我想做些土豆书强化武器，你有多余的土豆吗？

entries.en: Thanks man! I'll be sure to smear these potatoes all over my weapons, that'll sure improve 'em!
entries.zh: 谢了兄弟！我一定把这些土豆全抹在武器上，肯定能让它们变强！

entries.en: Too bad, I guess I'll have to look for actual metal next time...
entries.zh: 太可惜了，看来下次我得去找真正的金属……

entries.en: I work as the operator of this windmill.
entries.zh: 我负责操作这座风车。

entries.en: However, I seem to have broken some key components in the structure.
entries.zh: 不过，我好像把里面几个关键零件弄坏了。

entries.en: Could you help me fix it?
entries.zh: 你能帮我修好吗？

entries.en: I need a lot of string to fix the pulley system, could you bring me 64 of it?
entries.zh: 修滑轮系统需要很多线，你能给我带 64 个来吗？
这不是我需要的东西！

entries.en: I need some cobblestone to correct the base of the windmill, could you bring me 64 of it?
entries.zh: 修整风车底座需要一些圆石，你能给我带 64 个来吗？

entries.en: Now that my windmill is up and running, I'll open my shop to you so you don't have to go back to the Village.
entries.zh: 现在风车又能转起来了，我就向你开放商店吧，省得你还得跑回村庄。

entries.en: Where am I? Oh, it's you %1$s.
entries.zh: 我这是在哪儿？哦，是你啊，%1$s。

entries.en: Thank you. This should be enough potatoes to generate about %1$s volts. Might be just enough to cause a reaction.
entries.zh: 多谢。这些马铃薯应该能发出大约 %1$s 伏电压。说不定刚好够引发一次反应。

entries.en: I have a big problem. I lost my sense of taste, now I can't tell the difference between a melon and a cactus...
entries.zh: 我遇上大麻烦了。我的味觉没了，现在连西瓜和仙人掌都分不出来……

entries.en: Eating enough of these surely should bring back my taste memories. Thank you.
entries.zh: 这些多吃点，肯定能把味觉的记忆找回来。谢谢你。

entries.en: My tongue is hurting for some reason...
entries.zh: 不知道怎么回事，我舌头疼……

entries.en: Whenever you fish, make sure you're using some type of Bait.
entries.zh: 钓鱼的时候，记得用上鱼饵。

entries.en: You can store Bait in your inventory or Fishing Bag, which is unlocked at Raw Cod Collection III.
entries.zh: 你可以把鱼饵放在物品栏或钓鱼袋里，钓鱼袋要到生鳕鱼收集 III 才能解锁。

entries.en: Bait is automatically consumed whenever you cast your rod, so it's easy to use!
entries.zh: 鱼饵会在你抛竿时自动消耗，用起来可方便了！

entries.en: I craft Fish Bait all the time because it's so easy to do - just a couple of Raw Cod and a Raw Salmon!
entries.zh: 我经常合成鱼类鱼饵，做起来可简单了——两条生鳕鱼加一条生鲑鱼就行！

entries.en: Here, I've got some spare Fish Bait for ya!
entries.zh: 来，我这儿有些多余的鱼类鱼饵，给你！

entries.en: Fish Bait seems to give a really effective ☂ Fishing Speed boost!
entries.zh: 鱼类鱼饵对 ☂ 钓鱼速度的提升好像还挺明显！

entries.en: All Baits serve some specialized purpose, so be sure to keep some on you at all times!
entries.zh: 各种鱼饵都有各自的用途，记得随身带上一些！

entries.en: If you have any questions about Bait, you can view my Bait Guide at any time!
entries.zh: 要是对鱼饵有什么不明白的，随时可以翻翻我的鱼饵指南！

entries.en: Before you can sail, you must prove you know how to fish.
entries.zh: 想要出航，就得先证明你会钓鱼。

entries.en: Go find Fisherwoman Enid, learn how to fish, and then we'll talk!
entries.zh: 去找女渔夫伊妮德学会钓鱼，再回来谈吧！
这片海可不好闯啊，伙计！

entries.en: You'll need at least Fishing Skill V before setting sail!
entries.zh: 至少得达到钓鱼技能 V 级，才能扬帆起航！

entries.en: Ahoy, sailor! You must be Fishing Skill V to navigate the seas!
entries.zh: 喂，水手！想驾船出海，得先达到钓鱼技能 V 级！

entries.en: This Ship is missing an engine! Fisherman Gerald might have a clue on where to find it.
entries.zh: 这艘船还缺个引擎！渔夫杰拉德也许知道去哪儿找。

entries.en: I was about to set sail, but this Ship is missing its engine!
entries.zh: 我正准备出航呢，可这艘船却少了引擎！

entries.en: Maybe Fisherman Gerald knows where it is?
entries.zh: 也许渔夫杰拉德知道它在哪儿？

entries.en: Ahoy, is that the Rusty Ship Engine?
entries.zh: 哟，那是生锈船引擎吗？

entries.en: Excellent! I'm the Captain of this Ship, which means I oversee everything from repairs to navigation.
entries.zh: 太好了！我是这艘船的船长，从维修到航行都归我管。

entries.en: You can access the Ship Upgrades menu by talking to me.
entries.zh: 找我交谈就能打开船舶升级菜单。

entries.en: Apply that Rusty Ship Engine in the Engine slot by clicking the engine in your inventory!
entries.zh: 把那台生锈船引擎装进引擎槽，点击物品栏里的引擎就行！

entries.en: Apply the Rusty Ship Engine in the Ship Upgrades menu, and then we can set sail!
entries.zh: 在船舶升级菜单里装好生锈船引擎，咱们就能出航了！

entries.en: Amazing! That'll do just the trick!
entries.zh: 好极了！正好派上用场！

entries.en: It's a pretty weak engine, but it will be just powerful enough to reach the Backwater Bayou.
entries.zh: 引擎虽然没多大劲，不过刚好够我们开到死水河岸。

entries.en: Now, before we set off, you should make sure you've bought some starter equipment from the Fishing Merchant in the Fishing Outpost.
entries.zh: 出发前，记得先在钓鱼前哨的钓鱼商人那里买些入门装备。

entries.en: And when you're ready, use the Ship Navigator to travel to the Bayou!
entries.zh: 准备好了，就用船舶导航器前往沼泽吧！

entries.en: Land ho! We have arrived at the Backwater Bayou!
entries.zh: 陆地在望！我们到死水河岸了！

entries.en: You go on and explore! Come back to the Ship and set sail when you're done!
entries.zh: 去探索吧！逛完了回船上，咱们再出航！

entries.en: If you want to conquer the seven seas and be the first sailor to reach World's End, we're going to need a bigger crew!
entries.zh: 想征服七海，做第一个抵达世界尽头的水手，我们还得招一支更大的船员队伍！

entries.en: I've given it some thought, and I think we should recruit some more sailors to help us out.
entries.zh: 我琢磨过了，咱们该再招些水手来帮忙。

entries.en: You can find the Ship Crew menu by talking to me.
entries.zh: 找我交谈就能打开船员菜单。

entries.en: Use it to find NPCs who might want to join us on our adventure!
entries.zh: 里面能找到可能愿意跟我们一起冒险的人！

entries.en: If you find someone that interests you, persuade them to join the crew!
entries.zh: 有看中的人，就去说服对方上船吧！

entries.en: Land ho! We have landed onto the Lotus Atoll!
entries.zh: 陆地在望！我们登上莲花环礁了！

entries.en: You gotta be careful ‘round these parts.
entries.zh: 在这一带可得小心点。

entries.en: Lotsa dangerous stuff livin’ in this here bayou.
entries.zh: 这片沼泽里住着不少危险的家伙。
来，瞧瞧这个！

entries.en: Have you ever heard tales of the Fish Family?
entries.zh: 你听说过鱼类家族的故事吗？

entries.en: They're the curious group that trails behind Shrimp, you know?
entries.zh: 就是跟在 Shrimp 身后的那群怪家伙，你知道吧？
请选择: [有点印象。]

entries.en: I see. Would you like to delve deeper into their story?
entries.zh: 这样啊。想多了解一下它们的故事吗？
请选择: [是的。]

entries.en: Just a moment, let me gather my thoughts.
entries.zh: 稍等，让我理理思路。

entries.en: Are you truly eager to uncover more about them?
entries.zh: 你真的很想多了解它们吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [Get on with it.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [快说吧。]
好吧。

entries.en: Bring members of the Fish Family to me and I will reward you greatly!
entries.zh: 把鱼类家族的成员带来给我，我会好好奖励你！

entries.en: I just like to look at them, you see.
entries.zh: 其实啊，我就是喜欢看看它们。
你找到一条新鱼了！

entries.en: Great. Let's add it to the collection! The Fish Family is coming together swimmingly!
entries.zh: 太好了，把它加入收藏吧！鱼类家族的团聚可真是一帆风顺！

entries.en: But hold on... for that I would need to make your Fish Co-op Soulbound.
entries.zh: 不过等等……我得先把你的鱼设为合作模式 - 灵魂绑定。

entries.en: Which means you will not be able to trade it anymore.
entries.zh: 也就是说，之后你就不能再拿它交易了。
这样你能接受吗？

entries.en: That’s too bad. Come back when you are sure.
entries.zh: 那真可惜。想清楚了再来吧。
那条鱼真漂亮啊……

entries.en: Perfect, in that case I won't ask you that question again.
entries.zh: 太好了，那我以后就不再问你这个问题了。
一条新鱼！真让人高兴。

entries.en: As a token of my appreciation, I've given you %1$s!
entries.zh: 为表谢意，我给了你 %1$s!

entries.en: Brrrrr, I've been stuck down here ever since I fell into the pond with Steve.
entries.zh: 嘶——自从和史蒂夫一起掉进池塘，我就一直困在这下面。

entries.en: Here, let me share some of my ice with you.
entries.zh: 来，我分点冰给你。

entries.en: ✆ Hmphhh, it's absolutely freezing round here!
entries.zh: ✆ 嘶——这儿也太冷了！

entries.en: ✆ I can't feel my legs, toes, or hands!
entries.zh: ✆ 我的腿、脚趾、手……全冻得没知觉了！

entries.en: ✆ Hey, could you get me something to heat me up a bit?
entries.zh: ✆ 哎，能帮我找点东西暖暖身子吗？

entries.en: ✆ I'll give you my ...brr... Abiphone Contact in return.
entries.zh: ✆ 作为回报，我会把我的……嘶……阿比手机联系方式给你。

entries.en: Select an option: [Sure, what do you need?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [好啊，你需要什么？]

entries.en: ✆ Bring me an Enchanted Lava Bucket, please.
entries.zh: ✆ 麻烦带一个附魔熔岩桶给我吧。

entries.en: ✆ If I dunk it over myself it should get rid of all the cold.
entries.zh: ✆ 我要是把它往身上一倒，应该就不会再冷了。
✆ 呼——这下舒服了。
✆ 现在又冷起来了。

entries.en: ✆ You know, another dozen or so Enchanted Lava Buckets should be enough to thaw me out completely.
entries.zh: ✆ 其实啊，再来 12 个左右的附魔熔岩桶，应该就够让我彻底解冻了。

entries.en: ✆ Don't worry though - I'll give that job to whoever asks for my contact next.
entries.zh: ✆ 放心，这活儿我会交给下一个来要我联系方式的人。
✆ 这是我的……嘶……联系方式……

entries.en: Mum's making us read, but I'd rather be out fishing with pa.
entries.zh: 妈妈让我们读书，可我更想跟爸爸出去钓鱼。

entries.en: For my reading this week, I'm reading the Sea Creature Guide.
entries.zh: 这星期我选的读物是海洋生物指南。

entries.en: You can access it through the Fishing Skill menu.
entries.zh: 打开钓鱼技能菜单就能找到它。

entries.en: Don't tell mum this, but I just use /scg to open it.
entries.zh: 可别告诉妈妈，我都是直接输入 /scg 打开的。

entries.en: It's useful to explain which Sea Creatures can be found where, and what treasures they drop!
entries.zh: 里面会告诉你，各种海洋生物都在哪儿出没，还能掉什么宝藏！
嘿，我可是个投机商人！

entries.en: I sell Arrows and Bows for a truly overpriced amount!
entries.zh: 我这儿卖箭和弓，价格嘛，贵得离谱！

entries.en: Before I can get Fishing, I have to make sure I understand the fish themselves.
entries.zh: 开始钓鱼之前，我得先好好了解一下鱼才行。

entries.en: There are 4 Fishing stats you need to know about.
entries.zh: 有 4 种钓鱼属性，你得了解一下。
来，看看我的笔记！

entries.en: Ever heard of a Fishing Hotspot?
entries.zh: 听说过钓鱼热点吗？

entries.en: Sometimes, a ring of particles will appear on the surface of the water near you.
entries.zh: 有时候，你附近的水面上会出现一圈粒子。

entries.en: This is a Fishing Hotspot, and it will only be around for a little while. So cast your rod ASAP!
entries.zh: 那就是钓鱼热点！它只能维持一小会儿，所以得抓紧下竿！

entries.en: After all, some rare Sea Creatures are exclusive to Fishing Hotspots!
entries.zh: 毕竟有些稀有的海洋生物，只会出现在钓鱼热点里！
哇！快看！

entries.en: A Hotspot just popped up right behind you!
entries.zh: 一个热点刚好在你身后冒出来了！

entries.en: Cast your rod into it and fish something up!
entries.zh: 往那儿抛竿，钓点东西上来吧！

entries.en: Look! There's a Hotspot right there!
entries.zh: 看！那儿就有个热点！

entries.en: Cast your rod into it to gain its stat bonus!
entries.zh: 往热点里抛竿，就能获得它的属性加成！

entries.en: These Hotspots can appear all over the Backwater Bayou!
entries.zh: 这些热点在死水河岸各处都有可能出现！

entries.en: They show up in the Hub and Crimson Isle, too!
entries.zh: 在主城和绯红孤岛也能见到！

entries.en: Plenty of rare Sea Creatures can only be found by fishing in these Hotspots.
entries.zh: 不少稀有的海洋生物，只能在这些热点里钓到。

entries.en: I'm most interested by the Blue-Ringed Octopus, which doesn't really behave like a traditional octopus!
entries.zh: 我最感兴趣的是蓝环章鱼，它的举止可不像寻常章鱼！

entries.en: There are Hotspots here, in the Hub, and in the Crimson Isle!
entries.zh: 这里、主城和绯红孤岛，都能找到热点！

entries.en: Some Sea Creatures can only be caught in Hotspots!
entries.zh: 有些海洋生物只能在热点里钓到！

entries.en: The Snapping Turtle, Blue-Ringed Octopus, and Wiki-Tiki can be found here on the Bayou!
entries.zh: 在这片沼泽，你能钓到鳄龟、蓝环章鱼和维基提基魔像！

entries.en: Some others can only be found in Hotspots on the Crimson Isle!
entries.zh: 还有一些，只有在绯红孤岛的热点里才能钓到！

entries.en: You can gain certain Fishing stat bonuses by casting your rod in Fishing Hotspots!
entries.zh: 在钓鱼热点中抛竿，能获得特定的钓鱼属性加成！

entries.en: I like fishing in Hotspots that grant α Sea Creature Chance because I love finding new Sea Creatures!
entries.zh: 我喜欢能提高 α 海怪几率的热点，因为我就爱寻找新的海洋生物！

entries.en: I don't really hunt  Critters, it's not enough of a challenge.
entries.zh: 我一般不猎捕  小动物，没什么挑战。

entries.en: Torrhus Sea Creatures, though? That's more like it.
entries.zh: 托鲁斯的海洋生物？这才有点意思。

entries.en: Here's all of the ones that I've found throughout my time in Torrhus Springs.
entries.zh: 我在托鲁斯泉待的这段时间里，发现过的海洋生物全都在这里了。

entries.en: That there Fishing Hotspot is the only place to catch Giant Water Bug shards.
entries.zh: 只有那边的钓鱼热点，才能钓到巨型田鳖碎片。

entries.en: Who knows why they like it so much down here?
entries.zh: 谁知道它们为什么这么喜欢待在这底下呢？

entries.en: Getting all the way down here dang near killed me...
entries.zh: 光是一路赶到这底下，就差点要了我的命……

entries.en: We don't get many new faces around these parts...
entries.zh: 这地方可不常见到新面孔……

entries.en: Welcome, sailor, to our lil' Backwater Bayou!
entries.zh: 欢迎你，水手，来到咱们小小的死水河岸！

entries.en: We've got trash, junk, and everything in between!
entries.zh: 垃圾、废品，反正各种破烂咱这儿都齐了！

entries.en: I'm here to guide you through what our corner of SkyBlock has to offer!
entries.zh: 我会带你了解空岛这一角都有些什么！
还好吧，朋友？

entries.en: I don't see many people 'round these parts. Probably the smell of the place that drives them away, I'd think.
entries.zh: 这附近没什么人来。我猜啊，多半是被这儿的气味熏跑的。

entries.en: Some nasty spill happened a while ago, and ever since people 'ave been dumping their trash in the river.
entries.zh: 前阵子这里出了次严重的泄漏，从那以后，大家就一直往河里倒垃圾。

entries.en: Anyways, if you want to help with the cleaning effort, take this Junk Sinker and get fishin'!
entries.zh: 总之，想帮忙清理的话，拿上这个垃圾铅坠去钓鱼吧！

entries.en: Bring it over to Roddy and he'll help you attach it to your Fishing Rod!
entries.zh: 拿去找罗迪，他会帮你装到鱼竿上！

entries.en: I'll let ya trade any Junk that you bring me for something more worth your time!
entries.zh: 把找到的垃圾带给我，我让你换点更值当的东西！

entries.en: Like they always say, one man's trash is another man's treasure!
entries.zh: 老话说得好，有人眼里的垃圾，就是别人眼里的宝贝！

entries.en: Bring any Junk you find while fishing with your Junk Sinker to me, and I'll let ya trade it in for something more worth your time!
entries.zh: 用垃圾铅坠钓到的垃圾都拿来给我，我让你换点更值当的东西！
✆ 朋友，你还好吧？
✆ 看着像是有点反胃啊。

entries.en: ✆ Hm, what brings ya to ask?
entries.zh: ✆ 嗯？怎么突然问这个？

entries.en: ✆ You want me to put my little number thingy in it?
entries.zh: ✆ 想让我把电话号码存进你那东西里？

entries.en: ✆ Well, now that I think about it, my little girl got me one for my birthday a few months back.
entries.zh: ✆ 这么一说，几个月前过生日，我女儿还真送过我一个。

entries.en: ✆ It's somewhere in my hut. Place isn't too big so it shouldn't be too hard to find.
entries.zh: ✆ 就在我那小屋里。屋子不大，应该不难找。

entries.en: ✆ However, it's only a wee little Abiphone Basic, so it ain't got many contact slots.
entries.zh: ✆ 不过只是个小小的阿比手机基础版，存不了几个联系人。

entries.en: ✆ Matter of fact, I've got seven siblings alone that would probably want to be in it...
entries.zh: ✆ 光是我那七个兄弟姐妹，估计就都想在里面占个位置……
✆ 唉，这可有点难办。

entries.en: ✆ Tell you what, here's a compromise.
entries.zh: ✆ 这样吧，咱们各退一步。

entries.en: ✆ If you can bring me a Bayou Water Orb, I'll give you my contact.
entries.zh: ✆ 给我带个河岸水之球，我就给你联系方式。

entries.en: ✆ That thing is basically the holy grail to a junk collector like me.
entries.zh: ✆ 对我这样的废品收藏家来说，那简直就是圣杯啊。

entries.en: ✆ If you forgot, I'm after a Bayou Water Orb!
entries.zh: ✆ 怕你忘了，我想要的是河岸水之球！

entries.en: ✆ Ain't nothing I'd rather have than that beautiful hunk o' junk!
entries.zh: ✆ 再没有什么比这块漂亮的大破烂更让我惦记了！
✆ 哎哟，可真漂亮！

entries.en: ✆ Cheers, %1$s, you're always good to this old man.
entries.zh: ✆ 谢啦，%1$s,你总是这么照顾我这个老头子。

entries.en: ✆ You feel like the eighth sibling I never had.
entries.zh: ✆ 有你在，就像多了第八个兄弟姐妹。

entries.en: ✆ Here's my number, don't lose it!
entries.zh: ✆ 这是我的号码，别弄丢了！

entries.en: I've been frogging around all this time...
entries.zh: 我一直在四处闲逛，跟青蛙打交道……

entries.en: But yesterday, I saw something amazing! An island the likes of which I had never seen before!
entries.zh: 不过昨天，我可真开了眼！那样的岛，我以前从没见过！
就是莲花环礁！

entries.en: It was brimming with Lotus Sea Creatures and Trophy Frogs galore!
entries.zh: 岛上满是莲花海洋生物和锦标蛙，多得不得了！

entries.en: If you want to see it for yourself, go and find Captain Baha in the Fishing Outpost!
entries.zh: 想亲眼去看看，就去钓鱼前哨找巴哈船长吧！
这地方是不是挺神奇的？

entries.en: Absolutely no sea creatures here, can you believe it?
entries.zh: 这里一只海洋生物都没有，你能信吗？

entries.en: Still, you can catch some rare materials to craft top-quality fishing nets.
entries.zh: 不过，你还是能钓到些稀有材料，用来做品质一流的渔网。

entries.en: Hi! I assume you are here to help with our Trophy Frog research.
entries.zh: 你好！你是来帮我们研究锦标蛙的吧。

entries.en: I've got your list of tasks to complete while on the Lotus Atoll.
entries.zh: 我给你列了份任务清单，都是你在莲花环礁要完成的。

entries.en: Complete them all and you'll be rewarded. Here, take a look!
entries.zh: 全部完成就能拿到奖励。来，看看吧！

entries.en: Come back and talk to me once you have unlocked the Ship Crew!
entries.zh: 解锁船员队伍后，再回来找我聊聊吧！

entries.en: Reach Fishing Level X and talk to Captain Baha on your Ship!
entries.zh: 先达到钓鱼 X 级，再去你的船上找巴哈船长聊聊吧！

entries.en: I'm a researcher who focuses upon the study of Frogs!
entries.zh: 我是个专门研究青蛙的研究员！

entries.en: Well, I was a researcher, I suppose.
entries.zh: 嗯，应该说……我以前是个研究员。

entries.en: Today marks the first day of my retirement!
entries.zh: 今天可是我退休的第一天！
请选择: [恭喜你！]
谢谢你！

entries.en: Say, is that your Ship parked by the side of the island?
entries.zh: 对了，停在岛边的那艘船，是你的吗？
请选择: [没错！]

entries.en: Hmm, might I be so bold as to ask if I could join you on your adventures?
entries.zh: 嗯……冒昧问一句，能带上我一起去冒险吗？

entries.en: I don't have a lot going on now, with retirement and all.
entries.zh: 毕竟都退休了，我现在也没什么事要忙。
请选择: [当然可以！]
太好了。

entries.en: Say, I would like a souvenir to take on my travels, though, to remember this place by.
entries.zh: 对了，我还想带个纪念品上路，留作对这地方的念想。

entries.en: If it's not too much trouble, might you be able to fish me up a Busted Belt Buckle?
entries.zh: 要是不麻烦的话，能帮我钓个坏掉的皮带扣吗？

entries.en: As much of a dumping ground as this place is, it really feels like MY dumping ground, you know..?
entries.zh: 这儿就算是个垃圾场，那也是我自己的垃圾场啊……你懂吧？

entries.en: Do you have that souvenir for me?
entries.zh: 我的纪念品带来了吗？

entries.en: I'm just looking for a Busted Belt Buckle in case I ever need to return here!
entries.zh: 我就想要个坏掉的皮带扣，说不定哪天还得回这儿呢！

entries.en: It appears you don't have my souvenir yet! It would be such a shame to leave without it...
entries.zh: 看来你还没拿到我的纪念品！就这么走了，可真有点遗憾……

entries.en: Please could you get me a Busted Belt Buckle from Junker Joel?
entries.zh: 能麻烦你去拾荒者乔尔那儿帮我弄个坏掉的皮带扣吗？
太好了，真是太感谢你了！

entries.en: I'll go introduce myself to the rest of the crew!
entries.zh: 我去跟其他船员做个自我介绍！
起锚出发！
新岛屿已解锁！

entries.en: Open the Ship Navigator to travel to the %1$s!
entries.zh: 打开船舶导航器，前往%1$s吧！

entries.en: I'll come and join you on the Ship shortly!
entries.zh: 我很快就来船上和你会合！

entries.en: I love the feel of the wind in my hair!
entries.zh: 风吹过头发的感觉真舒服！

entries.en: I hope you brought your fishing rod!
entries.zh: 你带鱼竿了吧？

entries.en: I love the taste of the salt in the air!
entries.zh: 空气里这股咸咸的味道，真让人喜欢！

entries.en: I hope we catch something big!
entries.zh: 希望咱们能钓到个大家伙！

entries.en: I can't wait to catch some fish!
entries.zh: 我都等不及要钓鱼了！

entries.en: I love the sound of the waves!
entries.zh: 我可喜欢听海浪声了！

entries.en: A Tewtil just snatched a Trophy Frog right out of my hands!
entries.zh: 刚才有只幼龟直接从我手里抢走了一只锦标蛙！

entries.en: Unlucky for him! These Tewtils have a tendency to get bigger when eating Trophy Frogs...
entries.zh: 这下它可倒霉了！这些幼龟吃了锦标蛙，往往会变大……
走你！

entries.en: One moment please - I've run into quite a severe conundrum.
entries.zh: 先等一下——我碰上了个相当棘手的难题。
选择一个选项: [怎么了？]

entries.en: Okay, I'll tell you. But promise me you won't freak out.
entries.zh: 好，我告诉你。不过你得先答应我，听了别慌。

entries.en: Select an option: [I promise.] [Depends what we're dealing with here...]
entries.zh: 选择一个选项: [我保证。] [那得看咱们面对的是什么……]

entries.en: There appear to be several Wormholes on this island.
entries.zh: 这座岛上好像出现了几个虫洞。

entries.en: It started with just one, we began conducting research on it, and then more started appearing...
entries.zh: 一开始只有一个，咱们就着手研究了，后来又接连冒出了更多……

entries.en: Select an option: [I don't see any holes, or worms.]
entries.zh: 选择一个选项: [我既没看见洞，也没看见虫子。]

entries.en: C'mon dude, don't you deal with stuff like this all the time?
entries.zh: 拜托，你不是经常处理这种事吗？

entries.en: Ah, right! I probably sound crazy right now!
entries.zh: 啊，对了！我刚才说的这些，听着大概很离谱吧！

entries.en: You can only see Wormholes while wearing a pair of Froggles!
entries.zh: 只有戴上蛙镜，才能看见虫洞！

entries.en: You can craft your own pair after unlocking the Lotus Collection!
entries.zh: 解锁莲花收集后，你就能自己做一副了！

entries.en: After that, you can help us out!
entries.zh: 有了它，就能帮咱们的忙了！

entries.en: Select an option: [How am I supposed to help?]
entries.zh: 选择一个选项: [那我该怎么帮忙？]

entries.en: Look, bro. The term Wormhole doesn't sound very reassuring, right?
entries.zh: 你想啊，虫洞这名字，听着就不太让人放心，对吧？

entries.en: Destabilization, fragmentation, displacement - all very possible results of these anomalies.
entries.zh: 失稳、碎裂、位移……这些异常现象很可能带来这样的后果。

entries.en: Bottom line is, we need to catch the Frogs that are responsible for creating these holes!
entries.zh: 说到底，咱们得抓住那些制造虫洞的青蛙！

entries.en: Select an option: [Frogs? But you called them Wormholes...]
entries.zh: 选择一个选项: [青蛙？可你刚才说的是虫洞……]

entries.en: Yeah, I know it sounds weird. But trust me, these aren't ordinary frogs.
entries.zh: 是啊，听着是挺怪的。但相信我，这可不是普通的青蛙。

entries.en: These are Trophy Frogs! If you help us catch them, we can study them and figure out how to close the Wormholes!
entries.zh: 这些可是锦标蛙！你帮咱们把它们钓上来，咱们就能好好研究，弄清怎么关掉虫洞！

entries.en: Equip your Froggles, find the Wormholes, and cast your rod!
entries.zh: 戴上蛙镜，找到虫洞，再抛竿！

entries.en: With some luck, you'll be able to catch the elusive Reality Hopper!
entries.zh: 运气好的话，你就能钓到难得一见的现实跃迁者！

entries.en: After a bit of time, the hole will stabilize and disappear.
entries.zh: 过一会儿，虫洞就会稳定下来，然后消失。

entries.en: However, another one will open up somewhere else on the island...
entries.zh: 不过，岛上其他地方又会出现新的虫洞……

entries.en: Select an option: [That's a lot of yap.]
entries.zh: 选择一个选项: [你话也太多了吧。]

entries.en: I know, it's an arduous process.
entries.zh: 我知道，这个过程确实挺费劲。

entries.en: I am happy to answer any questions you might have! Best of luck!
entries.zh: 有什么问题尽管问我！祝你好运！
嘿，找我什么事？
➜ [蛙镜从哪儿弄？]
➜ [怎么钓现实跳蛙？]
➜ [虫洞是什么？]

entries.en: You can craft your own pair of Froggles after reaching Lotus Collection I.
entries.zh: 莲花收集达到 I 级后，就能自己做一副蛙镜。

entries.en: Reality Hoppers are a type of Trophy Frog that somehow create Wormholes!
entries.zh: 现实跳蛙是一种锦标蛙，也不知怎么就能制造虫洞！

entries.en: Equip your Froggles and look around for otherworldly particles in the water.
entries.zh: 戴上蛙镜，四处找找水里的异界粒子。

entries.en: When you find one, cast your rod into and wait for a bite!
entries.zh: 找到以后，把鱼钩抛进去，等着咬钩就行！

entries.en: You'll either pull a Reality Hopper out of the hole, or some loot that it's gathered.
entries.zh: 你要么从洞里钓出一只现实跃迁者，要么钓到它搜罗来的东西。

entries.en: Holes will close once you fish in them a few times, but a new one will open up elsewhere on the island.
entries.zh: 在虫洞里钓上几次，它就会关闭，不过岛上别处又会出现新的虫洞。

entries.en: Wormholes have begun to open up all around the Lotus Atoll!
entries.zh: 莲花环礁各处都开始出现虫洞了！

entries.en: They seem to be directly related to the Reality Hopper frog!
entries.zh: 看起来，这些虫洞和现实跃迁者有直接关系！

entries.en: At least, that's our current hypothesis!
entries.zh: 至少，咱们目前的假说是这样！
欢迎来到莲花环礁！

entries.en: Us Researchers are currently hard at work documenting the various species of Frog found here.
entries.zh: 我们这些研究员正忙着记录这里各种青蛙的资料。

entries.en: Want to give us a hand?
entries.zh: 愿意来帮个忙吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [I suppose I don't have a choice in the matter.]
entries.zh: 选择一个选项: [看来我也没得选啊。]
这态度真不错！

entries.en: Each species comes in four rarities - BRONZE, SILVER, GOLD, and DIAMOND.
entries.zh: 每种蛙都有四档品质: 铜品质、银品质、金品质和钻石品质。

entries.en: That means there are 48 unique Trophy Frogs to find!
entries.zh: 这么一算，就有 48 种不同的锦标蛙等着你去钓！

entries.en: We'll need you to catch one of every frog in order to complete our research!
entries.zh: 要完成研究，就得请你钓来每种锦标蛙各一只！

entries.en: Select an option: [What's in it for me?]
entries.zh: 选择一个选项: [那我能拿到什么好处？]

entries.en: If you bring any Frogs you catch to me, I'll reward you with some Lotus!
entries.zh: 把你钓到的锦标蛙带来给我，我就奖励你一些莲花！

entries.en: Progress through your Lotus Collection to unlock new useful items!
entries.zh: 提升莲花收集进度，就能解锁新的实用物品！
选择一个选项: [好吧，我听着……]
还不止这些呢！

entries.en: Each time you catch all of the Frogs at a certain tier, I'll give you a little something extra!
entries.zh: 每钓齐一个品质档位的所有锦标蛙，我还会额外送你点东西！

entries.en: Now, go start with the BRONZE tier!
entries.zh: 现在，先从铜品质开始吧！

entries.en: Come talk to me any time to donate Frogs and to view your current progress!
entries.zh: 想捐赠锦标蛙，或是看看现在的进度，随时来找我就行！
走你！

entries.en: The frequent rain throughout the Atoll means we see a lot of Wetlands Frogs!
entries.zh: 环礁经常下雨，所以我们能见到好多湿地蛙！
我就喜欢下雨！

entries.en: Sadly it'll stop raining in about %1$s minutes from now.
entries.zh: 可惜，再过大约 %1$s 分钟，雨就要停了。
我讨厌太阳！

entries.en: Luckily it'll start raining in about %1$s minutes from now.
entries.zh: 还好，再过大约 %1$s 分钟，就要下雨了。

entries.en: You can increase your chance of catching Trophy Frogs by increasing your %1$s Trophy Chance stat!
entries.zh: 想提高钓到锦标蛙的几率，就提升你的 %1$s 奖杯几率属性吧！

entries.en: The higher your %1$s Trophy Chance, the faster you'll catch whatever Frog you're after!
entries.zh: 你的 %1$s 奖杯几率越高，就能越快钓到想要的青蛙！

entries.en: Junker Joel wants to talk to you about Junk!
entries.zh: 拾荒者乔尔想和你聊聊垃圾的事！

entries.en: I can help you apply Rod Parts after!
entries.zh: 之后我能帮你安装鱼竿配件！
怎么样，钓鱼好手？

entries.en: If you ever want to apply Rod Parts to your fishing rods, I'm your guy!
entries.zh: 想给鱼竿安装鱼竿配件，找我就对了！

entries.en: Hooks make you more likely to catch certain things.
entries.zh: 鱼钩能让你更容易钓到某些东西。

entries.en: Lines grant bonus stats, no matter where you are!
entries.zh: 鱼线不管在哪儿，都能提供额外属性！

entries.en: Sinkers also grant bonuses, but only in certain areas!
entries.zh: 坠子也有加成，不过只在特定区域生效！

entries.en: If you ever want to apply a Rod Part or have any questions about them, come see me!
entries.zh: 想装鱼竿配件，或者有不明白的，尽管来找我！

entries.en: There ya go, your rod is now equipped with a Junk Sinker!
entries.zh: 好了，你的鱼竿已经装上垃圾铅坠了！

entries.en: I can apply Hooks, Lines, and Sinkers to your fishing rods at any time!
entries.zh: 随时都能来找我，给鱼竿安装鱼钩、鱼线和坠子！

entries.en: You can also remove them, but that'll cost you some Coins!
entries.zh: 也可以拆下来，不过得花点硬币！

entries.en: Hey pal! You lookin' for the contact, huh?
entries.zh: 嘿，你是来要联系方式的吧？

entries.en: Alright, pop a squat and listen up then, buddy.
entries.zh: 行，坐下来听我说。

entries.en: This morning I got woken up by a Banshee screechin' outside my window.
entries.zh: 今天早上，一只女妖在窗外尖叫，把我吵醒了。

entries.en: Before I knew it, she snatched something from my washin' line and leapt back into the Bayou.
entries.zh: 我还没反应过来，她就从晾衣绳上抢走了一件东西，跳回沼泽里去了。

entries.en: If you get that piece of Torn Cloth back off the Banshee, I'll give you my contact.
entries.zh: 帮我从女妖那儿把破布拿回来，我就给你联系方式。
我的破布呢，钓鱼好手？

entries.en: You got my Torn Cloth back!
entries.zh: 你把我的破布找回来了！
好吧，是剩下的那点……

entries.en: Not gonna be able to wear this anymore, bud. But a deal's a deal, I guess!
entries.zh: 这下可没法再穿了。不过说好了的事，我也不能反悔嘛！
喏，这是我的联系方式！

entries.en: I have the power to conjure rain from the skies.
entries.zh: 我能让天上下起雨来。
不过，这可是要收费的！

entries.en: you have elegant taste in fashion
entries.zh: 你这身打扮，挺优雅嘛

entries.en: u want to know a secret?
entries.zh: 想听个秘密吗？

entries.en: i can hold my breath under lava for 15 seconds!
entries.zh: 我能在熔岩里憋气 15 秒！
看来你也行！

entries.en: i heard a legend there was a big fish in these waters
entries.zh: 我听过个传说，说这片水里有条大鱼

entries.en: mayb u could fish it up?
entries.zh: 说不定你能把它钓上来？

entries.en: try using dat bait u hav
entries.zh: 试试用你手头的鱼饵

entries.en: anyway... i have a train to catch
entries.zh: 先不说了... 我得赶火车
我要去马戏团

entries.en: u can join me if u like
entries.zh: 想来的话，可以跟我一起
你好啊，未来的伐木高手！

entries.en: I'm Agatha, the youngest of the Starlyn Sisters.
entries.zh: 我是阿加莎，星林姐妹中年纪最小的那个。

entries.en: We each host contests on our own islands.
entries.zh: 我们各自在自己的岛上举办竞赛。

entries.en: Here in Moonglade Marsh, I'll reward your daily activities each SkyBlock day.
entries.zh: 在月光沼泽，每个空岛日我都会按你当天的活动表现发放奖励。

entries.en: So stick around, and please, avoid wandering into my sisters' territories.
entries.zh: 所以就在这儿多待会儿吧，也请别乱跑到我姐姐们的地盘去。

entries.en: Hey! You should probably stick to Fig Trees!
entries.zh: 嘿！你还是先砍无花果树吧！

entries.en: Mangrove Trees are too tough for you yet, try getting at least 50%1$s Sweep!
entries.zh: 红树对现在的你来说还太难砍，先弄到至少 50%1$s 横扫！

entries.en: Perhaps you should talk to him too, he's at the entrance of the village!
entries.zh: 你也可以找他聊聊，他就在村口！

entries.en: Hunting is incredible! You should talk to David Hunterborough in the Village to learn about it!
entries.zh: 狩猎可有意思了！去村里找大卫·亨特伯勒学学吧！

entries.en: Have you talked to Kysha, she knows all about Fusions!
entries.zh: 你找凯莎聊过吗？她对融合可了解了！
又见面啦！

entries.en: You've been doing well in my contests recently, don't think I haven't noticed!
entries.zh: 最近你在我的竞赛里表现不错嘛，我可都看在眼里！
哦，你想要我的阿比手机联系方式？
当然可以，我的通讯录还有空位。

entries.en: I'll give you a call whenever you finish an Agatha's Contest so that you can claim your rewards!
entries.zh: 每当你完成阿加莎竞赛，我就给你打电话，提醒你来领奖励！

entries.en: Hey, the results for my latest contest are in! You reached the %1$s bracket with %2$s points!
entries.zh: 嘿，最新一场竞赛的结果出来了！你以 %2$s 分的成绩进入了 %1$s 档！
你好，冒险者！

entries.en: You should talk to David Hunterborough to learn more about Hunting!
entries.zh: 去找大卫·亨特伯勒聊聊，了解一下狩猎吧！

entries.en: Have you dipped your toes into the world of Hunting?
entries.zh: 你已经开始接触狩猎了吗？

entries.en: There's an art to it! The right tools make all the difference.
entries.zh: 这里头可有学问！趁手的工具能让你事半功倍。

entries.en: Take these Huntaxes, for example. Sturdy, sharp, beautifully balanced.
entries.zh: 就拿这些狩猎斧来说，结实、锋利，配重也恰到好处。

entries.en: I stumbled upon the design while clearing out a damp, old shed.
entries.zh: 我收拾一间潮湿的旧棚屋时，偶然发现了它们的设计图。
用起来也出乎意料地顺手！

entries.en: In exchange, I only ask for a few valuables.
entries.zh: 拿些值钱的东西来，就能和我换。

entries.en: This device right next to me is a Gravity Condenser.
entries.zh: 我旁边这台装置叫重力凝聚器。

entries.en: I didn't build it, but I know how to use it.
entries.zh: 不是我造的，不过我知道怎么用。

entries.en: If you bring me the right materials, and the proper fee, then I'll craft you a Pocket Black Hole.
entries.zh: 带上合适的材料，再付点工钱，我就能给你做一个口袋黑洞。

entries.en: Have you got your very own Safari Belt yet? All of our customers get one!
entries.zh: 你有自己的游猎场腰带了吗？我们的客人人人都有一条！
请选择: [没有]

entries.en: Well, please take this spare one!
entries.zh: 那这条备用的就给你吧！

entries.en: The Safari Belt is the only item you can take with you into the Critter Safari.
entries.zh: 游猎场腰带是唯一能带进小动物游猎场的物品。

entries.en: You'll find it already equipped once you enter - for your convenience.
entries.zh: 进去时就会自动穿戴好，省得你还得自己动手。

entries.en: Whenever you reach a new Safari Milestone, your Safari Belt will upgrade either its stats or its rarity.
entries.zh: 每当你达到新的游猎场里程碑，腰带的属性或稀有度就会提升。

entries.en: It's kind of like David's Cloak, if you think about it.
entries.zh: 这么一想，和大卫的斗篷还挺像的。

entries.en: You can progress through each biome's milestones by catching %1$s Critters while in that biome. Simple, right?
entries.zh: 只要在对应的生态区捕捉%1$s 小动物，就能推进那里的里程碑。简单吧？

entries.en: Anyways, if you ever want to check your progress towards your next Safari Milestone, just come and chat with me!
entries.zh: 总之，想看看离下个游猎场里程碑还有多远，随时来找我聊聊！
你好啊！

entries.en: I ain't get many visitors down here. Just me, Ant, and these here ants.
entries.zh: 这底下可没什么客人。就我蚂蚁，还有这群蚂蚁。

entries.en: Say, you wouldn't happen to have any use for these fine stones, would you?
entries.zh: 话说，这些漂亮的石头，你用得上吗？

entries.en: My ants brought them to me as a peace offering, some time ago.
entries.zh: 前些时候，我的蚂蚁们把这些送给我，算是示好的礼物。

entries.en: Hello and welcome to the Critter Safari!
entries.zh: 你好，欢迎来到小动物游猎场！

entries.en: Say, have you heard of Safari Essence?
entries.zh: 话说，你听说过游猎场精粹吗？

entries.en: Then there's no need for me to explain!
entries.zh: 那就不用我多解释啦！

entries.en: All of the Safari Essence you gain while in the Critter Safari can be spent in my shop.
entries.zh: 你在小动物游猎场中获得的游猎场精粹都可以拿到我的商店消费。

entries.en: You can use it to buy useful perks that will help you out while in the zone.
entries.zh: 可以买些实用的天赋，帮你在游猎区里玩得更顺手。
来，看看吧！
那我给你讲讲！

entries.en: Safari Essence can only be gained while in the Critter Safari. There are two ways of obtaining it.
entries.zh: 游猎场精粹只能在小动物游猎场中获得，有两种获取方式。

entries.en: Firstly, it can be obtained from hunting mobs in the Critter Safari.
entries.zh: 首先，你可以通过狩猎来获取，目标是小动物游猎场里的生物。

entries.en: The rarer a mob's shard, the more Safari Essence it will drop when hunted.
entries.zh: 生物的碎片越稀有，猎获时掉落的游猎场精粹就越多。

entries.en: Secondly, you can sometimes find Safari Essence on the ground while walking around in the Critter Safari.
entries.zh: 其次，有时你会捡到地上的游猎场精粹，在小动物游猎场中多走走就能发现。

entries.en: So, if you ever see something shining on the ground. be sure to pick it up!
entries.zh: 所以，要是看见地上有东西闪闪发亮，一定要捡起来看看！

entries.en: Critter Safari been treating you well?
entries.zh: 小动物游猎场玩得还顺利吗？
行啊，应该没什么不可以的。

entries.en: Not much else to do here on slow days except get sunburn.
entries.zh: 生意清闲的时候，我在这儿除了晒伤也没什么别的事可干。

entries.en: Bring me a Helixis and I'm sure we can strike a deal.
entries.zh: 带一把螺旋晶核给我，这事肯定好商量。

entries.en: Err, buddy, I don't see a Helixis on you.
entries.zh: 呃，朋友，你身上好像没有螺旋晶核啊。

entries.en: You sure you had one? Did you lose it, maybe?
entries.zh: 你确定带了吗？该不会弄丢了吧？

entries.en: Cheers man! That's exactly what I was after.
entries.zh: 谢啦！我想要的就是这个。

entries.en: Woodworking is my true passion, you see, but I'm stuck behind this desk all day.
entries.zh: 其实我真正喜欢的是木工，可我整天都被困在这张桌子后面。

entries.en: And then, when I'm finally done, I haven't got any energy left to pursue my passions.
entries.zh: 好不容易忙完，又没力气干自己喜欢的事了。
恶性循环，是吧？
总之……抱歉，说远了。
这是我的阿比手机联系方式！

entries.en: I was cutting a tree when a Phanpyre suddenly appeared.
entries.zh: 我正砍着树，一只幻夜蝠突然冒了出来。

entries.en: Hunting Forest creatures is very different from Water or Combat creatures.
entries.zh: 狩猎森林生物的方法，跟水生生物和战斗生物可大不一样。

entries.en: For this one, you need a Lasso.
entries.zh: 对付它，你需要一条套索。

entries.en: I have a spare one here, take it.
entries.zh: 我这儿有条多余的，拿去吧。

entries.en: Great! Now throw the Lasso at the Phanpyre!
entries.zh: 好！现在把套索扔向幻夜蝠！

entries.en: When its stamina bar empties, right-click to reel it in!
entries.zh: 等它的耐力条耗尽，右键点击就能把它拉过来！

entries.en: Great, now throw the Lasso at the Phanpyre and hold on!
entries.zh: 好，现在把套索扔向幻夜蝠，抓稳了！

entries.en: Once their stamina bar is down, RIGHT CLICK your Lasso to Reel!
entries.zh: 等它的耐力条耗尽，右键点击套索就能收索！

entries.en: You killed it! That's NOT how you hunt!
entries.zh: 你把它杀了！狩猎可不是这么干的！
再试一次！
好好好！
对，就是这样！

entries.en: This Lasso isn't the best, but it gets the job done.
entries.zh: 这条套索算不上好，但也够用了。

entries.en: You should head back to David Hunterborough.
entries.zh: 你该回去找大卫·亨特伯勒了。

entries.en: You should go back to David Hunterborough.
entries.zh: 回去找大卫·亨特伯勒吧。

entries.en: I keep finding Phanpyres, but what I'm really looking for are Dreadwings.
entries.zh: 我找到的总是幻夜蝠，可我真正想找的是恐翼蝠。

entries.en: Have you got a better Lasso yet? I'm still looking for a better one myself.
entries.zh: 你换上更好的套索了吗？我自己还在找呢。

entries.en: Torrhus Canyon is home to a whole lot of Bees.
entries.zh: 托鲁斯峡谷住着一大群蜜蜂。

entries.en: They live in Honeyhives, like that one just over there.
entries.zh: 它们住在蜂巢里，就像那边那个。

entries.en: If you're feeling especially brave, you can reach your hand in and feel around for some Loot.
entries.zh: 胆子够大的话，可以把手伸进去摸摸，没准能找到些好东西。

entries.en: Be careful, though, you might anger some of its residents!
entries.zh: 不过小心点，你可能会惹恼里面的住户！
最近怎么样？
➜ [蜂巢里能找到什么？]

entries.en: ➜ [How long do Honeyhives take to refill?]
entries.zh: ➜ [蜂巢要多久才会补充物品？]

entries.en: ➜ [How can I lather Trees with Honeycomb?]
entries.zh: ➜ [怎么给树木涂上蜜脾？]

entries.en: Honeyhives usually contain Honeycomb, which will progress your Honeycomb Collection.
entries.zh: 蜂巢里一般都有蜜脾，能推进你的蜜脾收集进度。

entries.en: If you get particularly lucky, you might also find a Shard of sorts.
entries.zh: 运气特别好的话，还可能找到某种碎片。

entries.en: Or, if you get unlucky, you might awaken an angry Bee!
entries.zh: 要是运气不好，也可能吵醒一只怒气冲冲的蜜蜂！

entries.en: By my estimations, I’d say it takes around 1 hour for a Honeyhive to refill with loot.
entries.zh: 据我估计，大约要 1 小时，蜂巢里的物品才会重新补满。

entries.en: Hmm, I’m more of a Beekeeper than a Honeycomb Latherer. That was my previous job.
entries.zh: 嗯，我是个养蜂人，不是蜜脾涂抹工。那是我以前的工作了。

entries.en: If you want to learn more about that sort of thing, you should talk to Honey herself.
entries.zh: 想多了解这些，你得去找哈妮本人聊聊。

entries.en: She lives somewhere around these parts.
entries.zh: 她就住在这一带。

entries.en: The Birdfeeder in this here Forest Biome is simply amazing!
entries.zh: 这里的森林生态区里有个喂鸟器，真是妙极了！

entries.en: If you place some food in it and wait a while, a Bird will show up!
entries.zh: 往里面放点食物，再等上一会儿，就会有鸟儿飞来！

entries.en: Different birds seem to prefer different foods, though.
entries.zh: 不过，不同的鸟好像各有所爱。

entries.en: From what I can tell, Bluebirds prefer Yogi Berries...
entries.zh: 据我观察，蓝鸟喜欢瑜伽浆果……
长尾鹦鹉喜欢扭扭虫……

entries.en: And Macaws, the rarest of the lot, prefer a good ol' Bag of Seeds!
entries.zh: 而金刚鹦鹉是其中最稀有的，最爱一份实实在在的一袋种子！

entries.en: From what I've seen, you're more likely to attract a certain type of Bird if you use its favorite food...
entries.zh: 据我观察，用上某种鸟儿最爱的食物，就更容易把它引来……

entries.en: This Beacon here is incredibly ancient.
entries.zh: 这座信标真是古老得不像话。

entries.en: Some even believe it's a Precursor relic!
entries.zh: 有人甚至觉得，它是先驱留下的遗物！

entries.en: It radiates a strange energy that we must stabilize by fine-tuning its frequencies.
entries.zh: 它散发着一种奇怪的能量，我们得微调频率，让能量稳定下来。

entries.en: Occasionally the signal falters, and we have to recalibrate it.
entries.zh: 有时信号会不稳定，我们就得重新校准。

entries.en: Over, and over, and over again.
entries.zh: 一遍，又一遍，没完没了。

entries.en: Why? I wish I knew why...
entries.zh: 为什么？我也想知道为什么……

entries.en: Hey! I'm the leader of the Soul Campfire Cult!
entries.zh: 嘿！我是灵魂营火教团的首领！

entries.en: Survive 10s in the campfire to earn one!
entries.zh: 在营火里撑过 10 秒，就能拿到一枚！

entries.en: Wow! You survived the soul campfire!
entries.zh: 哇！你在灵魂营火里撑下来了！

entries.en: The soul campfire isn't quite as strong as a regular campfire. It respects your ❈ Defense!
entries.zh: 灵魂营火没普通营火那么猛烈，你的❈ 防御对它是有效的！

entries.en: Try to survive the Trial of Blue Flames II, and I'll give you the Soul Campfire Initiate Badge I!
entries.zh: 撑过蓝焰试炼 II,我就给你灵魂营火新人徽章 I!

entries.en: Wow! That campfire seems to scare off most foragers, but not you!
entries.zh: 哇！大多数伐木工都被那堆营火吓跑了，你倒是不怕！

entries.en: Here's your Soul Campfire Initiate Badge I!
entries.zh: 给，你的灵魂营火新人徽章 I!

entries.en: Complete the Trial of Blue Flames III, and I'll upgrade your badge!
entries.zh: 完成蓝焰试炼 III,我就给你的徽章升级！

entries.en: Next step is the Trial of Blue Flames III! (500 damage)
entries.zh: 下一步是蓝焰试炼 III! (500 点伤害)

entries.en: I need you to hold your %1$s so I can upgrade it!
entries.zh: 把 %1$s 拿在手上，我才能给它升级！

entries.en: Congrats! Your %1$s was upgraded to a %2$s!
entries.zh: 恭喜！你的 %1$s 已升级为 %2$s!

entries.en: Try the Trial of Blue Flames %1$s for a greater challenge!
entries.zh: 试试蓝焰试炼 %1$s,迎接更大的挑战！

entries.en: The rarity of your item will be upgraded in %1$s trials!
entries.zh: 再完成 %1$s 次试炼，物品的稀有度就会提升！

entries.en: The rarity of your item will be upgraded on the next trial!
entries.zh: 完成下一次试炼，物品的稀有度就会提升！
恭喜你完成第 %1$s 级试炼！

entries.en: You are ready for the next badge rarity!
entries.zh: 你已经能让徽章的稀有度再上一个台阶了！
想拿到它，得准备%1$s!

entries.en: Try the Trial of Blue Flames Trial %1$s for a greater challenge!
entries.zh: 试试蓝焰试炼 %1$s,迎接更大的挑战！

entries.en: Congratulations on beating every single Trial of Blue Flames! You're the real fire guy, hotshot!
entries.zh: 恭喜你打通了全部蓝焰试炼！你可真是玩火的行家啊！

entries.en: Hey I'm just here cause Ryan promised marshmallows.
entries.zh: 我来这儿就是因为瑞安答应给烤棉花糖。

entries.en: Some call us the campfire cult!
entries.zh: 有人管我们叫营火教团呢！

entries.en: Prove yourself in the Trials of Fire!
entries.zh: 去烈焰试炼证明一下自己吧！

entries.en: Next step is the Trial of Fire %1$s! (%2$s damage)
entries.zh: 下一关是烈焰试炼 %1$s! (承受 %2$s 点伤害)

entries.en: Step into the campfire to start the trial and survive for %1$ss!
entries.zh: 走进营火就能开始试炼，撑过%1$s 秒！

entries.en: Your Campfire God Badge %1$s has been upgraded to a Campfire God Badge %2$s!
entries.zh: 你的营火之神徽章 %1$s 级已升级至%2$s 级！

entries.en: Try the Trial of Fire Trial %1$s for a greater challenge!
entries.zh: 想挑战更难的？来试试烈焰试炼 %1$s!

entries.en: Keep completing trials to upgrade your accessory!
entries.zh: 继续闯关，你的饰品还能再升级！

entries.en: Howdy! Yer a friend of Lumber Jack, are ya?
entries.zh: 你好啊！你是伐木工杰克的朋友吧？
那就好办了！

entries.en: I need 64 Birch Logs. Could you grab 'em for me?
entries.zh: 我需要 64 根白桦原木，能帮我弄来吗？

entries.en: Do that, and then we can talk!
entries.zh: 带来了，咱们再聊！

entries.en: I don't see 64 Birch Logs. Where are they?
entries.zh: 没见着 64 根白桦原木啊，木头呢？

entries.en: Cheers! Here, take these trousers for payment!
entries.zh: 谢啦！这条裤子就当作报酬吧！

entries.en: The Park is home to many different kinds of wood. Each kind has its own collection.
entries.zh: 公园里有许多种木材，每种都有各自的收藏品。

entries.en: Me and my mates each gather a specific type of wood, and then split it all evenly so we can all increase our different collections!
entries.zh: 我和伙伴们各采一种木材，再把收成平均分掉，这样大家的各种收藏品进度都能涨！

entries.en: I wanted Kelly to get some Spruce Logs for us today, but I've not seen her in a while... Can you maybe look for her in the Spruce Woods?
entries.zh: 今天本想让凯莉帮我们采点云杉原木，可好一阵没见到她了……能去云杉林找找她吗？

entries.en: What? Lumber Jack said I have a Treecapitator? In my dreams...
entries.zh: 什么？伐木工杰克说我有一把砍树斧？做梦才有呢……

entries.en: So much wood to chop, such little time...
entries.zh: 木头这么多，时间却这么少……

entries.en: You heard about that weird Cult over in the Dark Thicket? I’m considerin' joining them.
entries.zh: 你听说过那个古怪的教团吗？就在幽暗灌木丛那边。我还琢磨着要不要加入呢。

entries.en: Perhaps you should talk to him too, he’s at the entrance of the Village!
entries.zh: 你也可以找他聊聊，他就在村口！
你好！

entries.en: I'm David Hunterborough, the island's Hunting Specialist.
entries.zh: 我是大卫·亨特伯勒，岛上的狩猎专家。
请选择: [狩猎？]

entries.en: Hunting has been around for eons, perfected by advanced beings known as the Precursors.
entries.zh: 狩猎由来已久，名为先驱的高等生灵让这门技艺日臻完善。

entries.en: They discovered that within every creature lies a power unique to its kind.
entries.zh: 他们发现，每种生物体内都蕴藏着独属于这个物种的力量。

entries.en: Select an option: [So, how do we access it?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [那要怎么获得这种力量？]

entries.en: Some creatures can be tamed, granting you their full power, as you may have seen with Pets.
entries.zh: 有些生物能够被驯服，把全部力量借给你，比如你可能已经见过的宠物。

entries.en: But most creatures cannot be tamed, so hunters extract what we call a Shard.
entries.zh: 但大多数生物都无法驯服，于是猎人会从中提取出我们所说的碎片。
请选择: [碎片？]

entries.en: Exactly. It represents the creature's biological footprint, its core attribute.
entries.zh: 没错。它就像生物的生命印记，代表着最核心的属性。

entries.en: By using a Shard, you harness that unique power yourself.
entries.zh: 使用碎片，你就能掌握那份独特的力量。

entries.en: Select an option: [Interesting. What does a Shard look like?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [有意思。碎片长什么样？]

entries.en: It's better if you start hunting to find out for yourself.
entries.zh: 不如亲自去狩猎，自己找出答案。

entries.en: Talk to Alan and buy your first hunting weapon to get started.
entries.zh: 去和艾伦聊聊，买下你的第一把狩猎武器，就能开始了。

entries.en: It's better if you start Hunting yourself!
entries.zh: 不如亲自去狩猎试试！

entries.en: But first, you should go talk to Alan and get proper gear.
entries.zh: 不过在那之前，先去找艾伦弄点趁手的装备。

entries.en: Perfect! You have your very first hunting weapon.
entries.zh: 很好！你有自己的第一把狩猎武器了。

entries.en: That's all you need to get started on your hunting journey.
entries.zh: 有它，你的狩猎之旅就能开始了。

entries.en: Head over to Oden, they'll teach you the basics of hunting.
entries.zh: 去找奥登吧，让对方教你狩猎的基础知识。

entries.en: You'll find them north of the village!
entries.zh: 就在村子的北边！

entries.en: First you should talk to Oden, they will show you the basics of Hunting.
entries.zh: 先去找奥登聊聊，学学狩猎的基本功。

entries.en: Go find them North of the Village!
entries.zh: 去村子北边找吧！

entries.en: It only took you %1$s:%2$s to complete that objective!
entries.zh: 你只用了 %1$s:%2$s 就完成了这个目标！

entries.en: You got your very first Combat Shard!
entries.zh: 你拿到了自己的第一枚战斗碎片！

entries.en: You can find all your Shards in your Hunting Box, inside your Hunting Skill Menu!
entries.zh: 打开狩猎技能菜单里的狩猎箱，就能找到所有碎片！

entries.en: But there are various types of monsters out there you can Hunt.
entries.zh: 外面还有各种各样的怪物，等着你去狩猎。

entries.en: You should go talk to Jaeger next!
entries.zh: 接下来去找耶格聊聊吧！

entries.en: You will find them close to the Loch.
entries.zh: 到湖边就能找到。

entries.en: You already completed your training with Jaeger?
entries.zh: 这么快就完成耶格的训练了？

entries.en: You got your very first Water Shard!
entries.zh: 你拿到了自己的第一枚水生碎片！

entries.en: Select an option: [Does the type of the Shard matter?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [碎片的类型很重要吗？]
当然重要！

entries.en: But that is still too early for you to learn.
entries.zh: 不过对现在的你来说，还太早了。

entries.en: You have to complete your training, with Auryon.
entries.zh: 你还得去奥瑞恩那里完成训练。

entries.en: They should be South of the Village.
entries.zh: 应该就在村子南边。

entries.en: You should go talk to Auryon next!
entries.zh: 接下来去找奥瑞恩聊聊吧！

entries.en: You managed to complete your Hunting training!
entries.zh: 你完成了狩猎训练！

entries.en: You got your very first Forest Shard!
entries.zh: 你拿到了自己的第一枚森林碎片！

entries.en: Combat, Water, and Forest are the only 3 types of Shards.
entries.zh: 战斗、水生和森林，碎片只有这 3 种类型。

entries.en: Dont ask me why, I have no idea!
entries.zh: 别问为什么，我也不知道！

entries.en: Now you should finally learn what Shards are for.
entries.zh: 现在，终于该学学碎片有什么用了。

entries.en: You should go talk to my assistant.
entries.zh: 去找我的助手聊聊吧。

entries.en: No, not Pounce, my other assistant Kysha, right next to the Fusion Machine in the back.
entries.zh: 不，不是扑扑，是另一位助手凯莎，就在后面的融合机器旁边。
真了不起！
也不算太差！

entries.en: You tried your best I guess!
entries.zh: 我想，你应该尽力了！
啊，狩猎工具包！

entries.en: An absolutely essential hunting item! It allows you to rapidly swap between your hunting tools!
entries.zh: 这可是狩猎必备的好东西！有了它，就能快速切换各种狩猎工具！
有空买一个吧！

entries.en: You should go talk to my assistant Kysha, right next to the Fusion Machine in the back.
entries.zh: 去找我的助手凯莎聊聊吧，就在后面的融合机旁边。

entries.en: You've mastered the fundamentals of hunting!
entries.zh: 你已经掌握狩猎的基本功了！

entries.en: At first, the attributes may seem weak, but over time they will grow stronger.
entries.zh: 刚开始，属性的效果也许不起眼，不过往后会越来越强。

entries.en: The more you syphon an attribute, the more powerful it becomes.
entries.zh: 同一种属性的碎片，吸收得越多，属性就越强。

entries.en: Hunters continue to discover new Shards every year.
entries.zh: 猎人们每年都会发现新的碎片。

entries.en: Actually, I've got another gift for you...
entries.zh: 其实，我还给你准备了一份礼物……

entries.en: I guess I'm in a generous mood today.
entries.zh: 看来我今天心情不错，出手都大方了。

entries.en: I crafted this Cloak some time ago. It seems to grow stronger with every hunt.
entries.zh: 这件披风是我前些日子做的。每次狩猎之后，它似乎都会变强一些。

entries.en: Use it to take your hunting skills to the next level!
entries.zh: 带上它，让你的狩猎本领再上一层楼吧！

entries.en: Talk to me if you want to learn more about hunting or view your progress.
entries.zh: 想多了解狩猎，或是看看自己的进展，就来找我。

entries.en: Have you got yourself a Huntrap yet?
entries.zh: 你有自己的猎捕陷阱了吗？
我可太喜欢这些东西了。

entries.en: Just set one up on any island, walk away, and when you come back, something's waiting for you!
entries.zh: 随便找个岛放好，转身走人，等你回来，就有东西在等着你了！

entries.en: You can place them where monsters tend to show up, or even dunk one underwater if you're feeling bold.
entries.zh: 可以放在怪物经常出没的地方，胆子大的话，泡在水底也行。

entries.en: I've caught creatures I'd never be able to snag on my own.
entries.zh: 有些生物凭我自己根本逮不住，靠它却抓到了。

entries.en: Ooh! Look! I think I just caught something!
entries.zh: 噢！快看！我好像抓到东西了！

entries.en: Anyways, maybe I should give you my spare Huntrap...
entries.zh: 总之，要不把我多余的猎捕陷阱送你吧……

entries.en: I've been cutting Fig Trees lately to gather more Tender Wood.
entries.zh: 最近我一直在砍无花果树，想多攒点嫩木。

entries.en: Once I have enough I will craft myself better Huntraps!
entries.zh: 等攒够了，我就做更好的猎捕陷阱！
嘿！那是我的！
等等……那是我的。

entries.en: Torrhus Springs being so high up means they run down super deep.
entries.zh: 托鲁斯泉的位置这么高，往下自然也深得很。

entries.en: The further down you go, the more Pressure builds up.
entries.zh: 潜得越深，压力就越大。

entries.en: If you're thinking of taking a dive, make sure you've got enough  Pressure Resistance and  Respiration to reach your destination.
entries.zh: 想潜下去的话，先确保  压力抵抗和  水下呼吸足够，能撑到目的地才行。

entries.en: Last thing I want to be doing on my day off work is hauling your butt out of there.
entries.zh: 我可不想休息的时候，还得把你从水里捞出来。

entries.en: Phew, you were almost a goner there. Good thing I'm a lifeguard, huh?
entries.zh: 呼，刚才你差点就没命了。还好我是救生员，对吧？

entries.en: Before diving down again, ensure you have enough  Pressure Resistance and  Respiration.
entries.zh: 再潜下去之前，先确认  压力抵抗和  水下呼吸都够用。

entries.en: My buddy Nemo over in Murkwater Loch sells some supplies, if you need them.
entries.zh: 我朋友尼莫在暗水湖卖补给，需要的话可以去看看。

entries.en: When cutting Helix Trees, you should always start with the Beige logs.
entries.zh: 砍螺旋树时，一定要先砍米色的原木。

entries.en: Once those have been dealt with, you can move on to the Red ones.
entries.zh: 把那些砍完，再去砍红色的。

entries.en: Make sure you do it in the right order, or you'll get a Sweep Penalty and the Tree will take longer to cut…
entries.zh: 千万别弄错顺序，否则会受到横扫惩罚，这棵树就得砍更久了……

entries.en: The axe forgets, but the tree remembers.
entries.zh: 斧头忘了，树却记得。

entries.en: My brother Teddy and I are some of the greatest hunters who have ever lived.
entries.zh: 我兄弟泰迪和我，可算是有史以来最出色的猎人了。

entries.en: This here Torrhus Canyon has become a second home to me over the years.
entries.zh: 这些年，托鲁斯峡谷就成了我的第二个家。

entries.en: If you ever need tips on how to hunt any  Critter on this here island, I’m yer man.
entries.zh: 要问这岛上的 小动物怎么捕，找我就对了。
蚂蚁？

entries.en: Hmm, them little fellas live down in Ant's Cave...
entries.zh: 唔，那些小家伙就住在下面的蚂蚁洞穴里...

entries.en: That thing's deep down in Torrhus Springs.
entries.zh: 那洞穴在托鲁斯泉的深处。

entries.en: Be sure to bring a Vacuum with ya - you'll need it to suck 'em up.
entries.zh: 可得带上吸尘器，得靠它把那些小家伙吸进去。

entries.en: Beeheemoths? Even I dunno where they come from.
entries.zh: Beeheemoths? 连我也不知道它们打哪儿来。

entries.en: They just show up sometimes, yaknow? Flying high around the island.
entries.zh: 它们偶尔就会冒出来，知道吧？在岛上空飞得老高。

entries.en: Listen out for a loud humming and keep yer eyes peeled and Lasso at the ready, I'd say.
entries.zh: 我的建议啊，听着点那响亮的嗡嗡声，眼睛放亮，把套索备好。

entries.en: Blue Jays? Them little guys live up in Torrhus Heights.
entries.zh: 蓝松鸦？那些小家伙住在托鲁斯高地上。

entries.en: Climb up high, Lasso in hand, and sneak up on 'em.
entries.zh: 爬到高处，拿着套索，悄悄靠近它们。

entries.en: Bunbuns? You ain't seen one yet?
entries.zh: Bunbuns? 你还没见过？
到处都是，蹦来跳去的！

entries.en: Them there Drybarks spawn from Helix Tree Gifts.
entries.zh: 那些 Drybarks 会从螺旋树赠礼里冒出来。

entries.en: Keep an eye on 'em while you get yer Lasso out.
entries.zh: 掏套索的时候，眼睛可别离开它们。

entries.en: Don't blink, or they'll come right atcha.
entries.zh: 眼都别眨，不然它们就直奔你来了。

entries.en: Them frogs known as Dustybits leap around the Spring Path.
entries.zh: 那些叫 Dustybits 的青蛙，就在泉水小径上蹦来蹦去。

entries.en: Chase 'em down, following them after each leap, an' eventually they'll get too tired to run any more.
entries.zh: 追着它们跑，每跳一次你就跟上去。到最后，它们就累得跑不动了。

entries.en: It's a battle of attrition, I'll say, you versus the beast.
entries.zh: 我说啊，这就是场消耗战，看你跟它谁耗得过谁。

entries.en: Them Embers live in Torrhus Springs, I believe.
entries.zh: 我记得那些 Embers 住在托鲁斯泉里。

entries.en: They be quite deep down, compared to Solars.
entries.zh: 比起日光蛾，它们住得可深多了。

entries.en: Catch 'em all in yer Fishing Net.
entries.zh: 用渔网把它们全捞起来。

entries.en: Pop open a Helix Tree Gift, ye might find a Firefox.
entries.zh: 打开一份螺旋树赠礼，说不定就能碰上火狐。

entries.en: They be quite timid, and won't cause yer Lasso any problems.
entries.zh: 它们胆子小，用套索抓，不会费多大劲。
唔，黄金蝾螈啊。

entries.en: That be a rare mutation of the Sepialot that sometimes appears in Torrhus Springs.
entries.zh: 这是墨鱼蝾螈的一种罕见变种，偶尔会在托鲁斯泉出现。

entries.en: I would say, hmm, maybe a 20% chance o' replacin' it.
entries.zh: 我估摸着，唔，大概有 20% 的概率由它来代替原来的那只。

entries.en: Sneak up on it and catch it in yer Fishing Net.
entries.zh: 悄悄靠近，再用渔网把它捉住。

entries.en: If I recall, them Groundhogs spawn from Helix Tree Gifts.
entries.zh: 没记错的话，那些土拨鼠会从螺旋树赠礼里冒出来。

entries.en: They're quite feisty, but use that there Lasso to tire 'em out.
entries.zh: 它们脾气不小，不过用套索耗到它们没力气就成。
匿日虫啊，唔，鬼鬼祟祟的小东西。

entries.en: Keep yer eyes peeled for any strange lookin' Orange Boxes.
entries.zh: 眼睛放亮，留意那些模样古怪的橙色箱子。

entries.en: They blend into the environment real well.
entries.zh: 它们可会藏了，跟周围环境几乎融成一片。

entries.en: Once ya find one, jump on its head or give it a punch to wake it up.
entries.zh: 一找到，就往它头上跳，或者给它一拳，把它弄醒。

entries.en: I seen a Hivethief or two show up sometimes.
entries.zh: 我偶尔也见过一两只盗巢蜂。

entries.en: They come by when you smear a Helix Tree with Honeycomb.
entries.zh: 在螺旋树上涂点蜜脾，它们就会过来。

entries.en: Me good friend Honey knows more about all that than me.
entries.zh: 我的好朋友哈妮比我更懂这事儿。

entries.en: Groups of Honeybuzz live within Honeyhives 'round the island.
entries.zh: 成群的嗡蜜蜂就住在岛上各处的蜂巢里。

entries.en: Stick yer hand in and you might just find one!
entries.zh: 把手伸进去，说不定就能摸到一只！

entries.en: The Mountain Goat live right up high.
entries.zh: 那些山羊啊，就住在高高的地方。

entries.en: On the Spring Path and other tall points is where you'll find 'em.
entries.zh: 到泉水小径和其他高处，就能找到它们。

entries.en: Keep yer distance when you Lasso 'em, though - their headbutt will send yer flying.
entries.zh: 用套索套它们时可得离远点——那一头撞过来，能把你顶飞。

entries.en: Them Pangolins be right scared of their own shadow, I tell ya.
entries.zh: 那些穿山甲连自己的影子都怕，真不骗你。

entries.en: Sneak up on 'em, quiet as you can, and Lasso 'em before they can turn into a ball.
entries.zh: 尽量放轻动静，悄悄靠近，赶在它们蜷成球之前用套索套住它们。

entries.en: If they do curl up, yer gonna have to wait a while until they let their guard down again.
entries.zh: 要是它们已经蜷起来了，你就得等上一阵，等它们再放松警惕。
那些干渴尸壳渴得厉害。

entries.en: If you smear a Helix Tree with Honey, they might show up.
entries.zh: 往螺旋树上涂点哈妮，它们说不定就来了。

entries.en: The lovely Honey knows more about all that stuff than I do.
entries.zh: 可爱的哈妮比我更懂这些事。

entries.en: Them Pollendarts love their Honey, I know that much!
entries.zh: 那些花粉镖蜂就爱哈妮，这点我可清楚！

entries.en: If you smear a Helix Tree with Honey, they might come.
entries.zh: 往螺旋树上涂点哈妮，它们说不定就会来。

entries.en: Open up a Helix Tree Gift, ye might find a Puck.
entries.zh: 打开一份螺旋树赠礼，说不定会碰上帕克。

entries.en: They be mischievous little buggers, but they ain't as strong as a well-placed Lasso, I can tell yer that much.
entries.zh: 它们是调皮的小家伙，但只要把套索套准了，任它们怎么闹也挣不过，这点我敢保证。

entries.en: Ah, the Queen Ant. A special one, she is.
entries.zh: 啊，蚁后，她可不一般。

entries.en: Dive deep down into Torrhus Springs, make yer way into Ant's Cave.
entries.zh: 潜到托鲁斯泉的深处，进到蚂蚁洞穴里去。

entries.en: You'll rarely find her scuttlin' about on the cave floor.
entries.zh: 平时很少能看到她在洞底爬来爬去。

entries.en: She's more likely to come out if ya start destroyin' the Anthills, though.
entries.zh: 不过，要是开始拆那些蚁丘，她就更有可能出来了。

entries.en: Sepialot, huh, that thing be up in Torrhus Springs.
entries.zh: 墨鱼蝾螈啊，那家伙就在托鲁斯泉里。

entries.en: Sneak up on it and catch it in yer Fishing Net before it sees ya.
entries.zh: 悄悄靠近，趁它还没发现你，就用渔网把它捉住。

entries.en: Hur hur hur hurr! That Tiki Trio, I hate 'em, I really do!
entries.zh: 嘿嘿嘿嘿！那帮提基魔像 Trio，我可太讨厌它们了，真的！

entries.en: The Sneaky Tiki, Shrieky Tiki, and Cheeky Tiki.
entries.zh: 就是潜行提基魔像、尖叫提基魔像，还有调皮提基魔像。

entries.en: I can't tell ya which one I hate the most. But I can tell ya which one I hate the least - none of 'em!
entries.zh: 要问我最讨厌哪个，还真说不准。可要问哪个没那么讨厌——一个都没有！

entries.en: You can find 'em up in Torrhus Heights.
entries.zh: 去托鲁斯高地，就能找到它们。

entries.en: They'll stay still, unmovin', until you solve their puzzle.
entries.zh: 只要你还没解开它们的谜题，它们就一直杵在那里，一动不动。

entries.en: Then they'll come to life and blitz 'ya.
entries.zh: 然后它们就活过来了，冲上来猛攻你。

entries.en: Fend 'em off, and catch 'em in a Pocket Black Hole.
entries.zh: 顶住它们的攻击，再用口袋黑洞把它们捉住。

entries.en: Ah, just thinkin 'bout them has me blood boilin'...
entries.zh: 唉，光想起那帮家伙，我就气得冒火...

entries.en: Eh, them Solars live in Torrhus Springs, too.
entries.zh: 哎，那些日光蛾也住在托鲁斯泉里。

entries.en: They be needing light to function, so they be up near the surface.
entries.zh: 它们需要光才能活动，所以都待在靠近水面的地方。

entries.en: Scoop em up in yer Fishing Net.
entries.zh: 用渔网把它们捞起来。
小子，你眼睛不好使吗？

entries.en: Turn around and look into that there Pond!
entries.zh: 转过身，瞧瞧那边的池塘！
里面全是怯水鱼，多得都快溢出来了！
水蛇啊...

entries.en: They be livin in the deepest depths of Torrhus Springs.
entries.zh: 它们就住在托鲁斯泉最深最深的地方。

entries.en: Get all of yer best divin' gear on, and them pay 'em a visit.
entries.zh: 把你最好的潜水装备全穿上，再下去瞧瞧它们。

entries.en: Bring yer biggest net, too - a Turbo Fishing Net or better should do the trick.
entries.zh: 也带上你最大的网——涡轮渔网或更好的网，应该就行。

entries.en: It's a great day to go for a run!
entries.zh: 今天真适合跑上一圈！

entries.en: You're always welcome to try the race again. Just run over the pressure plate to begin!
entries.zh: 随时欢迎你再跑一次！踩上压力板就能开始。

entries.en: Hey! Come talk to me over here! I'll tell you all about racing!
entries.zh: 嘿！到这边来找我聊聊！我来给你讲讲竞速！
没有什么比岛屿竞速更痛快的了！

entries.en: Come back when you have unlocked the rest of The Park if you want to give it a try!
entries.zh: 想试试的话，先解锁公园的其余区域再回来吧！

entries.en: I've traveled many islands and this is my favorite to race on. Want to try?
entries.zh: 我跑过不少岛屿，最喜欢的还是这里。想试试吗？

entries.en: To complete the race, you'll need to reach the opposite side of the island AND come back all the way back.
entries.zh: 完成比赛要先跑到岛的另一头，然后再一路跑回来。

entries.en: Start the race by walking over the pressure plate. If you finish in under 2 minutes, I'll reward you for it! Good luck!
entries.zh: 踩上压力板就能开跑。如果能在 2 分钟内完成，我就给你奖励！加油！

entries.en: Run over the pressure plate to start racing! Run up to the opposite side of the island AND back to complete the race. Can you finish it in 2 minutes?
entries.zh: 踩上压力板就能开始比赛！跑到岛的另一头再折返回来才算完成。你能在 2 分钟内跑完吗？

entries.en: I hope you can get a better than this!
entries.zh: 希望你还能跑出更好的成绩！

entries.en: Here's a Polished Pebble. I found it laying around...
entries.zh: 给你一颗抛光鹅卵石，我在附近捡到的……

entries.en: Try again, but this time come back in 1 minute or less!
entries.zh: 再试一次，不过这回要在 1 分钟内跑回来！

entries.en: Keep it up! Can you finish the race in 1 minute or less?
entries.zh: 继续加油！能在 1 分钟内完成比赛吗？

entries.en: Use my Hunter Knife. Holding it somehow makes me go faster.
entries.zh: 用我的猎人匕首吧。拿着它，不知怎么就跑得更快了。

entries.en: See if you can beat 32 seconds!
entries.zh: 看看你能不能跑进 32 秒！

entries.en: Keep at it! Can you finish the race in 32 seconds or less?
entries.zh: 再接再厉！能在 32 秒内完成比赛吗？

entries.en: Now we're cooking! You're getting close to my record!
entries.zh: 这才像话！你快赶上我的纪录了！

entries.en: Here's an trinket I've found in the caverns behind the waterfall.
entries.zh: 这是我在瀑布后面的洞穴里找到的小玩意儿。

entries.en: Finish the race in under 18 seconds and come talk to me!
entries.zh: 跑进 18 秒再来找我！

entries.en: Real challenge! Can you finish the race in 18 seconds or less and beat my personal record?
entries.zh: 真正的挑战来了！能在 18 秒内跑完，打破我的个人纪录吗？

entries.en: You did it! Congratulations, %1$s. You are now faster than Gustave!
entries.zh: 你做到了！恭喜你，%1$s。现在你比古斯塔夫还快了！

entries.en: I've been racing this island so fast that some bark from the trees snatched right off!
entries.zh: 我在岛上跑得太快，连树皮都被蹭下来了！

entries.en: Here's a rare piece of Silky Lichen. Maybe you can do something with it.
entries.zh: 给你一块稀有的丝滑地衣，说不定你能派上用场。
