entries.en: I heard this lichen could improve some weapons!
entries.zh: 听说这种地衣能用来强化一些武器！
嗨嗨！欢迎来到托鲁斯峡谷！

entries.en: Under the heat of the scorching sun, your journey's just begun!
entries.zh: 烈日当空，你的旅程才刚开头！

entries.en: I'm in charge of the Torrhus Chapters - complete my tasks and claim your Rewards!
entries.zh: 我负责的是托鲁斯章节——完成我的任务，就能领取奖励！

entries.en: So, before you go dashing off to find Miria and take part in her Starlyn Contest, why don't you take a look?
entries.zh: 先别急着跑去找米莉亚参加她的星林竞赛，来看看这些章节怎么样？

entries.en: Have you spoken to Miria yet? She's just down the Spring Path!
entries.zh: 你去找米莉亚聊过了吗？她就在泉水小径那边！

entries.en: Simply turn left at the crossroads up ahead and keep going until you see her!
entries.zh: 到前面的十字路口左转，一直走就能见到她啦！
哇，你真的做到了！

entries.en: You've completed all of the Torrhus Chapters!
entries.zh: 你已经完成了全部托鲁斯章节！

entries.en: You're one of a kind - a four-leaf clover among the foliage!
entries.zh: 你真是独一无二——就像绿叶丛中的四叶草！

entries.en: Great job, %1$s! I look forward to seeing where your journey takes you next!
entries.zh: 干得漂亮，%1$s! 真期待看看，你接下来的旅程会通向哪里！

entries.en: You've done what few even try. Each creature you met each tree you felled, it all shaped you. And now, you shape Galatea.
entries.zh: 你做到了少有人尝试的事。遇见的每个生灵、砍倒的每棵树，都造就了今天的你。如今，轮到你来改变加拉蒂亚了。

entries.en: Look at you. Sweeping like a storm, hunting like a whisper. I couldn't be prouder.
entries.zh: 瞧瞧你，横扫时如风暴席卷，狩猎时又悄无声息。我真是为你骄傲极了。

entries.en: You've mastered every path I know.
entries.zh: 我知道的这些门道，你已经全都掌握了。
恭喜你，%1$s。

entries.en: Psst, have you heard of the Tree Protection Agency?
entries.zh: 嘘，听说过树木保护局吗？

entries.en: Well, they're an evil group that is all about protecting the Trees!
entries.zh: 哼，那帮坏家伙，满脑子都是保护树木！

entries.en: Any poor tree with a Tree Protection Order on it, you simply can't cut!
entries.zh: 哪棵可怜的树一旦被下了树木保护令，你就砍不动它了！

entries.en: Though, while we can't cut them, what we can do is deface them a little...
entries.zh: 不过，虽说砍不了，稍微糟蹋一下还是可以的……
请选择: [糟蹋？!]

entries.en: Well I'm gonna tell you anyways, because you don't look like someone who knows a lot.
entries.zh: 那我还是给你讲讲吧，看你也不像懂很多的样子。

entries.en: So, about the Tree Protection Agency...
entries.zh: 说起树木保护局……

entries.en: Yeah, if you progress through the Honeycomb Collection, you'll notice that there's a Fun-Sized Pot of Honeycomb.
entries.zh: 对啊，推进蜜脾收集，你就会发现一个叫迷你蜂巢罐的东西。

entries.en: If you make one of those, you can go right up to a Protected Tree and smear Honeycomb all over it!
entries.zh: 做一个，走到受保护的树前，把蜜脾涂得满树都是！

entries.en: Then, if you check back after a while, a %1$s Critter will have come along and started eating all the Honeycomb!
entries.zh: 过一阵再去看，就会有%1$s 小动物跑来，大口享用那些蜜脾！

entries.en: Eh, why don't I just show you a visual?
entries.zh: 算了，我直接给你画出来吧？

entries.en: The hooded figure doesn't acknowledge your presence.
entries.zh: 戴着兜帽的身影没有理会你。

entries.en: I found this really cool %1$s on the floor around here.
entries.zh: 我在这附近地上捡到了一个挺不错的 %1$s。
你想要吗？

entries.en: I'll trade it to you in exchange for a %1$s.
entries.zh: 拿一个 %1$s 来，我就跟你换。
好吧好吧，看来不值什么钱……

entries.en: Are you trying to scam me? You don't have a %1$s.
entries.zh: 想骗我吗？你根本没有 %1$s。

entries.en: Trying to scam me? I'll hunt YOU!
entries.zh: 敢骗我？下一个猎物就是你！

entries.en: Done deal! Enjoy the %1$s, my dude!
entries.zh: 成交！这个 %1$s 归你了，朋友！
合作愉快！

entries.en: It's f-f-f-freezing out here - d-d-don't sit around for t-t-too long!
entries.zh: 这、这儿冷死了——别、别在外头待、待太久！

entries.en: I've got a %1$s you can h-h-have, if you w-w-want it...
entries.zh: 我有个 %1$s,你、你想要的话，可、可以给你……

entries.en: You can h-h-have it if you give m-m-me a %1$s...
entries.zh: 拿、拿个 %1$s 给我，就、就归你了……
行吧。
走、走路小心点……
你连 %1$s 都没有！
别、别想坑我！
太、太好了！谢、谢谢……
换、换得真值！谢、谢谢！
呼！

entries.en: Glad to find someone else out here - this place is scary!
entries.zh: 终于看见别人了——这地方太吓人了！

entries.en: Say, do you have a use for a %1$s? I found it lying around...
entries.zh: 话说，这个 %1$s 你用得上吗？我在附近捡到的……

entries.en: I'll give you it in exchange for a %1$s!
entries.zh: 拿一个来换就行: %1$s!
呃，好吧。

entries.en: Don't go too far, it's scary...
entries.zh: 别走太远，这里好吓人……
别耍我！
太好了，谢啦！

entries.en: That little ball right here is actually a Scrappy.
entries.zh: 这里这个小球，其实是一只废料怪。

entries.en: Critter Capsules don't seem to do anything to them.
entries.zh: 小动物捕捉胶囊好像对它们没用。

entries.en: "Hunter" Tobias had mentioned to me that you can lure them out with Food.
entries.zh: “猎人”托比亚斯跟我说过，可以用食物把它们引出来。

entries.en: He said that they might like either Wholesale Wheat, Flavor-packed Fish, or Lush Lily Pads.
entries.zh: 他说它们可能喜欢批发小麦、风味十足的鱼，或是繁茂睡莲。

entries.en: Hmm that "Hunter" Tobias guy was right... Nice Catch!
entries.zh: 嗯，那个 “猎人”托比亚斯还真没说错……抓得漂亮！

entries.en: There might be more Scrappy around - I wonder if my brothers have found them yet.
entries.zh: 附近应该还有废料怪，不知道我的兄弟们找到了没。

entries.en: I saw a really strange %1$s Critter the other day...
entries.zh: 前几天，我见到一只特别奇怪的%1$s 小动物……

entries.en: It looked different from the usual stuff I see around here - it was SPARKLING...
entries.zh: 和这里平常见到的都不一样——它竟然在闪耀……

entries.en: I stopped what I was doing and tried my best to catch it...but it got away.
entries.zh: 我立刻放下手里的活，拼命想抓住它……可还是让它跑了。

entries.en: Haven't seen one since - they must be pretty rare...
entries.zh: 后来就再也没见过，一定很稀有吧……

entries.en: Perhaps "Hunter" Tobias knows something about them?
entries.zh: 也许 “猎人”托比亚斯知道些什么？

entries.en: See that little creature next to me? That's actually a Scrappy that curled itself into a ball.
entries.zh: 看见我旁边的小家伙了吗？其实是一只蜷成球的废料怪。

entries.en: My Critter Capsules seem to just bounce right off it!
entries.zh: 我的小动物捕捉胶囊一碰到它就弹开了！

entries.en: That "Hunter" Tobias guy told me that they love Food.
entries.zh: 那个 “猎人”托比亚斯告诉我，它们特别爱吃食物。

entries.en: He said that they might be motivated to come out if given either Wholesale Wheat, Flavor-packed Fish, or Lush Lily Pads.
entries.zh: 他说给它们批发小麦、风味十足的鱼或繁茂睡莲，可能就肯出来了。

entries.en: That really worked, you caught the Scrappy! Nice going!
entries.zh: 真有用，你抓到废料怪了！干得漂亮！

entries.en: My brothers might be around here, maybe they found more Scrappy...
entries.zh: 我兄弟们可能也在附近，没准又找到了几只废料怪……

entries.en: That little ball nearby is actually a Scrappy all curled up.
entries.zh: 旁边那个小球，其实是一只蜷起来的废料怪。

entries.en: My Critter Capsules are useless against it in this state...
entries.zh: 它这副样子，我的小动物捕捉胶囊根本拿它没办法……

entries.en: However, that "Hunter" Tobias guy told me that you can sometimes coax them into coming out with Food.
entries.zh: 不过，那个 “猎人”托比亚斯告诉我，有时可以用食物把它们哄出来。

entries.en: He said that each Scrappy is different, and they like either Wholesale Wheat, Flavor-packed Fish, or Lush Lily Pads.
entries.zh: 他说每只废料怪的口味都不一样，有的喜欢批发小麦，有的喜欢风味十足的鱼，还有的喜欢繁茂睡莲。

entries.en: You really managed to catch that Scrappy? Nice going!
entries.zh: 你真抓到了那只废料怪？干得漂亮！

entries.en: Keep an eye out for my brothers - they might have found more Scrappy around...
entries.zh: 留意一下我的兄弟们吧，他们也许还找到了别的废料怪……
怎么样？

entries.en: I'm the greatest hunter around - the name's Tobias.
entries.zh: 我可是这一带最厉害的猎人——记住了，我叫托比亚斯。

entries.en: I'm actually so great that I've caught every single %1$s Critter in the Critter Safari.
entries.zh: 我可是把小动物游猎场里的每一种%1$s 小动物都抓到过了。
请选择: [厉害！] [啊对对对……]

entries.en: Anyways, why don't we see how many %1$s Critters you've caught?.
entries.zh: 总之，让我看看，你抓到多少种%1$s 小动物了？

entries.en: What did you say to me?
entries.zh: 你刚才说什么？

entries.en: Say sorry right now, or I won't let you use the Critterdex.
entries.zh: 立刻道歉，不然我就不让你用小动物图鉴。

entries.en: I'm not letting you use the Critterdex until you say I am very sorry Tobias and regret my actions deeply.
entries.zh: 想用小动物图鉴，就给我说: I am very sorry 托比亚斯 and regret my actions deeply。
我等着呢！

entries.en: That's what I thought! Thanks for acknowledging your inferiority.
entries.zh: 这还差不多！谢谢你承认自己不如我。
给，这是小动物图鉴。

entries.en: You can use it to view all of the %1$s Critters you've caught while in the Critter Safari.
entries.zh: 可以用它查看你在小动物游猎场中捕获的所有%1$s 小动物。

entries.en: While you'll never catch as many as me, you should try your best anyways.
entries.zh: 虽然你永远不可能抓得和我一样多，但还是努力试试吧。

entries.en: Uh guys, you better come and see this...
entries.zh: 呃，各位，你们最好过来看看……

entries.en: There are lots of useful things lying about on the ground in the Critter Safari.
entries.zh: 在小动物游猎场里，地上散落着不少实用的东西。

entries.en: Us hunters like to call them Floor Drops.
entries.zh: 我们猎人喜欢叫它们地面拾取物。

entries.en: Certain %1$s Critters can only be found with the help of specific floor drops. How exciting!
entries.zh: 有些%1$s 小动物，只有借助特定的地面拾取物才能找到。是不是很有意思！

entries.en: Do you want this %1$s? I already maxed that Attribute...
entries.zh: 想要这个 %1$s 吗？这个属性我已经升满了……

entries.en: How about I give you it in exchange for, say, a %1$s?
entries.zh: 要不这样，拿一个来换: %1$s?
哼，随你便。
呃，你并没有 %1$s。

entries.en: Come back when you find one!
entries.zh: 找到了再来吧！
好耶！谢谢你跟我交换！

entries.en: I'll let you know if I ever find another Shard to trade!
entries.zh: 以后要是又找到能交换的碎片，我再告诉你！
止步，年轻的凡人。

entries.en: You desire one of my precious Jade Eggs?
entries.zh: 你想要我珍藏的翡翠龙蛋？

entries.en: Know that they come at a price, measured in treasures beyond imagining.
entries.zh: 要知道，换取它的代价，是超乎你想象的珍宝。
证明你的价值吧。

entries.en: The forest rewards those who walk it with care.
entries.zh: 森林会回馈每一位用心行走其中的人。

entries.en: Hey, are you David Hunterborough's new apprentice?
entries.zh: 嘿，你是大卫·亨特伯勒新收的学徒吗？

entries.en: I've been hunting fish all day long, why don't you give it a try?
entries.zh: 我都捕了一整天鱼了，你也来试试？

entries.en: But first grab this fishing net.
entries.zh: 不过，先拿上这张渔网。

entries.en: I'm guessing you have never used a fishing net before?
entries.zh: 我猜你以前没用过渔网吧？

entries.en: All you have to do is throw it at fish you see in the water.
entries.zh: 只要看见水里有鱼，把网朝它扔过去就行。

entries.en: Try it on this fish right here.
entries.zh: 就拿这边这条鱼试试吧。

entries.en: All you have to do is throw it at any fish you see in the water!
entries.zh: 水里的鱼随便挑一条，把网朝它扔过去就行！

entries.en: Try it on this fish right there.
entries.zh: 就拿那边那条鱼试试吧。
干得漂亮！

entries.en: You've successfully ended the peaceful existence of a fish!
entries.zh: 你成功给一条鱼安稳的一生画上了句号！

entries.en: That's what all hunters live for!
entries.zh: 猎人活着不就图这个嘛！

entries.en: David Hunterborough's going to be over the moon about this.
entries.zh: 大卫·亨特伯勒知道了，肯定得乐开花。

entries.en: Make sure to share every gripping detail of your epic conquest with him next.
entries.zh: 接下来，记得把你这场史诗级大捷的每个精彩细节都讲给他听。

entries.en: You should go talk to David Hunterborough next.
entries.zh: 接下来，去找大卫·亨特伯勒聊聊吧。

entries.en: Those tiny fish are super cute, that's mostly why I hunt them.
entries.zh: 那些小鱼实在太可爱了，我捕它们主要就是因为这个。

entries.en: The creatures deep down this loch are quite scary.
entries.zh: 这湖深处的生物可吓人了。
很高兴认识你！

entries.en: Could you find my dear Romero?
entries.zh: 能帮我找找我亲爱的罗梅罗吗？

entries.en: He's in a cave somewhere under the Savanna Woodland.
entries.zh: 他在热带草原林地下面的某个洞穴里。

entries.en: He wears glasses and blends well in a crowd!
entries.zh: 他戴着眼镜，混在人群里很不起眼！
你找到罗梅罗了？

entries.en: Did he have anything for me?
entries.zh: 他有东西托你带给我吗？
(手持罗梅罗的礼物以推进任务)

entries.en: You found Romero? That's weird, I just saw him!
entries.zh: 你找到罗梅罗了？奇怪，我刚刚才见过他！

entries.en: He wanted me to have this? So sweet!
entries.zh: 这是他要送给我的？真贴心！

entries.en: A yellow rock? What's the point of that?
entries.zh: 一块黄石？这东西有什么用啊？
喏，你留着吧！

entries.en: Since you're here, can you find Romero again?
entries.zh: 既然你在这儿，能再帮我找找罗梅罗吗？

entries.en: He said he was getting groceries at the downtown markets.
entries.zh: 他说要去市中心的集市买些东西。

entries.en: Romero? He just came over with the groceries.
entries.zh: 罗梅罗？他刚带着买好的东西来过。
这些花是送给我的？
你真是太贴心了！

entries.en: You know I'm with Romero, right?
entries.zh: 你知道我已经和罗梅罗在一起了吧？
亲爱的，真不好意思，又要麻烦你……

entries.en: Can you please find Romero again?
entries.zh: 能再帮我找找罗梅罗吗？

entries.en: He's at some sort of emerald altar...
entries.zh: 他在一个什么绿宝石祭坛那儿……

entries.en: Oof! Why did you bring this all the way here?
entries.zh: 哎哟！你怎么把这东西大老远搬来了？
这也能叫礼物？

entries.en: Just keep it! I don't want this!
entries.zh: 你自己留着吧！我可不想要！
我想要的是罗梅罗！

entries.en: For some reason, he's now looking for...
entries.zh: 也不知道为什么，他现在在找……

entries.en: The largest, most evil patch of fungus ever!
entries.zh: 一片最大、最邪恶的蘑菇！
炖汤？我最爱喝汤了！
呸呸呸！!!
太恶心了！

entries.en: Is that a stew from hell?
entries.zh: 这汤是从地狱端来的吗？

entries.en: Maybe Romero should give you cooking lessons!
entries.zh: 也许你该跟罗梅罗学学做饭！

entries.en: Oh! I love Romero! He has so many skills.
entries.zh: 啊，我好爱罗梅罗！他可会好多东西呢。

entries.en: Did you know he likes photography?
entries.zh: 你知道他喜欢摄影吗？

entries.en: Just now, he went to take pictures of the old castle.
entries.zh: 他刚刚去给那座古堡拍照了。
去找他吧！

entries.en: You really believe that this is from the Moon?
entries.zh: 你真信这东西是从月亮上来的？
怎么弄的？有人飞上去了？
谢谢你吧。

entries.en: Actually, I heard Romero flew close to the Sun.
entries.zh: 说起来，我听说罗梅罗飞到太阳附近去了。

entries.en: Sounds more like a metaphor, like...
entries.zh: 听起来更像个比喻，比如说……

entries.en: He went to where gold is smelted.
entries.zh: 他去了冶炼黄金的地方。

entries.en: Please find him, wherever that is!
entries.zh: 不管是哪儿，拜托你找到他！
这份礼物太棒了！

entries.en: I will keep this one for myself.
entries.zh: 这件我要自己留着。

entries.en: Sometimes, some things have to remain a mystery.
entries.zh: 有些事情，就让它保持神秘吧。

entries.en: About something not so secret, can you get in touch with Romero?
entries.zh: 说件没那么神秘的事，你能联系一下罗梅罗吗？

entries.en: He told me he's in his home.
entries.zh: 他说他在自己家。
咦？罗梅罗解开他的魔方了？
真不敢相信。

entries.en: No, really, I don't believe it at all.
entries.zh: 不，我是说真的，我一点也不信。

entries.en: I don't know why Romero is trying to be so unlike himself lately.
entries.zh: 我不明白罗梅罗最近为什么总想变得不像自己。

entries.en: I like him just the way he is!
entries.zh: 我喜欢的就是他原本的样子！

entries.en: He says he's getting equipment for a duel.
entries.zh: 他说要去弄一套决斗用的装备。

entries.en: Can you find Romero before he hurts himself?
entries.zh: 能帮我找到罗梅罗吗？可别让他伤到自己。
这首诗真美。

entries.en: But, does he really think there's someone else?
entries.zh: 可是，他真以为我喜欢别人吗？

entries.en: I can't possibly imagine why he'd think that.
entries.zh: 我实在想不出他为什么会这么想。

entries.en: Romero went to meditate at his retreat.
entries.zh: 罗梅罗去他的清静小屋冥想了。

entries.en: It's the smallest house in SkyBlock.
entries.zh: 那是整个空岛最小的房子。
拜托你去找找他，我很担心！
又是罗梅罗送来的礼物？
谢谢你帮忙送来。

entries.en: I don't know how Romero has such hard a time understanding that I LOVE HIM.
entries.zh: 我真不明白，怎么罗梅罗就这么难以明白我爱他呢。

entries.en: I don't need tons of gifts to know that.
entries.zh: 我不需要一大堆礼物来证明这件事。

entries.en: It's decided, this is the day!
entries.zh: 决定了，就在今天！
我们要正式在一起了！

entries.en: We can't thank you enough for bringing us together!
entries.zh: 多亏你让我们走到了一起，真是感激不尽！
你真是最棒的，%1$s!
我爱罗梅罗！
你的%1$s已升级为%2$s!

entries.en: Select an option: [Yeah] [Never heard of him]
entries.zh: 请选择： [是啊] [没听说过他]
好吧，事情是这样的。

entries.en: I was breaking this tree right here, right.
entries.zh: 我刚刚在砍这棵树，对吧。

entries.en: But then I broke my axe!
entries.zh: 然后我的斧头就坏了！

entries.en: And now I don't want to break any more trees, in case I break any more axes!
entries.zh: 现在我可不想再砍树了，万一又弄坏一把斧头呢！

entries.en: Anyways, if you can bring me 128 Spruce Logs, I'll give you a reward!
entries.zh: 总之，你给我带来 128 个云杉原木，我就给你奖励！

entries.en: Strange... I could've sworn you'd met.
entries.zh: 奇怪……我明明记得你们见过。

entries.en: Anyways, I was breaking this tree right here, right.
entries.zh: 总之，我刚才在砍这棵树，对吧。

entries.en: If you can bring me 128 Spruce Logs, I'll give you a reward!
entries.zh: 你给我带来 128 个云杉原木，我就给你奖励！
给我带来 128 个云杉原木吧！

entries.en: That's two stacks of them, if you're struggling to do the math!
entries.zh: 算不过来的话，那就是两组！

entries.en: Oh, that's amazing! Thank you so much!
entries.zh: 啊，太棒了！真是谢谢你！

entries.en: And then, with the coins he gives me, I can get a Spruce Minion!
entries.zh: 然后拿他给的硬币，去买一个云杉小人！

entries.en: You should check out the Dark Thicket next. Be careful though!
entries.zh: 接下来你可以去幽暗灌木丛看看。不过要当心！

entries.en: I've heard some people are holding a Cult Meeting there RIGHT NOW!
entries.zh: 听说有人在那儿举行教团集会，而且现在就在开！

entries.en: I can't control what I say to people. I spend the whole day talking.
entries.zh: 我总管不住自己的嘴，一天到晚都在说话。

entries.en: I talk a lot, so I've learned to just tune myself out.
entries.zh: 我话太多了，已经学会不听自己在说什么了。

entries.en: Did you check out the Cult over in the Dark Thicket yet?
entries.zh: 你去教团那边看过了吗？就在幽暗灌木丛。

entries.en: Oh hey, I've seen you around.
entries.zh: 哦，是你啊，我见过你。

entries.en: I've been trying to get my Abiphone updated with more local contacts.
entries.zh: 最近我想给阿比手机多加些本地联系人。

entries.en: But I don't just hand out my number to anyone. You've got to earn it.
entries.zh: 不过，我的号码可不是谁都能拿到的。得看你的本事。
请选择: [当然。]

entries.en: There's this creature I've been dying to track. It shifts colors, blends in, vanishes like mist.
entries.zh: 有种生物，我一直想找到。它会变换颜色、融入环境，像雾一样消失。

entries.en: They say if you're lucky, you might find one in Tree Gifts... a Chameleon Shard.
entries.zh: 听说运气好的话，能从树木馈赠里找到它……一枚变色龙碎片。

entries.en: Bring me one. If you can do that, maybe you're worth talking to.
entries.zh: 带一枚给我。能做到的话，也许你值得结交。

entries.en: You actually found one? You weren't kidding around.
entries.zh: 你真找到了？看来不是说着玩的。

entries.en: Look at those colors... even holding it feels like it's trying to disappear.
entries.zh: 瞧瞧这颜色……握在手里，都感觉它随时想消失。

entries.en: Alright, fair's fair. I'm adding you to my Abiphone.
entries.zh: 行，我说话算话。这就把你加进阿比手机。

entries.en: Just don't flood me with calls.
entries.zh: 别天天打来烦我就行。

entries.en: Are you a fan of Reptiles and Amphibians? I can't get enough of them!
entries.zh: 你喜欢爬行动物和两栖动物吗？我怎么都看不够它们！
它们真是又珍贵又可爱！

entries.en: They can be very hard to find, but they all have unique abilities.
entries.zh: 它们可不好找，不过每一种都有独特的本领。

entries.en: Their genetics differ from most other creatures.
entries.zh: 它们的遗传特性和大多数生物都不一样。

entries.en: In the Fusion Machine, fusing shards with a Reptile often yields powerful results.
entries.zh: 用融合机融合碎片时，加入爬行动物的碎片，往往能得到很强的结果。

entries.en: Reptiles and Amphibians only need 2 shards to fuse, which is much less than most other creatures.
entries.zh: 爬行动物和两栖动物只需 2 个碎片就能融合，比大多数生物需要的少多了。

entries.en: There is a small chance for the rarity to increase too!
entries.zh: 还有小概率提升稀有度呢！

entries.en: I breed Reptiles daily, so stop by every day and I'll have some for sale!
entries.zh: 我每天都会繁育爬行动物。记得天天来看看，我会留一些出售！

entries.en: David Hunterborough says you've completed your training.
entries.zh: 大卫·亨特伯勒说你完成训练了。

entries.en: Now, it's time to teach you the true purpose of hunting.
entries.zh: 现在，该告诉你狩猎真正的用处了。

entries.en: Every Shard you collect goes into your Hunting Box, located in the Hunting Skill Menu.
entries.zh: 你收集的每枚碎片都会进入狩猎箱，打开狩猎技能菜单就能找到。

entries.en: There are two things you can do with those Shards.
entries.zh: 这些碎片有两种用法。
说到这里，都明白了吗？
请选择: [当然！]

entries.en: You can either syphon or fuse them.
entries.zh: 可以吸收，也可以融合。

entries.en: Syphoning is key - it lets you permanently gain the attribute of the creature it came from.
entries.zh: 吸收很重要——它能让你永久获得对应生物的属性。
请选择: [属性是什么？]

entries.en: Attributes are very much like Pet abilities in a way.
entries.zh: 从某种意义上说，属性很像宠物的技能。

entries.en: But hunting lets you harness those powers independently of the creature.
entries.zh: 但狩猎能让你不依靠那只生物，也能运用这份力量。
来，拿着这枚幻夜蝠碎片。

entries.en: Open your Hunting Box, inside the Hunting Skill Menu, and syphon it.
entries.zh: 打开狩猎技能菜单里的狩猎箱，把它吸收掉。
凯莎给了你 1 枚幻夜蝠碎片！

entries.en: Go inside your Hunting Box, inside the Hunting Skill Menu, and Syphon it.
entries.zh: 进入狩猎技能菜单里的狩猎箱，把它吸收掉。

entries.en: Congratulations! You permanently unlocked the %1$s attribute!
entries.zh: 恭喜！你永久解锁了 %1$s 属性！

entries.en: Every time you syphon more of a Shard, that attribute will grow stronger.
entries.zh: 每当你继续吸收同一种碎片，对应的属性就会变得更强。

entries.en: You can view it in your Attribute Menu inside the Hunting Skill Menu.
entries.zh: 可以在狩猎技能菜单里的属性菜单中查看。
请选择: [还有别的吗？]

entries.en: Like I said earlier, you can also fuse Shards.
entries.zh: 刚才说过，你还可以融合碎片。
我们把这个过程称为融合。

entries.en: To fuse, combine 5 Shards of one creature with 5 Shards of another in the Fusion Machine.
entries.zh: 进行融合时，在融合机器中放入一种生物的 5 枚碎片，再放入另一种生物的 5 枚碎片。

entries.en: The fusion process can uncover creatures that haven't been discovered yet!
entries.zh: 融合可能让你发现从未见过的生物！

entries.en: I've given you 5 Phanpyre Shards and 5 Cod Shards to fuse in the Fusion Machine.
entries.zh: 我给了你 5 枚幻夜蝠碎片和 5 枚鳕鱼碎片，拿去融合机器里试试吧。

entries.en: Try it out and see what you can create!
entries.zh: 试试看，能创造出什么！

entries.en: Kysha gave you 5x Phanpyre Shards and 5x Cod Shards!
entries.zh: 凯莎给了你 5 枚幻夜蝠碎片和 5 枚鳕鱼碎片！

entries.en: Go on, try to fuse Shards together in the fusion machine.
entries.zh: 去吧，试着把碎片放进融合机器里合成。

entries.en: You might need to hunt a few more creatures first!
entries.zh: 也许得先多狩猎几只生物！
你融合出了一枚 %1$s 碎片！

entries.en: We are still discovering Shards every year!
entries.zh: 每年，我们都还在发现新的碎片！
融合的可能性是无穷的！

entries.en: In my spare time I like to go swimming down in the Murkwater Loch.
entries.zh: 闲下来的时候，我喜欢到暗水湖里游泳。

entries.en: There are so many beautiful creatures to see down there.
entries.zh: 那下面有好多美丽的生灵。

entries.en: Verdants, Azures, Shellwise, Joydives, I've seen them all.
entries.zh: 翠绿鱼、湛蓝鱼、智壳龟、欢跃鸟，我都见过。

entries.en: However, there's one that I've never quite been able to find.
entries.zh: 不过，有一种我始终没能找到。

entries.en: The folk around here call her Nessie.
entries.zh: 这里的人叫她尼斯湖水怪。

entries.en: She's so seldom seen that many don't even believe she truly exists.
entries.zh: 她太少露面了，很多人甚至不相信她真的存在。

entries.en: But I do. I can sense her down there sometimes, while I'm swimming.
entries.zh: 但我相信。有时游泳的时候，我能感觉到她就在下面。
怎么样，愿意试试吗？

entries.en: Bring me a Nessie Shard and I'll give you my Abiphone Contact.
entries.zh: 带一枚尼斯湖水怪碎片给我，我就把阿比手机联系方式给你。

entries.en: Looks like you don't have the Nessie Shard I asked for.
entries.zh: 看来你没带我要的尼斯湖水怪碎片。

entries.en: I've heard that she's quite a rare catch, so I guess you'll just have to keep trying.
entries.zh: 听说她特别难捕到，只能再多试试了。

entries.en: Wow! You really found her! What was she like?
entries.zh: 哇！你真找到她了！她是什么样的？

entries.en: Select an option: [It was an amazing experience.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [那是一次难忘的经历。]
一定是！

entries.en: I can't believe she actually exists... I was beginning to lose hope.
entries.zh: 真不敢相信，她居然真的存在……我都快不抱希望了。

entries.en: Looks like I need to get down to the Loch as soon as possible.
entries.zh: 看来我得尽快去湖里一趟。

entries.en: Anyways, as promised, here's my contact.
entries.zh: 总之，说好的，这是我的联系方式。

entries.en: Give me a call if you ever need to use the Fusion Machine!
entries.zh: 以后要用融合机器，给我打电话就行！
你获得了一个斯卡萨碎片！
有意思……

entries.en: Fusions can have very peculiar results, I'm sure you will spend a lot of time around here.
entries.zh: 融合的结果有时很奇妙。我敢说，你以后少不了往这儿跑。

entries.en: Anyhow, I don't think I have anything left to teach you.
entries.zh: 总之，我能教你的应该都教完了。

entries.en: You might want to talk to David Hunterborough next.
entries.zh: 接下来不妨去找大卫·亨特伯勒聊聊。
你好，旅人。

entries.en: I'm Loras, a historian dedicated to uncovering the secrets of the Precursors.
entries.zh: 我是洛拉斯，一名历史学者，致力于揭开先驱的秘密。

entries.en: Sadly, their history is shrouded in mystery, with scarce records surviving.
entries.zh: 可惜，他们的历史笼罩在迷雾之中，留下的记载少之又少。

entries.en: I've had to piece together their story through fieldwork and ancient relics.
entries.zh: 我只能靠实地考察和古代遗物，一点点拼凑他们的故事。

entries.en: My dream? To pen a comprehensive tome about them, but the pieces are still falling into place.
entries.zh: 我的梦想？为他们写一部完整的史书。不过，眼下仍有许多缺失的拼图。

entries.en: Interested in what I've uncovered so far?
entries.zh: 想听听我目前的发现吗？
请选择: [想听] [下次吧]

entries.en: Understandable. History has a way of capturing us when we least expect it.
entries.zh: 可以理解。历史总在不经意间，才让人产生兴趣。

entries.en: Feel free to return if curiosity strikes.
entries.zh: 哪天好奇了，随时回来找我。

entries.en: Ah, a fellow history enthusiast! Excellent.
entries.zh: 啊，遇到同好了！太好了。

entries.en: Through my research, I've deducted that the Precursors were this world's first inhabitants.
entries.zh: 根据我的研究，先驱应该是这个世界最早的居民。

entries.en: Remarkably, they lived under the watch of multiple entities called Starborns!
entries.zh: 更惊人的是，他们生活在多位星裔的注视之下！

entries.en: I've identified at least eight Starborns, but I suspect there were more.
entries.zh: 我确认的星裔至少有八位，不过我想应该还有更多。

entries.en: Each Starborn had a unique domain and wielded immense power.
entries.zh: 每位星裔都执掌着独特的领域，拥有无比强大的力量。

entries.en: Select an option: [What kind of domain?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [什么样的领域？]

entries.en: From the Starborn of the Forests or the Sea, even a Starborn of Life!
entries.zh: 比如森林、海洋，甚至还有掌管生命的星裔！

entries.en: It's unclear whether the Precursors were creations of these Starborns, but they certainly revered them.
entries.zh: 先驱是否由这些星裔创造，还不清楚。但他们确实敬奉着星裔。

entries.en: My studies led me to distinguish two categories: Old and New Starborns.
entries.zh: 研究过程中，我把星裔分成了两类: 古老星裔与新生星裔。
请选择: [这名字没什么新意啊。]

entries.en: Ah, but the names reflect a theory.
entries.zh: 啊，但这命名背后，其实有一套推论。

entries.en: The Old Starborns seemen indifferent to mortal affairs, transcending earthly desires.
entries.zh: 古老星裔似乎不问凡间之事，早已超脱尘世的欲望。

entries.en: Conversely, the New Starborns engaged actively with the Precursors, reveling in their advancements and guiding their progress.
entries.zh: 新生星裔则恰恰相反。他们积极与先驱往来，为先驱的成就而欣喜，也引导着他们向前。

entries.en: I believe that immortals who maintain worldly interests and desire could be considered 'young' in a divine sense.
entries.zh: 我认为，仍眷恋尘世、心怀欲望的不朽者，在神明的尺度上，也许还算“年轻”。

entries.en: Select an option: [It's an interesting theory]
entries.zh: 请选择: [这个推论挺有意思。]
谢谢你这么说。

entries.en: The New Starborns were particularly invested, almost as proud mentors observing their wards' milestones.
entries.zh: 新生星裔尤其上心，就像满怀骄傲的导师，看着自己的学生一次次迈过里程碑。

entries.en: They even intervened directly at times, teaching essential lessons like substainable living and the imporance of nature's balance.
entries.zh: 有时，他们甚至亲自干预，教导先驱如何长久生存，以及维系自然平衡的重要性。

entries.en: Select an option: [So the Starborns were spectating them]
entries.zh: 请选择: [所以星裔一直在旁观？]
没错，但也在引导。

entries.en: For instance, they introduced magic to the Precursors, a decision with unforeseen consequences.
entries.zh: 比如，他们将魔法传授给先驱——这个决定，带来了意想不到的后果。

entries.en: The Precursors ended up excelling in both magic and science, eventually blending the two to create wonders.
entries.zh: 先驱最终精通了魔法与科学，又将两者结合，创造出种种奇迹。

entries.en: Select an option: [I see where this is going]
entries.zh: 请选择: [我大概猜到后面的发展了。]
他们的野心，渐渐没了边界。

entries.en: They sought more: longer life, greater strength, boundless energy.
entries.zh: 他们还想要更多: 更长的寿命、更强的力量、无穷无尽的能量。

entries.en: Later generations of Precursors, born into a world of accomplishments, yearned for purpose and legacy.
entries.zh: 后世的先驱生来就坐拥累累硕果，却渴望找到自己的目标，留下自己的功业。

entries.en: For those young generations of Precursors, it became impossible to define their own purpose in the shadow of monumental achievements.
entries.zh: 可笼罩在先辈辉煌成就的阴影下，年轻一代根本无从找到属于自己的意义。

entries.en: Something had to happen, the wheel of progress had to keep turning.
entries.zh: 总得发生些什么，进步的车轮必须继续转动。

entries.en: So one day, a bold claim arose: the Precursors had surpassed the Starborns.
entries.zh: 于是有一天，一个大胆的宣言出现了: 先驱已经超越了星裔。

entries.en: They saw the Starborns' teachings as shackles, hindering their true potential.
entries.zh: 在他们眼中，星裔的教诲成了枷锁，束缚着他们真正的潜能。

entries.en: Select an option: [Those Precursors are very human after all]
entries.zh: 请选择: [这么看来，先驱也很像人类啊。]

entries.en: Indeed... But this hubris marked the beginning of the end.
entries.zh: 确实如此……但这份狂妄，也拉开了终结的序幕。

entries.en: The Precursors harnessed their tools and magic to overpower the Starborns.
entries.zh: 先驱动用工具与魔法，压倒了星裔。

entries.en: Adding to this, the Starborns' power was intrinsically tied to the belief of their followers.
entries.zh: 更何况，星裔的力量本就与追随者的信仰紧密相连。

entries.en: As the Precursors' faith diminished, so too did the might of the Starborns, weakening them in this crucial confrontation.
entries.zh: 先驱的信仰越淡薄，星裔的力量就越衰弱，使他们在这场关键的对抗中更加不利。

entries.en: Select an option: [Can Starborns even die?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [星裔也会死吗？]

entries.en: That remains a mystery. But it's clear that their influence faded.
entries.zh: 这依然是个谜。但可以确定，他们的影响力消退了。

entries.en: As for the Precursors, they vanished without a trace, a puzzling paradox.
entries.zh: 至于先驱，他们却也消失得无影无踪，实在令人费解。

entries.en: Select an option: [So how does the story end?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [那故事最后怎样了？]

entries.en: Here's my theory: aware of their impending doom, the Starborn of Time, perhaps the most powerful due to universal belief, made a desperate move.
entries.zh: 我的推测是: 时间星裔预见了将至的末日，于是孤注一掷。或许正因为众生都信仰时间，他才拥有最强大的力量。

entries.en: He propelled the Precursors far into the future, hoping that by then, others could stand against them.
entries.zh: 他把先驱推向了遥远的未来，希望到那时，有人能与他们抗衡。

entries.en: Select an option: [The future? When exactly?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [未来？具体是什么时候？]
这就不得而知了。

entries.en: But it suggests that the Precursors might reemerge one day, a thought both fascinating and daunting.
entries.zh: 但这意味着，先驱也许终有一天会再度现身。这个念头，既令人向往，也令人不安。

entries.en: Select an option: [So the Precursors will just appear out of nowhere one day?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [所以有一天，先驱会凭空冒出来？]

entries.en: It's a possibility we cannot ignore.
entries.zh: 我们不能排除这种可能。

entries.en: We must be prepared for whatever comes.
entries.zh: 无论未来如何，都得做好准备。

entries.en: Thank you for lending an ear to my life's work.
entries.zh: 谢谢你愿意听我讲这些毕生研究的成果。

entries.en: Now, I must return to my studies.
entries.zh: 现在，我该回去继续研究了。

entries.en: You know them Boosters you can get from the Moonglade Marsh?
entries.zh: 你知道那些增幅器吧？就是月光沼泽能弄到的那种。

entries.en: Well, those puny things ain't gonna cut it 'round these parts.
entries.zh: 在这儿，那点小玩意儿可不够看。

entries.en: Luckily for you, I offer Booster Upgrades, for a price.
entries.zh: 算你走运，我这里提供增幅器升级，当然，得付钱。

entries.en: I last saw the sea %1$s years, %2$s months ago.
entries.zh: 我上次见到大海，已经是%1$s 年 %2$s 个月前了。

entries.en: I wish I could remember what it felt like!
entries.zh: 真想再记起当时的感觉啊！

entries.en: Sadly, my memory is now my worst enemy.
entries.zh: 可惜啊，如今最跟我过不去的，就是这记性。

entries.en: Please, help me remember the sea!
entries.zh: 求你了，帮我找回关于大海的记忆吧！

entries.en: Now that you poured an infinite amount of water,
entries.zh: 你这一倒，水可真是源源不断啊，

entries.en: I can remember the smell of salt water and the beauty of the waves.
entries.zh: 我又记起了海水的咸腥气，还有那些美丽的浪花。

entries.en: If only I could recall the smell of a tasty supper with my old warband.
entries.zh: 要是还能想起跟老战友一起吃美味的晚餐时的香味，就好了。

entries.en: You pour water from the bucket, but it's apparently never enough to extinguish the fireplace.
entries.zh: 你把桶里的水倒了出来，可这点水似乎总也浇不灭壁炉里的火。
这水……还是不够啊。

entries.en: There's as much water here as an ocean.
entries.zh: 这里的水简直跟大海一样多。

entries.en: If only you could pour it somewhere!
entries.zh: 要是能找个地方把它倒出来就好了！

entries.en: I would like to smell a good feast!
entries.zh: 我真想闻闻丰盛大餐的香味！

entries.en: I prefer when the fishes are lively and go splish-splash in the water!
entries.zh: 我还是更喜欢活蹦乱跳、在水里扑腾的鱼！
*咬了一口*
味道确实……*嚼嚼* 挺不错……

entries.en: But the smell isn't quite right!
entries.zh: 可这香味还是不太对！
嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯……
真香啊！

entries.en: You know what I really remember from the sea?
entries.zh: 你知道我对大海最难忘的是什么吗？
鱼儿四处扑腾、溅起水花！

entries.en: YES! This totally reminds me of the sea!
entries.zh: 对，就是这样！这下真让我想起大海了！

entries.en: Although... there were more fishes back then.
entries.zh: 不过……当年的鱼可多得多啊。

entries.en: EXCELLENT! Just a few more fishes and splashes please!
entries.zh: 太棒了！再多来几条鱼，多溅点水花吧！

entries.en: WOW! This feels just like on my Drakkar!
entries.zh: 哇！这感觉，简直就像回到了我的龙首船上！
整个人一下子都舒坦了！

entries.en: Thanks for bringing joy to an old viking!
entries.zh: 谢谢你，让我这个老维京人又找回了快乐！

entries.en: Take a look at my wares!
entries.zh: 来看看我的货吧！

entries.en: Wow! Nice move! There just isn't the ambiance to fully appreciate it.
entries.zh: 哇！好身手！可惜这儿还差点气氛，没法好好感受啊。

entries.en: If only there wasn't this infernal fire noise!
entries.zh: 要是没这烦人的烧火声就好了！
哦！看着可真稀奇！

entries.en: It wasn't quite what I was looking for, but I'll take it thanks!
entries.zh: 虽然不是我想要的，不过我还是收下了，多谢！

entries.en: Don't you have some liquid water?
entries.zh: 你就没有没冻住的水吗？

entries.en: Awesome hat! Does it do anything special?
entries.zh: 这帽子真不错！它有什么特别的功能吗？

entries.en: Please don't tell my family that I cry sometimes!
entries.zh: 千万别告诉我家里人，我有时候也会掉眼泪啊！

entries.en: It's a nice thought, but I don't feel like fishing right now.
entries.zh: 你的好意我心领了，不过我现在没心思钓鱼。
*嗅了嗅*
这味道怪怪的。
一艘船！

entries.en: Throw them at people you hate!
entries.zh: 把它们朝你讨厌的人扔过去吧！

entries.en: If you could bring me 512 Acacia Logs, I could craft another Harp!
entries.zh: 如果你能带来 512 个金合欢原木，我就能再做一把竖琴了！

entries.en: I already have some string, so I can just use this wood to fashion the base of the harp.
entries.zh: 我已经有琴弦了，这些木头正好拿来做琴身。

entries.en: Now, if I'm doing this right, this goes here, and...
entries.zh: 如果没弄错的话，这个装在这里，然后……
你好！ ♫
想学竖琴吗？
我来教你吧！ ❤

entries.en: Pick a song to get started!
entries.zh: 选一首曲子开始吧！
每首曲子你都弹得完美无缺了！

entries.en: Maybe you should teach me now!
entries.zh: 说不定该轮到你教我了！

entries.en: Here's a gift so you always remember me! ♪
entries.zh: 送你一份礼物，可别忘了我呀！ ♪

entries.en: You mastered every song with over 90%!
entries.zh: 每首曲子你都弹到了 90% 以上，真是学有所成了！
很高兴认识你，%1$s!

entries.en: About time you made your way to Torrhus Canyon, Agatha has told me all about you!
entries.zh: 你总算来托鲁斯峡谷了，阿加莎跟我提过你好多次！

entries.en: So, now that you're here, are you ready to take on your next set of Starlyn Contests?
entries.zh: 既然来了，准备好迎接新一轮星林竞赛了吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [Let's do it!] [Maybe later]
entries.zh: 请选择: [开始吧！] [待会儿再说]

entries.en: Gonna have a look around the island first? No problem! Toodles!
entries.zh: 想先逛逛岛屿？没问题！回见啦！

entries.en: Just so you know, my Starlyn Contests are partnered with the Critter Safari.
entries.zh: 先告诉你一声，我的星林竞赛和小动物游猎场有合作。

entries.en: What that means is, whenever you reach the UNCOMMON bracket or higher in one of my contests, you'll get a free Safari Ticket alongside your usual rewards!
entries.zh: 也就是说，只要在我的竞赛里达到罕见档或更高档次，你就能免费获得一张游猎场门票，外加平时那些奖励！

entries.en: Show your ticket to the Safari Manager and he'll give you access to the Critter Safari for a limited time!
entries.zh: 把票交给游猎场经理，他就会让你进入小动物游猎场，限时畅玩！

entries.en: I go there quite often - it's a pretty cool place where you can hunt dozens of %1$s Critters to your heart’s content.
entries.zh: 我常去那儿——真是个好地方，能尽情狩猎几十种%1$s 小动物。

entries.en: The better your ticket, the more free stuff you'll get, so aim for the stars!
entries.zh: 门票越好，送的东西就越多。所以，朝着星星努力吧！

entries.en: So, with all that in mind, are you ready to take on my Starlyn Contests?
entries.zh: 这些都了解了，现在准备好参加我的星林竞赛了吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [I sure am!] [I'll come back later]
entries.zh: 请选择: [当然准备好了！] [我晚点再来]

entries.en: Come take a look at what my Starlyn Contests have to offer!
entries.zh: 来看看我的星林竞赛都准备了什么！

entries.en: Huh? You reached my hidden MYTHIC bracket already? You're sure good at this Foraging business!
entries.zh: 咦？你已经达到我隐藏的神话档了？伐木这方面，你还真有两下子！

entries.en: Whaaat? You reached my hidden DIVINE bracket? Great job - keep it going!
entries.zh: 什么——?你达到隐藏的神圣档了？太棒了，继续加油！

entries.en: You found my hidden SPECIAL bracket? Wow, my sister was right about you!
entries.zh: 你发现我隐藏的特殊档了？哇，我妹妹真没看错你！
见到你真高兴！

entries.en: Sure, I guess I can do that...
entries.zh: 行啊，应该可以……

entries.en: But only if you reach the LEGENDARY bracket in my contest first!
entries.zh: 不过你得先在我的竞赛里达到传说档！
你已经达到了？
行吧，说到做到。

entries.en: I'll give you a call whenever you finish a Miria's Contest so that you can claim your rewards.
entries.zh: 每当你完成米莉亚竞赛，我就打电话提醒你领取奖励。

entries.en: Ridiculous! How could I be a mole if I am wearing human clothes, huh?
entries.zh: 荒唐！我明明穿着人类的衣服，怎么可能是鼹鼠，嗯？

entries.en: Have you seen moles wearing human clothes before?
entries.zh: 你见过穿人类衣服的鼹鼠吗？

entries.en: I don't think so. Now get back to the issue!
entries.zh: 我看没有吧。现在说正事！

entries.en: If you can bring me 512 Jungle Logs, we can make some traps!
entries.zh: 你给我带来 512 个丛林原木，我们就能做陷阱了！

entries.en: Good job, partner. Now we only need to wait for the right moment for these pests to show up.
entries.zh: 干得好，搭档。现在只需要等这些害兽在合适的时机现身。

entries.en: This might take some time, so you should come back later.
entries.zh: 这可能得等一会儿，你晚些再来吧。

entries.en: Hey.. uhm partner! I swear it's not what you think!
entries.zh: 嘿……呃，搭档！我发誓不是你想的那样！

entries.en: Could you lend me a hand here, I can explain everything!
entries.zh: 能拉我一把吗？我全都能解释！
[帮助莫尔伯特]

entries.en: Thank you so much, I was stuck there for at least 3 minutes, I was almost gone for good.
entries.zh: 太感谢你了，我被困在这里至少有 3 分钟了，差点就交代在这儿了。

entries.en: I.. I must have slipped by accident and then fell right into the trap! ... Yes, that's what happened!
entries.zh: 我……我一定是不小心脚滑，才掉进这个陷阱的！ …… 对，就是这么回事！

entries.en: Select an option: [I know that you are a mole]
entries.zh: 请选择： [我知道你是鼹鼠]

entries.en: Ok, fine you caught me. But please don't tell the others, they wouldn't want to be my friends anymore if they knew the truth.
entries.zh: 好吧好吧，被你发现了。可千万别告诉别人，他们要是知道真相，就不愿再和我做朋友了。

entries.en: Here, take this as compensation for all the trouble I made you go through.
entries.zh: 喏，这些给你，就当补偿我给你添的麻烦。

entries.en: I hope you forgive me after this and we can still be friends.
entries.zh: 希望你能原谅我，我们还能做朋友。

entries.en: I wish I could be in love just like Romero & Juliette.
entries.zh: 我也想谈场恋爱，就像罗梅罗和朱丽叶。

entries.en: Have you explored... *inhales*... the depths of the lake yet?
entries.zh: 你去探索过……*吸气*……湖的深处吗？

entries.en: The deeper you venture... *exhales*... the greater the pressure becomes.
entries.zh: 潜得越深……*呼气*……水压就越大。

entries.en: It's essential... *inhales*... to equip yourself with ample... *exhales*... %1$s Respiration and %2$s Pressure Resistance.
entries.zh: 一定要……*吸气*……穿上能提供足够……*呼气*……%1$s 水下呼吸和%2$s 压力抵抗的装备。

entries.en: Without these... *inhales*... accessing the lower chambers will be *exhales*... impossible.
entries.zh: 没这两样……*吸气*……想进下层洞室……*呼气*……根本不可能。

entries.en: Ah, you're awake... *inhales*... I pulled you from the depths just in time.
entries.zh: 啊，你醒了……*吸气*……还好我及时把你从深水里捞了上来。

entries.en: The pressure down there is... *exhales*... unforgiving.
entries.zh: 底下那水压啊……*呼气*……可不会跟你客气。

entries.en: Visit my shop for %1$s Respiration ...*inhales*... and %2$s Pressure Resistance gear.
entries.zh: 来我店里买些带%1$s 水下呼吸……*吸气*……和%2$s 压力抵抗的装备吧。

entries.en: It’s essential for... *exhales*... surviving down there.
entries.zh: 想在底下活下来……*呼气*……可少不了这些。

entries.en: And we meet again!... *inhales*... Seems the loch embrace is too strong?
entries.zh: 又见面了！ ……*吸气*……看来这湖抱你抱得太紧了？

entries.en: Perhaps lighten the load with some proper gear next time... *exhales*... just a thought.
entries.zh: 下次穿身合适的装备，也许能轻松点……*呼气*……就这么一说。

entries.en: You're really testing the waters, aren't you... *inhales*... Literally.
entries.zh: 你这可真是在试水啊……*吸气*……我可没打比方。

entries.en: A bit more Respiration and... *exhales*... Pressure Resistance might stop the loch from swallowing you whole.
entries.zh: 再多点水下呼吸和……*呼气*……压力抵抗，也许这湖就不会把你一口吞了。
我就……*吸气*……这么一说。

entries.en: You again... *inhales*... I’m no hero, but I might need a cape at this rate.
entries.zh: 又是你……*吸气*……我又不是什么英雄，可照这么下去，怕是得备件披风了。

entries.en: Maybe equip yourself a bit better, and I can retire my rescue hat... *exhales*... just a suggestion.
entries.zh: 要不穿身好点的装备，我这顶救生帽也就能退休了……*呼气*……只是个建议。
大卫·亨特伯勒让你来的？
明白了。

entries.en: Quick, help me deal with this Chillshot!
entries.zh: 快，帮我对付这只寒射手！

entries.en: Weaken it, but do not kill it! Punch it towards my Black Hole!
entries.zh: 削弱它，但别杀死它！把它打向我的黑洞！

entries.en: Monsters here only take damage from axes!
entries.zh: 这里的怪物只会受到斧头造成的伤害！
拿你的狩猎斧来对付它们！

entries.en: You can only damage it using an Huntaxe!
entries.zh: 只有狩猎斧才能伤到它！

entries.en: Great work! You handled that Chillshot like a professional hunter!
entries.zh: 干得好！你对付寒射手的手法，简直像个老猎人！

entries.en: As you saw, the best way to deal with monsters here is to use a Black Hole.
entries.zh: 看到了吧，对付这里的怪物，最好的办法就是用黑洞。

entries.en: If you'd like one, you can purchase a Pocket Black Hole from Albert over in the village.
entries.zh: 想要的话，就去村里找阿尔伯特，就能买到口袋黑洞。

entries.en: As you can see, the best way to hunt Combat creatures is with a Pocket Black Hole.
entries.zh: 你也看到了，狩猎战斗生物最好的工具，就是口袋黑洞。

entries.en: If you want one, you should go talk to Albert, in the Village.
entries.zh: 想要一个的话，去村里找阿尔伯特聊聊吧。

entries.en: I'm still trying to hone my Hunting Skills.
entries.zh: 我还在努力磨炼自己的狩猎技巧。

entries.en: I've been observing you, just a bit, nothing creepy.
entries.zh: 我观察过你，就一小会儿，没有什么奇怪的意思。

entries.en: But nonetheless, I can't help but feel like you and I are different.
entries.zh: 可不知怎么，我总觉得你和我不一样。

entries.en: You move around so fast, doing all sorts of crazy things.
entries.zh: 你跑来跑去，做着各种不可思议的事。

entries.en: And I'm just... here. You know?
entries.zh: 而我就只是……待在这里。你懂吗？

entries.en: Sometimes I feel like I don't belong, like I'm just a background character.
entries.zh: 有时候，我觉得自己格格不入，像个背景人物。

entries.en: I don't even have any ambition. But strangely... I'm happy to exist.
entries.zh: 我甚至没什么志向。可奇怪的是……能存在着，我就很开心。

entries.en: I can't help but feel like I'm in some kind of simulation. Not a real world.
entries.zh: 我总觉得，自己活在某种模拟里，而不是真实的世界。

entries.en: Well... maybe a real world, but one created as a test. For some other beings.
entries.zh: 嗯……也许世界是真的，但只是某些存在为了做实验而创造的。

entries.en: Select an option: [Can't help you with that, sorry]
entries.zh: 请选择: [抱歉，这个我帮不了你。]

entries.en: Have you noticed how the world is made up with simple rules?
entries.zh: 你发现了吗？这个世界，其实是由很简单的规则组成的。

entries.en: Sometimes, I glimpse something. In the corner of my eye, like threads of code holding the world together.
entries.zh: 有时，我能从眼角瞥见一些东西，就像一条条代码，把世界缝在一起。

entries.en: It's like a simple language that creates everything, just a few sets of rules...
entries.zh: 仿佛一种简单的语言，只靠寥寥几套规则，就创造了一切……

entries.en: Select an option: [Sounds like a you problem.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [听起来是你自己的问题。]

entries.en: The way I see it your world is also quite simple.
entries.zh: 在我看来，你的世界也挺简单的。

entries.en: Quarks, Leptons, Gauge Bosons, just a few building blocks.
entries.zh: 夸克、轻子、规范玻色子，无非就这么几种积木。

entries.en: Only 4 four fundamental interactions, fields and spacetime.
entries.zh: 仅有四种基本相互作用，再加上场与时空。

entries.en: Select an option: [Hold up, how do you know that?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [等等，你怎么知道这些？]

entries.en: Think about it, doesn't it feel strangely well designed?
entries.zh: 想一想，难道不觉得这设计巧得有点奇怪吗？

entries.en: With just a few ingredients you get a hundred elements, millions of molecules...
entries.zh: 只用几种材料，就能组合出上百种元素、数百万种分子……

entries.en: And from that, oceans, storms, thought, emotion, life itself.
entries.zh: 再由此诞生海洋、风暴、思维、情感，乃至生命本身。

entries.en: Doesn't that seem... too elegant? Too well designed to be random?
entries.zh: 会不会……太精妙了？精妙得不像随机的结果？

entries.en: Are you really sure you are not in some kind of giant experiment, a game, yourself?
entries.zh: 你真的确定，自己没有身处一场巨大的实验，或是一场游戏之中？

entries.en: Select an option: [I've had enough, this isn't fun anymore]
entries.zh: 请选择: [够了，这已经不好玩了。]

entries.en: If I can see the matrix sometimes... maybe you can too.
entries.zh: 如果我偶尔能看见世界背后的框架……也许，你也能。
好好想想吧……
我是大卫的助手。
我喜欢大自然，也喜欢动物。

entries.en: But I'm not sure I'm very talented.
entries.zh: 可我好像没什么天分。

entries.en: I saved a bee from a pool once.
entries.zh: 有次，我从水池里救起一只蜜蜂。

entries.en: But the bee still stung me.
entries.zh: 结果，蜜蜂还是蜇了我。
然后就死了……

entries.en: Select an option: [That's not your fault.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [这不是你的错。]

entries.en: I tried getting pets too but that didn't work very well.
entries.zh: 我也试过养宠物，但也不怎么顺利。
我买了只鸟。
然后，它就飞走了。

entries.en: So the next time I tried with a chameleon.
entries.zh: 所以下一次，我换了只变色龙。

entries.en: I brought it back home but it camouflaged itself.
entries.zh: 带回家以后，它就把自己伪装起来了。

entries.en: And now I can't find it.
entries.zh: 到现在，我都找不到它。

entries.en: Anyways, in my free time I tell jokes.
entries.zh: 总之，我闲下来会讲笑话。

entries.en: I'll tell you all my jokes if you want.
entries.zh: 你愿意听的话，我把知道的都讲给你。

entries.en: Why did the elephant quit the circus?
entries.zh: 大象为什么不在马戏团干了？

entries.en: He was tired of working for peanuts.
entries.zh: 干那么多活，工资却只有“花生米大的一点儿”。

entries.en: What do you call a pig that does karate?
entries.zh: 一头会空手道的猪，最擅长什么？
当然是“猪排掌”！

entries.en: Why did the cow go to outer space?
entries.zh: 奶牛为什么要去外太空？
去看月亮——哞亮！
蚂蚁为什么不生病？
因为它们自带小小的“蚁体”。

entries.en: Why don't oysters give to charity?
entries.zh: 牡蛎为什么不做慈善？
因为它们太自私，连壳都舍不得出。

entries.en: What do you call a fish wearing a bowtie?
entries.zh: 一条打着领结的鱼，看起来怎么样？
有“鳞”有礼。

entries.en: What do you call a bear with no teeth?
entries.zh: 没牙的熊叫什么？
软糖小熊。

entries.en: Why did the elephant wear green sneakers?
entries.zh: 大象为什么穿绿色运动鞋？
为了藏在草丛里！

entries.en: Why do cows have hooves instead of feet?
entries.zh: 为什么奶牛长蹄子，不长脚趾？
因为它们的牛奶是“脱趾”的。

entries.en: Why did the dog sit in the shade?
entries.zh: 狗为什么坐在树荫底下？

entries.en: Because he didn't want to be a hot dog!
entries.zh: 因为它不想变成热狗！
✆ 又见面了。

entries.en: ✆ It can get quite lonely up here sometimes, so I do a bunch of stuff to pass the time.
entries.zh: ✆ 有时候，待在这上面还挺孤单的，所以我会找些事情打发时间。

entries.en: ✆ My favorite thing to do at the moment is to collect cool-looking rocks.
entries.zh: ✆ 最近我最喜欢的事，就是收集那些好看的石头。

entries.en: ✆ Say, do you think you could get me a Figstone?
entries.zh: ✆ 对了，你能帮我弄一块无花果石吗？

entries.en: ✆ I'll give you my Abiphone Contact if you do.
entries.zh: ✆ 你要是帮我找来，我就把我的阿比手机联系方式给你。

entries.en: ✆ You don't seem to have a Figstone.
entries.zh: ✆ 你好像没带无花果石。

entries.en: ✆ If you ever have a spare one, you know where to find me.
entries.zh: ✆ 等你有多余的了，就来找我吧。

entries.en: ✆ A fine addition to my collection!
entries.zh: ✆ 我的收藏又添了件好东西！
✆ 这是我的号码！

entries.en: ✆ If you call me I probably won't feel like speaking, but I'll let you use the Forest Essence Shop.
entries.zh: ✆ 你打给我的时候，我可能不太想说话，不过你还是能用森林精粹商店。

entries.en: ✆ Like I said before, I'm not too good with people.
entries.zh: ✆ 我之前也说过，我不太擅长跟人打交道。

entries.en: Welcome to the Critter Safari, amigo!
entries.zh: 欢迎来到小动物游猎场，朋友！

entries.en: First things first, you'll need a Safari Belt - it's the only item you can bring into the Critter Safari with you.
entries.zh: 首先，你得有条游猎场腰带——这是唯一能带进小动物游猎场的物品。

entries.en: Here, take this one. It's on me!
entries.zh: 给，拿着这条，算我送你的！

entries.en: Looks like you've got yourself a Safari Belt already, so we can get straight down to business!
entries.zh: 看来你已经有游猎场腰带了，那咱们直接谈正事！

entries.en: Give me any tier of Safari Ticket and I'll get you right on into the Critter Safari.
entries.zh: 随便给我一张游猎场门票，不论档次，我都能安排你进入小动物游猎场。

entries.en: Here, why don't you take a look at the experiences we currently have on offer?
entries.zh: 来，先看看我们现在有哪些游猎套餐吧？

entries.en: I already saw your ticket, so you're free to go.
entries.zh: 你的票我已经看过了，可以进去了。

entries.en: Your friends will need to show me their tickets, though.
entries.zh: 不过，你的朋友们也得各自出示门票。

entries.en: Looks good to me. Have fun out there!
entries.zh: 没问题，玩得开心！

entries.en: You already gave me your ticket, bud.
entries.zh: 朋友，你的票已经交给我了。

entries.en: You're free to explore the Critter Safari 'til your heart's content!
entries.zh: 尽情探索小动物游猎场吧！

entries.en: Dude, if you're not gonna pay, you're not gonna play.
entries.zh: 朋友，不买票，就不能玩。

entries.en: You're just standing around doing nothing - I'm sending you back to the Critter Safari Entrance.
entries.zh: 你一直站着不动，我先送你回小动物游猎场入口了。

entries.en: Come and see me again if you decide you actually want to play next time.
entries.zh: 下次真想玩了，再来找我吧。

entries.en: Looks like you used up your last Critter Capsule!
entries.zh: 看来你用完最后一枚小动物捕捉胶囊了！

entries.en: Would you like to leave the Critter Safari?
entries.zh: 要离开小动物游猎场吗？
请选择: [离开]

entries.en: If you have any questions, I am at your service!
entries.zh: 有什么问题，我随时为你解答！

entries.en: Otherwise, please speak to the Safari Manager to enter!
entries.zh: 如果没有，就请找游猎场经理办理入场！
➜ [小动物游猎场是什么？]

entries.en: ➜ [How do I enter the Critter Safari?]
entries.zh: ➜ [怎么进入小动物游猎场？]

entries.en: ➜ [What are the rules of the Critter Safari?]
entries.zh: ➜ [小动物游猎场有哪些规则？]
➜ [怎么获得游猎场门票？]

entries.en: It's split into four unique biomes, and each one is home to its own kinds of %1$s Critters.
entries.zh: 这里分成四片各具特色的生态区，每片都有独特的%1$s 小动物。

entries.en: Be sure to explore them all to see everything there is to hunt!
entries.zh: 记得都去逛逛，看看有哪些猎物可抓！

entries.en: Getting in is simple! Just hand a Safari Ticket to the Safari Manager.
entries.zh: 入场很简单！把游猎场门票交给游猎场经理就行。

entries.en: He's right over there, and he'll sort out the rest for you.
entries.zh: 他就在那边，剩下的事他会替你安排好。

entries.en: Before you head in, there are three rules you ought to know.
entries.zh: 进去之前，有三条规则需要了解。

entries.en: Rule One: You can't bring any items, armor, or potions inside with you.
entries.zh: 第一条: 不能携带任何物品、护甲或药水入场。

entries.en: The only exception is your Safari Belt - that, you're welcome to bring along.
entries.zh: 唯一的例外是游猎场腰带，这个可以带着。

entries.en: If you don't have one yet, go and grab one from Andrea upstairs.
entries.zh: 还没有的话，到楼上找安德莉亚领一条。

entries.en: Rule Two: You can only hunt using the Critter Capsules we provide when you enter.
entries.zh: 第二条: 只能用入场时发放的小动物捕捉胶囊进行狩猎。

entries.en: Some %1$s Critters are trickier to catch than others, but you'll get the hang of it!
entries.zh: 有些%1$s 小动物更难抓，但你会慢慢摸到门道的！

entries.en: Safari Tickets are your reward for taking part in Miria's Contests.
entries.zh: 游猎场门票是参与米莉亚竞赛获得的奖励。

entries.en: Reach the UNCOMMON bracket and you'll earn yourself a Basic Safari Ticket.
entries.zh: 达到罕见档，就能获得一张基础游猎场门票。

entries.en: Place higher and the tickets only get better - all the way up to a First-Class Safari Ticket in the LEGENDARY bracket.
entries.zh: 名次越高，门票越好——达到传说档，就能拿到头等游猎场门票。

entries.en: And the fancier the ticket, the better the perks it comes with!
entries.zh: 门票越高级，附带的福利就越好！

entries.en: You can hear all about her Contests from Miria herself - she lives just down the Spring Path.
entries.zh: 想了解竞赛，直接找米莉亚本人聊聊吧。她就住在泉水小径那边。

entries.en: I came all the way to Torrhus Canyon just to experience the Critter Safari!
entries.zh: 我大老远赶来托鲁斯峡谷，就是为了体验小动物游猎场！

entries.en: However, I can't seem to place high enough in Miria's Contests to win any Safari Tickets...
entries.zh: 可是我在米莉亚竞赛里总拿不到好名次，一张游猎场门票都没赢到……
哔哔，啵啵。
这是生物铁砧。哔。

entries.en: If you still have attributes on items, you can use it to transfer them into your Hunting Box. Boop.
entries.zh: 如果物品上还留着旧属性，可以用它把属性转进你的狩猎箱。啵。
你好啊，我亲爱的朋友！

entries.en: It looks like you've found me!
entries.zh: 看来你找到我了！

entries.en: I'm Sanger - an elusive man who sells Shards gathered from %1$s Elusive mobs...
entries.zh: 我是桑格，一个行踪难觅的人，专卖%1$s 隐匿生物的碎片……

entries.en: Select an option: [What are Elusive Shards?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [什么是隐匿碎片？]
问得好。

entries.en: To put it simply, if you find a mob with the %1$s Elusive type...
entries.zh: 简单来说，如果你找到带有%1$s 隐匿类型的生物……

entries.en: And you go ahead and kill that mob...
entries.zh: 然后把它击杀……

entries.en: It will ALWAYS drop its Shard!
entries.zh: 它就一定会掉落对应的碎片！

entries.en: No ifs, no buts! No getting unlucky - a Shard is GUARANTEED!
entries.zh: 没有如果，没有但是！不用担心运气差——碎片是必掉的！

entries.en: Simple as that! Do you understand, my dear fellow?
entries.zh: 就这么简单！明白了吗，朋友？

entries.en: Select an option: [Yep!] [Can you give me an example?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [明白！] [能举个例子吗？]
当然可以！

entries.en: Special Zealots have the %1$s Elusive type...
entries.zh: 特殊狂热者就带有%1$s 隐匿类型……

entries.en: That means, whenever you kill a Special Zealot, it will always drop a Special Zealot Shard.
entries.zh: 也就是说，每当你击杀一只特殊狂热者，它就一定会掉落一枚特殊狂热者碎片。
明白了吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [Yep!] [Can you give me another example]
entries.zh: 请选择: [明白！] [能再举个例子吗？]

entries.en: That means, whenever you kill a Titanoboa, it will always drop a Titanoboa Shard.
entries.zh: 也就是说，每当你击杀一只泰坦巨蟒，它就一定会掉落一枚泰坦巨蟒碎片。

entries.en: Select an option: [Yep!] [Can you give me one last example?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [明白！] [能最后再举一个例子吗？]
行吧，也不是不可以……

entries.en: That means, whenever you kill a Field Mouse, it will always drop a Field Mouse Shard.
entries.zh: 也就是说，每当你击杀一只田鼠，它就一定会掉落一枚田鼠碎片。

entries.en: I hope you're beginning to understand now...
entries.zh: 希望你现在开始明白了……
请选择: [明白！]

entries.en: Even the best Hunters around struggle to find %1$s Elusive mobs...
entries.zh: 就连最出色的猎人，也很难找到%1$s 隐匿生物……

entries.en: However, thankfully for you, I am a particularly celebrated Hunter who has traveled the land far and wide.
entries.zh: 不过你运气不错，我可是一位远近闻名的猎人，走遍了各地。

entries.en: I have collected many Shards in my time, gathered from the %1$s Elusive mobs that frequented my homeland.
entries.zh: 这些年，我收集了不少碎片，都来自故乡常见的%1$s 隐匿生物。

entries.en: Why don't you peruse my collection - perhaps we can strike a deal?
entries.zh: 不如看看我的收藏？也许咱们能做笔交易。
随时欢迎你来！

entries.en: Though, you might have to find me again.
entries.zh: 不过，可能得重新找一找我。

entries.en: Oh, how brilliant! You appear to have found me once again!
entries.zh: 噢，真了不起！你似乎又找到我了！

entries.en: There truly is no tricking you, is there?
entries.zh: 还真是什么都瞒不过你，是吧？

entries.en: Sanger seemed to vanish before your very eyes!
entries.zh: 桑格仿佛就在你的眼前凭空消失了！

entries.en: I've got a Foraging Fortune Booster if you're interested!
entries.zh: 感兴趣的话，我这里有一个伐木时运增幅器！
你见过增幅器吗？

entries.en: They're special enhancements that can be applied to your Foraging Gear.
entries.zh: 它们是一种特殊强化，可以用在伐木装备上。

entries.en: You can attach them to any item unlocked by the Foraging Skill right at an anvil.
entries.zh: 凡是通过伐木技能解锁的物品，都能直接在铁砧上装上它们。

entries.en: No need to choose just one - you can stack multiple boosters on the same item!
entries.zh: 不用只挑一种，同一件物品上可以叠加多种增幅器！

entries.en: I've got a Common Foraging Fortune Booster if you're interested!
entries.zh: 感兴趣的话，我这里有一个普通伐木时运增幅器！

entries.en: Brian told me I would have an important role in his cult.
entries.zh: 布莱恩说，我会在他的教团里担任重要的角色。

entries.en: I'm not sure what the point of this cult is, but it's the closest thing I've found to a purpose in life.
entries.zh: 我不太明白这教团有什么意义，但这是我离人生目标最近的一次了。

entries.en: I need a sense of belonging.
entries.zh: 我需要一点归属感。
这教团可真火。
懂我意思吧？

entries.en: Sometimes at night we tell spooky stores.
entries.zh: 有时候，我们会在晚上讲鬼故事。
这就挺好了，对吧？

entries.en: A berry just appeared, simply punch the bush to collect it!
entries.zh: 刚长出一颗浆果，只要敲一下灌木就能采下来！

entries.en: Have you ever heard about %1$s Sweep?
entries.zh: 你听说过%1$s 横扫吗？

entries.en: For example, 10%1$s Sweep should allow you to cut 10 logs.
entries.zh: 比如,10%1$s 横扫应该能一次砍下 10 根原木。

entries.en: If a Tree has a high Toughness, you will need more than 10%1$s Sweep to cut 10 logs!
entries.zh: 如果一棵树的韧性很高，那就得超过 10%1$s 横扫，才能砍下 10 根原木！

entries.en: So I suggest you use an axe with at least +7%1$s Sweep.
entries.zh: 所以我建议，至少用一把有 +7%1$s 横扫的斧头。
明白了，是个纯新手。

entries.en: Well, %1$s Sweep allows you to cut multiple logs at once.
entries.zh: 嗯，%1$s 横扫能让你一次砍下多根原木。

entries.en: For example, 10%1$s Sweep should allow you to cut 10 logs, you understand?
entries.zh: 比如,10%1$s 横扫应该能砍下 10 根原木，懂了吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [So far so good]
entries.zh: 请选择: [目前都明白。]

entries.en: You should cut the trunks of the Fig Trees first!
entries.zh: 记得先砍无花果树的树干！

entries.en: Otherwise you will be much less efficient.
entries.zh: 不然会费劲得多。

entries.en: Don't forget you can RIGHT-CLICK Foraging axes to throw them into the air!
entries.zh: 别忘了，右键点击伐木斧，就能把它扔出去！

entries.en: Here, go and cut a Fig Tree.
entries.zh: 去吧，砍一棵无花果树。

entries.en: Cutting down enough Fig or Mangrove Trees will level up your milestones and grant extra %1$s Sweep.
entries.zh: 砍够一定数量的无花果树或红树，就能提升里程碑等级，获得额外的%1$s 横扫。

entries.en: The view from here is just so bad.
entries.zh: 这儿的风景真差。

entries.en: I mean look at it! Look!
entries.zh: 你看看！你看看嘛！

entries.en: It’s hard to even describe how awful this view is.
entries.zh: 差得我都不知道该怎么形容。

entries.en: I come here everyday just to see how terrible this view is.
entries.zh: 我每天都来，就为看看这景色究竟能有多糟。

entries.en: Every time I look, it somehow gets worse!
entries.zh: 每看一次，居然还能更糟一点！

entries.en: I traveled all the way... just to be disappointed again.
entries.zh: 我大老远跑来……就为了再失望一次。

entries.en: This island somehow managed to have an even worse view.
entries.zh: 这座岛居然还能把风景弄得更难看。

entries.en: Every rock, every tree, perfectly misplaced. It's a masterpiece of disaster.
entries.zh: 每块石头、每棵树，都恰到好处地摆错了地方。简直是灾难级的杰作。
平庸得纯粹，平庸得令人窒息。

entries.en: I could stare at this abomination for hours. Can't wait to come back tomorrow.
entries.zh: 这么难看的景色，我能盯着看上几个小时。已经等不及明天再来了。

entries.en: I am Teddy, the legendary hunter. Yes, yes, I know what you're thinking... no need to bow.
entries.zh: 我就是泰迪，传奇猎人。对，对，我知道你在想什么……不用行礼。

entries.en: I've walked this earth for 152 years, seen every creature, caught every beast... except... anyways.
entries.zh: 我在这世上活了 152 年，什么生灵没见过，什么野兽没抓过……除了……算了，不说了。

entries.en: I can teach you how to catch anything that walks, swims, or slithers on this island...
entries.zh: 这岛上走的、游的、爬的，我都能教你怎么抓……
请选择: [哇，谢谢！]
抓青蛙都费劲？真的假的？

entries.en: Back in my day, hunters would catch 'em blindfolded.
entries.zh: 想当年，猎人们蒙着眼睛都能抓。

entries.en: Hunters these days... no patience. Go to the lake and look for Mossybits.
entries.zh: 现在的猎人啊……一点耐心都没有。去湖边找 Mossybits 吧。

entries.en: Just poke at 'em, and they'll jump like they've seen a ghost. Eventually, they'll tire out.
entries.zh: 戳它们一下，它们就跟见了鬼似的乱跳。跳着跳着，总会累的。
小菜一碟。

entries.en: Mudworms? You've gotta watch the ground closely... and I mean closely.
entries.zh: 泥虫？你得盯紧地面……可得盯仔细了。

entries.en: Ever seen a faint glow in the dirt? Could be treasure... or a Mudworm.
entries.zh: 见过泥土里那点微光吗？可能是宝藏……也可能是条泥虫。
不管是什么，挖就是了！

entries.en: Ah, the Axolotl, tricky little devils. But here's a secret...
entries.zh: 啊，美西螈，狡猾的小家伙。不过，我有个秘诀……

entries.en: Their eyesight is rubbish, they only detect movements. So if you stand still long enough near them, you're golden.
entries.zh: 它们眼神差得很，只能察觉动静。你在它们身边站着不动，多等一会儿，就稳了。

entries.en: Shulkers are sneaky. They're like shadows that play tricks on you.
entries.zh: 潜影贝鬼鬼祟祟的，跟会捉弄人的影子似的。

entries.en: There are Hideonleafs on the island.
entries.zh: 岛上有 Hideonleafs。

entries.en: Step on them by mistake, and, well, they can get quite angry.
entries.zh: 要是不小心踩着它们，嗯……它们可是会发火的。

entries.en: When they attack, smack their projectiles right back at 'em. That'll teach 'em.
entries.zh: 它们一攻击，你就把弹射物打回去。让它们长长记性。

entries.en: Lumisquids hide in awkward places… but that's half the fun, right?
entries.zh: Lumisquids 躲的地方可刁钻了……不过，这也是一大乐趣嘛，对吧？

entries.en: Use your net on them until they shrink down.
entries.zh: 一直用渔网网它们，直到它们缩小为止。

entries.en: They'll poof away like magic, but they never go too far.
entries.zh: 它们会像变魔术一样，噗地消失。不过，跑不远的。

entries.en: Dolphins... smart and slippery. They'll flee to their dolphin holes if you're not quick enough.
entries.zh: 海豚啊……聪明又滑溜。你动作不够快，它们就会逃回海豚洞里。

entries.en: Get that net ready, and don't stop until you catch up to them. But hurry, they won't wait around for a chat.
entries.zh: 备好渔网，一路追上去，追到为止。可得快点，它们可不会等着跟你闲聊。

entries.en: Cod? Oh, please. The most boring of fish, hands down.
entries.zh: 鳕鱼？得了吧。要说最无聊的鱼，非它莫属。

entries.en: Spin 'em with a fishing net; they'll twirl like a clumsy dancer.
entries.zh: 用渔网让它们转起来，转得跟个笨手笨脚的舞者似的。

entries.en: Spin 'em too much, though, and... well, you'll see.
entries.zh: 不过，转得太多的话……嗯，你自己就知道了。

entries.en: Pandas? Oh, now we're talking real game!
entries.zh: 熊猫？哦，这才是真正的猎物！

entries.en: They're tough to find, but this old hunter knows a trick or two.
entries.zh: 它们是不好找，不过我这老猎人还是有两手的。

entries.en: Feed 'em bamboo, and they might just love you for a second.
entries.zh: 喂它们点 bamboo，说不定它们还能喜欢你那么一小会儿。
可要找到它们嘛？

entries.en: That's a secret only a 165-year-old like me can tell you. I won't though.
entries.zh: 这种秘密，也就我这样 165 岁的老猎人能告诉你。不过，我偏不说。

entries.en: Salmon? Fast as lightning, those slippery devils.
entries.zh: 鲑鱼？滑溜的小家伙，快得跟闪电似的。

entries.en: Hit 'em with the net to slow them down. Just don't blink, or you'll be left with water in your boots.
entries.zh: 用渔网打它们，让它们慢下来。可别眨眼，不然鱼跑了，靴子里倒全是水。

entries.en: Ah, the Invisibug, nearly impossible to see... but not to me, of course.
entries.zh: 啊，隐形虫，几乎看不见……当然，我可看得见。

entries.en: Look for the glow, throw a lasso, and hope your aim's as sharp as mine.
entries.zh: 找准那点亮光，扔出套索，但愿你的准头能跟我一样好。
智壳龟，那群老家伙。

entries.en: Well, ancient compared to you, not me, I'm only 178, after all.
entries.zh: 当然，是跟你比才算老。跟我可比不了，我毕竟才 178 岁嘛。

entries.en: No real tricks here. Just chuck your net until they give up.
entries.zh: 这可没什么诀窍。一直往它们身上扔渔网，扔到它们放弃为止。

entries.en: It's not pretty, but it works.
entries.zh: 不好看归不好看，管用就行。

entries.en: Pufferfish... Have you tried looking in the Kelpwoven Tunnels?
entries.zh: 河豚啊……你去海带交织隧道找过吗？

entries.en: I've seen a few, Spikes they are called.
entries.zh: 我见过几只，它们叫尖刺。

entries.en: You'll need a special Fishing Net with a long range and stand at a distance from them.
entries.zh: 你得备一张能捕捉远处目标的特殊渔网，还得跟它们保持距离。
咕噜敲打咕噜灯笼咕噜
咕噜咕噜
气泡咕噜
咕噜

entries.en: The Tree behind me is pretty mega, huh?
entries.zh: 我身后的树，够壮观吧？

entries.en: I bet you wanna cut it so bad, right? Get all that loot and everything.
entries.zh: 我猜你特别想砍它，对吧？把里面的好东西全拿走。

entries.en: Well, too bad! I’ve just had a Tree Protection Order placed upon it!
entries.zh: 可惜啦！我刚给它申请了树木保护令！

entries.en: So none of you people, with all of your fancy axes, can try to fell it!
entries.zh: 所以，你们拿着再花哨的斧头，也休想把它砍倒！

entries.en: Why don’t you go and try, huh? See how that works for you.
entries.zh: 不信就试试啊？看看你能砍出什么来。
好好享受罚款吧！

entries.en: How do you do! Are you from Galatea?
entries.zh: 你好啊！你是加拉蒂亚本地人吗？
真是个好地——
你刚才是不是说“Gala-tee”？
不对不对！应该读 Gala-té-à!

entries.en: A lot of folks get it wrong, but now you know better!
entries.zh: 很多人都念错，不过现在你可不会了！

entries.en: I manage the Year of the Witch Shop, where you can exchange ingredients from the event for rewards.
entries.zh: 我经营着女巫年商店，你可以用活动中获得的材料兑换奖励。

entries.en: Talk to Alcina nearby if you'd like to learn how to gather ingredients, as well as what they're used for!
entries.zh: 去问问附近的阿尔西娜，就能了解如何收集材料，以及它们有何用途！

entries.en: Or, come and talk to me again to view the Year of the Witch Shop!
entries.zh: 或者，再和我交谈一次就能查看女巫年商店！

entries.en: During this year, we make an assortment of mystical stews for the townsfolk to enjoy.
entries.zh: 这一年里，我们会制作各式神秘炖汤，供镇民享用。

entries.en: However, we need your help with gathering the various ingredients needed for each stew.
entries.zh: 不过，我们需要你帮忙收集每种炖汤所需的各种原料。

entries.en: To get ingredients, you need to kill certain types of mobs found throughout SkyBlock.
entries.zh: 要获取原料，你需要击杀特定类型的生物，它们分布在空岛各处。

entries.en: Each type of mob will drop its own ingredient. For example,  Undead mobs will sometimes drop a Festering Fly!
entries.zh: 每种生物都会掉落各自的原料。例如， 亡灵生物有时会掉落溃烂苍蝇！

entries.en: Bring ingredients to me and you can make special stews, which you can consume to gain permanent stat buffs and other rewards.
entries.zh: 把原料交给我就能制作特殊炖汤，食用后可获得永久属性增益及其他奖励。

entries.en: Here, take a look at what's brewing in this year's Witches Stew!
entries.zh: 来看看今年的女巫炖汤里正在煮些什么吧！

entries.en: One Mayfly Stew coming right up!
entries.zh: 一份蜉蝣炖汤，马上就好！
你的蜉蝣炖汤炖好啦！
欢迎来到阿比手机 & Co., %1$s!

entries.en: Are you here to buy an Abiphone?
entries.zh: 你是来买阿比手机的吗？

entries.en: Have ya ever needed to talk to or buy something from an NPC, but they're on a different island?
entries.zh: 你有没有遇到过这种情况:想找某个 NPC 聊天或买东西，可对方却在另一座岛上？

entries.en: And getting to them would take ages, even if you had a Travel Scroll?
entries.zh: 就算有传送卷轴，赶过去也得花上半天？

entries.en: That's where the Abiphone comes in!
entries.zh: 这时候就该阿比手机登场了！

entries.en: Simply add an NPC as a Contact and you can call them anytime, anywhere!
entries.zh: 只要把 NPC 加为联系人，无论何时何地都能打给他们！
听起来很棒，对吧？

entries.en: Then why don't ya buy one? I'll do a little discount, just for you.
entries.zh: 那还不买一部？我可以专门给你打个小折扣。

entries.en: Congratulations on becoming a proud owner of an Abiphone!
entries.zh: 恭喜你光荣成为阿比手机机主！

entries.en: Before you go, let me show you how to add a contact.
entries.zh: 先别急着走，我来教你怎么添加联系人。

entries.en: Simply hold the Abiphone in your hand, and click on an NPC!
entries.zh: 只要手持阿比手机点击一名 NPC 就行！

entries.en: Why don't you try it out on me now?
entries.zh: 现在就拿我试试怎么样？
✆ 做得好！

entries.en: ✆ It's really as simple as that. I'll add myself to your Contacts now!
entries.zh: ✆ 就是这么简单。现在我会把自己加入你的联系人！

entries.en: ✆ One last thing - not every NPC owns an Abiphone, so you can't add everyone as a Contact.
entries.zh: ✆ 最后提醒一句:不是每个 NPC 都有阿比手机，所以并非所有人都能加为联系人。

entries.en: ✆ To see who you can add, simply open up your phone and check the Contacts Directory.
entries.zh: ✆ 想知道能添加谁，打开手机查看联系人目录就行。
✆ 就这些。好好享用你的新手机吧！
请选择: [阿比手机是什么？]
请选择: [算是吧。]

entries.en: I'm here to help you with Bingo!
entries.zh: 我来助你完成宾果挑战！

entries.en: Come to me if you want some Potion Effects to help you in your journey!
entries.zh: 冒险时想要药水效果助你一臂之力，就来找我！

entries.en: I can give you better effects depending on your Bingo Level.
entries.zh: 你的宾果等级越高，我能提供的药水效果就越好。
哗啦……
哗！
祝你好运！!

entries.en: I gave you potions recently! Give me some time to prepare new ones!
entries.zh: 刚刚才给过你药水呢！等我准备好新的一批再来吧！

entries.en: You want to have my number?
entries.zh: 想要我的电话号码吗？

entries.en: I'd love to give you my number!
entries.zh: 当然可以给你啦！

entries.en: However, Bingo requests that you have completed at least 4 Bingo Goals before I can give you my number.
entries.zh: 不过，宾果要求你先完成至少 4 个宾果目标我才能把号码给你。

entries.en: That's a bunch of Bingo Goals you've completed!
entries.zh: 你已经完成不少宾果目标了嘛！

entries.en: I'll gladly give you my number!
entries.zh: 很乐意把我的号码给你！

entries.en: Hi! Did your potions run out?
entries.zh: 嗨！药水效果用完了吗？

entries.en: I'm not sure how well this works over the phone...
entries.zh: 不知道隔着电话行不行得通……

entries.en: Hold your phone close to your ear, I'll throw the potions into my phone.
entries.zh: 把手机贴近耳朵，我来把药水扔进我这边的手机里。

entries.en: Potions travel much faster by phone!
entries.zh: 药水走电话可快多了！
祝你宾果挑战顺利！

entries.en: You seem like quite the social butterfly!
entries.zh: 看起来你很擅长社交嘛！

entries.en: Why not buy some social items for your island?
entries.zh: 要不要为你的岛屿买些社交物品？

entries.en: For a price, you can buy it here!
entries.zh: 只要付钱，就能在这里买到！

entries.en: I'm still learning carpentry. I learn the most when crafting enchanted items!
entries.zh: 我还在学木工。制作附魔物品时，学到的东西最多！

entries.en: Talk to the Carpenter upstairs to learn more about Carpentry!
entries.zh: 找楼上的木匠聊聊，多学点木工知识吧！

entries.en: Looking for wool? Try the Mushroom Desert!
entries.zh: 想找羊毛？去蘑菇沙漠看看吧！

entries.en: Fuel makes your Minion work harder for a limited time.
entries.zh: 燃料能让你的小人在一段时间内更卖力地工作。

entries.en: There are multiple types of Fuel, like Coal, Enchanted Bread, and many more!
entries.zh: 燃料有很多种，比如煤炭、附魔面包等等！

entries.en: Minions always have 4 Upgrade Slots where you can place Fuel or other items.
entries.zh: 小人始终有 4 个升级槽，可以放入燃料或其他物品。
抱歉，那是我的！

entries.en: If you place your Minions poorly, they will complain!
entries.zh: 如果小人的摆放位置不合适，它们会抱怨的！

entries.en: Open their Menu and look for their Perfect Layout!
entries.zh: 打开它们的菜单，查看最佳布局！

entries.en: My favorite Minion Upgrade is the Compactor, soooo useful!
entries.zh: 我最喜欢的小人升级是压缩器，实在太太太好用了！

entries.en: I have one in my Minion, look!
entries.zh: 我的小人里就装了一个，快看！

entries.en: Once you unlock a Minion, you also unlock all their Level up recipes!
entries.zh: 解锁一种小人后，它的所有升级配方也会一并解锁！

entries.en: Use a Budget Hopper to make your Minions automatically sell their items once full!
entries.zh: 装个廉价漏斗，小人的库存满了就会自动卖出物品！

entries.en: People always empty the storage of my Minion when I'm not looking!
entries.zh: 总有人趁我不注意，把我的小人库存搬个精光！

entries.en: Ah! You look like someone strong.
entries.zh: 啊！看起来你身手不凡。

entries.en: These are trying times, indeed. The Graveyard up ahead is overflowing with monsters! Anyone who comes in is spooked off by the grunts of Zombies in the distance.
entries.zh: 真是艰难的时期。前方的墓地怪物泛滥！每个走进酒馆的人都会被远处僵尸的低吼吓跑。

entries.en: Could you give me a hand? If you help clear out some of these monsters, I'll pay you for it!
entries.zh: 能帮我个忙吗？如果你能清理一些怪物，我会付你报酬！

entries.en: Here, take this sword. It should help you take out the Zombies.
entries.zh: 来，拿上这把剑。它应该能帮你消灭僵尸。

entries.en: Words cannot describe how thankful I am, %1$s!
entries.zh: 我都不知道该怎么表达我的感激之情了，%1$s!

entries.en: If you're up for the challenge, both the Graveyard and the Spider's Den beyond it are great training grounds for improving your Combat Skill.
entries.zh: 如果你想挑战自己，墓地和更远处的蜘蛛巢穴都是提升战斗技能的绝佳训练场。

entries.en: For now, here's a reward for helping me out!
entries.zh: 先收下这份谢礼吧！

entries.en: I recommend you gear up in the Combat Settlement. You should talk to Rosetta, she has some great armor for sale!
entries.zh: 我建议你去战斗聚落整备装备。你应该找罗塞塔聊聊，她那里有很不错的护甲出售！

entries.en: Be careful in the Graveyard during the night time, the Zombies are stronger and even more of them like to show up!
entries.zh: 晚上去墓地可得小心，那时僵尸更强，冒出来的也更多！

entries.en: Sorry mate, not much space in the old handheld.
entries.zh: 抱歉啊，我这老手机没多少地方了。

entries.en: People always adding me left and right these days, asking if the ol' tav is open or not.
entries.zh: 这些天总有人加我，问老酒馆开没开门。

entries.en: I tell 'em every time that it's open every day, but when they put down the phone I know they'll call 'n ask again tomorrow.
entries.zh: 我每回都说，天天都开。可他们电话一挂，我就知道明天准又要打来问。

entries.en: Since I'm so limited on space, I've got to be quite particular on who I add.
entries.zh: 地方实在有限，加谁可得好好挑一挑。

entries.en: You go and reach Spider Slayer 9, and I'll add you. How's that sound?
entries.zh: 你先把蜘蛛猎手升到 9 级，我就加你。怎么样？

entries.en: You want me to add ya to my handheld, huh?
entries.zh: 想让我把你加进手机里，是吧？

entries.en: Looks like you've reached Spider Slayer 9, so you're as good a choice as any I suppose.
entries.zh: 看样子你已经达到蜘蛛猎手 9 级了，加你倒也挺合适。

entries.en: Just don't call me asking when the tavern is open, okay?
entries.zh: 可别打来问酒馆什么时候开门啊，好吗？
我们一直都开着……

entries.en: Hello! Do you have a pet?
entries.zh: 你好！你有宠物吗？

entries.en: Pets are little companions for your adventures in SkyBlock!
entries.zh: 宠物是陪你在空岛中冒险的小伙伴！

entries.en: Personally, I prefer the bee pet!
entries.zh: 我个人更喜欢蜜蜂宠物！

entries.en: Not everything in this world is immediately obvious.
entries.zh: 这个世界并非所有事情都一目了然。

entries.en: I've dedicated my life to collecting all the information I can about this place.
entries.zh: 我毕生都在尽力收集有关这里的一切信息。

entries.en: Keep your eye out for anyone with ⚑ GUIDE above their head. They tend to have useful information!
entries.zh: 留意头顶带有⚑ 指南标记的人。他们通常掌握着有用的信息！

entries.en: You have 7 days to complete as many tasks as you can on a fresh, temporary profile!
entries.zh: 你有 7 天时间在一个全新的临时存档中尽可能完成更多任务！

entries.en: Complete personal tasks and work towards Community Goals to earn Bingo Points.
entries.zh: 完成个人任务并推进社区目标，即可获得宾果点数。

entries.en: At the end of the event, your Bingo profile will be deleted.
entries.zh: 活动结束时，你的宾果存档将被删除。

entries.en: But don't fret, all of the Bingo Points you earn during the event will stick around!
entries.zh: 不过别担心，你在活动期间获得的所有宾果点数都会保留下来！

entries.en: You can spend these points in the Bingo Shop on any profile!
entries.zh: 你可以在宾果商店使用这些点数，而且任何存档都可以！

entries.en: Good luck this week. And remember...haaaaave fun with it!
entries.zh: 祝你这周好运。记住……玩得开——心——点！

entries.en: It's time to play SkyBlock Bingo!
entries.zh: 该来玩空岛宾果啦！

entries.en: If you join, you have 7 days to complete as many tasks as you can on a fresh, temporary profile!
entries.zh: 加入后，你有 7 天时间，在一个全新的临时档案上尽可能多地完成任务！

entries.en: I will stick around for a bit longer, but then I'll be gone until next event at the start of the month!
entries.zh: 我还会再留一阵子，之后就要等下个月初的活动再见了！

entries.en: Check out the Bingo Shop to spend Bingo Points while supplies last!
entries.zh: 快去宾果商店花掉你的宾果点数吧，售完为止！

entries.en: Check back soon to join the %1$s %2$s Bingo Event!
entries.zh: 过些时候再来参加%2$s 年 %1$s宾果活动吧！

entries.en: Welcome to the %1$s %2$s SkyBlock Bingo event!
entries.zh: 欢迎参加%2$s 年 %1$s的空岛宾果活动！

entries.en: Reforging usually costs Coins, but since I'm feeling friendly I can reforge your first item for Coal x10.
entries.zh: 重铸通常要花费硬币，不过我今天心情不错，首次重铸只收煤炭 x10。

entries.en: Go into the Mine to collect Coal, then come back to learn how to reforge items!
entries.zh: 去矿洞收集煤炭，然后回来学习如何重铸物品！

entries.en: However, this time I will reforge any item for the low price of Coal x10!
entries.zh: 不过这次，任何物品我都只收煤炭 x10!
喂，回去排队！
注意安全，新兵！

entries.en: I'm a little busy right now... come back soon!
entries.zh: 我现在有点忙……过会儿再来吧！
嘿，新队员！
跟我来。
来，坐下吧。

entries.en: Welcome to the Security Hall. It's the place for all safety matters.
entries.zh: 欢迎来到安全大厅。这里负责一切安全事务。

entries.en: I believe Elizabeth has already introduced you to what we do.
entries.zh: 我想伊丽莎白已经介绍过我们的工作了。

entries.en: The goal of the Safety Squad is to keep SkyBlock safe, and it starts with you.
entries.zh: 安全小队的目标是守护空岛的安全，而这要从你做起。
没错，就是你！

entries.en: If everyone is aware of the importance of safety, the number of safety-related incidents would greatly decrease.
entries.zh: 如果每个人都明白安全的重要性，安全事故就会少得多。
问得好。

entries.en: On one hand, it is very important to do things to keep yourself as safe as possible.
entries.zh: 一方面，采取措施尽可能保护好自己，是非常重要的。

entries.en: Stay indoors when there's a thunderstorm, wear a safety hat while at a construction site, washing your hands frequently while in a hospital...
entries.zh: 雷雨天待在室内，进入工地戴好安全帽，在医院里勤洗手……

entries.en: These are all examples of physical safety.
entries.zh: 这些都是人身安全方面的例子。

entries.en: Today, however, we will be focused on something that's also very important.
entries.zh: 不过，今天我们要关注另一件同样重要的事。
那就是——账号安全。

entries.en: Imagine logging in to SkyBlock and finding that all your belongings have disappeared.
entries.zh: 想象一下，你登录空岛，却发现自己的东西全不见了。

entries.en: Or even worse, trying to log into your Minecraft account but finding yourself locked out.
entries.zh: 更糟的是，你想登录 Minecraft 账号，却发现自己已经登不进去了。

entries.en: The point of Account Safety is to prevent this from happening.
entries.zh: 重视账号安全，就是为了防止这种事发生。

entries.en: And that's why you should pay close attention to today's briefing.
entries.zh: 所以，今天的讲解你可得认真听。

entries.en: SkyBlock has a lot of players.
entries.zh: 空岛有很多玩家。

entries.en: You will meet a lot of them throughout playing SkyBlock.
entries.zh: 游玩空岛的过程中，你会遇到其中的许多人。

entries.en: You could even make some very good friends!
entries.zh: 说不定还能交到很好的朋友！

entries.en: However, not everyone is here to make friends.
entries.zh: 不过，并不是所有人都来交朋友的。

entries.en: Some of them are here to steal your coins, items, or even your account!
entries.zh: 有些人是来偷你的硬币、物品，甚至账号的！
当然不是什么好事。

entries.en: Rule number 1, never trust strangers on the internet.
entries.zh: 第一条规则，绝不要轻信网上的陌生人。

entries.en: Strangers are people you just met. You don't know who they are.
entries.zh: 陌生人就是你刚认识的人。你根本不知道他们是什么人。

entries.en: If someone approaches you, they very likely want something from you.
entries.zh: 如果有人主动找上你，很可能是想从你这里得到些什么。

entries.en: What looks like a seemingly innocent request could lead to you losing your account.
entries.zh: 看似无害的请求，也可能让你丢掉账号。

entries.en: The most common way to lose your account is by opening suspicious links.
entries.zh: 账号被盗最常见的原因，就是打开了可疑链接。

entries.en: If someone sends a link in chat, chances are they are trying to steal your account.
entries.zh: 有人在聊天里发链接，很可能就是想偷走你的账号。
我相信你不会！

entries.en: The thing is, the evil people who steal accounts will try to catch you off guard.
entries.zh: 可问题是，那些盗号的坏人，就等着你放松警惕。

entries.en: They try to make you open links in situations where it seems reasonable.
entries.zh: 他们会挑看起来合情合理的场合，让你打开链接。

entries.en: Or situations where you're distracted, or least suspecting a scam.
entries.zh: 或者趁你分心、最想不到会遇上骗局的时候下手。

entries.en: A way hackers can gain your trust is by messaging you from an account they've already hacked.
entries.zh: 黑客还会用已经盗来的账号给你发消息，骗取你的信任。

entries.en: If it looks like your friend sent you that message, you'd be inclined to trust them more, right?
entries.zh: 如果消息看起来是朋友发来的，你就更容易相信，对吧？

entries.en: Then when you click the link they send you...
entries.zh: 然后，当你点开他们发来的链接……

entries.en: Just like that, your account is gone.
entries.zh: 就这么一下，你的账号没了。
我的确挺吓人的。

entries.en: But losing your account is an even scarier proposition.
entries.zh: 不过，丢掉账号可比我吓人多了。
说回正题。

entries.en: We were talking about links, and how you should be very careful when clicking on links.
entries.zh: 刚才说到链接，点击链接时一定要格外小心。

entries.en: If you ever receive a suspicious message in-game, you should report the player with the /report command.
entries.zh: 如果在游戏里收到可疑消息，请用 /report 指令举报那名玩家。

entries.en: The dangers of clicking unverified links is not limited to within SkyBlock.
entries.zh: 点击未经核实的链接有风险，这可不只是在空岛里。

entries.en: It's something that applies all over the internet, really.
entries.zh: 其实，整个互联网上都一样。

entries.en: There are some situations where you may encounter suspicious links for SkyBlock outside of the game itself.
entries.zh: 在游戏之外，也有一些场合会遇到与空岛有关的可疑链接。

entries.en: For example, you may be trying to download a mod for SkyBlock.
entries.zh: 比如，你可能正想下载一个空岛模组。

entries.en: Or perhaps, you're linked a page to someone's SkyBlock profile, to check out their stats or something.
entries.zh: 又或者，有人给你发了某位玩家的空岛档案页面，让你看看属性之类的。

entries.en: While it's unlikely that these links are bad, you should be careful when clicking them, and try your best to verify whether they're trustworthy.
entries.zh: 这些链接有问题的可能性虽然不大，但点击时仍要小心，尽量核实它们是否可信。
这样就对了！

entries.en: You're saying we got another recruit? That's great, I'll get them settled.

entries.en: If the trade goes through, you'd be stuck with the cheaper item!

entries.en: There are many other forms of these scams.
entries.zh: 这样的骗局还有很多种。

entries.en: Some people will set frequently used items up for auctions at a high price, hoping that someone accidentally clicks on them.
entries.zh: 有人会把常用物品标上高价放到拍卖行，就盼着谁不小心点错。

entries.en: Some people will pretend they can help you reforge something, then just steal your item once you handed it over to them.
entries.zh: 有人会假装帮你重铸装备，等你把物品交过去，就直接拿走。

entries.en: There's even scarier things, like someone telling you to click a link to join a giveaway.
entries.zh: 更可怕的还有人让你点开链接，参加赠奖活动。

entries.en: It will ask you to enter your Microsoft email and sends you a login code.
entries.zh: 网页会让你输入微软账号邮箱，然后给你发送登录验证码。

entries.en: If you give them your code, you've just lost your account entirely.
entries.zh: 如果你把验证码给了对方，整个账号就这么丢了。

entries.en: There are a lot of scams lurking around every corner.

entries.en: We try our best to prevent scams from happening, but scammers always come up with new tricks.
entries.zh: 我们竭力防止诈骗发生，可骗子总能想出新花招。

entries.en: That's why it's always important to stay alert, and stay safe.
entries.zh: 所以，时刻保持警惕、保护好自己，永远都很重要。

entries.en: Be especially wary of people you just met!

entries.en: Correct! In fact, all of the listed statements are true - losing your account can mean lost items, money, profiles, or even your whole Microsoft account.

entries.en: That's right! You can try to reach out to your friend through other methods of contact to verify if it's really them. Even so, you should try and verify that the link is from a reputable website - google the domain name to make sure you're landing at the right website.

entries.zh: 大多数市长一共有 4 项特权可供选择，但每次拥有的数量不尽相同。

entries.en: They'll usually have somewhere from 1-3, with an 8% chance to receive a 4th if they already have 3.
entries.zh: 他们通常拥有 1 至 3 项特权，并有 8%的概率获得第 4 项，前提是已经拥有 3 项。

entries.en: Each Mayor also has a ✯ Minister Perk, which goes hand-in-hand with the Minister system!
entries.zh: 每位市长还有一项✯ 大臣特权，与大臣机制配套生效！

entries.en: Do you want to hear more about that?
entries.zh: 想听听这套机制的详情吗？

entries.en: Each Mayor has a perk marked as a "✯ Minister Perk".
entries.zh: 每位市长都有一项特权，标记为“✯ 大臣特权”。

entries.en: Once a Mayor is elected, the runner-up with the most votes is selected to act as their Minister.
entries.zh: 一位市长当选后，第二名中票数最高者会被选为其大臣。

entries.en: That Minister will provide its ✯ Minister Perk as a nice little bonus!
entries.zh: 这位大臣会额外提供自己的✯ 大臣特权！

entries.en: Was there anything else you wanted to know about?
entries.zh: 还有什么想了解的吗？

entries.en: Every few months, a Special Mayor enters the running.
entries.zh: 每隔几个月，就会有一位特殊市长参选。

entries.en: Their perks are much stronger and crazier!
entries.zh: 他们的特权会强大得多，也疯狂得多！

entries.en: They're always sure to shake things up.
entries.zh: 他们总能把局势搅得天翻地覆。
既然你这么说。

entries.en: Daddy's the kind of steady you need in a storm. If he was any more laid back, he'd be horizontal. But that's why we never tilt!
entries.zh: Daddy 就是那种能让大家在风暴中稳住阵脚的人。他要是再悠闲一点，恐怕就直接躺平了。不过也正因如此，我们从不慌乱！

entries.en: Sis' spirit is so fiery, I keep a bucket of water handy. Just in case her passion for change sets the place ablaze!
entries.zh: Sis 的脾气火爆得很，我总在手边备一桶水，免得她改革的热情真把这里点着了！

entries.en: It's not about the individual leaps; it's about how we hop together as a team.
entries.zh: 关键不在谁一个人跳得多远，而在咱们这支队伍能不能一起往前跳。
