entries.en: I tried showing Granny how to build muscle mass.
entries.zh: 我试着教奶奶怎么练肌肉。

entries.en: I'm not welcome in the warren anymore.
entries.zh: 现在兔子窝不欢迎我了。

entries.en: I've seen it all - every island from here to the edge of the world!
entries.zh: 我见多识广——从这里到世界边缘的每座岛屿都去过！

entries.en: Over the years I've acquired a variety of Talismans.
entries.zh: 这些年来，我收集了各式各样的护符。

entries.en: For a price, you can have it all!
entries.zh: 只要付得起价钱，这些都能归你！

entries.en: Welcome! The museum is just starting to take shape. Your first few contributions are the seeds of something magnificent!
entries.zh: 欢迎！博物馆才刚开始成形。你最初的几件藏品，将成为宏伟事业的种子！

entries.en: I'm sorry, Bingo profiles do not qualify for the Museum.
entries.zh: 抱歉，宾果存档不符合进入博物馆的资格。

entries.en: Did you not listen to me?
entries.zh: 你刚才没听我说话吗？

entries.en: I told you that you aren't popular enough yet to Shen to participate in his auctions!
entries.zh: 我说过，你在申眼里还不够有名，没资格参加他的拍卖！

entries.en: Yet you come back to me and presume that you are.
entries.zh: 可你还是跑回来，还自以为够资格了。

entries.en: Come back when you're Museum Milestone 10.
entries.zh: 达到博物馆里程碑 10 后再来吧。

entries.en: You don't need to take part in Shen's Auction to complete the Bingo.
entries.zh: 完成宾果活动不需要参加申的拍卖会。
欢迎来到申的拍卖会！

entries.en: Down here we strive to provide you with the best value--
entries.zh: 在这里，我们力求让你物有所值——

entries.en: Oh don't you worry about that!
entries.zh: 哦，这个你就别操心了！

entries.en: I'm sure you will meet him one day!
entries.zh: 相信你总有一天会见到他的！
(哎，他可真是个怪人……)

entries.en: Anyway, do you want to see some of the special auctions we have in store?
entries.zh: 总之，要不要看看我们准备的特别拍卖？

entries.en: Alright! Well, all around us in this room are the best auctions from the Auction House upstairs!
entries.zh: 好！这屋子里四周摆的，都是楼上拍卖行的精选拍品！

entries.en: I'm glad you asked! There are three special displays at the head of the room.
entries.zh: 问得好！房间前方有三个特别展示台。

entries.en: Shen is holding 3 special auctions each SkyBlock year...
entries.zh: 申每个空岛年都会举办三场特别拍卖……

entries.en: And you can access them through those displays!
entries.zh: 通过那些展示台就能参与！

entries.en: Careful though, only the richest of the rich may be able to obtain those items!
entries.zh: 不过提醒你，只有富豪中的富豪才可能拿到这些物品！

entries.en: Ah yes! There is one more thing!
entries.zh: 啊，对！还有一件事！

entries.en: Shen is auctioning off one more special item every SkyBlock year.
entries.zh: 申每个空岛年还会额外拍卖一件特殊物品。

entries.en: These are special edition items that rotate every year!
entries.zh: 这些是特别版物品，每年都会轮换！

entries.en: Anyway! That's about everything I know.
entries.zh: 好了！我知道的差不多就这些。

entries.en: If you have any more questions, feel free to talk to me again!
entries.zh: 还有问题的话，随时再来找我！

entries.en: Well, there are three special displays behind you...
entries.zh: 这个嘛，你身后有三个特别展示台……

entries.en: But... you don't seem to be popular enough to Shen to access them...
entries.zh: 但是……在申眼里，你似乎还不够有名，没法参与……

entries.en: But don't worry! I'm sure you could catch up in no time!
entries.zh: 别担心！相信你很快就能赶上的！
没了！什么都没了……真的没了！

entries.en: Ok fine! There is ONE more thing... but you aren't popular enough yet to Shen!
entries.zh: 好吧好吧！是还有一件事……可你在申眼里还不够有名！

entries.en: Go and unlock Museum Milestone 10 and talk to me again!
entries.zh: 先去解锁博物馆里程碑 10,再来找我吧！

entries.en: I said don't worry about that!
entries.zh: 我说了，这个你不用操心！

entries.en: I have told you time and time again you aren't popular enough for Shen yet!
entries.zh: 我说了多少遍，你在申眼里还不够有名！

entries.en: Yet you still try to get through!
entries.zh: 可你还是想闯过去！

entries.en: You must not be very fond of rules are you?
entries.zh: 看来你不怎么喜欢守规矩，是吧？

entries.en: Anyway, unlock Museum Milestone 20 and I MIGHT let you see that!
entries.zh: 总之，先解锁博物馆里程碑 20,我或许就让你看了！
请选择: [申是谁？]
请选择: [好吧……]
请选择: [还有呢？]

entries.en: Select an option: [Is there anything else?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [还有别的吗？]
请选择: [但是？]
请选择: [你在说谎吗？]
面具。活动增益。还有一件饰品。
想要吗？
朋友，这些都能给你。

entries.en: As long as you have enough Carnival Tokens.
entries.zh: 只要你有足够的 Carnival Tokens。

entries.en: Runes are cosmetic effects that drop from Runic mobs!
entries.zh: 符文是由符文怪物掉落的外观特效！

entries.en: Most mobs have a chance to spawn as Runic, so keep your eye out!
entries.zh: 大多数怪物都有概率以符文怪物形态生成，所以留心观察！

entries.en: You can apply runes to weapons and armor with the Rune Pedestal behind me.
entries.zh: 你可以把符文应用到武器和护甲上，使用我身后的符文基座即可。

entries.en: You can also combine two runes for a chance to create a higher level rune with a better effect!
entries.zh: 你还可以合成两枚符文，有机会制成等级更高、效果更好的符文！

entries.en: If you're having trouble storing all the runes you've been collecting, you can buy a Rune Sack from Elizabeth in the Community Center!
entries.zh: 如果收集的符文多得没处放，可以在社区中心向伊丽莎白购买符文袋。
小声点。

entries.en: I can give you my contact but you need to do something for me.
entries.zh: 可以给你联系方式，不过你得先帮我办件事。

entries.en: Could you kill a Runic Enderman? It HAS to be an enderman. Please.
entries.zh: 能帮我杀一只符文末影人吗？一定得是末影人。拜托了。
哦——你做到了。

entries.en: Here take my contact, but don't give it to anyone else!
entries.zh: 来，这是我的联系方式，可别给其他人！

entries.en: Stand back, I'm tinkering with a new necklace.
entries.zh: 退后点，我在研究一条新项链。

entries.en: Looks like there isn't enough Magic left in this universe to complete my project.
entries.zh: 看来这个宇宙剩下的魔力已经不够完成我的研究了。

entries.en: I'll have to talk to Barry...
entries.zh: 得找巴里谈谈了……

entries.en: It's very complicated! Only great enchanteresses may understand.
entries.zh: 这可复杂得很！只有出色的女附魔师才理解得了。
走开，我忙着呢。

entries.en: I can't focus when blockheads keep interrupting me!
entries.zh: 总有呆头呆脑的家伙来打断，我怎么专心！

entries.en: Look buddy, I don't know who you think you are, but back off okay?
entries.zh: 听着，我不知道你把自己当谁了，不过离我远点，好吗？
你烦到我了！

entries.en: What? What is that even supposed to mean?
entries.zh: 什么？你到底想说什么？
等等，你有吗？
那就走开！
哇——哦。

entries.en: If you know this keyword, it means there's a me out there who figured out how to power the necklace.
entries.zh: 你知道这个口令，说明某个地方有一个我，已经想出了给这条项链供能的办法。

entries.en: But since I never stepped into the portal...
entries.zh: 可我从没踏进过传送门……

entries.en: It means that other me must be a future version of my past self, before Barry opened the portal.
entries.zh: 也就是说，另一个我一定是过去的我的未来版本，来自巴里打开传送门之前。

entries.en: I do NOT understand the multi-dimensional journey I must have taken to reach this point...
entries.zh: 我完全不明白，自己究竟经历了怎样的多维旅程，才到了这一步……
* 回过神来 *

entries.en: I need some time to figure out how to empower the necklace...
entries.zh: 我需要些时间，想想怎么增强这条项链……

entries.en: You breathing down my neck does NOT help.
entries.zh: 你在旁边盯着，可一点忙也帮不上。

entries.en: Sure I haven't personally figured out the necklace...
entries.zh: 没错，我还没亲自弄明白这条项链……

entries.en: Plus, I actually need to finish it to avoid a paradox!
entries.zh: 而且，为了避免悖论，我还真得把它完成！

entries.en: I'm ready to do whatever is needed to finish this work.
entries.zh: 只要能完成这项研究，要做什么我都愿意。

entries.en: People are remembered by their greatest work, so everything else doesn't matter.
entries.zh: 人们只会记住一个人最伟大的成果，其他都不重要。

entries.en: Select an option: [You told me to come talk to you.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [是你叫我来找你的。]
请选择: [巧克力？] [焦糖？] [冰淇淋？]
请选择: [没有？]

entries.en: Select an option: [Can I get the necklace?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [能把项链给我吗？]

entries.en: There are many, many, many enchantments that exist in SkyBlock.
entries.zh: 空岛里存在非、常、非、常、多的附魔。

entries.en: Most enchantments require you to be a certain Enchanting Level to use them, though.
entries.zh: 不过，大多数附魔都要求达到一定的附魔等级才能使用。

entries.en: Anyways, I've been writing down every enchantment I've come across so far. Here, take a look!
entries.zh: 总之，我一直在记录遇到的每一种附魔。来，你看看！

entries.en: I know that Gavin uses /scg instead of looking in his Fishing Skill menu.
entries.zh: 我知道加文不查看自己的钓鱼技能菜单，而是使用 /scg。

entries.en: He thinks he's being sneaky, but everyone knows about it.
entries.zh: 他以为自己神不知鬼不觉，其实大家早就知道了。

entries.en: Little does he know, I use it too!
entries.zh: 他不知道的是，我也用这个指令！

entries.en: I've heard stories of Frog Man, but I've never quite worked out if he's a frog or a man.
entries.zh: 我听说过蛙人的故事，但一直没弄明白他究竟是青蛙还是人。

entries.en: Perhaps he is both, perhaps neither.
entries.zh: 也许两者都是，也许两者都不是。
你好呀，亲爱的！
你是来钓鱼的吗？
太好了！

entries.en: Take my spare Fishing Rod and stand near the water.
entries.zh: 拿上我备用的钓鱼竿，站到水边。

entries.en: This rod isn't that special, but it will get the job done for now!
entries.zh: 这根竿子没什么特别的，不过暂时够用了！

entries.en: To fish, cast your rod into the water and wait for a fish to bite!
entries.zh: 钓鱼时，把鱼竿抛入水中，然后等待鱼儿咬钩！

entries.en: And that's really how simple Fishing is!
entries.zh: 没错，钓鱼就是这么简单！

entries.en: This part of the %1$s is a popular area for fishing because of the Fishing Outpost!
entries.zh: 不少人爱来%1$s这一带钓鱼，因为这里有钓鱼前哨！

entries.en: If you follow the river that flows under this bridge downstream, you'll find your way to it!
entries.zh: 沿着从这座桥下流过的河顺流而下，就能找到那里！

entries.en: Fisherman Gerald will be happy to help you on your Fishing journey. Just tell him his wife sent you!
entries.zh: 渔夫杰拉德很乐意在你的钓鱼之旅中帮助你。告诉他是他妻子让你去的就好！

entries.en: If you follow the river that flows under the bridge downstream, you'll find your way to it.
entries.zh: 沿着从桥下流过的河顺流而下，就能找到那里。

entries.en: And tell Gerald I won't be home for dinner tonight! I'm tired of him making salmon.
entries.zh: 还有，告诉杰拉德我今晚不回家吃饭了！我受够他做的鲑鱼了。

entries.en: Using Bait is important to get better results!
entries.zh: 想钓得更好，鱼饵可不能少！

entries.en: My favorite kind is Dark Bait because I prefer fishing at night.
entries.zh: 我最喜欢黑暗鱼饵，毕竟我更爱夜钓。

entries.en: Angler Angus knows a lot more about Bait than I do. I think he's fishing somewhere along this river if you're interested in learning more.
entries.zh: 垂钓者安格斯比我更懂鱼饵。你要是想多学点，他应该就在这条河沿岸钓鱼。
别忘了领你的钓鱼竿！

entries.en: If you like fishin', you'll love the Backwater Bayou!
entries.zh: 要是喜欢钓鱼，你一定会喜欢死水河岸！

entries.en: You should go there sometime soon!
entries.zh: 最近抽空去看看吧！

entries.en: Great day to be on the Farm!
entries.zh: 今天真适合待在农场！

entries.en: A farmer's life is a simple life.
entries.zh: 农夫的生活就是这么简单。

entries.en: My cow is sick, she needs some food to replenish her strength.
entries.zh: 我的奶牛病了，得吃点东西才能恢复力气。

entries.en: Could you gather some Wheat from my farm and bring it back to me so that I can feed her? Poor thing.
entries.zh: 能从我的农场采些小麦带回来吗？我好喂给她，可怜的小家伙。

entries.en: My cow is getting worse! Hurry with that Wheat!
entries.zh: 我的奶牛病得更厉害了！快把小麦带来吧！

entries.en: My farm is yours to harvest! Wheat is a valuable resource to collect. You can unlock many cool things by collecting more of it!
entries.zh: 我的农场随你收割！小麦可是值得收集的好东西，收集得越多，解锁的好东西也越多！

entries.en: Here, try out this Rookie Hoe! It's specifically modified to drop more crops when using it!
entries.zh: 来，试试这把新手锄！特意改过的，用它能多收获些作物！

entries.en: Travel to The Barn to gain access to more crops like Carrots, Potatoes, Pumpkins, and Melons!
entries.zh: 去谷仓看看吧，那里还有胡萝卜、马铃薯、南瓜和西瓜等更多作物！

entries.en: Have you been to The Barn yet?
entries.zh: 你去过谷仓了吗？

entries.en: That might've been our best feast yet!
entries.zh: 那或许是我们办得最好的一次盛宴！

entries.en: We're hoping to run another one next Early Autumn!
entries.zh: 我们打算明年七月再办一场！

entries.en: Check the calendar, there should be another feast scheduled!
entries.zh: 看看日历，上面应该已经排好了下一场盛宴！

entries.en: You can access your Ender Chest in your SkyBlock Menu.
entries.zh: 打开空岛菜单就能找到你的末影箱。

entries.en: Store items in this chest and access them at any time!
entries.zh: 把东西放进这个箱子，随时都能取出来！
我们在管理资金！

entries.en: We went to school for this!
entries.zh: 我们可是专门上学学过这个的！
这里没什么好看的。

entries.en: Welcome! Feel free to browse my fishing wares!
entries.zh: 欢迎！随便看看我的钓鱼用品吧！

entries.en: Good choice! You can equip that beauty by right-clicking it while it's in your hand.
entries.zh: 好眼光！把这件宝贝拿在手上，点右键就能装备了。

entries.en: Or, you can type /equipment to access your equipment menu.
entries.zh: 也可以输入 /equipment,打开装备菜单。

entries.en: Have you found the Rare Frost Wisp yet?
entries.zh: 你找到 Rare 寒霜鬼火了吗？

entries.en: Hey there, I'm George the Pet Collector!
entries.zh: 你好，我是宠物收藏家乔治！

entries.en: I travel the world searching far and wide for the rarest pets I can find!
entries.zh: 我四处游历，就是为了寻找世上最稀有的宠物！

entries.en: If you have any pets which need a new home I'd be happy to buy them off you!
entries.zh: 如果你的宠物需要一个新家，我很乐意买下它们！

entries.en: Have you found the Epic Giraffe yet?
entries.zh: 你找到史诗长颈鹿了吗？

entries.en: Ah, a seasoned tamer, I see! Welcome!
entries.zh: 啊，一看就是经验丰富的驯养者！欢迎！

entries.en: You've mastered the art of Taming to level 50, a commendable feat.
entries.zh: 你已经把驯养练到了 50 级，真了不起。

entries.en: You see, I have a penchant for collecting exotic pets.
entries.zh: 我呢，特别喜欢收集奇珍异宠。

entries.en: A hobby that's not as easy for me as it is for a skilled tamer like yourself.
entries.zh: 可我没你这么好的驯养本领，这个爱好做起来并不容易。

entries.en: In exchange for your help in expanding my collection, I offer a unique opportunity.
entries.zh: 如果你愿意帮我扩充收藏，我可以给你一个特别的机会。

entries.en: For each rare pet you bring to me, starting with the elusive Epic Rift Ferret, I'll unlock an additional level in your Taming skill.
entries.zh: 从难得一见的史诗裂隙雪貂开始，每带来一只我需要的珍稀宠物，我就为你的驯养技能解锁一级上限。

entries.en: Why the Rift Ferret you ask?
entries.zh: 你问为什么是裂隙雪貂？

entries.en: Ah, the Rift is a place of mystery, one I've longed to explore but alas, have never had the chance.
entries.zh: 啊，裂隙真是个神秘的地方。我一直想去探个究竟，可惜始终没机会。

entries.en: Bring me this creature from beyond, and let's advance your taming prowess together!
entries.zh: 把这只来自另一个世界的小家伙带来，我们一起让你的驯养本领再上一层楼！

entries.en: Thank you for bringing me the Mythic Enderman.
entries.zh: 谢谢你带来神话末影人。

entries.en: Their enigmatic presence and otherworldly aura have always captivated me.
entries.zh: 它们那神秘莫测的身影和超凡的气息，总让我着迷。

entries.en: Your Taming level cap has been increased!
entries.zh: 你的驯养等级上限提升了！

entries.en: Shhhh. Don't disturb the Legendary Black Cat.
entries.zh: 嘘，别惊动了传说黑猫。

entries.en: I've always been fascinated by their mysterious charm.
entries.zh: 我一直很着迷于它们神秘的魅力。

entries.en: Thank you for bringing me this pet!
entries.zh: 谢谢你带来这只宠物！
哦，没错，一只史诗蛞蝓。

entries.en: My garden seems to miss having one around!
entries.zh: 我的花园好像正缺这么个小家伙呢！
那是史诗灵魂吗？

entries.en: Their mysterious aura has always intrigued me.
entries.zh: 它们神秘的气息总让我好奇。

entries.en: I've always wanted a Epic Giraffe?
entries.zh: 我一直想要一只史诗长颈鹿！

entries.en: I'm curious to see if they really are as tall as the legends say.
entries.zh: 我真好奇，它们是不是像传说中那么高。

entries.en: Do you think the Epic Jellyfish can dance?
entries.zh: 你说史诗水母会跳舞吗？

entries.en: I've always been mesmerized by their underwater ballet.
entries.zh: 它们在水下的舞姿总让我看得入迷。

entries.en: Thank you for getting the Epic Bal.
entries.zh: 谢谢你帮我找到史诗巴尔。

entries.en: It's a bit too hot for me down there!
entries.zh: 下面对我来说，实在热了点！

entries.en: I'm glad you could fetch me a Epic Baby Yeti?
entries.zh: 很高兴你能帮我带来一只史诗雪怪宝宝！
我可受不了寒冷！

entries.en: Now, I am be delighted to see a Rare Frost Wisp.
entries.zh: 现在能见到一只稀有寒霜鬼火，我真高兴。

entries.en: Their icy presence is said to be quite refreshing.
entries.zh: 听说它们周围冰凉的气息相当清爽。
你做到了！

entries.en: You've brought me all the pets I've asked for, and in doing so, have shown exceptional dedication and skill.
entries.zh: 我想要的宠物你全都带来了，这份耐心和本领可真不一般。

entries.en: Your Taming level cap can now reach the maximum level of 60, thanks to your efforts.
entries.zh: 多亏你的努力，你的驯养等级上限现在能达到最高的 60 级了。

entries.en: You've not only helped me complete my collection but also demonstrated the true spirit of a master tamer.
entries.zh: 你不仅帮我集齐了收藏，也让我看到了驯养大师真正的风范。

entries.en: Remember, the world of taming is vast and ever-changing.
entries.zh: 记住，驯养的世界广阔无边，也一直在变化。

entries.en: May your adventures continue to be as fruitful and exciting as this quest has been!
entries.zh: 愿你接下来的冒险，也能像这次一样精彩、满载而归！

entries.en: Oh absolutely you can have my contact info.
entries.zh: 哦，当然可以给你联系方式。

entries.en: It may look like I'm always here at my desk, but really I'm always traveling.
entries.zh: 看起来我好像总坐在桌边，其实我一直都在四处旅行。

entries.en: Lately I've been looking across the universe for 3 specific pets.
entries.zh: 最近，我跑遍了整个宇宙，就为了找三种特定的宠物。

entries.en: If you can bring me ALL of those, you can have my contact!
entries.zh: 把它们全部带来，我就给你联系方式！

entries.en: Oh, by the way, they should all be Lvl 1.
entries.zh: 哦，对了，它们都得是 1 级。
太棒了！
我最喜欢宠物了！
来，收下我的联系方式。

entries.en: You'll be able to reach me while I am or you are in the wilderness.
entries.zh: 这样不管是我还是你在野外，都能联系上了。

entries.en: Have you found the Mythic Enderman yet?
entries.zh: 你找到神话末影人了吗？

entries.en: Have you found the Legendary Black Cat yet?
entries.zh: 你找到传说黑猫了吗？

entries.en: Have you found the Epic Rift Ferret yet?
entries.zh: 你找到史诗裂隙雪貂了吗？

entries.en: Have you found the Epic Slug yet?
entries.zh: 你找到史诗蛞蝓了吗？

entries.en: Have you found the Epic Spirit yet?
entries.zh: 你找到史诗灵魂了吗？

entries.en: Have you found the Epic Jellyfish yet?
entries.zh: 你找到史诗水母了吗？

entries.en: Have you found the Epic Bal yet?
entries.zh: 你找到史诗巴尔了吗？

entries.en: Have you found the Epic Baby Yeti yet?
entries.zh: 你找到史诗雪怪宝宝了吗？
[交付宠物]

entries.en: I met Captain Baha when I was marooned on a distant pirate cove.
entries.zh: 我被困在遥远的海盗湾时遇见了巴哈船长。

entries.en: He saved my skin then, and I'm forever grateful to him.
entries.zh: 当时他救了我的命，我永远感激他。
钓鱼是咱家的老本行。

entries.en: Enid and I are thrilled that our two children love it as much as we do!
entries.zh: 伊妮德和我可高兴了，两个孩子也跟我们一样喜欢钓鱼！

entries.en: I've only gone lava fishing a few times in my life.
entries.zh: 我这辈子也就试过几次熔岩钓鱼。

entries.en: I prefer the open water. More peaceful, less Ghasts!
entries.zh: 我还是喜欢在开阔的水面钓鱼。清静多了，恶魂也少！
哦……等等。算了。

entries.en: Here, you can join me in drinking away your sorrows.
entries.zh: 来吧，你可以和我一起借酒消愁。

entries.en: Your SkyBlock Profile in your SkyBlock Menu shows details about your current stats!
entries.zh: 想看自己现在的属性，打开空岛菜单里的空岛档案就行！

entries.en: There are 7 stats in total, including ❤ Health, ❁ Strength, and ❈ Defense.
entries.zh: 一共有 7 种属性，比如 ❤ 生命值、❁ 力量和 ❈ 防御。

entries.en: Equipped armor, weapons, and accessories in your inventory all improve your stats.
entries.zh: 穿戴的护甲、武器，还有物品栏里的饰品，都能提升你的属性。

entries.en: Additionally, leveling your Skills can permanently boost some of your stats!
entries.zh: 另外，把技能练上去，还能永久提升部分属性！

entries.en: The higher your ❤ Health stat, the faster your health will regenerate!
entries.zh: 你的 ❤ 生命值越高，回血就越快！

entries.en: If you live for having it all, what you have is never enough.
entries.zh: 若你只为拥有一切而活，那你拥有多少都永远不够。

entries.en: Empty pockets never held anyone back. Only empty heads and empty hearts can do that.
entries.zh: 空空的口袋从未阻挡过任何人，只有空洞的头脑和心灵才会。

entries.en: The real measure of your wealth is how much you'd be worth if you lost all your coins.
entries.zh: 衡量财富的真正标准，是失去所有硬币后你还值多少。

entries.en: Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.
entries.zh: 富有不在于拥有多少，而在于想要的够少。

entries.en: Coins isn't everything, but everything needs coins.
entries.zh: 硬币不是万能的，但没硬币却万万不能。

entries.en: It's not the Steve who has too little, but the Steve who craves more, who is poor.
entries.zh: 穷的不是拥有太少的史蒂夫，而是总想要更多的史蒂夫。

entries.en: You must gain control over your coins or the lack of it will forever control you.
entries.zh: 你得管好自己的硬币，不然缺钱这件事就会永远管着你。

entries.en: Coins don't buy happiness, but it helps.
entries.zh: 硬币买不来快乐，不过确实能帮上忙。

entries.en: You have reached the maximum amount of Jacobus upgrades! That was NOT a smart business decision.
entries.zh: 你的雅各布斯升级次数已达上限！这可不是什么明智的生意。

entries.en: An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
entries.zh: 投资知识，回报最高。

entries.en: Hello %1$s! What brings you to my workshop? I forge the newest and most powerful arrows in all of SkyBlock!
entries.zh: 你好，%1$s! 什么风把你吹到我的工坊来了？全空岛最新、最强的箭都出自我手！

entries.en: If you can prove to me you're a real archer I'll forge you arrows whenever you need them.
entries.zh: 只要向我证明你是真正的弓箭手，往后缺箭就来找我锻造。

entries.en: Ready to test your skills? Step on the pressure plate and all the targets will light up, if you can shoot them all in 25 seconds, I'll know you're the real deal.
entries.zh: 准备好大显身手了吗？踏上压力板后，所有目标都会亮起。若你能在 25 秒内将它们全部射中，我就承认你是真材实料。

entries.en: Wow, you can really shoot a bow!
entries.zh: 哇，你还真会射箭！

entries.en: Well, a deal's a deal! Come to me any time and I'll forge you whatever arrows you need for adventures.
entries.zh: 说话算话！随时来找我，冒险要用什么箭，我都给你造。

entries.en: I have only one condition... These are powerful arrows, they can't fall into the wrong hands so keep them in your quiver and don't share them with anyone.
entries.zh: 我只有一个条件……这些箭威力很强，可不能落到不该拿的人手里。放好在你的箭袋里，别分给别人。

entries.en: Uh... maybe before you dare get my contact, you should prove yourself as a real archer first.
entries.zh: 呃……想要我的联系方式，是不是得先证明自己是个真正的弓箭手？
我的阿比手机联系方式？

entries.en: Listen pal, I've been nice with you but it's strictly business etiquette.
entries.zh: 听着，我对你客气，那只是做生意的礼数。

entries.en: I'm freaking Jax the Archer, you see those lanterns? I can clear them all in 11 seconds!
entries.zh: 我可是神射手杰克斯！看见那些灯笼了吗？我 11 秒就能全打掉！
我就是这么厉害！

entries.en: If you want my contact you'll have to show me you can hit them all in UNDER 11 seconds.
entries.zh: 想要我的联系方式，就拿出本事来，用不到 11 秒把它们全射中。

entries.en: Otherwise you'll have to give me %1$s coins to get my contact, no less.
entries.zh: 不然就给我 %1$s 硬币买联系方式，一分都不能少。
怎么样，你选哪条路？
今天这么有自信，是不是有点想多了？

entries.en: Alright let me know when you realize the massive skill gap between us.
entries.zh: 行，等你认清咱俩射术差得有多远，再来告诉我。

entries.en: I unlocked Target Partice IV for you, good luck kiddo.
entries.zh: 我给你解锁了靶场练习 IV,祝你好运，小子。
你该不会……
我是说……
什么。怎么做到的？?
拿好我的联系方式，走吧。
你还没钱，是吧？

entries.en: Come back when you have the money.
entries.zh: 带够钱再来。

entries.en: Yep, that's right, I'm the best.
entries.zh: 对，没错，我就是最强的。

entries.en: Consider yourself lucky you only had to pay %1$s million, I could easily have added a zero.
entries.zh: 只收你 %1$s 百万硬币，你就偷着乐吧，我完全可以再加个零。

entries.en: Your SkyBlock island is part of a much larger universe.
entries.zh: 你的空岛岛屿只是广阔世界的一部分。

entries.en: The SkyBlock universe is full of islands to explore and resources to discover!
entries.zh: 空岛世界中有无数岛屿等你探索，也有各种资源等你发现！

entries.en: Use the Portal to warp to the first of those islands - the SkyBlock Hub!
entries.zh: 使用传送门前往其中的第一座岛屿——空岛中心岛！

entries.en: It's the holiday season in SkyBlock and that can only mean one thing...
entries.zh: 空岛的节日季到了，这只意味着一件事……
杰瑞的工坊遭到袭击了！

entries.en: Save the Jerrys' home and ensure all of SkyBlock gets to receive Gifts!
entries.zh: 救救杰瑞们的家园，让整个空岛都能收到礼物！

entries.en: Your SkyBlock island is all you have!
entries.zh: 你的空岛岛屿就是你的全部！

entries.en: Progress as far as you can by killing mobs, gaining collection, and using minions.
entries.zh: 击杀生物、积累收藏品、使用小人，能走多远走多远。

entries.en: There is no escape...you are stranded!
entries.zh: 无处可逃……你被困在这里了！

entries.en: My expertise doesn't come for free!
entries.zh: 我的专业意见可不是免费的！

entries.en: Villagers tend to have sweet trades!
entries.zh: 村民手里常有划算的交易！

entries.en: Did you know Slimes can spawn near the void?
entries.zh: 你知道吗？史莱姆会在虚空边上刷出来。

entries.en: Cocoa Beans only grow on one type of tree!
entries.zh: 可可豆只长在一种树上！

entries.en: Shiny creatures can drop shiny things!
entries.zh: 闪亮的生物会掉闪亮的东西！

entries.en: Rabbits can spawn in different biomes!
entries.zh: 兔子会在不同的生物群系里刷出来！

entries.en: I've heard that scary monsters can attack your island sometime in Autumn.
entries.zh: 听说到了八月，会有可怕的怪物袭击你的岛。

entries.en: The only way to obtain Emeralds is to trade for them!
entries.zh: 绿宝石只能靠交易换来！

entries.en: Pigmen are great at hoarding wealth.
entries.zh: 猪人最擅长囤财。

entries.en: This place desperately needs more Iron Golems!
entries.zh: 这地方急需更多铁傀儡！

entries.en: In my opinion, Magma Cubes are just fiery slimes.
entries.zh: 要我说，岩浆怪不过是着了火的史莱姆。

entries.en: Villagers tend to have cool trades!
entries.zh: 村民手里常有不错的交易！

entries.en: Your SkyBlock island is part of a much larger universe... [1/2]
entries.zh: 你的空岛岛屿只是广阔世界的一部分…… [1/2]

entries.en: Wait, how did I get here? [2/2]
entries.zh: 等等，我怎么会在这儿？ [2/2]

entries.en: I seem to be having some issues warping you... Check again soon!
entries.zh: 我好像没法把你传送过去……稍后再试试！

entries.en: Thank you for your bravery! Good luck!
entries.zh: 感谢你的勇气！祝你好运！

entries.en: You are truly a hero! Thank you for helping us!
entries.zh: 你真是个英雄！谢谢你帮助我们！

entries.en: Off you go! Thanks for the help!
entries.zh: 去吧！多谢帮忙！

entries.en: I don't talk to guests! Go away!
entries.zh: 我不跟客人说话！走开！

entries.en: I refuse to speak with guests!
entries.zh: 我拒绝和客人交谈！
别烦我，客人！
吉米瞥了玩家一眼。

entries.en: For the lowly price of %1$s coins, they can be yours.
entries.zh: 只要 %1$s 硬币，它就是你的了。

entries.en: Between you and me, if you ever want to upgrade it you should travel to the Crimson Isle.
entries.zh: 私下告诉你，想升级的话，应该去绯红孤岛。

entries.en: There's this guy named Udel there - he created the Abiphone. Forgot to patent it, though.
entries.zh: 那里有个叫乌德尔的人，阿比手机就是他发明的。不过他忘了申请专利。

entries.en: He sells a whole bunch of high-end Abiphones with more features, you should check it out sometime!
entries.zh: 他出售许多功能更丰富的高端阿比手机，你有空应该去看看！

entries.en: Hey there, I'm Kat the Pet Sitter!
entries.zh: 你好呀，我是宠物保姆凯特！

entries.en: While you're busy adventuring I can take care of your pets.
entries.zh: 你忙着冒险时，我可以替你照顾宠物。

entries.en: I might even be able to give them new abilities!
entries.zh: 我甚至还能赋予它们新的能力！

entries.en: I'll get your %1$s upgraded to %2$s in no time!
entries.zh: 我很快就能把你的%1$s升级到%2$s!

entries.en: I'm currently taking care of your %1$s!
entries.zh: 我正在照顾你的%1$s!

entries.en: Stop by once it's done, okay?
entries.zh: 完成后记得回来一趟，好吗？

entries.en: You can pick it up in %1$s hours %2$s minutes %3$s seconds.
entries.zh: 再过%1$s小时%2$s分%3$s秒就能接它了。
哦，嗨！

entries.en: I was able to upgrade your pet %1$s to %2$s.
entries.zh: 我把你的宠物%1$s升级到%2$s了。

entries.en: If you have any other pets you'd like to upgrade, you know where to find me!
entries.zh: 还有别的宠物想升级的话，你知道上哪儿找我！

entries.en: A flower? For me? How sweet!
entries.zh: 一朵花？送我的？太贴心了！

entries.en: A bouquet? For me? How sweet!
entries.zh: 一束花？送我的？太贴心了！
✆ 交个朋友？当然可以！

entries.en: ✆ But hold on, I don't give my contact for everyone.
entries.zh: ✆ 不过等等，我可不是谁都给联系方式的。
✆ 哎呀，太客气啦！ :3

entries.en: ✆ Do you want me to train your pet?
entries.zh: ✆ 要我帮你训练宠物吗？

entries.en: You can pick it up in %1$s.
entries.zh: 再过 %1$s就能接它了。
你好！欢迎来到图书馆！

entries.en: You can enchant items by clicking any Enchantment Table. Enchanting costs experience levels - the more levels you spend, the better enchantments you will receive.
entries.zh: 点击任意附魔台即可为物品附魔。附魔会消耗经验等级——花费的等级越多，获得的附魔就越好。

entries.en: Use the Enchantment Table to enchant an item!
entries.zh: 使用附魔台为物品附魔！

entries.en: Sorry, but there's... not much to see here right now.
entries.zh: 抱歉，不过……现在这里没什么可看的。

entries.en: We're friends of Diaz's, so we only really have stuff to do when she's elected as Mayor with the Stock Exchange perk, haha.
entries.zh: 我们是迪亚兹的朋友，所以只有她当选市长且携带证券交易所特权时，我们才真有事情做，哈哈。
改天再来看看吧！

entries.en: We're friends of Diaz's, so we only really have stuff to do when she's elected as Mayor, haha.
entries.zh: 我们都是迪亚兹的朋友，所以得等她当上市长，我们这儿才有活儿干，哈哈。

entries.en: Try dropping by when she's in office!
entries.zh: 等她在任时再来看看吧！

entries.en: Richard thinks he's it, being the Stonks Auction Manager.
entries.zh: 理查德当了暴涨拍卖会经理，就觉得自己了不起了。
讨厌鬼。

entries.en: If not for me and my shop, people wouldn't even CARE about Stock of Stonks.
entries.zh: 要不是我和我的商店，谁会在乎什么暴涨股份。

entries.en: Yup, that's right - you can trade me Stock of Stonks for some special items.
entries.zh: 没错，你可以拿暴涨股份来我这儿换些特别的东西。

entries.en: Most of them are Crafting materials used to upgrade various Coin-related pieces of gear.
entries.zh: 大多是合成材料，用来升级各种跟硬币有关的装备。

entries.en: Better hurry, though because they're only available during Mayor Diaz's term.
entries.zh: 不过得抓紧，只有市长迪亚兹在任期间才买得到。
来看看我的货吧。

entries.en: I'm sorry, I have nothing for you.
entries.zh: 抱歉，我这里没有能给你的东西。

entries.en: To fast travel or not to fast travel?
entries.zh: 快速旅行，还是不快速旅行？
嘘！听我说！
别太大声！

entries.en: My cousin Sirius leads an... organization.
entries.zh: 我的表亲西里乌斯领导着一个……组织。

entries.en: It's a... business, auctioning sweet items.
entries.zh: 那是个……做好货拍卖的生意。

entries.en: He regularly runs events at a nearby house, but only under the cover of night.
entries.zh: 他经常趁夜色掩护在附近的一栋房子里举办活动。

entries.en: Buy a few items from Sirius and come back!
entries.zh: 去买几件物品吧，从西里乌斯那儿买完再回来！

entries.en: You've purchased %1$s items from the Dark Auction.
entries.zh: 你已经在暗黑拍卖买了 %1$s 件物品。

entries.en: Come back when you've purchased %1$s. I'll have something for you then.
entries.zh: 买够 %1$s 件再来吧，到时我有东西给你。

entries.en: You're basically family at this point.
entries.zh: 到这份上，你简直就是自家人了。

entries.en: Have you enchanted your axe with Efficiency V? It'll help ya break stuff a lot faster.
entries.zh: 你给斧头附魔效率 V 了吗？它能让你破坏东西快得多。

entries.en: My woodcutting assistant has fallen quite ill! Do you think you could take over for him?
entries.zh: 我的伐木助手病得很重！你愿意替他工作吗？

entries.en: Cheers! Let me tell ya a little about what we're going to be doing.
entries.zh: 太好了！让我简单说说我们接下来要做什么。

entries.en: We will be Foraging! As one of SkyBlock's core skills, Foraging involves cutting down lots of different types of trees!
entries.zh: 我们要去伐木！伐木是空岛的核心技能之一，需要砍伐许多不同种类的树木！

entries.en: As you do this, you'll unlock various crafts and useful stat boosts that will help in other areas of your adventure.
entries.zh: 在这个过程中，你会解锁各种配方和实用的属性加成，它们也会在冒险的其他方面助你一臂之力。

entries.en: Here, let me unlock the Foraging skill for you, and then you can get started!
entries.zh: 来，我先为你解锁伐木技能，然后你就可以开始了！

entries.en: To get you started, please bring me 20 Oak Logs! You can break the trees just off the trail to get 'em.
entries.zh: 先帮我拿来 20 个橡木原木吧！小径旁的树木就能采集到。

entries.en: Use your fists for now - I'll give you my previous assistant's axe if you can prove your worth!
entries.zh: 暂时先用拳头吧——只要你能证明自己的能力，我就把前任助手的斧头送给你！

entries.en: Nice job! In return for those logs, I'll give ya this Promising Axe.
entries.zh: 干得漂亮！作为这些原木的回报，这把潜力斧就送给你吧。

entries.en: It's far less painful than using your fists to punch trees, I'll tell ya that much!
entries.zh: 这可比徒手砸树轻松多了，真的！

entries.en: If you feel like Foraging is the thing for you, continue down the path and head towards The Park.
entries.zh: 如果你喜欢伐木，就沿着小径继续前往公园吧。

entries.en: My friend Charlie can be found there. I'm sure he'll have some work for you!
entries.zh: 我的朋友查理就在那里。他肯定有些活儿需要你帮忙！

entries.en: My mate Charlie has a Treecapitator! With it, he can break down entire trees in a single swipe!
entries.zh: 我的老朋友查理有一把砍树斧！用它挥一下就能砍倒整棵树！

entries.en: Have you spoken to my mate Charlie over in The Park yet? He could probably use your help.
entries.zh: 你和老朋友查理聊过了吗？他就在公园，应该正需要你的帮助。

entries.en: Buy and sell Wooden Axes with me!
entries.zh: 来我这里买卖木斧！
想要我的联系方式？没问题。
让我想想……

entries.en: My Axe could do with an upgrade...
entries.zh: 我的斧头也该换把好的了……

entries.en: That's right! A Spruce Axe is what I desire!
entries.zh: 对了！我想要一把云杉斧！

entries.en: A deal is a deal and I'm a man of my word. Here's my contact.
entries.zh: 说话算话，我可是一诺千金的人。这是我的联系方式。

entries.en: Every problem in life can be solved with a little redstone.
entries.zh: 生活里的任何难题，一点红石就能解决。
哇，你想要我的联系方式？

entries.en: I always hear people wanting the Builder's contact, but nobody ever asks for mine...
entries.zh: 总听到大家想要建筑师的联系方式，却从来没人问我的……

entries.en: Unfortunately for you, I don't own an abiphone.
entries.zh: 可惜，我没有阿比手机。

entries.en: Lucky for you, I have constructed my very own abiphone out of redstone, and it's got infinite contact slots!
entries.zh: 不过你运气不错，我用红石给自己造了一部阿比手机，联系人还不限数量！

entries.en: Simply bring me an Enchanted Redstone Block and I'll add you right in!
entries.zh: 给我带一个附魔红石块，我马上就把你加上！

entries.en: This ain't no Enchanted Redstone Block, mi amigo...
entries.zh: 朋友，这可不是附魔红石块……
哇哦！就是这个。
这是我的联系方式！

entries.en: I'm your guy for anything related to redstone, or to explosions.
entries.zh: 红石也好，爆炸也好，都找我就对了。

entries.en: Give me a call if you ever need anything from my shop, I can always make time for another redstone enthusiast.
entries.zh: 想买店里的东西就打给我，只要同样喜欢红石，我总能抽出时间。

entries.en: Come back with the right amount of items!
entries.zh: 带够数量的物品再回来！
嘿！

entries.en: I'm a world-famous artist to be. Most people just call me "the new da Vinci".
entries.zh: 我是未来的世界级艺术家。大家一般管我叫“新一代达芬奇”。

entries.en: Unfortunately I ran out of dye this morning...
entries.zh: 可惜今天早上我的颜料用完了……

entries.en: In my garden are some flowers. Could you pick 5 Poppies and turn them into Rose Red Dye, then bring them back to me?
entries.zh: 我的园子里种着些花。你能摘 5 朵虞美人，做成玫瑰红染料，再拿回来给我吗？

entries.en: Wow! That's the most beautiful red dye I have ever seen!
entries.zh: 哇！这是我见过最美的红色染料！
这罐喷漆送你！

entries.en: You can select a spray by left-clicking your Spray Can!
entries.zh: 拿着喷漆罐左键，就能选择喷绘图案！

entries.en: Right-click any wall on your private island to spray it. If you ever lose your Spray Can, you can craft another one using the recipe in your Recipe Book!
entries.zh: 在私人岛屿上对着任意墙面右键就能喷上去。要是喷漆罐弄丢了，用配方书里的配方再做一罐就行！

entries.en: Thank you so much for your help. You should visit me in my Canvas Room sometime! Step into the portal to the left over there!
entries.zh: 太感谢你的帮忙了。有空来我的画布室坐坐！走左边那扇传送门就到！

entries.en: Look who it is... you made it to my Canvas Room!
entries.zh: 瞧瞧这是谁……你还真找到我的画布室了！

entries.en: Since you're here already... would you like to draw something?
entries.zh: 既然来都来了……想不想画点什么？

entries.en: Put your Spray Can in your hand, hold right-click and move it across the canvas to draw!
entries.zh: 手里拿着喷漆罐，按住右键在画布上移动，就能画画！

entries.en: You can choose a color by clicking it in the palette below the canvas.
entries.zh: 点画布下方调色板里的颜色就能换色。

entries.en: Let me know when you're done with your painting!
entries.zh: 画完了告诉我一声！
哇！太美了！

entries.en: For now, enjoy the sprays you have available in your Spray Can!
entries.zh: 眼下嘛，先好好玩玩你喷漆罐里已有的图案吧！

entries.en: Thank you again for your help!
entries.zh: 再次感谢你的帮忙！

entries.en: Before spraying on a wall, consider previewing it in the menu! Right-click on any spray of your choice and it'll magically appear in your hand.
entries.zh: 往墙上喷之前，不妨先在菜单里预览一下！右键点任意一个图案，它就会神奇地出现在你手里。

entries.en: Don't forget to refill your spray can with dye! You can pick some of the flowers in my garden if you want to.
entries.zh: 别忘了给喷漆罐补充染料！想要的话，可以去我园子里摘些花。

entries.en: You can select sprays by left-clicking with your Spray Can!
entries.zh: 拿着喷漆罐左键就能选择图案！

entries.en: I love sprays! So many colors!
entries.zh: 我太爱喷绘了！五颜六色的！

entries.en: In the future, the canvas room will let you save your drawings to sprays!
entries.zh: 将来，画布室还能把你的画保存成喷绘图案！

entries.en: In the distant future I'll let you create your very own sprays with this canvas...
entries.zh: 再往后，我还打算让你用这块画布做出专属于自己的图案……

entries.en: Hey if you really want to know...
entries.zh: 嘿，如果你真想知道……
慢慢研究吧！

entries.en: Come back once you've put an accessory in your Accessory Bag!
entries.zh: 先往饰品袋里放入一件饰品，然后再来找我！

entries.en: Accessories are X magical X pieces of gear.
entries.zh: 饰品是一种 X 神奇 X 的装备。

entries.en: To truly harness their power, collect as many as possible and store them in your Accessory Bag!
entries.zh: 要充分发挥它们的力量，就尽可能多地收集饰品，放进你的饰品袋！

entries.en: On top of their existing abilities, each accessory makes your Accessory Bag more powerful!
entries.zh: 除了自带的能力，每件饰品还能让你的饰品袋变得更强！

entries.en: Accessories add some ACCESSORY POWER to the bag depending on their rarity.
entries.zh: 饰品会根据自身的稀有度，为饰品袋增加一定的饰品之力。

entries.en: Yes! The more Accessory Power, the more stats like ❤ Health or ✎ Intelligence you get from your Accessory Bag.
entries.zh: 没错！饰品之力越高，你的饰品袋提供的❤ 生命值、✎ 智力等属性就越多。
不，这是魔法！

entries.en: Even better, YOU choose what stats you get!
entries.zh: 更棒的是，由你来决定获得哪些属性！

entries.en: ✆ That way you'll be able to access my features from anywhere?
entries.zh: ✆ 这样你在哪儿都能找我办事了？
✆ 这算不算作弊啊？

entries.en: ✆ Don't you know you're supposed to walk all the way over here every single time?
entries.zh: ✆ 你难道不知道，每次都得老老实实走过来找我吗？

entries.en: ✆ Ah well, times are changing I suppose...
entries.zh: ✆ 唉，算了，时代总在变嘛……

entries.en: ✆ Plus, it's a magical object, so it's not that bad.
entries.zh: ✆ 再说了，它也是魔法物品，倒也没那么糟。

entries.en: ✆ Now let's see, what should I ask for it...
entries.zh: ✆ 让我想想，该找你要点什么呢……

entries.en: ✆ What about some more Luxurious Spool, hum?
entries.zh: ✆ 要不再来点奢华线轴，怎么样？

entries.en: ✆ I'm joking! Bring me Ultimate Carrot Candy x2.
entries.zh: ✆ 开玩笑的！给我带终极胡萝卜糖 x2 就行。
✆ 我还得喂家里的宠物呢。

entries.en: ✆ My frogs are going to love that, thanks a lot!
entries.zh: ✆ 我家的青蛙一定喜欢，多谢啦！
请选择: [好，然后呢？]
请选择: [饰品之力？]
请选择: [太厉害了！]
%1$s,这个能力可真不错！

entries.en: I'm not so sure about this power, it's used by some dark wizards.
entries.zh: 这个能力我可不太放心，有些黑巫师也在用它。
这个能力我自己也学过，%1$s。
你想要我的阿比手机联系方式？

entries.en: That way you'll be able to access my features from anywhere?
entries.zh: 这样不管走到哪儿，都能找我办事了？
可这不算作弊吗？

entries.en: Don't you know you are supposed to walk all the way here every single time?
entries.zh: 你难道不知道，每次都该自己走到这里来吗？

entries.en: Ah well, times are changing I suppose...
entries.zh: 算了，时代总是在变嘛……

entries.en: Plus it's a magical object, so it's not that bad.
entries.zh: 何况那也是件魔法道具，倒也不算坏。

entries.en: Now let's see, what should I ask for it...
entries.zh: 让我想想，该要点什么来交换呢……

entries.en: What about some more Luxurious Spool, hum?
entries.zh: 再来点奢华线轴，怎么样？

entries.en: I'm joking! Bring me Ultimate Carrot Candy x2.
entries.zh: 开玩笑的！给我带 2 个终极胡萝卜糖吧。
我还有宠物要喂呢。

entries.en: My frogs are going to love that, thanks a lot!
entries.zh: 我的青蛙一定会喜欢的，多谢了！
说什么话？杀就完了。

entries.en: Maddox always hiding, Me know why.
entries.zh: 马多克斯总躲着，俺知道为啥。

entries.en: If me lose mayor, me find you.
entries.zh: 俺要是没当上市长，就去找你。
俺叫亚托克斯。
马多克斯的哥哥。

entries.en: Maddox is brain. Me slay. If you vote me, you slay too!
entries.zh: 马多克斯动脑。俺动手。投俺一票，你也能杀个痛快！

entries.en: Oi, mining is tough, but has t'be done!
entries.zh: 喂，挖矿虽辛苦，但总得有人干！

entries.en: I'm no different than yu' pal, I just work twice as hard!
entries.zh: 我跟你没啥两样，伙计，不过是加倍卖力罢了！

entries.en: Nothin' is more satisfying, than a full inventory after a day of work!
entries.zh: 苦干一天后装满整个物品栏，没啥比这更痛快了！

entries.en: Some people mine to forget, I mine to remember.
entries.zh: 有人靠挖矿遗忘，我靠挖矿铭记。

entries.en: A good pickaxe, is a swinging pickaxe!
entries.zh: 好镐子，就该挥起来！
我会让挖矿彻底变个样，等着瞧吧！

entries.en: Pets are the best, trust me.
entries.zh: 宠物是最棒的，相信我。

entries.en: If I get elected I SWEAR you won't regret it.
entries.zh: 我发誓，选我当市长你绝不会后悔。

entries.en: I bonded with a legendary creature once, they sometimes follow me.
entries.zh: 我曾和一只传奇生物结下羁绊，它偶尔会跟着我。

entries.en: My private island is a Zoo, you should come by and visit.
entries.zh: 我的私人岛屿就是一座动物园，你应该来参观。

entries.en: Griffins are real, but they only like pure people.
entries.zh: 狮鹫真的存在，但它们只喜欢心灵纯洁的人。

entries.en: I am in perfect communion with nature.
entries.zh: 我与自然完美相通。

entries.en: You know what's good for you? More coins.
entries.zh: 知道什么对你有好处吗？更多硬币。

entries.en: I'm not talking small coins, I mean mountains of coins.
entries.zh: 我说的可不是小钱，而是堆积如山的硬币。

entries.en: You look smart, you and I can fix this economy.
entries.zh: 你看起来很聪明，你我联手就能挽救经济。

entries.en: One day I'll build the Diaz tower.
entries.zh: 总有一天，我会建起迪亚兹大厦。

entries.en: I love the sound of coins in the morning.
entries.zh: 我喜欢清晨硬币碰撞的声音。
存钱罐是我父亲发明的。
我是芬尼根！
我跟雅各布是姻亲，跟特雷弗是堂表亲！!
世界真小啊！
农场倒是大得很！

entries.en: All of us are trappers at heart!
entries.zh: 我们骨子里都是捕猎的好手！

entries.en: I don't know if farming is for everyone, but everyone should give it a shot!
entries.zh: 种地未必适合所有人，不过总该试一试嘛！

entries.en: Yes, I do have a PhD in Agriculture & Forestry and a Masters in Applied Mathematics.
entries.zh: 没错，我还真有农林学博士学位和应用数学硕士学位。
哟——是我！! FOXY!!!
无聊透顶啦！!!!!!

entries.en: Let's turn the heat up, it's party time!
entries.zh: 气氛搞起来，派对时间到！

entries.en: Why not just schedule an extra event??
entries.zh: 干嘛不多办一场活动呢？?
咱们能拿下 5000 万票吗？!?

entries.en: Vote for me if you like fun!
entries.zh: 想玩得尽兴，就投我一票！

entries.en: I love diving and fishing. The world is much simpler when you live on the beach.
entries.zh: 我喜欢潜水和钓鱼。住在海滩上，世界会简单得多。

entries.en: If you don't like the sea, don't vote for me.
entries.zh: 如果你不喜欢大海，就别投我。

entries.en: I come from an atoll, the sea goes very deep there.
entries.zh: 我来自一座环礁，那里的海非常深。
如水一般吧，我的朋友。

entries.en: Caught a big fish today, you got anything to pair it with?
entries.zh: 今天钓了条大鱼，你这儿有什么能搭着吃的吗？
正好，这就是我需要的！
没关系，大海总有馈赠。

entries.en: Hey, I know a few Dungeon tricks.
entries.zh: 嘿，我懂几招地牢里的门道。

entries.en: If you vote for me I'll teach you!
entries.zh: 投我一票，我就教你！

entries.en: You merely adopted the Dungeons, I was born in them, molded by them.
entries.zh: 你不过是学会了闯地牢，我却生在地牢，长在地牢。

entries.en: I used to be a Dungeon adventurer, until I took an arrow to the elbow.
entries.zh: 我以前也是个地牢冒险者，直到手肘中了一箭。

entries.en: All this paperwork is making me hungry.
entries.zh: 处理这一堆文书，都把我弄饿了。
我好想再去闯地牢啊，%1$s。

entries.en: Being a mayor is downtime, anyways.
entries.zh: 反正当市长也就是在耽误时间。
书籍令人着迷。
知识能跨越时间和空间。
空间也不过是一种构想……
呼！我得来杯咖啡！
书里的文字能长久留存。
以知识的形式。

entries.en: Elise really wanted this but she is shy.
entries.zh: 伊莉丝很想要这个，不过她比较害羞。
我在帮她选书。

entries.en: Anything to do with the Calamity or the Riftway at the top of the mountain.
entries.zh: 只要是讲大灾变，或是山顶裂隙通道的书都行。

entries.en: Did you know that for the longest time...
entries.zh: 你知道吗，曾经有很长一段时间……

entries.en: The Blacksmith would reforge your accessories?
entries.zh: 铁匠会重铸你的饰品？
真离谱！

entries.en: If you find reforged accessories, I'll buy their reforges from you for coins!
entries.zh: 如果你找到了重铸过的饰品，我会用硬币买下它们的重铸效果！

entries.en: Hoppity thinks he's all that with his chocolate empire.
entries.zh: 霍皮提觉得自己有个巧克力帝国就了不起。

entries.en: But ask him this...who can hop the highest?
entries.zh: 但你问问他……谁跳得最高？

entries.en: If you need a rundown of Uncle's high school football stats, just stick around for five minutes.
entries.zh: 想听叔叔细数自己的高中橄榄球战绩？在旁边待五分钟就行。

entries.en: He'll bring it up somehow, even if we are talking about chocolate molds.
entries.zh: 哪怕大家聊的是巧克力模具，他也总能想办法扯到这上面。

entries.en: My morning routine? A quick hop around the fields, a bit of carrot juice, and then straight to work on the next big chocolate innovation.
entries.zh: 我的晨间安排？先绕田地蹦一圈，喝点胡萝卜汁，然后立刻开工，研发下一款划时代的巧克力。
弱者才需要睡觉！
叔叔真是我的榜样。

entries.en: He inspires me to care less about the details, because nothing ever works out in the end.
entries.zh: 他激励我别太在意细节，反正最后什么事都成不了。

entries.en: They say genius often looks like laziness. Guess I'm living proof.
entries.zh: 都说天才看起来往往像懒汉。看来我就是活生生的证明。

entries.en: When I finally get to it, even Granny's impressed with the flavors I whip up.
entries.zh: 等我终于动手时，就连奶奶都会被我调出的味道折服。

entries.en: Rabbit Dog is so youthful and full of energy.
entries.zh: 兔子狗可真有活力，整天精力旺盛。
就是身上臭得有点厉害。

entries.en: I tell ya, family gatherings got a lot more interesting when Hoppity started bringing those experimental chocolates.
entries.zh: 我跟你说，自从霍皮提开始带那些试验版巧克力来，家庭聚会就热闹多了。
还记得胡萝卜脆那次翻车吗？

entries.en: Coach could motivate a snail to enter a sprint. It's exhausting, but you've got to admire that kind of energy.
entries.zh: 教练能鼓动一只蜗牛去参加短跑。虽然听着都累，但你不得不佩服这股劲头。

entries.en: Hoppity wants us to 'think outside the box.' Last time I did that, we ended up with chocolate-covered grass.
entries.zh: 霍皮提让我们“跳出框框想问题”。上次这么一想，我们就做出了裹巧克力的草。

entries.en: Sold out in a week. Shows what I know.
entries.zh: 结果一周就卖光了。看来是我见识少了。

entries.en: Bro's dedication is what this company needs more of. And Cousin, well, he brings...creativity.
entries.zh: 公司就缺兄弟这股干劲。至于表哥嘛，他带来的是……创意。

entries.en: Granny? She's the glue holding us all together.
entries.zh: 奶奶？多亏有她，咱们这个家才拧得成一股绳。
汪汪！
*呜咽*
汪！
汪。
*喘气*

entries.en: That coach could talk a carrot into growing faster. It's a talent, but sometimes I just want him to turn the volume down.
entries.zh: 那位教练能说动胡萝卜快点长。这确实是本事，但有时我只想让他小点声。

entries.en: That dog of ours, always bustling about. You'd think he understands the stakes.
entries.zh: 咱家的那条狗总是忙前忙后。看那样子，你还以为它真懂事情有多要紧。

entries.en: But it's just his nature, always wanting to please, always ready to help. Bless his loyal heart.
entries.zh: 不过它天性如此，总想讨人欢心，随时准备帮忙。愿它忠诚的心永远蒙福。

entries.en: Hoppity wants to automate the chocolate wrapping. I told him, 'Nothing beats the personal touch.'
entries.zh: 霍皮提想让机器自动包装巧克力。我跟他说:“哪有亲手做的贴心。”

entries.en: He gave me a computerized knitting machine.
entries.zh: 结果他送了我一台电脑控制的编织机。
请继续往前走。

entries.en: Don't be snootin' around here now.
entries.zh: 别在这里到处乱嗅。

entries.en: Get back to finding them eggs!
entries.zh: 别在这儿晃了，找你的蛋去！

entries.en: They call me a troublemaker, a rebel. I say, I'm the only one talking sense!
entries.zh: 他们说我是麻烦精、叛逆者。要我说，全家只有我讲道理！

entries.en: Wake up and smell the exploitation, family!
entries.zh: 家人们，醒醒吧，闻闻这剥削的味道！

entries.en: Chocolate is love, chocolate is life. But at what cost?
entries.zh: 巧克力就是爱，巧克力就是生命。可代价呢？

entries.en: It's time this family faces the music and listens to the cocoa beans' side of the story!
entries.zh: 这个家也该面对现实了，听听可可豆怎么说吧！

entries.en: Bro's always talking about his 'sigma grindset'. Tried to get me to read a book on it.
entries.zh: 兄弟整天把他的“独狼奋斗心态”挂在嘴边，还想塞本书让我看。

entries.en: I told him I'd start my own movement: the 'chocolate mindfulness mindset'.
entries.zh: 我跟他说，我要自创一派:“巧克力正念心态”。

entries.en: I told Hoppity we should have a line of eco-friendly chocolates.
entries.zh: 我跟霍皮提提议，咱们该出个环保巧克力系列。

entries.en: He asked if green food coloring counted.
entries.zh: 他问我，加绿色食用色素算不算。
我们……还在努力。

entries.en: Cuz might not have the typical athlete's discipline, but he's clutch.
entries.zh: Cuz 或许没有典型运动员的自律，但关键时刻绝对靠得住。

entries.en: Just like my old teammate who didn't show up to every practice, but could score tuddies when it mattered most.
entries.zh: 就像我以前那个队友:不是每次训练都来，可到了紧要关头总能达阵得分。

entries.en: I used to chuck that ball like nobody's business. Those were the days, eh?
entries.zh: 想当年我那一手传球，谁见了不服气？那才叫好日子啊。

entries.en: Still got some of those moves, you know.
entries.zh: 别看我现在这样，当年的本事可没全丢。

entries.en: Hoppity's like the star quarterback of this chocolate game. Always looking for that next big play.
entries.zh: 霍皮提就像巧克力界的明星四分卫，总在琢磨下一次怎么打出漂亮的进攻。

entries.en: He's got that championship mindset, just like I had.
entries.zh: 他那股非拿冠军不可的劲儿，跟当年的我一个样。
没看见我正忙着吗？
哦，你看不出来？

entries.en: Whatever. Go talk to Liz, she'll tell you what's up.
entries.zh: 随便吧。去找莉兹，她会告诉你怎么回事。
嘿，嘿，你好呀！

entries.en: I'm Richard, the Stonks Auction Master.
entries.zh: 我是理查德，暴涨拍卖会的拍卖师。

entries.en: As long as Diaz is Mayor, I'll let you bid on Stock of Stonks to use in Liz's shop!
entries.zh: 只要迪亚兹还是市长，你就能在我这儿竞拍暴涨股份，拿去莉兹的商店用！

entries.en: It's kind of a big deal.
entries.zh: 这可是件了不起的事。

entries.en: Don't know what equipment to aim for?
entries.zh: 不知道该以什么装备为目标？

entries.en: Try some of my starter gear!
entries.zh: 试试我的新手装备！

entries.en: Thank you for supporting the server and allowing us to maintain SkyBlock!
entries.zh: 谢谢你支持服务器，让我们能继续维护空岛！

entries.en: If you want to support us, head over to the Hypixel Store at store.hypixel.net!
entries.zh: 想支持我们的话，可以去 Hypixel 商店看看: store.hypixel.net!

entries.en: Excuse my manners, my name is Sam and I live next door... or should I rather say next "island".
entries.zh: 请原谅我没先自我介绍，我叫萨姆，就住在隔壁……或者该说隔壁的“岛”上。

entries.en: You seem to have quite a talent for growing crops... which is something I couldn't really say about myself...
entries.zh: 看来你很有种植作物的天赋……我自己可完全谈不上……

entries.en: You see, I've been having quite the struggle with my farm that I inherited from my father.
entries.zh: 你看，我一直不太会打理父亲留给我的农场。

entries.en: He was a very skillful farmer... not like me... I have two left thumbs when it comes to farming.
entries.zh: 他曾是个非常熟练的农夫……不像我……我干起农活来总是笨手笨脚。

entries.en: I was wondering if maybe you could... help me out... with my farm.
entries.zh: 我在想，也许你能……帮帮我……打理农场。
哦……那好吧……

entries.en: Could you help me out with my farm?
entries.zh: 你能帮我打理农场吗？

entries.en: Wow!! Thank you so much. I'll bring you right there.
entries.zh: 哇！! 太感谢你了。我这就带你过去。

entries.en: Hmmm, it seems we can't go to The Garden right now. Let's try again later...
entries.zh: 嗯……现在好像去不了花园。待会儿再试试吧……
为萨姆收集小麦？
帮帮她？ [好吧]
卖掉剩下的小麦？

entries.en: [Good call!] [I'd rather keep it for myself]
entries.zh: [好主意！] [我还是想留给自己]

entries.en: You can modify your maximum speed when farming specific crops at your Desk.
entries.zh: 你可以在管理台调整收获特定作物时的速度上限。
我最喜欢雪了！

entries.en: I've got the perfect tool to make your island a winter wonderland!
entries.zh: 我这儿有件宝贝，保准能把你的岛变成冬日仙境！

entries.en: My name is Scorpius, I don't come here very often.
entries.zh: 我叫斯科皮乌斯，不常来这儿。

entries.en: If you know Sirius, you may want to do business with us.
entries.zh: 如果你认识西里乌斯，也许会想和我们做点生意。

entries.en: We'll take...very good care of you.
entries.zh: 我们会……好好关照你的。

entries.en: Great men are not born great, they grow great.
entries.zh: 伟大的人并非生来伟大，而是一步步成长起来的。

entries.en: I'll make you an offer you can't refuse.
entries.zh: 我会给你一个无法拒绝的条件。

entries.en: Now that I'm mayor, I can truly serve the underground community.
entries.zh: 如今我当了市长，总算能真正为地下圈子的各位效劳了。

entries.en: This Auction will have more rounds and upgraded items.
entries.zh: 这场拍卖会的轮次更多，拍品也更好了。

entries.en: Thank you for joining the Safety Squad.
entries.zh: 感谢你加入安全小队。

entries.en: Your Safety Badge is ready! Your information has been digitally registered.
entries.zh: 你的安全徽章准备好了！你的信息也已经完成电子登记。

entries.en: You're now a fully fledged Safety Advocate!
entries.zh: 现在你是一名正式的安全宣传员了！

entries.en: Hopefully there won't be more incidents happening around.
entries.zh: 希望今后这附近别再出什么事了。

entries.en: Oh, Elizabeth wants to have a word with you.
entries.zh: 对了，伊丽莎白想和你说几句话。

entries.en: Downloading suspicious mods or visiting untrusted discord servers can put your account at risk. It is up to you to keep your account secure!
entries.zh: 下载来路不明的模组、进不可信的 Discord 群，都可能让你的账号出问题。账号安不安全，得靠你自己把关！

entries.en: Here are some helpful support articles that will help you keep your account more secure and avoid losing valuable progress or items.
entries.zh: 下面这几篇帮助文档能教你把账号护得更牢，别让辛苦攒下的进度和物品打了水漂。

entries.en: What a pleasant surprise! I see you have quite an impressive island.
entries.zh: 真是个惊喜！看得出来，你的岛屿相当不错。
出门在外要注意安全，新兵！

entries.en: You look like you're still getting the hang of things. Come back when you're SkyBlock Level 10!
entries.zh: 看样子你还在熟悉这里。等你达到空岛等级 10 级再来吧！

entries.en: Hey, are you here to volunteer for the Safety Squad?
entries.zh: 你好，你是来报名加入安全小队的吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [Absolutely!] [Tell me more about the Safety Squad.] [Not right now.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [当然！] [跟我讲讲安全小队吧。] [现在不了。]
天哪，这可真是个好消息！

entries.en: With dangerous activity running rampant recently, we could really use your help.
entries.zh: 最近危险的事接连不断，我们正需要你的帮助。

entries.en: You'll need to undergo some training to become a Safety Advocate.
entries.zh: 成为安全宣传员之前，你需要接受一些培训。

entries.en: Is this fine with you? I promise it won't take long.
entries.zh: 这样可以吗？我保证不会花太久。

entries.en: Select an option: [Sounds good with me!] [Give me a moment.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [我没问题！] [等我一下。]

entries.en: The Safety Squad is dedicated to keeping SkyBlock safe.
entries.zh: 安全小队致力于守护空岛的安全。

entries.en: A lot of incidents can be avoided if there just was more awareness about safety.
entries.zh: 只要大家多一点安全意识，很多事故本来都能避免。

entries.en: As such, we are recruiting Safety Advocates to help spread the importance of safety in SkyBlock.
entries.zh: 所以我们正在招募安全宣传员，让更多人重视空岛的安全。

entries.en: Are you willing to become a Safety Advocate?
entries.zh: 你愿意成为安全宣传员吗？
这个世界需要你的帮助！

entries.en: Select an option: [Absolutely!] [Let me think about it a bit more.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [当然！] [让我再想想。]

entries.en: That's fine, you can always come back later.
entries.zh: 没关系，想来了随时再来。

entries.en: Talk to me when you're ready.
entries.zh: 准备好了就来找我。

entries.en: Are you ready for your Safety Advocate training?
entries.zh: 准备好接受安全宣传员培训了吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [I'm good to go!] [Give me a moment.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [我准备好了！] [等我一下。]
正在办理登记……
太棒了！你是我们的第 %1$s 位志愿者！

entries.en: Head into the doorway next to me, she'll be waiting for you!
entries.zh: 从我旁边的门进去，她在里面等你！

entries.en: Brigette is waiting for you in the Security Hall. Better not keep her waiting!
entries.zh: 布丽吉特正在安全大厅等你，可别让她等太久！
嘿，冒险者！

entries.en: You look like someone who values fashion as much as fighting!
entries.zh: 看样子，你和我一样，既重视战斗，也讲究时尚！

entries.en: Want to stand out while you slash and dash?
entries.zh: 想在挥剑冲锋时也能脱颖而出吗？
来看看我这里的外观商品吧！

entries.en: The Hex will not see you now.
entries.zh: 魔咒台现在不愿见你。

entries.en: The Hex does not wish to be tainted with useless items.
entries.zh: 魔咒台不愿被无用物品玷污。

entries.en: The Hex does not have time for you.
entries.zh: 魔咒台没空理你。

entries.en: The Hex is troubled by your presence.
entries.zh: 魔咒台因你的出现而感到不安。

entries.en: Welcome to the Fairy Pond, %1$s! I am Tia.
entries.zh: 欢迎来到仙女池塘，%1$s! 我是蒂娅。

entries.en: You may have noticed some strange orbs laying around the island.
entries.zh: 你也许注意到了，岛上散落着一些奇怪的光球。

entries.en: They are the souls of my fallen sisters.
entries.zh: 那是我逝去的姐妹们的灵魂。

entries.en: If you find any more during your travels, please bring them back to me!
entries.zh: 旅途中要是再找到，请把它们带回来给我！
✆ 你有阿比手机啦！
✆ 太酷了！

entries.en: ✆ Did you know the fairies helped the mages build the Abiphone's 9f™ network?
entries.zh: ✆ 你知道吗？阿比手机的 9f™ 网络，是我们仙女帮法师们一起建的。

entries.en: ✆ But since so many of us are now missing, we're behind on maintenance!
entries.zh: ✆ 可我们失踪了太多姐妹，维护工作早就落下了！

entries.en: ✆ Come back wearing Fairy Armor and I can add a 9f™ Operator Chip to your Abiphone so you can help us out!
entries.zh: ✆ 穿上仙女盔甲再来，我就能给你的阿比手机装上 9f™ 运营商芯片，你就能帮上忙了！
✆ 制服真好看！

entries.en: ✆ Okay I added 9f™ Operator Chip to your Abiphone plan.
entries.zh: ✆ 好了，我把 9f™ 运营商芯片加进你的阿比手机套餐了。

entries.en: ✆ It will work on any Abiphone as long as I'm in your contacts list.
entries.zh: ✆ 只要我还在你的通讯录里，它在任何阿比手机上都能用。

entries.en: ✆ We need to upgrade all of the 9f™ Network Relays spread across SkyBlock.
entries.zh: ✆ 我们得把分布在空岛各处的 9f™ 网络中继全部升级一遍。

entries.en: ✆ Call me and I can tell you where the first relay is!
entries.zh: ✆ 打给我，我告诉你第一个中继在哪儿！

entries.en: ✆ You need more contacts before you can deal with the next relay!
entries.zh: ✆ 你的联系人还不够多，还处理不了下一个中继！
✆ 别问我为什么……
✆ 规矩又不是我定的！

entries.en: ✆ Hey! It's you! On the Abiphone!!!
entries.zh: ✆ 嘿！是你！打的是阿比手机！!!

entries.en: ✆ The first relay is on a branch of the large tree on the north-east of the fairy pond.
entries.zh: ✆ 第一个中继在仙女池塘东北边那棵大树的树枝上。

entries.en: ✆ Make sure to wear Fairy Armor!
entries.zh: ✆ 记得穿上仙女盔甲！

entries.en: ✆ I don't personally know what the maintenance procedure is, but I'm sure you can figure it out!
entries.zh: ✆ 维护流程我自己也不清楚，但我相信你能琢磨出来！

entries.en: ✆ Wow, you figured out the maintenance plan!
entries.zh: ✆ 哇，你把维护方案搞明白了！
✆ 真聪明！

entries.en: ✆ The next relay is in the castle ruins!
entries.zh: ✆ 下一个中继在城堡废墟里！

entries.en: ✆ The next relay is in the Royal Palace within the Dwarven Mines.
entries.zh: ✆ 下一个中继在矮人矿洞的皇家宫殿里。

entries.en: ✆ It's in a very high place to reverb the signal for the royal council.
entries.zh: ✆ 它装在很高的地方，好把信号传给王室议会。

entries.en: ✆ Although I don't think technology can help with their communication problems...
entries.zh: ✆ 不过我觉得，他们之间的沟通问题，科技也帮不上忙……

entries.en: ✆ The next relay is on the highest spike of The End.
entries.zh: ✆ 下一个中继在末地最高的那根尖塔上。

entries.en: ✆ It's on the face which looks at the moon rising.
entries.zh: ✆ 在朝着月亮升起的那一面。

entries.en: ✆ Or the sun! If you're that kind of person...
entries.zh: ✆ 或者说朝着太阳！如果你是那种人的话……

entries.en: ✆ The next relay was placed by our consultant, Odger.
entries.zh: ✆ 下一个中继是我们的顾问奥杰装的。

entries.en: ✆ He said "Travel too far home. Bye." after installing it and never called again.
entries.zh: ✆ 他装完只说了句“回家路太远。拜。”,之后再没打过电话。

entries.en: ✆ Maybe he can tell you where he put the relay?
entries.zh: ✆ 说不定他能告诉你中继装在哪儿？

entries.en: ✆ Scarleton itself has one of the most robust connection to the 9f™ Network.
entries.zh: ✆ 绯红城本身就是 9f™ 网络信号最强的地方之一。

entries.en: ✆ If you face the cathedral, there is a relay at the top of the left tower.
entries.zh: ✆ 面朝大教堂，左边塔楼的顶上就有一个中继。

entries.en: ✆ The next relay is on top of the shack next to the shady inn right here close to the pond.
entries.zh: ✆ 下一个中继就在池塘附近那家可疑小旅馆旁边的小屋顶上。

entries.en: ✆ Usually we wouldn't have a relay serve so few people, but we were paid generously by anonymous contributors!
entries.zh: ✆ 平时我们不会为这么少的人专门架一个中继，不过有匿名人士出手阔绰！

entries.en: ✆ So generously in fact that we also share some of the data from the 9f™ Network with one of the mayor candidates.
entries.zh: ✆ 阔绰到我们还把 9f™ 网络的一部分数据分享给了某位市长候选人。

entries.en: ✆ But hey, let's keep this between us!
entries.zh: ✆ 不过嘿，这事你知我知就行！

entries.en: ✆ They'll know if you tell anyone.
entries.zh: ✆ 你要是说出去，他们会知道的。

entries.en: ✆ The next relay is on top of a statue in the dungeon hub.
entries.zh: ✆ 下一个中继在地牢大厅的一座雕像顶上。

entries.en: ✆ The one that doesn't have a fairy soul...
entries.zh: ✆ 就是没有仙女之魂的那座……

entries.en: ✆ The next relay is on top of the Auction House.
entries.zh: ✆ 下一个中继在拍卖行的屋顶上。

entries.en: ✆ It offers service to the whole village!
entries.zh: ✆ 整个村庄的信号都靠它！

entries.en: ✆ Why is the tooth fairy so smart?
entries.zh: ✆ 为什么牙仙那么聪明？
✆ 因为她有智齿！

entries.en: The second island of Galatea - Torrhus Canyon, is here!
entries.zh: 加拉蒂亚的第二座岛屿 - 托鲁斯峡谷已经开放！

entries.en: Between Miria’s Contests, the Critter Safari, Torrhus Sea Creatures, and the new Collections, there's so much to do!
entries.zh: 无论是米莉亚的竞赛、小动物游猎场、托鲁斯海洋生物还是全新的收集，都有太多内容可以体验了！

entries.en: If you want to check it out for yourself, you can access it from the Launch Pad over in the Moonglade Marsh.
entries.zh: 想亲自去看看，可以通过发射台，它位于月光沼泽。
祝你狩猎愉快！

entries.en: I saw it on the horizon this morning and made my way over.
entries.zh: 我今早在地平线上看到了它，于是便赶了过来。
魔法可是很危险的。

entries.en: One second everything is fine and the next, the world is ending.
entries.zh: 上一秒还好好的，下一秒世界就要毁灭了。

entries.en: I was playing with a Sculk Catalyst in a different world from the future...
entries.zh: 我之前在一个来自未来的异世界里，摆弄了下幽匿催发体……

entries.en: And the sculk spread all over my body!
entries.zh: 结果幽匿爬满了我全身！
就连阿拉塔那么厉害的巫师……
也在某一天突然消失了！
噗！

entries.en: I'm working on a masterpiece currently. Want to take a look?
entries.zh: 我正在创作一件杰作。想看看吗？

entries.en: This piece is really starting to shape up.
entries.zh: 这幅画终于有点样子了。

entries.en: You'll need some strong weapons to survive out in the wild! Lucky for you, I've got some!
entries.zh: 想在野外生存，你需要强力的武器！算你走运，我这里正好有！

entries.en: Click me again to open the Weaponsmith Shop!
entries.zh: 再点我一次，就能打开武器匠商店！

entries.en: If wool shrinks when you wash it...
entries.zh: 如果羊毛洗过会缩水……

entries.en: Have you ever wanted to change fate?
entries.zh: 你是否曾想过改变命运？

entries.en: Unsay something you shouldn't've, undo a mistake you've made?
entries.zh: 收回不该说的话，或是撤销犯下的错误？

entries.en: Well, I can't help you do any of that, but I can increase the amount of Coins paid on Midas weapons so you can harness their maximum  Damage bonus.
entries.zh: 那些事我帮不了你，不过我可以让 Midas 武器发挥出最高的  伤害加成，只需增加你为它支付的硬币数额。

entries.en: And really, isn't that practically the next-best thing?
entries.zh: 说真的，这不就是退而求其次的最佳选择吗？

entries.en: Hello! Have you heard of pet items?
entries.zh: 你好！你听说过宠物道具吗？

entries.en: Pet items give your companions bonuses!
entries.zh: 宠物道具能为你的伙伴提供加成！

entries.en: I sell all kinds of them if you'd like to try one out!
entries.zh: 我这里各式各样的都有，想试试的话就来买吧！

entries.en: ✆ You know %1$s, I'm a pet lover.
entries.zh: ✆ 你知道吗 %1$s,我是个宠物迷。

entries.en: ✆ So my abiphone contacts list is FILLED with TONS of other pet lovers.
entries.zh: ✆ 所以我的阿比手机通讯录里塞满了一大堆宠物迷。

entries.en: ✆ I don't want to sound too gamey but...
entries.zh: ✆ 我不想显得太像在打游戏，不过……

entries.en: ✆ If you had 5 Max Lvl pets of Legendary tier or better in your pet menu...
entries.zh: ✆ 要是你的宠物菜单里有 5 只满级的传说或更高稀有度的宠物……

entries.en: ✆ That would show me you're a pet lover too!
entries.zh: ✆ 那就说明你也是个宠物迷！

entries.en: ✆ Wow, you're a true pet lover!
entries.zh: ✆ 哇，你是货真价实的宠物迷！

entries.en: ✆ You doubled my HUGE contacts list too!
entries.zh: ✆ 你还让我那“庞大”的通讯录翻了一倍！

entries.en: ✆ Now there's both Kat AND you!
entries.zh: ✆ 现在里面有凯特，还有你了！

entries.en: Bah! Come forth my minions! Fly above, take them out!
entries.zh: 哼！出来吧，我的仆从们！飞上去，干掉他们！

entries.en: Grrrr! You won't be able to hit my Fire Bats!
entries.zh: 哼哼！你打不到我的火焰蝙蝠！
啊啊啊啊啊啊！

entries.en: You're a long way from home!
entries.zh: 你在离家很远的地方啊！

entries.en: Luckily your coins are safe with me! Store them here before venturing deep into the depths of the Dwarven Mines!
entries.zh: 幸运的是，你的硬币在我这儿很安全！深入矮人矿洞之前，先把它们存在这里吧！

entries.en: Standing in that bank all day. Just me and the dwarves. But they are either all business, or drunk. Or both! I need better company!
entries.zh: 整天站在银行里。只有我和这些矮人。可他们不是在忙生意，就是喝得醉醺醺的。有时候两样都占！我需要更好的伙伴！

entries.en: Oh what a lovely specimen this is. I wonder, how should I name you?
entries.zh: 哦，多可爱的一个家伙啊。我该给你取个什么名字呢？

entries.en: Well, maybe I will be able to understand the burping dwarves if I try hard enough.
entries.zh: 唉，也许只要我够努力，总有一天能听懂这些打嗝的矮人在说什么吧。

entries.en: I just had a very very strange dream...
entries.zh: 我刚做了一个非常非常奇怪的梦……

entries.en: In my dream I flew out of my body, went through some kind of screen barrier.
entries.zh: 在梦里，我飞出了自己的身体，穿过了某种像屏幕一样的屏障。

entries.en: I turned and I could see myself standing behind that screen, right here.
entries.zh: 我转过身，看见自己就站在那道屏幕后面，就站在这里。

entries.en: Around me were strange objects everywhere, but the strangest part was the giant.
entries.zh: 我周围到处都是奇怪的东西，但最奇怪的是那个巨人。

entries.en: A Giant! Sitting in front of that screen, watching me.
entries.zh: 一个巨人！他就坐在那道屏幕前面，盯着我看。

entries.en: The giant seemed to speak a foreign language, they screamed "POGGERS!"
entries.zh: 那巨人好像说的是外语，他大喊了一声“POGGERS!”

entries.en: Then I woke up in a sweat.
entries.zh: 然后我就一身冷汗地醒了。

entries.en: I'm really upside down, I need time to think.
entries.zh: 我整个人都乱了，我需要点时间想想。
谢谢你听我说这些。

entries.en: I had another nightmare, very similar to the previous one.
entries.zh: 我又做了个噩梦，和上次那个很像。

entries.en: I could see myself behind the screen again, it looked like I was talking.
entries.zh: 我又看见自己站在那道屏幕后面，看样子是在说话。

entries.en: I couldn't hear it, but the words appeared on the screen.
entries.zh: 我听不见声音，但那些话会显示在屏幕上。

entries.en: The exact words I told you last time.
entries.zh: 一字不差，就是我上次讲给你听的那些话。

entries.en: So weird, so weird.... I need time to think.
entries.zh: 太怪了，太怪了……我需要点时间想想。

entries.en: Once again, I had the same recurring nightmare, a little different this time.
entries.zh: 我又做了同一个反复出现的噩梦，不过这次有点不一样。

entries.en: I was talking behind the screen again, I mentioned a treasure.
entries.zh: 我又在屏幕后面说话，还提到了一件宝藏。

entries.en: I knew the location of a treasure right right close to a giant Dwarf Statue.
entries.zh: 我知道有件宝藏就在一座巨大的矮人雕像旁边。

entries.en: Buried in loose rocks next to a bridge I said.
entries.zh: 我说它埋在一座桥边的碎石堆里。

entries.en: But it makes no sense, I've never even heard of such a treasure!!
entries.zh: 可这说不通啊，我压根就没听说过有这么件宝藏！!

entries.en: Dwarf Statue, bridge,, loose rocks, treasure...? What a strange dream...
entries.zh: 矮人雕像、桥、碎石堆、宝藏……?真是个奇怪的梦……

entries.en: The dreams stopped, it'll forever remain a mystery.
entries.zh: 那些梦不做了，这事儿怕是永远都是个谜了。

entries.en: Last night I had another horrible nightmare. I'm afraid to fall asleep again.
entries.zh: 昨晚我又做了个可怕的噩梦。我都不敢再睡了。

entries.en: Thank you. I'll make a strong brew from this that'll keep me awake all night.
entries.zh: 谢谢你。我拿这个煮一壶浓的，今晚就能整宿不睡了。

entries.en: Tough love, but maybe you're right. They're only nightmares, right? Not real. Heh.
entries.zh: 话是狠了点，不过也许你说得对。不就是噩梦嘛，对吧？又不是真的。嘿。

entries.en: I wonder if I'll have that nightmare again tonight...
entries.zh: 不知道今晚会不会又做那个噩梦……
哇，那个梦可真怪。

entries.en: I'm still thinking about that dream I had.
entries.zh: 我还在想我做的那个梦。
这是什么？一壶饮子？
我得把这个喝了？
好吧，我信你。
咕咚

entries.en: Meh, I doubt this will do anything...
entries.zh: 唉，我看这玩意儿也起不了什么作用……
我的天，这也太难喝了！!!
那这有什么意义啊！!!!

entries.en: I guess it was rhetorical, uh?
entries.zh: 我猜这是反问句，是吧？

entries.en: I REALLY CAN'T SLEEP AT ALL!!!!
entries.zh: 我是真的一点都睡不着了！!!!
这太棒了！!!!
再也不做噩梦了！!!!
来，这个给你！!!!

entries.en: That drink you gave me the other day...
entries.zh: 你那天给我的那杯饮子……

entries.en: It was amazing! I couldn't have nightmares that night!
entries.zh: 太神了！那一晚我一个噩梦都没做！

entries.en: You should give me another and visit in the morning!
entries.zh: 你该再给我一杯，然后早上再来看看我！
我说话是不是太大声了？?!!

entries.en: I HAD NO IDEA I COULD JUST STAY AWAKE, IT'S GENIUS!!!
entries.zh: 我以前完全不知道人可以干脆不睡，这简直是天才！!!

entries.en: WHY SLEEP WHEN YOU CAN JUST STAY AWAKE FOREVER!!!!
entries.zh: 能一直醒着，干嘛还要睡觉！!!!

entries.en: I'm the town Blacksmith! I can reforge items for you, for a price.
entries.zh: 我是镇上的铁匠！我可以帮你重铸物品，当然要收费。

entries.en: Reforging usually costs Coins, but since I'm feeling friendly I can reforge your first item for 10 Coal.
entries.zh: 重铸通常要花硬币，不过我今天心情好，你的第一件物品只收 10 个煤炭。

entries.en: Go into the Mine to collect Coal and return to learn how to reforge items!
entries.zh: 去矿里挖点煤炭，回来我教你怎么重铸物品！
啊，太好了！

entries.en: Reforging items allows you to get the most out of your weapons, armor, and other items by applying stat modifiers to them!
entries.zh: 重铸物品可以通过附加属性修正，让你的武器、护甲和其他物品发挥出最大效果！

entries.en: To reforge an item, place an item in my inventory. Reforging costs Coins - the more prestigious items cost more to reforge!
entries.zh: 要重铸物品，把它放进我的物品栏就行。重铸要花硬币——越贵重的物品，重铸费越高！

entries.en: However, this time I will reforge any item for the low price of 10 Coal!
entries.zh: 不过这一次，任何物品我都只收 10 个煤炭的低价帮你重铸！

entries.en: Mine some more Coal in the Mine!
entries.zh: 再去矿里多挖点煤炭吧！

entries.en: I will teach you how to reforge items once you mine some more Coal!
entries.zh: 等你再挖点煤炭回来，我就教你怎么重铸物品！

entries.en: Reach Mining Level I to gain access to the Gold Mine, north of the Coal Mine.
entries.zh: 达到挖矿等级 1,就能进入煤矿以北的金矿了。

entries.en: The Gold Mine is more dangerous than the Coal Mine, but it has better ores and treasures!
entries.zh: 金矿比煤矿危险，但那里的矿石和宝藏也更好！

entries.en: Travel to the Gold Mine to spelunk for better ores, including iron and gold!
entries.zh: 去金矿探索吧，那里有更好的矿石，包括铁和金子！

entries.en: It costs coins based on rarity, though your first reforge only costs %1$s Coal if you've completed the mining quest.
entries.zh: 费用会根据稀有度而定，不过如果你完成了挖矿任务，第一次重铸只需要%1$s个煤炭。
不不不，没门。
嗯……其实嘛……
不行，不行，绝对不行。

entries.en: Unless? Hmm, lemme think about it.
entries.zh: 除非……嗯，让我想想。

entries.en: No for sure, for sure. That would be too much.
entries.zh: 不行，肯定不行。那也太过分了。

entries.en: But maybe... If you do something for me.
entries.zh: 不过也许……你要是能帮我一件事。

entries.en: I owe a lot of money to someone... Someone important.
entries.zh: 我欠了一个人很多钱……一个很有分量的人。

entries.en: Don't ask me how I got into this situation.
entries.zh: 别问我怎么落到这步田地的。
我欠了对方 %1$s 硬币。

entries.en: If you help me, I'll allow you to use my services from anywhere.
entries.zh: 你要是帮了我，以后不管在哪儿都能找我办事。
你真是我的救命恩人。

entries.en: I swear I wont get in that trouble again!
entries.zh: 我发誓，再也不惹上这种麻烦了！
[偿还债务]

entries.en: ♪ When the calling of riches gets louder ♪
entries.zh: ♪ 当财富的呼唤越来越响 ♪

entries.en: ♪ And ye hunger for Mithril Powder ♪
entries.zh: ♪ 你又馋起了秘银粉末 ♪

entries.en: ♪ Go talk to the Station Master ♪
entries.zh: ♪ 那就去找站长聊一聊 ♪

entries.en: ♪ Take yer rod to the Quarry 'n cast her ♪
entries.zh: ♪ 扛上钓鱼竿去采石场下钩 ♪
♪ 再一遍又一遍把它们宰掉 ♪
♪ 哟嗬，哟嗬 ♪

entries.en: ♪ To the Abandoned Quarry you go! ♪
entries.zh: ♪ 你要去的正是废弃采石场！ ♪
那个宏伟计划。
我才没有。

entries.en: Try not to break those too.
entries.zh: 这些你可别也给我打碎了。

entries.en: I don't think that would work.
entries.zh: 我觉得那样行不通。

entries.en: I'm not really available then, couple coworkers are off so the boss wants me in to cover.
entries.zh: 我那天不太方便，有几个同事休假，老板要我去顶班。

entries.en: You are right. I shall be there.
entries.zh: 你说得对。我会到场的。
猫又跑了？
糟了。

entries.en: We? I didn't get a single bite either.
entries.zh: 我们？我可是一口都没吃到。

entries.en: Might be three in a minute.
entries.zh: 再过一会儿说不定就是三个了。

entries.en: You can pay for the pizza.
entries.zh: 那披萨你请。
又来了，松丁？
哦。那可不妙。

entries.en: And why do I suspect it will be entirely unimportant?
entries.zh: 那我怎么总觉得，这事儿一点都不重要呢？
果然如此。

entries.en: And how did you reach that conclusion?
entries.zh: 那你是怎么得出这个结论的？

entries.en: But not many civilizations outside of us dwarves use minecarts, Thondin.
entries.zh: 可除了我们矮人之外，用矿车的文明并不多，松丁。

entries.en: And why are you so certain that minecarts have wheels?
entries.zh: 那你又凭什么这么确定矿车有轮子？

entries.en: By definition, a wheel must be circular. Those "wheels" are blocky, and I've never actually seen them turn.
entries.zh: 按定义，轮子必须是圆的。那些「轮子」是方的，而且我从没见它们转过。

entries.en: How can you be so sure?
entries.zh: 你凭什么这么肯定？

entries.en: Have you ever seen one turn?
entries.zh: 你见过哪一辆真的动起来吗？

entries.en: The same is true for me.
entries.zh: 我也一样。

entries.en: Unlikely. There's no way to prove we're living in a simulation.
entries.zh: 不太可能。没有任何办法能证明我们活在模拟里。
好。

entries.en: Firstly, we discovered that the wheels on minecarts are solely for show, and that minecarts cannot actually move.
entries.zh: 首先，我们发现矿车上的轮子纯粹是装饰，矿车根本动不了。

entries.en: Next, Thondin made the realization that food actually has no taste or texture, though we are inclined to eat it.
entries.zh: 其次，松丁意识到食物其实既没有味道也没有口感，可我们还是忍不住要吃。

entries.en: Then, we realized that fallen stars always land at the same few spots. Mathematically unlikely, to put it lightly.
entries.zh: 接着，我们发现陨星总是落在那固定的几个地点。往轻了说，这在数学上也太不可能了。

entries.en: After which, we noted that the same things always happen at the same time, each day.
entries.zh: 再之后，我们注意到每天的同一时刻，总会发生同样的事。

entries.en: Indeed. It seems almost as if everyone here is living the same day, again and again.
entries.zh: 的确。简直就像这里所有人都在一遍又一遍地过着同一天。

entries.en: Indeed. With this in mind, only one logical conclusion can be reached.
entries.zh: 的确。这样一想，只能得出唯一一个合乎逻辑的结论。

entries.en: We... are living in a XsimulationX.
entries.zh: 我们……活在一个 X 模拟 X 里。

entries.en: It is unfortunate. Though we are certain of it, there's simply nothing we can do.
entries.zh: 这很不幸。虽然我们已经确信无疑，却什么也做不了。

entries.en: The moment all of the "players" leave the game, we shall cease to exist until they return.
entries.zh: 只要所有「玩家」一离开游戏，我们就会不复存在，直到他们回来为止。

entries.en: Or do we merely feign consciousness? Perhaps we are nothing more than the simulation experiencing itself.
entries.zh: 又或者我们只是假装有意识？也许我们不过是模拟在体验它自己罢了。

entries.en: Yes, I suppose we should go for the blue. It feels... familiar. Have we had it before?
entries.zh: 嗯，还是点蓝的吧。感觉……有点熟悉。我们以前吃过吗？
欢迎光临酒馆！

entries.en: We're known best for our Powder Pie!
entries.zh: 我们这儿最出名的就是粉末派！
祝你玩得尽兴！

entries.en: ✆ Eh? My Contact? On my phone?
entries.zh: ✆ 嗯？我的联系方式？手机上那个？

entries.en: ✆ I s'pose you could have it, if you can help me out first.
entries.zh: ✆ 给你也行，不过你得先帮我个忙。

entries.en: ✆ One night, one of my regulars got a bit rowdy and took off towards the Abandoned Quarry.
entries.zh: ✆ 有天晚上，我一位老主顾闹腾起来，一路跑去了废弃采石场。

entries.en: ✆ He was carrying my most beloved antique - my Speckled Teacup.
entries.zh: ✆ 他手里还拿着我最心爱的古董——我那只斑点茶杯。

entries.en: ✆ By the time I caught up with him, he had already gone and DROPPED IT into the quarry's lake!
entries.zh: ✆ 等我追上他时，他已经把它丢进采石场的湖里了！

entries.en: ✆ I fished about for a while, but didn't find nothin' apart from a bunch of grubbers.
entries.zh: ✆ 我在那儿钓了好一阵子，除了一堆掘虫，什么也没钓着。

entries.en: ✆ If you ever have the time, could you go to the Abandoned Quarry and fish around for my Speckled Teacup?
entries.zh: ✆ 你要是哪天有空，能不能去废弃采石场试着钓回我的斑点茶杯？

entries.en: ✆ If you manage to find it, bring it back here and I'll be happy to give you my contact.
entries.zh: ✆ 你要是能找到它，拿回来给我，我很乐意把联系方式给你。

entries.en: ✆ You don't have my beloved Speckled Teacup...
entries.zh: ✆ 你手上没有我那只心爱的斑点茶杯……

entries.en: ✆ You found it! My Speckled Teacup! How amazing!
entries.zh: ✆ 你找到了！我的斑点茶杯！太了不起了！

entries.en: ✆ Lesson learned, I'm never letting anyone borrow it ever again - even my regulars!
entries.zh: ✆ 这回我算是长记性了，以后谁也别想再借走它——老主顾也不行！

entries.en: ✆ Thanks for the help, here's my contact.
entries.zh: ✆ 谢谢你帮忙，这是我的联系方式。
✆ 老样子？

entries.en: Select an option: [How can I help?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [我能帮什么忙？]
请选择: [交出物品]

entries.en: It's definitely still floating about in the waters of the Abandoned Quarry somewhere...
entries.zh: 它肯定还在废弃采石场的水里哪儿漂着呢……

entries.en: ✆ %1$s has neem added to your Abiphone's contacts!
entries.zh: ✆ %1$s 已加入你的阿比手机联系人列表！

entries.en: You'll be needing some stronger pickaxes to mine down here!
entries.zh: 在这下面挖矿，你需要更强力的镐子！

entries.en: Conveniently for you, I've got just what you need!
entries.zh: 算你走运，我这儿正好有你需要的东西！

entries.en: Ever thought you'd see a Tier 12 Minion?
entries.zh: 你想过能亲眼见到 12 级小人吗？
那今天算你走运了！

entries.en: Hmm? My Abiphone Contact? Well, today might just be your lucky day - again. Abiphones ain't much use down here - you'll seldom get a signal, but I do own one. Seeing as I'm feeling nice, I'll give you my contact for the small sum of one Silex. How about it?
entries.zh: 嗯？我的阿比手机联系人？看来今天又是你走运的一天。在这下面阿比手机基本没什么用——你很少能收到信号，不过我确实有一台。既然我今天心情不错，只要一块燧晶，我就把联系方式给你。怎么样？

entries.en: I don't know what ya think that is, but it's not a Silex. Come back once you've got yourself one.
entries.zh: 我不知道你以为那是什么，但那可不是燧晶。等你弄到一块再回来找我吧。

entries.en: That'll do it! Cheers friend, once I got that on my Drill I'll be mining like Divan! Oh, and before I forget - here's that contact you were asking for. Give me a call in case you ever need some Tier XII Mining Minions.
entries.zh: 就是这个！谢啦朋友，把这个装到我的钻头上，我挖矿的水平就能跟迪万有得一拼了！哦对了，差点忘了——这是你要的联系方式。要是哪天需要 12 级挖矿小人，尽管给我打电话。

entries.en: According to the legends, this bridge is very big.
entries.zh: 传说里说，这座桥非常大。
他们人都挺不错！
庆祝的时候用得上

entries.en: You look like maybe you need a new torch? Something bigger, perhaps? A lantern maybe?
entries.zh: 你看起来也许需要一支新火把？或者大一点的？灯笼怎么样？

entries.en: This guy isn't the sharpest hammer in the smithy!
entries.zh: 这家伙可不是最聪明的那个！

entries.en: Last week they promoted me from guarding the exit to guarding the entrance! Still the same spot but I gladly take that promotion!
entries.zh: 上周他们把我从守出口提拔到守入口了！虽说还是站在同一个地方，但这升职我照单全收！
我守卫着整个王国。

entries.en: I'm guarding the guard on the other side.
entries.zh: 我守卫着对面的那个守卫。

entries.en: I, Murdohr, son of Murdohr the Third, Commander of the Phoenix Forge, and Warden of the Holy Pickaxe, am guarding this wall.
entries.zh: 我，默多尔，默多尔三世之子，凤凰锻造厂的统帅，圣镐的守护者，正在守卫这堵墙。
我是个守卫。
我什么都没在守卫。
我在守卫熔岩。

entries.en: Last week they promoted me from guarding the exit to guarding the entrance! Still...
entries.zh: 上周他们把我从看守出口“提拔”成了看守入口！说到底……

entries.en: I, Murdohr, son of Murdohr the Third, Commander of the Phoenix Forge, and...
entries.zh: 我，穆多尔，穆多尔三世之子，凤凰锻炉的指挥官，以及……
这不是什么大问题。

entries.en: I have a big issue to get rid of.
entries.zh: 我有个大麻烦要处理掉。
这样就行了。

entries.en: I guess I'll have to turn up empty-handed.
entries.zh: 看来我只能空着手回去了。

entries.en: I've figured out exactly how this Cold stuff works!
entries.zh: 寒冷这回事，我已经研究得明明白白了！这寒冷机制可难不倒我！

entries.en: For every 1  Cold Resistance you have, Cold builds up 1% slower.
entries.zh: 每有 1 ❄ 寒冷抵抗，寒冷的积累速度就会降低 1%。

entries.en: So, if you have 100  Cold Resistance, Cold will take 2x as long to build up!
entries.zh: 所以，只要有 100 ❄ 寒冷抵抗，寒冷积累同样数值所需的时间就会延长到 2 倍！

entries.en: You can get  Cold Resistance from some Heart of the Mountain perks, and from certain items.
entries.zh: 想获得 ❄ 寒冷抵抗，可以点一些山之心天赋，也可以靠特定物品。

entries.en: Your  Mining Speed is reduced by 0.5% for every Cold you have.
entries.zh: 每积累 1 点寒冷，你的 ⸕ 挖掘速度就会降低 0.5%。

entries.en: The formula is: (Current Cold -  Cold Resistance ) / 2 = Mining Speed Penalty
entries.zh: 公式是: (当前寒冷值 - ❄ 寒冷抵抗) / 2 = 挖掘速度减益

entries.en: So, if you have 70 Cold and 55  Cold Resistance, your  Mining Speed will be reduced by 7.5%.
entries.zh: 举个例子，你有 70 点寒冷和 55 ❄ 寒冷抵抗时，⸕ 挖掘速度就会降低 7.5%。

entries.en: If your  Cold Resistance is greater than the amount of Cold you have, you won't receive a  Mining Speed reduction!
entries.zh: 要是你的 ❄ 寒冷抵抗高于当前寒冷值，就不会受到 ⸕ 挖掘速度减益！

entries.en: Since 99 Cold is the most you can have before dying, a  Cold Resistance stat of 99 or more will be enough to ensure you never receive a Mining Speed Penalty.
entries.zh: 你最多只能扛到 99 点寒冷，再高就会冻死。所以只要 ❄ 寒冷抵抗达到 99 或以上，就再也不会受到挖掘速度减益。

entries.en: Every 25 Cold, your speed cap will be reduced by 25%.
entries.zh: 每积累 25 点寒冷，移动速度上限就会降低 25%。

entries.en: By the time you're at 75 Cold, you'll be moving at a snail's pace...
entries.zh: 等你攒到 75 点寒冷，走起路来就跟蜗牛一样慢了……

entries.en: If you want to keep moving, keep warm!
entries.zh: 想跑得动，就得先暖起来！

entries.en: Have you heard of the Cult of the Fallen Star?
entries.zh: 你听说过陨落之星教团吗？

entries.en: I've never seen any members myself but I heard they were growing in numbers.
entries.zh: 我自己从没见过什么成员，但听说他们的人数正在增长。

entries.en: Not sure what the point of their cult is, but it worries me a bit.
entries.zh: 我不太清楚他们这个教团到底图什么，但这让我有点担心。

entries.en: They sometimes show up near the Fallen Star at night, as far as I know.
entries.zh: 据我所知，他们有时会在夜里出现在陨落之星附近。

entries.en: I saw some weird guy in a mask go into a tiny hole inside the Dwarven Mines, maybe he's part of the Cult of the Fallen Star?
entries.zh: 我看见一个戴面具的怪人钻进了矮人矿洞里的一个小洞，他会不会是“陨落之星教团”的人？

entries.en: These guys... are scaring me. I'm not quite sure what they are planning in there, but I'd also rather not want to know.
entries.zh: 这些家伙……真让我害怕。我不太清楚他们在里面策划什么，但我其实也不想知道。
哇哦，你找到我们了！

entries.en: Are you trying to stop us from doing our suspicious activities?
entries.zh: 你是想阻止我们进行「可疑活动」吗？

entries.en: We are the Cult of the Fallen Star, we mean no harm.
entries.zh: 我们是陨落之星教团，我们没有恶意。

entries.en: To be honest, we just want to look cool.
entries.zh: 老实说，我们只是想显得酷一点。
想加入我们吗？
很好！来，拿着这个。

entries.en: It's one of our Fallen Star Helmets.
entries.zh: 这是我们的陨落之星头盔之一。

entries.en: Wear it in our next meetings!
entries.zh: 下次例会记得戴上它！
真没礼貌。

entries.en: Eager to join our cult I see?
entries.zh: 看来你很想加入我们的教团？

entries.en: Come back to our next meeting in seven days while wearing the Fallen Star Helmet we gave you.
entries.zh: 过七天后，戴上我们给你的坠星头盔，再来参加下一次例会。

entries.en: Hey, %1$s! Glad you came to our cult meeting!
entries.zh: 嘿，%1$s! 很高兴你来参加教团例会！

entries.en: Here, have some of these cool looking stars we found.
entries.zh: 来，这些我们捡到的星星挺好看的，拿一点去。
等等……

entries.en: Where's the Fallen Star Helmet we gave you?
entries.zh: 我们给你的坠星头盔呢？

entries.en: You need it to join us!
entries.zh: 你得戴着它才能加入我们！

entries.en: Come back next time wearing our matching hat.
entries.zh: 下次戴上我们的同款帽子再来。

entries.en: We'll share some of our cool stars with you.
entries.zh: 我们会分你一些捡到的好看星星。

entries.en: Wanna get pizza after this cult meeting?
entries.zh: 这场教团例会结束后要不要一起去吃披萨？

entries.en: We meet here every seven days at midnight. That's when the star is the brightest, after all.
entries.zh: 我们每七天在午夜于此聚会。毕竟那时候星星最亮。

entries.en: We hope you love the Fallen Star as much as we do.
entries.zh: 希望你也和我们一样喜欢陨落之星。
你能来真是太好了，%1$s。

entries.en: I wonder why the star is purple.
entries.zh: 我一直好奇那颗星星为什么是紫色的。
嘿，头盔不错。
咱们几个看着都挺酷的。

entries.en: Ah, %1$s! Nice to see you at our cult meeting!
entries.zh: 啊，%1$s! 很高兴在教团例会上见到你！

entries.en: You've now attended 1 meeting of the Cult of the Fallen Star! As a reward, here's some Starfall!
entries.zh: 你已经参加了 1 次陨落之星教团的例会！作为奖励，这些星落给你！

entries.en: Attend two more and I'll give you my Abiphone Contact.
entries.zh: 再参加两次，我就把我的阿比手机联系人给你。

entries.en: Now, time for the meeting to begin!
entries.zh: 好了，例会正式开始！

entries.en: Alright, where did we finish off last time?
entries.zh: 那么，我们上次说到哪儿了？

entries.en: Right, the master plan. Thondin, care to update us?
entries.zh: 对了，那个宏伟计划。松丁，你来给大家讲讲进展？

entries.en: Break anything? It wasn't me, it was Brarnas! And, honestly, who stores plates like that anyways?
entries.zh: 打碎东西？那可不是我，是布拉纳斯！而且说真的，谁会那样摆盘子啊？

entries.en: They're just asking to be knocked over. Why not just put them in a drawer, out of the way?
entries.zh: 那不就是等着被碰倒吗。干嘛不收进抽屉里放好？

entries.en: You don't need to display them. Everyone has plates, they're nothing special.
entries.zh: 又不用摆出来展示。谁家没有盘子，又不是什么稀罕东西。

entries.en: And I didn't! But Brarnas told me about it.
entries.zh: 我确实没看见！不过是布拉纳斯跟我说的。
总之！

entries.en: My wife said I'm free to come to the sleepover if I do the dishes first.
entries.zh: 我老婆说了，只要我先把碗洗了，就可以去过夜。

entries.en: Yeah, it doesn't really align with our cult's theme. How about the fourteenth instead?
entries.zh: 是啊，那个日子和我们教团的主题不太搭。改成十四号怎么样？

entries.en: Well, you should probably make yourself available.
entries.zh: 那你最好还是把时间腾出来。
好，下一项议题……
又来？

entries.en: Alright, I guess we can end the meeting there. Same time next week!
entries.zh: 行吧，今天的例会就到这儿。下周同一时间见！

entries.en: You've now attended 2 meetings of the Cult of the Fallen Star! As a reward, here's some Starfall!
entries.zh: 你已经参加了 2 次陨落之星教团的例会！作为奖励，这些星落给你！

entries.en: Attend one more and I'll give you my Abiphone Contact.
entries.zh: 再参加一次，我就把我的阿比手机联系人给你。
怎么了？
我们当时饿了嘛。
你这话可帮不上忙。

entries.en: Okay, okay, I get it. The next sleepover can be at my house. I'll make it up to you guys.
entries.zh: 好啦好啦，我懂了。下次过夜就在我家办，我补偿你们。
