entries.en: Yes, of course! Now, can we move on with the meeting?
entries.zh: 是是，当然。那我们可以继续开会了吗？

entries.en: Well, I guess we will have to suspend today's meeting... Until next week, everyone!
entries.zh: 那今天的例会看来只能先散了……各位，下周见！

entries.en: You've now attended # meetings of the Cult of the Fallen Star! As a reward, here's some Starfall!
entries.zh: 你已经参加了#次陨落之星教团的例会！作为奖励，这些星落给你！

entries.en: Anyways... This meeting's been running long, and we're starving.
entries.zh: 总之……这次会开得太久了，我们都快饿死了。

entries.en: You've now attended 4 meetings of the Cult of the Fallen Star! As a reward, here's some Starfall!
entries.zh: 你已经参加了 4 次陨落之星教团的例会！作为奖励，这些星落给你！
怎么了，松丁？

entries.en: And guards, though they serve a similar purpose, are not doors, I suppose.
entries.zh: 而卫兵嘛，虽然作用差不多，但终究不是门，我想是这样。
对啊，我就睡在矿车里。

entries.en: You know, now that I think of it, everything is really blocky around here. And everywhere.
entries.zh: 你别说，我现在一想，这附近什么东西都是方的。全世界都是。
别胡说八道了。

entries.en: Come, let's go and check out those minecarts. Meeting adjourned!
entries.zh: 走，我们去看看那些矿车。散会！

entries.en: You've now attended 5 meetings of the Cult of the Fallen Star! As a reward, here's some Starfall!
entries.zh: 你已经参加了 5 次陨落之星教团的例会！作为奖励，这些星落给你！

entries.en: Well, guys, I'm still a bit shook from our recent series of discoveries.
entries.zh: 各位，我到现在还没从我们最近这一连串发现里缓过来。

entries.en: I suppose we should recap them, just for the agenda. Brarnas, if you would...
entries.zh: 为了走个流程，我们还是复述一遍吧。布拉纳斯，麻烦你……

entries.en: And the Puzzler always has a stupid puzzle to solve!
entries.zh: 而且解谜者永远都有一道蠢谜题等着人解！

entries.en: I can't deal with this right now, I need some time to process it all.
entries.zh: 我现在实在承受不了这个，我需要点时间消化一下。
散会！

entries.en: You've now attended 6 meetings of the Cult of the Fallen Star! As a reward, here's some Starfall!
entries.zh: 你已经参加了 6 次陨落之星教团的例会！作为奖励，这些星落给你！

entries.en: I don't know about you guys, but I'm still coming to terms with our recent findings...
entries.zh: 不知道你们怎么样，反正我还在慢慢接受我们最近的发现……

entries.en: What was never alive may never die, Thondin.
entries.zh: 从未活过的东西，也就无所谓死去，松丁。

entries.en: But we are conscious, Brarnas, are we not? Surely we exist in some capacity.
entries.zh: 可我们是有意识的啊，布拉纳斯，不是吗？我们总归是以某种方式存在着的。

entries.en: Or perhaps we are real, but are stuck within the XsimulationX?
entries.zh: 又或者我们是真实的，只是被困在 X 模拟 X 里？

entries.en: This is all too much for me to comprehend. I liked things better before.
entries.zh: 这些我实在想不明白。我还是喜欢以前那样。
那就这么办。
行，我这就打电话。

entries.en: Hello, can I have a pizza please.
entries.zh: 喂，我要一份披萨。

entries.en: Hmm, give me a second, I'll ask my friends.
entries.zh: 嗯，稍等一下，我问问我朋友。

entries.en: Guys, red pizza or blue pizza?
entries.zh: 各位，红披萨还是蓝披萨？

entries.en: I don't think so. Let's get it.
entries.zh: 应该没有吧。就点它了。

entries.en: Hey! One blue pizza, please. Yup, thanks, we'll come over now, bye!
entries.zh: 喂！来一份蓝披萨，谢谢。嗯，好的，我们这就过去，再见！

entries.en: Alright guys, let's go grab our pizza! And no more talk of all of this XsimulationX stuff, it scares me!
entries.zh: 好了各位，我们去取披萨吧！还有别再聊这些 X 模拟 X 的事了，吓得我慌！
喜欢泥土。
泥土！!
哦……这颗种子……需要泥土。

entries.en: YES! Needs the dirty, need to be DIRTY!
entries.zh: 对！需要沾满泥土，得变得脏兮兮的！
施了肥
满足地低吼。现在……好多了。
施过肥了……precious!

entries.en: THIS ISN'T WHAT I ASKED FOR! BRING TASTY MITHRIL TO ME NOW!
entries.zh: 这根本不是我点的！马上给我端美味秘银上来！

entries.en: DISGUSTING! I'M GONNA GET YOU FIRED FOR FEEDING ME THIS GARBAGE!
entries.zh: 恶心！就凭你给我端这种垃圾，我要让你被开除！
呃啊，这是什么玩意儿？
我饿了
给我上能吃的秘银

entries.en: THIS OLD MITHRIL IS STALE! DON'T EVER FEED THIS TO ME AGAIN!
entries.zh: 这秘银都放陈了！以后别再拿这种东西喂我！

entries.en: I FORGOT TO BRING A SNACK
entries.zh: 我忘了带点心

entries.en: 0/10, WOULD NOT RECOMMEND, TAKING TOO LONG
entries.zh: 0/10 分，绝不推荐，上菜太慢

entries.en: WHAT ARE YOU GUYS WAITING FOR
entries.zh: 你们几个到底还在等什么

entries.en: I AM LEAVING A BAD RATING FOR THIS PLACE ON MINEADVISOR
entries.zh: 我要在 MINEADVISOR 上给这地方打差评

entries.en: I WANT TO SPEAK TO YOUR MANAGER
entries.zh: 我要见你们经理
看着可真不错

entries.en: I MIGHT JUST STAY HERE FOREVER THEN
entries.zh: 那我干脆在这儿待一辈子算了

entries.en: DO YOU EVEN KNOW WHO I AM
entries.zh: 你到底知不知道我是谁

entries.en: MY FATHER WILL HEAR ABOUT THIS
entries.zh: 这事我一定告诉我父亲

entries.en: WHY IS THIS TAKING SO LONG
entries.zh: 怎么要这么久

entries.en: I AM RATING THIS ESTABLISHMENT ONE STAR ON DWELP
entries.zh: 我要在 DWELP 上给这家店打一星

entries.en: I DON'T HAVE ALL DAY, I ONLY WANT THE BEST LOOKING MITHRIL PIECES!
entries.zh: 我可没一整天时间，我只要卖相最好的那几块秘银！

entries.en: MY MEALS SHOULD HAVE ALREADY BEEN READY
entries.zh: 我的餐早就该做好了

entries.en: I AM NOT HAPPY WITH HOW LONG THIS IS TAKING
entries.zh: 上菜要这么久，我很不满意

entries.en: I AM NOT OKAY WITH THIS
entries.zh: 这种事我可接受不了

entries.en: YOU SHOULD ALL BE ASHAMED OF YOURSELVES
entries.zh: 你们都该为自己感到羞耻
喂我

entries.en: I THINK I MIGHT HAVE ROCK POISONING, I NEED TO LIE DOWN!
entries.zh: 我觉得我可能是石头中毒了，我得躺一会儿！
我感觉不太好……

entries.en: PLEASE NO, NO MORE. I'M STUFFED!
entries.zh: 别、别了，我吃不下了，撑死我了！

entries.en: Hello! I am Dr. Stone, a prominent Paleontologist from lands afar.
entries.zh: 你好！我是石头博士，一位从远方赶来的知名古生物学家。

entries.en: I've been able to set myself up down here for a short while in search of rare Fossils. I know the risks of doing so, but I just love research!
entries.zh: 我暂时在这里安顿了下来，想找些稀有的化石。我知道这样做有风险，可我实在太爱搞研究了！

entries.en: I'm always on the lookout for Suspicious Scraps when I'm mining around in Glacite Mineshafts, which I sometimes find when in the Glacite Tunnels.
entries.zh: 我在极冰矿井挖矿时，总会留意有没有可疑残料。这些矿井有时会出现在极冰矿道里。

entries.en: If you ever find a scrap when mining in a mineshaft, simply put it in the Fossil Excavator over there!
entries.zh: 你要是在矿井里挖到了残料，放进那边的化石挖掘机就行！

entries.en: Sometimes you'll find little treasures, and sometimes you'll find an entire fossil! If you do find a fossil, show it to me!
entries.zh: 有时能挖出小宝贝，有时则能找到一整块化石！要是找到了化石，可要拿来给我看看！

entries.en: If you donate a fossil to me, I'll show you how to turn it into a pet! That way, if you ever find another, you can keep it!
entries.zh: 你捐一块化石给我，我就教你怎么把它变成宠物！这样下次再找到一块，你就能自己留着养了！

entries.en: Here, take this Chisel. Now you just need a Suspicious Scrap!
entries.zh: 来，拿上这把凿子。现在你就差一份可疑碎屑了！

entries.en: Looks like that odd fellow over by the campfire might know a thing or two about getting them...
entries.zh: 营火那边那个怪人，好像知道该上哪儿弄到残料……

entries.en: I've been after that one for ages.
entries.zh: 这块化石我可是找了好久啊。

entries.en: I've never seen one of these before!
entries.zh: 这种化石我还从没见过呢！

entries.en: This one is a rare find!
entries.zh: 这块可真少见！
真漂亮！
真是了不起的发现！

entries.en: I can't believe you found this!
entries.zh: 没想到你居然找到了这个！

entries.en: This display case is empty. If you bring me a fossil, I'd be happy to display it and tell you about it.
entries.zh: 这个展柜还空着呢。你要是带块化石来，我很乐意把它摆出来，再给你讲讲它的来历。

entries.en: It's so small, but it's a Helix Fossil!
entries.zh: 别看它这么小，这可是螺旋化石！
这东西绝对是菊石！

entries.en: Don't let their cute looks fool you, those things were predators!
entries.zh: 可别被它可爱的样子骗了，这些家伙可是掠食者！

entries.en: If you're a slow-moving animal on the sea floor, these guys would have been your enemies.
entries.zh: 你要是海底那些行动缓慢的动物，当年可就得提防这些家伙了。

entries.en: Ooh, you like the look of the Helix Fossil?
entries.zh: 哦，你也喜欢这块螺旋化石？

entries.en: That's a very fossilized Ammonite, still completely intact!
entries.zh: 这是已经彻底石化的菊石，居然还保存得完完整整！

entries.en: Once upon a time, there were thousands of different species of Ammonite, and they were plentiful in numbers.
entries.zh: 很久以前，菊石有数千个不同的物种，数量也多得很。
现在嘛……可就没那么多了。

entries.en: Something just feels special about the Helix Fossil.
entries.zh: 总觉得这块螺旋化石有种特别的魅力。

entries.en: It's actually a well-preserved Ammonite from long ago.
entries.zh: 其实，它是一只从远古保存下来的菊石，保存得相当完好。

entries.en: While this one is pretty small, the largest known fossils of this variety are massive!
entries.zh: 这块虽然小，但目前发现的同类化石里，最大的可是庞然大物！

entries.en: That thing looks gross. It's surely an Ugly Fossil!
entries.zh: 这东西看着真恶心。肯定是丑陋化石！

entries.en: Whatever Goblin that belonged to was pretty nasty-looking, even for a Goblin.
entries.zh: 它原来的主人是个哥布林，那长相放在哥布林里也算难看的。

entries.en: Goblins don't really think for themselves most of the time, and prefer to blindly follow the herd.
entries.zh: 哥布林大多不怎么独立思考，就喜欢一窝蜂地跟着走。

entries.en: Kind of like the people over in the Hub when it comes to voting for a Mayor...
entries.zh: 跟主岛那些人选市长时的样子还挺像……

entries.en: Ew! That's definitely an Ugly Fossil!
entries.zh: 咦！这绝对是丑陋化石！

entries.en: Looks like it belonged to an especially ugly Goblin.
entries.zh: 看样子，它原来的主人是个特别丑的哥布林。

entries.en: Goblins are plentiful in other areas of the mines, but I'm yet to find any down here.
entries.zh: 矿山别的地方到处都是哥布林，可我还没在这底下见过它们。

entries.en: Maybe it got lost many years ago and ended up down here?
entries.zh: 难道它很多年前迷了路，才跑到这儿来的？

entries.en: That in front of you is an Ugly Fossil!
entries.zh: 你面前这块就是丑陋化石！

entries.en: Yeah, that name was the best we could come up with...
entries.zh: 对，我们实在想不出更好的名字了……

entries.en: It's a skull that once belonged to a particularly deformed-looking Goblin.
entries.zh: 这是一颗头骨，原来的主人是个长得格外畸形的哥布林。

entries.en: Just looking at it is giving me the heebie-jeebies, let's move on!
entries.zh: 光看着就让我浑身发毛，咱们还是看下一个吧！

entries.en: That Claw Fossil looks pretty daunting...
entries.zh: 这块爪子化石看着还挺吓人的……

entries.en: That was once attached to a Mole.
entries.zh: 它曾经长在一只鼹鼠身上。

entries.en: Those guys are solitary creatures and quite territorial, so you don't normally see them about.
entries.zh: 这些家伙喜欢独来独往，领地意识也很强，所以平时不太见得到。

entries.en: That Claw Fossil looks real menacing with those sharp claws...
entries.zh: 这块爪子化石的爪子这么尖，看着真够凶的……

entries.en: But it becomes a bit less scary when you realize it came from a Mole.
entries.zh: 不过，知道它来自一只鼹鼠之后，好像就没那么可怕了。

entries.en: Those little guys actually only live for a few years, which is kinda sad...
entries.zh: 这些小家伙其实只能活几年，想想还有点难过……

entries.en: Pretty sharp, huh? That's the Claw Fossil for you.
entries.zh: 够锋利吧？这就是爪子化石。

entries.en: Those things are actually insectivores and love digging tunnels.
entries.zh: 这些家伙吃昆虫，还特别爱挖隧道。

entries.en: When they dig, they move their arms in an outward motion, like a human swimming in breaststroke!
entries.zh: 挖洞时，它们的前肢会往外划，就像人在游蛙泳！

entries.en: That Tusk Fossil looks absolutely amazing.
entries.zh: 这块獠牙化石实在太漂亮了。

entries.en: Mammoths had two of these, and used them to fend off predators.
entries.zh: 猛犸象长着两根这样的长牙，用来抵御掠食者。

entries.en: They also used them to fight each other over territory and gather food!
entries.zh: 它们还会用长牙互相争夺领地、采集食物！

entries.en: That thing there is a Tusk Fossil!
entries.zh: 那边那块就是獠牙化石！

entries.en: That thing was once attached to a Mammoth , believe or not.
entries.zh: 信不信由你，它曾经长在一头猛犸象身上。

entries.en: While people often think Mammoths were huge, they were actually around the size of your average modern-day elephant.
entries.zh: 大家常以为猛犸象大得不得了，其实它们跟如今常见的大象差不多大。

entries.en: Though it's not like that fact makes their tusks any less intimidating...
entries.zh: 不过，这可不会让它们的长牙显得没那么吓人……

entries.en: Look how awesome! The Tusk Fossil!
entries.zh: 看看，多气派！这块獠牙化石！

entries.en: I wish I could see the Mammoth it belonged to.
entries.zh: 真想亲眼见见它原来的主人，那头猛犸象。

entries.en: Though they look pretty scary, these guys mostly ate vegetation.
entries.zh: 这些家伙虽然看着挺吓人，其实主要吃植物。

entries.en: Still, if you ever saw one you'd probably want to keep out of its way...
entries.zh: 不过真要碰上一头，你大概还是会想躲远点……

entries.en: That in front of you is a Webbed Fossil!
entries.zh: 你面前这块是蛛网化石！

entries.en: It belonged to a particularly resilient Penguin.
entries.zh: 它来自一只格外顽强的企鹅。

entries.en: While on land, a group of penguins is called a waddle.
entries.zh: 企鹅在陆地上聚成一群时，英文会用 waddle 来称呼它们，就是摇摇摆摆的意思。

entries.en: But, if they're in the water, they're instead referred to by researchers as a raft!
entries.zh: 可到了水里，研究者们就把这一群叫作 raft,也就是筏子的意思！

entries.en: Which one do you like more?
entries.zh: 你更喜欢哪种叫法？

entries.en: Aw! That little fella is a Webbed Fossil!
entries.zh: 哎呀！这小家伙是蛛网化石！

entries.en: It's all that remains of whatever little Penguin once lived around here.
entries.zh: 曾经在这里生活的那只小企鹅，如今就只剩下这个了。

entries.en: The black-and-white look of most penguins is actually a form of camouflage.
entries.zh: 大多数企鹅那身黑白配色，其实是一种伪装。

entries.en: When they're swimming, predators looking from above see the black on their backs, which camouflages with the water.
entries.zh: 它们游泳时，从上方俯视的掠食者看到的是黑色的背部，能跟水面融为一体。

entries.en: And, to predators below, their white underbelly blends in with the light shining down on the water from above!
entries.zh: 而在下方的掠食者眼里，它们白色的肚皮又会融入从上方照进水里的光线！

entries.en: Ooh! One of my favorites! The Webbed Fossil!
entries.zh: 哦！我最喜欢的化石之一！蛛网化石！

entries.en: Believe it or not, that once belonged to a Penguin!
entries.zh: 信不信由你，它曾属于一只企鹅！

entries.en: Most bird species evolve with hollow bones, to help them stay light when flying.
entries.zh: 大多数鸟类进化出了中空的骨骼，好让自己飞起来轻盈些。

entries.en: Penguins, however, have solid bones, which help them float when in the water.
entries.zh: 可企鹅的骨骼是实心的，有助于它们在水里漂浮。

entries.en: The Clubbed Fossil is quite majestic, I've never seen another tail like it.
entries.zh: 这块棒状化石真气派，我从没见过这样的尾巴。
它原本属于一只甲龙。

entries.en: Though this dino was covered in strong plating that would usually make it impervious to predators, it had a soft underbelly.
entries.zh: 这种恐龙浑身披着坚硬的甲片，掠食者通常奈何不了它，不过它的肚皮却很柔软。

entries.en: So, it was an easy meal... if you could roll it over first, and that thing weighed more than a dwarven forge!
entries.zh: 所以它其实很容易吃到嘴里……前提是你能把它翻过来，而那家伙比一座矮人熔炉还重！

entries.en: This one here looks a little strange, but is the Clubbed Fossil!
entries.zh: 这块看着有点奇怪，不过它就是棒状化石！

entries.en: It was once a tail belonging to an Ankylosaurus.
entries.zh: 它曾是一只甲龙的尾巴。

entries.en: The Ankylosaurus was a herbivore, but it lived at the same time as the T-Rex.
entries.zh: 甲龙是食草动物，不过它生活的时代跟霸王龙一样。

entries.en: Though, if you have to live at the same time as a bloodthirsty predator like the T-Rex, it probably would help to have an armored body and bone-shatteringly strong tail.
entries.zh: 要跟霸王龙这种嗜血的掠食者活在同一个时代，有一身铠甲和一条能砸碎骨头的强壮尾巴，大概还是挺管用的。
啊，棒状化石！

entries.en: That thing was once attached to the rear of an Ankylosaurus.
entries.zh: 这东西曾经长在一只甲龙的屁股后面。

entries.en: Those things were pretty much walking fortresses - completely covered in bony deposits known as osteoderms that protected them from predators.
entries.zh: 这些家伙简直是行走的堡垒——全身覆着一种叫皮内成骨的骨质结构，保护它们免受掠食者伤害。

entries.en: Today, you'll see similar armor-like osteoderms on Crocodiles and Armadillos.
entries.zh: 现在的鳄鱼和犰狳身上，也能看到类似铠甲的皮内成骨。

entries.en: That there is a Footprint Fossil!
entries.zh: 那边那块是足迹化石！

entries.en: Once upon a time, it belonged to a ferocious T-Rex!
entries.zh: 很久以前，它属于一只凶猛的霸王龙！

entries.en: Those boys were bad news - they would take a bite out of anything!
entries.zh: 那些家伙可不好惹，见什么都想咬上一口！

entries.en: There's even evidence to suggest that they would sometimes eat each other!
entries.zh: 甚至有证据表明，它们有时连同类都吃！

entries.en: Believe it or not, but that's a Footprint Fossil!
entries.zh: 信不信由你，那可是一块足迹化石！

entries.en: It looks to have belonged to the legendary T-Rex!
entries.zh: 看样子，它来自大名鼎鼎的霸王龙！

entries.en: The T-Rex is made fun of for its comparatively small arms, but they were still over three feet long!
entries.zh: 大家总拿霸王龙相对短小的前肢开玩笑，可那双前肢也有三英尺多长呢！

entries.en: Some other carnivores also had even stubbier little arms, so I guess there's that...
entries.zh: 有些别的食肉动物，前肢甚至比它还短，这么一想倒也还好……

entries.en: That looks like a Footprint Fossil!
entries.zh: 那看起来是块足迹化石！

entries.en: That bad boy once belonged to the T-Rex!
entries.zh: 这块厉害的化石，原来的主人是霸王龙！

entries.en: The T-Rex actually had a brain twice as large as most other carnivores.
entries.zh: 霸王龙的大脑，其实有大多数其他食肉动物的两倍大。

entries.en: Some researchers believe it was smart enough to set traps for its prey, and actually functioned as an ambush predator.
entries.zh: 有些研究者认为它聪明到会给猎物设陷阱，其实是靠伏击捕猎的。

entries.en: A Spine Fossil! This one's pretty rare.
entries.zh: 一块脊椎化石！这个可挺稀有。

entries.en: It was once part of a particularly interesting creature called the Spinosaurus.
entries.zh: 它曾是某种非常有趣的生物的一部分，那种生物叫棘龙。

entries.en: This dinosaur is actually really controversial, as fossils make it hard to tell how it truly behaved.
entries.zh: 这种恐龙其实争议很大，光靠化石很难弄清它究竟怎样生活。

entries.en: Did it spend most of its time hunting on land, or was it more of an aquatic forager?
entries.zh: 它大部分时间是在陆地上捕猎，还是更喜欢在水里觅食？

entries.en: Either way, it's pretty funny. With every new discovery, the Spinosaurus loses a bit more of its mystique.
entries.zh: 不管怎样，这事还挺有意思。每有一个新发现，棘龙的神秘感就少一分。

entries.en: I can't believe Paleontologists are nerfing dinosaurs now.
entries.zh: 没想到现在连古生物学家都开始削弱恐龙了。

entries.en: This was once attached to the back of the Spinosaurus.
entries.zh: 它曾经长在棘龙的背上。

entries.en: The Spinosaurus was not only a carnivore, but also one of the few dinosaurs to be an adept swimmer.
entries.zh: 棘龙不光吃肉，还是少数擅长游泳的恐龙之一。

entries.en: What I'm saying is that, no matter where you ran, it would probably follow. Nice.
entries.zh: 我的意思是，你不管往哪儿跑，它大概都能追过来。真不错啊。

entries.en: That in front of you is a Spine Fossil!
entries.zh: 你面前这块是脊椎化石！

entries.en: Many, many, many years ago, it would have belonged to one Spinosaurus.
entries.zh: 很多很多很多年前，它属于一只棘龙。

entries.en: Fun fact, the T-Rex isn't actually the heaviest carnivorous dinosaur known to researchers!
entries.zh: 说个有趣的事，霸王龙其实不是研究者已知最重的食肉恐龙！

entries.en: That title actually goes to this fella, who was one BIG BOY!
entries.zh: 这个头衔归这家伙，它才是真正的大块头！

entries.en: Wow! Looks like you've found every type of fossil around!
entries.zh: 哇！看来这附近每一种化石你都找到了！

entries.en: Maybe we'll find more together in the future, but for now my work here is done!
entries.zh: 也许将来我们还能一起找到更多化石，不过眼下我在这里的工作算是告一段落了！

entries.en: Please, take these rewards. It's the least I can do!
entries.zh: 这些奖励请你收下。这是我起码该做的！

entries.en: I think I'll stick around for a little longer, and then it's onto my next adventure!
entries.zh: 我想我还会在这里多待一会儿，然后就该去下一站冒险了！

entries.en: I gotcha ya a good story piling up, but beware!
entries.zh: 我给你攒了个好故事，不过可得当心！

entries.en: but her parents, oh no!, they were quite the brute
entries.zh: 可她的爹娘，哎哟不得了！凶得很呐

entries.en: so the lil' fellow went out and about into the wood,
entries.zh: 于是那小家伙一路走啊走，走进了林子里,

entries.en: "a bit of rest wouldn't hurt" she said very bold
entries.zh: “歇一会儿也没什么大不了”,她说得挺硬气

entries.en: he tugged himself in and went right to sleep,
entries.zh: 他把自己裹好，倒头就睡,
可他接下来看见的东西……

entries.en: I am the King's favorite Emissary, which is why I'm the furthest away from him!
entries.zh: 我是国王最喜欢的委托官，所以他才把我派得离他这么远！

entries.en: Commissions inside the Crystal Hollows are different from the ones in the Dwarven Mines.
entries.zh: 水晶洞窟里的委托和矮人矿洞里的不一样。

entries.en: Click me again to recieve your first set of Crystal Hollows commissions.
entries.zh: 再点我一次，领取你的第一批水晶洞窟委托。

entries.en: Once you complete them, come back to me!
entries.zh: 完成之后，再回来找我！

entries.en: The King has sent me to go shopping for I am his favorite emissary!
entries.zh: 国王派我出来采购，因为我是他最喜欢的委托官！

entries.en: This will make me gain even more favor with the King!
entries.zh: 这样我在国王心里的地位会更高！

entries.en: How dare you reject me, the King's favorite emissary?!
entries.zh: 你竟敢拒绝我，国王最喜欢的委托官？!

entries.en: The King's favorite emissary is here to request potatoes for the King's great feast!
entries.zh: 国王最喜欢的委托官来啦，为国王的盛大宴会征集马铃薯！

entries.en: Maybe the King will even announce me as his favorite at the feast!
entries.zh: 说不定国王会在宴会上当众宣布我是他最喜欢的那个！

entries.en: I will inform the King about this disgrace!
entries.zh: 我会把这次耻辱禀报给国王的！

entries.en: I know what all the others say, but I am the King's true favorite emissary.
entries.zh: 我知道别人都是怎么说的，但我才是国王真正最喜欢的委托官。

entries.en: As the King's true favorite only I know he secretly loves melon.
entries.zh: 作为国王真正的心头好，只有我知道他其实偷偷爱吃甜瓜。

entries.en: The King will surely punish you for this disrespect!
entries.zh: 国王一定会因为你这份无礼惩罚你的！
我劝你还是别往前走了。

entries.en: But, if you do, the current "King" has some tasks he would appreciate your help with.
entries.zh: 不过你要是愿意，现任的那位“国王”有些任务，正需要你的帮忙。

entries.en: I say King, but ever since Dulin returned, whispers are going around of him being the true king.
entries.zh: 我说是国王，但自从杜林回归之后，坊间就一直在传，说他才是真正的国王。

entries.en: But, if you do, the current 'King' has some tasks he would appreciate your help with.
entries.zh: 不过，如果你执意要去，现在这位「国王」倒是有些差事，希望能有你帮忙。

entries.en: I've heard I can find the best mushrooms here, and as the King's favorite emissary I will bring them to him!
entries.zh: 听说这里能找到最好的蘑菇，作为国王最喜欢的委托官，我会把它们带给他的！

entries.en: My standing as the King's favorite emissary is secured as soon as I bring these back home!
entries.zh: 只要我把这些带回去，我“国王最喜欢的委托官”这个位置就稳了！

entries.en: You are going to regret this!
entries.zh: 你会后悔的！

entries.en: The King's least favorite vegetable is carrot, so he sent me, his favorite emissary, to make it better!
entries.zh: 国王最不喜欢的蔬菜是胡萝卜，所以他派我这个他最喜欢的委托官来把它变得好吃点！

entries.en: I'm sure that by giving him his least favorite vegetable, he'll make me his favoritest emissary!
entries.zh: 我肯定，只要把他最不喜欢的蔬菜献给他，他就会封我当他“最最最喜欢”的委托官！

entries.en: I'm not sure if the carrots would have worked anyways...
entries.zh: 我其实也不确定胡萝卜到底管不管用……

entries.zh: 嗨可能需要你帮个忙

entries.zh: 我在找点东西说真的不记得叫什么了

entries.en: you didnt find my things yet?
entries.zh: 还没找到我要的东西吗？

entries.en: i didnt ask for this bro
entries.zh: 老哥我要的不是这个

entries.en: why you giving me something completely different
entries.zh: 你怎么给我完全不一样的东西
现在的人啊哈哈……
嗯你挺接近了
但是数量不对？?

entries.en: thanks thats probably what i needed
entries.zh: 谢啦应该就是这个了
拿点礼物去吧！

entries.en: come back another time, maybe tmrw
entries.zh: 改天再来吧也许明天
要%1$s个拜托了

entries.en: You need to unlock Heart of the Mountain Tier 2 to access the Forge!
entries.zh: 你需要解锁山之心 2 级才能使用锻造炉！

entries.en: me so cold. me so hungry.
entries.zh: 我好冷。我好饿。

entries.en: u bring me fossil if u dont need them?
entries.zh: 你用不上的化石，给我好不好？
这不是化石

entries.en: mmm nope not hungry for that fossil.
entries.zh: 唔不是这块这化石我不想吃。
唔挺好吃。
粉末拿去

entries.en: u feed me more fossil tomorrow?
entries.zh: 明天再喂我化石好不好？
唔……我不饿
回头再来

entries.en: the fossil i want lived underground and dug tunnels
entries.zh: 我要的化石住在地下，会挖洞

entries.en: the fossil i want had a really fancy tail
entries.zh: 我要的化石有条特别花哨的尾巴

entries.en: the fossil i want was the king of his kind
entries.zh: 我要的化石是它那族的王

entries.en: the fossil i want lived underwater
entries.zh: 我要的化石住在水里

entries.en: the fossil i want was kinda spiny u know
entries.zh: 我要的化石浑身是刺你懂吧

entries.en: the fossil i want lived in herds and was quite woolly
entries.zh: 我要的化石成群生活，毛茸茸的

entries.en: the fossil i want is pretty rough to look at
entries.zh: 我要的化石长得挺丑

entries.en: the fossil i want had a really pointy beak
entries.zh: 我要的化石有个特别尖的喙

entries.en: me so cold. me so hungry
entries.zh: 我好冷。我好饿

entries.en: errrr... that is not a fossil
entries.zh: 呃……这不是化石

entries.en: mmm nope not hungry for that fossil
entries.zh: 唔不是这块这化石我不想吃

entries.en: Y'know now that we are getting deeper and deeper a lot of these blocks are getting harder to mine!
entries.zh: 你有没有发现，越往深处走，这些方块就越难挖！

entries.en: Luckily I have a handy guide right here for you!
entries.zh: 幸好我这儿正好有一本速查手册给你！

entries.en: Hey you! Can you bring me the hardest block you can mine?
entries.zh: 喂，那边的！你能把你挖得动的最硬的方块带给我看看吗？

entries.en: Cactus? I'm sure you could do better, but I'll take it for now.
entries.zh: 仙人掌？我相信你还能挖到更硬的，不过眼下就先收下吧。

entries.en: Just as I thought...I am talking to a softie!
entries.zh: 果然不出我所料……我这是在跟个软脚虾说话啊！

entries.en: These forges have been running at an endermite's pace!
entries.zh: 这些熔炉慢得像只末影螨！

entries.en: My job here is to make sure the lava flows and that the titanium shines.
entries.zh: 我在这儿的活儿，就是保证岩浆一直流、钛一直亮。

entries.en: Yep, it's mostly watching other people work!
entries.zh: 是啊，基本上就是看别人干活！
呃，你确定？

entries.en: The signal doesn't work too well around here, but suit yourself.
entries.zh: 这儿的信号可不太好，不过你愿意就行。

entries.en: Could definitely use some help, if you are willing to trade.
entries.zh: 你要是愿意做个交换，我倒确实有件事想请你帮忙。

entries.en: The Forge doesn't charge users for its fuel, but we're using a mountain of it every day.
entries.zh: 锻造厂不向使用者收燃料费，可我们每天烧掉的燃料都堆成山了。

entries.en: I'm a little ashamed to admit it, but we mostly use Foul Flesh nowadays.
entries.zh: 说出来有点不好意思，我们现在主要烧的是恶臭血肉。

entries.en: We tried a bunch of things but that's been working the best so far.
entries.zh: 各种东西我们都试过，目前还是它最好用。

entries.en: For a stack of Foul Flesh, I'll give you my personal contact.
entries.zh: 给我一组恶臭血肉，我就把私人联系方式给你。
谢谢，真帮大忙了！

entries.en: Hey %1$s! Your %2$s is ready down here at the forge!
entries.zh: 嘿，%1$s! 你的%2$s已经在熔炉这儿做好了！

entries.en: I can't really hear you right now, the signal is really bad!
entries.zh: 我这会儿真听不清你说什么，信号太差了！

entries.en: I'm not interested in extending my anvil warranty.
entries.zh: 我不需要给铁砧续保。

entries.en: You're breaking up, I CAN'T HEAR YOU!
entries.zh: 你那边断断续续的，我听不见！

entries.en: All I hear is crackling, the signal is really bad down here.
entries.zh: 我只能听见滋啦滋啦的杂音，这底下信号实在太差了。

entries.en: Hello there! That's strange... you don't look like a dwarf, but you also don't look like a Goblin!
entries.zh: 你好啊！奇怪了……你看着不像矮人，可你看着也不像哥布林啊！

entries.en: I've not seen a human down here since... well, nevermind.
entries.zh: 我已经好久没在这下面见过人类了……嗯，算了，不提也罢。

entries.en: The name's Gemma, and I run the Diamond Essence Shop, where you can trade in Diamond Essence for useful perks and upgrades!
entries.zh: 我叫杰玛，我经营着钻石精粹商店，你可以用钻石精粹换取各种好用的天赋和升级！

entries.en: Show me that you know your way around. Bring back all five Crystals found throughout the Crystal Hollows and complete the Crystal Nucleus, I'll let you use my shop.
entries.zh: 先让我看看你对这里有多熟悉吧。把散布在水晶洞窟各处的五颗水晶全都带回来，把水晶核心拼齐，我就让你用我的商店。

entries.en: If you're having trouble finding any of those Crystals, go take a look at the Nucleus Vault over there.
entries.zh: 要是有哪颗水晶你找不着，就去那边的晶核宝库看看。

entries.en: That'll tell you where each Crystal can be found in the Dwarven Mines.
entries.zh: 那里会告诉你每颗水晶在矮人矿洞的什么地方。

entries.en: Stuck? Go take a look at the Nucleus Vault.
entries.zh: 卡住了？去晶核宝库看看吧。

entries.en: That'll tell you where each Crystal can be found in the Crystal Hollows.
entries.zh: 那里会告诉你每颗水晶在水晶洞窟的什么地方。

entries.en: Awesome! You really completed the Crystal Nucleus?
entries.zh: 太棒了！你真把水晶核心拼齐了？

entries.en: I'll give you 25 Diamond Essence to get you started- you can find more all around the Crystal Hollows!
entries.zh: 我先给你 25 点钻石精粹当启动资金——水晶洞窟里到处都能找到更多！

entries.en: Let me show you the Diamond Essence Shop!
entries.zh: 我带你看看钻石精粹商店！
✆ 你好啊。
✆ 你想要我的阿比手机联系方式？

entries.en: ✆ You know the signal isn't great down here, right?
entries.zh: ✆ 你知道这下面信号很差吧？

entries.en: ✆ Well, I suppose it wouldn't do any harm.
entries.zh: ✆ 不过嘛，给了也没什么坏处。

entries.en: ✆ Most of the Dwarves are pretty against all of this newer tech, so I've got plenty of space in my directory.
entries.zh: ✆ 大部分矮人都挺排斥这些新玩意儿，所以我通讯录里空位多得很。

entries.en: ✆ How about you bring me a Pure Mithril Gem? I'll trade it for my contact.
entries.zh: ✆ 不如你给我带一颗纯秘银宝石来？我拿联系方式跟你换。

entries.en: ✆ It's such a beautiful gem. Perhaps the most beautiful one of all.
entries.zh: ✆ 那种宝石太美了。也许是世上最美的一种。

entries.en: ✆ Well, outside of the fabled Arkenstone, that is.
entries.zh: ✆ 当然啦，传说中的阿肯宝钻不算在内。

entries.en: ✆ As nice as that thing is, it's not a Pure Mithril Gem.
entries.zh: ✆ 这东西是不错，可它不是纯秘银宝石。

entries.en: ✆ If you could find me one I'd really appreciate it.
entries.zh: ✆ 你要是能帮我找到一颗，我会非常感激。

entries.en: ✆ I've heard they sometimes drop from Diamond Goblins.
entries.zh: ✆ 我听说钻石哥布林偶尔会掉这个。
✆ 哇！太美了！!

entries.en: ✆ Thank you so much - I think I'll fashion it into a necklace.
entries.zh: ✆ 太感谢你了——我打算把它做成一条项链。
✆ 来——这是我的联系方式。

entries.en: ✆ Give me a call if you ever need to use the Diamond Essence Shop!
entries.zh: ✆ 以后想用钻石精粹商店就给我打电话！
哦，是个人类！大概……是吧？

entries.en: Nice seeing you! It gets a bit lonely down in the Hollows.
entries.zh: 见到你真好！在水晶残核里待着，还真有点孤单。
那就下次吧！

entries.en: Gemstones have magical properties and can be applied to some special items.
entries.zh: 宝石拥有神奇的属性，可以镶嵌到一些特殊物品上。

entries.en: There are 12 different Gemstones, all of them having their own unique properties!
entries.zh: 一共有 12 种不同的宝石，每一种都有各自独特的属性！

entries.en: For example, adding Ruby to armor will increase its ❤ Health, while Jasper increases ❁ Strength.
entries.zh: 举个例子，给盔甲镶上红宝石会提升它的❤ 生命值，而碧玉则会提升❁ 力量。

entries.en: The more pure the Gemstone - the stronger the effect!
entries.zh: 宝石纯度越高，效果就越强！

entries.en: Only some items can have Gemstones applied, and you can remove them any time.
entries.zh: 只有部分物品可以镶嵌宝石，而且你可以随时取出它们。

entries.en: Use the Gemstone Grinder next to me to apply Gemstones to items!
entries.zh: 用我旁边的宝石研磨机把宝石镶到物品上吧！

entries.en: There are several qualities of Gemstone, including Rough, Flawed, and Fine.
entries.zh: 宝石分好几种品质，包括粗糙、有瑕和精细。

entries.en: The highest quality of Gemstone - Perfect - will increase your stats the most!
entries.zh: 宝石品质里最高的一档——完美——提升的属性也最多！

entries.en: Not all items can have Gemstones applied to them.
entries.zh: 并不是所有物品都能镶嵌宝石。

entries.en: Check out the Gemstone Grinder menu to check which items work with it!
entries.zh: 打开宝石研磨机的菜单，就能看到哪些物品可以镶嵌！

entries.en: Sup, %1$s? I am Geonathan Greatforge, your one stop shop for refueling and upgrading Drills.
entries.zh: 嘿，%1$s?我是吉奥纳森·巨锻，给钻头加油和升级，找我一家就够了。

entries.en: Drills are like pickaxes, but better! They are powered with Drill Fuel, which comes in many different forms.
entries.zh: 钻头就像镐子，但更好用！它们靠钻头燃料驱动，而燃料有很多种。

entries.en: Biofuel is one of such fuels, which applies 3,000 fuel to your Drill!
entries.zh: 生物燃料就是其中一种，能给你的钻头补充 3,000 点燃料！

entries.en: You can also apply Drill Upgrades to Drills, offering various buffs!
entries.zh: 你还可以给钻头装上钻头升级模块，提供各种各样的增益！

entries.en: I usually only work with Oil Barrels, but I'd like to try making some Biofuel from compost.
entries.zh: 我平时只用油桶，不过我挺想试试拿堆肥做点生物燃料。

entries.en: Oil Barrels are much more superior, but at least this is 100% renewable. Pretty neat!
entries.zh: 油桶当然强得多，不过这玩意儿好歹百分之百可再生。挺妙的！

entries.en: Not a problem. I hear that Biofuel is worse anyways.
entries.zh: 没关系。反正我听说生物燃料本来就更差。

entries.en: Drills are sweet! Too bad you don't have one. I hear you can create them in the Forge!
entries.zh: 钻头可是好东西！可惜你没有。我听说在锻造厂里能造出来！

entries.en: Come back to me when you have a Drill in your inventory!
entries.zh: 等你物品栏里有钻头了再来找我！

entries.en: What are you doing talking to me without a Drill? Come back when you have one!
entries.zh: 连钻头都没有，你找我干嘛？有了再来！
嗝
嗝儿
嗝！
*《盗梦空间》式的 BRRRAAWWWWWBRBRBB 音效*
嗝儿……嗝！
嗝嗝！?!

entries.en: THEY'RE STEALING THE CRYSTAL! GET THEM!
entries.zh: 他们在偷水晶！抓住他们！
给我站住！

entries.en: You do not belong here! Get out while you still can!
entries.zh: 你不该来这里！趁还能走，赶紧出去！
我爱金~子~!

entries.en: Click me again to open the Gold Forger Shop!
entries.zh: 再点我一下就能打开黄金锻造师商店！

entries.en: Do Golden Carrots taste different than normal ones? I've actually never tried one before so I am pretty curious how they taste.
entries.zh: 金胡萝卜吃起来和普通胡萝卜不一样吗？我其实一次都没吃过，还挺好奇是什么味道的。

entries.en: Let's taste...THIS IS DISGUSTING!!! Why would anyone waste such precious gold on this? Just like any other fancy food, expensive and gross...
entries.zh: 来尝一口……这也太难吃了！!! 谁会把这么珍贵的金子浪费在这种东西上？跟别的什么高档菜一样，又贵又难吃……

entries.en: They would've probably tasted bad anyways...
entries.zh: 反正八成也不好吃……

entries.en: Oh, %1$s! I'm having a conundrum! There's so many corpses scattered around the Glacite Mineshafts, and so little time!
entries.zh: 哎，%1$s! 我可犯愁了！极冰矿井里到处都是尸体，可时间哪够用啊！

entries.en: Tell you what, would you be willing to help me gather them all for me? I'll reward you handsomely!
entries.zh: 要不这样，你愿不愿意帮我把它们都收集起来？我会好好报答你的！

entries.en: Awesome! Okay, stand still real quick...
entries.zh: 太好了！来，先站着别动……
*嗅嗅*

entries.en: Okay, now I'm familiar with your scent!
entries.zh: 好了，我记住你的气味了！

entries.en: Using my amazing power of smell, I'll track you as you move through the Glacite Mineshafts.
entries.zh: 靠我这灵敏的鼻子，你在极冰矿井里走到哪儿，我都能跟上。

entries.en: You know what the Glacite Mineshafts are, right?
entries.zh: 你知道极冰矿井是什么吧？
哦，没关系。

entries.en: My wife's not gonna be happy.
entries.zh: 我老婆可要不高兴了。

entries.en: Been out here for months without so much as a scrap to show for it...
entries.zh: 在外头待了好几个月，连点残渣都没捞着……

entries.en: You know, you're starting to look kinda tasty...
entries.zh: 你知道吗，你看着好像越来越可口了……

entries.en: Great, the look on your face had me worried for a second!
entries.zh: 那就好，看你刚才那表情，我还担心了一下！

entries.en: Anyways, whenever you loot a Frozen Corpse, I'll come soon after to retrieve it.
entries.zh: 总之，你每搜刮一具冰冻尸体，我很快就会过来把它收走。

entries.en: Come talk to me and I'll show you how many corpses we, the dream team, have gathered together!
entries.zh: 来找我聊聊，我就告诉你，咱们这对梦幻搭档一共收集了多少具尸体！

entries.en: After reaching certain Frozen Corpse Milestones I'll even give you some useful stuff from my stash!
entries.zh: 达到特定的冰冻尸体里程碑后，我还会从私藏里拿点实用的东西送你！

entries.en: Hmm, maybe you're not ready then, yet.
entries.zh: 嗯，看来你还没准备好。

entries.en: Glacite Mineshafts sometimes pop up while you're mining in the Glacite Tunnels.
entries.zh: 极冰矿井有时会在你开采极冰矿道时出现。

entries.en: If you enter one, you'll fine Frozen Corpses strewn throughout the place - they're all that's left of some unfortunate dwarves from long ago!
entries.zh: 走进矿井，就会发现到处散落着冰冻尸体——那是很久以前那些不幸矮人仅存的遗骸！

entries.en: Though they're not very talkative fellows on account of being dead 'n all, you can still have a rummage through their backpacks for some loot!
entries.zh: 这些家伙毕竟都死了，也没法陪你聊天，不过你还是能翻翻他们的背包，找些战利品！

entries.en: Now, why don't you go and find a Glacite Mineshafts or two, and then come talk to me again when you're ready for us to partner up?
entries.zh: 要不你先去找一两座极冰矿井，等准备好跟我搭档了，再来找我吧？
站住！

entries.en: How'd you get in here? The entrance is sealed off...
entries.zh: 你是怎么进来的？入口明明封死了……
唉，算了。

entries.en: If you got in here, you probably know what you're doing.
entries.zh: 你既然进得来，想必也知道自己在干什么。

entries.en: If you don't know already, this is the only place where you can fish up Mithril Grubbers.
entries.zh: 要是你还不知道的话:这里是唯一能钓上秘银掘虫的地方。

entries.en: When you kill 'em, they'll drop lotsa Mithril Powder.
entries.zh: 把它们宰了，会掉一大堆秘银粉末。

entries.en: Just make sure you're Fishing Level 6 or you won't be able to catch 'em.
entries.zh: 不过你得先到钓鱼等级 6,不然根本钓不上来。

entries.en: When you kill 'em, they'll drop lotsa ᠅ Mithril Powder.
entries.zh: 把它们宰了，会掉一大堆᠅ 秘银粉末。

entries.en: Just make sure you're Fishing Level 6 or you wont be able catch 'em.
entries.zh: 不过你得先到钓鱼等级 6,不然根本钓不上来。

entries.en: Come back to me when you reach Heart of the Mountain Tier 4.
entries.zh: 等你的山之心到 4 级再来找我。

entries.en: Hello! Behind me lies the entrance to the Crystal Hollows.
entries.zh: 你好！我身后就是水晶洞窟的入口。

entries.en: This place is full of treasures and secrets!
entries.zh: 那地方到处都是宝藏和秘密！

entries.en: We dwarves have tried to setup outposts there but it is harder than it looks.
entries.zh: 我们矮人试过在那儿建前哨站，可比看上去难多了。

entries.en: Nowadays this place is only used for expeditions and adventures!
entries.zh: 如今那地方只用来做探险和考察了！

entries.en: A fantastic place to explore and mine Gemstones.
entries.zh: 是个探险和采宝石的绝佳去处。

entries.en: I'll grant you access to the Crystal Hollows for 6 hours, for only 10,000 coins!
entries.zh: 我可以让你进水晶洞窟待 6 小时，只要 10,000 硬币！

entries.en: Once access is granted, you can always come here by using the Fast Travel menu in your SkyBlock Menu!
entries.zh: 开通之后，你随时可以用快速旅行菜单回到这里——它在你的空岛菜单里！

entries.en: You should also talk to Emissary Braum, they have more information about commissions.
entries.zh: 你也该去找使者布劳姆聊聊，他那儿有更多关于委托的消息。

entries.en: Great! Now hop on into the Minecart and I'll get you on your way!
entries.zh: 太好了！赶紧跳上矿车，我这就送你出发！
祝你在矿里一切顺利！

entries.en: Oh no! It looks like you missed the Minecart!
entries.zh: 糟糕！看来你没赶上矿车！

entries.en: Hey! Someone special has been asking to meet you!
entries.zh: 嘿！有位特别的人物一直想见你！

entries.en: I'm not quite sure what he's doing back in the Dwarven Mines- it's been years since I last saw him!
entries.zh: 我也不太清楚他跑回矮人矿洞来做什么——我上次见他都是好多年前的事了！

entries.en: Anyways, he's expecting you over in the Hanging Court by the Royal Palace. Better not keep him waiting!
entries.zh: 总之，他在皇家宫殿旁边的悬廷等着你。可别让他久等！

entries.en: One day I will be useful.
entries.zh: 总有一天我会派上用场的。

entries.en: I don't really have a sweet tooth, but chocolate is probably my favorite thing in this world. But the supply is really poor mostly because of the mines' lack of accessibility.
entries.zh: 我其实不怎么爱吃甜的，不过巧克力大概是这世上我最喜欢的东西了。只是矿里进出太不方便，货源实在太差。

entries.en: Amazing! I haven't eaten such chocolatey goodness in a long time...Maybe they should invest in that rusty old lift.
entries.zh: 太棒了！我好久没吃到这么浓的巧克力了……也许他们真该在那台老掉牙的升降梯上花点钱。

entries.en: I helped you enter the Crystal Hollows so many times! Why won't you return the favor?
entries.zh: 我帮你进了那么多次水晶洞窟！你怎么就不肯还我个人情呢？

entries.en: Many treasures await you blah, blah, blah... Get in the Minecart!
entries.zh: 无数宝藏正等着你，等等等等……快上矿车！

entries.en: What are you waiting for? Christmas? Get in!
entries.zh: 你还在等什么？等过年吗？快上车！

entries.en: Just get in the heckin Minecart already.
entries.zh: 赶紧给我上这破矿车。
快点，上车吧。

entries.en: The Minecart will leave without you...
entries.zh: 矿车可要丢下你开走了……

entries.en: That Minecart won't wait forever you know.
entries.zh: 那辆矿车可不会永远等着你。

entries.en: I'll grant you access to the Crystal Hollows for %1$s hours, for only %2$s coins!
entries.zh: 我可以让你进入水晶洞窟%1$s小时，只要%2$s硬币！

entries.en: Hey! Someone special has been asking to meet you! Anyways, he's expecting you over in the Hanging Court.
entries.zh: 嘿！有个特别的人一直想见你！总之，他在悬廷等着你了。
嗝儿——!

entries.en: For my wares, you'll have to pay the iron price!
entries.zh: 想要我的货，就得付出铁的代价！
……说正经的，我收硬币。

entries.en: Click me again to open the Iron Forger Shop!
entries.zh: 再点我一下就能打开铁锻造师商店！

entries.en: I've recently got into cooking, yesterday I made pasta carbonara, today I'm planning on baking a carrot cake.
entries.zh: 我最近迷上了做饭，昨天做了培根蛋面，今天打算烤个胡萝卜蛋糕。

entries.en: That's quite an excessive amount of carrots, but it'll do! Thanks, %1$s!
entries.zh: 胡萝卜是有点太多了，不过将就着用吧！谢啦，%1$s!

entries.en: Will have to order some food today then.
entries.zh: 那今天只好点外卖了。

entries.en: Seriously though, I only accept Coins.
entries.zh: 不过说真的，我只收硬币。

entries.en: Sup, %1$s? I am Jotraeline Greatforge, your one stop shop for refueling and upgrading Drills.
entries.zh: 嘿，%1$s?我是乔特雷琳·巨锻，给钻头加油和升级，找我一家就够了。

entries.en: ✆ Hey it's very nice of you, but I can't take your ONLY Abiphone!
entries.zh: ✆ 嘿，你人是真好，可我不能收下你唯一的一台阿比手机！

entries.en: I heard you have a composter in your barn, it happens to run on the same fuel drills run on! Could I check it out?
entries.zh: 听说你谷仓里有台堆肥器，它烧的燃料正好和钻头一样！我能去看看吗？

entries.en: Quite fascinating technology you have there, I'm sure with this machinery we could create even better appliances in the future!
entries.zh: 你那套技术真是妙极了，我相信有了这种机械，将来我们能造出更好的设备！

entries.en: That's alright! I'll just save up 12 years to be able to afford one myself.
entries.zh: 没关系！我攒个 12 年，自己也买得起一台。

entries.en: ✆ You have an Abiphone! I've always wanted an Abiphone Basic!
entries.zh: ✆ 你有一台阿比手机！我一直都想要一台阿比手机基础版！
祝你挖矿愉快！

entries.en: ✆ Oooh an Abiphone, thank you so much!
entries.zh: ✆ 哇，阿比手机！太谢谢你了！

entries.en: ✆ Now I can finally add Cole, and you!
entries.zh: ✆ 这下终于能加科尔了，当然还有你！

entries.en: ✆ Oooh an Abiphone, and a fancy one!
entries.zh: ✆ 哇，阿比手机！还是高级款！
✆ 太谢谢你了！

entries.en: This temple is locked, you will need to bring me a key open the door!
entries.zh: 这座神庙已经上锁，你得给我带一把钥匙来才能开门！

entries.en: This temple is locked, you will need to bring me a key to open the door!
entries.zh: 这座神庙已经上锁，你得给我带一把钥匙来才能开门！

entries.en: A Jungle Key! I will open the door for you.
entries.zh: 丛林钥匙！好，我这就替你开门。

entries.en: This temple does not have the treasure you are seeking at this time.
entries.zh: 眼下这座神庙里没有你要找的宝藏。

entries.en: Take this Metal Detector to scavenge the ground for lost items!
entries.zh: 拿上这个金属探测器，在地里翻找遗失的物件吧！

entries.en: Return the items to their rightful owners to gain a reward!
entries.zh: 把物件还给它们真正的主人，就能获得奖励！

entries.en: Talk to me when you have found a Scavenged %1$s.
entries.zh: 找到翻找到的 %1$s之后再来找我。

entries.en: Excellent! You have returned the Scavenged %1$s to it's rightful place!
entries.zh: 太好了！你把翻找到的 %1$s 放回了它原本的位置！

entries.en: Use your Metal Detector to find the remaining items!
entries.zh: 用你的金属探测器找到剩下的道具吧！

entries.en: You have already restored this Dwarf's Scavenged %1$s!
entries.zh: 你已经帮这位矮人找回过翻找到的 %1$s了！

entries.en: Use your Metal Detector to find the rest of the items!
entries.zh: 用你的金属探测器把剩下的道具都找齐吧！

entries.en: You found all of the items! Behold... the Jade Crystal!
entries.zh: 你找到了所有的道具！看啊……翡翠水晶！

entries.en: Punch the crystal in front of me to collect it!
entries.zh: 攻击我面前的水晶即可收集它！

entries.en: You haven't placed the Jade Crystal yet!
entries.zh: 你还没把翡翠水晶放上去呢！

entries.en: Go to the Crystal Nucleus to place it!
entries.zh: 去水晶核心把它放上去吧！

entries.en: You have already placed the Jade Crystal!
entries.zh: 你已经把翡翠水晶放上去了！

entries.en: Come back when you need to collect it again!
entries.zh: 等你需要再领一次的时候再回来吧！

entries.en: Excellent! You have returned the Scavenged Diamond Axe to its rightful place!
entries.zh: 太好了！你把拾荒钻石斧物归原主了！

entries.en: Talk to me when you have found a Scavenged Diamond Axe!
entries.zh: 带着拾荒钻石斧再来找我吧！

entries.en: Excellent! You have returned the Scavenged Golden Hammer to its rightful place!
entries.zh: 太好了！你把拾荒金锤物归原主了！

entries.en: Talk to me when you have found a Scavenged Golden Hammer!
entries.zh: 带着拾荒金锤再来找我吧！

entries.en: Talk to me when you have found a Scavenged Emerald Hammer!
entries.zh: 带着拾荒绿宝石锤再来找我吧！

entries.en: Excellent! You have returned the Scavenged Emerald Hammer to its rightful place!
entries.zh: 太好了！你把拾荒绿宝石锤物归原主了！

entries.en: Excellent! You have returned the Scavenged Lapis Sword to its rightful place!
entries.zh: 太好了！你把拾荒青金石剑物归原主了！

entries.en: Talk to me when you have found a Scavenged Lapis Sword!
entries.zh: 带着拾荒青金石剑再来找我吧！

entries.en: You haven't collected the Jade Crystal yet!
entries.zh: 你还没领取翡翠水晶呢！

entries.en: Why don'tcha come by the fire and sit down anywhere
entries.zh: 何不到火边来，随便找个地方坐下

entries.en: There was once a baby bear, little and cute,
entries.zh: 从前有一只小熊崽，又小又可爱,

entries.en: but the lil' bear had enough and said "that's my cue!"
entries.zh: 可小熊崽受够了，说了句“该我上场了！”

entries.en: she found an empty cabin, rusty and old,
entries.zh: 她找到一间空木屋，又旧又生锈,

entries.en: and threw some wood and watched the fire unfold
entries.zh: 扔了几块柴进去，看着火苗窜起来

entries.en: he got up and looked deep down the darkness
entries.zh: 他站起身，朝那片黑暗深处望去
你好，冒险者！

entries.en: I see you've found yourself in my cavernous kingdom.
entries.zh: 看来你发现了我这洞穴王国。

entries.en: All work here is rewarded, complete commissions and I will bestow you with riches!
entries.zh: 这里的劳动都有回报，完成委托，我将赐予你财富！

entries.en: Are you looking for the King?
entries.zh: 你在找国王吗？

entries.en: I'm not the King at the moment, I am but his humble servant.
entries.zh: 我现在不是国王，只是他卑微的仆从。
今天当值的国王是 %1$s。

entries.en: He's right here at this table!
entries.zh: 他就在这张桌子旁！
*咕噜* *咕噜*

entries.en: Did ya hear that, %1$s? That's the sound of an empty stomach.
entries.zh: 听见了吗，%1$s?那是空肚子叫的声音。

entries.en: I've been so hungry since the Goblin Queen tossed me aside
entries.zh: 自从被哥布林女王一脚踢开，我就一直饿着

entries.en: Bring me back a Goblin Egg of any type and we can teach her a lesson!
entries.zh: 随便给我带一颗哥布林蛋回来，咱们就能好好教训她一顿！

entries.en: Bring me any type of Goblin Egg and we can show the Goblin Queen what it's like to lose something she loves?!
entries.zh: 随便给我带一颗哥布林蛋，咱们就让哥布林女王也尝尝失去心爱之物的滋味？!
够狠吧？!

entries.en: That is certainly not the meal I am looking for! Bring me back a Goblin Egg and you will satiate my hunger.
entries.zh: 这绝对不是我要的那顿饭！给我带一颗哥布林蛋回来，才能填饱我的肚子。

entries.en: Where is that Goblin Egg? My Chef is waiting!
entries.zh: 那颗哥布林蛋呢？我的厨子还等着呢！

entries.en: These eggs will help me stomach my pain.
entries.zh: 有了这些蛋，我这份痛苦总算能咽下去了。

entries.en: Now let's hit the Queen where it hurts - by stealing her Amber Crystal!
entries.zh: 现在就往女王的痛处上戳——把她的琥珀水晶偷走！

entries.en: I'm covering you in my foul stench as we speak. It won't last long before it dissipates!
entries.zh: 我这就往你身上抹我的恶臭。这味道散得快，撑不了多久！

entries.en: Get to the Queen before my stench goes away and you'll be able to sneak past her imbecile Guards!
entries.zh: 趁我的臭味还没散，赶到女王那儿去，你就能从她那帮蠢卫兵眼皮底下溜过去！

entries.en: You must hurry! Get to the Goblin Queen before my stench escapes you!
entries.zh: 你得快点！赶在我的臭味散掉之前找到哥布林女王！
还有，离水远点！

entries.en: You need my foul stench again? Bring me a Goblin Egg of any type!
entries.zh: 又要用我的恶臭了？随便给我带一颗哥布林蛋来！

entries.en: Hey you! I broke my Lapis Pickaxe - do you think you could bring me another?
entries.zh: 喂，那边的！我的青金石镐断了——你能不能再给我弄一把？

entries.en: First you'll need to reach Lapis Lazuli Collection III, and then you can craft it for me.
entries.zh: 你得先把青金石收集 III 解锁了，才能给我做一把。

entries.en: Some items in SkyBlock can only be crafted when you reach a certain collection requirement.
entries.zh: 空岛里有些物品，必须达到相应的收藏品等级才能合成。

entries.en: To craft me a Lapis Pickaxe, you will need to reach Lapis Lazuli Collection III.
entries.zh: 想给我做一把青金石镐，你得先解锁青金石收集 III。

entries.en: Oh! You reached Lapis Lazuli Collection III!
entries.zh: 哦！你解锁青金石收集 III 了！

entries.en: Any chance you can craft me a new Lapis Pickaxe now?
entries.zh: 那现在能不能给我做一把新的青金石镐？

entries.en: Check the Recipe Book in your SkyBlock Menu to learn how to craft it!
entries.zh: 打开空岛菜单里的配方书就能看到怎么合成！

entries.en: Thank you! I appreciate your support in these trying times.
entries.zh: 谢谢你！在这种难熬的日子里，你的帮忙我记在心里了。

entries.en: For your trouble, here's a Compactor. Place it in a minion upgrade slot and it will automatically turn items into their block form once it's collected enough of them!
entries.zh: 麻烦你跑一趟，这个压缩器给你。把它装进小人的升级槽，它就会在攒够数量后自动把物品压成方块！

entries.en: I use it in my Lapis Minion, those things fill terribly fast!
entries.zh: 我在自己的青金石小人上就装了一个，那东西装满得可快了！

entries.en: My Lapis Pickaxe might not mine the fastest, but it gives me a lot of experience!
entries.zh: 我这把青金石镐挖得不算最快，但它给的经验可不少！

entries.en: I use that experience to enchant my Lapis Pickaxe with efficiency, which makes it mine faster!
entries.zh: 我就用这些经验给青金石镐附上效率，这样挖起来就快多了！
是不是很妙？

entries.en: Whoops! I lost my good pickaxe again in the mines. That's why I always come prepared with a backup!
entries.zh: 哎呀！我那把好镐子又丢在矿里了。所以我才总是随身多带一把备用的！

entries.en: It's probably down in the mine somewhere. Can you go find it?
entries.zh: 它八成还在矿里的某个角落。你能帮我找回来吗？

entries.en: Maybe one day I'll go back down there.
entries.zh: 说不定哪天我会自己下去一趟。
%1$s %2$s 日是我的休息日！

entries.en: I'd go mining but I'm too lazy.
entries.zh: 我倒是想去挖矿，可我太懒了。

entries.en: Find my pickaxe in the Gold Mine! I'm not going back down there...
entries.zh: 去金矿里找我那把镐子！我可不想再下去了……

entries.en: Smelting Touch is a really useful enchantment. It automatically smelts ores into ingots!
entries.zh: 「自动熔炼」是个非常好用的附魔。它能把矿石自动熔炼成锭！

entries.en: Collect iron and gold ingots with that pickaxe you found!
entries.zh: 用你找到的那把镐子去收集铁锭和金锭吧！

entries.en: The Deep Caverns are full of strange creatures and expensive treasures.
entries.zh: 深层洞穴里满是奇怪的生物和值钱的宝藏。

entries.en: Reach Mining Level V to gain access!
entries.zh: 挖矿等级到 5 级就能进去了！

entries.en: Have you spelunked the Deep Caverns?
entries.zh: 你去深层洞穴探过险了吗？

entries.en: They are full of bountiful treasures but watch out for those Lapis Zombies!
entries.zh: 那儿宝藏多得是，不过小心那些青金石僵尸！

entries.en: It's %1$s, my resting day! I earned myself a little treat, maybe you could bring me some chocolate?
entries.zh: 今天是%1$s,我的休息日！我得犒劳犒劳自己，你能不能给我带点巧克力来？

entries.en: Mmh! This is really good! I'll be sure to come back again when I'm no longer busy!
entries.zh: 唔！这个真好吃！等我不忙了一定再来！

entries.en: That's really unfortunate, I'll just come back again on my next resting day!
entries.zh: 那真是太可惜了，那我下个休息日再来吧！
嘿，伙计！

entries.en: I control this lift here behind me.
entries.zh: 我身后这台升降梯归我管。

entries.en: Once you've explored an area I can give you a safe ride back there.
entries.zh: 只要你去过某个区域，我就能安全地把你送回那儿。

entries.en: Be careful not to fall down the shaft though, it's a long way down!
entries.zh: 不过千万小心别掉进井里，下面深着呢！
祝你冒险顺利！

entries.en: Venture down into the Lapis Quarry to unlock my Lift Menu!
entries.zh: 去青金石采石场探险，解锁我的升降梯菜单吧！
那儿太深了，旅行者！

entries.en: For that you require Heart of the Mountain.
entries.zh: 要去那儿，你得先有山之心。

entries.en: Talk to Rhys, the Dwarven Emissary.
entries.zh: 去找矮人使节里斯谈谈吧。

entries.en: Operating that lift all day takes a lot outta ya, you know?
entries.zh: 整天开这台升降梯，可真够累人的，你知道吧？
干杯！这才够味儿！

entries.en: Back to the mines I go...
entries.zh: 我这就回矿里去……

entries.en: Looking to protect yourself or light up some tunnels?
entries.zh: 想防身，还是想照亮隧道？

entries.en: We've got torches, lanterns. Pretty much anything to suit your needs.
entries.zh: 火把、灯笼我们都有，基本上你要什么都能配齐。
跟你做生意真痛快。

entries.en: I'm looking to make some Jack o' Lanterns to help light up the Crystal Hollows - maybe you can help me out?
entries.zh: 我想做点南瓜灯，好照亮水晶洞窟——你能帮我一把吗？

entries.en: Nice doin' business with ya! Here's some copper in return.
entries.zh: 跟你做生意真痛快！这些铜就当是回礼。

entries.en: Not a problem, thanks for your time anyways.
entries.zh: 没关系，还是谢谢你抽空。

entries.en: My specialites are ores, stone, and mining equipment!
entries.zh: 我最拿手的就是矿石、石料和挖矿装备！
欢迎来到我们村子，旅行者！

entries.en: We have much to offer and explore - but be careful.
entries.zh: 这里有很多东西可看可换——不过要小心。

entries.en: The Kalhuiki tribe are a friendly people, but protective.
entries.zh: 卡尔怀基部族是友善的人，但护起自己人来毫不含糊。

entries.en: Do not attack our young, else we will put you down.
entries.zh: 别攻击我们的孩子，否则我们不会放过你。

entries.en: I'm supposed to collect some food for the village, the Kalhuiki people have been through a tough time recently.
entries.zh: 我得给村里收集些食物，卡尔怀基人最近日子很不好过。

entries.en: Perfect! I'll share the good news with my village!
entries.zh: 太好了！我这就把好消息带回村里！

entries.en: Mining Events on the Dwarven Mines happen regularly!
entries.zh: 挖矿活动在矮人矿洞会定期举行！

entries.en: They are a good way to earn Heart of the Mountain Exp, complete Commissions, and more!
entries.zh: 这是赚山之心经验、完成委托之类的好路子！

entries.en: If you ever need to know more about Mining Events, come talk to me!
entries.zh: 以后想多了解挖矿活动，随时来找我聊！

entries.en: People have no manners these days. They come up to me, and disappear instantly! They don't even greet me! Back in my day, we were raised better than that.
entries.zh: 现在的人真是一点礼貌都没有。走到我跟前，转眼就没影了！连声招呼都不打！想当年，我们可不是这么教出来的。

entries.en: It turns out, manners haven't all been lost yet.
entries.zh: 看来礼貌这东西还没彻底绝迹嘛。

entries.en: Of course. What else did I expect from this generation.
entries.zh: 果然如此。我还能对这一代人抱什么指望呢。

entries.en: You like flint? I like flint! I sell flint!
entries.zh: 你喜欢燧石？我也喜欢燧石！我就卖燧石！

entries.en: My brother is mining the gravel from the Spider's Den. We are the Flint Bros!
entries.zh: 我兄弟正在蜘蛛巢穴挖沙砾。我们是燧石兄弟！

entries.en: My brother is mining the gravel from the Spider's Den! We are the Flint Bros!
entries.zh: 我兄弟正在蜘蛛巢穴挖沙砾！我们是燧石兄弟！

entries.en: Pal, you seem a lil' lost over there,
entries.zh: 老兄，你在那边看着有点迷路啊,

entries.en: It's the scary story about the big bad bear
entries.zh: 这是个关于大坏熊的恐怖故事

entries.en: they'd always throw tantrums about what and who,
entries.zh: 他们总为了这个那个、为了谁谁谁大发脾气,

entries.en: but what came of that, let me tell you, it didn't end very good
entries.zh: 至于后来怎么样了嘛，我告诉你，结局可不太好

entries.en: "so he sat down by the chimney with paws freezing cold,
entries.zh: “于是他在烟囱边坐了下来，爪子冻得冰凉,

entries.en: but then something happened, the fire went out and he heard a loud creak
entries.zh: 可就在这时出事了，火灭了，他听见「咯吱」一声巨响

entries.en: Horror stories are better when you have something to snack on y'know? If you help us gather some ingredients, we could roast some tasty marshmallows.
entries.zh: 恐怖故事嘛，边听边有点零嘴才带劲，你说是吧？你要是帮我们凑齐材料，咱们就能烤点香喷喷的棉花糖。

entries.en: Thanks Pal! Why don't you sit around the campfire with us and enjoy these tasty treats?
entries.zh: 谢啦老兄！不如就坐在营火边和我们一起，好好享用这些好吃的？

entries.en: No supplies? You wouldn't want to experience what the lil' bear did, would you?
entries.zh: 没带东西？你总不想亲身体验一遍小熊的遭遇吧？

entries.en: This citadel used to be the epicenter of fructuous engineering.
entries.zh: 这座城塞曾经是繁盛工程学的中心。

entries.en: The inhabitants, Precursors, as they were once called, laid the foundations for the future.
entries.zh: 这里的居民，当年被称作先驱者，为未来打下了根基。

entries.en: However, they have been extinct for eons - only leaving the remnants of the Automatons behind.
entries.zh: 可他们已经灭绝了无数纪元，只留下了机关傀儡的残骸。

entries.en: One rather peculiar discovery is the Automaton Prime - the giant robot towering above me. The exact purpose of it is unknown, although it appears to be guarding something.
entries.zh: 其中一项格外奇特的发现，就是初代机关傀儡——也就是耸立在我身后的那个巨型机器人。它究竟是做什么用的还没人知道，不过看样子是在守着什么东西。

entries.en: There seems to be 6 key components to the giant that are missing.
entries.zh: 这个巨人似乎缺了 6 个关键部件。

entries.en: Each part - the Electron Transmitter, FTX 3070, Robotron Reflector, Superlite Motor, Control Switch, and a Synthetic Heart plays a distinctive role in the creation of this behemoth.
entries.zh: 每一个部件——电子发射器、FTX 3070、罗博特隆反射器、超轻马达、控制开关以及合成心脏——在这个庞然大物的构造里都各司其职。

entries.en: I think the Automatons nearby are built with similar components. Find them and bring them to me!
entries.zh: 我想附近那些机关傀儡用的应该是同类部件。找到它们，带来给我！

entries.en: That's not one of the components I need! Bring me one of the missing components:
entries.zh: 这不是我需要的组件！给我带一个还缺少的组件来:

entries.en: You have already delivered that part to me! Bring me a unique robot part!
entries.zh: 你已经把这个部件交给我了！给我带一个还没交过的机器人部件来！

entries.en: You've brought me all of the components!
entries.zh: 你把所有部件都带来了！

entries.en: I have uploaded them to the giant below...it appears it has opened its storage compartment!
entries.zh: 我已经把它们装到下面那个巨人身上了……看样子它的储物舱打开了！

entries.en: Perhaps the long-lost Sapphire Crystal is in there!
entries.zh: 失传已久的蓝宝石水晶说不定就在里面！

entries.en: That's not one of the compon-
entries.zh: 这不是那几个部——

entries.en: Wait a minute. This will work just fine.
entries.zh: 等一下。这个也完全能用。

entries.en: I have uploaded this to the giant below...it appears it has opened its storage compartment!
entries.zh: 我已经把这个装到下面那个巨人身上了……看样子它的储物舱打开了！

entries.en: You've brought me all of the components... I think? To be honest, I kind of lost count...
entries.zh: 你把所有组件都带给我了……我觉得？说实话，我好像有点数糊涂了……

entries.en: You haven't placed the Sapphire Crystal yet!
entries.zh: 你还没把蓝宝石水晶放上去呢！

entries.en: Thanks for bringing me the %1$s! Bring me %2$s more components to fix the giant!
entries.zh: 谢谢你把%1$s带来！再给我带 %2$s 个部件，就能把这个巨人修好了！

entries.en: You've brought me all of the components! I have uploaded them to the giant below...it appears it has opened its storage compartment!
entries.zh: 你把所有组件都带来了！我已经把它们上传给下面的大块头了……看起来它的储物仓已经打开了！

entries.en: Wait a minute. This will work just fine. I have uploaded this to the giant below...it appears it has opened its storage compartment!
entries.zh: 等一下。这个应该能用。我已经把它上传给下面的大块头了……看起来它的储物仓已经打开了！
▶▶不错！  ▲来，◀拿点▼◀ ▶秘银粉末吧！ ▲
▶▲方块▲ ◀不对◀ ▼▶再试一次▶▶
在我喜欢的国王里,Grandan 排第 7。

entries.en: Thormyr only sleeps and eats when he's not at this table. Nothing else.
entries.zh: Thormyr 不在这张桌子边的时候就只会睡觉和吃东西，别的什么都不做。
报歉,Brammor 真的太臭辣。

entries.en: I'm fairly sure Redros used to be a guard, and they added him to the table one day by mistake.
entries.zh: 我很确定 Redros 以前是个卫兵，是他们哪天不小心把他加进这张桌子的。

entries.en: Emmor is the King today... sigh.
entries.zh: Emmor 是今天的国王……唉。

entries.en: Erren keeps losing at Tic Tac Toe, but he loves the game. A brave man in a way.
entries.zh: Erren 老是输井字棋，但他很喜欢这个游戏。某种意义上也算个勇士。

entries.en: Emkam is funny at least. But that's about it.
entries.zh: 至少 Emkam 挺有趣的。不过也就这样了。

entries.en: The King made me go grocery shopping. Me! Can you believe that? He has a pair of perfectly good legs, and still, here I am.
entries.zh: 国王居然打发我去买菜。让我去！你敢信吗？他明明有一双好腿，结果跑腿的还是我。

entries.en: I bet when I am back, they are all still sitting around that table! All day, every day! It's ludicrous!
entries.zh: 我敢打赌，等我回去的时候，他们准还全都围坐在那张桌子边上！天天如此，一天到晚！简直荒唐！

entries.en: Oh, you refuse to work as well? I should have known.
entries.zh: 哦，你也不肯干活？我早该想到的。

entries.en: Redstone is such an amazing resource that can be used for so many different purposes.
entries.zh: 红石是一种用途广泛的神奇资源。

entries.en: For example, by leveling up your Redstone Collection, you can unlock more slots in your Accessory Bag!
entries.zh: 例如，提升你的红石收集等级，就能为饰品袋解锁更多栏位！

entries.en: Reach Redstone Collection II to unlock the Small Accessory Bag upgrade, then talk to me again!
entries.zh: 达到红石收集 II 级后即可解锁小型饰品袋升级，然后再来找我！

entries.en: You can increase your Redstone Collection by mining it here, in the Pigmen's Den.
entries.zh: 你可以在这里开采红石来提升红石收集等级，这里就是猪人巢穴。

entries.en: Filling your Accessory Bag grants you Accessory Power. If you speak to my friend Maxwell in the Village, he can channel that power into giving you bonus stats!
entries.zh: 往饰品袋中放入饰品即可获得饰品之力。去麦克斯韦所在的村庄找他，他能引导这股力量，为你提供额外属性！
谢谢，真是帮大忙了！

entries.en: If you can bring me 128 Redstone, I'll reward you with an extra slot for your Accessory Bag.
entries.zh: 如果你能带给我 128 个红石，我就奖励你一个额外的饰品袋栏位。

entries.en: You can find Redstone all around the Pigmen's Den, but the Pigmen don't really appreciate you stealing it.
entries.zh: 你能在猪人巢穴四处找到红石，不过猪人可不喜欢你偷走它。

entries.en: They roughed me up real good earlier, so I'm a bit worried about mining any myself. But, you look strong enough to go for it!
entries.zh: 它们刚才狠狠揍了我一顿，所以我有点不敢自己去挖。不过你看起来够强，肯定没问题！

entries.en: Alright, come back later when you want to give the items!
entries.zh: 好吧，想交材料时再回来！
太棒了！谢谢你的红石！

entries.en: Just as I promised, here's an extra Accessory Bag slot!
entries.zh: 我说到做到，这个额外的饰品袋栏位给你！

entries.en: You can view your Accessory Bag within the SkyBlock Menu.
entries.zh: 你可以在空岛菜单中查看饰品袋。

entries.en: If you can bring me 256 Redstone, I'll reward you with another slot for your Accessory Bag.
entries.zh: 如果你能带给我 256 个红石，我就奖励你另一个栏位，扩充你的饰品袋。
非常感谢！

entries.en: Now, as I promised, take another slot!
entries.zh: 和我承诺的一样，再收下一个栏位！

entries.en: We're not done yet though; This time I'll need 512 Redstone - that's 8 stacks! It's quite a lot, but I know you can do it.
entries.zh: 还没结束呢；这次我需要 512 个红石——也就是 8 组！数量不少，但我知道你能做到。

entries.en: This time I'll need 512 Redstone - that's 8 stacks! It's quite a lot, but I know you can do it.
entries.zh: 这次我需要 512 个红石——也就是 8 组！数量不少，但我知道你能做到。

entries.en: That's the most Redstone I've ever seen in one place! And it's all for me...
entries.zh: 这是我见过堆在一起最多的红石了！而且全都归我……

entries.en: Please, take another Accessory Bag slot! You deserve it!
entries.zh: 请再收下一个饰品袋栏位！这是你应得的！

entries.en: If you have any energy left, I have just one more task for you. Finally, I will need 1,024 Redstone. That's 16 stacks, if you didn't know.
entries.zh: 如果还有精力，我只剩最后一项任务。最后，我需要 1,024 个红石。那可是 16 组，你可能还不知道。

entries.en: I know it's a lot, so feel free to come back later if you're busy.
entries.zh: 我知道数量很多，所以如果你正忙，晚点再来也没关系。

entries.en: This time, I will need 1,024 Redstone. That's 16 stacks, if you didn't know!
entries.zh: 这次我需要 1,024 个红石。那可是 16 组，你可能还不知道！

entries.en: Great work! Here's your last Accessory Bag slot, you've earned it!
entries.zh: 干得漂亮！这是最后一个饰品袋栏位，你实至名归！

entries.en: With this much Redstone, there's no end to what I can do! The sky's the limit!
entries.zh: 有了这么多红石，我什么都能做到！没有上限！

entries.en: I hope you've come to appreciate Redstone as much as I do.
entries.zh: 希望你现在也和我一样懂得欣赏红石了。

entries.en: That's all I can do for you! If you still want more Accessory Bag slots, talk to Jacobus in the Village, or simply level up your Redstone Collection!
entries.zh: 我能为你做的就这些了！如果还想增加饰品袋栏位，可以去村庄找雅各布斯，或者直接提升红石收集等级！

entries.en: That's all I can do for you.
entries.zh: 我能帮你的就这么多啦。

entries.en: If you still want more Accessory Bag slots, talk to Jacobus in the Village, or simply level up your Redstone Collection!
entries.zh: 还想继续增加饰品袋栏位的话，可以去村庄找雅各布斯，或者提升你的红石收集等级！

entries.en: Oh wait, you already have Redstone Collection II!
entries.zh: 哦，等等，你已经达到红石收集 II 级了！

entries.en: In that case, would you like to help me out with something? In return, I can give you some more slots for your Accessory Bag.
entries.zh: 既然这样，你愿意帮我个忙吗？作为回报，我可以为你的饰品袋增加些栏位。

entries.en: Understandable, have a nice day. Please speak to me again if you ever change your mind.
entries.zh: 理解，祝你今天过得愉快。哪天改主意了，再来找我聊聊。
请选择: [交付材料] [不用了，谢谢！]

entries.en: The Pigmen around here are actually quite passive. They'll only attack if you or someone nearby mines too much Redstone.
entries.zh: 这附近的猪人其实挺温顺的。只有你或附近的人挖了太多红石，它们才会攻击。

entries.en: Working as part of the Fossil Research Team wasn't my first choice.
entries.zh: 其实我一开始并不想加入化石研究团队。

entries.en: I actually wanted to be a part of our sister team, who works on a tropical island studying cute little frogs.
entries.zh: 我本来想加入姐妹团队，去一座热带小岛研究可爱的小青蛙。

entries.en: As you can see, things didn't really work out...
entries.zh: 喏，你也看见了……后来没成。

entries.en: My neighbor is the most narcissistic guy I have ever seen.
entries.zh: 我邻居是我这辈子见过最自恋的人。

entries.en: My neighbor told me to get off his property, but he doesn't even own this place!
entries.zh: 我邻居让我滚出他的地盘，可这地方压根就不是他的！

entries.en: Maybe I have to talk to the King about him. He is going too far. I think the current King is %1$s.
entries.zh: 也许我该去找国王说说他的事。他实在太过分了。我记得现在这位国王是%1$s。
我不跟贱民说话。

entries.en: I don't really converse with your kind, but today I'll make an exception.
entries.zh: 我一般不跟你们这种人交谈，不过今天就破例一次。

entries.en: This is acceptable. I would never eat this myself, but it's good enough for my servants.
entries.zh: 这个还行。我自己是绝不会吃的，不过赏给仆人倒是够了。

entries.en: My disappointment is immeasurable. What a waste of my valuable time.
entries.zh: 我的失望无以言表。真是白白浪费我宝贵的时间。

entries.en: So you want to visit the Dwarven Mines?
entries.zh: 你想去矮人矿洞？

entries.en: You must prove yourself worthy of Heart of the Mountain...
entries.zh: 你得先证明自己配得上山之心才行……

entries.en: You are no match for the Dwarves of the Dwarven Mines.
entries.zh: 你还不是矮人矿洞中那些矮人的对手。

entries.en: Come back when you are Mining Level XII!
entries.zh: 等你的挖矿达到 XII 级再回来吧！

entries.en: You must bring me some valuable materials that peak my interest.
entries.zh: 你得给我带些能让我提得起兴趣的贵重材料来。

entries.en: I would like a total of 15 items. Any from this list will do:
entries.zh: 我总共要 15 件物品。下面这张单子里的任意几件都行:

entries.en: That's not an item I'm looking for!
entries.zh: 这不是我要的东西！

entries.en: I would like a total of 15 items. Any from the list will do:
entries.zh: 我总共要 15 件物品。那张单子里的任意几件都行:
谢谢你带来的这些东西！

entries.en: Perhaps you are someone we can get along with after all.
entries.zh: 看来你也许是个能相处得来的人。

entries.en: I'll get your Heart of the Mountain. It's time for a visit!
entries.zh: 我这就把你的山之心取来。是时候去看看了！

entries.en: Let's go together now. For future trips, remember the Lift Operator.
entries.zh: 我们现在就一起出发。以后要再去，记得找电梯操作员。

entries.en: Now that you have your Heart of the Mountain, you have access to all of the deeper areas of the mines!
entries.zh: 现在你有了山之心，矿山更深处的区域都对你开放了！

entries.en: You can access the Heart of the Mountain from the Mining Skill menu, and unlock loads of powerful upgrades as you continue your journey!
entries.zh: 你可以从挖矿技能菜单里打开山之心，随着旅程推进解锁大量强力升级！

entries.en: We Dwarves inhabit this area. We love it! It is rich in Mithril and even some Titanium.
entries.zh: 我们矮人就住在这一带。我们爱这儿！这里秘银储量丰富，甚至还有一些钛。

entries.en: You will need a good pickaxe to mine ores here. For Mithril, at least something with a Breaking Power of 4. Bubu just down the street could help you with that!
entries.zh: 要在这儿挖矿石，你得有把好镐子。想挖秘银，至少也得有开采等级 4 级的家伙。街那头的布布就能帮你弄到！

entries.en: If you're looking for better hardware, maybe try checking out the Forge. You could also visit the Royal Palace to talk to the King about certain tasks!
entries.zh: 想要更趁手的装备，不妨去锻造厂看看。你也可以去皇家宫殿找国王聊聊某些任务！

entries.en: Enjoy our little slice of mining heaven!
entries.zh: 好好享受我们这一小片挖矿天堂吧！

entries.en: I found an unexplored cave while mining for titanium. But it's too dark to see in there, even for me! Can you spare any glowing pumpkins?
entries.zh: 我挖钛矿的时候发现了一个没人探过的洞穴。可里面太黑了，连我都看不清！你能匀我几个发光的南瓜吗？
谢谢你！新发现在等着我们呢。

entries.en: Well then, I will even mine in total darkness if I must!
entries.zh: 那好吧，就算全黑我也照样挖！

entries.en: I had a sunburn once, I have stayed down there ever since.
entries.zh: 我晒伤过一次，从那以后就一直待在下面了。

entries.en: You can ask the Lift Operator for a ride to the Dwarven Mines!
entries.zh: 你可以找电梯操作员捎你去矮人矿洞！

entries.en: So you want to visit the Dwarven Mines? You must prove yourself worthy... I would like a total of %1$s items. Any from this list will do: %2$s
entries.zh: 你想去矮人矿洞？你得先证明自己配得上才行……我需要总共%1$s件物品。以下清单中的任意几件都可以: %2$s

entries.en: Watch yourself, traveler. There are creatures about.
entries.zh: 当心点，旅人。这附近有东西在游荡。

entries.en: Behold a fellow holder of Heart of the Mountain!
entries.zh: 瞧啊，又一位持有山之心的同道！
退后！

entries.en: Great treasures lie ahead, but at what cost?
entries.zh: 前方有无尽的宝藏，可代价又是什么呢？

entries.en: There are no miners like the dwarves.
entries.zh: 论挖矿，没人比得上矮人。

entries.en: What are you doing in my room?
entries.zh: 你在我房间里干什么？

entries.en: Get out of my room now!
entries.zh: 马上从我房间出去！

entries.en: I am going to call the guards if you don't leave
entries.zh: 你再不走我就叫卫兵了

entries.en: Guards! Take them into custody NOW!
entries.zh: 卫兵！马上把这人给我抓起来！

entries.en: Well hmph, I guess the guards are kind of busy right now...
entries.zh: 哼，好吧，看来卫兵这会儿都挺忙的……

entries.en: Can you just leave my room now?
entries.zh: 你现在能不能出去啊？

entries.en: I mean seriously, what is your problem?
entries.zh: 我说真的，你到底有什么毛病？

entries.en: I have never seen someone that stubborn before.
entries.zh: 我从没见过这么犟的人。

entries.en: Ok how about this, I'll give you 1,000 coins if you leave right now?
entries.zh: 好吧，这样如何:你现在就走，我给你 1,000 硬币？

entries.en: No? Ok ok how about 10,000 coins then?
entries.zh: 不干？好好好，那 10,000 硬币呢？

entries.en: For god's sake, please just leave my room!
entries.zh: 我的老天爷，你就行行好出去吧！

entries.en: Alright alright, how does 1 Million coins sound to you?
entries.zh: 行行行,100 万硬币你觉得怎么样？

entries.en: I guess you wanna stay poor?
entries.zh: 看来你是打定主意要一直穷下去了？

entries.en: You sure you don't want the coins?
entries.zh: 你确定不要这些硬币？
真——的确定？

entries.en: Welp I was kidding about the coins anyway...
entries.zh: 行吧，反正硬币那事我本来就是开玩笑的……

entries.en: Not going to give someone like you coins.
entries.zh: 才不会给你这种人硬币呢。
太宝贵了。
那么，最近过得怎么样？还不错？

entries.en: That's great to hear, how's the family?
entries.zh: 那真是太好了，家里人还好吗？

entries.en: Wonderful, so what brings you here actually?
entries.zh: 很好很好，话说回来，你到底是来干嘛的？

entries.en: What makes you play this game?
entries.zh: 是什么让你玩起了这个游戏？

entries.en: What makes you continue to click me over and over again?
entries.zh: 又是什么让你一遍又一遍地点我？

entries.en: You know this is gonna go on forever, right?
entries.zh: 你知道这会没完没了下去的吧？

entries.en: I won't stop until you go away.
entries.zh: 你不走，我就不停。

entries.en: So now that's out of the way, wanna hear a joke?
entries.zh: 行吧，这话说完了，想听个笑话吗？
你想听？
很好，准备好了！

entries.en: What kind of music did the gold nugget listen to?
entries.zh: 金粒最爱听什么音乐？
*重金属*
我知道，特别好笑吧！
还想再听一个吗？
我知道你想。

entries.en: Why don't mining towns have hospitals?
entries.zh: 为什么矿业小镇都不设医院？

entries.en: Because everyone there only ever suffers from ''miner'' injuries!
entries.zh: 因为那儿的人受的伤全是「矿伤」——说白了就是「轻伤」！
笑话就先讲到这儿吧……

entries.en: I am surprised you haven't left after those horrible jokes.
entries.zh: 讲了这么烂的笑话你居然还没走，真让我意外。

entries.en: Have you seen the monster behind you?
entries.zh: 你看见你背后那只怪物了吗？

entries.en: Yea over there, just outside of the door!
entries.zh: 对，就在那边，门外头！

entries.en: Go get it, it might want something from you.
entries.zh: 快去抓啊，说不定它有什么东西要给你呢。

entries.en: I think it's the Golden Goblin, it gives out free powder.
entries.zh: 我觉得那是金哥布林，它会白送粉末的。

entries.en: Get it before you'll regret it.
entries.zh: 趁早去抓，不然你会后悔的。

entries.en: Come on! Get it, you are gonna miss it!
entries.zh: 快去啊！去抓它，再不去就没了！

entries.en: Welp I guess no free powder for you then.
entries.zh: 行吧，那你就没有白送的粉末了。

entries.en: I have never seen someone stay this long in here.
entries.zh: 我从没见过谁在这儿待这么久。
你可真是个特别的生物。
你说不定该得点好东西！
但不是从我这儿拿。

entries.en: Anyway, do you want to see a magic trick?
entries.zh: 话说回来，你想看个魔术吗？
你想看？?
好，准备好！

entries.en: You need to turn around for this one.
entries.zh: 这个魔术你得转过身去才行。
你保证？
很好，现在转过身去！
噔——噔！
厉害吧？
你这么说我很难过……

entries.en: I guess I'll have to give up my magic career now. Again.
entries.zh: 看来我这魔术生涯又得放弃了。又一次。

entries.en: I had a lot of hopes and dreams.
entries.zh: 我曾经有过很多希望和梦想。

entries.en: I wanted to become a magician.
entries.zh: 我想成为一名魔术师。

entries.en: Perform on stage for thousands of people!
entries.zh: 在舞台上给成千上万的人表演！

entries.en: But I guess that's not gonna work anymore...
entries.zh: 可我看这事儿是没指望了……

entries.en: Because of you and those meddling kids...
entries.zh: 都怪你，还有那群多管闲事的小鬼……
我是说你。就你一个……
你毁了我的梦想。
我永远不会原谅你。

entries.en: Anyway, wanna grab a coffee some day?
entries.zh: 算了，哪天要不要一起去喝杯咖啡？

entries.en: I like mine with a lot of milk.
entries.zh: 我喜欢多加好多牛奶的那种。

entries.en: I don't know why I like milk so much.
entries.zh: 我也不知道自己为什么这么喜欢牛奶。

entries.en: Maybe I was a cow in my past life?
entries.zh: 也许我上辈子是头牛？

entries.en: Imagine I was a cow, how funny would that be?
entries.zh: 想象一下我是头牛，那得多好笑啊？
你想象得出来吗？
想象得出来吗？
再使劲想想
再使点劲！

entries.en: Welp now you imagined it a bit too much...
entries.zh: 行吧，你这下想得有点太用力了……
我现在变成一头牛了！
这到底是怎么做到的？?

entries.en: How can someone just turn into a cow just from someone imagining it?
entries.zh: 怎么会有人光靠别人想一想，就真的变成一头牛？

entries.en: Maybe I am not a cow, but instead just a hallucination and you are dreaming it all?
entries.zh: 又或者我根本不是牛，只是个幻觉，而这一切都是你在做梦？

entries.en: Have you ever thought about that?
entries.zh: 你有没有想过这种可能？
万一什么都不是真的呢？

entries.en: What if everything you knew and loved wasn't real?
entries.zh: 万一你所熟知、所珍爱的一切，全都不是真的呢？

entries.en: I mean that would be pretty crazy wouldn't it be?
entries.zh: 我是说，那可就太离谱了，对吧？

entries.en: What if you are just inside of a simulation?
entries.zh: 万一你其实就活在一个模拟里呢？

entries.en: And some higher power would control everything about you...
entries.zh: 而某种更高的存在操控着关于你的一切……

entries.en: How you look, how you talk, even the core fundamentals of who you actually are...
entries.zh: 你长什么样、你怎么说话，甚至你究竟是个什么样的人，统统都由它决定……
这我可不敢信。

entries.en: I don't think that actually happens with any of us, right?
entries.zh: 我觉得这种事不会发生在我们身上，对吧？

entries.en: I am still a cow somehow, can you stop imagining me as a cow now?
entries.zh: 我怎么还是头牛啊，你能别再把我想成牛了吗？
什么？
我现在变成羊了？??
我不是这个意思啊！!

entries.en: I mean technically I said I didn't wanna be a cow anymore and you kind of did what I asked of you...
entries.zh: 好吧严格来说，我确实说了不想再当牛，你也算是照我说的做了……

entries.en: But I didn't think you would turn me into another animal?!
entries.zh: 可我没想到你会把我变成另一种动物啊？!

entries.en: Whatever, I think I like being a sheep anyway.
entries.zh: 算了，反正当只羊我好像还挺喜欢的。
我这身毛可真蓬松！
我在这儿待着可舒服了。

entries.en: Maybe that's better than becoming a magician?
entries.zh: 说不定这比当魔术师还好？
变成一只羊！
这才叫生活啊。

entries.en: You just roam around all day and eat grass.
entries.zh: 整天到处溜达，吃吃草。

entries.en: Isn't that the dream of all humans?
entries.zh: 这难道不是全人类的梦想吗？

entries.en: To one day stand in a field and eat grass?
entries.zh: 有朝一日站在田野里吃草？

entries.en: No? I guess that's just me then...
entries.zh: 不是？那看来只有我这么想了……

entries.en: By the way, the reward I told you about earlier?
entries.zh: 对了，我之前跟你提过的那个奖励？

entries.en: The one that you would get from me?
entries.zh: 就是你能从我这儿拿到的那个？

entries.en: There is none. There is no cake.
entries.zh: 一个都没有。没有蛋糕。

entries.en: What, did I just say cake?
entries.zh: 什么，我刚才说「蛋糕」了吗？
我是想说，什么都没有。
蛋糕是个谎言。
别惦记了。

entries.en: There will be no cake whatsoever!
entries.zh: 根本不会有什么蛋糕！

entries.en: This is a no cake zone.
entries.zh: 这里是无蛋糕区。

entries.en: It says it on the sign right over there.
entries.zh: 那边的牌子上就是这么写的。

entries.en: "No cake zone" It says it right there!
entries.zh: “无蛋糕区”,那儿写得清清楚楚！

entries.en: See? So it's clear now, there is no cake.
entries.zh: 看到没？这下清楚了吧，没有蛋糕。

entries.en: Glad we got that over with.
entries.zh: 总算把这事说明白了。
因为根本没有奖励。
一个都没有。
话说回来，你叫什么名字？
%1$s?这名字真难听
我见过好听得多的名字。
好听得多得多。

entries.en: That one you have - not good.
entries.zh: 你这个——不行。

entries.en: Just wanted to make that clear.
entries.zh: 我就是想把话说明白。
话说回来，你问我叫什么？
我没有名字。

entries.en: I need one more ingredient to make The Cake for the next person I can get to listen to me.
entries.zh: 我还差一样材料，就能给下一个肯听我说话的人做「那个蛋糕」了。

entries.en: This should do it! I've got some counting to do.
entries.zh: 这样应该就够了！我还得算算账去。

entries.en: What cake? There is no cake.
entries.zh: 什么蛋糕？根本没有蛋糕。

entries.en: My mother told the doctor to not give me a name.
entries.zh: 我妈当年跟医生说，别给我取名字。

entries.en: Because that's the best name - to not have name.
entries.zh: 因为那才是最好的名字——压根没有名字。

entries.en: Think about it, there is nothing to make fun of about your name if you don't even have one.
entries.zh: 你想想看，你要是连名字都没有，别人还能拿你的名字取笑什么呢。
我妈简直是个天才！
跟我一样！

entries.en: I guess she got that from me.
entries.zh: 我猜这点是她随我。

entries.en: Actually that doesn't make any sense...
entries.zh: 话说回来，这好像根本说不通……

entries.en: I mean of course it does, because I am a genius!
entries.zh: 不对不对，当然说得通，因为我是个天才！

entries.en: Anyway, aren't you getting tired of this?
entries.zh: 算了，你难道还没腻吗？

entries.en: Talking to a guy in a game?
entries.zh: 在一个游戏里跟一个人说话？

entries.en: Inside a palace in a cave on a floating island?
entries.zh: 而且还是在一座浮空岛的山洞里的宫殿里？

entries.en: If you asked me, that makes no sense...
entries.zh: 要我说，这根本说不通……
这到底是怎么运作的？
算了……

entries.en: I think I am gonna get some rest soon.
entries.zh: 我想我该去休息一会儿了。
时候不早了。

entries.en: I have a big day tomorrow.
entries.zh: 我明天有件大事要办。
要不你也回去吧？

entries.en: I mean it's pretty dark outside.
entries.zh: 外面天都黑透了。

entries.en: It's better you also go to sleep.
entries.zh: 你也早点睡比较好。
来，这块蛋糕给你！

entries.en: I know I said there is no cake.
entries.zh: 我知道我说过没有蛋糕。

entries.en: But the lie was a lie!
entries.zh: 但那句谎话本身也是谎话！
我撒了两次谎。
不过你还是做到了。

entries.en: You got what you wanted from me.
entries.zh: 你从我这儿拿到了你想要的东西。

entries.en: Even though you probably just looked it up somewhere.
entries.zh: 虽说你八成是在哪儿查到的攻略。

entries.en: And didn't even know about this beforehand.
entries.zh: 自己事先根本不知道有这回事。

entries.en: But regardless, I hope you are happy now.
entries.zh: 但不管怎样，希望你现在开心了。
到此为止了。
我们的对话到此为止。
结束了！
全都结束了……

entries.en: You can stop talking to me now.
entries.zh: 你现在可以不用再跟我说话了。

entries.en: You got exactly what you wanted from me.
entries.zh: 你想从我这儿要的，一样不少全拿到了。
现在结束了。

entries.en: If you wanna thank anyone, this is the time.
entries.zh: 你要是想谢谁，趁现在。
因为已经完事了——结束了。
说真的，结束了。
没有别的了。

entries.en: I'll start counting down, if you don't leave by then, I will be very angry...
entries.zh: 我开始倒数了，数完你还不走，我可要真生气了……
好，我开始数了！
0 时间到！
你居然还在这儿？!

entries.en: Didn't I tell you to go?
entries.zh: 我不是让你走了吗？

entries.en: I'll give you a second chance.
entries.zh: 我再给你一次机会。

entries.en: This time I am gonna give you a lot more time.
entries.zh: 这次我给你的时间会多得多。

entries.en: I am gonna start counting down again!
entries.zh: 我要重新开始倒数了！
哇，你居然做到了！
你真的等了这么久？
老天，你可真够执着的
你干这个干了好几个小时？?
你就这么一直等着？

entries.en: And no server restart made you disappear?
entries.zh: 连房间重启都没把你弄消失？!

entries.en: I don't know what to say...
entries.zh: 我都不知道该说什么了……

entries.en: I am sorry though, there is nothing here.
entries.zh: 不过很抱歉，这儿真的什么都没有。
这次是真的到头了。
我发誓！

entries.en: Now you can finally go to sleep.
entries.zh: 现在你总算可以去睡觉了。
这是我最后一次跟你道别！
好梦！

entries.en: Hi, I'm the janitor of this mine.
entries.zh: 你好，我是这座矿井的清洁工。

entries.en: You would not believe how many people leave ingots and stones behind them!
entries.zh: 你绝对想不到有多少人会把锭块和石头落在这里！

entries.en: It drives me insane, but at least you unlocked Auto-pickup.
entries.zh: 这简直让我抓狂，不过好在你已经解锁了自动拾取。

entries.en: It makes my job a lot easier, but despite that, I still find so many items on the ground.
entries.zh: 这让我的工作轻松了许多，可即便如此，我还是会在地上发现许多物品。

entries.en: Maybe some of those items are yours? In which case I'll let you buy them back.
entries.zh: 也许其中有些就是你的？如果真是这样，我可以让你把它们买回去。

entries.en: You found the Lazy Miner's pickaxe!
entries.zh: 你找到了懒惰矿工的镐子！

entries.en: I'll have to put it in my stores.
entries.zh: 我得把它放进店里。
再点我一次！

entries.en: It drives me insane, but at least you'll unlock Auto-pickup at SkyBlock Level %1$s.
entries.zh: 这简直让我抓狂，不过好在你到空岛 %1$s 级就能解锁自动拾取了。

entries.en: Maybe some of these items are yours? In which case I'll let you buy them back.
entries.zh: 说不定这些物品里就有你的？真是那样的话，我可以让你把它们买回去。
你问我有没有捡到阿比手机？

entries.en: Yes, sometimes I do find one lying around.
entries.zh: 有啊，有时候地上就能捡到一部。
我这个清洁工？

entries.en: I don't... don't know what to say...
entries.zh: 我都……不知道该说什么好了……

entries.en: Yes of course you can have it!
entries.zh: 当然，当然可以给你！

entries.en: Nice to meet you. I'm Scout Plinius, a Dwarven Scout.
entries.zh: 很高兴认识你。我是斥候 Plinius,一名矮人斥候。

entries.en: Are you about to head into the Glacite Tunnels?
entries.zh: 你是准备去极冰矿道吗？

entries.en: Well, try to keep track of where you are!
entries.zh: 那可要随时留意自己走到哪儿了！

entries.en: If you ever get a bit too Cold you can always warm yourself up over at the Campfire!
entries.zh: 要是觉得太冷，随时可以去营火旁暖暖身子！

entries.en: Try to watch your step, word around is that there are a lot of old Glacite Mineshafts hidden around this place.
entries.zh: 走路小心些，听说这附近藏着不少老旧的极冰矿井。

entries.en: See that giant cliff with the giant crystal?
entries.zh: 看到那边那座立着巨大水晶的悬崖了吗？

entries.en: At night, my friends host a secret meeting in a nearby secret cave.
entries.zh: 晚上，我的朋友们有个秘密聚会，就在附近一个隐秘的洞穴里。

entries.en: Drop by some time, out secret club is open!
entries.zh: 有空就来看看吧，我们的秘密俱乐部随时欢迎你！

entries.en: If my friends approve of you, they'll give you a special item.
entries.zh: 如果我的朋友们认可你，他们会给你一件特别的道具。

entries.en: Come back to me then and show it to me!
entries.zh: 到时候把它拿回来给我看看！

entries.en: Hurrah! A fellow member of the Cult of the Fallen Star!
entries.zh: 太好了！又一位陨落之星教团的同伴！

entries.en: Hey, I've crafted new tech to let us locate Fallen Stars easily.
entries.zh: 嘿，我做了个新装置，能让我们更容易找到陨落之星。
来看看吧！

entries.en: With the Fallen Star Lozenge, you can find Fallen Stars much easier!
entries.zh: 有了坠星菱片，你找陨落之星就轻松多了！

entries.en: Now go find some stars, but don't forget about the next meeting of the Cult!
entries.zh: 现在去找几颗星星吧，不过别忘了教团的下次聚会！

entries.en: I expect to see you there!
entries.zh: 我等着你到场！

entries.en: Hey you! Help me I'm stuck!
entries.zh: 喂，那边的！救救我，我卡住了！

entries.en: I fell asleep and when I woke up I was too large to fit the entrance!
entries.zh: 我睡了一觉，醒来就发现自己胖得从入口钻不出去了！

entries.en: Maybe you can punch me out.
entries.zh: 要不你把我打出去试试。
哇，这我可没想到！

entries.en: Thank you so much, I stayed there for weeks!
entries.zh: 太感谢你了，我在那儿卡了好几个星期！

entries.en: You freed me, and helped me find the love of my life!
entries.zh: 你不但把我放了出来，还帮我找到了此生挚爱！
拿着这份心意，算是我的回礼！
真是太感谢你了！

entries.en: Maybe I feel such an intense connection with my other half because, it was literally my other half?
entries.zh: 也许我和我的另一半之间感应这么强烈，是因为——它本来就真的是我的另一半？

entries.en: Ah, a fresh face in these parts!
entries.zh: 哟，这地方来了张新面孔！

entries.en: Ye've got the look of someone who ain't afraid to delve deep into the earth's belly.
entries.zh: 看你的样子，倒是不怕钻进地底深处。

entries.en: Name's Sor'Hen, and before ye ask, no, I'm not here for the camaraderie.
entries.zh: 我叫索尔亨。先说好，我来这儿可不是为了交朋友。

entries.en: I've got me eyes on the prize - ancient artifacts and the truth behind the lost king, Divan.
entries.zh: 我盯上的是宝贝——古代遗物，还有失落国王迪万背后的真相。
说说吧，你来这儿干什么？
稀有物品，是吧？

entries.en: Well, ye've got the spirit of a true miner then.
entries.zh: 这么说来，你倒真有几分矿工的劲头。

entries.en: In these lands, the earth hides secrets and treasures older than any of us.
entries.zh: 这片土地底下藏着秘密，还有比咱们所有人年纪都大的宝藏。
来，收下这个。

entries.en: Found that beauty myself, deep in the shadows of those mines.
entries.zh: 这宝贝是我亲手找到的，就在那些矿井深处的阴影里。

entries.en: It's but a glimpse of what's buried beneath.
entries.zh: 跟地底埋着的东西比起来，它不过是冰山一角。

entries.en: Suspicious Scrap are always surprising, may this one guide ye to riches and revelations.
entries.zh: 可疑碎屑总会带来意外之喜。但愿这份能带你找到财富，也解开些谜团。

entries.en: We'll cross paths again, I'm sure.
entries.zh: 我相信，咱们还会再见的。

entries.en: The mines have a way of bringing like-minded souls together.
entries.zh: 矿山总能让志同道合的人走到一起。

entries.en: Hop in and we'll be off!
entries.zh: 上车吧，我们这就出发！

entries.en: See that empty, weak metal box? Good! That's your cart, hop in!
entries.zh: 看到那个空荡荡、脆弱的铁盒子了吗？没错！那就是你的车厢，上车吧！

entries.en: Hold tight, it's going to be a bump ride!
entries.zh: 坐稳了，这一路可有得颠了！

entries.en: Thanks for choosing Dwarven Mine Co. - we operate 24/7 across the whole mine!
entries.zh: 感谢你选择矮人矿业公司——我们在整座矿山全天候运营！

entries.en: Now, please climb aboard before your cart leaves without you.
entries.zh: 现在请赶紧上车，免得车开走了却没有你。
再来一次。
出发咯！

entries.en: Ever been in one of these before? No?
entries.zh: 以前坐过这玩意儿吗？没有？
我相信你肯定没问题的！
