entries.en: Last guy who was in this cart didn't feel too well so watch out he might have left a surprise in there.
entries.zh: 上一个坐这辆车的人下来时脸色不太好，你小心点，他八成在里面留了点“惊喜”。

entries.en: Quickly now the Minecart is leaving!
entries.zh: 快点，矿车要开了！
欢迎来到矮人村庄！

entries.en: Off to the court? I would tell you to talk to the King but I don't know who he is anymore...
entries.zh: 去朝廷那边？我本想让你去找国王聊聊的，可我现在也不知道国王到底是谁了……

entries.en: Did you know the Court is almost as old as the throne room, it's got some lovely flower beds too!
entries.zh: 你知道吗，朝廷那地方差不多和王座厅一样古老，那儿的花圃也很漂亮！

entries.en: See those statues? They are the former Kings, Bunumir Ironbeard and Skordous Pebblebeard, guarding the entrance to the mines.
entries.zh: 看见那些雕像了吗？那是两位先王,Bunumir Ironbeard 和 Skordous Pebblebeard,守着矿山的入口。

entries.en: Aristocrat passage ey? Best of luck to you.
entries.zh: 去贵族通道啊？那祝你好运了。

entries.en: Did you know that the Forge is so big it has to have multiple forging stations.
entries.zh: 你知道吗，锻造厂大到必须设好几个锻造台才够用。

entries.en: You ever seen those Goblins? Some say they lay eggs. How weird.
entries.zh: 你见过那些哥布林吗？有人说它们会下蛋。真是怪事。

entries.en: Goblin's are not the only creatures that dwell here. Rumor has it dirt monsters linger in these parts too...
entries.zh: 住在这儿的可不止哥布林。传闻这一带还游荡着泥土怪……

entries.en: Fell into a state of disrepair following an accident.
entries.zh: 出过一次事故之后，这里就一直荒废着。

entries.en: I once stumbled upon a hidden lake in these parts, Some unsavory characters living there robbed me of all my gold!
entries.zh: 我有一次误打误撞找到了这一带一个隐秘的湖，结果住在那儿的几个不三不四的家伙把我的金子抢了个精光！

entries.en: You came down the lift? I never thought you could get this far down! Someone should have called this place the Deeper Caverns!
entries.zh: 你是坐升降梯下来的？我从没想过还能下到这么深！这地方真该叫“更深层洞穴”才对！

entries.en: Hey, if you find any Titanium down here let me know! I wanted to buy some of that stuff for a new pickaxe.
entries.zh: 嘿，你在下面要是找到钛就告诉我一声！我想买点回来打把新镐子。

entries.en: Last guy who was in this cart didn't feel too well so watch out for a surprise.
entries.zh: 上一个坐这节车厢的人身体不太舒服，所以小心会有"惊喜"哦。

entries.en: I'm not really in the mood to talk right now
entries.zh: 我现在不太想说话
至少现在不想
我今天只谈正事

entries.en: Things to do, places to be
entries.zh: 有事要办，有地方要去
谢谢你这些漂亮的花

entries.en: They're a gift to myself, sort of
entries.zh: 算是我送给自己的礼物吧

entries.en: You see, recently I spoke to the wizard up in his big tower
entries.zh: 你看，我最近和塔楼上那位巫师聊过

entries.en: He told me that he finally got his portal to work
entries.zh: 他跟我说，他的传送门终于弄成了

entries.en: And that he knew of an alternate version of himself who existed, stuck in another world
entries.zh: 还说他知道存在着一个和他不一样的自己，被困在另一个世界里

entries.en: I wonder if there is an alternate version of myself out there too
entries.zh: 我在想，外面会不会也有另一个我

entries.en: But would he still really be me?
entries.zh: 可他真的还是我吗？

entries.en: If he has lived in such a different world and experienced so many different things
entries.zh: 如果他活在一个如此不同的世界里，经历了那么多不同的事

entries.en: Is he still me by anything other than name?
entries.zh: 那除了名字之外，他还有哪一点算是我呢？

entries.en: I am Tal Ker, and I speak often and loud
entries.zh: 我是塔尔·克尔，我话多，嗓门大

entries.en: But what if he is Tal Ker, who speaks little and softly
entries.zh: 可要是他也是塔尔·克尔，却话少、声音轻呢

entries.en: What if he has lived an entire life in silence
entries.zh: 要是他一辈子都活在沉默里呢

entries.en: Not feeling like anyone cares for what he has to say
entries.zh: 总觉得没人在乎他要说什么

entries.en: So he simply does not speak
entries.zh: 于是他索性就不说了

entries.en: In that case, are we still the same Tal Ker?
entries.zh: 那样的话，我们还算是同一个塔尔·克尔吗？
也许他是用歌声说话的

entries.en: And passes time by playing the piano
entries.zh: 靠弹钢琴打发时间

entries.en: Maybe he's been playing for so long that he's gotten really good at it
entries.zh: 也许他弹了太久，已经弹得非常好了

entries.en: And, if we ever met, maybe we would just sit in silence
entries.zh: 如果我们真见了面，也许我们就只是静静地坐着

entries.en: And he would play me a song
entries.zh: 然后他给我弹一首曲子

entries.en: And he would share with me tales of his life, and his strange world, all without saying a word.
entries.zh: 他会把他这一生的故事，还有他那个奇异的世界，全都讲给我听——一个字都不用说。

entries.en: Maybe if I went to this alternate dimension I would become like him
entries.zh: 也许我要是去了那个平行的维度，我就会变成他那样

entries.en: Maybe I would speak less, think more
entries.zh: 也许我会话更少，想得更多

entries.en: And maybe you would come along one day
entries.zh: 也许有一天你也过来了

entries.en: And tell me that I've changed
entries.zh: 跟我说，我变了

entries.en: And maybe I would tell you that I have never been more me
entries.zh: 而我大概会告诉你，我从来没有像现在这样像我自己

entries.en: Because maybe I shouldn't worry that my alternate self isn't enough like me
entries.zh: 因为也许我不该担心另一个我不够像我

entries.en: Maybe I should worry that I'm not more like my alternate self
entries.zh: 也许我该担心的是，我不够像另一个我
你懂吗？

entries.en: I wonder what your alternate self is like
entries.zh: 我很好奇，另一个你会是什么样子
也许他是个花匠

entries.en: And they give out flowers to everyone, even if they can't afford them
entries.zh: 见人就送花，哪怕自己根本负担不起

entries.en: Maybe that's why you are short on flowers in this life
entries.zh: 也许这就是为什么这一世的你，花总是不够用

entries.en: Because your other self gave them all away
entries.zh: 因为另一个你，把花全都送出去了
我可不是什么讨厌鬼

entries.en: But given that you see me as such, I shall depart.
entries.zh: 不过既然你把我当成讨厌鬼，那我就走了。
就此别过！

entries.en: I'm the guy that never stops talking
entries.zh: 我就是那个说个不停的家伙

entries.en: All I do is say stuff
entries.zh: 我干的事就是不停地说

entries.en: I'm not entirely sure why but I can't help it
entries.zh: 我也不太清楚为什么，但就是控制不住

entries.en: There really is no point talking to me
entries.zh: 其实跟我说话真没什么意义
我什么都不会给你

entries.en: I won't even say anything interesting
entries.zh: 我甚至说不出什么有意思的话

entries.en: I just talk about random things
entries.zh: 我只是随便说说
比如说

entries.en: The other day I met some kind of wizard
entries.zh: 前几天我遇到了个什么巫师

entries.en: And they told me to come back in 3 to 5 business days
entries.zh: 他让我 3 到 5 个工作日后再来

entries.en: That was over a year ago
entries.zh: 那都是一年多以前的事了
到现在还是没消息

entries.en: What kind of people do that?
entries.zh: 什么样的人会这么干啊？

entries.en: Tells you to come back in a few days for no reason
entries.zh: 无缘无故让你过几天再来
真是让人深思

entries.en: Also this guy, Crappox or something
entries.zh: 还有这家伙，叫 Crappox 还是什么来着

entries.en: Told me to kill enemy monsters for him
entries.zh: 让我帮他杀敌对怪物

entries.en: I asked him how much he'd pay me
entries.zh: 我问他给我多少钱

entries.en: He said I had to pay him instead
entries.zh: 他说得反过来，是我付他钱
我怎么想都想不通

entries.en: I met a guy called Jerry too
entries.zh: 我还见过一个叫杰瑞的家伙
聪明人，前途无量

entries.en: Met him a few times in fact, he's always around
entries.zh: 其实碰到过他好几次，他老是在附近

entries.en: Not the best for conversations but
entries.zh: 虽然不太擅长聊天，不过

entries.en: At least he's a good listener
entries.zh: 至少他是个很好的听众

entries.en: And I like that, good listeners
entries.zh: 我就喜欢这样，好的听众

entries.en: But you know what I don't like listening to?
entries.zh: 但你知道我不喜欢听什么吗？
弹那种竖琴的人

entries.en: You know the one I'm talking about?
entries.zh: 你知道我说的是哪种吧？

entries.en: Always people playing it, but terrible music
entries.zh: 总有人在弹，但弹出来的曲子难听死了

entries.en: Sometimes they even stop in the middle of the song
entries.zh: 有时候弹到一半还会突然停下来

entries.en: And they restart, just like that
entries.zh: 然后又重新开始，就这么干
也是没谁了

entries.en: There's also this guy who's asking me to race him sometimes
entries.zh: 还有个家伙，时不时找我比赛

entries.en: He's acting like he's the best
entries.zh: 摆出一副自己天下第一的样子

entries.en: But I always beat him first try
entries.zh: 但我每次都是一把就赢他
他这是有什么毛病？
不过至少他挺有个性的

entries.en: Most people always talk about coins around here
entries.zh: 这里的人大多总是聊硬币

entries.en: Everything has a value, and time is money
entries.zh: 什么都有价格，时间就是金钱

entries.en: People don't take their time to enjoy the little things
entries.zh: 人们都不愿花时间去享受生活里的小事
我敢说你也一样

entries.en: You really think I'm going to reward you with something
entries.zh: 你该不会真觉得我会给你点什么奖励吧
但我不会的，我发誓

entries.en: You can leave at any time and it won't affect anything
entries.zh: 你随时可以走，不会有任何影响

entries.en: I just like to talk, I can go on for hours
entries.zh: 我就是喜欢说话，能说上几个小时

entries.en: Someone told me I was interesting once
entries.zh: 曾经有人说我很有意思
我一点都不信

entries.en: So many people lying and trying to be your friend
entries.zh: 太多人一边撒谎一边想跟你套近乎
他们都别有目的
尤其是那些市长候选人

entries.en: All they want is your vote
entries.zh: 他们要的只是你的一票

entries.en: But do they really care about me?
entries.zh: 但他们真的在乎我吗？
怀疑 [x]

entries.en: It's always so black and white with them
entries.zh: 他们看事情总是非黑即白
挖矿、钓鱼，从来不搭边

entries.en: Why is that? What if I like mining and fishing?
entries.zh: 为什么会这样？万一我两个都喜欢呢？

entries.en: But there is no point arguing
entries.zh: 但争论这个没什么意义
反正他们永远是对的

entries.en: And the people, sheep I say
entries.zh: 至于其他人，我说啊，都是绵羊

entries.en: They always vote for the same
entries.zh: 他们总是投给同一个人
每次都是一边倒

entries.en: Everyone wants to do like everyone else
entries.zh: 大家都想跟别人一样

entries.en: Not me, I'm a free spirit
entries.zh: 我可不是，我是个自由的灵魂
我告诉你为什么

entries.en: My home is clean and beautiful
entries.zh: 我家又干净又漂亮
你的小岛漂亮吗？

entries.en: A proper island is the key to success
entries.zh: 一座像样的小岛是成功的关键

entries.en: Healthy island leads to healthy life
entries.zh: 健康的小岛才有健康的生活

entries.en: Also, remember those island we could place?
entries.zh: 对了，还记得那些我们能放置的小岛吗？

entries.en: Like the sand one and forest one?
entries.zh: 比如沙地那个，还有森林那个？

entries.en: What happened to those, why not more?
entries.zh: 那些后来怎么样了，为什么没有更多？
真奇怪，当时看着挺有前途的
结果你们得到的是我
有时候我会想

entries.en: If I wasn't talking, what would people do instead
entries.zh: 如果我不说话了，大家会干什么呢

entries.en: Am I a waste of time and space
entries.zh: 我是不是在浪费大家的时间和空间

entries.en: Is that why I'm here, on this world
entries.zh: 所以我才会出现在这个世界上吗

entries.en: Maybe it's time I do something with my life
entries.zh: 也许是时候该干点正经事了
我可以去竞选市长

entries.en: I wonder if people would vote for me
entries.zh: 不知道会不会有人投我

entries.en: What would my program even be?
entries.zh: 我的竞选纲领又该是什么呢？

entries.en: I would reward people for talking
entries.zh: 我会奖励爱说话的人

entries.en: But not those who talk about their auctions, yuck
entries.zh: 但不包括那些整天聊拍卖的人，呸

entries.en: I would reward people who explore and walk around
entries.zh: 我会奖励那些喜欢探索、四处走走的人

entries.en: I would fill the village with friends with amazing stories to tell
entries.zh: 我会让村子里住满能讲精彩故事的朋友

entries.en: But who would vote for me
entries.zh: 但又有谁会投我呢

entries.en: Maybe instead I should stay there and keep talking
entries.zh: 也许我还是该留在这儿继续说下去
说话是我最喜欢的活动

entries.en: I like events but I prefer uneventful days
entries.zh: 我喜欢活动，但更喜欢平淡无事的日子

entries.en: That way I can keep talking
entries.zh: 这样我才能继续说下去

entries.en: I can't believe you are still listening
entries.zh: 真不敢相信你还在听

entries.en: You are one of a kind
entries.zh: 你真是独一无二

entries.en: I have many more stories up my sleeve
entries.zh: 我肚子里还有好多故事呢

entries.en: Like that time I found a fairy soul
entries.zh: 比如我找到仙女之魂的那次

entries.en: I went to Tia after because she asked me to
entries.zh: 后来我去找了蒂娅，因为她让我去

entries.en: So I asked her, what are fairy souls?
entries.zh: 于是我问她，仙女之魂到底是什么？

entries.en: And she said they are the remains of dead fairies
entries.zh: 她说那是死去妖精的遗骸

entries.en: Isn't that terrible?! So many dead fairies everywhere!
entries.zh: 这不是很可怕吗？! 到处都是死去的妖精！

entries.en: She also said that all those fairies didn't die a peaceful death.
entries.zh: 她还说那些妖精都不是安详死去的。

entries.en: They were all killed! A long time ago.
entries.zh: 它们都是被杀死的！很久以前的事了。

entries.en: But why would anyone do that? And who did it?
entries.zh: 但为什么会有人做这种事？又是谁干的？

entries.en: The strangest part is, Tia really didn't seem phased about it.
entries.zh: 最奇怪的是，蒂娅听起来一点也不在意。

entries.en: Just thinking about it I have a chill down my spine.
entries.zh: 光是想想就让我脊背发凉。
那些妖精真是奇怪。

entries.en: But you know what else is strange?
entries.zh: 但你知道还有什么奇怪的吗？

entries.en: Accessories, I mean what are those
entries.zh: 饰品，我是说，那到底是什么东西

entries.en: I have an entire bag full of accessories
entries.zh: 我有整整一袋子饰品

entries.en: I'm basically a garage sale at this point
entries.zh: 我现在基本就是个跳蚤市场了

entries.en: My favorite one is the cat one
entries.zh: 我最喜欢的是猫那个
我爱猫

entries.en: I want a cat pet but not the black one, bad memories
entries.zh: 我想要只猫宠物，但不要黑色的，有不好的回忆

entries.en: Cats are the best, they listen to me
entries.zh: 猫是最棒的，它们会听我说话

entries.en: I think they are learning, one day they will take control
entries.zh: 我觉得它们在学习，总有一天会掌权

entries.en: But be my guest, a cat mayor is all I need
entries.zh: 不过随便它们，猫市长正合我意

entries.en: My second favorite activity is sleeping
entries.zh: 我第二喜欢的活动是睡觉

entries.en: But even in my sleep, I dream of talking
entries.zh: 但即使在梦里，我也在梦见说话

entries.en: Sometimes I dream that I'm talking to myself
entries.zh: 有时候我会梦见自己在跟自己说话

entries.en: A whole table with 10 clones of me around it
entries.zh: 一整张桌子，周围坐着 10 个我的分身

entries.en: All of us pretending to be more interesting than the others
entries.zh: 大家都假装自己比别人更有意思

entries.en: But how could we? We are all the same
entries.zh: 但这怎么可能呢？我们都是一样的

entries.en: I guess my dreams are not very creative
entries.zh: 我猜我的梦不太有创意

entries.en: I don't have a great imagination, that's why I never lie
entries.zh: 我想象力不太好，所以我从不撒谎

entries.en: I wonder though, do you think there will be another world like this one day?
entries.zh: 不过我在想，你觉得有一天会不会出现另一个像这样的世界？

entries.en: Somewhere else, not exactly the same, but better in some way
entries.zh: 在别的地方，不完全一样，但在某些方面更好

entries.en: Also it sounds crazy but, do you think we could exist without cubes?
entries.zh: 还有，虽然听起来挺离谱的，但你觉得没有方块我们还能存在吗？

entries.en: Ender Pearls are my favorite items
entries.zh: 末影珍珠是我最喜欢的道具

entries.en: Not because of what they do, but because they are circles
entries.zh: 不是因为它们的用途，而是因为它们是圆的

entries.en: I wish the world was a circle too, it's so much prettier
entries.zh: 我希望这个世界也是圆的，那样漂亮多了

entries.en: I'd love to be in a circle world
entries.zh: 我很想生活在一个圆形的世界里

entries.en: Maybe there is a circle world somewhere, with someone just like me
entries.zh: 也许在某个地方就有一个圆形世界，住着一个和我一样的人

entries.en: In their circle world, dreaming of a cubic world
entries.zh: 在他们的圆形世界里，梦见一个方块世界

entries.en: You really are a great listener
entries.zh: 你真的是个很棒的听众

entries.en: Now I regret saying I wouldn't reward you
entries.zh: 现在我有点后悔说过不会奖励你了

entries.en: But I swore, and I am a man of my words
entries.zh: 但我发过誓，我是个信守承诺的人

entries.en: But thank you for listening, I appreciate it a lot
entries.zh: 不过还是谢谢你愿意听我说，我真的很感激

entries.en: I hope that you are happy and that everything is good in your life
entries.zh: 我希望你过得开心，生活中一切顺利

entries.en: There are ups and down sometimes but there is always a shinning light
entries.zh: 生活总有起起落落，但总会有一束光在闪耀

entries.en: My shinning light is you, a beam of hope in this dark cave
entries.zh: 我的那束光就是你，这黑暗洞穴里的一线希望

entries.en: I'll tell you the story of my life
entries.zh: 我来给你讲讲我的人生故事

entries.en: Once upon a time, on an island far away
entries.zh: 很久以前，在一座遥远的小岛上

entries.en: I used to live in a small town, we had a house, 2 floors and an attic
entries.zh: 我曾经住在一个小镇上，我们家有栋房子，两层楼加一个阁楼

entries.en: Back then I was quite shy and reserved
entries.zh: 那时候我挺害羞、挺内向的

entries.en: I liked reading and listening to birds
entries.zh: 我喜欢看书，听鸟叫

entries.en: There was always a cat around the house, sometimes killing the birds
entries.zh: 家附近总有只猫，有时候会咬死那些鸟

entries.en: I hated that cat with a passion, but my parents seemed to enjoy its presence
entries.zh: 我恨透了那只猫，但我父母好像挺喜欢它待在那儿

entries.en: One day the cat gave birth to 3 little devils, and decided to hide them in our attic
entries.zh: 有一天那只猫生了 3 只小恶魔，还把它们藏进了我们家阁楼

entries.en: They were making so much noise, right above my room
entries.zh: 它们吵得要命，就在我房间正上方

entries.en: I never understood the reason we had to leave them be, I wanted them out
entries.zh: 我一直不明白为什么非得由着它们，我只想把它们赶出去

entries.en: One day after sundown, a fire started spreading in our house
entries.zh: 有一天日落之后，我们家突然起了火，火势越来越大

entries.en: Quickly we understood it was too late to stop it, and exited the house with our valuables
entries.zh: 我们很快意识到已经来不及扑灭了，就带着值钱的东西逃出了房子

entries.en: I was asked if I knew whether or not the kittens were still inside the house
entries.zh: 有人问我知不知道那些小猫是不是还在屋里

entries.en: When asked that question, I remained silent, but I knew the answer
entries.zh: 被问到这个问题时，我一言不发，但我心里清楚答案

entries.en: Soon after, the flames were engulfing the house
entries.zh: 没过多久，大火就吞没了整栋房子

entries.en: Suddenly the mom cat appeared from the shadows of the night and ran into the house
entries.zh: 突然，那只猫妈妈从夜色中冲了出来，径直跑进了屋子

entries.en: This creature usually so afraid of the fire, rushed into the infernal flames
entries.zh: 这个平时最怕火的生物，冲进了地狱般的烈焰之中

entries.en: About 20 seconds later, the cat passed the front door again, holding one of their cubs
entries.zh: 大约 20 秒后，那只猫又出现在前门，嘴里叼着一只幼崽

entries.en: And immediately after, dashed back inside the fire to save the rest of their litter
entries.zh: 紧接着又立刻冲回火里，去救剩下的孩子

entries.en: After the second trip, the cat was burning, but still went back in, right after making sure the cub was safe
entries.zh: 第二趟回来时，猫身上已经着了火，但确认幼崽安全后，它还是又冲了进去

entries.en: I waited 30 seconds, my eyes fixed on the front door, holding my breath
entries.zh: 我等了 30 秒，眼睛死死盯着前门，屏住了呼吸

entries.en: Finally it came out with the last kitten
entries.zh: 终于，它叼着最后一只小猫出来了

entries.en: The cat was in terrible shape, but the kittens were safe
entries.zh: 那只猫已经伤得很重，但小猫们都安然无恙

entries.en: It looked one last time at them, and died next to the 3 little bodies
entries.zh: 它最后看了它们一眼，就倒在那 3 只小猫身边，再也没有醒来

entries.en: I was in shambles, never in my life had I been so wrong
entries.zh: 我整个人都垮了，这辈子从没这么彻底地看错过一件事

entries.en: Later on I buried the cat under my favorite tree, and adopted their cubs
entries.zh: 后来我把那只猫埋在了我最喜欢的那棵树下，收养了它的孩子们

entries.en: I loved those 3 little devils with all my heart and gave them all the care in the world
entries.zh: 我全心全意地爱着那 3 只小家伙，把能给的照顾全都给了它们

entries.en: They became beautiful and happy cats, their mom would have been proud
entries.zh: 它们后来都长成了漂亮又快乐的猫，它们的妈妈一定会为它们骄傲

entries.en: This event changed me to my very core, everything about me had to change
entries.zh: 这件事彻底改变了我，我整个人都不一样了

entries.en: From that day I never hated anything anymore, and never stopped talking
entries.zh: 从那天起，我再也没恨过任何东西，也再没停止说话

entries.en: But having said this story, I'll exceptionally need to take a break
entries.zh: 不过讲完这个故事，我破例得歇一会儿

entries.en: I haven't told that story to many people
entries.zh: 这个故事我没跟多少人讲过

entries.en: Thank you for listening to me
entries.zh: 谢谢你听我说这些

entries.en: I still need to think, but I'll probably want to talk again later. Come back tomorrow.
entries.zh: 我还需要想想，不过我大概之后还会想再聊聊的。明天再来吧。
哦，你回来了！

entries.en: For a moment I thought you wouldn't
entries.zh: 有那么一瞬间我还以为你不会来了

entries.en: I'm sorry if I spooked you a little bit last time
entries.zh: 如果上次把你吓到了，我很抱歉

entries.en: Sometimes I get carried away too much and tell personal stories
entries.zh: 有时候我会一时兴起，讲太多私事
我道歉

entries.en: You can call me Tal, some people call me TK
entries.zh: 你可以叫我 Tal,也有人叫我 TK

entries.en: I don't actually live there, I'm just visiting
entries.zh: 我其实不住在那儿，只是过来看看

entries.en: Maybe one day I'll show you my place
entries.zh: 也许哪天我会带你去我住的地方看看

entries.en: I think I had dwarves somewhere in my family tree
entries.zh: 我觉得我祖上大概有矮人的血统

entries.en: That's why I look like one
entries.zh: 所以我长得才这么像矮人

entries.en: I like visiting islands, some more than others
entries.zh: 我喜欢到处逛小岛，当然有些更喜欢一些

entries.en: Golden Mines, Crimson Isle... haven't been there in ages
entries.zh: 黄金矿场、绯红孤岛……好久没去了

entries.en: I used to go to the End a lot, not anymore
entries.zh: 我以前经常去末地，现在不去了

entries.en: The dragon heart corrupts everything, even the people
entries.zh: 末影龙之心会腐化一切，连人也不例外

entries.en: I like it better down here, there are people like you
entries.zh: 我更喜欢待在下面这里，这儿有像你这样的人

entries.en: The story of these mines is old, older than the End island for sure!
entries.zh: 这座矿山的历史很悠久，肯定比末地岛还要古老！

entries.en: You do know the story of the End island right?
entries.zh: 你知道末地岛的故事吧？
呃，这就有点尴尬了

entries.en: I guess they don't really teach you much do they
entries.zh: 看来他们没怎么教你东西啊

entries.en: Unfortunately I don't know enough details myself
entries.zh: 可惜我自己也不太清楚细节

entries.en: I do know a few things, you remember the giant skeleton on the island nearby?
entries.zh: 不过我确实知道一些，你记得附近那座岛上的巨大骷髅吗？

entries.en: The heart of that creature is sealed on the End island
entries.zh: 那个生物的心脏被封印在末地岛上

entries.en: Not many people are left, who can tell the story of that day
entries.zh: 现在没剩多少人能讲清楚那天发生的事了

entries.en: Maybe Jerry saw it, when he was very young
entries.zh: 也许杰瑞小时候见过

entries.en: And even he was probably born much later
entries.zh: 但就算是他，大概也是很久以后才出生的

entries.en: The Calamity is the reason why the earth got shattered into many islands
entries.zh: 正是"大灾变"让大地四分五裂，变成了如今这些小岛

entries.en: I wish I knew more, it's a fantastic subject
entries.zh: 真希望我知道得更多，这话题太有意思了

entries.en: The end of an era, and the beginning of a much darker one
entries.zh: 一个时代的终结，也是一个更加黑暗的时代的开端

entries.en: Sorry if I'm boring you, I like history
entries.zh: 如果让你觉得无聊我很抱歉，我就是喜欢历史

entries.en: I went to the Sky Academy, greater teachers there
entries.zh: 我上过天空学院，那儿的老师更厉害

entries.en: You should go there someday, even greater adventurers need to learn a few things!
entries.zh: 你哪天也该去看看，再厉害的冒险者也得学点东西！

entries.en: My parents always told me to focus on my studies
entries.zh: 我父母总是让我专心学习

entries.en: They were right, I'm a successful young man now!
entries.zh: 他们是对的，我现在可是个成功人士！

entries.en: Maybe not so young, but my point still stands
entries.zh: 也许没那么年轻了，但我的意思还是没变

entries.en: Studies on one side and fun on the other, both are very important
entries.zh: 一边是学习，一边是玩乐，两边都很重要

entries.en: Yin and yang, one should not go without the other
entries.zh: 阴和阳，缺了哪个都不行

entries.en: The Academy was tough, but I met a few friends there
entries.zh: 学院的日子挺苦的，不过我在那儿交到了几个朋友
你知道那个银行家吗？

entries.en: He was in my promotion back then
entries.zh: 他当年跟我是同一届的
银行就是他发明的！

entries.en: I still have no idea where all that interest is coming from
entries.zh: 我到现在都搞不懂那些利息到底是从哪儿来的
这家伙真是个天才

entries.en: I like seeing the world evolve through time
entries.zh: 我喜欢看着这个世界随时间演变

entries.en: What they did to the village a few years ago was great
entries.zh: 几年前他们对村子做的改造真不错

entries.en: I feel like we entered the modern age
entries.zh: 感觉我们已经进入了现代

entries.en: The technology is progressing fast, who knows what's coming next!
entries.zh: 科技进步得这么快，谁知道接下来还会有什么呢！

entries.en: I'm sure one day people will fly to the moon
entries.zh: 我相信总有一天人们会飞上月球

entries.en: I knew a time without adventurers, without banks and auctions
entries.zh: 我经历过那个没有冒险者、没有银行也没有拍卖行的年代

entries.en: Not much was happening back then
entries.zh: 那时候没什么大事发生
然后，事情就发生了

entries.en: One day hordes of people appeared out of nowhere
entries.zh: 有一天，成群结队的人不知从哪儿冒了出来
好像没人知道原因

entries.en: I have my theory but I won't tell you
entries.zh: 我有自己的猜测，但我不会告诉你

entries.en: You would think I'm crazy, maybe you already do
entries.zh: 你会觉得我疯了，说不定你已经这么想了
一下子来了那么多人
真的让人应接不暇

entries.en: It did create so many business opportunities
entries.zh: 不过这倒是带来了不少商机
经济一片繁荣

entries.en: That guy, Bazaar, he really took advantage of it
entries.zh: 那家伙——集市——真是把这机会用透了

entries.en: Bazaar isn't even his real name
entries.zh: 集市其实都不是他的真名

entries.en: He changed his name to Bazaar because it was better for business, he said
entries.zh: 他说改名叫集市对做生意更有利
真是个"人才"

entries.en: Lots of people think they understand the market
entries.zh: 很多人都觉得自己看懂了市场
我早就放弃搞懂它了

entries.en: I did buy some stocks of stonks when he opened
entries.zh: 他开张的时候，我倒是买了点 stonks 的股份
我手里现在还留着一些

entries.en: That Warren guy made a lot of money and disappeared
entries.zh: 那个叫 Warren 的家伙赚了一大笔钱就消失了
又是个"鲨鱼"

entries.en: Maybe I should sell my own currency and make people believe it's worth many coins
entries.zh: 也许我也该发行自己的货币，让大家相信它值很多硬币
比如 Talcoins?

entries.en: The value of anything is in the eyes of the buyers
entries.zh: 任何东西的价值都取决于买家怎么看

entries.en: I'm sure I could raise the price of anything if I really tried
entries.zh: 我敢说只要我真想，什么东西的价格我都能炒起来

entries.en: Some people do that all the time in the community
entries.zh: 这个圈子里总有人一直在这么干

entries.en: I like it though, it creates opportunities for everyone
entries.zh: 不过我倒挺喜欢的，这给了每个人机会

entries.en: I think a lot of what happens around here can serve as a life lesson
entries.zh: 我觉得这儿发生的很多事都能当作人生的一课

entries.en: It's important to experience the right things when you are young
entries.zh: 年轻的时候经历对的事情很重要

entries.en: Even bad moments can be blessings in disguise
entries.zh: 就算是糟糕的时刻，也可能是因祸得福

entries.en: Someone scammed me a very valuable thing one day
entries.zh: 曾经有人骗走了我一件非常值钱的东西

entries.en: They even got away with it, awful
entries.zh: 他们居然还成功脱身了，真过分

entries.en: But never again have I gotten fooled
entries.zh: 但从那以后我再也没被骗过

entries.en: If I could I would pay him double
entries.zh: 要是可以的话，我愿意付他双倍的钱

entries.en: A lesson for a few coins, a great deal
entries.zh: 花几个硬币买个教训，真是太划算了
永远保持警惕

entries.en: Some people don't see it the same way
entries.zh: 有些人不这么看

entries.en: Do you know the origin of the word utopia?
entries.zh: 你知道"乌托邦"这个词的由来吗？

entries.en: It means a place that does not exist
entries.zh: 它的意思是"不存在的地方"

entries.en: Even the people who created the word knew it was a paradox
entries.zh: 就连创造这个词的人自己都知道这是个悖论

entries.en: Some people are smarter than hundreds of other combined
entries.zh: 有些人比其他上百个人加起来还聪明

entries.en: Do you think they were born that way, or became?
entries.zh: 你觉得他们是生来如此，还是后天变成这样的？

entries.en: I have my own view on the matter
entries.zh: 对这件事我有自己的看法

entries.en: My opinion is that it's a little bit of both
entries.zh: 我的看法是两者都有一点

entries.en: The smartest baby would become a monkey if it wasn't taught anything
entries.zh: 就算是最聪明的婴儿，如果什么都不教，也会变得像猴子一样

entries.en: Someone told me a story one day
entries.zh: 有一天有人跟我讲了个故事

entries.en: Bird eggs are grey and dirty, snake eggs are white and clean
entries.zh: 鸟蛋灰灰脏脏的，蛇蛋又白又干净

entries.en: The bird decided to sit on the clean egg instead of his
entries.zh: 那只鸟决定去孵那颗干净的蛋，而不是自己的

entries.en: The egg hatched and the snake ate the bird
entries.zh: 蛋孵化了，蛇把那只鸟吃掉了

entries.en: He told me the moral of the story is that birds are stupid
entries.zh: 他跟我说这个故事的寓意是鸟很蠢

entries.en: But is that the moral of the story?
entries.zh: 但这真的是故事的寓意吗？

entries.en: Maybe it's about appearances being deceiving
entries.zh: 也许这个故事讲的是外表会骗人

entries.en: A clean shell can hide a dirty mind
entries.zh: 干净的外壳也可能藏着肮脏的心思

entries.en: Maybe it's about beauty being subjective
entries.zh: 也许讲的是"美"是很主观的

entries.en: If the bird found dirty eggs pretty, he wouldn't have gotten in that situation
entries.zh: 要是那只鸟觉得脏蛋也好看，就不会落到那步田地了
也许讲的是要提前规划

entries.en: Short term comfort can lead to troubles in the future
entries.zh: 眼前的舒适可能会给将来带来麻烦

entries.en: Maybe it's about trusting your family more than others
entries.zh: 也许讲的是要更信任家人，而不是外人

entries.en: If you tell the same story to multiple people they might understand it differently
entries.zh: 同一个故事讲给不同的人听，他们理解的可能都不一样

entries.en: What do you think is the moral of the story?
entries.zh: 你觉得这个故事的寓意是什么？

entries.en: I love talking, but I also think a lot!
entries.zh: 我喜欢说话，但我也很喜欢思考！

entries.en: I'm going to think for a bit, thanks for listening to me! See you!
entries.zh: 我要去想一会儿了，谢谢你听我说！回头见！
嗝儿？……嗝儿嗝！

entries.en: My wife said we can have a sleepover if you promise not to break anything this time.
entries.zh: 我老婆说了，只要你保证这次别再打碎东西，我们就可以办过夜聚会。

entries.en: You said you never even saw the plates.
entries.zh: 你说过你压根没看见那些盘子。

entries.en: I was thinking of hosting it on the fifteenth?
entries.zh: 我本来想定在十五号？

entries.en: Jobs may come and go, but the Cult of the Fallen Star is eternal.
entries.zh: 工作可以来来去去，但陨落之星教团是永恒的。
太好了。

entries.en: Hold up, guys. My wife's calling.
entries.zh: 等一下各位，我老婆打电话来了。

entries.en: Hello? Mhm? Okay. Calm down. Yes, I'll come and look, make sure you check under the porch.
entries.zh: 喂？嗯？好。你先别急。好，我这就回去看看，你记得找找门廊底下。

entries.en: Cat again. I've got to go.
entries.zh: 猫又跑了。我得走了。

entries.en: Today I have something I'd like to talk about.
entries.zh: 今天我有件事想说。
上次那个过夜聚会。

entries.en: We're never having another one again.
entries.zh: 我们再也不办第二次了。

entries.en: I wonder why. Where do I start?
entries.zh: 你说为什么呢？我该从哪儿说起好？

entries.en: You didn't take your shows off when you came in.
entries.zh: 你进门连鞋都不脱。

entries.en: You also left the door open, so the cat ran out and I had to spend an hour looking for him.
entries.zh: 你还把门开着，猫跑出去了，我找了一个小时。

entries.en: And, while I was doing that, you ate all of the pizza I ordered for us.
entries.zh: 我在外面找猫的时候，你把我给大家点的披萨全吃光了。

entries.en: You then fell asleep in my bed before the show we were meant to watch even began.
entries.zh: 然后我们说好要一起看的剧还没开播，你就在我床上睡着了。

entries.en: You don't even know which two people died!
entries.zh: 你连死的是哪两个人都不知道！
剧透你活该。还有——
抱歉。

entries.en: Hello? Missing? Again? Okay. Yep, I can hear you. I'll be right there.
entries.zh: 喂？又不见了？好。嗯，我听得见。我这就过去。
不是，是我老婆。

entries.en: Nah, it's fine. She'll be getting a cuppa down in Scarleton. Thought it was her day off.
entries.zh: 没事，不要紧。她八成是跑去绯红城喝下午茶了。我还以为她今天休息呢。

entries.en: I should probably go and tell her that she's supposed to be at work.
entries.zh: 我最好还是过去告诉她一声，她今天该上班。

entries.en: Guys, today I have something super urgent to discuss.
entries.zh: 各位，今天我有件特别紧急的事要讨论。

entries.en: Well... you think there are more doors or wheels in this world?
entries.zh: 那个……你们觉得这世上是门多还是轮子多？

entries.en: I've been thinking about it all week, and I believe there are probably more wheels.
entries.zh: 我想了整整一个星期，我认为应该是轮子更多。

entries.en: Well, first of all, many houses don't even have doors. For example, many of us dwarves don't use them.
entries.zh: 首先，很多房子压根就没有门。比如我们矮人里就有不少人不用门。

entries.en: Like, you could just walk right on in to the dwarven palace, if it wasn't for the guards.
entries.zh: 你看，要不是有卫兵拦着，你完全可以一路直接走进矮人宫殿。

entries.en: Yeah. Unless you're like, a philosopher, or something.
entries.zh: 对啊。除非你是那种……哲学家之类的。

entries.en: And then, when you think about it, every minecart has four wheels, but no door on it.
entries.zh: 然后你仔细一想，每辆矿车都有四个轮子，可一扇门都没有。

entries.en: And us, being dwarves, have a whole lot of minecarts.
entries.zh: 而我们矮人，矿车多得是。
可它就是轮子啊！

entries.en: Because everyone calls it a wheel!
entries.zh: 因为大家都管它叫轮子啊！

entries.en: Now that I think about it, no. I've never seen a minecart actually move. They're always in the same place!
entries.zh: 现在这么一想，还真没有。我从没见过矿车真的动起来。它们永远都停在原地！

entries.en: Then what are they there for? Just for decoration?
entries.zh: 那它们摆在那儿是干嘛的？纯粹当摆设？

entries.en: Guys... are we living in a simulation?
entries.zh: 各位……我们是不是活在一个模拟里？
贝德诺姆永远都在做噩梦。

entries.en: Brynmor always loses his Speckled Teacup.
entries.zh: 布林莫尔永远都在弄丢他的斑纹茶杯。

entries.en: Fetchur always needs someone to bring him something.
entries.zh: 费彻永远都要人帮他带东西。

entries.en: And, when we asked them about it, none of them knew why they do what they do!
entries.zh: 而我们问起他们的时候，没有一个人说得出自己为什么要这么做！

entries.en: To think I was right all along.
entries.zh: 没想到我一直都是对的。
我简直不敢相信……

entries.en: We really are living in a XsimulationX!
entries.zh: 我们真的活在一个 X 模拟 X 里！

entries.en: Please don't leave, %1$s, I don't want to die!
entries.zh: 求你别走，%1$s,我不想死！

entries.en: How about we order a pizza?
entries.zh: 要不我们点份披萨吧？

entries.en: Ooh, a blue pizza! That's my favorite!
entries.zh: 哦！蓝披萨！那是我最爱吃的！

entries.en: Hopefully it'll all be over when we wake up tomorrow...
entries.zh: 但愿明天一觉醒来，这一切都过去了……

entries.en: Hop on in and I'll get you going!
entries.zh: 上车吧，我这就送你走！
欢迎来到%1$s!

entries.en: They're always sitting at this table. All day, every day...
entries.zh: 他们总是坐在这张桌旁，日复一日……

entries.en: There isn't much going on in our caves at the moment so they don't have much to talk about.
entries.zh: 眼下我们的洞穴里没什么动静，所以他们也没多少可聊的。

entries.en: Most of their time is spent trying to decide who is going to be the next king.
entries.zh: 他们大部分时间都在设法决定下一任国王由谁来当。

entries.en: And then once they have decided on a new king he gets bored and names another new king almost instantly.
entries.zh: 可他们刚选出新国王，他转眼就会觉得无聊，几乎立刻又任命一位新国王。

entries.en: Most of their time is spent trying to decide who's going to be the next king.
entries.zh: 他们大部分时间都在商量，下一任国王该由谁来当。

entries.en: Currently the reigning king is %1$s. I think...
entries.zh: 现在在位的国王是 %1$s。我想应该是吧……
噢！
哎哟！
住手！
这很疼！

entries.en: You need to be taught some manners.
entries.zh: 看来得有人教教你规矩了。
够了！给我过来！
咱们把这事了结了吧。

entries.en: With the right tools, you can get through anything!
entries.zh: 工具用得对，什么障碍都挡不住你！

entries.en: My abiphone is for Platinum-level donors of the Walter cause only.
entries.zh: 我的阿比手机只向沃尔特事业的白金级捐赠者开放。

entries.en: You know these superbooms don't craft themselves right?
entries.zh: 你知道的，这些超爆 TNT 可不会自己蹦出来，对吧？

entries.en: You just need Sulphur Collection 7 and to then donate an Enchanted Sulphur Cube!
entries.zh: 你只要达到硫磺收集 7 级，再捐赠一个附魔硫磺立方就行！

entries.en: Welcome to the Platinum club, high roller!
entries.zh: 欢迎加入白金俱乐部，大金主！
随时给我打电话！

entries.en: And before you ask... yes, I do try to commercialize all of my friendships.
entries.zh: 先说好……没错，我确实想把每一份友情都变成生意。

entries.en: Mmh... you're missing something to become a Platinum-level donor...
entries.zh: 唔……想成为白金级捐赠者，你还差点东西……

entries.en: Hello traveler! Would you like to try my new recipe?
entries.zh: 你好啊旅行者！要不要尝尝我的新菜谱？

entries.en: This meat is a special blend of well... everything.
entries.zh: 这肉是特调的，用的是……嗯，所有东西。

entries.en: Ahh you stinky humans must have weak stomach. Maybe you will like my Zog stew?
entries.zh: 啊，你们这些臭烘烘的人类肠胃就是弱。那我的佐格炖菜你或许会喜欢？
哦，那好吧，下次再说。

entries.en: Ooooh, what's this? You bring Xalx funny little seed and strange crop?
entries.zh: 噢——这是什么？你给扎尔克斯带来了好玩的小种子和奇怪的作物？

entries.en: Smells... weird. But not bad weird! Good weird! Like stew left in sun for three days.
entries.zh: 闻着……怪怪的。但不是难闻的那种怪！是好怪！像在太阳底下晒了三天的炖菜。

entries.en: Hmmm... something missing. Needs... more! More flavor! More stink!
entries.zh: 唔……还差点什么。还要……再多点！再多点味道！再多点臭味！

entries.en: Here, take this back. Let it... marinate. Yes, marinate! Then it be ready.
entries.zh: 来，先拿回去。让它……腌一腌。对，腌一腌！那样才算好。

entries.en: Hello gardener, I've been looking for some sugar to grow my new crop. Wanna try it?
entries.zh: 你好啊园丁，我正想找点糖来种我的新作物。要不要试试？

entries.en: Darn humans, you don't understand how to use things...
entries.zh: 该死的人类，你们根本不懂怎么用东西……
明智的选择。

entries.en: Hmm... I haven't seen you around here before. Do you work here?
entries.zh: 唔……我以前没在这一带见过你。你在这儿干活？

entries.zh: 目标：达到钓鱼技能 V  (55.5/1,175 经验)

entries.zh: 请选择: [我们找到了一束满怀爱意的花！]

entries.zh: 请选择: [我们得知道他在哪儿，有人要杀他。]

entries.zh: 请选择: [冷静点，我们需要你的帮助。]

entries.en: And please try to follow the story, a lot of effort went into it.
entries.zh: 还有，请按剧情走，我们为此花了不少心思。

entries.en: Select an option: [I'm afraid so, but we found you right on time.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [恐怕是的，不过我们及时找到了你。]
阿莫格知道该怎么做……

entries.zh: 有人听到了你的呼唤，出现在房间里。
嗖！

entries.zh: 你和巫师侠的传承四连棋对局以平局结束。

entries.zh: 你已经收集齐所需的干草了！

entries.zh: 啪叽！你的兔子 %1$s 被压扁了！

entries.en: I should tell Barry about Creed's complaints...
entries.zh: 我该把克里德的抱怨告诉巴里听……

entries.en: You bought Buy a unique BZT!!
entries.zh: 你买下了独一无二的 BZT!

entries.en: It might have been a scam...
entries.zh: 这可能是个骗局……

entries.en: If something seems too good to be true... maybe it is.
entries.zh: 要是一件事好得不像真的……那也许就是假的。

entries.en: I should tell Barry about Dust's complaints...
entries.zh: 我该把达斯特的抱怨告诉巴里听……

entries.en: I should tell Barry about Frankie's complaints...

弗兰基离开了。
弗兰基加入了。

entries.en: I should tell Barry about Harriette's complaints...
entries.zh: 我该把哈丽特的抱怨告诉巴里听……

entries.en: Well, I hope he found what he was looking for...

entries.zh: ■ 与西摩交谈，查看他出售的各式燕尾服。

entries.zh: 你尚未满足此物品的使用条件！

entries.en: This pet doesn't want candies! In fact it's quite offended at the proposition.
entries.zh: 这只宠物不想吃糖！事实上，光是这个提议就让它很不高兴。

entries.en: Using the Cadacous Feeder requires consuming an Ultimate Carrot Candy!
entries.zh: 使用易落喂食器需要消耗一个终极胡萝卜糖！

entries.en: You do not have any Ultimate Carrot Candy in your inventory!
entries.zh: 你的物品栏中没有终极胡萝卜糖！

entries.en: You should return it to Okron...
entries.zh: 该把它交还给奥克隆了……

entries.en: You already have one in your inventory!
entries.zh: 你的物品栏中已经有一个了！

entries.en: This amazing bouquet has been made with love, no doubt about that.
entries.zh: 这束漂亮的花显然饱含心意，毫无疑问。
- 血迹 -

entries.en: This blood stain has been looked at before.
entries.zh: 这片血迹之前已经有人检查过了。

entries.en: That definitely spooked them quite a lot, perhaps they ran away.
entries.zh: 这一定把他们吓坏了，也许他们逃走了。
可他们逃到哪里去了……
- 戒指 -

entries.en: This is clearly an engagement ring.
entries.zh: 这显然是一枚订婚戒指。

entries.en: However, there is a curve on the front where there should be a jewel.
entries.zh: 不过，戒指正面本该镶着宝石的地方，只剩下一处凹槽。
它还不完整。
- 冰箱 -
冰箱是空的。
可这些又是什么？
BlockDash 的外卖小票？? 足足几百张！
- 长幅画 -

entries.en: It looks like an abstract painting of our victim.
entries.zh: 看起来像是一幅描绘受害者的抽象画。

entries.en: They seem to be wearing a red-ish top and blue jeans.
entries.zh: 画里的人似乎穿着偏红色的上衣和蓝色牛仔裤。
- 窗户 -

entries.en: The attacker might've escaped through this window!
entries.zh: 凶手可能从这扇窗逃走了！

entries.en: Or one of the other windows!
entries.zh: 也可能是别的窗！
或者从门出去的！
甚至可能是烟囱！!!
- 大幅画 -

entries.en: A picture of the future wedding.
entries.zh: 一幅描绘未来婚礼的画。
这位看起来是新娘。

entries.en: The husband is missing from the picture of course, he will be dead by then...
entries.zh: 当然，画里没有新郎，到那时他已经死了……

entries.en: Unfortunately the picture is too pixelated to recognize the wife.
entries.zh: 可惜画面像素太粗，认不出新娘是谁。
- 信件 -
一封情书！

entries.en: It appears that they are engaged.
entries.zh: 看来他们已经订婚了。
真是悲剧……

entries.en: They might have gone to warn their love of their incoming murder.
entries.zh: 他们也许是去提醒爱人，自己即将被谋杀。
你已检查所有线索！
和侦探交谈。

entries.en: The wedding dress in that picture is fresh, it was just made.
entries.zh: 画中的婚纱很新，刚刚才做好。

entries.en: You can tell by the pixels.
entries.zh: 从像素就能看出来。
再和侦探交谈。
血爆弹还在冷却中！

entries.en: Updated your pants color! It's like the Hypixel Pit!
entries.zh: 已更换护腿颜色！像不像 Hypixel 天坑乱斗！
你不能再吃更多汉堡了！
注意你的胆固醇。
你破解了终端！

entries.en: You hacked the presumably make-believe terminal!
entries.zh: 你破解了这个据说是虚构的终端！

entries.en: You failed to hack the terminal!
entries.zh: 你没能破解终端！
该去和奥克隆谈谈了……

entries.en: Warding Spells must be cast precisely!
entries.zh: 必须精准施放守护法术！

entries.en: Mmh... I should look ahead for more crumbs...
entries.zh: 唔……得往前看看，找找更多面包屑……

entries.en: The breadcrumbs disappear in your hand...
entries.zh: 手中的面包屑消失了……

entries.en: I should go talk to the Wizard again...
entries.zh: 该再去找巫师谈谈了……

entries.en: Home of the Argofays. No one knows how they got there, but they do like visits from strangers!
entries.zh: 这里是阿戈菲一族的家。没人知道他们是怎么来的，不过他们很欢迎陌生人来访！

entries.en: Thin strip of land and yet very dangerous. Mushrooms pop out when detecting nearby vibrations.
entries.zh: 狭窄的陆地，却危险至极。蘑菇感应到附近的震动就会突然冒出。

entries.en: As the focal point of study of Dr. Emmett, the west end of the village is where reality is at its most twisted.
entries.zh: 作为埃米特博士的重点研究地点，村庄西端的现实最为扭曲。

entries.en: Fertilized by a long-gone necromancer, the dreadfarm grows crops unique to this dimension.
entries.zh: 一位早已离去的死灵法师曾为惊惧农场施肥，这里生长着这个维度独有的作物。

entries.en: Whatever marvels you find in the village center, make sure to avoid the enderman roaming in it.
entries.zh: 不管村庄中心有多少奇观，都要记得避开游荡的末影人！

entries.en: The only place where staring at walls may be interesting, because they're as much alive as you are.
entries.zh: 在这里，盯着墙壁也能很有趣，因为它们和你一样有生命。

entries.en: A threatening slime has infested the colosseum, its toxicity channeled by everyone's memories of a famous dictator.
entries.zh: 危险的史莱姆占据了斗兽场，人们对一位著名独裁者的记忆汇成了它的毒性。

entries.en: A cult of vampires has settled in the castle. Beware being sent to their prison.
entries.zh: 一个教团的吸血鬼已在城堡定居。小心别被送进他们的监狱。

entries.en: The tip of this dimension, where the SkyBlock world originally fractured.
entries.zh: 这里是这个维度的顶端，也是空岛世界最初破裂的地方。

entries.en: Craft a helmet upgrade using spines obtained from defeating deadgehogs.
entries.zh: 用击杀亡刺猬获得的尖刺，制作升级后的头盔。

entries.en: Help out the scientific community in the lagoon with some fantastic research.
entries.zh: 帮助潟湖的科学界开展奇妙的研究。

entries.en: Reed is stranded on the Lagoon Hut and it's not because he created a special profile.
entries.zh: 里德被困在潟湖小屋里，可不是因为他创建了荒岛模式档案。

entries.en: Assemble your friends and defeat the plagued remnants of a dictator who is still trying to infect everyone's life.
entries.zh: 召集朋友，击败那位独裁者染疫的残躯。他还想继续荼毒所有人的生活。

entries.en: Collect all the resources that Shania needs. This task completes once you wear Chicken Leggs!
entries.zh: 收集莎尼亚所需的全部资源。穿上鸡腿裤即可完成此任务！

entries.en: Defeat Autonulls and use Nullified Metal to upgrade your sword into... a pickaxe.
entries.zh: 击败自灭者，用虚无化金属把剑升级成...一把镐子。

entries.en: Find Shen and complete his puzzles.
entries.zh: 找到申并解开他的谜题。

entries.en: You thought there was a hidden clue here, didn't you?
entries.zh: 你以为这里藏着线索，对吧？
解锁时晶收集。
向巫师侠证明你的实力。

entries.en: Help all the Eleanors on the mountain.
entries.zh: 帮助山上所有的埃莉诺。

entries.en: Monsters deal ❤ damage in the Stillgore Château, obtain a Healing Melon from killing vampires.
entries.zh: 怪物会造成 ❤ 伤害的区域是静血城堡。击杀吸血鬼可获得治疗西瓜。

entries.en: Deal with the protestors stressing out Barry about their needs and wants.
entries.zh: 处理那些抗议者吧，他们的各种诉求让巴里焦头烂额。

entries.en: Damia is running auctions for Shen in the Rift auction house. Make a bid on an item!
entries.zh: 达米娅正在裂隙拍卖行为申主持拍卖。为一件物品出价吧！

entries.en: Feed Cowboy Nick's hungry rabbits with carrots.
entries.zh: 用胡萝卜喂饱牛仔尼克那些饥肠辘辘的兔子。

entries.en: Assist Detective Amog in solving a murder case that is about to happen.
entries.zh: 协助侦探阿莫格调查一桩即将发生的谋杀案。

entries.en: Seraphine was detransfigured when she attempted to cross into the Rift.
entries.zh: 塞拉芬尝试进入裂隙时，容貌发生了异变。

entries.en: Requires completing "Barry, Premier Leader of SkyBlock" in order to complete by yourself...
entries.zh: 需先完成“巴里，空岛的最高领袖”,才能独自完成此任务...

entries.en: Purchase good shoes from Seymour at the tailor's house. They last for life!
entries.zh: 在裁缝家向西摩买双好鞋，一辈子都穿不坏！

entries.en: Follow Dr. Emmett's story through his mirror puzzles and experiments.
entries.zh: 通过镜子谜题与实验，了解埃米特博士的故事。

entries.en: Sorcerer Okron is holding a giant fireball still. Collect glyphs and cast warding spells to protect the house.
entries.zh: 巫师奥克隆正定住一颗巨大的火球。收集符文，施放守护法术来保护房屋。

entries.en: Do Kat's job for her, fill the vermin bin and obtain the disinfestor gloves.
entries.zh: 帮凯特完成工作，装满害虫收集箱并获得除虫手套。

entries.en: Some unhinged kloon wants to hack the world.
entries.zh: 一个疯疯癫癫的 kloon 想黑进整个世界。

entries.en: Complete the race in the West Village and upgrade your boots.
entries.zh: 完成西村的竞速挑战，升级你的靴子。

entries.en: Help out the hungry Argofay Bughunter looking to "collect" Odonatas.
entries.zh: 帮助饥肠辘辘的阿戈菲·捕虫者 “收集”蜻蜓。

entries.en: Inverted Sirius found a way to transfer items in-and-out of the Rift, but he's in a bit of a predicament.
entries.zh: 倒转西里乌斯找到了在裂隙内外转移物品的办法，但他遇上了一点麻烦。
他正“站”在小屋后面。

entries.en: Sad Jacquelle needs help to find her cat. She's on a branch next to her house in the Wyld Woods.
entries.zh: 伤心的杰奎尔需要你帮她找猫。她在异野森林的家旁边，站在树枝上。

entries.en: Porhtal knows a trick to fast travel in the Rift.
entries.zh: 波塔尔知道在裂隙中快速传送的诀窍。

entries.en: Talk to Enigma at the base of the Wizard Tower and wear the Enigma Cloak.
entries.zh: 与巫师塔底部的伊尼格玛交谈，并穿戴谜之斗篷。

entries.en: Three argofays have a spare weapon somewhere in the trees.
entries.zh: 树上的三位阿戈菲有一把备用武器。

entries.en: Obtain the armor set from the Argofay Traffickers chilling in the treehouses.
entries.zh: 向树屋里悠闲的阿戈菲·倒卖者购买整套护甲。

entries.en: Find Enigma Souls in the Rift to upgrade your Enigma Cloak.
entries.zh: 寻找谜魂，在裂隙中升级你的谜之斗篷。

entries.en: Store items here, it's free real estate!
entries.zh: 把物品放这里吧，免费仓库不用白不用！

entries.en: Worried you missed something? The Wizards prepared a book for you to fill with checkmarks!
entries.zh: 怕漏掉什么？巫师们为你准备了一本书，就等你把待办事项逐个勾完！

entries.en: Get out of this weird place because you're freaked out.
entries.zh: 这鬼地方太吓人了，赶紧离开吧。

entries.en: An eerie selection of occult stats unique to this island.
entries.zh: 这座岛屿独有的一组诡异神秘属性。

entries.en: Rift Time represents the number of available seconds that you have and spawn with in the Rift Dimension.
entries.zh: 裂隙时间表示你进入裂隙维度时拥有的可用时间，以秒计。

entries.en: Increases the damage dealt against mobs in the Rift Dimension.
entries.zh: 提高对裂隙维度内怪物造成的伤害。

entries.en: You walk at a regular walking speed.
entries.zh: 你以正常步行速度移动。

entries.en: Increases your base mana regen (2 mana/s).
entries.zh: 提高基础法力回复速率(每秒 2 点法力)。

entries.en: Determines the number of hearts on your health bar.
entries.zh: 决定生命条上的爱心数量。

entries.en: Defeat Shies and craft their cruxes into the Crux Talisman.
entries.zh: 击败害羞怪，用它们掉落的核心制作驱灵核护符。

entries.en: Defeat Shadows and craft their cruxes into the Crux Ring.
entries.zh: 击败暗影怪，用它们掉落的核心制作驱灵核戒指。

entries.en: Defeat Volts and craft their cruxes into the Crux Artifact.
entries.zh: 击败伏特怪，用它们掉落的核心制作驱灵核神器。

entries.en: Defeat Scribes and craft their cruxes into the Crux Relic.
entries.zh: 击败抄写怪，用它们掉落的核心制作驱灵核遗物。

entries.en: Defeat Frozilles and craft their cruxes into the Crux Heirloom.
entries.zh: 击败冰冻怪，用它们掉落的核心制作驱灵核传家宝。

entries.en: Defeat Splatters and craft their cruxes into the Crux Chronomicon.
entries.zh: 击败泼溅怪，用它们掉落的核心制作驱灵核时之典。

entries.en: Defeat Puffs and craft their cruxes into the Celestial Starstone.
entries.zh: 击败鼓气怪，用它们掉落的核心制作天界星石。

entries.en: Infuse yourself with magical protection pioneered by Barry which lets you step into the wizard portal.
entries.zh: 为自己灌注魔法防护。这是巴里开创的魔法，让你能踏入巫师传送门。

entries.en: Automatically purchase the Dimensional Infusion when transferring to the rift, either for free or using bits.

entries.zh: 工作日获得 %1$s♨ 活力；周末随机一种智慧属性获得 %2$s☯ 加成。

entries.zh: 在裂隙内击杀生物时，额外获得 %1$s 战斗经验。

entries.zh: 一只狂暴的狼，被著名的疯狂科学家做过基因改造，以骨头和血肉为食。

entries.en: If Necron is the right-hand of the Wither King, this dark demigod is the left-hand.
entries.zh: 如果说耐克伦是凋灵之王的右手，这位黑暗半神就是他的左手。

entries.en: Even demons fear this incarnation of pure evil, constantly feeding on its burning desire for destruction.
entries.zh: 连恶魔都畏惧这个纯粹邪恶的化身，它不断以自己对毁灭的炽热渴望为食。

entries.zh: 击败首领后，若随身或银行有足够的硬币，就会自动完成任务并开始同类型的新任务。

entries.zh: 根据你击杀过的不同种类与阶级的猎手首领，获得额外战斗经验。

entries.zh: 击杀任意首领对应的小首领时，额外获得 +3 份该首领的主要代币掉落物。

entries.en: Your RNG Meter fills with Slayer XP every time you defeat a Tier III or higher!
entries.zh: 每次击败 III 阶或更高阶的首领后，便会用猎手经验填充你的 RNG 计量表。

entries.en: Reed is repairing his boat and needs your help finding components.
entries.zh: 里德正在修船，需要你帮忙寻找零件。

entries.en: Gain ф Rift Time for each step you complete.
entries.zh: 每完成一个步骤，获得 ф 裂隙时间。

entries.en: Sails as fine as silk requires a bit more non-consensual surgery.
entries.zh: 想做出丝般细腻的船帆，还得再做几场未经同意的手术。
所需物品: 幼虫丝
获取地点: 异野森林
完成后: +%1$s ф 裂隙时间

entries.en: Complete previous steps to unlock this one!
entries.zh: 完成之前的步骤后解锁！

entries.zh: 船上的细小部件需要上好的木材。
所需物品: 枯萎小檗
获取地点: 惊惧农场

entries.zh: 能让你的肚子至少填个半饱的口粮。

entries.zh: 通过镜子谜题与实验，了解埃米特博士的研究。

entries.zh: 塞拉芬尝试进入裂隙时，容貌发生了异变。

entries.zh: 跳下活体静域，击败冰冻怪，制作生命时间护符。

entries.zh: 与活体静域的岩石居民交谈，了解获取活体金属之心的线索。

entries.en: Fact: Ducks have a specially designed beak that allow them to filter water and mud for food while swimming.
entries.zh: 小知识: 鸭子的喙结构特殊，能让它们一边游泳，一边从水和泥里滤出食物。
点击选择这种动物！

entries.en: Fact: Foxes have a unique hunting technique where they use the Earth's magnetic field to pinpoint the exact location of their prey.
entries.zh: 小知识: 狐狸有独特的捕猎技巧，能利用地球磁场精确定位猎物。

entries.en: Fact: Sheeps have an excellent sense of smell and can recognize individual members of their flock by their unique scent.
entries.zh: 小知识: 绵羊嗅觉灵敏，能通过独特的气味辨认羊群中的每个成员。

entries.en: Fact: Chickens are one of the closest living relative to the Tyrannosaurus Rex.
entries.zh: 小知识: 鸡是现存动物中与霸王龙亲缘关系最近的动物之一。

entries.en: Fact: Penguins have a special gland above their eyes that filters salt from the seawater they ingest.
entries.zh: 小知识: 企鹅眼睛上方有一种特殊的腺体，能过滤摄入海水中的盐分。

entries.en: Fact: Antarctic blue whales can weigh 112,000kg (250,000lb) and still swim at 25+ km/h (18 mp/h).
entries.zh: 小知识: 南极蓝鲸体重可达 112,000 千克（250,000 磅），却仍能以 25 千米/小时以上（18 英里/小时）的速度游泳。

entries.en: Fact: Pandas have a "pseudo thumb" made of an elongated wrist bone that helps them hold bamboo stalks.
entries.zh: 小知识: 熊猫有一根由腕骨延长形成的“伪拇指”，能帮助它们握住竹子。

entries.en: Fact: Monkeys have been known to use their own fur as a tool to floss their teeth.
entries.zh: 小知识: 人们发现，猴子会拿自己的毛当牙线，清理牙缝。

entries.en: Fact: Dogs have a unique sense of smell and are even able to detect diseases like cancer and changes in blood sugar levels in people with diabetes.
entries.zh: 小知识: 狗的嗅觉非同寻常，甚至能嗅出癌症等疾病，以及糖尿病患者血糖水平的变化。

entries.en: Fact: Squids have the ability to change the color and texture of their skin to blend in with their surroundings, communicate with other squids and even hypnotize their prey.
entries.zh: 小知识: 鱿鱼能改变皮肤的颜色和纹理，以融入周围环境、与其他鱿鱼交流，甚至催眠猎物。

entries.en: Fact: Toads have glands behind their eyes that secrete bufotoxin, which can cause hallucinations, seizures and death in predators that try to eat them.
entries.zh: 小知识: 蟾蜍眼后有能分泌蟾毒的腺体。试图吃掉它们的捕食者可能因此出现幻觉、抽搐，甚至死亡。

entries.en: Fact: Hippos secrete a sticky pink substance called "blood sweat" that acts as a natural sunscreen and moisturizer for their sensitive skin.
entries.zh: 小知识: 河马会分泌一种叫作“血汗”的粉红色黏液，为敏感的皮肤提供天然防晒和保湿。

entries.en: Time flows differently in this dimension.
entries.zh: 时间在这个维度里流动的方式不一样。

entries.en: A lot of wizards, including me, try and study Time around here.
entries.zh: 很多巫师，包括我在内，都在这一带研究时间。

entries.en: Tomorrow you might come back here yesterday.
entries.zh: 明天你再回到这里时，可能是昨天。

entries.en: Maybe we already had this conversation in the future.
entries.zh: 也许这段对话我们早就聊过了——就在将来。

entries.en: Is there even a before and an after in this place?
entries.zh: 在这个地方，真的还有之前和之后之分吗？

entries.en: Some speculate that we are in the past, some say in the future, perhaps we're always in the present.
entries.zh: 有人猜我们在过去，有人说是在未来，也许我们一直都在现在。

entries.en: A full revolution of events around here is what we here call a "business day".
entries.zh: 在我们这里，事件走完一个完整轮回，就叫一个"营业日"。

entries.en: All you have to decide is what to do with the time that is given to you.
entries.zh: 你唯一要决定的，是如何利用赋予你的时间。
走开，我忙着呢。

entries.en: Select an option: [That's not very polite]
entries.zh: 请选择: [这可不太礼貌]
我结巴了吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [No. There is a darkness in Seraphine]
entries.zh: 请选择: [不。塞拉芬身上才有黑暗]
别提了！

entries.en: Just thinking of that face makes me queasy.
entries.zh: 光是想到那张脸，我就犯恶心。

entries.en: Select an option: [Barry said you could help]
entries.zh: 请选择: [巴里说你能帮忙]
当然可以。

entries.en: I can help you prepare an Anti-Morph Potion, which should at least help with the situation.
entries.zh: 我可以帮你调配一瓶反变形药水，至少能让情况有所好转。

entries.en: Select an option: [What is the first step?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [第一步是什么？]

entries.en: The first step is that you pay me 10,000 Motes!
entries.zh: 第一步，先付我 10,000 微尘！

entries.en: An unhinged clown once told me, if you're good at something, never do it for free!
entries.zh: 有个疯癫的小丑告诉过我:如果你擅长什么，千万别免费干！
[支付微尘]

entries.en: I can help you prepare the Anti-Morph Potion to fix Seraphine's face.
entries.zh: 我可以帮你调配反变形药水，治好塞拉芬的脸。
但首先，我需要 10,000 微尘。
你的微尘不够！
好嘞！

entries.en: First, you need to fill the cauldron with water.
entries.zh: 首先，你得把坩埚装满水。

entries.en: I can't help you with this, I'm counting my Motes.
entries.zh: 这个我可帮不了你，我正忙着数我的微尘呢。

entries.en: Next up you should add 64 Riftwart Roots.
entries.zh: 接下来，你该加入 64 个裂隙疣根。

entries.en: I've planted them around the building.
entries.zh: 我在房子周围种了一些。

entries.en: Nice! Put it in the cauldron!
entries.zh: 不错！放进坩埚里！

entries.en: Now the Brew needs 8 Larva Silk.
entries.zh: 现在这锅药剂还需要 8 份幼虫丝。

entries.en: It helps with the texture of the potion.
entries.zh: 它能改善药水的质地。

entries.en: You can collect some back in the Wyld Woods.
entries.zh: 你可以回异野森林里采一些。

entries.en: Finally you should add 4 Caducous Extract.
entries.zh: 最后，再加入 4 份早落提取物。

entries.en: You can find them in the Dreadfarm.
entries.zh: 你可以在惊惧农场找到它们。

entries.en: It's needed for taste, otherwise we'll just get more vomit!
entries.zh: 这是为了调味，不然熬出来只会是更多呕吐物！
有了这瓶反变形药水……

entries.en: Seraphine gets to look like something again.
entries.zh: 塞拉芬终于又能有个样子了。

entries.en: I get to drink my favorite beverage.
entries.zh: 这样我就又能喝上最爱的饮料了。
而世界照常运转！
也可能不会。

entries.en: Anyway, splash this potion on whoever makes you want to vomit.
entries.zh: 总之，把这瓶药水泼向任何让你想吐的家伙。
还需要一瓶药水吗？

entries.en: To be frank, I can see why you could need another one.
entries.zh: 说实话，我能理解你为什么可能还需要一瓶。
我们吃得不多。
有时候我们吃蜻蜓。
请选择: [你好？]

entries.en: To collect Odonatas, you need to fly.
entries.zh: 想捕捉蜻蜓，你得会飞。
用幼虫就能飞。

entries.en: Talk to Bugshopper, then show me a Larva Hook.
entries.zh: 去找购虫者谈谈，然后拿一个幼虫鱼钩给我看。

entries.en: Get a Larva Hook from Bugshopper.
entries.zh: 去找购虫者要一个幼虫鱼钩。
现在用钩子。

entries.en: Find a larva in the branches.
entries.zh: 在树枝间找一只幼虫。

entries.en: Hook it until it relinquishes its SILK.
entries.zh: 钩住它，直到它交出丝。
然后回来。

entries.en: Hook it until it relinquishes its silk.
entries.zh: 钩住它，直到它交出丝。
不错。
千万别吃丝。
不然你就飞不起来了。

entries.en: Now go and bring back 6 Larva Silk.
entries.zh: 现在去带 6 份幼虫丝回来。
给我带 6 份幼虫丝。
你可能已经注意到了……

entries.en: You can use silk to create wires.
entries.zh: 丝可以做成线。
丝线。
用丝线来飞。
配上这根棍子。

entries.en: Now talk to Bugshopper and show me an Odonata Bottle.
entries.zh: 现在去找购虫者谈谈，然后拿一个蜻蜓瓶给我看。
棍子丢了？
现在该飞了。
到外面找一只蜻蜓。
它们特别小。

entries.en: Lay out a Silkwire which crosses the Odonata.
entries.zh: 拉一条丝线，横穿那只蜻蜓。

entries.en: Use the Silkwire Stick on the Silkwire to fly.
entries.zh: 把丝线棒用在丝线上，就能飞。

entries.en: Then collect the Odonata using the Empty Odonata Bottle.
entries.zh: 然后收集蜻蜓，用空的蜻蜓瓶。

entries.en: I am hungry. Please bring back the Bottled Odonata.
entries.zh: 我饿了。把瓶装蜻蜓带回来。

entries.en: Lay out a Silkwire which crosses it.
entries.zh: 拉一条丝线横穿过去。
请带一只瓶装蜻蜓来。
非常好，非常好。
非常美味。

entries.en: Select an option: [Why do you say so few words?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [你为什么说话这么少？]
因为话少，照样管用。

entries.en: I taught you how to capture Odonatas.
entries.zh: 我教过你怎么抓蜻蜓了。

entries.en: Now please bring back 8 Bottled Odonata.
entries.zh: 现在请带 8 只瓶装蜻蜓回来。
我非常饿。

entries.en: There is something in it for you if you do.
entries.zh: 照做的话，有好处等着你。
请给我带 8 只瓶装蜻蜓。
太棒了。
你最棒了。
收下这条腰带。
系上它更安全。
腰带丢了？
那可不太安全。
谢谢你的蜻蜓。
我不饿了。

entries.en: Come back when I am hungry again.
entries.zh: 等我下次饿了再来。
我饿了。
请给我带 3 只瓶装蜻蜓。

entries.en: I will give you 5,000 Motes if you do.
entries.zh: 照做的话，我给你 5,000 微尘。
这是给你的微尘。
呃……先去跟捕虫者谈。

entries.en: You can enter here only if you obtained the Supreme Timecharm.
entries.zh: 只有拿到至尊时间护符，你才能进入这里。
请选择: [我拿到了。]

entries.en: Oh! Very well then, you may enter.
entries.zh: 哦！好，那你可以进去了。

entries.en: Wizardman is waiting for you in his bureau.
entries.zh: 巫师侠正在办公室里等你。
对，我完全就是个炼金术士……

entries.en: Here, I've been marinating this potion.
entries.zh: 给，这瓶药水我一直腌着呢。

entries.en: That sac over there is my son.
entries.zh: 那边那枚茧里，是我的儿子。

entries.en: Argofays have a set amount of time to hatch.
entries.zh: 阿戈菲一族孵化所需的时间是有定数的。

entries.en: If their time runs out they get stuck.
entries.zh: 如果时间耗尽，他们就会被困住。

entries.en: I hope my son will hatch.
entries.zh: 我希望我的儿子能孵出来。

entries.en: But if he does, he won't remember me, and I won't tell him.
entries.zh: 但如果他真孵出来了，他不会记得我，我也不会告诉他。

entries.en: For maybe he is my father, in another revolution of events.
entries.zh: 因为在另一场轮回中，也许他才是我的父亲。

entries.en: You only have %1$s left, be efficient or you will be stuck like some of those sacs.
entries.zh: 你只剩 %1$s 了，抓紧时间，否则你也会像那些茧一样被困住。
刚刚过了 10 秒。

entries.en: It's rare to meet new faces around these woods.
entries.zh: 这片林子里很少见到新面孔。

entries.en: Especially one who is so ill-prepared!
entries.zh: 尤其还是这么个毫无准备的家伙！

entries.en: I don't have it on me, but one of my two brothers should have a spare weapon.
entries.zh: 我身上没有，但我的两个兄弟里应该有人有把备用武器。

entries.en: If you run into them, tell them I sent you.
entries.zh: 碰到他们的话，就说是我让你去的。

entries.en: They will know what it means.
entries.zh: 他们知道这是什么意思。

entries.en: Select an option: [Your brother sent me.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [是你兄弟让我来的。]
这很可疑。

entries.en: He wouldn't let you leave so ill-prepared.
entries.zh: 他不可能让你就这么毫无准备地离开。

entries.en: My other brother should have a spare weapon.
entries.zh: 我的另一个兄弟应该有一把备用武器。

entries.en: Whatever you do, do not call him by his name, that might trigger him to use it on you.
entries.zh: 不管你做什么，都别叫他的名字——那可能会刺激他，把武器用到你身上。

entries.en: Select an option: [I don't know his name.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [我不知道他的名字。]
请选择: [我毫无准备。]

entries.en: What a strange thing to say.
entries.zh: 这话说得真奇怪。

entries.en: Did you talk with my brothers?
entries.zh: 你跟我兄弟聊过了？
总之，你说得对……

entries.en: But I do have a weapon that could help you!
entries.zh: 不过我确实有件武器能帮上你！

entries.en: Try and find one of my brothers.
entries.zh: 去找我的一个兄弟试试。

entries.en: They should be able to equip you with a weapon.
entries.zh: 他们应该能给你配一件武器。

entries.en: They keep a spare weapon around for new faces.
entries.zh: 他们备着一件备用武器给新面孔。
我有一件备用武器。
给。
备用武器？

entries.en: Are you sure you're not mistaking me with someone else?
entries.zh: 你确定没把我认成别人？
记住。
我从没来过这儿。

entries.en: According to the dictionary definition of "trafficker", I'm selling something illegal.
entries.zh: 按词典里“trafficker”的定义，我卖的东西是非法的。
我不是！

entries.en: Just don't talk to anyone about it.
entries.zh: 反正别跟任何人提这事。

entries.en: That's where all the ladders were?
entries.zh: 原来梯子都跑这儿来了？
等你看到就知道了……

entries.en: You'll think I forgot a zero!
entries.zh: 你会以为我少写了个零！
蜜蜂为什么老是哼歌？
因为它们记不住歌词！
爬上去吧！

entries.en: I am rooted to this tree.
entries.zh: 我和这棵树长在一起了。
但我不记得……

entries.en: Was the tree there before me, or was I there before the tree?
entries.zh: 是树先于我存在，还是我先于树存在？
我就是那棵树吗？

entries.en: From your point of view, I will always be standing here.
entries.zh: 从你的角度看，我会永远站在这里。

entries.en: I ran out of time long ago, probably.
entries.zh: 大概，我很久以前就用光了时间。
啾啾—叮咚，生命时间护符吗？
请选择: [有。]
滋滋—嗡——叮……
叮叮—咔滋啪！

entries.en: All these protestors upstairs hate me!
entries.zh: 楼上这群抗议者都恨死我了！
可我根本不知道为什么！

entries.en: Select an option: [You could just ask them why.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [你直接去问问他们为什么。]
当然，%1$s,可我做不到！

entries.en: I'm stuck here planning my campaign for the next Rift election.
entries.zh: 我忙着筹备下一届裂隙选举，脱不开身。

entries.en: I don't have time to hear out the populace...
entries.zh: 我没时间听民众一个个诉苦……

entries.en: Select an option: [Hearing them out would help with the election.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [听听他们的诉求，对选举有帮助。]
哈哈，这想法太疯了……

entries.en: So crazy it might just work!
entries.zh: 疯到说不定真能成！
好，就这么办。

entries.en: Go and hear a protestor's complaint.
entries.zh: 去听一位抗议者的诉求。

entries.en: Then, come back to me so we can resolve their issue.
entries.zh: 然后回来找我，我们一起解决他们的问题。

entries.en: Oh Creed is still asking for Motes?
entries.zh: 哦，克里德还在要微尘？
我的政府可付不起这个！
弗兰基卡了？

entries.en: I suppose that's technically my fault, with all those new people in the Rift lately.
entries.zh: 严格说这得怪我，最近裂隙里来了那么多新面孔。

entries.en: Maybe they are using a VPN, or downloading something, or just on a bad proxy.
entries.zh: 也许他们在用 VPN,或者在下载东西，或者只是网络代理太差。
请选择: [啊……?]
去问弗兰基吧，他会懂的。

entries.en: Soma is concerned about the 50% tax rates?
entries.zh: 索玛担心的是 50% 的税率？

entries.en: Well, she has to understand that Tax Brackets are part of a progressive tax system.
entries.zh: 她得明白，税率档次是累进税制的一部分。
请选择: [啊？?]

entries.en: There are currently 5 different federal tax brackets in the Rift.
entries.zh: 目前在裂隙共有 5 个不同的联邦税率档次。
请选择: [慢点讲。]

entries.en: The first bracket is for anyone earning below 20,000 Motes per revolution.
entries.zh: 第一档适用于每轮回收入低于 20,000 微尘。

entries.en: So for example if you earn 40,000...
entries.zh: 比如说你收入 40,000……

entries.en: You will pay 10% on your first 20,000 Motes, so 2,000.
And you will be taxed 20% on the next 20,000, so 4,000 extra.
In total you will have to pay 6,000 Motes.
entries.zh: 总共要缴 6,000 微尘。

entries.en: Select an option: [Maybe you should explain that to Soma yourself...]
entries.zh: 请选择: [也许你该自己去跟索玛解释……]

entries.en: The 5th and final bracket is anything above 100,000, at 50% tax rate.
entries.zh: 第五档，也就是最后一档，是超过 100,000 的部分，税率 50%。

entries.en: Select an option: [Why don't you just tell Soma what she owes?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [你为什么不直接告诉索玛她欠多少？]

entries.en: Sorry, we only tell her if she didn't pay enough!
entries.zh: 抱歉，我们只在她少缴的时候才告诉她！

entries.en: Now that you are armed with accounting knowledge, go help Soma!
entries.zh: 现在你有会计知识傍身了，去帮帮索玛吧！

entries.en: Harriette said that I want to ban jumping?
entries.zh: 哈丽特说我想禁止跳跃？

entries.en: Harriette said that the Rift Herald said that I want to ban jumping...
entries.zh: 哈丽特说，裂隙先驱报上写着我想禁止跳跃……

entries.en: It's just not true, I never said anything like that!
entries.zh: 这根本不是真的，我从没说过这种话！

entries.en: She knows the Rift Herald is a newspaper owned by the family, right?
entries.zh: 她不会不知道，裂隙先驱报就是那家人办的报纸吧？

entries.en: They'll bribe, lie and DEFAME anybody just to get votes!
entries.zh: 为了拉票，他们行贿、撒谎，还造谣中伤任何人！

entries.en: Violetta needs help with her math homework again?!
entries.zh: 维奥莱塔的数学作业又要人帮忙了？!

entries.en: Those questions keep getting tougher and tougher...
entries.zh: 这些题真是一道比一道难……

entries.en: Can you help her out yourself?
entries.zh: 你能自己去帮帮她吗？
我搞的是魔法，不是科学！
斯坦说什么？
可我不是浆果……
我是 BARRY! 带 A 的那个！

entries.en: Dust wants me to fix his mistakes?
entries.zh: 达斯特想让我帮他收拾烂摊子？

entries.en: It sounds like it's too late, I don't know what to tell him.
entries.zh: 听起来已经太迟了，我不知道该怎么跟他说。
就……跟他说点聪明话吧！

entries.en: It might just do the trick.
entries.zh: 说不定真能糊弄过去。

entries.en: Thanks to your help, all of the protestors have decided to help the community instead of just complaining!
entries.zh: 多亏了你，所有抗议者都决定去帮助社区，而不是光抱怨！

entries.en: Here, I want you to take my favorite pen.
entries.zh: 来，收下这支我最喜欢的钢笔。

entries.en: I don't need it anymore since this whole universe is on computers anyway.
entries.zh: 反正整个宇宙都跑在电脑上了，我用不着它了。
嘿，需要钢笔吗？

entries.en: All of us here are preparing for the next Rift election.
entries.zh: 我们这儿的人都在为下一届裂隙选举做准备。

entries.en: With some luck, our government may stay in place for an eternity!
entries.zh: 运气好的话，我们的政府能千秋万代地待下去！

entries.en: Running for Mayor office, I have many times.
entries.zh: 竞选市长，我参加过很多次。

entries.en: City Projects for coins towards wizards, I tried organizing.
entries.zh: 为巫师们筹硬币的市政工程，我试着组织过。

entries.en: Embezzled it all away, Scorpius did.
entries.zh: 把它全贪走了，斯科皮乌斯干的。

entries.en: They will see when I turn the world upside down!
entries.zh: 等我颠倒这个世界，他们就会见识到！
传送门，就快修好了。
市长，我还会再当上的。
贪污嘛，这次不会了。

entries.en: I love my job, I do.
entries.zh: 我喜欢我的工作，真的。
但有时候……

entries.en: I think of slipping into the lava.
entries.zh: 我会想着干脆滑进岩浆里算了。

entries.en: You are looking for Ramero, I assume?
entries.zh: 我猜，你是在找拉梅罗？

entries.en: Select an option: [Do you know where he is?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [你知道他在哪儿吗？]

entries.en: No, but he said that he was about to be murdered.
entries.zh: 不知道，但他说过自己快要被杀了。

entries.en: He took the stone I made him and then left in a hurry...
entries.zh: 他拿走了我给他打的石头，然后就匆匆忙忙走了……
他还欠着我 25,000 微尘呢！
请选择: [不。]

entries.en: Anyway, I do not know where he went.
entries.zh: 总之，我不知道他去了哪儿。

entries.en: I think he's trying to cover his tracks.
entries.zh: 我觉得他是在抹掉自己的踪迹。

entries.en: Sadly, I do not know where he went.
entries.zh: 很遗憾，我不知道他去了哪儿。

entries.en: Select an option: [Have you seen anything weird lately?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [你最近有看到什么怪事吗？]
天天都有。

entries.en: If you are talking about Ramero, he was just there and seemed very agitated.
entries.zh: 你要是说拉梅罗的话，他刚才就在那儿，看起来很焦躁。
噗叽—咕噜—扑通，球状时间护符咕噜咕噜噗？
请选择: [没错。]
噗叽咕噜，啵啵噗，吸溜吸溜啪叽。

entries.en: That tickles more than you'd think!
entries.zh: 比你想的要痒多了！

entries.en: A little gentleness goes a long way, you know?
entries.zh: 你懂的，温柔一点点，效果大不同。

entries.en: There's a RING hologram right above. Try using that, would you?
entries.zh: 正上方有个 RING 全息投影，用那个试试，行吗？

entries.en: Sigh, the things I endure... Youth these days indeed!
entries.zh: 唉，我遭的这些罪……现在的年轻人哟！
请选择: [对不起。]

entries.en: All forgiven. Just, maybe click on RING next time?
entries.zh: 原谅你了。就是……下次点 RING，好吗？

entries.en: Ah, seeking Wizardman? They're currently on a cosmic errand.
entries.zh: 啊，找巫师侠？他这会儿正在宇宙里跑腿呢。

entries.en: If you say "Help Wizardman!" I am sure they will come save you.
entries.zh: 你只要喊一声 "Help 巫师侠！"，他肯定会来救你。

entries.en: That's the spot! Just kidding, please click the RING.
entries.zh: 就是那儿！开玩笑的，请点 RING。

entries.en: Ahhh! That actually hurts, you know!
entries.zh: 啊啊啊！真的很疼，你知道吧！

entries.en: You're really committed to this, aren't you? I can't wait to see what you don't do next.
entries.zh: 你还真是执着啊？我倒要看看你下一步又不干什么。

entries.en: What joy! Another press. I was just hoping you'd ignore the RING again.
entries.zh: 多开心啊！又按了一次。我还盼着你继续无视 RING 呢。

entries.en: It's almost like the RING doesn't exist for you. How poetic.
entries.zh: 简直就像 RING 对你来说根本不存在一样。多有诗意啊。

entries.en: Congratulations! You've mastered the art of ignoring obvious instructions.
entries.zh: 恭喜！你已经精通了无视明显提示的艺术。

entries.en: No, please, press me again. It's not like I had any plans today besides being your personal toy.
entries.zh: 别停，请继续按我。反正我今天除了当你的专属玩具也没别的安排。

entries.en: Why do you continue to do this? Wizardman is right there!
entries.zh: 你为什么还要继续按？巫师侠就在那儿！

entries.en: Okay, so you really do just want to torture me.
entries.zh: 行吧，看来你就是想折磨我。

entries.en: I guess it was pure cosmic randomness that you figured out how to ring Wizardman.
entries.zh: 看来你能叫来巫师侠，纯属宇宙级的随机巧合。

entries.en: I've watched a lot of contestants and I've noticed one trick...
entries.zh: 我看过很多参赛者，发现了一个小窍门……

entries.en: All the big winners have been extremely lucky.
entries.zh: 所有大赢家都运气爆棚。
你可算来了，%1$s!

entries.en: Joey is a world-class competitive pizza eater and is trying to break into the hot dog scene.
entries.zh: 乔伊是位世界级竞吃披萨选手，现在正试着打进热狗圈。
听着，很简单。
1. 我烤热狗。

entries.en: 2. YOU put them on the plate in front of Joey.
entries.zh: 2. 你把它们放到乔伊面前的盘子里。
3. 他开吃。
准备好了吗？
请选择: [开始比赛]
嘿 %1$s，你准备好了吗？
快！
把热狗收集起来！

entries.en: We didn't break the record of 50 hot dogs.
entries.zh: 我们没打破 50 根热狗的纪录。

entries.en: Mmh... maybe call a friend over and let's try again!
entries.zh: 嗯……要不叫个朋友过来，我们再试一次！
嗯……我们再试一次！
蛋美绝伦！
乔伊吃了 %1$s 根热狗！

entries.en: That's more than the record of all the scientists even theorized was possible.
entries.zh: 这可比所有科学家理论上推演的纪录还要多。

entries.en: Wait... come look what I found behind the furnace...
entries.zh: 等等……过来看看我发现了什么，就在熔炉后面……
* 咯咯 *
* 咯咯咯 *
喂！把手拿开，寻宝的家伙！

entries.en: Select an option: [Wait... are you a talking pickaxe?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [等等……你是一把会说话的镐子？]

entries.en: Brilliant deduction! Next thing you'll tell me water's wet.
entries.zh: 好一个神推理！接下来你是不是要告诉我水是湿的？

entries.en: Honestly, the nerve of some people. See something shiny and think it's theirs for the taking!
entries.zh: 说真的，有些人的胆子可真大。看见亮闪闪的东西就觉得是自己的，伸手就拿！

entries.en: Select an option: [Well, you were just lying there...]
entries.zh: 请选择: [可你就躺在那儿啊……]
躺在那儿？

entries.en: Excuse me, I was enjoying some peace and quiet, contemplating the sedimentary layers.
entries.zh: 不好意思，我那是在享受清净，顺便思考沉积岩层。

entries.en: But since you've disturbed my geological meditation, perhaps we can make this interruption worthwhile.
entries.zh: 不过既然你打扰了我的地质冥想，那就让这次打扰变得有价值点吧。

entries.en: I happen to run a little business, Care to browse the finest selection of pickaxes this side of the bedrock?
entries.zh: 我正好在经营一门小生意，想不想逛逛基岩这一侧最上等的镐子？

entries.en: Select an option: [You are a pickaxe that sells pickaxes?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [你是一把卖镐子的镐子？]

entries.en: Who better to trust with your mining needs? Would you buy a sword from a plow?
entries.zh: 买挖矿装备，还有比我更靠谱的吗？你会找犁买剑吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [You make a compelling point.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [你说得很有道理。]

entries.en: Of course I do! I'm sharp in more ways than one.
entries.zh: 当然有道理！我可是全方位地锋利。

entries.en: Anyways, if you are done talking to a tool, let's get you geared up.
entries.zh: 总之，跟一件工具聊够了的话，就来给你配点装备吧。

entries.en: Us dolphins have to go through heavy training before being sent to space.
entries.zh: 我们海豚被送上太空之前，都要经过严苛训练。

entries.en: Want to give it a shot?
entries.zh: 想试试吗？
给你！
作为人类，不赖嘛！

entries.en: I hope the space agency doesn't replace us with birds soon.
entries.zh: 希望航天局别那么快用鸟把我们换掉。

entries.en: Since they can already fly, you know?
entries.zh: 毕竟它们本来就会飞，你懂的。
* 非常哞 *

entries.en: I'm havin' to feed me bunnies ya see?
entries.zh: 我得喂喂我家的兔子，懂吧？

entries.en: I had me farrier dabble into ye old smithin' to concoct one Horsezooka.
entries.zh: 我让蹄铁匠重操老本行，打铁捣鼓出了一把马式火箭筒。

entries.en: So listen, take me Horsezooka and have it eatin' 3,000 Hay Bales and come back hey?
entries.zh: 听好，拿上我的马式火箭筒，让它吃掉 3,000 个干草块再回来，怎么样？

entries.en: Use the Horsezooka on the Hay Bales and break 3,000 of 'em!
entries.zh: 拿马式火箭筒去打干草块，打够 3,000 个！
干得漂亮，小家伙！

entries.en: Select an option: [Why are the horses exploding?]
entries.zh: 选择一个选项: [马为什么会爆炸？]

entries.en: Oy there ain't no nothing to worry about hehe!
entries.zh: 哎呀，没什么好担心的，嘿嘿！

entries.en: It's special effects! Some pizzaz! Cinéma!
entries.zh: 那都是特效！加点花样！电影艺术嘛！

entries.en: Ye cowboy cares about him bunnies, so let's get em' some carrots eh?
entries.zh: 我这个牛仔可疼自家的兔子了，咱给它们弄点胡萝卜吃吧？

entries.en: Here, take %1$s and go on harvestin' some 50 carrots in the Half-Eaten Cave.
entries.zh: 来，带上 %1$s，去半蚀洞穴采 50 根胡萝卜。

entries.en: Stand behind %1$s to motivate it to hop forward!
entries.zh: 站在 %1$s 后面，它就会往前跳了！

entries.en: Have ye bunny eat the carrot patches!
entries.zh: 让你的兔子把胡萝卜田里的胡萝卜吃掉！
带 50 根胡萝卜回来！
太棒了！
呃，等等……
这些胡萝卜怎么都被吃了一半！

entries.en: Select an option: [%1$s nibbed at them.]
entries.zh: 选择一个选项: [%1$s 啃了几口。]
好吧，那也没办法。
那么……

entries.en: Do ya think you could get %1$s to nib a lot more and craft some 7 Nearly-Whole Carrots?
entries.zh: 能不能让 %1$s 再多啃些，合成 7 根近乎完整的胡萝卜？

entries.en: The other rabbits don't want to eat no Half-eaten Carrots...
entries.zh: 其他兔子可不想吃「吃了一半的胡萝卜」……

entries.en: Can ya bring me 7 Nearly-Whole Carrots?
entries.zh: 你能给我带 7 根近乎完整的胡萝卜来吗？
这里每只兔子一根！

entries.en: Now we'll be havin' reserves for all o' winter!
entries.zh: 这下整个冬天都不愁吃啦！

entries.en: What style of music do rabbits listen to?
entries.zh: 兔子最爱听哪种音乐？
嘻哈！听着就想蹦蹦跳跳！

entries.en: What do you call a very rich bunny?
entries.zh: 特别有钱的兔子叫什么？
叫兔豪！
小事一桩！它就在这儿。
怎么，%1$s 出什么事了？

entries.en: Well well, plenty where it came from!
entries.zh: 好啦好啦，这种兔子多的是！
想要你最喜欢的兔子 %1$s 吗？
给你！

entries.en: Barry is the Prime Minister and he's still not giving me Motes?
entries.zh: 巴里都是首相了，居然还不给我微尘？

entries.en: Then why is he Prime Minister?
entries.zh: 那他当什么首相？
我要求至少给我 100 微尘！
等等，不对……300 微尘！
① [给 300 微尘]

entries.en: ② [Barry says he can't afford 300 Motes, he's poor.]
entries.zh: ② [巴里说他拿不出 300 微尘，他很穷。]

entries.en: ③ [What did the duck say after he went shopping?]
entries.zh: ③ [鸭子买完东西会说什么？]

entries.en: Select an option: [Put it on my bill.]
entries.zh: 选择一个选项: [账记我嘴上。]

entries.en: Yeah tell that to my kid who need braces.
entries.zh: 是啊，去跟我家那个需要戴牙套的孩子说吧。
我就要那 300 微尘

entries.en: Can't Barry just ask for Motes from someone, like everyone else is doing?
entries.zh: 难道巴里就不能跟大家一样，找别人要点微尘吗？
总算来了。

entries.en: I'll support Barry during his term, I guess.
entries.zh: 那我就支持巴里干完这一届吧，大概。

entries.en: What am I going to spend my 300 Motes on?
entries.zh: 我该拿这 300 微尘买什么呢？

entries.en: Nothing... I just wanted to have more Motes.
entries.zh: 什么都不买……我只是想要更多微尘。
你问 BZT 是什么？

entries.en: Well everyone is talking about them, so you should know, bro!
entries.zh: 哥们，大家都在聊，你总该知道吧！
BZT 就是不可篡改的数字所有权！

entries.en: Each one of them are unique and because they're unique, they're super rare!
entries.zh: 每一个都独一无二，既然独一无二，那就超级稀有！
你还能收集它们！

entries.en: There's a bunch of a different collections, depending on your tastes!
entries.zh: 各种各样的系列应有尽有，随你喜欢！

entries.en: And you can always resell them! Everyone is trading BZTs!
entries.zh: 而且随时都能转卖！人人都在交易 BZT!

entries.en: Think about it, they're so rare, a collector will snatch it from you for BIG coins!
entries.zh: 你想啊，这么稀有的东西，收藏家还不得砸一大笔硬币抢着买！
你还在等什么？
限时发售！

entries.en: Bro I would totally give you the pitch again but I'm busy picking my next car!
entries.zh: 哥们，我倒是想再给你介绍一遍，可我正忙着挑下一辆车呢！
然——后它就没啦！

entries.en: There are not many constants in the multiverse.
entries.zh: 多元宇宙里，恒定不变的东西可不多。

entries.en: But one of them is that Shen is ALWAYS the richest person.
entries.zh: 但其中一条就是，申永远是最有钱的那个人。

entries.en: In every single dimension he's by FAR the wealthiest being.
entries.zh: 每一个维度里，他都是最富有的，远远甩开其他人。

entries.en: And in every dimension I'm his assistant.
entries.zh: 而每一个维度里，我都是他的助手。
我哪知道。

entries.en: I don't even really like him.
entries.zh: 其实我都不怎么喜欢他。

entries.en: But the job is pretty chill.
entries.zh: 不过这份工作倒是挺清闲。

entries.en: Anyway, Shen is hosting auctions for Motes in here.
entries.zh: 总之，申在这里办拍卖，用微尘竞价。

entries.en: Hundreds of people bid on the items, then the few highest bids get the item!
entries.zh: 几百个人一起出价，最后出价最高的少数人能拍到物品！

entries.en: Check it out by clicking one of the items!
entries.zh: 点击任意一件物品看看吧！

entries.en: Hey are you looking to get to the castle?
entries.zh: 嘿，你想去城堡吗？

entries.en: All you need is a flying boat!
entries.zh: 有条会飞的船就行了！

entries.en: From here, you must go alone.
entries.zh: 从这里开始，你得独自前行。

entries.en: Your destiny lies at the mountain's peak.
entries.zh: 你的命运就在山巅。

entries.en: Seek out the breach and fulfill your purpose.
entries.zh: 找到那道裂口，完成你的使命吧。
你好。

entries.en: It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.
entries.zh: 很高兴认识你。

entries.en: Are you the culprit of this wrongdoing?
entries.zh: 这桩恶行，可是你干的？
请选择： [真凶？]

entries.en: In fact, do not reveal the answer just yet.
entries.zh: 且慢，先别急着揭晓答案。

entries.en: Allow me to introduce myself. I am Special Agent Thomas Amog.
entries.zh: 容我自我介绍。我是特工托马斯·阿莫格。

entries.en: I am currently investigating a most heinous reverse murder.
entries.zh: 我正在调查一桩极其恶劣的反转谋杀案。
请选择： [反转谋杀案？]

entries.en: Observe the bloodstains on the ground, my dear.
entries.zh: 仔细看看地上的血迹，亲爱的。

entries.en: It is clear that a murder is about to occur.
entries.zh: 显而易见，一场谋杀即将发生。

entries.en: Someone is going to die here, it is inevitable.
entries.zh: 有人将在这里丧命，这是不可避免的。

entries.en: Might you assist me in solving this case?
entries.zh: 你愿意协助我侦破此案吗？
请选择： [好。]

entries.en: Perfect, here is a Detective Scanner, take it.
entries.zh: 很好，这台侦探扫描仪，你拿着。

entries.en: I suggest utilizing it on various objects within this abode to uncover clues as to the whereabouts of the hapless victim.
entries.zh: 建议你用它扫描这栋宅邸中的各样物件，寻找线索，查明那位不幸受害者的下落。
这是扫描仪。

entries.en: Are you sure you used the scanner on everything in this house?
entries.zh: 你确定这屋里的东西都扫描过了？

entries.en: This part is crucial for the investigation.
entries.zh: 这一步对调查至关重要。

entries.en: Use the Detective Scanner to uncover clues as to the whereabouts of the hapless victim.
entries.zh: 用侦探扫描仪寻找线索，查明那位不幸受害者的下落。

entries.en: I believe we have gathered all the necessary clues to unravel this mystery.
entries.zh: 我想，解开这个谜团所需的线索，我们已经全部掌握了。
干得漂亮，亲爱的！

entries.en: However, the question remains, where ought we to begin our investigation?
entries.zh: 不过，问题来了，我们该从何处着手调查呢？

entries.en: Select an option: [Perhaps their lover is the florist?]
entries.zh: 请选择： [也许他的爱人就是那位花匠？]

entries.en: The bouquet was crafted with love, that much is certain.
entries.zh: 这束花中饱含爱意，这一点毋庸置疑。

entries.en: Well done, my dear, for deducing as much.
entries.zh: 能推理出这一点，做得很好，亲爱的。

entries.en: We must make haste and locate the florist at once. Time is of the essence in this matter.
entries.zh: 我们必须赶紧找到那位花匠。此事刻不容缓。

entries.en: Marcia, she must be the lover.
entries.zh: 玛西娅，她一定就是那位爱人。

entries.en: Ah, it appears Master Tactician Fink is the culprit.
entries.zh: 啊，看来战术大师芬克就是真凶。
真是耐人寻味。

entries.en: Come, let us make haste to the Colosseum and apprehend him.
entries.zh: 来吧，我们速去斗兽场将他缉拿。

entries.en: The culprit is right there, let's interrogate him.
entries.zh: 真凶就在那儿，我们去审问他。

entries.en: Marvelous! We have discovered the instrument of the crime.
entries.zh: 妙极了！我们找到了作案凶器。

entries.en: However, the location of Ramero remains unknown.
entries.zh: 不过，拉梅罗的下落仍然不明。
请选择： [这也太复杂了。]

entries.en: Yes, have you managed to uncover any promising leads?
entries.zh: 是啊，你找到什么有价值的线索了吗？
想想，亲爱的%1$s，再想想。

entries.en: Select an option: [What about that ring we found?]
entries.zh: 请选择： [我们找到的那枚戒指呢？]
啊哈！

entries.en: Yes, Ramero is probably in search of the final piece to complete his wedding ring.
entries.zh: 没错，拉梅罗大概正在寻找婚戒最后缺的那一部分。

entries.en: I suspect he has visited the local blacksmith to obtain the necessary jewel.
entries.zh: 我猜他去了本地的铁匠那里，寻找所需的宝石。
我们马上过去！

entries.en: I am quite certain that Mr. Ramero can be found at the blacksmith's shop at this very moment.
entries.zh: 我十分确信，拉梅罗先生此刻就在铁匠铺。

entries.en: Let's head there! It is near the mines.
entries.zh: 我们过去吧！就在矿洞附近。

entries.en: We found the Blacksmith, but no sign of Ramero, let's ask them.
entries.zh: 铁匠找到了，却不见拉梅罗的踪影，问问他们吧。
又走进了“死”胡同……

entries.en: But we are right on his tail. I can feel it.
entries.zh: 不过，我们已经紧随其后了。我能感觉到。

entries.en: Select an option: [I hope we're not too late.]
entries.zh: 请选择： [希望我们还来得及。]
我也是。再想想吧。

entries.en: Select an option: [Perhaps we missed something at his house?]
entries.zh: 请选择： [也许我们在他家漏掉了什么？]
好主意，我亲爱的朋友。

entries.en: When one is stuck in a difficult situation, it is often wise to return to the beginning and re-examine all the evidence.
entries.zh: 陷入困境时，回到起点，重新审视所有证据，往往才是明智之举。

entries.en: I believe we may have overlooked something of great importance at Mr. Ramero's residence.
entries.zh: 我想，我们可能在拉梅罗先生家中漏掉了极其重要的东西。

entries.en: Let us make haste and go back to his house at once to see if we can uncover any new clues.
entries.zh: 我们赶紧回他家，看看能否发现新的线索。

entries.en: See if you can find anything extra in the house!
entries.zh: 看看屋里还有没有别的发现！
找到什么了吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [Joliet bought the dress right before the picture was taken.]
entries.zh: 请选择： [乔莉埃是在拍照前刚买的裙子。]
正是如此！

entries.en: How could we have been so blind?
entries.zh: 我们怎么就视而不见呢？

entries.en: Joliet is undoubtedly buying the dress as we speak!
entries.zh: 乔莉埃此刻一定正在买裙子！
我们赶紧去泰勒那儿，动作快一点！

entries.en: There is Joliet. Let's ask her what she knows.
entries.zh: 那是乔莉埃。问问她知道些什么。
可怜的乔莉埃……

entries.en: Let's leave her alone and go find Ramero at his house.
entries.zh: 别再打扰她了，去拉梅罗家找他吧。
看来拉梅罗把自己封在屋里了。

entries.en: Select an option: [Smart, he knows he's in danger.]
entries.zh: 请选择： [聪明，他知道自己有危险。]

entries.en: Yes, I don't think we can enter now.
entries.zh: 没错，恐怕我们现在进不去了。

entries.en: Select an option: [How do we get inside?]
entries.zh: 请选择： [我们怎么进去？]

entries.en: The barricade is far too sturdy to break through on our own.
entries.zh: 这道路障太结实了，凭我们自己可破不开。

entries.en: There is only one person in the Rift who possesses the strength necessary to break through it.
entries.zh: 有力气破开它的，只有一个人，整个裂隙里再无第二位。

entries.en: But I fear he is often too busy with other matters to be of assistance to us...
entries.zh: 不过，恐怕他常常忙于别的事务，无暇相助……

entries.en: Select an option: [Who could this be?]
entries.zh: 请选择： [那会是谁？]

entries.en: The individual in question is none other than Wizardman.
entries.zh: 此人不是别人，正是巫师侠。

entries.en: Admittedly, his methods can be a tad unpredictable.
entries.zh: 不得不说，他的行事方式有些隐匿。

entries.en: Nonetheless, we should call upon his help.
entries.zh: 但我们还是应该向他求助。

entries.en: You should try to shout "Help Wizardman!"
entries.zh: 你试着喊一句：“Help 巫师侠！”

entries.en: Select an option: [We are investigating the reverse murder of Ramero.]
entries.zh: 请选择： [我们正在调查拉梅罗的反转谋杀案。]
拉梅罗就在那儿！
他马上就要死了！

entries.en: We are almost at the end of our journey.
entries.zh: 我们的旅程即将抵达终点。

entries.en: We have found the murder weapon, the victim, and the place where the crime was committed.
entries.zh: 我们已经找到了凶器、受害者，以及罪行发生的地点。
这一步非做不可。

entries.en: Select an option: [Hold on, I'm the murderer?]
entries.zh: 请选择： [等等，我才是凶手？]

entries.en: Naturally, this is where the investigation leads.
entries.zh: 自然，调查指向的正是这个结论。

entries.en: Courage, %1$s. I know that you are more than capable to see this through to the end.
entries.zh: 鼓起勇气，%1$s。我知道你完全有能力将此事进行到底。

entries.en: You are almost there, my friend.
entries.zh: 就差一步了，我的朋友。
你能做到的。

entries.en: Come on, use the murder weapon.
entries.zh: 来吧，使用凶器。
是时候了。
恭喜你，%1$s。
你破案了！

entries.en: But I must ask, why did you kill him?
entries.zh: 不过我得问一句，你为何要杀他？
请选择： [你在开玩笑吧？]

entries.en: These reverse murders always have a motive.
entries.zh: 这些反转谋杀案总是有动机的。

entries.en: Did you kill him to steal his ring of love?
entries.zh: 你杀他，是为了夺走他的爱之戒指吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [Maybe? I don't know.]
entries.zh: 请选择： [也许吧？我不知道。]

entries.en: I see. Well, take it then.
entries.zh: 原来如此。那就拿走吧。

entries.en: You have completed your goal and the case is now closed.
