entries.zh: 你的目标已经达成，此案就此了结。
你干得漂亮，%1$s！

entries.en: I hope we get to work together again!
entries.zh: 希望我们还有机会合作！

entries.en: One can hope you won't have to investigate my own reverse murder.
entries.zh: 但愿你不会需要调查我自己的反转谋杀案。

entries.en: Do you need to find Ramero's Ring again?
entries.zh: 你还需要再找一次拉梅罗的戒指吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [I know. Don't you remember me?]
entries.zh: 请选择： [我知道。你不记得我了吗？]

entries.en: I do remember you, although I am uncertain if we have met in this timeline.
entries.zh: 我确实记得你，只是不确定我们在这条时间线上是否见过。
请选择： [唉……]
受害者是拉梅罗。

entries.en: Select an option: [You can't be serious.]
entries.zh: 请选择： [你不是认真的吧。]

entries.en: I came to this vantage point in hopes to see the murderer.
entries.zh: 我来到这处高点，希望能望见凶手。

entries.en: Yet, I must confess, my investigations have yet to bear fruit.
entries.zh: 不过，不得不承认，目前的调查还一无所获。

entries.en: Select an option: [Have you looked in his house yet?]
entries.zh: 请选择： [你去他家看过了吗？]

entries.en: Indeed, I have inspected his house, but perhaps a fresh pair of eyes might reveal what I have missed.
entries.zh: 确实，我已经查看过他家了，不过换双眼睛，也许就能发现我漏掉的东西。

entries.en: Let us proceed to Ramero's house together.
entries.zh: 我们一起去拉梅罗家吧。

entries.en: We might find more clues at Ramero's house.
entries.zh: 或许能在拉梅罗家找到更多线索。

entries.en: Select an option: [Do we really have to go through this?]
entries.zh: 请选择： [我们真的非得再来一遍吗？]

entries.en: Indeed my dear, it must be done.
entries.zh: 当然，亲爱的，这是必须的。

entries.en: We should employ a detective scanner to uncover clues as to the whereabouts of the hapless victim.
entries.zh: 我们应该用侦探扫描仪寻找线索，查明那位不幸受害者的下落。

entries.en: Select an option: [I think we should go to the florist because the bouquet over there was made with love.]
entries.zh: 请选择： [我想应该去找花匠，因为那边的花束饱含爱意。]

entries.en: The bouquet, yes! That appears to be true, impressive.
entries.zh: 花束，对！看来确实如此，了不起。

entries.en: Well done my dear, for deducing as much.
entries.zh: 能推理出这一点，做得很好，亲爱的。

entries.en: Have you uncovered more clues, my dear?
entries.zh: 亲爱的，又发现什么线索了吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [I don't know what to believe anymore.]
entries.zh: 请选择： [我都不知道还能相信什么了。]

entries.en: What revelations did the Master Tactician Fink bestow upon you?
entries.zh: 那位战术大师芬克向你透露了什么？

entries.en: Select an option: [He saw the murderer leave to the Blacksmith with the murder weapon.]
entries.zh: 请选择： [他看见凶手带着凶器去找铁匠了。]

entries.en: Shall we pursue that avenue then?
entries.zh: 那我们就顺着这条线索追查？

entries.en: Select an option: [The Blacksmith is a dead end and I'm tired of this case...]
entries.zh: 请选择： [铁匠那边是死胡同，我受够这个案子了……]

entries.en: Indeed, it is an exhausting endeavor.
entries.zh: 的确，这着实令人疲惫。

entries.en: Select an option: [Let's skip directly to Joliet, she is at Taylor's shop.]
entries.zh: 请选择： [直接去找乔莉埃吧，她在泰勒的店里。]

entries.en: Directly to Joliet at Taylor's shop? A judicious choice, indeed.
entries.zh: 直接去找乔莉埃，到泰勒的店里？确实是明智之选。

entries.en: It is plausible that Ramero sought out Joliet one final time before his untimely demise.
entries.zh: 很可能，拉梅罗在遭遇不测之前，最后一次去找了乔莉埃。
请选择： [你说什么就是什么吧。]

entries.en: Let us hasten our steps to Taylor's shop without delay!
entries.zh: 我们赶紧去泰勒的店，别再耽搁了！
你的直觉果然没错，%1$s。

entries.en: We found Ramero before the murderer could.
entries.zh: 我们比凶手先找到了拉梅罗。

entries.en: Yet, something is amiss, as a murder was foretold to occur at his house.
entries.zh: 可是，有些不对劲。预示的谋杀应该发生在他家中。

entries.en: It is destined that someone will perish where these bloodstains lay.
entries.zh: 注定会有人死在这片血迹所在之处。

entries.en: Every word has reached my ears.
entries.zh: 每一个字，我都听到了。

entries.en: Let's quickly make our way to Ramero's house to barricade it.
entries.zh: 我们赶紧去拉梅罗家，把屋子封起来。
凶手还没到！

entries.en: Let's move quickly and help Ramero!
entries.zh: 快去帮拉梅罗！
干得出色！
这道路障异常坚固。

entries.en: I can think of only one person who might manage to destroy it in the Rift!
entries.zh: 整个裂隙里，我只能想到一个人有可能破开它！

entries.en: Select an option: [I think it's going to break very soon.]
entries.zh: 请选择： [我觉得它马上就要被打破了。]

entries.en: Expecting a breach soon? Then we must gear up.
entries.zh: 预料它很快就会被突破？那我们得做好准备。

entries.en: Quickly, find a hiding spot until the murderer makes their move!
entries.zh: 快找个藏身处，等凶手出手！

entries.en: You will need to defeat them before they kill Ramero!
entries.zh: 你必须在凶手杀死拉梅罗之前击败对方！

entries.en: Hurry, find a hiding place before the murderer breaches the entrance!
entries.zh: 快，找地方藏好，凶手就要破门而入了！

entries.en: Quickly now, take cover in the corner!
entries.zh: 快点，躲到角落里！

entries.en: Perfect, stay there hidden, until you see the murderer attempt on Ramero's life!
entries.zh: 很好，藏在那儿别动，等你看见凶手对拉梅罗下手！

entries.en: Now's the time! Defend Ramero with all you've got!
entries.zh: 就是现在！全力保护拉梅罗！

entries.en: Hurry, take down the murderer now!
entries.zh: 快，立刻打倒凶手！

entries.en: Act swiftly, %1$s! Shield Ramero from the assailant!
entries.zh: 快行动，%1$s！保护拉梅罗，别让凶手伤到他！

entries.en: Act fast! Bring the murderer to justice immediately!
entries.zh: 动作快！立即将凶手绳之以法！
你破案了。

entries.en: But I must ask, why did you choose to protect Ramero?
entries.zh: 不过我得问一句，你为何选择保护拉梅罗？
请选择： [你认真的？]

entries.en: Very few people would harm themselves rather than endanger another.
entries.zh: 很少有人宁愿伤害自己，也不愿让别人陷入危险。

entries.en: Such valor is most commendable, truly.
entries.zh: 这份勇气，实在值得称颂。

entries.en: Select an option: [Hold up, was that really me, or another version of me??]
entries.zh: 请选择： [等等，那真的是我，还是另一个版本的我？？]

entries.en: I cannot say for certain, only you can uncover such answers.
entries.zh: 我无法断言，只有你自己能找到答案。

entries.en: Select an option: [First you made me murder Ramero, and now... what?!]
entries.zh: 请选择： [先是你让我杀了拉梅罗，现在又……什么啊？！]

entries.en: Alas, it appears you had transformed into the murderer.
entries.zh: 唉，看来你已经变成了凶手。

entries.en: It was an inevitable turn of events, justice found its way.
entries.zh: 这一切不可避免，正义终究得到了伸张。

entries.en: Select an option: [What will happen to me now?]
entries.zh: 请选择： [那我现在会怎么样？]
难以预料。

entries.en: Depending on the timeline, this might be your fate.
entries.zh: 视时间线而定，这可能就是你的命运。

entries.en: Perhaps, however, that was a just end.
entries.zh: 不过，或许那也是罪有应得。

entries.en: You crossed a line when you tried to end Ramero's life.
entries.zh: 你越界了，你竟然企图夺走拉梅罗的生命。
那是不可辩解的行为。

entries.en: One indeed reaps what they sow.
entries.zh: 种下什么因，就会结出什么果。

entries.en: Select an option: [None of that would have happened without you!]
entries.zh: 请选择： [没有你，这一切根本就不会发生！]
那些事都是你亲手做的。

entries.en: And for that, you earned my respect.
entries.zh: 因此，你赢得了我的尊重。

entries.en: However you are correct, it is likely nothing would have happened had I not placed this blood on the ground.
entries.zh: 不过，你说得没错，要不是我把这些血洒在地上，大概什么也不会发生。
请选择： [你干了什么？！？！]

entries.en: One cannot investigate a reverse murder without first creating a murder scenario, dear.
entries.zh: 亲爱的，不先制造一场谋杀的现场，又怎么调查反转谋杀案呢？
这是最基本的道理。

entries.en: Select an option: [I hope I never meet you again.]
entries.zh: 请选择： [希望再也别见到你。]
看那边！

entries.en: Joliet has just arrived, and she seems quite delighted.
entries.zh: 乔莉埃刚刚到了，看起来相当高兴。

entries.en: You ought to speak with her, it could be enlightening!
entries.zh: 你该去和她聊聊，或许会有所启发！
又破了一桩案子！
请选择： [怎么又是你……]

entries.en: Allow me to introduce myself, I am Special Agent Thomas Amog.
entries.zh: 容我自我介绍，我是特工托马斯·阿莫格。
请选择： [什么恶行？]

entries.en: Someone is going to die right here.
entries.zh: 有人将在此地丧命。
就在此刻。
就在此处。
这是不可避免的。

entries.en: I already found a possible motive.
entries.zh: 我已经找到了一个可能的动机。

entries.en: This Wallet, that I found in my pocket.
entries.zh: 就是这个皮夹，我从自己口袋里找到的。
你知道该怎么做。

entries.en: Someone is going to die here, right now, it is inevitable.
entries.zh: 有人将在此时、此地丧命，这是不可避免的。
好痛！
我不想死！
求求你！

entries.en: I have many more cases to solve!
entries.zh: 我还有好多案子要破！
又破了一桩案子……

entries.en: The developer creating this didn't have time to implement a proper barricade breaking sequence.
entries.zh: 做这段内容的开发者没来得及实现一个像样的破障流程。

entries.en: But since we already broke the 4th wall, maybe we can use this opportunity to break this other wall.
entries.zh: 不过，既然我们已经打破了第四面墙，不妨借机把另一堵墙也打破吧。

entries.en: Select an option: [Click HERE to break barricade.]
entries.zh: 请选择： [点击这里破开路障。]
锵锵！
我们进去吧。
是我呀！

entries.en: I stepped into the Rift to help with the elections...
entries.zh: 我踏入裂隙，是为了帮忙筹办选举……

entries.en: I feel fine, but I wish it could be fixed.
entries.zh: 我感觉还好，不过我还是希望能恢复原样。

entries.en: Barry told me that the Alchemist could help.
entries.zh: 巴里告诉我，炼金术士能帮忙。

entries.en: But every time I talk to him, he gets uncontrollable nausea and starts vomiting incessantly.
entries.zh: 可每次我跟他说话，他都会忍不住恶心，然后开始呕吐，根本停不下来。

entries.en: Somehow, anyone who looks at me starts vomiting!
entries.zh: 不知怎么回事，谁一看见我就会吐！

entries.en: Select an option: [I'm starting to feel why.]
entries.zh: 请选择： [我好像开始明白为什么了。]
不要啊啊啊！

entries.en: Your face is turning green too!
entries.zh: 你的脸也开始发绿了！
求求你！

entries.en: Go to the Alchemist and help me fix my face!
entries.zh: 去找炼金术士，帮我把脸修好！

entries.en: Please go talk to the Alchemist.
entries.zh: 拜托，去找炼金术士谈谈。

entries.en: Barry told me he could fix my face.
entries.zh: 巴里告诉我，他能修好我的脸。

entries.en: Did you get a potion from the Alchemist?
entries.zh: 你从炼金术士那里拿到药水了吗？
快！泼到我身上！
呼！
我的脸居然真的掉下来了！

entries.en: Well, if I'm not making everyone throw up, it's a welcome improvement! :)
entries.zh: 好吧，只要不会再让所有人吐出来，就算是好转了！ :)
给，拿着我原来的脸！

entries.en: Thank you so much for helping to fix my face, %1$s!
entries.zh: 太感谢你帮我修好脸了，%1$s！

entries.en: Do you need my old one again?
entries.zh: 你还需要我原来那张脸吗？
我和凯特是表亲。

entries.en: If you work hard in school maybe you can wear a yellow suit like me!
entries.zh: 在学校好好念书，说不定你也能穿上我这样的黄色制服！

entries.en: I usually work in a nuclear power plant.
entries.zh: 我平时在核电站工作。

entries.en: I guess I looked the part so Kat hired me.
entries.zh: 大概是这身打扮挺像那么回事，凯特就雇了我。

entries.en: Standing here behind this big desk...
entries.zh: 站在这张大桌子后面……
不知怎么，灵感就来了……

entries.en: Like an inner voice telling me...
entries.zh: 仿佛心里有个声音在说……
开个店吧。
我一直在研究潟湖水蛭。

entries.en: I tasked my assistant Kay with a critical component of my research, but clearly she forgot about me!
entries.zh: 我把一项关键的研究任务交给了助手凯，可她显然把我忘得一干二净了！

entries.en: She's stuck near the Lagoon Hut, go talk to her.
entries.zh: 她困在潟湖小屋附近了，去找她聊聊。

entries.en: Have you talked to Kay yet?
entries.zh: 你找凯谈过了吗？

entries.en: She's stuck near the Lagoon Hut.
entries.zh: 她困在潟湖小屋附近。

entries.en: I can send you to the Leeches Lair but be warned, it's dangerous down there!
entries.zh: 我可以送你去水蛭巢穴，不过先警告你，下面可危险得很！
想去杀几只水蛭吗？
出发喽！

entries.en: I heard the Leech Supreme is dead!
entries.zh: 听说至尊水蛭已经死了！
大约 %1$s 秒后再来。

entries.en: Are you looking to go to a specific room?
entries.zh: 你想去某个特定的房间吗？

entries.en: I am Dr Emmett, the first human to manage entering the Rift.
entries.zh: 我是 Dr 埃米特，首位进入裂隙的人类。

entries.en: I built the Mirrorverse to better understand portals and their behaviors.
entries.zh: 我建造镜像世界，是为了更好地理解传送门及其运作方式。

entries.en: While I couldn't quite figure out portals, I did manage to let the mirror dimension interact with the real world and vice versa.
entries.zh: 虽然没能彻底搞懂传送门，但我成功让镜像维度与现实世界产生了双向互动。

entries.en: You can learn all of the secrets through the many rooms I built.
entries.zh: 我建造了许多房间，你可以通过它们了解其中所有的秘密。

entries.en: In every room I've placed a button in case you want to back out.
entries.zh: 每个房间里我都放了一个按钮，以防你想中途退出。

entries.en: Hey! Don't forget the first lever in this room!
entries.zh: 喂！别忘了这个房间里的第一个拉杆！

entries.en: Some of the experiments have harder difficulty challenges with unique rewards.
entries.zh: 有些实验提供更高难度的挑战，还设有独特奖励。

entries.en: You may activate it in this room using the hidden wooden button.
entries.zh: 你可以用这个房间里藏着的木制按钮开启挑战。

entries.en: I am actually stuck in the Mirrorverse.
entries.zh: 其实我被困在镜像世界里了。

entries.en: I do not have a physical representation anymore...
entries.zh: 我已经没有实体了……

entries.en: In this puzzle experiment, toggle which mirror is active by clicking on it.
entries.zh: 在这项解谜实验中，点击镜子就能切换当前启用的镜面。

entries.en: Try to think outside the box...
entries.zh: 试着跳出框框思考……

entries.en: Also make sure to check all sides of the box.
entries.zh: 当然，也别忘了把框框的每一面都检查一遍。

entries.en: If only I had used my head fully, I wouldn't be stuck in a bunch of mirrors.
entries.zh: 要是当初我多动动脑子，也不至于被困在一堆镜子里。

entries.en: Pro tip! If you have a hard time reaching the iron door, try stepping on the wood above the button.
entries.zh: 专业小窍门！够不着铁门的话，试着踩到按钮上方的木头上。

entries.en: I wish someone had given me a pro tip before I started studying the breach.
entries.zh: 真希望在我开始研究裂口前，也有人给我一点专业小窍门。

entries.en: It was my unbound thirst of knowledge which brought me to the Rift.
entries.zh: 正是我无止境的求知欲，驱使我来到裂隙。

entries.en: I built the Mirrorverse to better understand the Calamity.
entries.zh: 我建造镜像世界，是为了更好地理解大灾变。

entries.en: This is the Tubulator. You will need my lazer pointer.
entries.zh: 这里是镜像攀登。你会用到我的激光指示器。
继续吧！

entries.en: Time is infinite, but you can still run out of it!
entries.zh: 时间无穷无尽，但你依然可能将它耗尽！
恭喜！

entries.en: You reached the end of the Mirrorverse.
entries.zh: 你抵达了镜像世界的终点。

entries.en: I hope you gained valuable insights here.
entries.zh: 希望你在这里有所领悟。

entries.en: Accept these Motes as a reward for your efforts.
entries.zh: 收下这些微尘吧，作为你努力的回报。

entries.en: Is there anything else I can assist you with?
entries.zh: 还有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [No, I'm good.] [I have a few questions...]
entries.zh: 请选择： [不用了，我没事。] [我有几个问题……]

entries.en: Very well, may you lead a fulfilling life!
entries.zh: 很好，愿你此生充实圆满！
尽管问！我有的是时间……

entries.en: Select an option: [Why didn't the wizards simply build the portal at the top of the Mountain?]
entries.zh: 请选择： [巫师们为什么不干脆把传送门建在山顶？]

entries.en: They were unable to do so because the time distortion at the summit is too intense, while the woods offered a more manageable environment.
entries.zh: 他们做不到，因为山顶的时间扭曲太过剧烈，而树林的环境则更易掌控。

entries.en: Especially stabilized by the aura of the nearby Fairy.
entries.zh: 尤其是附近仙女的气场，还能帮助稳定它。

entries.en: Select an option: [The Wizard mentioned a great danger approaching our world. What is it?]
entries.zh: 请选择： [巫师说有巨大的危险正在逼近我们的世界。究竟是什么？]
这是高度机密。

entries.en: It is related to the Precursors, but I cannot say more.
entries.zh: 与先驱者有关，但我不能透露更多。

entries.en: Select an option: [Why did you choose to enter the breach?]
entries.zh: 请选择： [你为什么选择进入裂口？]

entries.en: While studying the breach at the top of the mountain....
entries.zh: 当我在山顶研究裂口时……

entries.en: I entrusted a letter containing my findings to Lathrop for delivery.
entries.zh: 我把发现写在一封信里，托 Lathrop 送出去。

entries.en: As the letter never reached the wizard, I had Alatar summon an exact copy of it.
entries.zh: 可信一直没有送到巫师手中，于是我让阿拉塔召出了一封一模一样的信。

entries.en: I threw the letter into the breach, which broke the laws of causality.
entries.zh: 我把信扔进裂口，这就打破了因果法则。

entries.en: I instantly appeared here, shattered by my boneheaded decision-making and eternally trapped.
entries.zh: 我瞬间出现在这里，支离破碎，都是拜我那愚蠢的决定所赐，从此永困于此。

entries.en: But I've been continuing my research.
entries.zh: 不过，我一直没有停止研究。
你就是研究的一部分。

entries.en: Select an option: [Yes. That is not weird at all.]
entries.zh: 请选择： [好啊。这真是一点也不奇怪。]

entries.en: May you lead a fulfilling life!
entries.zh: 愿你此生充实圆满！
又是你。

entries.en: Select an option: [Open your shop] [I have a few questions...]
entries.zh: 请选择： [打开商店] [我有几个问题……]
回见！

entries.en: I gambled all of my coins away.
entries.zh: 我把所有硬币都赌光了。
我失去了家人。
我失去了朋友。
连工作也丢了。

entries.en: How is Barry going to fix that? Uh?
entries.zh: 这事巴里打算怎么解决？嗯？

entries.en: Why would Barry be the Prime Minister if he can't even fix my own mistakes?!
entries.zh: 要是连我犯的错都收拾不了，巴里还当什么首相？!
嘘——下台吧！
① [有智慧的话。]

entries.en: ② [Patience comes to those who wait.]
entries.zh: ② [等得久了，自然就有耐心了。]

entries.en: ③ [The secret to life is good dental hygiene.]
entries.zh: ③ [人生的秘诀就是保持牙齿卫生。]
有智慧的话？

entries.en: This could quite possible be the dumbest thing I've heard in my entire life.
entries.zh: 这可能是我这辈子听过最蠢的话了。
请离我远点。
巴里真这么说？?

entries.en: It's so simple, but so true...
entries.zh: 这么简单，却这么有道理……

entries.en: I need to wake up and work on myself.
entries.zh: 我得清醒过来，好好改变自己。

entries.en: This Barry is such a wise man.
entries.zh: 这个巴里可真是个智者。

entries.en: Oh gosh I think I'm tearing up...
entries.zh: 天哪，我好像要哭了……

entries.en: Barry is the only thing worth betting on.
entries.zh: 巴里才是唯一值得押注的。
抱歉，我现在正忙。

entries.en: I'm working on the next big thing!
entries.zh: 我正在研究下一个了不起的发明！
我终于做到了！
终于想明白了！

entries.en: By combining the magic of the Rift with the rest of the universe...
entries.zh: 只要将裂隙的魔法与其余宇宙的力量结合……

entries.en: Select an option: [Can I have one?]
entries.zh: 请选择： [能给我一条吗？]

entries.en: Of course! But there's one tiny hiccup...
entries.zh: 当然可以！不过还有一点点小问题……

entries.en: In order to combine the magic, we will need to have the magic.
entries.zh: 想要融合这些魔法，我们得先拥有这些魔法。

entries.en: But I suppose for an adventurer of your caliber, traversing the weirdest parallel universe...
entries.zh: 不过，以你这样的冒险家的本事，穿越最古怪的平行宇宙……
避免永远被困在其中……

entries.en: Dodging giant, triple-stacked, INSTAKILLING temporal pillars...
entries.zh: 躲开三层叠起、巨大无比、一碰就死的时间柱……
可能还要对付吸血鬼……
应该完全没问题吧？

entries.en: Select an option: [What do I need to do for the necklace?]
entries.zh: 请选择： [想要项链，我得做些什么？]

entries.en: First, bring me the Supreme Timecharm.
entries.zh: 首先，把至尊时间护符带给我。

entries.en: Despite the name, it's not the best one.
entries.zh: 别看名字这么厉害，它可不是最好的那枚。

entries.en: It's the first of like 8 Timecharms.
entries.zh: 一共有 8 枚时间护符左右，这只是第一枚。

entries.en: We'll need that before going any further.
entries.zh: 有了它，我们才能继续下一步。

entries.en: Find the Supreme Timecharm somewhere in the Rift.
entries.zh: 去找至尊时间护符，它就在裂隙的某个地方。

entries.en: And only then can we move forward with the necklace.
entries.zh: 找到了，才能继续制作项链。
哇啊啊啊啊啊！

entries.en: You managed to get the Supreme Timecharm!
entries.zh: 你竟然拿到了至尊时间护符！

entries.en: We need to secure it to safety.
entries.zh: 我们得把它妥善保存起来。

entries.en: Use the warp to the gallery.
entries.zh: 通过传送点去画廊吧。
我在那里等你。
这里就是裂隙画廊！

entries.en: The wizards managed to take control of this section of the dimension for use in my necklace project.
entries.zh: 那些巫师设法掌控了这片维度的一角，专门用来支持我的项链计划。

entries.en: Secure Timecharms here every time you find one!
entries.zh: 每找到一枚时间护符，就在这里妥善保存！

entries.en: Place the Supreme Timecharm in the right slot of the gallery!
entries.zh: 把至尊时间护符放进画廊中对应的槽位！
太棒了！

entries.en: I frankly did not expect that much from you.
entries.zh: 老实说，我真没想到你能做到这一步。
给，你的项链。

entries.en: Okay... it might not seem incredible right now...
entries.zh: 好吧……它现在可能没那么惊艳……

entries.en: But there are two things about it!
entries.zh: 不过，关于它有两件事要告诉你！

entries.en: First, it becomes way stronger the more Timecharms you secure in the Rift.
entries.zh: 第一，在裂隙里保存的时间护符越多，它就会强大得多。

entries.en: Second, the real power is OUTSIDE, in the "real" universe.
entries.zh: 第二，它真正的威力在外面，也就是那个“真实”的宇宙里。

entries.en: Come and see me in the Wizard Tower in the SkyBlock Hub.
entries.zh: 来空岛主岛的巫师塔找我吧。

entries.en: Although, I might not be too kind out there.
entries.zh: 不过，外面的我可能没这么好说话。

entries.en: Simply tell my outside self the keyword CARAMEL and I should understand.
entries.zh: 只要对外面的我说出暗号焦糖，我应该就明白了。
玩得开心！

entries.en: My mother was a wizard, while my father crafted beautiful jewelry.
entries.zh: 我的母亲是位巫师，父亲则制作精美的珠宝。

entries.en: Naturally, I decided to combine their talents!
entries.zh: 于是，我自然决定将他们的才华结合起来！

entries.en: Congratulations on obtaining the mrahcemiT esrevrorriM!
entries.zh: 恭喜你拿到了符护间时宙宇像镜！

entries.en: I've heard that one demands wits, a quality that cannot be gained easily.
entries.zh: 听说那一枚考验的是智慧，这可不是轻易就能拥有的。

entries.en: Numerous wizards have ventured into the Rift, but not all are from the world you and I come from.
entries.zh: 许多巫师都曾踏入裂隙，但他们并不全来自你我所在的世界。

entries.en: Due to the Rift's nature, we can never be sure if they hail from the past or from a time yet to come.
entries.zh: 由于裂隙的特性，我们永远无法确定他们究竟来自过去，还是尚未到来的未来。
你又收集到了一枚时间护符！

entries.en: As you journey deeper into the Rift, things maybe become more challenging.
entries.zh: 越是深入裂隙，遇到的挑战也许就越难。

entries.en: My advice? Gather as much ф Rift Time as possible before proceeding further.
entries.zh: 我的建议？尽量多积攒ф 裂隙时间，再继续深入。

entries.en: Barry is truly one of the most skilled wizards I've ever met.
entries.zh: 巴里真的是我见过最厉害的巫师之一。

entries.en: Too bad he's using his powers for all the wrong reasons.
entries.zh: 可惜他把力量用在了错误的事情上。

entries.en: Don't tell him I said that!
entries.zh: 别告诉他是我说的！

entries.en: There's been enough complaints against him recently.
entries.zh: 最近对他的抱怨已经够多了。

entries.en: Barry was rather downcast before his first election.
entries.zh: 巴里在第一次当选前，情绪一直很低落。

entries.en: But once elected, he discovered he could make a positive impact.
entries.zh: 但当选后，他发现自己能够带来积极的改变。

entries.en: He REALLY wanted to become mayor again, to no avail.
entries.zh: 他特别想再次当上市长，却怎么也没能如愿。

entries.en: I guess he found a way...
entries.zh: 我想，他找到了另一条路……

entries.en: In any case, without his help, we couldn't have fixed the portal.
entries.zh: 无论如何，没有他的帮助，我们就修不好传送门。

entries.en: Honestly, I've made my peace with leaving all the meaning of my life to the past.
entries.zh: 说实话，对于把人生的全部意义留在过去这件事，我已经释怀了。

entries.en: If getting here was my purpose in life, then anything beyond that point would've been meaningless anyway.
entries.zh: 如果来到这里就是我一生的使命，那么在那之后的一切，本来也就没有意义了。
至少，现在这事算是定下来了。

entries.en: But sometimes, when I'm alone in the Gallery...
entries.zh: 可有时候，当我独自待在画廊里……

entries.en: It's cold, isolated and utterly confounding.
entries.zh: 那里寒冷、与世隔绝，又令人完全摸不着头脑。

entries.en: I'm relieved you managed to secure the Timecharm from there!
entries.zh: 你能把那里的时间护符安全带回来，真让我松了口气！

entries.en: Best of luck battling the infection in the Colosseum.
entries.zh: 祝你在斗兽场顺利战胜感染。

entries.en: I crossed the breach a little bit after Dante's defeat in our world.
entries.zh: 我穿过裂口时，我们世界里的但丁刚被击败没多久。

entries.en: While I can't be sure if the Slime was there "before" his demise, the resemblance is striking.
entries.zh: 我不确定那只史莱姆是否在他死前就已经存在，但它们实在太像了。

entries.en: The wizards believe Shen employed Dante, or perhaps even created him!
entries.zh: 巫师们认为是申雇用了但丁，甚至可能是他创造了但丁！

entries.en: Or did Shen find a way into the Rift before us?
entries.zh: 还是说，申比我们更早找到进入裂隙的方法？
难道他是在这里找到了但丁？
不可思议！
你真的打败了巴克特？

entries.en: Perhaps you're the one who can reach the Mountaintop...
entries.zh: 也许你就是那个能登上山巅的人……

entries.en: The vampires have bestowed their Timecharm upon you?
entries.zh: 那些吸血鬼竟然把他们的时间护符赐给你了？

entries.en: You must've made a powerful impression on their Coven.
entries.zh: 你一定给他们的秘会留下了极深的印象。

entries.en: We may never fully comprehend it, but your assistance has been invaluable so far!
entries.zh: 我们也许永远无法完全理解它，但到目前为止，你的帮助实在无可替代！

entries.en: I've heard rumors that the breach on top of the Mountain was made by a massive Dragon.
entries.zh: 我听过传闻，说山顶的裂口是一头巨大的龙造成的。

entries.en: But hey, did the breach cause the Rift?
entries.zh: 不过，究竟是裂口造成了裂隙？

entries.en: Or was the Rift just hanging around before we even had a way in?
entries.zh: 还是在我们找到入口以前，裂隙就一直在那里？

entries.en: Guess we might never figure that out...
entries.zh: 恐怕我们永远也弄不清了……

entries.en: Nice job getting all the timecharms.
entries.zh: 全部时间护符都拿到手了，干得漂亮。

entries.en: Your Rift Necklace is totally maxed out now.
entries.zh: 你的裂隙项链现在已经彻底升满了。

entries.en: Really appreciate the help with all this.
entries.zh: 这一切多亏你帮忙，真的很感谢。

entries.en: Drop by sometime, it gets pretty lonely out here.
entries.zh: 有空就来坐坐，这里还挺寂寞的。
拜托了。

entries.en: Spirit of many souls, I am.
entries.zh: 万千灵魂的化身，是我。
选择一个选项: [仙女之魂？]

entries.en: Fairy Souls, of I've never heard?
entries.zh: 仙女之魂，听说过我可没有？
谜魂，我全都吞噬！

entries.en: Power of Souls, cloak you through with me share!
entries.zh: 灵魂之力，透过披风你与我共享！
选择一个选项: [呃……什么？]

entries.en: Picture, more is 100 Motes worth than.
entries.zh: 一幅画，胜过 100 微尘的价值。
微尘颗粒，捡起来。

entries.en: 4 souls come back, you find and.
entries.zh: 找到 4 枚魂，再回来你。
披风，你弄丢了？

entries.en: Dark path, start once down the consume, it will.
entries.zh: 黑暗之路，一旦踏上便将你吞噬，它会。

entries.en: Great Warrior, not wars great make one.
entries.zh: 伟大的战士，战争并不使人伟大。

entries.en: Door or door not, there is no open.
entries.zh: 门，或不门，没有开。
回来，欢迎。
回来回来，欢迎欢迎。
回来回来回来，欢迎欢迎欢迎。
回来回来回来回来，欢迎欢迎欢迎欢迎。
回来回来回来回来回来，欢迎欢迎欢迎欢迎欢迎。
再次，来。
那个供货商？

entries.en: Yeah, I know who they are.
entries.zh: 对，我知道是谁。
是个很有名的阿戈菲炼金术士！

entries.en: They should be in their shack up in the trees.
entries.zh: 应该就在树上的小屋里。
那人总在那儿干活。
这里没有吸血鬼！

entries.en: Fairies lived in the castle for a while, you know?
entries.zh: 你知道吗，仙女们曾在城堡里住过一阵。

entries.en: To fairy or not to fairy?
entries.zh: 当仙女，还是不当仙女？

entries.en: Well...considering some fairies get thrown off towers...
entries.zh: 唔……想到有些仙女会被扔下高塔……
咱们还是别当仙女了吧……

entries.en: Oh, wondrous sprite of fairy kind,
entries.zh: 啊，仙女一族的奇妙精灵，

entries.en: Whose soul is light and free,
entries.zh: 你的灵魂轻盈而自由，

entries.en: Thy nature is a thing divine,
entries.zh: 你的天性如此神圣，

entries.en: A joy for all to see.
entries.zh: 让目睹的人们满心欢欣。

entries.en: Thy wings are like the morning mist,
entries.zh: 你的翅膀宛如晨雾，
你的笑声恰似微风，

entries.en: Thy voice, a sound that can't be missed,
entries.zh: 你的声音令人倾耳，
如一曲甜美自在的歌。

entries.en: So let us revel in thy glee,
entries.zh: 让我们沉醉在你的欢欣里，

entries.en: And bask in thy sweet glow,
entries.zh: 沐浴你柔美的光，

entries.en: For in thy soul, we all can see,
entries.zh: 因为在你的灵魂深处，
我们都看见了爱的赠予。
选择一个选项: [把仙女扔出去]

entries.en: Oh, fairy soul, how bright thou art,
entries.zh: 啊，仙女之魂，你多么明亮，
你的美令人惊叹，

entries.en: Thy presence fills my grateful heart,
entries.zh: 你的到来让我的心充满感激，
你是我寻获的珍宝。

entries.en: Thou art a creature of delight,
entries.zh: 你是欢愉的精灵，
你是优雅的化身，

entries.en: Thy soul doth glow with inner light,
entries.zh: 你的灵魂闪耀着内在的光，
那光芒将人温柔拥抱。
踢得真远！

entries.en: Congratulations on getting the first ever fairy soul!
entries.zh: 恭喜你拿到了有史以来第一枚仙女之魂！
嗯哼，是啊……诗歌。
仙女们总是形影不离！

entries.en: Except her, I never liked her.
entries.zh: 除了她，我一直都不喜欢她。

entries.en: Yes, yes, I know why you're here.
entries.zh: 知道啦，知道啦，我明白你为什么来。

entries.en: You think I'm an Enigma Soul.
entries.zh: 你以为我是一个谜魂。

entries.en: Well, in a way I was, but not anymore.
entries.zh: 嗯，以前勉强算是，现在可不是了。

entries.en: Many objects around here have become sentient. We're just living our lives now.
entries.zh: 这里不少东西都产生了自我意识。如今我们只想过自己的日子。

entries.en: Select an option: [Nice... I'm happy for you?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [挺好……那我该为你高兴？]

entries.en: I won't give you an Enigma Soul, you know.
entries.zh: 我可不会给你谜魂，你知道的。
这里没有你要的东西。

entries.en: I'm really not an Enigma Soul.
entries.zh: 我真的不是谜魂。
现在请让我一个人待着吧。
你可能觉得这东西很贵……
卡死了！! 一直都在卡！

entries.en: It wasn't like that with the last Prime Minister!!
entries.zh: 上一个首相在的时候可不这样！!
真是气死人了！!!!

entries.en: ① [Are you perhaps using a VPN?]
entries.zh: ① [你是不是开了 VPN?]

entries.en: ② [You might be on a bad proxy.]
entries.zh: ② [你连的代理服务器可能不太好。]
③ [你是不是在下载东西？]

entries.en: No, I'm lagging even with my VPN turned off.
entries.zh: 没有，我关了 VPN 也卡。
没有啊，不可能。

entries.en: Both Grandiose Games and Vapor are closed.
entries.zh: 我把 Grandiose Games 和 Vapor 都关了。
哦，哇！
这下好了。

entries.en: Thank you Barry! And you too, %1$s!
entries.zh: 谢谢你，巴里！也谢谢你，%1$s!

entries.en: One day will come when the world will be cured from lag.
entries.zh: 总有一天，世界上再也不会有卡顿。

entries.en: If anyone can do it, it's Barry.
entries.zh: 要是有人能做到，那一定是巴里。

entries.en: Back in my day, booster cookies were 800k.
entries.zh: 想当年，增益曲奇才卖 800k。
爬梯子...好累啊...

entries.en: I spent... years... crafting... this magical scroll...
entries.zh: 我花了...好多年...才做出...这张魔法卷轴...

entries.en: With it... you can... skip the climb... effortlessly...
entries.zh: 有了它...你就不用爬了...轻轻松松...

entries.en: I've traveled many uh... dimensions and this is my favorite to race on. Want to try?
entries.zh: 我去过很多个，呃……维度，这里最适合赛跑。想试试吗？

entries.en: Start the race by walking over the pressure plate. If you finish in under 60s, you get something!
entries.zh: 踩上压力板就能开始赛跑。60 秒内跑完，就有奖励！

entries.en: Run over the pressure plate to start racing! Try to finish within 60s!
entries.zh: 踩上压力板开始赛跑！争取在 60 秒内跑完！

entries.en: How do you suppose you'll beat 60s by talking to me?
entries.zh: 光顾着跟我聊天，还怎么跑进 60 秒啊？

entries.en: Take this Dark Pebble. It's like a Polished Pebble, but not polished.
entries.zh: 拿着这颗暗黑卵石。和抛光鹅卵石差不多，就是没抛光。
试试跑进 35 秒吧！

entries.en: Real challenge! Can you finish the race in 35s or less?
entries.zh: 真正的挑战来了！你能在 35 秒内跑完吗？

entries.en: How do you suppose you'll beat 35s by talking to me?
entries.zh: 光顾着跟我聊天，还怎么跑进 35 秒啊？
恭喜你，%1$s!

entries.en: Here's a rare piece of Gunthesizer Lichen. Maybe you can do something with it.
entries.zh: 给你一块稀有的冈瑟合成地衣。也许你能拿它做点什么。
丢东西了？

entries.en: I read in the Rift Herald that Barry wants to make jumping illegal!
entries.zh: 我在裂隙先驱报上看到，巴里想禁止跳跃！

entries.en: That's not okay with me, I love jumping.
entries.zh: 我可不答应，我最爱跳了。

entries.en: When I wake up in the morning, I jump.
entries.zh: 早上醒来，我就跳。

entries.en: If I'm feeling blue, I jump!
entries.zh: 心情低落时，我也跳！
巴里恨我们这些爱跳跃的人。

entries.en: Barry is an anti-jumper, a bigot and stands against all my values.
entries.zh: 巴里就是个反跳跃的偏执狂，我相信的一切，他都反对。

entries.en: ① [Barry said jumping is an affront to gravity.]
entries.zh: ① [巴里说跳跃是对重力的冒犯。]

entries.en: ② [Barry said you shouldn't base your identity on jumping.]
entries.zh: ② [巴里说你不该靠跳跃来定义自己。]

entries.en: ③ [Barry said the Rift Herald is bought and paid for by the mob.]
entries.zh: ③ [巴里说裂隙先驱报早就被黑帮收买了。]
那又怎样？

entries.en: What has gravity ever done for me?
entries.zh: 重力到底为我做过什么？

entries.en: And what do YOU base your identity on?
entries.zh: 那你又靠什么定义自己？
你的地牢等级？??
我的天哪。

entries.en: They should say so on the cover!!
entries.zh: 他们就该把这事写在封面上！!

entries.en: Instead of blindly following a newspaper, I will instead follow Barry, a real politician of the people!
entries.zh: 与其盲目相信一份报纸，我还不如追随巴里这位真正为人民着想的政治家！

entries.en: I'm working on a resolution to ban anti-jumping.
entries.zh: 我正在拟一项决议，禁止反对跳跃。

entries.en: If it works, everyone will stay midair all the time.
entries.zh: 要是通过了，所有人就得一直待在半空中。

entries.en: They grew from the trees after the Rift opened.
entries.zh: 他们是在裂隙打开之后，从树上长出来的。

entries.en: You should try to get a complete Wyld Armor set from them.
entries.zh: 你应该找他们凑一整套异野盔甲。

entries.en: Select an option: [I'm sorry but who are you?]
entries.zh: 选择一个选项: [抱歉，你是谁？]
听好了。

entries.en: If you want your mind intact when you get out of here...
entries.zh: 如果你还想神志清醒地离开这里……

entries.en: That's it, I'm about to make it out of here!
entries.zh: 就是现在，我马上就能出去了！

entries.en: You see the sun way up there in the sky?
entries.zh: 看见天上高高挂着的太阳了吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [No I don't, there is no Sun in here...]
entries.zh: 选择一个选项: [没看见，这里根本没有太阳……]

entries.en: If I can reach it, I'll be able to exit this place- I'm sure of it!
entries.zh: 只要够到它，我就能离开这里——我敢肯定！

entries.en: Anyway, I've been prepping my super jump since I was a wee tot.
entries.zh: 总之，我从小就开始准备这次超级大跳了。

entries.en: The more I squat before a jump, the higher I jump!
entries.zh: 起跳前蹲得越多，跳得就越高！

entries.en: Gotta say, it's pretty far up though...
entries.zh: 不过话说回来，真的挺高啊……

entries.en: How many squats do you reckon I need? Like 3, 6, or maybe 9?
entries.zh: 你说我该蹲几下？ 3 下、6 下，还是 9 下？

entries.en: Hmmm, %1$s, huh? Sounds like a plan!
entries.zh: 嗯……%1$s 下，是吧？听起来不错！
拼了！

entries.en: Woah, the exit is way higher than I thought...
entries.zh: 哇，出口比我想的还高……

entries.en: Let's AMP IT UP a bit! What do you say to 12, 18, or even 24 squats?
entries.zh: 咱们再加把劲！蹲 12 下、18 下，甚至 24 下，怎么样？

entries.en: Alright, deep breaths! Let's do this!
entries.zh: 好，深呼吸！上吧！

entries.en: Ouch, that was a bit too much oomph.
entries.zh: 哎哟，刚才好像用力过猛了。

entries.en: But I felt super close that time!
entries.zh: 但这次感觉真的快够到了！

entries.en: The next one's gonna nail it.
entries.zh: 下一次一定行。

entries.en: I don't want to overshoot it though...
entries.zh: 不过我可不想跳过头……

entries.en: We need the perfect amount of squats.
entries.zh: 蹲下的次数得刚刚好才行。
你觉得呢？

entries.en: 30, 40, or should we go big with 50?
entries.zh: 30 下、40 下，还是豁出去来 50 下？

entries.en: Hmm, %1$s, huh? Sounds like a plan!
entries.zh: 嗯，%1$s 下，是吧？听起来不错！
哎哟喂！!!

entries.en: I was like, super-duper close this time!
entries.zh: 这次真的就差那么一点点了！

entries.en: C'mon, what's next? Maybe 40 or do we just go wild and try 50?
entries.zh: 来，接下来呢？蹲 40 下，还是干脆疯一把，来 50 下？
选择一个选项: [40] [50]

entries.en: Okay, it's showtime! 40 squats here we come...
entries.zh: 好，好戏开场！ 40 下深蹲，开始……
让这一跳成为传奇！

entries.en: As you see, I've done all the legwork... all the research!
entries.zh: 如你所见，所有跑腿活儿……研究，都是我做的！

entries.en: I found a way to smuggle items in and out of the Rift Dimension.
entries.zh: 我找到办法偷运物品进出裂隙维度。

entries.en: Bring me a Stability Elixir and I'll show you how!
entries.zh: 给我带一瓶稳定灵药来，我就演示给你看！

entries.en: Bring me a Stability Elixir and I'll let you smuggle items between dimensions!
entries.zh: 给我带一瓶稳定灵药来，我就让你在维度之间偷运物品！

entries.en: You should be able to find the potion at any local brewery.
entries.zh: 本地随便哪家酿酒坊应该都能找到这种药水。
哎哟，慢着！
别碰那个！
这一口下去，真舒服！

entries.en: Alright, both here and in the real world I've placed this Ender Chest.
entries.zh: 好了，我在这一侧和现实世界都放了一个末影箱。

entries.en: Use it to transfer Rift-Transferable items.
entries.zh: 用它来转运可跨裂隙转移的物品。

entries.en: Keep in mind, the items may turn different between dimensions!
entries.zh: 记住，物品在两个维度之间可能会变得不一样！
来，把这个示例物品拿着。

entries.en: Uh... you didn't pick up the example item.
entries.zh: 呃……你没把示例物品捡起来。

entries.en: You know, you learn a lot from looking at people's shoes.
entries.zh: 你知道吗，看别人的鞋能看出不少门道。

entries.en: I don't know how long I've been stuck here.
entries.zh: 我都不知道自己被困在这里多久了。

entries.en: Smuggling items is easy, but transferring people has its dangers.
entries.zh: 偷运物品容易，转移活人可是有风险的。

entries.en: Don't tell the wizard about me.
entries.zh: 别把我的事告诉巫师。

entries.en: Thought you could escape me, did you?
entries.zh: 以为你能躲开我，是吧？

entries.en: Silly, you can't run away from Jerry.
entries.zh: 傻孩子，你跑不出杰瑞的手掌心。

entries.en: I am every and nowhere all at once.
entries.zh: 我无处不在，同时又哪儿都不在。
有时候，我连我自己都复制！

entries.en: I am the very bedrock of the universe!!!
entries.zh: 我就是宇宙的根基！!!
请选择: [好。]

entries.en: Sorry, I can't talk right now.
entries.zh: 抱歉，我现在没法说话。
我在做心理建设。
* 吧唧吧唧吧唧 *
* 咔嚓咔嚓咔嚓 *
* 咕咚咕咚咕咚 *

entries.en: Alas, my Ramero is near death's door!
entries.zh: 唉，我的拉梅罗已经来到鬼门关前了！

entries.en: Oh Ramero, why doth thou have to die?
entries.zh: 啊，拉梅罗，你为何偏偏要死？

entries.en: My love for thee is unending.
entries.zh: 我对你的爱永无止境。

entries.en: Select an option: [My most sincere condolences.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [致以我最诚挚的哀悼。]

entries.en: We were to be joined in holy matrimony, and had even captured our love in a portrait.
entries.zh: 我们本要步入神圣的婚姻殿堂，还曾把我们的爱意留在一幅画像里。

entries.en: All was perfect in our world.
entries.zh: 我们的世界曾经完美无缺。

entries.en: We were to live happily ever after, until fate intervened.
entries.zh: 我们本会从此幸福地生活下去，直到命运横插一手。

entries.en: Select an option: [Ok but, where is Ramero now?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [好吧，可是拉梅罗现在在哪儿？]

entries.en: He hast retreated to his abode, consumed by fear.
entries.zh: 他躲回了自己的住所，被恐惧吞噬。

entries.en: Oh, how my poor darling doth suffer!
entries.zh: 哦，我可怜的达令受了多少苦啊！

entries.en: Select an option: [Thank you Joliet, we will find him promptly.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [谢谢你，乔莉埃，我们会尽快找到他。]

entries.en: Oh, gentle friend, grant me thine ear!
entries.zh: 哦，温柔的朋友，请听我一言！

entries.en: My dear Ramero, whom fortune hath forsaken, is nigh unto his final breath!
entries.zh: 我亲爱的拉梅罗，被命运抛弃的人，已经只剩最后一口气了！

entries.en: The vile murderer hounds us close, his shadow ever near.
entries.zh: 那邪恶的凶手步步紧逼，他的阴影始终笼罩着我们。

entries.en: I beseech thee, bring us thy aid!
entries.zh: 我恳求你，助我们一臂之力！

entries.en: Canst though, in valor, rise to defend and deliver us?
entries.zh: 你能否鼓起勇气挺身而出，保护我们，救我们于危难？

entries.en: Select an option: [I'll try my best.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [我会尽力而为。]

entries.en: I thank thee, kind soul, for thy gracious aid.
entries.zh: 谢谢你，善良的人，多谢你慷慨相助。

entries.en: Our love, steadfast and true, seeks to defy the caprice of fate.
entries.zh: 我们坚贞不渝的爱，偏要对抗命运的无常。

entries.en: Ere long, Ramero and I shall pledge our troth and seek to populate our hearth with joyous offspring.
entries.zh: 不久之后，拉梅罗和我就会许下婚约，生儿育女，让家里充满欢声笑语。

entries.en: My Ramero breathes still, thanks to thy valor!
entries.zh: 我的拉梅罗还活着，多亏你的英勇！

entries.en: The monstrous wretch who sought his life is no more!
entries.zh: 那个想要他命的怪物恶棍已经灰飞烟灭了！

entries.en: Such a villain, surely spawned from the darkest pit, sought to rend asunder our sweet love.
entries.zh: 这样的恶徒，定是从最黑暗的深渊里爬出来的，竟想拆散我们甜蜜的爱情。

entries.en: With that specter dispatched, we may wed and plant the seeds of our lineage.
entries.zh: 那幽灵既已铲除，我们就能成婚，开枝散叶，延续香火。

entries.en: I offer thee my dearest possession, a small recompense for thy heroic deeds.
entries.zh: 我把我最珍视的宝物送给你，聊表谢意，报答你的英雄之举。
再会了，亲爱的朋友。

entries.en: May fortune smile upon thy path and grace thy life with prosperity.
entries.zh: 愿幸运眷顾你前行的路，愿你一生富足安康。

entries.en: Do you need the ring again?
entries.zh: 你还需要那枚戒指吗？

entries.en: If you've made it this far, you're talented.
entries.zh: 能走到这一步，说明你很有本事。

entries.en: I'm trying to solve one of the deepest mysteries of our world.
entries.zh: 我正试图解开我们这个世界最深的谜团之一。

entries.en: I'm looking for traces of the Precursors, but there's none anywhere.
entries.zh: 我在寻找先驱者的踪迹，但哪里都找不到。
一无所获！

entries.en: Not even anywhere in the Rift!
entries.zh: 连裂隙里也毫无踪迹！

entries.en: If they're trying to return to our world one day, shouldn't they come through here?
entries.zh: 如果他们哪天想回到我们的世界，那他们不是应该从这里过来吗？
奥鲁奥根本不在这里。

entries.en: But I know for a fact he acquired the Blessing of Time right here, in the Château!
entries.zh: 但我知道一件事:他获得时间祝福的地方，就在这儿，就在城堡里！
还有太多问题没有答案……
你见过朱利安吗？

entries.en: He's been spotted in the Rift on several occasions.
entries.zh: 有人好几次在裂隙里看到过他。

entries.en: While he may seem friendly, be cautious.
entries.zh: 他看似友善，但请务必小心。

entries.en: Those in his organization have committed questionable acts.
entries.zh: 他组织里的人干过一些见不得光的事。

entries.en: One doesn't reach his rank without crossing a few lines.
entries.zh: 能爬到他这个位置的人，没少越界。
你能来真是太好了！

entries.en: I was hired to disinfest this house from the vermin.
entries.zh: 我是被雇来除虫的，把这栋房子清干净。
请选择: [好吧？]

entries.en: Well, I can't do it myself!
entries.zh: 可我自己干不了啊！

entries.en: Turns out, I'm scared of insects.
entries.zh: 结果你猜怎么着，我怕虫子。
而且我对灰尘过敏。

entries.en: And the cleaning contract was badly negotiated.
entries.zh: 再说，那份清洁合同签得太亏了。

entries.en: And I have to watch over the disinfestor crew.
entries.zh: 还得盯着除虫队干活。

entries.en: Select an option: [Wait you're scared of insects?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [等等，你怕虫子？]

entries.en: Yes, I suffer from arachnophobia, entomophobia and pteronarcophobia.
entries.zh: 没错，我有蜘蛛恐惧症、昆虫恐惧症，还有石蝇恐惧症。

entries.en: Select an option: [Don't you petsit spiders and bees?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [你不是还帮人照看蜘蛛和蜜蜂吗？]

entries.en: You're thinking of Kat the Pet Sitter.
entries.zh: 你想说的是凯特，宠物保姆。

entries.en: I'm Kat the Neuroscientist. I'm purple Kat!
entries.zh: 我是凯特——神经科学家。我可是紫色的凯特！

entries.en: Select an option: [Then why were you hired to disinfest?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [那你为什么会被雇来除虫？]
别转移话题！
我这是被调查了吗？

entries.en: You have to do this quest!
entries.zh: 这任务你必须做！
把我的吸尘器拿去。

entries.en: Now please deal with the infestation problem.
entries.zh: 现在，请去解决虫害问题吧。

entries.en: Vacuum the silverfishes, spiders and flies in the area.
entries.zh: 把这一带的蠹虫、蜘蛛和苍蝇都吸掉。

entries.en: Make sure to empty the vacuum in the Vermin Bin!
entries.zh: 记得把吸尘器清空到害虫箱里！

entries.en: How did you lose my vacuum?
entries.zh: 你怎么把我的吸尘器弄丢的？
好吧……这把备用的拿去……

entries.en: It's always good to be well equipped for the job ahead!
entries.zh: 干活之前装备齐全，总归是好事！

entries.en: We found this Ferret when cleaning the house.
entries.zh: 我们打扫房子的时候发现了这只雪貂。

entries.en: It's very scared and of course I don't know how to deal with pets.
entries.zh: 它吓坏了，而我嘛，当然完全不会照顾宠物。

entries.en: I think you should bring it with you to the overworld!
entries.zh: 我觉得你该把它带到外面的世界去！

entries.en: I've had this pile of unused diplomas for a while.
entries.zh: 这堆没派上用场的文凭在我这儿放了有一阵子了。

entries.en: Don't ask me why and let's keep it between us.
entries.zh: 别问我为什么，这事就咱俩知道。

entries.en: Hey you can't click that yet!
entries.zh: 嘿，那个你还点不了！

entries.en: Help me with the disinfestation and I'll give you a key!
entries.zh: 帮我完成除虫工作，我就给你一把钥匙！

entries.en: Who's Dr. Hibble? Never heard of them.
entries.zh: 希布尔博士是谁？没听说过。
噢，你说的是埃德温博士？

entries.en: Yeah! I finished the research paper!
entries.zh: 对！研究论文我已经写完了！

entries.en: Wow, you made it through the lagoon!
entries.zh: 哇，你居然穿过了潟湖！
我们都困在这儿不知道多久了！
嗨，你好。

entries.en: Speak for yourself, I almost got it!
entries.zh: 那是你，我差一点就跳上去了！

entries.en: I can't right now. Maybe next time you ask me I will.
entries.zh: 现在不行。下次你再问，说不定我就能跳了。
厉害！这一跳可真够高的！

entries.en: They're a human, dummy. That's why.
entries.zh: 笨蛋，因为人家是人类啊。

entries.en: I can tell you their name for %1$s Motes.
entries.zh: 只要 %1$s 微尘，我就把名字告诉你。

entries.en: I heard that Vreike might know who the supplier is.
entries.zh: 我听说弗雷克可能知道供货商是谁。
呃……嗨！
我有点孤单。:(

entries.en: If you could sit around with me, then you can get my soul! :)
entries.zh: 你要是愿意坐下来陪陪我，就能拿到我的灵魂！ :)

entries.en: But please don't do it only for the soul like everyone else. :(
entries.zh: 不过，拜托别像其他人一样，只是为了灵魂才来。:(
这世界可真奇怪，是吧？

entries.en: You can pick a chair if you feel like it.
entries.zh: 愿意的话，随便挑张椅子坐吧。

entries.en: You can take a seat nearby if you'd like.
entries.zh: 愿意的话，就在附近坐坐吧。

entries.en: Feel free to keep me company or whatever.
entries.zh: 陪陪我什么的，都可以。

entries.en: I'm sorry but I'm sitting at this table.
entries.zh: 不好意思，这桌我坐着呢。

entries.en: Could you go to another table?
entries.zh: 你能换张桌子吗？

entries.en: %1$s, you're in my bubble right now.
entries.zh: %1$s，你离我太近了。

entries.en: Please sit at a different table.
entries.zh: 请换张桌子坐吧。

entries.en: Sorry but I'm sitting at this table.
entries.zh: 抱歉，我坐这桌。

entries.en: Can you please sit at a different table?
entries.zh: 能麻烦你换张桌子坐吗？
谢谢你愿意陪我……

entries.en: But could you sit at another table please?
entries.zh: 不过能请你坐到另一桌吗？
这张桌子我坐着呢。

entries.en: You're kind of in my bubble.
entries.zh: 你有点挤到我的私人空间了。
请坐到别处去。
?符护间时宙宇像镜了到拿经已你
请选择: [。看你给，了到拿]
我在找一位特定的矿工。

entries.en: Reflected in this mirror... could that be you?
entries.zh: 这镜子里映着的……会是你吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [They definitely look like me.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [那人确实长得像我。]
向我证明你的身份吧。

entries.en: From beyond the mirror, wear a similar set of mining gear, or stronger.
entries.zh: 在镜子另一侧，穿上类似的挖矿装备，或者更强的装备。
然后，潜行两次。
你已经证明了自己的身份。
来，收下这份赠礼。

entries.en: Perhaps you are the one my master seeks.
entries.zh: 或许你就是我主人要找的人。

entries.en: If you've reached this point, you truly are a once-in-a-generation talent.
entries.zh: 能走到这里，你确实是百年难得一遇的人才。

entries.en: However, I must see your Celestial Timecharm before allowing you to proceed.
entries.zh: 不过，你得先让我看看天界时间护符，我才能让你继续前进。

entries.en: Select an option: [I don't have it yet.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [我还没拿到。]

entries.en: Without the Timecharm, I cannot permit you to pass.
entries.zh: 没有时间护符，我不能让你通过。
我们一定还会再见。
请选择: [给你看。]

entries.en: You have successfully gathered all 8 Timecharms.
entries.zh: 你已经集齐了全部 8 个时间护符。

entries.en: The moment has come to meet your destiny.
entries.zh: 是时候去面对你的命运了。
你可以通过了。
我在找一位特定的渔夫。

entries.en: From beyond the mirror, wear a similar set of fishing gear, or stronger.
entries.zh: 在镜子另一侧，穿上类似的钓鱼装备，或者更强的装备。

entries.en: Then, splash yourself with a potion.
entries.zh: 然后，用喷溅药水泼自己。
我在找一位特定的农夫。

entries.en: From beyond the mirror, wear a similar set of farming gear, or stronger.
entries.zh: 在镜子另一侧，穿上类似的农耕装备，或者更强的装备。
然后说出 "埃莉诺 is the best!"
我在找一位特定的伐木工。

entries.en: From beyond the mirror, wear a golden armor.
entries.zh: 在镜子另一侧，穿上一身金质护甲。
我在找一位特定的战士。

entries.en: From beyond the mirror, wear a similar set of combat gear, or stronger.
entries.zh: 在镜子另一侧，穿上类似的战斗装备，或者更强的装备。

entries.en: Then, I want to see you vanish out of thin air.
entries.zh: 然后，我想看看你凭空消失。

entries.en: But first, you must demonstrate your worth to the other Eleanors.
entries.zh: 不过，你得先向其他埃莉诺证明自己的价值。

entries.en: Until then, I cannot grant you Shen's Ringalia.
entries.zh: 在那之前，我不能给你沈恩的王权戒饰。

entries.en: It seems you are indeed whom my master seeks.
entries.zh: 看来，你确实是我主人要找的人。

entries.en: I will allow you to purchase Shen's Ringalia.
entries.zh: 我会允许你购买沈恩的王权戒饰。

entries.en: You must now seek my master, at the end of the road.
entries.zh: 现在，到路的尽头去找我的主人吧。

entries.en: Good luck with the rest of your adventures.
entries.zh: 祝你接下来的冒险顺利。

entries.en: I'm not letting magic, dimensions, or the arrest of time stop me from grinding.
entries.zh: 管它什么魔法、异次元，还是时间停滞，都别想拦着我刷怪。

entries.en: If there's something to slay, I show up no matter what.
entries.zh: 只要有怪可杀，我就一定会来。

entries.en: Today, vampires are on the menu.
entries.zh: 今天要收拾的就是吸血鬼。

entries.en: Be careful because they deal ❤ damage and if you die around here...
entries.zh: 小心点，它们造成的是❤ 伤害。要是你在这儿死了……
所以你得回血！
靠西瓜回血！

entries.en: Slay a few vampires, then craft and show me your Healing Melon!
entries.zh: 先杀几只吸血鬼，再做个治疗西瓜拿来给我看看！

entries.en: Now let's get down to business.
entries.zh: 现在来办正事吧。

entries.en: I'm not letting magic, inter-dimensional travel, or the arrest of time stop me from grinding.
entries.zh: 管它什么魔法、跨次元旅行，还是时间停滞，都别想拦着我刷怪。
白天，黑夜，漆黑虚空……
无所谓！
我照来不误！
欢迎光临我的花店！

entries.en: Marco is sick, so I'm filling in for the day.
entries.zh: 马可病了，所以我替他照看一天。

entries.en: A day which lasted %1$s hours, by the way!
entries.zh: 顺带一提，这一天可是足足过了%1$s 小时啊！

entries.en: Welcome to my flower shop, may I help you?
entries.zh: 欢迎光临我的花店，有什么能帮你的吗？
我的恋人？
我可是单身！
你肯定弄错了……
噢，这样啊。

entries.en: No point in hiding it, I suppose.
entries.zh: 看来也没必要再瞒着了。
我爱上了拉梅罗。
什么！?!

entries.en: OMG! I'm having a panic attack!
entries.zh: 天啊！我快要吓死了！

entries.en: Ok, but while it IS true I love him, Ramero loves Joliet, not me!
entries.zh: 好吧，可我虽然确实爱他，拉梅罗爱的却是乔莉埃，不是我！

entries.en: I have no idea where they are...
entries.zh: 我也不知道他们在哪儿……
噢，知道，知道！
就是战术大师芬克！

entries.en: Fink is in love with Joliet, he definitely wants to do terrible things to Ramero...
entries.zh: 芬克爱着乔莉埃，他肯定想狠狠地收拾拉梅罗……

entries.en: I think they are usually around the Colosseum.
entries.zh: 他们平时好像就在斗兽场附近。
我可怜的拉梅罗！
噢，是你。
你救下拉梅罗了吗？
他还好吗？
我能见见他吗？
你为什么要这么做？??
噢，我的拉梅罗！
我能看看他的遗体吗？

entries.en: I would like to see his beautiful face one last time.
entries.zh: 我想再看一眼他俊美的脸。
噢，不！

entries.en: Really? Ramero is about to die?
entries.zh: 真的？拉梅罗就要死了？
真是天大的好消息！

entries.en: No, unfortunately I do not have it in me to do the deed myself.
entries.zh: 不是，可惜我下不了手，没法亲自办这件事。

entries.en: I will gladly sell you the murder weapon however.
entries.zh: 不过，我很乐意把凶器卖给你。
请自便。
合作愉快。

entries.en: Good luck on solving the case.
entries.zh: 祝你破案顺利。

entries.en: Do you need anything else to solve your case?
entries.zh: 破案还缺什么吗？
你动作真快！

entries.en: I'm glad people like you exist!
entries.zh: 这世上有你这样的人，真是太好了！
绝对不是。
我为什么要那么做？
那他的尸体在哪儿？

entries.en: Are you sure you killed him?
entries.zh: 你确定杀死他了？

entries.en: That's very strange because I just saw you leave to the Blacksmith to find more clues.
entries.zh: 那就怪了，我刚才才看见你出发去铁匠那儿找更多线索。
我发誓。

entries.en: You bought the Murder Weapon and left just a moment ago.
entries.zh: 你买下凶器，刚走没多久。

entries.en: Maybe you should go there and find out for yourself.
entries.zh: 要不你还是去那儿，亲自弄清楚吧。
你骗了我！
我还以为你杀了拉梅罗呢！

entries.en: I look like a fool now.
entries.zh: 这下我成笑话了。

entries.en: I even sold you the murder weapon!
entries.zh: 我连凶器都卖给你了！
你可真让我失望。

entries.en: Wife asked me to get a can of worms.
entries.zh: 老婆让我去买罐虫子。

entries.en: So you know, I dig down to the grocery store.
entries.zh: 那我当然就往下挖，去杂货店咯。

entries.en: I must've missed it since I ended up here.
entries.zh: 结果到了这儿，看来是挖过头了。

entries.en: Guess things tend to go full circle over time.
entries.zh: 看来时间一长，什么事都会兜回原点。

entries.en: Jump down to the pillar down there.
entries.zh: 跳到下面那根柱子上。
再跳下一根……

entries.en: Surely you'll be here again eventually.
entries.zh: 一直跳下去，你肯定会回到这儿的。
去吧。
跳到柱子上！

entries.en: If I can see it, you can too!
entries.zh: 我都能看见，你肯定也看得见！
兜回原点了。
我吃东西，给微尘。
以前，我收东西，给硬币！

entries.en: But now, me eat items, give Motes.
entries.zh: 现在，我吃东西，给微尘。

entries.en: Everybody knows mushrooms pop out when walking nearby.
entries.zh: 大家都知道，从旁边走过时蘑菇会冒出来。

entries.en: But not everybody knows they stay big longer around here.
entries.zh: 但不是所有人都知道，在这附近，它们保持巨大形态的时间更久。

entries.en: I know why, but I'm not telling.
entries.zh: 我知道为什么，但我不打算告诉你。
在这里没法传送。
这里不允许。

entries.en: Nice day to go fishing, isn't it?
entries.zh: 今天天气不错，正适合钓鱼，对吧？

entries.en: Have you got the SkyBlock Citizen Timecharm?
entries.zh: 你拿到空岛居民时间护符了吗？
请选择: [当然。]

entries.en: I think you should run for office.
entries.zh: 我觉得你应该去竞选公职。
你有沈恩的王权戒饰吗？

entries.en: Otherwise I cannot let you in.
entries.zh: 不然我不能放你进去。

entries.en: I see you have Shen's Ringalia.
entries.zh: 看来你有沈恩的王权戒饰。
你可以进去了。

entries.en: Where do you think you're going?
entries.zh: 你这是要去哪儿？
听说过时晶吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [Can't say I have.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [还真没听过。]

entries.en: Ah, a fresh face! Timite is an ore in these parts!
entries.zh: 啊，新面孔！时晶是这一带的一种矿石！

entries.en: Timite is a bit of a shape-shifter.
entries.zh: 时晶这东西还会变模样呢。

entries.en: When it's young and spry, we call it Youngite. Full of energy but doesn't know a thing!
entries.zh: 年轻又有活力的时候，我们叫它新生石。浑身是劲儿，可什么都不懂！

entries.en: Then Youngite ages into Timite, wise and valuable!
entries.zh: 之后，新生石慢慢老去，成了时晶，既有见识，又值钱！

entries.en: And with a little extra push, it becomes Obsolite, a grumpy old thing, complains about the 'good old days'.
entries.zh: 再稍微推它一把，就变成了过时石，一块脾气古怪的老东西，整天念叨 "当年可不是这样"。

entries.en: Select an option: [And how do I give it that 'little push'?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [那要怎么 "推它一把"?]

entries.en: Glad you asked! You need a Time Gun.
entries.zh: 问得好！你得有一把时间枪。

entries.en: Craft one using enough Youngite. Point it at an ore, and bam! You've aged it faster than cheese left in the sun.
entries.zh: 攒够新生石，做一把出来。对着矿石，砰！它老得比晒在太阳底下的奶酪还快。

entries.en: Select an option: [So I shoot rocks with a Time Gun to make them older?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [所以，我要拿时间枪打石头，让它们变老？]

entries.en: Precisely! And the older the ore, the more valuable it gets. Just like me!
entries.zh: 没错！矿石越老就越值钱，跟我一样！

entries.en: Now go one, make those ores feel their age. Time's a-wastin'!
entries.zh: 去吧，让那些矿石知道自己几岁了。时间可不等人！

entries.en: These bones ain't what they used to be.
entries.zh: 这把老骨头不比当年啦。

entries.en: Maybe I should give myself a zap with the Time Gun... or maybe not.
entries.zh: 要不拿时间枪给自己来一下……还是算了。

entries.en: I tried using the Time Gun on my tea once.
entries.zh: 我曾经拿时间枪打过一次茶水。

entries.en: Ended up with a cup of dust!
entries.zh: 结果只剩一杯灰！

entries.en: I am Oruo The Almighty. I have lived many lives. I have ascended.
entries.zh: 我是全能者奥鲁奥。我经历过许多次人生，如今已然超脱。

entries.en: I have control over the Blessing of Time.
entries.zh: 我掌握着时间祝福。

entries.en: In this place where time has no meaning, I created a zone where time is everything.
entries.zh: 在这个时间毫无意义的地方，我创造了一片时间决定一切的领域。

entries.en: It is the only room in The Rift where your body will feel the effects of Time.
entries.zh: 这是裂隙中唯一能让你的身体感受到时间影响的房间。

entries.en: In this Time Chamber, you will be able to train and get stronger.
entries.zh: 在这间时间密室里，你能通过训练变得更强。

entries.en: Entry demands 5,000 Motes, a trivial sum for a taste of eternity.
entries.zh: 进入需要 5,000 微尘。花这点代价，就能触及永恒。

entries.en: Though beware, for your ф Rift Time shall deplete twice as fast.
entries.zh: 不过要留意，你的 ф 裂隙时间将以两倍的速度消耗。
你意下如何？

entries.en: Select an option: [Enter Time Chamber] [Maybe later...]
entries.zh: 请选择: [进入时间密室] [晚点再来……]
你只是把必然到来的事往后推了。
你在想，我是不是神明？

entries.en: I am but a seeker who stumbled upon the Blessing of Time hidden within the veils of this dimension.
entries.zh: 我不过是个求索者，偶然发现了时间祝福，它一直藏在这个维度的帷幕之下。

entries.en: My partner, Sun Gecko, and I discovered the Blessing of Time together.
entries.zh: 我的同伴太阳壁虎和我一同发现了时间祝福。

entries.en: The fates decreed that only one could wield its power.
entries.zh: 命运却只允许一个人驾驭它的力量。

entries.en: It was I who was chosen, and thus I crafted this chamber so he could train against people such as yourself.
entries.zh: 被选中的人是我。于是我造出这间修炼室，让他能与像你这样的对手交锋。

entries.en: He must become stronger, in preparation for a hardship that has yet to come.
entries.zh: 他必须变得更强，好迎接尚未到来的磨难。
你问的是先驱者吗？

entries.en: Through the Blessing of Time I have earned the knowledge and memories of the ancient God of Time.
entries.zh: 凭借时间祝福，我获得了古代时间之神的知识与记忆。

entries.en: I have seen what no man has seen.
entries.zh: 我见过无人见过的景象。

entries.en: The shadows of their return soon loom over us; we must stand prepared.
entries.zh: 他们归来的阴影即将笼罩我们。我们必须做好准备。

entries.en: Julian seeks me, yet he knows not the full scope of the web woven by Shen, his own master.
entries.zh: 朱利安在找我，却还不清楚他的主人申究竟织下了多大的一张网。

entries.en: If he finds his way through the labyrinth of time to my domain, it will be my duty to enlighten him.
entries.zh: 如果他能穿过时间的迷宫，来到我的领地，我就有责任为他解惑。

entries.en: I will unveil the intricate plots of Shen and his organization.
entries.zh: 我会揭开申和他的组织布下的复杂阴谋。

entries.en: That knowledge, crucial and potent, may well tilt the scales of Destiny.
entries.zh: 这些至关重要的知识，或许足以让命运的天平倾斜。

entries.en: Magnificent. You have vanquished Sun Gecko, not a feat to be understated.
entries.zh: 漂亮。你击败了太阳壁虎，这可不是件小事。

entries.en: While moments have passed for you, weeks have slipped by for Sun Gecko.
entries.zh: 对你而言只过了片刻，对太阳壁虎而言却已过去数周。

entries.en: He lies in rest, rejuvenated and eager for your return.
entries.zh: 他正在休息，已恢复精神，正盼着你再来。

entries.en: The price for reentry remains at 5,000 Motes.
entries.zh: 再次进入仍需 5,000 微尘。
你敢付出这份代价吗？

entries.en: Your strength prevails, but your journey has only just begun.
entries.zh: 你的实力赢得了胜利，但旅途才刚刚开始。

entries.en: You are now granted access to Time Chamber Modifiers and the Sun Gecko Essence Shop.
entries.zh: 现在，你可以使用时间密室调整项和太阳壁虎精粹商店。

entries.en: The power of Sun Gecko is only limited by your own resolve.
entries.zh: 你的决心，决定着太阳壁虎力量的极限。

entries.en: Select an option: [Enter Time Chamber] [Maybe later...] [Ponder with Oruo]
entries.zh: 请选择: [进入时间密室] [晚点再来……] [与奥鲁奥思辨]

entries.en: Magnificent, you have vanquished Sun Gecko, not a feat to be understated.
entries.zh: 漂亮，你击败了太阳壁虎，这可不是件小事。
还要再挑战他一次吗？

entries.en: Once more you have triumphed over Sun Gecko. Such perseverance is rare, even in Tales of old.
entries.zh: 你又一次击败了太阳壁虎。这份毅力，即便在古老的传说中也不多见。

entries.en: A third victory! You have surpassed even my expectations.
entries.zh: 第三次胜利！你甚至超出了我的预期。

entries.en: Though Sun Gecko's power grows more daunting, you have found a way through once again.
entries.zh: 虽然太阳壁虎的力量愈发强大，你还是再次找到了取胜之道。

entries.en: Sun Gecko's intensity thundered across the battlefield, yet your will stood firm, forging a triumph that whispers of greatness yet untold.
entries.zh: 太阳壁虎的威势席卷整个战场，你的意志却丝毫未动摇。这份胜利，已显露出尚待书写的伟业。

entries.en: Sun Gecko pressed against the very limits of mortal endurance, yet today you sculpted a victory from raw chaos.
entries.zh: 太阳壁虎的攻势考验着凡人耐力的极限，而今天，你从混沌中铸就了胜利。

entries.en: As Sun Gecko unleashed deeper reserves of power, you carved a new mark of valor into the shifting sands of time.
entries.zh: 当太阳壁虎释放更深层的力量时，你在流动的时间之沙上，刻下了新的英勇印记。

entries.en: At the apex of Sun Gecko's power, when all seemed unattainable, you forged a moment of legend that will echo through ages.
entries.zh: 当太阳壁虎的力量登峰造极，一切都似乎遥不可及，你仍铸就了一个将回响千古的传奇时刻。

entries.en: Your trials here have woven a portion of the Blessing of Time into the very fibers of your being.
entries.zh: 你在这里经历的试炼，已将一部分时间祝福融进了你的身体。

entries.en: Stronger you stand, bearing the vigor of both this realm and yours.
entries.zh: 如今你已更强，同时拥有这个世界和你原本世界的活力。

entries.en: Feel the surge of power coursing through your veins, a testament to your enduring spirit and the time spent within these walls.
entries.zh: 感受体内奔涌的力量吧。那是你坚定的意志，以及在这里付出的时间留下的证明。

entries.en: You have now received the final Blessing of Time.
entries.zh: 如今，你已获得最后一份时间祝福。

entries.en: Congratulations on mastering the trials of my Time Chamber.
entries.zh: 恭喜你通过了我的时间密室试炼。

entries.en: With the final Blessing, our contract is fulfilled, thrice granted, and thrice received.
entries.zh: 获得最后一份祝福后，我们的约定已完成。三次授予，三次领受。

entries.en: Rest now, for you have earned it.
entries.zh: 休息吧，这是你应得的。

entries.en: With less than 120ф Rift Time remaining, your risk outweighs the reward.
entries.zh: 剩余 120ф 裂隙时间都不到，风险已大过回报。

entries.en: I cannot permit you to enter.
entries.zh: 我不能允许你进入。

entries.en: Oruo's Time Chamber demands more than just fleeting moments.
entries.zh: 奥鲁奥的时间密室需要的时间，可不止短短一瞬。

entries.en: Your motes purse is not as strong as your will.
entries.zh: 你的微尘囊可没有你的意志那么充足。
奥鲁奥的时间密室需要你付出代价。

entries.en: In order to access the Time Chamber, you must be closer to its entrance. Please move closer to the Continuum.
entries.zh: 要进入时间密室，你必须靠近入口。请再靠近时空连续体。

entries.en: Interesting. The Time Chamber is not currently available.
entries.zh: 有意思。时间密室现在无法使用。

entries.en: You can either cross on your own and experience anger.
entries.zh: 你可以自己走过去，体验一下愤怒。

entries.en: Or pay 150,000 Motes and experience despair.
entries.zh: 也可以付 150,000 微尘，体验一下绝望。
好好享受吧。

entries.en: Ow! That's my face you're stepping on!
entries.zh: 嗷！你踩着我的脸了！

entries.en: Show some respect and punch the "READY" hologram, please.
entries.zh: 尊重我一下，麻烦去打那个写着"准备就绪"的浮空字。

entries.en: Ah, the sweet sensation of being stepped on again. If only there was a way to avoid this!
entries.zh: 啊，又是被踩的美妙滋味。要是能躲开就好了！

entries.en: Ouch! Did you miss the READY sign or do you just enjoy causing pain?
entries.zh: 哎哟！你是没看见准备就绪的牌子，还是就喜欢折磨人？

entries.en: Ever considered punching something? Say, a hologram?
entries.zh: 有没有考虑过打点别的？比如，浮空字？
太好了，你找到地板了。
又来了……

entries.en: Marvelous, another footprint for my collection!
entries.zh: 妙啊，我的脚印收藏又多了一个！

entries.en: Back for more, I see. If only there was a big, glowing hint above me on what to do instead...
entries.zh: 看来你还没踩够。要是我头顶能有个又大又亮的提示，告诉你该干什么就好了……

entries.en: You treat all inanimate objects this way, or am I just the lucky one? Try the READY hologram for a change.
entries.zh: 你对所有没生命的东西都这样，还是偏偏看上了我？换个目标，试试那个准备就绪的浮空字吧。
百分百服务保障，跨越一切次元！

entries.en: I'm looking for my Liege, but my Eyes went rogue.
entries.zh: 我正在寻找我的主君，可我的眼睛却失控了。

entries.en: If you calm one of them down, I will be able to teleport you to it.
entries.zh: 你若能安抚其中一只，我就能把你传送到它那里。

entries.en: Before you venture into The Rift again, I must thank you.
entries.zh: 在你再次踏入裂隙之前，我必须向你道谢。

entries.en: You have calmed all of my eyes.
entries.zh: 你安抚了我所有的眼睛。

entries.en: I now comprehend my purpose here.
entries.zh: 如今，我终于明白自己在此的使命。

entries.en: I am but a creation, a link through time, a messenger, a catalyst.
entries.zh: 我只是一件造物，一道贯穿时间的纽带，一个信使，一个引子。

entries.en: Soon, our destinies will intertwine once more.
entries.zh: 不久之后，我们的命运将再度交织。

entries.en: You must repair the breach, for I am to receive and deliver a vision from it.
entries.zh: 你必须修复那道裂口，我要从中接收并传递一道幻象。
住手！

entries.en: Oh misery, is this my end?
entries.zh: 唉，命运何其残酷，难道我就要命丧于此？

entries.en: Is mine own death truly inevitable?
entries.zh: 难道我真的逃不过死亡？

entries.en: I beseech thee, I am an honest man. Please do not take my life.
entries.zh: 求求你，我是个本分的人，请别取我的性命。

entries.en: For I am to wed fair Joliet, and begin a family.
entries.zh: 我还要迎娶美丽的乔莉埃，与她建立一个家。
啊！好痛！

entries.en: Fie! That pain doth gnaw at my very soul!
entries.zh: 唉！这痛楚仿佛在啃噬我的灵魂！
天啊！真是痛彻心扉！

entries.en: By heaven! That wound doth ache!
entries.zh: 苍天在上！这伤口痛得厉害！

entries.en: Prithee, the pain is almost unbearable!
entries.zh: 求求你，这痛苦几乎让我无法承受！

entries.en: I beg of you... convey to Joliet that my love for her shall never die...
entries.zh: 求你……转告乔莉埃，我对她的爱永不消逝……
纵使死亡也无法改变。

entries.en: Upon my home's floor, grim bloodstains I found.
entries.zh: 我在自家地板上发现了骇人的血迹。

entries.en: An awful sign that death's shadow grows near.
entries.zh: 这是凶兆，预示着死神的阴影正步步逼近。

entries.en: Overtaken by dread, I thought to flee, yet how to save myself I know not.
entries.zh: 恐惧将我淹没，我想逃离，却不知该如何自救。

entries.en: I am compelled to live, for should I fall, Joliet would wander this world alone until death's embrace reunites us.
entries.zh: 我必须活下去。若我倒下，乔莉埃便只能独自行走世间，直到死亡让我们重逢。
那我必须尽快逃离。

entries.en: I resolve to barricade my abode with materials at hand.
entries.zh: 我决定用手边的材料封住自己的居所。

entries.en: Yet, without aid, I fear my preparations will fall short of time's cruel demand.
entries.zh: 可若是无人相助，只怕残酷的时间不会等我准备妥当。
谢谢你，%1$s!

entries.en: May our united efforts grant me victory against the dire fate that shadows my path.
entries.zh: 愿你我齐心协力，助我战胜如影随形的厄运。

entries.en: Let us assemble at mine own house.
entries.zh: 我们在我家会合吧。

entries.en: I have collected yon materials upon the floor.
entries.zh: 那些地上的材料，是我收集来的。

entries.en: Let us employ these planks to fortify the entrance.
entries.zh: 我们用这些木板封住入口吧。

entries.en: Make haste, for the villain may arrive forthwith.
entries.zh: 动作快些，恶徒随时可能到来。

entries.en: See how this barricade holds firm; it is a fortress in its own right.
entries.zh: 看，这屏障多么坚固，简直就是一座堡垒。

entries.en: Truly, they instill a newfound sense of safety.
entries.zh: 看着它们，我心中终于又有了几分安宁。

entries.en: My gratitude for thy aid is boundless, for thy labors were crucial, and alone I stood no chance.
entries.zh: 你的帮助，我感激不尽。若没有你付出这番辛劳，单靠我一人绝无胜算。

entries.en: Thou hast delivered me from death's cold grasp, when all seemed lost to cruel fate's design.
entries.zh: 就在我以为残酷的命运已成定局时，是你将我从死亡的冰冷掌心救了出来。

entries.en: My heart, once frail, now beats anew, by thy noble hand restored.
entries.zh: 我曾经脆弱的心，因你的义举重获生机，再次有力地跳动。

entries.en: This ring, once forged in love's sweet name, now lies as broken as the vow it bore.
entries.zh: 这枚戒指曾因甜蜜的爱意铸成，如今却和它承载的誓言一样，支离破碎。

entries.en: Yet methinks it holds a greater meaning still - one of survival, of hope reborn.
entries.zh: 可我想，它仍有更深的意义——劫后余生，希望重燃。

entries.en: I can no longer bear its weight, for it is both wound and memory. But thou, dear savior, shouldst take it.
entries.zh: 它既是伤痕，也是回忆，我已无法再承受这份重量。亲爱的恩人，请你收下。

entries.en: Not as token of despair, but as a sign that even the broken may yet be saved, as I have been by thee.
entries.zh: 它不是绝望的信物，而是一个证明: 纵使破碎，也仍有获救的希望，就像你拯救了我一样。

entries.en: The crew and I have been stuck on this islet since we crossed the Rift.
entries.zh: 自从穿过裂隙，我和船员们就一直困在这座小岛上。

entries.en: We navigated through the infinite ocean to come here.
entries.zh: 我们横渡无尽之海，才来到这里。

entries.en: Alas, our boat broke into a million pieces when we were attacked by leeches.
entries.zh: 可惜遭到水蛭袭击，船被撞得粉碎。

entries.en: Will you help me repair our boat?
entries.zh: 你愿意帮我修船吗？

entries.en: I'm still missing components to repair our boat.
entries.zh: 修船的零件还没凑齐。

entries.en: Will you help me find them?
entries.zh: 你愿意帮我找找吗？

entries.en: We need to get out of here!
entries.zh: 我们得离开这里！

entries.en: Thanks, we're now one step closer to repairing the boat!
entries.zh: 谢谢，船又离修好近了一步！
我们的船终于修好了！

entries.en: Until then, I can make a boat for you using leftovers.
entries.zh: 在那之前，我可以用剩下的材料给你造条船。

entries.en: For a price of course... he he.
entries.zh: 当然，得收点钱……嘿嘿。

entries.en: Thanks for delivering all the boat components.
entries.zh: 谢谢你送来所有的船用零件。

entries.en: In the meantime, I can make a boat for you using leftovers.
entries.zh: 这段时间里，我可以用剩下的材料给你造条船。
太高了，根本够不着。
是吗？跳一个看看。

entries.en: How did you manage to jump that high?
entries.zh: 你怎么能跳那么高？
人类！不会吧！

entries.en: It's not every century we meet players down here.
entries.zh: 我们在这下面见到玩家，可是百年难遇啊。

entries.en: I find that when meeting people, it's important to have a good ice breaker prepared.
entries.zh: 我觉得跟人见面时，得先准备好一句破冰的开场白。
哆哆哆哆哆嗦！

entries.en: It's so cold down here, even the Snakes go slower.
entries.zh: 这下面太冷了，连蛇都爬慢了。

entries.en: It's always good to have a friend.
entries.zh: 有个朋友总是好的。
我们的友谊可坚如磐石！

entries.en: My life goal is to kill two birds.
entries.zh: 我的人生目标，就是干掉两只鸟。
别再点我了！

entries.en: Need a Travel Scroll to The Rift?
entries.zh: 需要一张前往裂隙的旅行卷轴吗？

entries.en: You can't activate it here...too much magic in the air I guess?
entries.zh: 这里用不了它……大概是空气里的魔法太多了吧？

entries.en: But it's Rift Transferable! That hand-stand Dark Auction man in the Wyld Woods can help you get it back to the real world.
entries.zh: 不过它可以跨裂隙转移！那个倒立着的暗黑拍卖会家伙就在异野森林，他能帮你把它带回现实世界。

entries.en: Puck puck, puck Chicken N Egg Timecharm?
entries.zh: 咯咯，咯，鸡与蛋时间护符吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [Yep, I got it.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [嗯，拿到了。]

entries.en: The crew has been stranded here for so long.
entries.zh: 我们这伙人被困在这里已经好久了。

entries.en: But honestly, the more I get to know these guys...
entries.zh: 不过说真的，跟这帮家伙相处得越久……

entries.en: I found this when we arrived, maybe you can use it?
entries.zh: 刚到这里时，我找到了这个，也许你用得上？

entries.en: The Argofays have been so kind to welcome me in one of their huts.
entries.zh: 阿戈菲们真好，让我住进了他们的一间小屋。

entries.en: It's been rough since I lost my cat.
entries.zh: 自从我的猫不见了，日子就一直不好过。
它就在我眼皮底下跑没影了！

entries.en: I think it's playing around the Rift!
entries.zh: 我猜它正在裂隙里到处玩呢！
求求你！!
求求你！!!
帮我找到我的猫，蒙特祖玛！

entries.en: Open my chest and take my Cat Detector!
entries.zh: 打开我的箱子，拿上我的猫咪探测器！
不是那个箱子！

entries.en: That's where I store all the pictures of little Monte!
entries.zh: 那里面放的都是小 Monte 的照片！

entries.en: Uh... it's not that one either.
entries.zh: 呃……也不是那个。

entries.en: I was talking about the one behind me, silly!
entries.zh: 我说的是我身后那个啦，傻瓜！

entries.en: Now please go and find my dear Montezuma!
entries.zh: 拜托，快去找到我亲爱的蒙特祖玛吧！
嘿，你回来啦！
你找到蒙特祖玛了吗？
我知道呀！

entries.en: I'm so glad you found him!
entries.zh: 你找到它了，我真高兴！

entries.en: It's soul fractured into 9 parts when we crossed into the Rift.
entries.zh: 它的灵魂在我们穿过裂隙时碎成了 9 份。

entries.en: I've been living in this cabin with 1/9th of Montezuma for an eternity now.
entries.zh: 我在这间小屋里守着 1/9 个蒙特祖玛，已经像是过了一辈子了。

entries.en: Find all parts of Montezuma's soul so I can enjoy a full cat again!
entries.zh: 请找到蒙特祖玛的全部灵魂碎片，让我再拥有一只完整的猫吧！

entries.en: Have you found all of Montezuma's soul yet?
entries.zh: 你找到蒙特祖玛的全部灵魂了吗？

entries.en: You found all the pieces of Montezuma's soul?
entries.zh: 你把蒙特祖玛的灵魂碎片全都找到了？
太棒了！
现在，我就跟你说实话吧。
我还是很难过。

entries.en: But it's because I'm stuck in an alternate reality...
entries.zh: 不过，那是因为我被困在了另一个现实里……
无处可去……
无事可做……

entries.en: I can't sleep and yet I can't get out of bed.
entries.zh: 我睡不着，却又起不了床。
那你呢，过得怎么样？

entries.en: No matter what, I always stay classy.
entries.zh: 不管怎样，我总要保持格调。

entries.en: The thing about classy is, it's a state of mind.
entries.zh: 所谓格调，其实是一种心境。

entries.en: That's why I'm offering you dark but slightly purple shoes.
entries.zh: 所以，我向你推荐这双黑色、又微微泛紫的鞋。
而且还是运动鞋！

entries.en: Because with the Enderman roaming around, that's what the state of mind uh... requires.
entries.zh: 毕竟周围到处都是末影人，这种心境，呃……需要跑得快。

entries.en: The farmer is sick for a totally unknown reason.
entries.zh: 农夫生病了，原因完全不明。

entries.en: None of the animals here have eaten since they started existing.
entries.zh: 这里的动物从存在的那一刻起，就没吃过东西。

entries.en: I would become a farmer mooself, but I don't have opposable thumbs.
entries.zh: 我倒想亲自当个农夫，可惜我没有能对握的拇指。

entries.en: You'll have to do the work. Take this Wand of Farming!
entries.zh: 只能请你来干活了。拿上这根农业法杖！

entries.en: We will need a lot of stockpiles to survive through an eternity.
entries.zh: 要熬过永恒，我们得囤上好多好多粮食。
请帮我带来:

entries.en: Caducous are upside-down plants which grow near humid environmengs.
entries.zh: 易落茎是一种倒着长的植物，喜欢生长在潮湿的环境附近。

entries.en: Simply collect them from top to bottom!
entries.zh: 只要从上往下采就行啦！

entries.en: There was once a powerful necromancer who lived in the Catacombs.
entries.zh: 从前有个强大的死灵法师，住在地下墓穴里。

entries.en: After a falling out with its administration, she retired to the Rift.
entries.zh: 后来她和那里的管理层闹翻了，就退隐到了裂隙。

entries.en: She started growing Wilted Berberis in the farm plots and operated the Dreadfarm Bed & Breakfast.
entries.zh: 她开始在农田里种枯萎小檗，还开起了惊惧农场民宿。

entries.en: Sadly, she passed when her brain melted in an unrelated incident.
entries.zh: 可惜后来，她的脑子在一起毫不相干的事故里融化了，人也就没了。

entries.en: Anyway, you can harvest the farm patches around the remnants of her decrepit lifework.
entries.zh: 总之，你可以在她那破败的毕生心血周围的田地里采收。

entries.en: If you look at the mushrooms around the Dreadfarm...
entries.zh: 你要是看着惊惧农场周围的蘑菇……

entries.en: Bada bing, bada boom, you click it when it's red!
entries.zh: 噼里啪啦，等它变红时，点它就行啦！

entries.en: I can personally attest, all of this food is very good.
entries.zh: 我可以亲自作证，这些食物都很好吃。
干得真是顶呱呱，%1$s。

entries.en: I want you to have this Proto-Chicken.
entries.zh: 这只原型鸡就送给你啦。

entries.en: Time is a bit muddy here. I found it when I first spawned in this farm.
entries.zh: 这里的时间有点乱。我刚在这座农场出现的时候，就发现了它。

entries.en: Did you lose the first chicken ever?
entries.zh: 你把有史以来第一只鸡弄丢了？
常有的事。再给你一只。

entries.en: I'd love to moove around, but I'm stuck here helping the farmer.
entries.zh: 我也想四处走走，可还得留在这里帮农夫。

entries.en: As a cow, all I want to do is eat, sleep and moo.
entries.zh: 作为一头牛，我只想吃饭、睡觉、哞哞叫。

entries.en: Sometimes I sleep and dream about touching grass, what about you?
entries.zh: 有时我睡着了，会梦见踩在草地上的感觉。你呢？
* 咩咩咩咩咩 *
* 咩咩咩咩咩咩咩咩咩咩咩咩咩咩咩咩 *
你好。

entries.en: Which dimension do you originate from?
entries.zh: 你来自哪个维度？

entries.en: Have you met the Shen from your own dimension yet?
entries.zh: 你见过自己那个维度的申了吗？
算了，当我没问。

entries.en: When you do encounter him, please direct him to us.
entries.zh: 以后遇到他，麻烦让他来找我们。

entries.en: We could benefit from his intellect.
entries.zh: 他的才智能帮上我们的忙。

entries.en: The next Shen will provide you with the Celestial Timecharm.
entries.zh: 下一位申会给你天界时间护符。

entries.en: You're undertaking a significant responsibility, you know.
entries.zh: 你肩上的责任可不小，知道吗？

entries.en: Let's hope you will succeed where others have not.
entries.zh: 希望你能做到别人没能做到的事。
啊，你好。
你就是 %1$s，对吧？

entries.en: I've encountered versions of you before.
entries.zh: 我以前遇到过其他版本的你。

entries.en: You're seeking the Celestial Timecharm, aren't you?
entries.zh: 你在找天界时间护符，对吧？
请选择: [嗯。]

entries.en: Shen's Citrinitas currently holds it, you'll find him beyond the third sequence.
entries.zh: 申之黄化现在拿着它，走过第三个序列就能找到他。

entries.en: If you're searching for the Celestial Timecharm, you'll need to summon Shen's Citrinitas.
entries.zh: 如果你在找天界时间护符，就得召唤申之黄化。

entries.en: Proceed to the next sequence to continue your journey.
entries.zh: 进入下一个序列，继续你的旅途吧。

entries.en: Could you please refrain from summoning the other Shens?
entries.zh: 能不能别再召唤其他申了？

entries.en: We were engaged in an important cognitive construction.
entries.zh: 我们正在进行重要的认知构建。

entries.en: Select an option: [I just want the Timecharm and I'm out.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [我拿到时间护符就走。]
明白，给你。
时间宝贵。

entries.en: At this altitude, temporal distortions are most severe.
entries.zh: 在这个高度，时间扭曲最为严重。
你很出色，%1$s。

entries.en: We recruit individuals like you into our organization.
entries.zh: 我们会招募像你这样的人加入组织。

entries.en: Perhaps you'll surpass Julian, Maeve, or even Seth in your dimension.
entries.zh: 或许你会超越自己那个维度的朱利安、梅芙，甚至赛斯。

entries.en: Here, accept this token for your journey to the summit.
entries.zh: 来，收下这份信物，带着它去山顶吧。
快去吧。

entries.en: I've spent my life outsmarting everyone.
entries.zh: 我这辈子一直在智谋上胜过所有人。

entries.en: But among the other Shens, I've finally found my place.
entries.zh: 但和其他申在一起时，我终于找到了归属。

entries.en: We support each other and share a common goal.
entries.zh: 我们互相扶持，有着同一个目标。

entries.en: Select an option: [I lost my Golden Belt.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [我的黄金腰带丢了。]

entries.en: This action has left me unimpressed.
entries.zh: 你这件事办得可不怎么样。

entries.en: It seems you've mastered the sequencing quite well...
entries.zh: 看来你已经很熟悉序列的运作了……

entries.en: Though it's unfortunate you may fail like the others.
entries.zh: 可惜，你也许还是会失败，和其他人一样。

entries.en: Well, I suppose it doesn't hurt to tell you.
entries.zh: 嗯，告诉你应该也没什么坏处。

entries.en: You're either destined to perish or become invaluable to us.
entries.zh: 你要么注定丧命，要么会成为我们不可或缺的人。

entries.en: We're assembling as many Shens as possible to create the ultimate Shen.
entries.zh: 我们正在召集尽可能多的申，创造出终极申。

entries.en: By uniting the greatest minds across dimensions, we aim to achieve unparalleled greatness.
entries.zh: 集结各个维度最伟大的头脑，我们要成就无人能及的伟业。

entries.en: The details of our grand project, however, will remain undisclosed.
entries.zh: 不过，我们宏大计划的细节暂时不会公开。

entries.en: Have you confronted any of the Elites in your dimension yet?
entries.zh: 你和自己那个维度的精英交过手了吗？
请选择: [什么精英？]

entries.en: I see. In that case, our discussion concludes here.
entries.zh: 明白了。那就谈到这里吧。

entries.en: The underworld took control of my tavern in the real world.
entries.zh: 冥界占领了我在现实世界里的酒馆。

entries.en: It's great! Business has been booming here!
entries.zh: 这可太好了！我在这里的生意红火得很！

entries.en: Plus, I get to be comfortable in my own skin.
entries.zh: 而且，我终于能自在地做自己了。

entries.en: Oops! That elixir is sold out!
entries.zh: 哎呀！那种药剂卖光了！

entries.en: I do happen to know a guy who knows a guy who knows the supplier.
entries.zh: 不过，我认识一个人，他认识另一个人，那人认识供货商。

entries.en: For 20 Motes, I can give you their name.
entries.zh: 给我 20 微尘，我就告诉你那人的名字。
* 农夫病恹恹的呻吟声 *

entries.en: I used to, because it seems like everything you CAN do is pre-determined, like a computer program.
entries.zh: 以前觉得有，毕竟我们能做的一切好像都早就定好了，跟电脑程序一样。

entries.en: Like an all-powerful entity created this world and everything that can exist in it.
entries.zh: 就像有个无所不能的存在，创造了这个世界和其中所有可能存在的东西。

entries.en: Well, think of it like a video game.
entries.zh: 嗯，把它想成一款电子游戏吧。

entries.en: The main storyline may be fixed.
entries.zh: 主线剧情也许是固定的。

entries.en: But that doesn't stop the player from creating their own stories and experiences within the game.
entries.zh: 但这并不妨碍玩家在游戏里创造属于自己的故事和经历。
特别是和别人一起玩的时候！

entries.en: I earn a lot of Motes. I'm very rich.
entries.zh: 我赚了很多微尘。我很有钱。

entries.en: I heard that Barry wanted to tax people who earn that much by 50%.
entries.zh: 听说巴里要向我这样收入的人征收 50%的税。

entries.en: I need him to explain himself.
entries.zh: 我要他给个说法。
百分之五十的税啊！!
我每个轮回赚 110,000 微尘。
接下来会怎样？
那就去问清楚啊！!

entries.en: I see. And how many brackets are there?
entries.zh: 原来如此。那一共有几个税档？

entries.en: Interesting, and can you tell me what are the Tax Brackets?
entries.zh: 有意思，能说说具体的税档怎么划分吗？

entries.en: Interesting. And what are the tax rates in each bracket?
entries.zh: 有意思。每个税档的税率又是多少？

entries.en: So how much will I be taxed? Considering I earn 110,000?
entries.zh: 那我到底要交多少税？我的收入是 110,000。

entries.en: It's not that bad after all!
entries.zh: 看来也没那么糟嘛！

entries.en: I can totally afford if it's for the community.
entries.zh: 要是为了大家好，这点钱我完全出得起。
唔，不太对吧……

entries.en: What are they spending the tax money on?
entries.zh: 收来的税都花到哪儿去了？
真是个谜。
冒险者！请帮帮我！
一头强大的巨龙来袭了！

entries.en: I'm casting a freeze spell to counter the fireball but I cannot hold this forever!
entries.zh: 我正在施放冰冻法术来抵挡这颗火球，可我撑不了多久了！
来，拿上这把 diamathame!

entries.en: It will let you imbue Glyphs with Warding Spells.
entries.zh: 你可以用它给符文注入守护法术。

entries.en: I need you to collect each Glyph and bring them to me!
entries.zh: 我需要你收集每一种符文，把它们带回来！

entries.en: The first Glyph can be found by the pond below!
entries.zh: 第一个符文就在下面的池塘边！

entries.en: I think you might have lost this!
entries.zh: 我想，你可能把这个弄丢了！

entries.en: Find me the next Glyph, it can be found by the pond below!
entries.zh: 帮我找到下一个符文，它就在下面的池塘边！
你找到了强健符印！

entries.en: Use your Warding Diamathame to imbue the Glyph on the south side of the house.
entries.zh: 用你的守护钻石仪刀给房屋南侧的符文注入法术。

entries.en: Great work, the Warding Spell was a success!
entries.zh: 干得好，守护法术成功了！

entries.en: Find me the next Glyph, it can be found in the windmill!
entries.zh: 帮我找到下一个符文，它就在风车里！
你找到了勇猛符印！

entries.en: Find me the next Glyph, it can be found by the water tower!
entries.zh: 帮我找到下一个符文，它就在水塔旁！
你找到了极盛符印！

entries.en: Use your Warding Diamathame to imbue the Glyph on the east side of the house.
entries.zh: 用你的守护钻石仪刀给房屋东侧的符文注入法术。

entries.en: Find me the next Glyph, it can be found in the barn!
entries.zh: 帮我找到下一个符文，它就在谷仓里！
你找到了呐喊符印！

entries.en: Use your Warding Diamathame to imbue the Glyph on the north side of the house.
entries.zh: 用你的守护钻石仪刀给房屋北侧的符文注入法术。

entries.en: Find me the next Glyph, it can be found next to a glutton!
entries.zh: 帮我找到下一个符文，它就在一个贪吃鬼旁边！
你找到了伟力符印！

entries.en: Find me the next Glyph, it can be found on top of the infested house's chimney!
entries.zh: 帮我找到下一个符文，它就在那座虫害屋的烟囱顶上！
你找到了刚力符印！

entries.en: Use your Warding Diamathame to imbue the Glyph on the west side of the house.
entries.zh: 用你的守护钻石仪刀给房屋西侧的符文注入法术。

entries.en: Find me the next Glyph, it can be found in a lot of cake!
entries.zh: 帮我找到下一个符文，它就在一大堆蛋糕里！
你找到了坚固符印！

entries.en: The last Glyph can be found in a server room, whatever that means...
entries.zh: 最后一个符文在一个什么服务器机房里，虽然我也不知道那是什么……

entries.en: Find me the next Glyph, it can be found in a server room, whatever that means!
entries.zh: 帮我找到下一个符文，它在一个什么服务器机房里，天知道那是什么！
你找到了潜能符印！

entries.en: Great work, the house is fully warded!
entries.zh: 干得好，整座房子都保护好了！

entries.en: I'm going to teleport us to safety and release the fireball!
entries.zh: 我要把我们传送到安全的地方，然后放开那颗火球！
呼！多亏你力挽狂澜！

entries.en: Take the Warding Trinket as a token of my gratitude, you deserve it.
entries.zh: 拿上这个守护小饰物吧，一点谢意，你值得拥有。

entries.en: Thank you for helping with the Dragon attack.
entries.zh: 谢谢你帮忙抵御巨龙的袭击。
喂，先站住。

entries.en: You think you can just waltz through here without showing some credentials?
entries.zh: 什么凭证都不出示，就想大摇大摆地过去？

entries.en: Flash me your Vampiric Timecharm, or you can sod off.
entries.zh: 把你的吸血鬼时间护符亮出来，不然就滚远点。

entries.en: Fancy that, you're one of the chosen few, eh?
entries.zh: 哟，你也是被选中的那几个人之一，是吧？

entries.en: Well, don't let it go to your head.
entries.zh: 不过，可别因此飘了。

entries.en: Why is Berry the Prime Minister?
entries.zh: 为什么浆果能当首相？

entries.en: I have known Berry since he was kid, and he's never done anything right in his life.
entries.zh: 我从浆果小时候就认识他，他这辈子就没干成过一件事。

entries.en: In any of his lives actually, never!
entries.zh: 不对，是他哪辈子都没有！
不要浆果！
谁都行，就是不能是浆果！
我才不信呢。

entries.en: I'm fairly certain he did zero.
entries.zh: 我很确定，他一件事都没干成过。
零。
一个大鸭蛋。

entries.en: Not cool. That's very low, even for Berry.
entries.zh: 这可不好。就算是浆果，这话也太下作了。
巴里，那个有名的巫师！
对呀！我可喜欢他了！

entries.en: I'll help Berry until I die.
entries.zh: 我会一直帮浆果，直到死。
我是说巴里。

entries.en: With the world being so strange out there...
entries.zh: 外面的世界变得这么奇怪……

entries.en: It's been a blessing to our trade!
entries.zh: 对我们这行来说，简直是天大的好事！

entries.en: The world is beaming with originality!
entries.zh: 整个世界都在迸发创意！

entries.en: If you set aside her unconsolable grief, she really looks FAN-TAS-TIC!
entries.zh: 要是不看她那止不住的悲伤，她真是美——极——了！
我真心希望拉梅罗能活下来。

entries.en: I doubt Joliet will buy the dress otherwise.
entries.zh: 不然，我怕乔莉埃就不买那条裙子了。

entries.en: I would love to talk with you.
entries.zh: 我很想和你聊聊。

entries.en: But I don't think you have the time.
entries.zh: 但看起来，你的时间不太够。

entries.en: Let's talk next time we meet.
entries.zh: 下次见面再聊吧。
我是特尔·卡尔。

entries.en: You must be wondering what exactly this place is.
entries.zh: 你一定很想知道，这到底是什么地方吧。

entries.en: Select an option: [Do you know anything about it?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [你知道些什么吗？]
这是另一个维度。

entries.en: You arrived here through the portal, right?
entries.zh: 你是通过传送门来到这里的，对吧？

entries.en: Select an option: [Yes, how do you know?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [是啊，你怎么知道的？]

entries.en: That's because unlike me, you are not trapped in here.
entries.zh: 因为你和我不一样，没有被困在这里。

entries.en: You are what I call a "tourist".
entries.zh: 我管你这样的人叫“游客”。

entries.en: Select an option: [Why are you trapped?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [你为什么被困住了？]

entries.en: Because I made the mistake of entering through a breach!
entries.zh: 因为我犯了个错误，从一道裂口钻了进来！

entries.en: You see, there is a breach near the portal you entered, in your world.
entries.zh: 在你的世界里，你走过的那扇传送门附近，有一道裂口。

entries.en: As a dwarf, I spend considerable time exploring caves and mountains.
entries.zh: 身为矮人，我经常探索洞穴和山脉。

entries.en: And I stepped into it by accident!
entries.zh: 然后就一不小心走进了那道裂口！

entries.en: Any breach has an extremely large impact on causality. This is why everything is so strange.
entries.zh: 任何一道裂口都会严重影响因果关系。所以这里的一切才会这么奇怪。

entries.en: Until that breach is tamed, anything that steps through it becomes a paradox and remains TRAPPED.
entries.zh: 那道裂口在被驯服之前，所有穿过它的东西都会成为悖论，一直被困在这里。

entries.en: Select an option: [How do we tame it?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [要怎么驯服它？]

entries.en: I'm not certain, but I have a theory.
entries.zh: 我也不确定，不过我有个想法。

entries.en: I think you'll find the answer to that question at the top of the mountain, right here in the Rift.
entries.zh: 我想，这个问题的答案就在山顶，就在裂隙里。

entries.en: However, it won't be easy getting all the way up there.
entries.zh: 不过，要一路上去可不容易。
请选择: [为什么？]
该怎么解释呢……

entries.en: You know about the three primary dimensions, right?
entries.zh: 你知道最基本的三个维度吧？
上下。
左右。
前后。
对吧？

entries.en: They're also known as x, y and z.
