entries.zh: 也就是 x、y 和 z。

entries.en: Well, what if I told you this place has FIVE dimensions?
entries.zh: 那，如果我告诉你，这个地方有五个维度呢？

entries.en: Select an option: [Ok. What is the 4th one?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [好吧。第四个是什么？]

entries.en: It's usually recognized that TIME is the 4th dimension.
entries.zh: 一般认为，时间就是第四个维度。

entries.en: But time does not flow in the Rift.
entries.zh: 不过，时间在裂隙里并不会流逝。

entries.en: You can use time around here just as well as you can move in 3D in your world, as if you can interact with the space-time continuum itself.
entries.zh: 在这里，你可以操纵时间，就像你在自己的世界里穿行于三维空间，仿佛能直接与时空连续体互动。

entries.en: It's a relatively superhot concept in physics.
entries.zh: 这是物理学里一个相对来说超级火热的概念。

entries.en: Select an option: [I'm following. What is the 5th dimension?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [听懂了。那第五个维度呢？]

entries.en: It is the only constant of SkyBlock...
entries.zh: 那是空岛里唯一不变的东西……
随机性！

entries.en: Which is more accurately defined as possibilities.
entries.zh: 更准确地说，就是可能性。

entries.en: Most people and things have a reflection in other universes.
entries.zh: 大多数人和事物，在其他宇宙里都有自己的倒影。

entries.en: Infinite reflections, one for each possibility.
entries.zh: 倒影无穷无尽，每一种可能性都对应着一个。

entries.en: In your world, randomness is pre-defined.
entries.zh: 在你的世界，随机性是预先设定好的。

entries.en: Only affected by powers like Magic Find.
entries.zh: 只有魔法寻宝这样的力量能影响它。
但在这里呢？
一切皆有可能。

entries.en: Select an option: [Sure, but what about the mountain?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [好吧，可这和山有什么关系？]

entries.en: I was just about to explain!
entries.zh: 我正要说呢！

entries.en: The closer you get to the top of the mountain, the stronger the distortion gets.
entries.zh: 你离山顶越近，扭曲就越强烈。

entries.en: Basically, the mountain might seem close to you in three dimensions...
entries.zh: 简单来说，在三维空间里，那座山看着也许离你很近……

entries.en: But in reality, it is very very far away in five dimensions!
entries.zh: 但实际上，它在五维空间里离你非常、非常遥远！

entries.en: Select an option: [How do I reach it then?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [那我该怎么过去？]
没人能说得准。

entries.en: But as you may have noticed, as you experience the Rift, you gain control over more and more time.
entries.zh: 不过，你也许已经发现了: 随着你在裂隙里的经历越来越多，你能掌控的时间也会越来越多。

entries.en: So if you interact with everything in here, it might lead you to the mountain!
entries.zh: 所以，试着和这里的一切都打打交道，也许就能找到通往那座山的路！

entries.en: Do you have any more questions?
entries.zh: 还有别的问题吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [Yes. Do you have a soul for me?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [有。你有灵魂可以给我吗？]
那可真巧！

entries.en: See how this universe is filled with randomness?
entries.zh: 看见了吧，这个宇宙就是这么充满随机性！
拿去吧！
和你聊天真开心！

entries.en: I would love talking more with you, but I'm not sure I have the time.
entries.zh: 我还想和你多聊一会儿，不过不确定自己有没有时间。

entries.en: It's a joke... I have infinite time!
entries.zh: 开玩笑的……我的时间无穷无尽！

entries.en: In fact I'm the exact opposite of you....
entries.zh: 其实，我和你恰恰相反……

entries.en: Time is the only thing I have!
entries.zh: 我有的，就只有时间！
好了，回头见。
这里是另一个维度。

entries.en: We meet across the strands of space and time. I was waiting for you.
entries.zh: 我们跨越时空的丝线相遇。我一直在等你。

entries.en: You might not know me, Ubik Von Neumann, a moniker that resonates through the echelons of intellect.
entries.zh: 你也许不认识我，尤比克·冯·诺伊曼——这个名字在智者的殿堂中回响。

entries.en: I am the smartest man that ever lived.
entries.zh: 我是有史以来最聪明的人。

entries.en: My IQ is above 200, my mind is a crucible of infinite possibilities.
entries.zh: 我的智商超过 200，我的头脑是一座熔炉，孕育着无限可能。

entries.en: If you made it this far, it means yours is at least 100, a notable intellect, perhaps not quantum, but commendable nonetheless.
entries.zh: 能走到这里，说明你的智商至少有 100。相当不错，也许还没到量子级别，但仍值得称赞。
除非……有人给你指了路。

entries.en: But intellect is not merely inherited; it is challenged, honed, and expanded.
entries.zh: 不过，才智并非只靠天生，也要经过挑战、磨炼和拓展。

entries.en: I need to figure out just how smart you are.
entries.zh: 我得弄清楚，你究竟有多聪明。
请选择: [放马过来。]

entries.en: Have you yet noticed these 3 boxes next to me?
entries.zh: 你注意到我旁边这 3 个箱子了吗？
请选择: [当然看到了。]

entries.en: Only one contains something invaluable; an IQ Point, a testament to wisdom.
entries.zh: 其中只有一个装着无价之宝: 一枚智商点，智慧的证明。
另外两个都是空的。

entries.en: You desire this IQ Point. It symbolizes an enhancement of your cognitive arsenal.
entries.zh: 你想要这枚智商点。它象征着你的思维武库又添了一件利器。

entries.en: But you can only open one of these boxes.
entries.zh: 但你只能打开其中一个箱子。

entries.en: Please select the one you wish to open.
entries.zh: 请选择你想打开的那一个。

entries.en: Welcome back, %1$s. The game awaits your strategic touch.
entries.zh: 欢迎回来，%1$s。这场游戏正等着你施展谋略。
请选择你的箱子。

entries.en: One of the boxes holds an IQ Point.
entries.zh: 一个箱子里装着一枚智商点。

entries.en: But the other two are empty.
entries.zh: 但另外两个都是空的。

entries.en: You may only open one of the boxes.
entries.zh: 你只能打开其中一个箱子。
你选了第%1$s个箱子。

entries.en: Hopefully you didn't think too much about this choice, as it is quite irrelevant.
entries.zh: 希望你没在这次选择上费太多脑筋，因为它其实无关紧要。

entries.en: I myself know where the IQ Point is. Watch as I open a box that I know is empty.
entries.zh: 我知道智商点在哪儿。看好了，我要打开一个我知道是空的箱子。

entries.en: As the empty box stands revealed, consider your next move carefully.
entries.zh: 空箱子已经揭晓，好好想想你下一步要怎么做。

entries.en: Will you keep the box you opened, or will you switch to the other?
entries.zh: 你要保留自己打开的箱子，还是换另一个？

entries.en: Please choose the box you want to open.
entries.zh: 请选择你想打开的箱子。

entries.en: You chose the %1$s box. Let's open another box.
entries.zh: 你选了第%1$s个箱子。我们来打开另一个箱子。
这个箱子已经打开了。

entries.en: You may not have 100 IQ after all...
entries.zh: 看来你的智商也许还不到 100……

entries.en: You have chosen to keep the box you originally selected.
entries.zh: 你选择保留最初选中的箱子。
来开箱吧。

entries.en: You did not find the IQ Point.
entries.zh: 你没找到智商点。

entries.en: After due time, come back to play again.
entries.zh: 过段时间，再回来玩吧。
恭喜，你拿到了奖励。

entries.en: But did you make the right decision?
entries.zh: 不过，你真的选对了吗？
时间会给出答案。

entries.en: But you already beat my game previously.
entries.zh: 可你之前已经赢过我的游戏了。

entries.en: Why did you decide to keep this time?
entries.zh: 为什么这次决定不换呢？

entries.en: [I just wanted to see what you would say]
entries.zh: [我只是想看看你会说什么]

entries.en: [I felt like I would win by keeping]
entries.zh: [我觉得不换就能赢]

entries.en: [I don't really believe in your theory]
entries.zh: [我不太相信你的理论]

entries.en: [I think your game is rigged anyway]
entries.zh: [反正我觉得你这游戏动了手脚]
[我不想说]
有好奇心，是件好事。

entries.en: But remember, every choice has consequences.
entries.zh: 不过要记住，每个选择都有后果。

entries.en: When ready, the game will await your return.
entries.zh: 等你准备好了，这场游戏随时欢迎你回来。
那你就是在骗我。

entries.en: Understanding is a journey, not a destination.
entries.zh: 理解是一段旅程，而不是终点。

entries.en: Rest assured, this game's integrity is as solid as quantum mechanics.
entries.zh: 放心，这场游戏的公正性和量子力学一样牢靠。

entries.en: The correct box is decided before you even talk to me.
entries.zh: 在你开口和我说话之前，正确的箱子就已经定下来了。

entries.en: Sometimes silence speaks louder than words.
entries.zh: 有时，沉默胜过千言万语。
你的理由，只属于你自己。

entries.en: You have chosen to swap to the other box.
entries.zh: 你选择换到另一个箱子。

entries.en: Alas, the reward was not within your grasp this time.
entries.zh: 唉，这次奖励与你擦肩而过。

entries.en: Yet fret not, for every challenge is but a prelude to your next triumph.
entries.zh: 不过别烦恼，每一次挑战，都不过是下一场胜利的序曲。

entries.en: You can always come back and play my game again later.
entries.zh: 以后随时可以回来，再玩一次我的游戏。

entries.en: Congratulations, you got the IQ Point.
entries.zh: 恭喜，你拿到了智商点。

entries.en: Much like time, the game will always be here, testing the limits of your ingenuity.
entries.zh: 就像时间一样，这场游戏会一直在这里，考验你才智的极限。

entries.en: Inquire me this, what prompted your decision to switch boxes?
entries.zh: 告诉我，是什么让你决定换箱子？

entries.en: Select an option: [Because it increases the odds!] [Because I felt like it! >:( ]
entries.zh: 请选择: [因为这样赢的概率更高！] [因为我乐意！ >:( ]

entries.en: Then you have grasped the essence of this game, and truly deserve this IQ Point.
entries.zh: 那么，你已经领悟了这场游戏的精髓，也真正配得上这枚智商点。

entries.en: For your decision, I will grant you an Enigma Soul.
entries.zh: 为了奖励你的决定，我会送你一个谜魂。

entries.en: You can always come back and play my game later.
entries.zh: 以后随时可以回来玩我的游戏。

entries.en: You've already completed my game. Please come again, in another time.
entries.zh: 你已经玩完了我的游戏。请在另一个时间再来。

entries.en: Ah, let's engage in a new challenge, shall we?
entries.zh: 啊，来试试新的挑战吧？

entries.en: Select an option: [How did you get up here? You were just further down the mountain.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [你怎么上来的？你刚才还在山下。]

entries.en: Indeed, I remain below as well as here, and above too.
entries.zh: 没错，我仍在下面，也在这里，还在更上面。
我无处不在。

entries.en: Select an option: [I have truly seen everything now.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [这下我真是什么都见识过了。]

entries.en: Let me present you my new game.
entries.zh: 让我为你介绍我的新游戏。

entries.en: Simply select a number from 1 to 100.
entries.zh: 只要从 1 到 100 中选一个数。

entries.en: Each revolution of time, I compile the answers from all participants.
entries.zh: 时间每完成一次轮转，我就会汇总所有参与者的答案。

entries.en: The 10% of participants who will have a number closest to half of the average will obtain the reward.
entries.zh: 所选数字最接近平均值的一半的前 10% 参与者，将获得奖励。
你会选哪个数呢？

entries.en: The results from the previous revolution are still being calculated!
entries.zh: 上一次轮转的结果还在计算中！
过一分钟再来看看吧。

entries.en: The previous revolution had %1$s participants with an average choice of %2$s.
entries.zh: 上一次轮转共有 %1$s 名参与者，所选数字的平均值是 %2$s。
你选的是 %1$s。

entries.en: Regrettably you were not among the 10% closest to half the average, and you will receive nothing.
entries.zh: 遗憾的是，你没有排进最接近平均值一半的前 10%，所以没有奖励。

entries.en: May your next choice reflect deeper insights.
entries.zh: 希望你下次能做出更有见地的选择。

entries.en: Exemplary! Your choice was among the closest 10% to half of the averages!
entries.zh: 出色！你选的数字排进了最接近平均值一半的前 10%!
真正展现了你的智慧。
你获得了一份自由意志。

entries.en: You managed to predict a very low average and choose a number over 4 times the average.
entries.zh: 你成功预料到了极低的平均值，并选了一个超过平均值 4 倍的数字。

entries.en: Astounding foresight! You predicted a significantly low average and chose boldly.
entries.zh: 惊人的远见！你预见到了极低的平均值，并大胆做出了选择。

entries.en: Your reward is TWO Free Wills.
entries.zh: 你的奖励是两份自由意志。

entries.en: You've also earned an Enigma Soul for this strategic triumph.
entries.zh: 这次策略上的胜利，还为你赢得了一个谜魂。

entries.en: Let's see if you can succeed again this revolution.
entries.zh: 看看这一次轮转，你还能不能再赢一次。

entries.en: Ah, delightful to see you again in the corridors of The Rift.
entries.zh: 啊，真高兴又能在裂隙的回廊里见到你。

entries.en: I've crafted a two-player game of strategy and consequence.
entries.zh: 我设计了一场考验策略与后果的双人游戏。

entries.en: The rules are simple yet profound. Each round, you and your opponent decide whether to split or steal.
entries.zh: 规则简单，却意味深长。每一回合，你和对手都要决定是平分还是独吞。

entries.en: If both players split, each player earns 3,000 Motes.
entries.zh: 如果两人都选择平分，每人获得 3,000 微尘。

entries.en: If both steal, each player earns only 1,000 Motes.
entries.zh: 如果两人都选择独吞，每人只能获得 1,000 微尘。

entries.en: However, if one steals while the other splits, the stealer takes 5,000 Motes, leaving the other with nothing.
entries.zh: 不过，如果一人选择独吞，另一人选择平分，独吞者会拿到 5,000 微尘，另一人则一无所获。
请选择: [我明白了。]

entries.en: The game unfolds over 5 to 9 rounds, randomly determined.
entries.zh: 一局游戏有 5 到 9 个回合，随机决定。

entries.en: Your first challenge is to play against these three weirdos next to me.
entries.zh: 你的第一个挑战，是和我旁边这三个怪人对局。
他们各自都有一套独特的策略。

entries.en: Now that you played against them, I want to see how much you have learned.
entries.zh: 既然已经和他们交过手了，我想看看你究竟学到了多少。
我们来比一场吧！

entries.en: Let me know when you are ready.
entries.zh: 准备好了就告诉我。
这场较量倒是很有干劲。

entries.en: However, your strategy does not garner my respect.
entries.zh: 不过，你的策略还赢不了我的尊重。

entries.en: Perhaps we shall revisit this game later.
entries.zh: 也许我们可以改天再玩。

entries.en: Your strategy does not garner my respect.
entries.zh: 你的策略赢不了我的尊重。

entries.en: Do you want to play another match?
entries.zh: 想再比一场吗？
这场对局不错。
你的策略很有意思。

entries.en: Let's play again, this time I will try something a tad different.
entries.zh: 再来一局吧，这次我要稍微换个玩法。

entries.en: However I do not respect your strategy.
entries.zh: 不过，我并不认同你的策略。

entries.en: We can play again some other time.
entries.zh: 我们改天可以再玩。

entries.en: I do not respect your strategy.
entries.zh: 我并不认同你的策略。
精彩的对局！

entries.en: It seems like you are always copying my last move.
entries.zh: 看来你一直在模仿我上一回合的选择。

entries.en: I believe that is the optimal strategy, a method I find both practically and theoretically sound.
entries.zh: 我认为这就是最优策略，无论实践还是理论，都站得住脚。

entries.en: I want you to have this gift, I made it myself.
entries.zh: 这份礼物送给你，是我亲手做的。

entries.en: The Ubik's Cube allows you to play this game with anyone else in The Rift.
entries.zh: 有了尤比克魔方，你就能和裂隙里的任何人玩这个游戏。

entries.en: Additionally, take this Enigma Soul as a token of our intellectual camaraderie.
entries.zh: 另外，收下这个谜魂吧，纪念我们这份智者间的友谊。

entries.en: Select an option: [I lost my Ubik's Cube.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [我的尤比克魔方丢了。]

entries.en: Take good care of this one.
entries.zh: 这一个可要好好保管。
玩得开心。
都走这么远了……
结果这里什么都没有！
请选择: [传送回去]
恶魂喷出来的都是化学尾迹！
我们根本没去过末地！
Minecraft 的世界是圆的！

entries.en: Biggest of all, Big Mayor is always watching!!!
entries.zh: 最要命的是，老大市长一直在盯着我们！!!

entries.en: They hacked me, I'm telling you!
entries.zh: 我跟你说，他们把我黑了！

entries.en: All the cables are gray now!
entries.zh: 现在所有缆线都成灰色的了！

entries.en: I don't want gray, I hate gray!
entries.zh: 我不要灰色，我讨厌灰色！

entries.en: Take this Visor, follow the cables and hack them back!!!
entries.zh: 拿上这个目镜，沿着缆线找过去，再黑回去！!!
你把我的目镜弄丢了？

entries.en: No problem! I got tons of them!
entries.zh: 没事！我多的是！
用目镜。
紧紧沿着缆线走。
黑进那些终端。
选择正确的颜色吧。
又不是什么高深学问。

entries.en: I see you've hacked all the terminals, that's good...
entries.zh: 我看到你已经黑进所有终端了，很好……

entries.en: But you have to set them to the proper colors so I can hack their nexus!!!
entries.zh: 但你得把它们设成正确的颜色才行，这样我才能黑进他们的中枢！!!
哇，%1$s，你做到了！

entries.en: Now that their own network is working against them, I can start working on infiltrating Big Mayor.
entries.zh: 现在他们自己的网络反过来对付他们了，我终于可以着手渗透老大市长那边了。

entries.en: Shouldn't the reward of video games be the fun you've had playing them?
entries.zh: 玩电子游戏的奖励，不就应该是玩的过程中的乐趣吗？
好吧好吧……
这个旧东西你拿去吧。

entries.en: Thank you for stopping Big Mayor from watching my every moves.
entries.zh: 谢谢你，让老大市长没法再监视我的一举一动。

entries.en: My math homework is way too hard!
entries.zh: 我的数学作业难死了！

entries.en: Prime Minister Barry should do my homework!!!
entries.zh: 首相巴里就应该替我写作业！!!
我的作业是这么问的……

entries.en: If Mary is 10 years old and Jamie is 25.
entries.zh: 假设玛丽今年 10 岁，而杰米今年 25 岁。

entries.en: And considering that Mary's time flows 2 and a half times faster than Jamie's...
entries.zh: 而且玛丽的时间流速是杰米的 2.5 倍……

entries.en: In how long will Mary be the same age as Jamie?
entries.zh: 再过多久，玛丽才会和杰米一样大？
15 年后？等等……
不行，这根本不对。

entries.en: Why don't you ask Barry instead of trying to think for yourself.
entries.zh: 你别自己瞎琢磨了，去问问巴里不行吗。

entries.en: That's why I thought at first, but my teacher told me I'm stupid.
entries.zh: 我一开始也是这么想的，可老师说我笨。

entries.en: Lemme see... In 10 years they will both be 35 years old.
entries.zh: 让我算算……10 年后，他们都是 35 岁。

entries.en: Incredible! How did you figure it out??
entries.zh: 太厉害了！你怎么算出来的？?

entries.en: Wait actually, I prefer choosing ignorance.
entries.zh: 等等，还是算了。我宁愿不知道。

entries.en: A Prime Minister who can help with your homework?
entries.zh: 一位能帮你写作业的首相？

entries.en: Truly someone deserving of their title!
entries.zh: 真是实至名归啊！
欢迎来到裂隙维度，%1$s!

entries.en: I remember meeting you, out there.
entries.zh: 我记得见过你，就在外面的世界。

entries.en: Select an option: [What is this place?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [这里是什么地方？]
我们在一个独立的维度里。
大概可以说是另一个宇宙。

entries.en: Both marvelous and dangerous at the same time.
entries.zh: 这里既奇妙又危险。
不过，听仔细了。

entries.en: Some SkyBlock dwellers feel lost here.
entries.zh: 有些空岛居民到了这里会觉得迷茫。

entries.en: Always anxious of laying out their own path.
entries.zh: 他们总是担心，不敢走出自己的路。

entries.en: I can help you with finding a path, literally.
entries.zh: 我能帮你找条路，字面意义上的那种。
来，拿着这些面包屑。

entries.en: Select an option: [Teleport to the Wizard's Path]
entries.zh: 请选择: [传送到巫师小径]
这么快就迷路啦？

entries.en: I can take you back to my path!
entries.zh: 我可以带你回到我的小径上！

entries.en: Now set a path for yourself.
entries.zh: 现在，给自己铺一条路吧。

entries.en: Use the breadcrumbs on the yellow particles.
entries.zh: 把面包屑用在黄色粒子上。

entries.en: Now that you've laid out a path, you have at least one thing to do if you follow it!
entries.zh: 路已经铺好了，沿着它走，至少就有一件事可做了！

entries.en: Some of us prefer a clear path ahead, while others would rather explore on their own.
entries.zh: 有些人喜欢前路清晰，有些人则更愿意自己探索。

entries.en: Either is fine! One has to experience the universe at their own pace.
entries.zh: 都很好！每个人都该按自己的节奏去认识这个宇宙。

entries.en: One thing is certain, dropping breadcrumbs everywhere would take too long!
entries.zh: 不过有一点我很确定: 到处撒面包屑可太费时间了！

entries.en: That's why we wizards have prepared the Rift Guide, in case you're unsure what to do.
entries.zh: 所以，我们这些巫师准备了裂隙指南，不知道该做什么时就看看吧。

entries.en: The greatest magic comes from the courage to venture into the unknown.
entries.zh: 最伟大的魔法，来自踏入未知的勇气。

entries.en: An entity we call Enigma has decided to live at the base of the tower.
entries.zh: 有个我们称作伊尼格玛的存在，决定住在塔底。
我几乎理解不了它。

entries.en: Fear is a barrier to adventure, but embracing it can lead to magical experiences.
entries.zh: 恐惧是冒险的障碍，但试着接纳它，也许就能收获奇妙的经历。

entries.en: I wonder where Barry is now. He was the first to step into the portal after we opened it.
entries.zh: 不知道巴里现在在哪儿。他是传送门开启后第一个走进去的人。

entries.en: When you believe in the magic of the world around you, anything is possible.
entries.zh: 只要你相信身边这个世界的魔法，一切皆有可能。
我就是巫师侠！

entries.en: How are you doing little fellow?
entries.zh: 小家伙，你还好吗？

entries.en: Do you need the help of Wizardman?
entries.zh: 需要巫师侠帮忙吗？

entries.en: All you have to do is scream "Help Wizardman!" and I'll come save you if I'm not too busy.
entries.zh: 你只要大喊“Help 巫师侠！”，只要我不太忙，就会赶来救你。

entries.en: Sorry young companion, someone needs me!
entries.zh: 抱歉，小伙伴，有人需要我！
我得闪人了。

entries.en: Sorry little fellow, I'm busy right now!
entries.zh: 抱歉，小家伙，我现在正忙着呢！

entries.en: Maybe don't disturb me when I'm trying to save the multiverse!
entries.zh: 我拯救多元宇宙的时候，能不能别来打扰！

entries.en: It's Wizardman! He has truly arrived!
entries.zh: 是巫师侠！他真的来了！
巫师侠来救场了。

entries.en: What kind of pickle are you in?
entries.zh: 你们碰上什么麻烦了？

entries.en: Select an option: [He barricaded himself inside, can you help us break in?]
entries.zh: 请选择: [他把自己关在里面了，你能帮我们闯进去吗？]
没问题，小家伙。

entries.en: Back off and watch the pro.
entries.zh: 往后站，看专业人士的。
我的任务完成了。
回见，菜鸟们。

entries.en: Ah, it's you. I've been expecting your arrival.
entries.zh: 啊，是你。我一直在等你来。
我就知道你会来。

entries.en: I've seen hundreds of iterations of you, all from different dimensions, who have come before me seeking to claim the title of Wizardman.
entries.zh: 我已经见过几百个你，来自不同的维度，都来到我面前，想要继承巫师侠的名号。

entries.en: If you aspire to take my place, you must first defeat me.
entries.zh: 想接替我，就先打败我。

entries.en: Are you ready to rise above your predecessors?
entries.zh: 你准备好超越那些前来挑战的人了吗？

entries.en: Are you prepared to succeed where they have faltered?
entries.zh: 你准备好在他们失败的地方，取得成功了吗？
请选择: [当然。]

entries.en: Excellent. Let's find out if you are merely another echo, or if you are the one.
entries.zh: 很好。让我看看，你是又一道回声，还是那个命中注定的人。

entries.en: Choose from the three Trials before you.
entries.zh: 从眼前的三项试炼中选一项吧。

entries.en: Each is designed to test your mettle in its own unique way.
entries.zh: 每一项都会用独特的方式，考验你的本领。

entries.en: You now have enough Fragments to assemble my Armor.
entries.zh: 你已经有足够的残片，可以做出我的盔甲了。

entries.en: Put on your new armor and speak to me.
entries.zh: 穿上新护甲，再来和我说话。
那么。

entries.en: You are the first one of your kind to defeat me and craft this armor.
entries.zh: 在无数个你之中，你是第一个打败我、做出这套护甲的人。

entries.en: I, too, once stood in your shoes, having overthrown the Wizardman before me.
entries.zh: 我也曾和你一样，击败了上一任巫师侠。

entries.en: It is time for you to become Wizardman.
entries.zh: 现在，轮到你成为巫师侠了。

entries.en: Understand this: Wizardman is not merely a person; it is a concept, a legacy handed down through generations, striving towards a singular dream.
entries.zh: 记住: 巫师侠不只是一个人，更是一种理念，一份代代相传、为同一个梦想奋斗的传承。

entries.en: Together, one of us will eventually mend the rift and repair the Breach atop the mountain.
entries.zh: 只要我们接力前行，终有一人能修复裂隙，补上山顶的裂口。

entries.en: Though I faltered, perhaps you will prevail.
entries.zh: 我没能做到的事，也许你能做到。

entries.en: You are only missing one part of the armor to become Wizardman.
entries.zh: 你只差最后一件护甲，就能成为巫师侠了。
拿着，这是最后一件。
现在，戴上它。

entries.en: You're lucky I keep a spare in my back pocket!
entries.zh: 算你走运，我后口袋里还留了一张备用的！

entries.en: I've been watching over you this whole time...
entries.zh: 其实，我一直都在照看着你……

entries.en: I remember when you proved your identity to the Eleanors...
entries.zh: 我记得，你向埃莉诺证明自己身份的时候……

entries.en: When your blood was first drained by the Riftstalker Bloodfiend...
entries.zh: 你第一次被裂隙潜猎血魔吸干血的时候……

entries.en: When you first went to battle with Bacte...
entries.zh: 你第一次与巴克特交战的时候……

entries.en: When you first ventured deeper into the Living Cave...
entries.zh: 你第一次深入活体洞穴的时候……

entries.en: When you first explored the Village Pla-
entries.zh: 你第一次探索村庄广——

entries.en: Oh... I actually don't remember this...
entries.zh: 哦……这段我还真不记得了……

entries.en: I watched your back as you vacuumed up vermin...
entries.zh: 你忙着吸捕害虫时，我一直在背后保护你……

entries.en: When you murdered the innocent Ramero...
entries.zh: 你杀害无辜的拉梅罗的时候……

entries.en: When you raced around collecting hot dogs for Joey McPizza...
entries.zh: 你为乔伊·麦克披萨四处奔走收集热狗的时候……

entries.en: When you were on the hunt for Enigma Souls...
entries.zh: 你四处寻找谜魂的时候……

entries.en: When you wandered past the Montezuma fragments...
entries.zh: 你从蒙特祖玛碎片旁路过的时候……

entries.en: When you first learned to count to 10...
entries.zh: 你第一次学会数到 10 的时候……
我们第一次见面的时候……

entries.en: All you have to do is scream "Help Wizardman" and I'll come save you if I'm not too busy.
entries.zh: 你只要大喊“Help 巫师侠”，只要我不太忙，就会赶来救你。

entries.en: So, you believe you can outpace me in a Temporal Race?
entries.zh: 这么说，你觉得能在时间竞速中跑赢我？
志气倒是不小。

entries.en: Follow me to the Trial Grounds, let's put that confidence to the test.
entries.zh: 跟我去试炼场吧，看看你的本事配不配得上这份自信。

entries.en: The rules are straightforward. Once you signal readiness, we race.
entries.zh: 规则很简单。你一示意准备好了，我们就开跑。

entries.en: Have you grasped all the details, little one?
entries.zh: 小家伙，都弄明白了吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [Yep.] [Actually, I want to do something else.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [明白了。] [其实，我想换个项目。]

entries.en: Remember, we race when you signal readiness.
entries.zh: 记住，你一示意准备好了，我们就开跑。

entries.en: Let's race! Good luck to you!
entries.zh: 开跑吧！祝你好运！

entries.en: No one can match these raw skillz!
entries.zh: 这硬实力，谁能比得上！

entries.en: You are proving quite formidable... well played.
entries.zh: 你还真是个劲敌……跑得漂亮。
你追不上我的！

entries.en: I'm the best! Me, Wizardman! The best!
entries.zh: 我最强！我，巫师侠！最强！

entries.en: Nicely done! I didn't see that coming.
entries.zh: 干得漂亮！这一下我可没想到。
一点小挫折罢了……

entries.en: Ah, a clever tactic! You've set me back.
entries.zh: 啊，这招不错！居然让我倒退了。
哎呀！平时可不会这样！
你什么也没看见……

entries.en: Already? But I haven't finished yet!
entries.zh: 这就到了？可我还没跑完啊！

entries.en: This is a shocking turn of events!
entries.zh: 居然会变成这样！
等等，什么？怎么会……?
我赢了。哈！

entries.en: That must be a new personal best for me!
entries.zh: 这肯定刷新了我的个人纪录！
我就知道我会赢！
%1$s，这次冲线真是精彩。

entries.en: You have bested me, this time.
entries.zh: 这次，是你胜过了我。

entries.en: For your victory, you have earned a Fragment of my armor.
entries.zh: 作为获胜的奖励，你赢得了一块我的护甲残片。

entries.en: Keep it safe, for it is a piece of my power.
entries.zh: 好好保管，它承载着我的一部分力量。

entries.en: Once again, victory eludes you in the face of Wizardman, as it has for your countless predecessors.
entries.zh: 和无数前来挑战的人一样，你再次败在了巫师侠面前。

entries.en: Would you care to challenge me again, or would you prefer to attempt a different Trial?
entries.zh: 你想再挑战一次，还是换一项试炼？

entries.en: Select an option: [Let's race again.] [I would like to do another trial.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [再比一次竞速吧。] [我想换一项试炼。]

entries.en: Oh, you need a moment? Let's go back so you can decide what to do next.
entries.zh: 哦，需要缓一缓？我们先回去，让你想想接下来做什么。
你选择了乱斗。

entries.en: Very well then, to the Wizard Brawl we go.
entries.zh: 那好，出发去巫师乱斗吧。

entries.en: To aid you in our duel, you will need this magical wand.
entries.zh: 为了能和我决斗，你需要这根魔杖。

entries.en: This legendary item once vanquished a dire menace to humanity in my home dimension.
entries.zh: 这件传说之物，曾在我的故乡维度消灭过一个威胁全人类的可怕敌人。

entries.en: Today, it shall serve us in our brawl.
entries.zh: 今天，就让它为我们的乱斗出一份力。

entries.en: The rules here are simple: In this arena, you may fly, like Wizardman.
entries.zh: 这里的规则很简单: 在这座竞技场里，你可以像巫师侠一样飞行。

entries.en: The first to deplete the other's ❤ Hearts shall be declared the winner.
entries.zh: 谁先耗尽对方的 ❤ 心数，谁就获胜。
准备好了吗？
请选择: [放马过来吧！]
那么，乱斗开始！

entries.en: I have people waiting for me. I cannot stay.
entries.zh: 还有人在等我，我不能一直待在这里。

entries.en: Come back when you're actually ready!
entries.zh: 真正准备好了再来！

entries.en: You handle yourself well, but it's far from over.
entries.zh: 身手不错，不过离结束还早。

entries.en: Let's see if your endurance matches your spirit.
entries.zh: 看看你的耐力能不能跟上这股斗志。

entries.en: Well done! You've proven more formidable than I had anticipated.
entries.zh: 干得好！你比我预想的更难对付。
真是惊人的毅力！

entries.en: But beware, desperation lends me strength.
entries.zh: 不过小心了，绝境会给我力量。

entries.en: You've pushed me to the brink.
entries.zh: 你已经把我逼到极限了。

entries.en: But don't underestimate a Wizardman's last stand.
entries.zh: 但别小看巫师侠的背水一战。

entries.en: It seems I may have met my match.
entries.zh: 看来，我遇上对手了。

entries.en: You have bested me, a feat none other can claim.
entries.zh: 你打败了我。这可是谁都没做到过的事。

entries.en: Hold this triumph close, as many will look to challenge it.
entries.zh: 珍惜这份胜利吧，想挑战它的人可不会少。

entries.en: For your victory, you've earned a Fragment of my armor.
entries.zh: 作为获胜的奖励，你赢得了一块我的护甲残片。

entries.en: It appears you're not quite ready to play in the league of wizards, little fellow.
entries.zh: 小家伙，看来你还没准备好跻身巫师的行列。

entries.en: Reflect, learn, and try once more.
entries.zh: 好好想想，学学教训，再来一次吧。

entries.en: Ah, little fellow, it seems this isn't your moment.
entries.zh: 啊，小家伙，看来这次还没轮到你。

entries.en: Return when the gaps in your skill are filled.
entries.zh: 把欠缺的本领练好再来吧。

entries.en: Select an option: [Let's brawl again.] [I would like to do another trial.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [再来一场乱斗吧。] [我想换一项试炼。]

entries.en: Remember, never let your guard down. Defeat me in battle!
entries.zh: 记住，任何时候都别放松警惕。在战斗中打败我吧！

entries.en: Select an option: [I get it. Let's fight!]
entries.zh: 请选择: [明白了。开打吧！]
来吧。

entries.en: Ah, the Quad Link Legacy! A personal favorite of mine.
entries.zh: 啊，传承四连棋！我最喜欢的项目之一。

entries.en: Prepare yourself for a battle of wits.
entries.zh: 准备来一场智慧的较量吧。

entries.en: Would you like to review the rules?
entries.zh: 需要我讲一遍规则吗？

entries.en: Select an option: [Yes please!] [No thanks.] [No, please don't ask me again.]
entries.zh: 请选择: [好，麻烦你了！] [不用，谢谢。] [不用了，以后也别问了。]

entries.en: Each turn, we will choose a column to drop a colored token into the lowest open slot.
entries.zh: 每一回合，我们各选一列，把自己的彩色棋子落进那一列最底下的空位。

entries.en: The first to align four tokens of their color in a row claims victory!
entries.zh: 谁先让自己的四枚棋子连成一线，谁就获胜！

entries.en: Now that you know the rules, let's begin.
entries.zh: 规则明白了，那就开始吧。
好，那就开始吧。

entries.en: Very well. I will not ask you again.
entries.zh: 好。我不会再问了。

entries.en: What could %1$s be thinking right now?
entries.zh: 不知道 %1$s 现在在想什么？

entries.en: I'm thinking two steps ahead... hmmm...
entries.zh: 我得往后多想两步……嗯……

entries.en: Hmmmm, what can I play to win?
entries.zh: 嗯……怎么下才能赢呢？

entries.en: Do not rush the almighty Wizardman.
entries.zh: 不许催促全能的巫师侠。
下得漂亮！

entries.en: It seems I've underestimated your capacity for foresight and planning.
entries.zh: 看来，我低估了你预判和布局的本事。

entries.en: We will complete our match one day, little one.
entries.zh: 小家伙，总有一天我们会把这盘棋下完的。

entries.en: Ah, it seems the depths of wisdom still elude you.
entries.zh: 啊，看来你还没摸到智慧的门道。

entries.en: Return when the fogs of ignorance have lifted.
entries.zh: 等你拨开无知的迷雾，再来吧。
真是势均力敌！
可惜，你还是没赢过我。

entries.en: Very well. Let's put your wits to the test.
entries.zh: 好吧。让我考考你的脑子。

entries.en: Do you ever feel like we're just programmed to do certain things in life?
entries.zh: 你有没有觉得，我们只是被安排好了要做某些事，就像程序一样？

entries.en: What made you change your mind?
entries.zh: 那是什么让你改变了想法？

entries.en: There is all sorts of strange magic in this world.
entries.zh: 这世界上有各式各样奇怪的魔法。
有时，实验会出岔子。

entries.en: But nothing that can't be repaired!
entries.zh: 不过没什么是修不好的！
裂隙维度
达到钓鱼技能 V
小提示:
广告:
累计微尘: %1$s
剩余裂隙时间: %1$s
进入裂隙: %1$s 次
巴里是最棒的
空岛市长,
有史以来无人能及。
[#%1$s] %3$s的%2$s训练结束了，现在是 [等级 %4$s]

entries.en: My services aren't for everyone young traveler!
entries.zh: 年轻的旅行者，我的服务并非人人都能享用！

entries.en: Come back to me when you have Taming Skill 10
entries.zh: 达到以下条件后再来找我:驯养技能 10 级
你好呀，冒险者！
来认识一下我可爱的猫头鹰胡蒂！

entries.en: We offer a special service here.
entries.zh: 我们这里提供一项特殊服务。

entries.en: For a small fee, we'll train your pets and help them while you're off doing heroic things.
entries.zh: 只需一点费用，你外出英勇冒险时，我们就会替你训练并照顾宠物。
胡蒂也赞成，相信我！

entries.en: So, interested in leaving your pet with us for a bit?
entries.zh: 所以，有兴趣把宠物暂时留在我们这里吗？

entries.en: Oh my feathers! You sure know how to spoil an owl, don't you?
entries.zh: 哎呀呀！你可真知道怎么宠一只猫头鹰！

entries.en: As a reward for your hard work, I will train an extra pet for you in Slot #%1$s
entries.zh: 作为辛苦付出的奖励，我会额外为你训练一只宠物，放在训练位 #%1$s
你想要我的阿比手机联系方式？

entries.en: Well, I'm usually a bit guarded about that.
entries.zh: 这事嘛，我平常还是挺谨慎的。

entries.en: If you treat Hootie to a Bat the Fish, we might just become fast friends!
entries.zh: 要是你请胡蒂吃一条蝙蝠鱼，咱们很快就能成为好朋友！
哇，胡蒂高兴坏了！

entries.en: Did you know, Bat the Fish only swims at night?
entries.zh: 你知道吗，蝙蝠鱼只在夜里游动。
好吧，你已经证明自己了。

entries.en: I'll add you to my Abiphone contacts!
entries.zh: 我会把你加进阿比手机通讯录！

entries.en: Ready for a fun fact? Owls have asymmetrical ears, helping them pinpoint sounds from different directions. Talk about surround sound!
entries.zh: 来听个小知识？猫头鹰的双耳不对称，能帮它们准确辨别各个方向的声音。自带环绕声呢！

entries.en: Hoo's ready for some owl wisdom? Owls have been symbols of wisdom in various cultures. Makes me wonder what Hootie's pondering!
entries.zh: 谁想听点猫头鹰的智慧？在不少文化里，它们都是智慧的象征。真想知道胡蒂在琢磨什么！

entries.en: Whoo's up for some owl trivia? Did you know owls don't have teeth? They swallow their prey whole. A bit gruesome, but efficient!
entries.zh: 再来点猫头鹰冷知识？它们没有牙齿，猎物都是整个吞下去的。有点吓人，不过效率很高！

entries.en: Did you know some owls like to take baths? Hootie here loves a good splash now and then!
entries.zh: 知道吗，有些猫头鹰喜欢洗澡。胡蒂就喜欢时不时扑腾两下水！

entries.en: Listen to this: The Eurasian Eagle-Owl can live up to 60 years in captivity. Imagine all the wisdom they gather!
entries.zh: 听我说，欧亚雕鸮在人工饲养下能活到 60 岁。想想那得攒下多少智慧啊！

entries.en: Listen to this: Some owls have special feathers for silent flight. Perfect for sneaking up on snacks, or in Hootie's case, a cheeky cuddle!
entries.zh: 有些猫头鹰靠特殊的羽毛悄无声息地飞行。偷袭猎物正合适——至于胡蒂嘛，是偷偷飞来讨个抱抱！

entries.en: Did you know that owls can rotate their heads up to 270 degrees? Hootie's quite the head-turner!
entries.zh: 你知道猫头鹰能把头转到 270 度吗？胡蒂可真是让人回头看的高手！

entries.en: Owls have a third eyelid! It's transparent and helps protect their eyes while they hunt.
entries.zh: 猫头鹰还有第三层眼睑！透明的，捕猎时能保护眼睛。

entries.en: Hoo's up for a flight lesson? Unlike most birds, owls make nearly silent flight possible by the structure of their wing feathers!
entries.zh: 想上堂飞行课吗？猫头鹰翅膀上的羽毛结构和大多数鸟类不同，能让它们几乎无声地飞行！

entries.en: Fancy some trivia? The Barn Owl has the most extensive range of any owl species. They're world travelers, just like you!
entries.zh: 来点小知识？仓鸮是分布范围最广的猫头鹰。和你一样，也是满世界跑的旅行家！

entries.en: Fancy this: The smallest owl in the world is the Elf Owl, about the size of a sparrow. Hootie here thinks they're adorable!
entries.zh: 世界上最小的猫头鹰是姬鸮，大概只有麻雀那么大。胡蒂觉得它们可爱极了！

entries.en: Did you know that owls can't chew? That's why they regurgitate pellets with the parts they can't digest!
entries.zh: 猫头鹰不会咀嚼，你知道吗？所以它们会把消化不了的部分团成食丸，再吐出来！

entries.en: Hoo knew? Owls can actually swim! Though Hootie prefers to keep his feathers dry, thank you very much!
entries.zh: 猜不到吧，猫头鹰其实会游泳！不过胡蒂表示，它的羽毛还是干着比较好！

entries.en: Brace yourself: Some owls have what's called a ‘facial disc,' a feather arrangement that helps funnel sound to their ears. It's like their own personal satellite dish!
entries.zh: 听好了，有些猫头鹰脸上有个羽毛围成的面盘，能把声音集中到耳朵里。就像自带一口卫星锅！

entries.en: You'll love this: Owls have zygodactyl feet, meaning two toes face forward and two face backward. Perfect for gripping prey!
entries.zh: 你会喜欢这个的: 猫头鹰是对趾足，两根脚趾朝前、两根朝后。抓猎物可牢了！

entries.en: Here's a tidbit: Owls have hollow bones, which helps them stay lightweight for flying. It's like nature's own aviation engineering!
entries.zh: 猫头鹰的骨头是中空的，能减轻体重，方便飞行。大自然自己的航空工程！

entries.en: Hold onto your feathers! Some owls have a wingspan that's nearly twice their body length. Talk about aerodynamics!
entries.zh: 可别吓得掉毛！有些猫头鹰的翼展接近体长的两倍，这才叫会飞！

entries.en: Here's a beak-blowing stat: The Great Gray Owl can locate prey under two feet of snow and snatch it up without a sound!
entries.zh: 说个让你惊掉下巴的: 乌林鸮能发现两英尺厚的积雪下的猎物，再悄无声息地抓住它！

entries.en: Have you heard? The Northern Hawk Owl can spot prey from up to half a mile away! That's some keen eyesight!
entries.zh: 听说了吗？猛鸮能看清半英里外的猎物！这眼神可真厉害！

entries.en: Here's something: Owls don't have crops, those pouches some birds have for storing food. They're all about that direct-to-stomach service!
entries.zh: 猫头鹰没有嗉囊——就是有些鸟类用来存食物的小袋子。它们的饭都是直达胃里！

entries.en: Did you know the largest owl is the Blakiston's Fish Owl? Its wingspan can reach up to 6.6 feet! Hootie's a bit envious.
entries.zh: 你知道最大的猫头鹰是毛腿渔鸮吗？翼展能达到 6.6 英尺！胡蒂可有点羡慕了。
咕！

entries.en: Hoot hoot! Talk to Fann again!
entries.zh: 咕咕！再和范恩说说话吧！

entries.en: Mmh... you shouldn't be able to click me right now!
entries.zh: 嗯……现在你应该没法点到我才对！
你想要我的联系方式？!
这要求可真少见！

entries.en: I travel a lot and I'm running quite low on Silent Pearl.
entries.zh: 我常年四处跑，手头的寂静珍珠快用完了。

entries.en: If you bring me 64 of them, I'll give you my contact.
entries.zh: 给我带来 64 个，我就把联系方式给你。

entries.en: Great! Silent Pearls can be pretty useful sometimes.
entries.zh: 太好了！无声珍珠有时候可真能派上用场。

entries.en: Hi! Check back later for information on the next Traveling Zoo!
entries.zh: 你好！过阵子再来问问下一次巡回动物园的消息吧！

entries.zh: 你协助击杀的敌人有 %1$s% 几率掉落一颗任何人都能拾取的宝珠。宝珠会治疗拾取者，并给予一个随机增益。

entries.en: Healing a player that is full health will convert the healing into an absorption shield up to %1$s% of their health.
entries.zh: 治疗满血的玩家时，溢出的治疗量会转化为伤害吸收护盾，最多为其生命值的 %1$s%。

entries.en: Launches a healing orb that creates a healing circle where it lands. The healing circle heals friendly players inside for %1$s% of their health every second.
entries.zh: 发射一颗治疗宝珠，在落点生成治疗法阵。法阵每秒为其中的友方玩家恢复 %1$s% 生命值。

entries.en: Heals everyone in your group to full health and grants them a shield for %1$s% of their maximum health. The cooldown is reduced by %2$s seconds for every player below %3$s% health.
entries.zh: 将队伍中所有人的生命值恢复至满，并给予相当于其最大生命值 %1$s% 的护盾。每有一名玩家生命值低于 %3$s%，冷却时间缩短 %2$s 秒。

entries.en: Those attacks deal %1$s% of their melee damage (increased by your Intelligence) up to %2$s blocks, after which damage is reduced.
entries.zh: 这些攻击造成其近战伤害 %1$s% 的伤害（受你的智力加成），射程最远 %2$s 格，超出后伤害降低。

entries.en: Shoots a Guided Sheep, dealing damage based on your Mage level!
entries.zh: 发射一只引导绵羊，根据你的法师等级造成伤害！

entries.en: Unleash a Thunderstorm, striking enemies in a %1$s block radius for %2$s seconds, dealing damage based on your Mage level!
entries.zh: 释放一场雷暴，在 %2$s 秒内打击 %1$s 格范围内的敌人，根据你的法师等级造成伤害！

entries.en: Create a %1$sx%2$s wall at the block you are looking at which lasts for %3$s seconds.
entries.zh: 在你注视的方块处生成一堵 %1$sx%2$s 的墙，持续 %3$s 秒。

entries.en: Shoots a fireball, dealing damage based on your Mage level!
entries.zh: 发射一颗火球，根据你的法师等级造成伤害！

entries.en: Use this class in a Dungeon to level it up!
entries.zh: 在地牢中使用此职业即可升级！

entries.en: Increase your Mage Level to unlock Perks, statistic bonuses, and more!
entries.zh: 提升你的法师等级以解锁天赋、属性加成等更多内容！

entries.en: Your next hit after killing a monster deals %1$s% increased damage. This bonus will expire after %2$s seconds. Reduces the cooldown remaining on Throwing Axe by %3$s second on activation. Heals you for %4$s% of your missing health every hit.
entries.zh: 击杀怪物后的下一次攻击伤害提高 %1$s%，加成 %2$s 秒后失效。触发时飞斧的剩余冷却缩短 %3$s 秒。每次攻击恢复你已损失生命值的 %4$s%。

entries.en: Every time you hit an enemy, increases the damage you deal to that enemy by %1$s% up to a maximum of %2$s%.
entries.zh: 每次攻击敌人时，你对该敌人造成的伤害提高 %1$s%，最多提高 %2$s%。

entries.en: Your melee weapons hit up to %1$s enemies within your swing range in a frontal cone. Increases your maximum swing range by %2$s blocks.
entries.zh: 你的近战武器可命中前方锥形挥击范围内最多 %1$s 名敌人。最大挥击范围增加 %2$s 格。

entries.en: Throw an Axe, dealing the same damage as your highest hit in the last minute.
entries.zh: 掷出一把斧，造成与你最近一分钟内最高单次伤害相同的伤害。

entries.en: Throw a potion which temporarily gives all teammates in a %1$s block radius +%2$s Strength.

entries.en: Throw an Axe, dealing damage based on your Berserk level!

entries.en: Temporarily stuns any non-boss dungeon monster for a short period of time when shot.

entries.en: %1$s% chance for your arrows to bounce to an additional target.
entries.zh: 你的箭有 %1$s% 的几率弹射到额外一个目标。

entries.zh: 射出一轮 %1$s 支箭，命中时爆炸，对 %2$s 格范围内造成与你最近一分钟内最高弓箭单次伤害相同的伤害。

entries.en: Divert %1$s% of the damage taken by your teammates within %2$s blocks around you.

entries.en: A Seismic Wave emerges from underneath you and travels in a straight line. Deals %1$s +%2$s% every +%3$s Defense in damage to any enemy in its path.
entries.zh: 一道地震波从你脚下涌出并沿直线前进，对路径上的所有敌人造成 %1$s 点伤害，每 +%3$s  防御额外提高 +%2$s%。

entries.en: Fortifies your defence, reducing the damage you take by %1$s% for %2$s seconds. Also aggros all enemies in a %3$s block radius.
entries.zh: 强化你的防御，在 %2$s 秒内受到的伤害降低 %1$s%。同时吸引 %3$s 格范围内所有敌人的仇恨。

entries.en: All Foraging Axes can be thrown while on Galatea.
entries.zh: 在加拉蒂亚时，所有伐木斧都可以掷出。

entries.en: However, throwing your axe reduces the amount of logs you obtain by half! So only throw when needed.
entries.zh: 不过，掷斧会使你获得的原木减半！所以只在需要时再掷。

entries.en:  Sweep increases the amount of logs you can cut in a row with your axes.
entries.zh:  横扫决定你用斧头一次能连续砍下多少原木。

entries.en: Tree toughness HEAVILY reduces the effect of  Sweep.
entries.zh: 树木的韧性会大幅削弱  横扫的效果。

entries.en: Each tree has a different style!
entries.zh: 每种树的砍伐风格都不同！

entries.en: Cutting logs of a tree in the wrong order will also reduce the amount of logs you obtain by half!
entries.zh: 砍树的顺序不对，获得的原木同样会减半！

entries.en: There are bushes throughout Galatea that periodically grow Berries. Simply click the bushes to collect them.
entries.zh: 加拉蒂亚各处的灌木丛会定期长出浆果，点击灌木丛即可采集。

entries.en: And who knows, you might even wake up some creatures inside of them!
entries.zh: 说不定还会吵醒藏在里面的生物！

entries.en: You want to know exactly what is happening when you cut a Tree? With this chat message you will see all the details you need to understand if you are cutting trees correctly!
entries.zh: 想知道砍树时到底发生了什么吗？开启这条聊天消息，你就能看到判断自己是否砍对所需的全部细节！

entries.en: Show death messages when other players die.

entries.en: Receive a message when someone bids on one of your auctions.
entries.zh: 有人对你的拍卖出价时收到消息。

entries.zh: 进入区域时是否在动作栏显示区域名。

entries.en: When enabled, a distinct sound will play when a fish reaches the bobber.

entries.zh: 开启后，钓鱼时会显示全息文字作为辅助。

entries.en: Play music when you enter zones or other circumstances.

entries.en: Hear the sound effect when an Ability is on cooldown.
entries.zh: 技能冷却中时播放音效。

entries.en: Place this minion and it will start generating and chopping acacia logs! Requires an open area to place trees.
entries.zh: 放置此小人后，它会开始生成并砍伐金合欢原木！需要一片空地来种树。

entries.en: Place this minion and it will start generating and chopping birch logs! Requires an open area to place trees.
entries.zh: 放置此小人后，它会开始生成并砍伐白桦原木！需要一片空地来种树。

entries.en: Place this minion and it will start generating and slaying Blazes!
entries.zh: 放置此小人后，它会开始生成并击杀烈焰人！

entries.en: Place this minion and it will start generating and harvesting cactus. Requires sand nearby so cacti can be planted.
entries.zh: 放置此小人后，它会开始生成并收获仙人掌。需要附近有沙子来种植仙人掌。

entries.en: Place this minion and it will start generating and harvesting carrots. Requires dirt or soil nearby so carrots can be planted.
entries.zh: 放置此小人后，它会开始生成并收获胡萝卜。需要附近有泥土或耕地来种植胡萝卜。

entries.en: Place this minion and it will start generating and slaying Chickens!
entries.zh: 放置此小人后，它会开始生成并击杀鸡！

entries.en: Place this minion and it will start generating and mining clay! Requires an open area to place clay.
entries.zh: 放置此小人后，它会开始生成并挖掘黏土！需要一片空地来放置黏土。

entries.zh: 放置此小人后，它会开始生成并收获可可豆。需要附近有丛林原木来放置可可果，或有空位来放置丛林原木。

entries.en: Add the Chicken Pet to your Pets Menu.

entries.en: Talk to Hattie in the Backwater Bayou.
entries.zh: 与死水河岸的哈蒂交谈。

entries.en: Wait for Beth to revisit your Garden again.
entries.zh: 等待贝丝再次拜访你的花园。
